The series is set 150 years after humanity lost half of the planet due to a mysterious "black fog." To contain the "black fog," 3,000-meter-tall (about 10,000-feel-tall) walls were erected to split the world, and the half of the human population that survived now live in cities called "Arks."

Shidou Enishi, one of the few Japanese survivors, runs a detective agency on the ninth ark. While pursuing a male suspect in a burglary, he learns of a massive conspiracy, one that may be tied to the Rivig

title: Sennen Meikyuu no Nana Ouji: Eikyuu Kairou no Kishi
author: Aikawa, Yuu, Atori, Haruno

title: Blue Bird
author: Lee, So Young
description:
When the blue bird sings, it brought it's owner happiness. However, when the blue bird dies.. They can only be resurrected when the owner sacrifices something that they cherish...The cycle repeats until the owner has nothing left to offer as sacrifice, leaving the owners with nothing to cherish and no blue bird to sing to them. Yuria is the owner of a blue bird... a blue bird someone wants to steal away from her. Will Yuria be able to protect her blue bird and find her own happiness? 

(Source:

title: Manner of Death
author: Sammon, Umemoto, Yukari
description: When the skilled coroner Dr. Bunnakit is called to examine the body of his childhood friend after her "suicide," he soon determines that she was actually murdered. That night, a mysterious stranger threatens him, telling him to rule her death a suicide—and after he confides in his prosecutor friend about this incident, his friend suddenly goes missing. But all hope is not lost, as a young lecturer named Tan offers to help him get to the bottom of all this—which would be more reassuring if Tan we

title: The Girl Who Sees Smells
author: Maanchwee
description:
Girl who can see the smell in a visual particles. She use her ability to solve the incident with a rookie police officer.

(Source: MU)

title: Bishoku Tantei Akechi Gorou
author: Higashimura, Akiko
description:
The "Tokyo Gourmet Club" meets once a month in order to eat delicious foods. During one of these sessions, Inspector Katoono receives a phone call: the corpses of a man and woman were found in the same hotel. The cause of death is poisoning. Using the information and connections within the hotel that Inspector Akechi gives him, and involving Ichigo, he sets off on this investigation.

(Source: MU)

title: Twelfth Night
author: Muryu
description:
Flames spread like disease as the royal palace falls victim to murder led by greed and betrayal. Forced to escape from the catastrophe, two young survivors seek help from a courtesan of Yu Hyangru. To reclaim what has been lost, the plan is set within the heroic guise of the Crimson Moon. However, as the mysteries of the past begins to resurface and dark secrets start to unwind, a cruel fate awaits for each and every encounter.

(Source: SpotToon)

title: Gekijouban Mononoke: Karakasa
author: Nagata, Kitsuneko
description:
Asa and Kame meet on their first day of serving in the Ooku—and quickly discover that things there are more complicated than they imagined. A strange cult, an unexplained delay in a palace festival, and even samurai in the Ooku are just some of the oddities they encounter. And what does the Medicine Seller, who peddles love potions and mononoke exorcisms, have to do with any of this...?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Trouble Is My Business
author: Taniguchi, Jiro, Sekikawa, Natsuo
description: Joutaro Fukamachi is a private investigator and has the motto of "Trouble is my business," which was inspired by the story of his idol Raymond Chandler. He dreams of being a second Philip Marlowe, but still has ways to go. His agency called Shark resides in the adjoining room of a dentist's office, and Joutaro's most fearsome weapon is the use of the strongest human muscle: his jaw. He bites his opponent and doesn't let go again.

title: One of Them Is My Wife
author: Kudou

title: Re:teen: Mayu no Naka de Mou Ichido 10-dai no Kimi to Au
author: Oohori, Yutaka, Date, Masanori

title: Platonic Chain
author: Toono, Yama, Watanabe, Kozy
description: Everyone carries a camera phone, one of many different types of security cameras. This certain country has access to all the supercomputers that gather information from those cameras. Those who have access have hacked the network and call it "Platonic Chain."

title: Canaan Sfill
author: Sasameyuki, Jun
description: A spin-off manga connecting the anime Canaan with the game 428: Fuusa sareta Shibuya de.

title: Mimi ga Kieta Hi
author: Isuzu
description: At the news that her best friend Mimi was missing, Tsukino began frequenting the rabbit hutch more so than before. One day she sees a boy she's never seen before, and a twisted truth is unfolded.

title: I Killed Him
author: Jeong, Haeyeon, Jeong Dongsaeng
description: Attorney Kim Mooil usually only takes simple copyright cases to keep his practice afloat, so when his landlord comes to him and confesses to killing one of his tenants, Mooil thinks it'll be an open-and-shut case. But the day before they're to go to the police, his landlord seemingly takes his own life. As Mooil and his team of sleuths try to solve this mystery, he learns the incident may be linked to a police cover-up, revenge porn, and a murder from seven years ago. So much for open-and-shut!

title: Arashi no Hana Murakumo no Uta
author: Saiki, Keita
description:
Alternative reality of Manchukuo filled with military disputes and dangerous mystical beings, where humans and monsters fight each other. In the year 1932 a little boy survives a horrible train crash. Seven years later in Harbin city, he meets a beautiful and mysterious gypsy girl from an ancient Clan of Shinnou. This destined meeting is only the beginning of a larger story that like a spider's web gets everyone caught in the chaos of the upcoming war.

(Source: Lila Wolves)

title: Killed Again, Mr. Detective.
author: Riichu, Teniwoha
description:
Sakuya Otsuki is the son of a legendary detective, working to follow in his father's footsteps with his assistant, Lilithea. However, something's different about this high-school sleuth. Wherever he goes, he always manages to get himself entangled in his cases—as a murder victim! When Sakuya is tasked to infiltrate a luxury cruise ship, he finds himself killed once again. But every time he reopens his eyes, Lilithea is there by his side, ready to help him get to the bottom of the mystery...

(So

title: Sharin no Kuni, Himawari no Shoujo
author: Usami, Wataru
description:
In the near future. In a not so distant place. There exists a society where law is based upon deterrence and criminals are assigned "obligations" fitting for their crimes. Within this society, a man named Morita Kenichi aspires to the position of Special High Class Individual, one who holds authority over said criminals.

For the purpose of fulfilling his ambition, Kenichi returns to the town he once called home. There he will encounter three girls bearing "obligations" and there he will encount

title: Kuusou Garou
author: Minakami, Kaori
description:
The spring when Minori passed her middle-school entrance exams, her granny called her to her atelier and drew a good-luck charm on Minori's back to protect her. But then, her granny passed away without telling her from what she had to be protected from. She only said that when Minori enters high-school she must never ever enter the art-gallery at night. But now Minori is in the art-club. Will she be able to stay away from the Art Gallery as she promised?

(Source: Aerandria)

title: Shinrei Tantei Yakumo: Another Files
author: Kaminaga, Manabu, Suzuki, Yasushi
description: Series of Shinrei Tantei Yakumo side stories.

title: Kugiko-chan
author: PEACH‐PIT
description: A chibi manga that was based on Kugiko-san.

title: 12-nin no Yasashii Koroshiya - Libra: Kuroki Shinpan
author: Fujieda, Toru

title: The Summer of the Ubume
author: Kyougoku, Natsuhiko
description: A bizarre set of mysteries have befallen the Kuonji household. Kyoko Kuonji is said to be with child for the last twenty months, and her husband Makio disappeared a few months prior to the pregnancy. The odd circumstances have left the family with no one to turn to for help, until a freelance writer asks his exorcist friend to take on the case. The catch—the exorcist does not believe in ghosts. To Akihiko "Kyogokudo" Chuzenji, the supernatural is as much metaphysical and mental as it is unearthl

title: Killed Again, Mr. Detective?
author: Teniwoha, Inaba
description:
Sakuya Otsuki is the son of a legendary detective, working to follow in his father's footsteps with his assistant, Lilithea. However, something's different about this high-school sleuth. Wherever he goes, he always manages to get himself entangled in his cases—as a murder victim! When Sakuya is tasked to infiltrate a luxury cruise ship, he finds himself killed once again. But every time he reopens his eyes, Lilithea is there by his side, ready to help him get to the bottom of the mystery...

(So

title: Shirube no Michi
author: Konno, Kita
description: Six short stories about the passage from life to death.

title: Yukito
author: Monden, Akiko, Oosawa, Arimasa
description: The story take place in the Kabukicho district of Shinjuku. A man from the north, appeared in the area. We do not know who he is. But soon it will be mayhem. It will then attract the attention of a young inspector.

title: Puzzle
author: Sanbe, Kei, Yamada, Yuusuke
description: High school student Azusa jumps off from the rooftop of a school building, but she survives. One month later, the school is taken over by group of people wearing bizarre masks. A pregnant teacher is imprisoned, while the head director of the school and male students disappear. Azusa then finds pieces of a puzzle in an envelope given to her by classmate Shigeo. The puzzle pieces holds the key to solve the case. Azusa chases after Shigeo and she sees something which is unimaginable.

title: Black Out
author: Asaki, Masashi, Kisaragi, Ryu
description:
Kuroki has been asked to replace an injured pitcher in Koshien,and he performs well until an accident happens at the last inning. His team is lost. After the game, Kuroki sees a smile on the face of Suzuki who missed to catch the ball at the last inning. Unable to hold his anger, Kuroki causes a fight. As a result, his school is banned from Koshien.

Two years later, Kuroki, who has not attend school since then, receives a mysterious letter from Suzuki, and shortly after that, he sees the news a

title: Aoi Haru no Subete
author: Horiguchi, Yukiko, Anda, Sadanatsu
description:
"If you could redo your high school life one more time, what would you do?"

A mysterious power, "Syndrome," which is contracted simply by enrolling into Wazuki High School.

Due to that power, Yokosuka Hiroto had his time forcefully rewound three years back. Without knowing the circumstances, nor who's ability was responsible, what he was left with were merely faint memories. In this situation the goal Hiroto set for himself was: To make these three blank years into the best high school experie

title: Sea View
author: Kano, Ayumi
description:
Collection of 2 short series.

1)  Sea View -- (Umi no Mieru Yane)
3 chapters and an extra
Kei's grandfather is a well-known architect, and the young boy cherishes every letter from his beloved relative...until the notes suddenly stop.  Now, Kei, must visit his grandfather's distant island home and solve the mystery for himself!  Upon arriving, he meets the shy and aloof Michiru, a serious student at the school where his grandfather once taught.  Michiru may have the answers to Kei's burning que

title: Part Threes
author: Kawashita, Mizuki, NISIO, ISIN
description: The story follows Miki Mikimoto and her fellow student council members as they attempt to solve the mystery of a braid thief in their school.

title: Shiki
author: Ono, Fuyumi
description: The story takes place in particularly hot summer in 1994, in a small quiet Japanese village called Sotoba. A series of mysterious deaths begin to spread in the village, at the same time when a strange family moves into the long-abandoned Kanemasa mansion on top of a hill. Megumi Shimizu, a young girl who wanted to leave the village and move to the city, pays them a visit never to return. She is later found lying in the forest and tragically dies. Doctor Toshio Ozaki, director of Sotoba's only ho

title: Mimizuku and the King of Night
author: Kougyoku, Iduki, Suzuki, Yuu
description:
Mimizuku, a small girl with chains on her wrists and ankles and the numbers "332" branded onto her forehead, wanders into the Forest of Night seeking to be eaten by a monster. However, when the ruler of the monsters, the mysterious and beautiful "King of Night," refuses to eat her, she tries to formulate a way to convince him otherwise.

(Source: Baka-Tsuki)

title: 007 Series
author: Saitou, Takao
description: A series of manga adaptations of Ian Fleming's James Bond novels.

title: Reibaishi Izuna
author: Okano, Takeshi, Makura, Shou
description:
A spin-off of Jigoku Sensei Nube taking place three years later.

Izuna Hazuki is a 17-year-old high school Itako, a person in tune with spirits, that works in the city as a Reibaishi. There are evil spirits in the world that take advantage of people's insecurities, emotional stress and weakness. These evil spirits take over people and enhance their negative energy, eventually harming themselves and the people around them. Some evil spirits make young girls looking to be in the spotlight into ar

title: Return from Death: I Kicked the Bucket and Now I'm Back at Square One with a Boyfriend Who Doesn't Remember Me
author: Aika, Yugiri, Mutsuhana, Eiko
description:
Magic school is a lot harder when you're trying not to die!

Life seemed perfect for Oriana after she started dating Vincent in the winter of her fifth year at the academy. Little did she know, her beloved would soon die under suspicious circumstances. Before she can process anything, she wakes up to find herself back in her seven-year-old body with no idea how she died. When she finally returns to the magic academy in hopes of reuniting with her boyfriend, she finds out Vincent has no memory of

title: The Unforgiving Flowers Blossom in the Dead of Night
author: Ryukishi07, Sakuya, Tsuitachi
description:
Marie is trapped in a horrible situation. She's being constantly tormented by her classmates and regularly molested by her teacher. With nowhere else to turn, she finds herself asking for supernatural help from one of the seven demons of the seven mysteries of her school. All she desires is the death of her cruel classmates and teacher. How far will Marie be willing to go in order to achieve the murders that would free her from her living hell?

(Source: MU)

title: Hakudatsu no Masquerade
author: Tsubaki, Kawori
description:
Elite Development Education Academy, Noblesse Oblige. The grandson of the academy's chairman, promised heir as the next chairman, Inaba Hakuto. The kind-hearted, younger brother who supports him, Inaba Kokuto. However, with the chairman's death, the fate of the twins begins to greatly warp. The one who holds the key is, the demon who resides in the mask... Masquerade... 

(Source: AQUA Scans)

title: She is more ordinary than I expected.
author: Shirodaira, Kyou, Mizuno, Eita
description:
The story takes place in the city of Tokui, which has a legend of two monsters. Yuuko Tengai transfers to the town's high school out of season in order to look for clues to clear her older brother of suspicion in a 10-year-old murder case. She teams up with her classmate Masaki Maki, who was in a coma for eight years, and her brother, who uses a robot to communicate to them from his zashikirou (Edo period-style room for confining criminals).

(Source: ANN)

title: Lupin the 3rd vs Detective Conan
author: Abe, Yutaka, Monkey Punch, Aoyama, Goushou, Maru, Denjirou
description: Manga adaptation of the 2009 crossover special.

title: Void's Enigmatic Mansion
author: Kim, Hee Eun, Ha, Ji Eun
description:
What if your greatest wish could be granted?

The enigmatic mansion on 6 Roland Street belongs to one Mr. Void, who resides on the seventh floor. Unbeknownst to the rest of the tenants in Void's mansion, their greatest wishes could be granted. And as the stories of the residents intertwine, they soon learn that what they desire is not always what is best...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Goodbye, Diamond.
author: Hiruzuka, Miyako
description:
The manga centers on three girl friends who spent their youth in the high school softball club. Now in their 30s, they turn their lives around and open a detective agency in Asakusa.

(Source: ANN)

title: Magatsuhi.com
author: Mori, Kazumasa, Inui, Souda
description: Normal high school student Midou Karuto one day out of curiosity came across the website "magatsuhi.com" but somehow could not access website. Thinking it was a prank website after all, Karuto turns off the Computer!  But somehow... due to this 'prank' event, Karuto found out that the people around him—no matter if it's family, friends, or even strangers— occur all kinds of misfortunes, dying...missing...all kind of things starts to happen around him! And the time before these happen, the comput

title: Se no Me
author: Koike, Nokuto, Michio, Shuusuke
description:
Mysteriously disappeared children, an old folk legend that speaks of strange events and a monstrous creature, a strange voice...

Michio, a writer, visit Shirotoge, a small rural village dispersed in the dense mountain forests of Japan, with almost no contact with the rest of the world...and here begins the worst nightmare of his life. When the atavistic fears are realized up to shake the mind of the most rational of men, then there is no hope.

title: Dusk Story
author: TONO
description: Takt is a boy who can see ghosts and other strange apparitions. Often the ghosts and people he meets carry strong emotions only he can help resolve. See the world through Takt's eyes, let yourself be touched by these heart-warming stories.

title: Shook Up!
author: Hiroe, Rei
description: An unknown girl has moved into a supposedly "haunted house" in a seemingly normal neighborhood.

title: The Irregulars
author: Matsubara, Toshimitsu, Aosaki, Yuugo
description: Gas-tou Norainu Tanteidan is set in late Victorian London, and will center on a street urchin whose life is changed by a big event.

title: Rokurei: The Anti-Exorcism Division
author: Jinushi
description:
In order to combat the rising number of spiritual incidents, the government established a local office specializing in ghostly phenomena. Namely, the Sixth Sense Department's Anti-Exorcism Division. Their purpose is to work as mediums between the living and the dead, literally mediating problems without the need for exorcism! See how it unfolds in this buddy cop mystery drama bordering between this world and the next.

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Funsou deshitara Hatta made
author: Den, Motohiro
description: The story follows Hatta Yuri, a geopolitical risk consultant who travels around the world solving problems.

title: The Paradise on the Sand
author: Ima, Ichiko
description: A collection of four short stories: Chapter 1 is the 100 page title story. It's a supernatural shoujo about a man with one chance to escape from death, a mysterious woman he meets, and a tribe seeking to find its way back into Heaven. Chapter 2 deals with the mystery of a man gone missing, and presumed dead. Chapter 3 is a very short story about a couple in the mountains who pick up a strange guest. Chapter 4 is a longer story about the traditions binding a family, those that would break away fr

title: The Hand of God or Devil
author: Kagetsu, Jin
description:
The story revolves around 6 young criminals held in a youth training center. One day a mysterious man appears from the wall. He finds himself wounded and entrusts them with a "hand", which is called "the Hand of Zeus". It harbors a mysterious power and energy. This hand can create a "mouth" that acts like a portal, which they use to escape the correctional room, however having in their possession that "hand" is a great danger, since strange beings are after it so they will have to face them.

(S

title: Taimashin: The Red Spider Exorcist
author: Shin, Yong-Gwan, Kikuchi, Hideyuki
description:
Traveling in-between the world of the living and the twilight world of the dead, Akamushi, the shaman, priest, demon-hunter, or specifically, the Red Spider Exorcist, is one that’ll never refuse a request for help from lost souls falling prey to evil spirits and demons of the underworld. With the strength and regeneration powers of a giant spider, and the ability to command his swarm of arachnids to his will, he combats the malevolent supernatural and is a force to be reckoned with.

When career

title: Detective Kouko Feels Melancholy
author: Suzuki, Julietta
description:
The manga is set during the height of the Showa era, and centers on a little girl named Kouko who is in training to become a detective. She is hired by a notable family to find out who sent a death threat to the family's son Inugami, who currently resides in a dormitory in Tokyo. To this end, she moves in to the dormitory to begin her investigation, but she is bad at cooking and even worse at figuring out where to start with the case.

(Source: ANN)

title: Tenkuu no Inu
author: Nagai, Go
description:
In this story, Nagai gets his folklore on with every chapter containing a lot on Buddhist lore or Japanese folklore. The prologue introduces us to Heaven, Incorporated, a company with a particular staff that hunts down all sorts of supernatural monsters and protects humanity from them.

(Source: MU)

title: Oshigerinanshi: Rouchou Tantei Fuyou no Otogibanashi
author: Maruyama, Tomoo, Katou, Miaki, Watari
description: Working at Kaikarou in the red-light district of Edo Yoshiwara, Ikutarou finds himself among many beautiful women. One in particular, Fuyou, seems to have been gifted with not only beauty but intelligence as well. An intelligence that people from many walks of life secretly turn to when they cannot go to the police. After discovering this secret, Ikutarou is made to be Fuyou's "feet" made to go out to observe crime scenes and evidence to report back to Fuyou so that she may solve the case even w

title: Charön
author: Yamada, Yoshinobu
description:
An average of 260 humans are born every minute. On the 9th minute of the 9th hour of September 9, 2024, only 18 individuals were born. On that day and minute, 18 stars shined brightly in the sky, and these 18 children were chosen by prophecy to be the saviors of mankind.

Nitarazu Hisoka wakes up, completely naked and surrounded by cold metal. Others lay around him, all approximately similar in age. As they attempt to grasp their situation, they find themselves face to face with the leader of a

title: Ark
author: Fuyuki, Nea
description:
In a field of green stands a single castle. One night, the residents sense that something is amiss. Suddenly a doll starts moving, and the residents disappear one after another. Thus, a young girl is left alone inside the mansion...

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Hyakki Tsurezurebukuro
author: Shimizu, Aki, Kyougoku, Natsuhiko
description:
In 1950s Tokyo, only the Rose Cross Detective Agency can tackle the cases that the police won't touch. Enokizu is an eccentric private eye with psychic abilities, and Chuuzenji is a surly used book store owner with an encyclopaedic knowledge of obscure trivia. Together with their associates, they seek justice for the victims.

(Source: MU)

title: Sister Red
author: Hayashiya, Shizuru
description:
Mahito lives at home with her father and her cousin, Erika, who came to live with Mahito's family several years ago after the death of her parents. One fateful, stormy night, Mahito is run down by a reckless motorist. Upon her death, she is reborn with the help of a stranger woman. This strange woman shared a part of her "sacred heart" with Mahito, giving her life as a median, or undead.

(Source: ANN)

title: Prometheus no Kasa
author: Fujinari, Takumi
description:
Prometheus was restrained in the Caucasus Mountains and continues to be tortured for 30,000 years to pay for his unforgivable sin of giving fire to humanity. During the day, the eagle devours his liver. And at night, Zeus punishes him by making him solve humanity's cold cases of history—an unbearable predicament for someone who loves the human race.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Princess 100%
author: Akaishi, Michiyo
description:
Hime wants answers. How could her father, an expert driver, die in a car accident caused by his own carelessness? What about the mysterious note he left behind? What exactly is going on? Hime intends to find out!

(Source: MU)

Includes two one-shots:

The Act of the Star Theater
Going Through the Time

title: Azanael: The Case-Book of ENA
author: Nitroplus, Murasaki, Hisato
description: The story centers on Ena, a girl who wants to be a detective someday like her dad. She finds a gun that can grant wishes if you play Russian Roulette with it.

title: Bible of Black
author: Hanao, Kouhei
description:
The world's most infamous villains are being murdered one after another, in what is called the "Judge's Incident." A mark is left at each and every crime scene. And then, the balance tips to one side, little by little. What is the reason behind the continuing paranormal occurrences, and what is the true nature of Shouya, the boy connected to each incident?

(Source: Batoto)

title: Inferno
author: Rinno, Miki
description:
After causing the destruction of his parents, the protagonist only lives for the sake of his younger sister and avoids other people. But one day, a mysterious stranger appears and calls him 'master'...thus his life is forever changed.

(Source: Wasuretai)

title: Akechi Shounen no Karei Naru Jikenbo
author: Kibayashi, Shin, Satou, Fumiya
description:
A side series of Young Kindaichi's case file.

This manga consisted of:

   1. "File 1 The First Case of Young Akechi/Alternative title: Farewell, My Dear Friend" (FILE1 明智少年最初の事件, "Fairu Ichi Akechi Shōnen Saisho no Jiken"?)
   2. "File 2 Quartet with Intent to Kill/Alternative title: The Perfect Violinist, Akechi" (FILE2 殺意の四重奏, "Fairu Ni Satsui no Karutetto"?)
   3. "File 3 Ghost Swordman Murder Case/Alternative title: The Pride Murder)" (FILE3 幽霊剣士殺人事件, "Fairu San Yūrei Kenshi Satsujin Jiken

title: Kishibe Rohan Tanpen Shousetsushuu
author: Kitakuni, Ballad, Zomcho, Yoshigami, Ryou, Iba, Yuusuke
description: Kishibe Rohan Tanpen Shousetsushuu is an anthology of short stories written by various authors and based on the Kishibe Rohan wa Ugokanai series.

title: Combination
author: Ohkawa, Nanase, Sei, Leeza
description:
The police officer Shigemitsu Hashiba is a funny man. He never seems to take anything seriously. But this attitude is just a mask that prevents him from being truly known by others. 

All this will change when he is assigned as a partner to Keiji Sasaki, a diligent and too serious rookie.

The two form a perfect combination and their goal is to arrest Mr Sawada.

title: Keishi Sokan Asami
author: Aruga, Teruto
description:
Asami is a beautiful cop in the Investigative Precint 1! Her dream is to solve a big case! But because of Asami hating Lieutenant Shimoyama's interference Asami's chances are thwarted time and time again. One day, an all-points bulletin stating a discovery of a floating corpse!? Shimoyama claims it's a suicide but Asami does not rule out foul play and starts investigating with her partner, Harada. A front line police story depicting the adventures of a female cop! With sex!

From Baka-Updates Ma

title: After Killing You
author: Mulyang, Ttangjwi
description: Mismatched lovers Eunsung and Hyunwoo face a bizarre twist of fate. When Hyunwoo abruptly ends their relationship, Eunsung finds himself committing the darkest of crimes. However, Eunsung wakes up in a world where the cold body in his arms isn't Hyunwoo's and instead, he's the one who's been killed... In this surreal switch, Eunsung realizes a chilling truth—their destinies are entwined in a dark cycle of love and murder. Despite this deadly paradox, Eunsung still believes they are meant to be t

title: Psycho+
author: Fujisaki, Ryuu
description: Midorimaru was born with green hair and rejected of social companionship since birth. Although he claims that he's gotten over his green hair, he often takes strolls at night because it hides his hairs color. One day, as he was taking his usual stroll, he meets Yukino Mizunomori, who said his hair was beautiful. The next day, he finds out that Yukino was dubbed the "Computer Girl" and anyone that beats her at any game can have a chance to date her. Later, he comes across a mysterious game called

title: Inou Maze
author: Yamada, J-ta, Okada, Shinichi
description: Kokoro City, the city haunted by strange rumors, series of murder cases and missings, secretly hides the inescapable "Maze of Death," controlled by supernatural forces.

title: Yoake no Boogiepop
author: Kadono, Kouhei, Kawabata, Yoshihiro
description:
The origin of Boogiepop revealed at last! Not only is this the long-awaited story of how Boogiepop was born, but it is also the tale of four very strange individuals: a detective, an eater of fear, a popular writer and a skilled assassin. Uncover all the secrets!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Sakurada Reset
author: Kouno, Yutaka, Nohana, Tatsu
description: Nearly half the population of Sakurada, a small town near the Pacific Ocean, has some sort of unique power. These powers range from being able to enter the mind of a cat, to resetting the world back to a certain point in time in the past. There is a group known as the "Kanrikyoku" that controls and monitors the use of these powers. Asai Kei and Haruki Misora work for their school's club called "Houshi" club, which execute any missions received from the Kanrikyoku. Misora has the ability to reset

title: Aa Tantei Jimusho
author: Kanzaki, Shummi
description:
Tsumaki is a private investigator of the "Aaah Detective Agency" that is obviously listed on the first line of the phone book. He has a great love toward investigation, and aims to solve new cases with his keen and original insight, yet always tends to fail miserably. No wonder he's pinched to pay his rent... With the support of his colleagues, powerful action, and elaborated costumes, he tries to solve crimes in his original ways!

(Source: MU)

Included one-shots:
Volume 2: Kemono Michi

title: Tomogui
author: Kanazawa, Nobuaki, Saitou, Rokuro
description:
The students of Kamishiro High School class 2-A swore revenge on their homeroom teacher, Takao Nanami. Against her, a fake suicide had been concerted, meant to be played out by one of her students, whose actual death would later sink the class into confusion. Who soiled the water with blood? Skinned of its trust, their friendship became an urge to sate each other's hunger.

(Source: MU)

title: Bungo Stray Dogs: The Untold Origins of the Detective Agency
author: Asagiri, Kafka, iyutani
description: Over a decade before the events of the manga series, a chance encounter leads professional bodyguard Yukichi Fukuzawa to begrudgingly take an arrogant boy genius named Ranpo Edogawa under his wing. Their first job brings them to a local theater on high alert after receiving a bizarre death threat-a challenge that will require both Ranpo's brains and Fukuzawa's experience. The aftermath spurs Fukuzawa to establish the Armed Detective Agency, an organization that takes on dangerous jobs even the p

title: Monitoring Black Site
author: Azuki, Ryou
description:
Because she wanted to have more luck with guys, Tsukushi bought online a charm necklace. After she tried to wear it, everything seemed to work fine. But little by little the necklace's color change and turned in black...

(Source: Sound of Jewels)

Included one-shot: Koroshitagari no Hime

title: How About a Cosmic Horror?
author: Lee, Jeongwoon, Gilmok
description:
Irae wakes up in the hospital, married but with no memory of the wedding or her husband. To everyone else, he's the perfect man, but to her, he's a tentacled cosmic horror! Bewildered by the gap between memory and reality, she wonders... Is this really just an aftereffect of her accident?

(Source: Manta)

title: 7's
author: Kido, Jirou
description:
A pretty girl, Tamura Nagisaki, appears before an ordinary high school boy. When she says, "Will you protect me?" his ordinary life is thrown into a tailspin. The pleasure killer, Dimensional Rider, kills Nagisaki without a motive. With Nagisaki's death, time between the two loops back and forth. Can the two escape the carnage and infinite loops...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Bungo Stray Dogs: Another Story - Yukito Ayatsuji vs. Natsuhiko Kyougoku
author: Asagiri, Kafka
description: Yukito Ayatsuji, a brilliant investigator known as the Homicide Detective, has a skill so deadly that he is assigned a minder―rookie Special Division for Unusual Powers agent Mizuki Tsujimura―to monitor him. And when Ayatsuji is tasked with solving a murder case, who should be pulling the strings behind the scenes but his archnemesis... Natsuhiko Kyougoku?! As the stakes continue to ramp up, so too do the mysteries. In this battle of wits between a sorcerer and a detective, it's trick or be tric

title: Midnight Sun
author: Arina, Toshimi
description: Shitou Teruaki is a former top-notch bounty hunter who's been out of the business for a while and is currently struggling to get back in the game. He takes up a relatively low-paying mission to track down a serial rapist because of his desperate need for money, and is surprised when the currently 2nd-ranked bounty hunter—the mysterious and assertive "K"—appears to be competing with him for the prize. But when Shitou encounters local Ice Prince Ayatsuji Kaoru by "saving" him from the clutches of

title: Dennou Coil
author: Honda, Takeshi, Miyamura, Yuuko
description: Eleven years after the introduction of internet-connected, augmented reality eyeglasses and visors, Yūko Okonogi moves with her family to Daikoku City, the technological center of the emerging half-virtual world. Yūko joins her grandmother's "investigation agency" comprised of children equipped with virtual tools and powerful metatags. She quickly crosses paths with Yūko Amasawa, an expert hacker of the virtual environment, as Amasawa relentlessly seeks to "unlock" the mystery of a computer viru

title: Bio Hunter
author: Hosono, Fujihiko
description: Two scientists are attempting to distribute the cure for a demon virus that is affecting people all over Japan, however, things have become complicated. One of them has become infected. So begins his battle with himself, as he attempts to not only control his emerging demon side, but also to save the lives of others by wielding its great strength.

title: Yuurei
author: Syundei
description: Fear and self-loathing coalesce with tragic consequences in this haunting tale of a college boy who is repulsed by his classmate's openly gay childhood friend.

title: Hanjuku Sakka to "Bungaku Shoujo" na Muse
author: Nomura, Mizuki, Takeoka, Miho
description:
Sequel to "Bungaku Shoujo" series, set some years after Touko graduation, where she's now working as supervising editor for genius novelist, Suzumenomiya Kaito.

The book is in Suzumenomiya Kaito's point of view.

title: Princess Principal
author: Akizuki, Ryou
description:
At the end of the 19th century, London, the Kingdom of Albion has been split into East and West sides by a giant wall. Five girls attend Queen's Mayfaire, a conventional and prestigious school. Under the guise of regular high school girls, they act as spies under cover. Disguise, reconnaissance, infiltration, car chases... Each girl uses their own set of special skills to dart around the world of shadow.

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)

title: Akechi Keishi no Yuuga Naru Jikenbo
author: Kibayashi, Shin, Satou, Fumiya
description:
Side story of the Young Kindaichi Case Files. The cases in this series are:

1. "File 1 Testimony Puzzle/Alternative title: The Murder Train" (FILE1 証言パズル, "Fairu Ichi Shōgen Pazuru"?)
2. "File 2 Killing Poker/Alternative title: Unlucky Men in the Rain" (FILE2　殺人ポーカー, "Fairu Ni Satsujin Pōkā"?)
3. "File 3 Dead Person's Checkmate/Alternative title: The Great Chess Player, Akechi" (FILE3 死者のチェックメイト, "Fairu San Shisha no Chekkumeito"?)
4. "File 4 Ghost Hotel Murder Case/Alternative title: The Encou

title: Nein: 9th Story
author: Arisaka, Aco, Kamikou, Chizu, Furumi, Shouichi
description: In the back alley of an old antique store, the vocalist of Vanishing Starlight discovers a futuristic information terminal that transcends time and space in form of sunglasses. He is then possessed by a mysterious cat being.

title: SCP tte nan desu ka?
author: Nashi, Miyama, Taka, Hachifun
description:
A request was sent to two manga artists, M and H, from the editorial department of Ichijinsha's Comic Howl.

"I would like you to create artwork based on the name (storyboard) for 'SCP,' which is popular on the internet. Additionally, I would like you to draw a manga that serves as an introduction to 'SCP."

The two accepted the project, but there were many unknowns about the original name. While tilting his head in confusion, M—who is learning about SCP from H, who is knowledgeable about horror

title: Nanashi wa Ittai Dare deshou?
author: Okazaki, Kousuke, Yamada, Kanehito
description: "There are three things that worry me in this moment. First, before I noticed, I was here. Second, I have no memory. Third, there is a girl with a knife in front of me. Who on earth am I?" A story in which mystery and memories cross each other. High-end mystery which asks the new era!

title: "Bungaku Shoujo" to Koisuru Episode
author: Nomura, Mizuki, Takeoka, Miho
description: Collection of "Bungaku Shoujo" short stories.

title: Captain Zenigata
author: Monkey Punch, Okada, Tai
description: Lupin III spin-off about Kouichi Zenigata.

title: Psycho-Pass 3: First Inspector
author: Hashino, Saru
description:
Tokyo, 2120. In a society overseen by the Sibyl System, Inspectors Arata Shindou and Kei Mikhail Ignatov of the Criminal Investigation Department's Unit One clash over truth and justice. Kouichi Azusawa, the mastermind behind a string of crimes, sets his sights on the CID itself and launches an assault on the NONA Tower. Division 01 (a.k.a. Unit One) is in peril like never before—a case that will try Shindou and Ignatov's loyalties.

(Source: Psycho-Pass Wiki)

title: Hiruko
author: Yamagishi, Ryouko
description:
A university student befriends a young boy who is her distant relative. She's initially taken in by his beautiful appearance, but slowly starts to realize that strange things are happening around her...

(Source: BrickMe)

title: Tantei to Neko-chan
author: Josee
description:
An ex-police detective turned private investigator x an incomprehensible young man. Kawasaki runs a detective agency and by the time he realizes it, Okachimachi, who is sometimes an uninvited helper (?) and sometimes a target of investigation himself (?!), has crept his way into his heart!

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

title: Gifted
author: Kibayashi, Shin, Amamiya, Rima
description: One day, Natsuki Amakusa—the hope of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department—meets an unusual high schooler named Yuuya Shiki. Natsuki's interest in the high schooler is piqued after Yuuya happens to be passing through the scene of a difficult murder case and determines the perpetrator with ease. How did he know who the killer was? When an incident later takes place at Yuuya's high school, the two happen across each other again... Thus, a young policeman and a high schooler with a hidden power

title: "Bungaku Shoujo" to Koisuru Poet
author: Nomura, Mizuki, Hiyoshimaru, Akira
description: The manga adaptation of several chapters from "Bungaku Shoujo" to Koisuru Episode.

title: Arve Rezzle: Kikaijikake no Yousei-tachi
author: Yamaguchi, Yuu, Amou, Gin
description:
A cyber battle sci-fi. In 2022, the technology of quantum computing has greatly advanced and many people have transfered their mind into the cyber space.

Remu's sister, Shiki, skipped grades and entered a high school in the academic city "Okinotori-island Mega Float City (OMFC)" when she was 14. One day, Shiki confessed to her brother via Skype that she was talking to him directly from the cyber space and her real body had been kept in a water tank filled with a culture medium. It's called "Bod

title: Mugen Shinshi
author: Takahashi, Yousuke
description:
When a strange group of men attempt to kidnap Atsuko Fukune, a dancer at a club, she seeks the help of Mamiya Mugen, a famous detective - who also happens to be a child. When it turns out that other girls have gone missing, Mamiya, with the help of his butler Alucard, springs into action to solve the mystery.

(Source: ANN)

title: Kyokugen Dasshutsu 9-jikan 9-nin 9 no Tobira: Alterna
author: Kuroda, Kenji, Nishimura, Kinu, Uchikoshi, Koutarou

title: Lupin the 3rd vs Detective Conan: The Movie
author: Abe, Yutaka, Monkey Punch, Aoyama, Goushou, Maru, Denjirou
description: Manga adaptation of the 2013 crossover movie.

title: Itsuka Watashi wa, Kimi wo Uragiru
author: Sakurai, Mizuki

title: Kimi to Shitai to Boku no Kaitou
author: Yogenme
description: After souls die, corpses still keep their hearts. Both protagonists Inoue and Fujiwara can see those corpses whose human hearts have died. Two lonely and special people encounter each other. They are determined to rescue the people who left their soul's corpses behind and alleviate their soul's pain. This is a moving work that soothes the spiritual wounds!

title: Summertime Render 2026: Shousetsuka Nagumo Ryuunosuke no Ibun Hyakkei
author: Tanaka, Yasuki, Handa, Hotori

title: Void: No. Nine
author: Shinya, Shima
description:
Three hundred years ago, God destroyed the world. All that remains of humanity lives deep underground, far from the blasted surface—and far from The Emissaries, remnant soldiers of the divine war against mankind. Most live quite lives in the tunnel cities, but the few daring or desperate enough to risk death work as scavengers, collecting relics of the old world...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Boku no Kanojo wa Kirei ni Warau
author: Nakayama, Chibako
description:
"I'll never tell Kii-kun!!" Kiichi's childhood friend Tsubaki harbored a certain "secret."  But when he pressed, he'd get: "It's fine, it's fine. I'm fine." A psycho-horror romance manga jumbled with pure love.

(Source: COMICSMART, translated)

title: OZ
author: Itsuki, Natsumi
description: On the 15th of October 1990, World War III breaks out. It only lasts for 40 minutes, but industrial establishments were nearly wiped out by the 1000 megatons of nuclear weapons used in the war. The Earth was then cloaked by in a nuclear winter which lasted for 6 months, and all the grain plants died. Each government fell into anarchy and transport and communication networks could not be restored easily. Soon, declarations of state establishment from the citizens in various areas came one after a

title: 9S
author: Yamamoto, Yamato, Hayama, Tooru, Masuda, Megumi
description:
The Security System that Seals the Savage Science Smartly by its Supreme Sagacity and Strength.

9S is set in an age of science, but in a too distant future. The Mad Scientist, Mineshima Yujiro, dissapeared several years previous to where the story begins. The inheritance he left behind, the technology and objects he had created, were given the codename 'Legacy', and are highly sought after by government agencies and terrorists, for reasons both good, and...not so pleasant. One of these 'objects

title: Otodama: Voice from the Dead
author: Nitta, Youka
description:
Kaname Otonashi, the former "Ears of the Police," has the gift (and curse) of hearing so exceptional that he can sense the screams of the dead. His friend Hide is a former cop whose detective work is perfectly complemented by Kaname's incredible talent. Will the swirl of sound that surrounds Kaname help him solve the city's biggest crimes... or will sonic mayhem finally drive him mad?

Otodama pits beautiful men against calloused criminals in a battle for the streets! Can an acoustical analysis

title: Kuuchuu Teien no Hitobito: Toume Kei Sakuhinshuu
author: Toume, Kei
description:
1. Element 7
2. Kobito Jijou (Fairy Affairs)
3. Apartment of the Dead
4. Yuuyami Koshoichi (The Twilight Antique Book Market)
5. Tengoku no Door (Heaven's Door)
6. Seimitsuka (Blue Secret Flower)

title: Hoshi no Sabaku: Talsha Night
author: Funato, Akari, Yuya, Aoi
description: Mana and Kenji, twin sister and brother, found a star as little children. On a far off world, their star is called the Talshas, meaning 'Stone of Wind and Gods', and it will grant the wishes of one person for as long as they live. And though it has lain quiet for 10 years, that is swiftly changing. The twins' lives are rocked by tragedies and miracles, chance meetings that are not as innocent as they seem, and trust forged and broken as a war between two distant planets descends around them. And

title: Doctors in Isolated Room
author: Mori, Hiroshi, Asada, Torao
description: Invited by a colleague, college professor Saikawa decides to drop by on the execution of a certain experiment. However, during this experiment a murder takes place. Will Saikawa be able to get to the bottom of this?

title: Soul Messenger
author: Fujisawa, Tooru, Kitagawa, Shou
description: A rookie female reporter named Kei tackles a story about a dead body one day. The police have determined that it was suicide, but Kei believes it is actually murder. Kei happens to have a special talent in scientific forensic investigation.

title: In the Night Comes a Girl
author: Moriizumi, Takehito
description:
Satoru is an insomniac, stuck in his own night as the rest of the world keeps turning. One night he meets the peculiar girl Mikoto, who claims her eyes see just fine at night but don't work during the day. She asks him to help her find a picture book she'd once read, a simple request that turns into an unimaginable journey for the two of them.

(Source: Lovely Strange Dark)

title: Hakata Tonkotsu Ramens
author: Ichiiro, Hako, Kisaki, Chiaki
description:
Crime runs rampant in Fukuoka's seedy underworld. The Hakata ward is especially hard-hit, being a gathering place for top-class assassins, private eyes, information-mongers and professional avengers. Perhaps the most legendary among them is the Niwaka Samurai, notorious for being an "assassin of assassins."

In the midst of all this, private detective Banba Zenji appears to be the eye of the storm, calmly and cheerfully investigating cases for his police officer friend and playing baseball in hi

title: Aegis in the Dawn
author: Nanatsuki, Kyoichi, Fujiwara, Yoshihide
description:
The sequel of AEGIS in the dark.

How can Tate Karito beat Butterfly?

title: For You to be You
author: Matsumoto, Yoko
description:
What will happen when a human has extra power? What will happen when that power is used to fulfill all of his will?
Masami, who often looks like an innocent little boy, apparently has the power that he uses as a killer weapon. He even dares to hurt his own mother in order to reach his goal. What will shogo do as his best friend?

title: D.Diver
author: Mori, Kouji
description:
Kagura is a college student who lost his parents in a fire when he was a child. One day he visited a courthouse as part of a seminar, and that same night he had a strange dream.... Was it just a nightmare or was it reality?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Nekokan.Batch
author: Tomizawa, Hitoshi
description: A girl finds out the boy whom she's been texting with is a cat.

title: Ookami Game
author: Konno, Paru
description:
"Who the hell is the wolf? A game of death and life!"

Twelve men and women suddenly found themselves in a building and get caught up in a mysterious game called "The Wolf Game." They are divided into two groups: sheep and a wolf. Whoever is the wolf must kill one of them.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Houmonsha wa Mayonaka ni...
author: Shinohara, Chie
description:
1. Houmonsha wa Mayonaka ni... (A Midnight Visitor)
2. Soshite 5-kai no Suzu ga Naru (And the Bell Rings 5 Times)
3. Yasashii Satsujinsha (Kind Killer)

title: Hostage Detective
author: Nishizaki, Taisei, Abiko, Takemaru
description: The implications of a man who unwittingly stumble upon a dead body when he breaks into a lady's room to steal her underwear.

title: Folklore of Kudan
author: Nichiru, Shimizu, Hatsumi
description:
Gossips around town spoke of an urban legend called "Kudan". It is said that "Kudan" takes the form of a woman wearing western mourning dress. She lacks a right wrist, and her face is hidden behind a black veil. It is predicted that those who lay eyes on "Kudan", within 7 days calamity will befall them.

Through strange coincidence, 16 years old Sakuya Kudan meets cooking class instructor Touko Shima. As they come in contact with each other, faint feelings grow between the two. However, as Touko

title: Ankoku Joshi
author: Anisaki, Yuna, Akiyoshi, Rikako
description:
The manga is set at a school named the Virgin Mary Girls Academy, where Itsumi Shiraishi, the beautiful daughter of the school's director, recently died. Whether the death was an accident, a suicide, or a murder remains a mystery, known only to the lily that Itsumi clutched in her hand as she died.

Rumors begin to circulate that the members of the literature club that Itsumi supervised were responsible for her death. With leadership of the club transferring to Sayuri Sumikawa, the club members

title: Boy From the Future
author: Ine
description:
Dain and Sihyeon are in the same class, but they are awkward. One day, an unfamiliar man claims to be from the future, and said that he will be her boyfriend in the future. And that man is Lee Sihyeon, her classmate!? Dain doesn't believe the words of the unfamiliar man, but she gradually trusts him each time they met.

(Source: MU)

title: Sakurako-san no Ashimoto ni wa Shitai ga Umatteiru: Chou wa Juuichigatsu ni Kieta
author: Ota, Shiori, Ayamine, Keu

title: The Treasure of the King and the Cat
author: Kajika, You
description:
One day, a large number of people suddenly disappeared in the royal capital. When young King Castio goes out to investigate this occurrence, he comes across the culprit... but the criminal puts a spell on him! To help him out, the king calls the wizard O'Feuille to his castle, along with Prince Volks and his loyal retainer Nios. Together, they're determined to solve this strange, fluffy mystery full of cats, swords and magic!

(Source: Tokyopop)

Included one-shot: Henkyou no Mahoutsukai (Wizard

title: Ebisu Gakuen Sunday Class Detectives
author: Renjouji, Mei, TKKT
description:
A long-awaited comic series which is a collaboration with the rising stars "EBiDAN39"! A teenage prodigy… and also a dropout?!

Follow the school life adventures of 6 unique and unconventional students! Due to his excessive absences, Riku Rokuoin, who is a genius with an IQ of 270 ,ends up needing to go to a special "Sunday Remedial Class" but the students he met there were ones of his kind!

(Source: Manga Box)

title: Bannou Kanteishi Q no Jikenbo
author: Kiyohara, Hiro, Matsuoka, Keisuke
description: The main character is the 23 years old Riko Rinda aka "Q," an all purpose appraiser, which with her wide range of knowledge, her great memory and her reasoning, she can detect the true value of everything.

title: Chronicle of the Divine Sword
author: Ogasawara, Uki
description:
The first story is like 'Highlander Immortals Gone Yaoi' but not exactly, because there can be more than one and cutting off the head will NOT stop them! Will anything?! There sure is lots of penetration going on, and these boys aren't shy about doing it with swords either. (That double-meaning is not a joke.)

The second story is about ninja-boy training. Those boys train hard. Long and hard.

The third, fourth and fifth chapter is a story called Birds of Wing Abreast. It starts when a woman ta

title: Maga Maga Yama
author: Koike, Nokuto
description:
In the depths of the Maga Maga Mountain range, dark, mysterious and foul events befall upon those who enter.

(Source: Jaimini's Box)

title: Nightmare Express
author: Shimotsuki, Kairi
description:
The story begins with a mysterious invitation sent to the most miserable people in the world. With this letter, a girl is invited on a journey aboard a strange, enigmatic train.

(Source: ANN)

title: Amnesia:Cradle
author: Kuwayoshi, Asa
description:
In 20XX, owing to the mounting international tension, a certain country passes a new law that mandates a special education program for adolescents of fifteen years and older. Oblivious to the impending war, Kazuki finds himself, along with others, shipped to a remote island named Yurikago—the "Cradle Island." There they undergo training, but all too soon everything comes to an abrupt end...

(Source: Iskultrip Scans)

title: Youkai Hunter: Yami no Kyakujin
author: Inoue, Junya, Morohoshi, Daijirou
description: Hieda-sensei is a professor of archeology, with a fervent belief in the existence and power of supernatural creatures like gods and demons. Since he can't prove anything, his belief has earned him the mocking nickname "Youkai Hunter" from his colleagues. One day, two men from Ootori-chou come to visit him. They're planning to promote tourism by reviving their town's old, traditional "Demon Festival," which has been discontinued for the past century. They're basing the festival on Hieda's researc

title: Cinderella Tokkyuu
author: Matsumoto, Kazura, Matsumoto, Yoko
description:
Mari is to be headed to another country to visit her friend who became a queen. When Mari arrives there, things starts to get mysterious as there is an attempt to kill the royal family. Who is behind the plot to kill them? 

(Source: MU)

title: Telepathy Shoujo "Ran"
author: Iida, Toshitsugu, Asano, Atsuko
description: Ran is a bright and energetic first-grader in junior high school who possesses supernatual abilities. Together with Midori (her friend who also has supernatural powers) and Rui, the threesome are constantly embroiled in mysterious circumstances. Ran is troubled by her powers because it seems to spark off the ill intentions of people in contact with her. However, with the support of her family and peers, Ran learns to deal with her 'other' side and accepts who she is. The threesome also learn how

title: Revenger
author: Yamada, Ryuusei
description:
As master assassin Usui Yuen looks into a series of assassinations made on the grand samurai clan, the Satsuma, he encounters Kurima Raizo, member and survivor of one of the attacks. Together, they discover the true nature of these murders is bigger than over stolen resources. As they get closer to the truth, will they come out alive to exact revenge?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Teizokureigari
author: Okuse, Saki
description:
Mami Ryuuka, who has a talismanical power, hunts only low-grade spirits, and all the requests are for vulgar spirits. Actions between death spirits and Mami are displayed.

(Source: MU)

Included one-shot:
Volume 5: Gosenzou-sama wa Gokigennaname

title: Muhyo to Rouji no Mahouritsu Soudan Jimusho: Mazoku Magushi-hen
author: Nishi, Yoshiyuki
description:
Magical Law (Mahouritsu)... its purpose is to punish spirits who have harmed human beings or have committed wrongdoings.

Muhyo, who is a genius practitioner of Magic Law and the youngest Executor ever, and Jirou Kusano (Roji), Muhyo's crybaby assistant who hardly ever supports him, investigate mysterious blackouts and spiritual phenomena that have been occurring in the city frequently. Moreover, those blackouts involve a person called the "demon magician," who creates forbidden tools.

As they

title: Detective Conan the Movie: The Time Bomb Skyscraper
author: Abe, Yutaka, Aoyama, Goushou, Maru, Denjirou
description: Manga adaptation of the first Meitantei Conan movie.

title: Gedou the Unidentified Mysterious Boy
author: Okano, Takeshi
description:
Sarara’s normal life changes one day after she meets Gedou, a mysterious boy who claims himself a doctor of unidentified creatures. Sarara’s suspicion towards the young doctor results in Gedou revealing his true self to Sarara. Despite being shocked to see Gedou’s true self, Sarara decides to know more about Gedou and unidentified mysterious creatures.

Included one-shot:
Volume 3: Mikakunin Shounen Gedou (pilot)

title: The Reincarnated Cop Who Strikes With Wealth
author: Baeppu, Blue Sae

title: Missing: Kamikakushi no Monogatari
author: Midorikawa, Shin, Kouda, Gakuto
description:
Kyouichi Utsume, a.k.a. "His Majesty, Lord of Darkness," is a dark and compelling mystery—so much so that his fellow Literature Club members would rather discuss him than books! When "His Majesty" vanishes in front of their very eyes, his friends are left with several unanswered questions: what is the source of Kyouichi's long-standing obsession with the "other side"? And just who is Ayame—the eerily ghostlike girl Kyouichi brought to school as his girlfriend the day before he disappeared?

(Sou

title: Akumugari
author: Fujisaki, Masato, Oosawa, Arimasa
description: The drug 'Nightmare' gives a drastic impact, changing a human physical to a gigantic creature. Then a man appeared to stand up against these creatures for the sake of prosperity and to prevent misfortunes of mankind.

title: Unhinged
author: Kim, Biva
description:
A story of murder and violence, Unhinged follows Erika as she walks a path of vengeance. Seven years ago, Erika came home to find her husband murdered. Unable to find any other suspects, Erika was found guilty and spends most of a decade plotting her revenge from the inside of a cell. Once freed, she finds herself moving past the boundaries of "respectable" society and beyond the shackles of morality. Laws will be broken, lives will be lost, and, yes, there will be blood.

(Source: Lezhin Entert

title: Paradise on Earth
author: Dalgonyak
description: In search of perfect love, 16 men and women participate in the dating reality program "Paradise on Earth." With sparkling blue seas and warm sunshine 365 days a year, this place is a paradise-like island. However, in the second week of filming, the staff members infected with an unknown virus begin to show strange phenomena, and paradise turns into hell in an instant. All contact between the island and the outside world is cut off, and rescue efforts are out of reach. Will they be able to surviv

title: Detective Conan the Movie: Dimensional Sniper
author: Abe, Yutaka, Aoyama, Goushou, Maru, Denjirou
description: Manga adaptation of the eighteenth Meitantei Conan movie.

title: A Tale of Six Trillion Years and a Night
author: Nishimoto, Hirona, hatsuko
description:
The story tells of "a fairytale that no one knows" about a demon boy with no name, abused by the villagers, and who only wanted to be human. He wants to die, and he can't see any dreams in his future. One day, a girl named Ai comes to the prison he is held in. Although talking is forbidden, she asks him what his name is, and says that they will leave together.

(Source: Vocaloid Synthesizer Wiki, edited)

title: The X Files
author: Mochizuki, Mikiya, Inoue, Sen, Kakizaki, Kazumi, Sakata, Yasuko, Itahashi, Shuuhou, Carter, Chris
description:
Contains adaptations of various episodes of "The X Files" series created by Chris Carter.

Volume 1:
-File #00: Pilot
-File #07: Ice

Volume 2:
-File #2: Squeeze
-File #12: Beyond the Sea

Volume 3:
-File #11: Fire
-File #05: Shadows

title: Phenomenon X: Paranormal Crime Files
author: Onsen, Nakaya
description: Spontaneous fires with no cause. A mummy found in a quiet neighborhood. Sunflowers blooming in the dead of winter. Beneath each reported paranormal event, a criminal presence may be hiding in plain sight. Anan, a cat-eared demi-human cop buried in everyday cases, finds herself reluctantly partnered with Kanai—a federal agent with spiked hair, dark shades, and secrets of his own. Together, they dig into a string of bizarre cases that defy logic. What lies behind the impossible may not be ghosts,

title: Robin in the Veil of Night
author: Tsuyuhisa, Fumi
description: After a string of suspicious deaths strikes the political sphere, police officer Norito is dispatched to investigate the possible involvement of a religious cult. He drags his brother Shinji, a reticent folklorist, along to Hirasaka, a remote village hidden deep in the snowy mountains. Norito and Shinji are taken to the residence of the village chief, a strikingly beautiful Shinto priest named Yoshiomi. The snow shrouds his estate in disquiet, and the brothers realize that their lives might be i

title: Ameku Takao Series
author: Chinen, Mikito
description:
In Tenikai General Hospital's general diagnostic department, patients who are deemed difficult to treat by other doctors are collected here. From mysteries of unknown illness to murders that even the police can't handle. Genius doctor Takao Ameku reveals the shocking truth hidden behind these mysterious "disease."

(Source: Official Site, translated)

title: Conductor
author: Kaminaga, Manabu, Suzuki, Yasushi
description:
Kuchiki, a flautist, was plagued by nightmares every night that forced her to seek the help of counsellor Matsuzaki. Ishikura, a police inspector, unexpectedly discovered a headless mummified body in an empty apartment and is now on the case. When Kuchiki regains her lost memories, the curtains also opens to a tragedy!

(Source: The Zero Alliance)

title: Till the End of the Night
author: Nishida, Higashi
description:
Public prosecutor Hiura's friend and colleague Kageyama has become the victim in one of his cases. It seems Kageyama was assaulted and dumped in a river, and the case is turning into a murder investigation. But if Kageyama is dead, where’s his body? Meanwhile Hiura is having strange and vivid dreams, and meets a man with an eerie resemblance to Kageyama.

(Source: MU)

author: Fujinari, Takumi
description:
Late one evening, Kamimura’s radio picks up a mysterious radio station. The next day, a man called Michael comes into the electronics shop where Kamimura works and Kamimura recognises his voice as the DJ from the mysterious radio station. Suddenly, Michael compliments Kamimura’s voice and invites him to be a guest on his show!

(Source: The Zero Alliance)

title: JDC Tribute
author: NISIO, ISIN
description:
JDC is the Japan Detectives Club, a feature of Seiryoin Ryusui's genre exploding novels. His work was so influential on the next generation of writers that several of them have penned novels using his world and characters.

(Source: easternstandard)

See more info for information about authors.

title: Strobo
author: Tsukinowa, Kousuke
description:
Children who died before their parents, change their 'cause of death' into weapons, and kill each other over chance of resurrection.... Youth Battle Royal Graffiti.

(Source: Official site)

title: Dotsuki Manzai
author: Takatou, Rui
description: Dotsuki Manzai (type of Japanese comedy) is a few stories from the universes of Tsukihime, Melty Blood, and Fate/stay night.

title: Hikari
author: Rinno, Miki
description:
Three students are living fairly normal lives when, one day, they are overcome with intense stomach pain and a star symbol appears like a tatoo on their skin. With the symbol came supernatural powers, as well as enemies coming to kill them.

As more and more people develop similar supernatural powers, the story starts to turn into a Battle Royalesque bloody playground, only with an entire city as the setting and many innocents caught in the crossfire.

Among other themes, the story asks the ques

title: Tonight, I Have a Date with a Serial Killer
author: Iguchi, Kon, Nakamura, Yuuji
description: Crime is ever-rising, a fact that police officer Shiro Isogai lives with every day. After the brutal murder of his fiancée, Isogai has been working tirelessly to find the killer. Suddenly, a "mysterious informant" begins popping up, helping the police locate serial killers one after another. Isogai knows this could be his chance for closure and decides his only hope is to team up with this person. But when it comes time to meet the secretive ally, he's surprised to be face-to-face with a young w

title: Minase Youmu to Hontou wa Kowai Cthulhu Shinwa
author: Yoshihara, Masahiko, Asagiri, Kafka
description: One day, an ordinary high-school girl named Minase Youmu is kidnapped up in the mountains. Her kidnappers claim that she has taken some kind of "medicine" and that there's no going back. Luckily, though, a former detective named Sanpouji Kotetsu happens to pass by where she is being held, and rescues her. Kotetsu hastily gets the underage girl to the police, where the investigator Naru Asuka and her 'psychic' partner Hayama Reiichi take on the girl's case. Asuka, Reiichi and Kotetsu have to figu

title: Petshop of Horrors: Hyouhaku no Hakobune-hen
author: Akino, Matsuri
description:
Papa D is one of a mysterious species that never ages; this is his story, as he lives through time in search of a specialized piece of DNA enclosed in amber, which will be used to fulfill his goals and ambitions.

(Source: MU)

title: Wani Bunsho
author: Shinohara, Tooru
description: Welcome to the 82nd Precinct, also known as the Crocodile Precinct, which is filled with cops that never let go once they sink their teeth into something. Leading them is Hino Mika, a female cop who's as dangerous as she is beautiful. Follow her on her adventures in this sexy action suspense series.

title: Suteki Tantei Labyrinth
author: Akahori, Satoru, Wakayama, Seiji
description: In a forgotten town known as the old capital of Tokyo, strange and mysterious crimes are progressively occuring. These supernatural occurances are beyond comprehension and bring fear and terror to the people. Only one person is not intimidated by the evil underlying these occurances and is willing to challenge them: Hyuga Mayuki, a young boy detective who holds a special insight power that allows him to uncover the real truth behind these occurances.

title: Petshop of Horrors: Passage-hen
author: Akino, Matsuri
description: A prequel story set in Paris at the turn of the 20th century focusing on D's grandfather.

title: Moko and unusual Murderers
author: Hanten, Sharou
description:
22-year-old Haijima Hitsugi has been transferred to the unusual murders section, where he will investigate mysteries with Utagata Moko. Moko is actually the same age as he is, but she looks, dresses, and acts like a little girl. While dealing with Moko is basically like taking care of a child, she is also brilliant at unraveling some pretty twisted murder mysteries.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Mizunoke: A Modern Tale of Mysterious Water Dwellers
author: Yama, Uta
description:
Mizunoke are monsters and spirits that appear at the water's edge. While many have been driven out with the advent of modern civilization, they can still be found within this town of Uroko. One day, a young girl named Kichi appears like a storm before Sayo, an employee of the Mizunoke Extermination Center. Though Kichi claims to be searching for her missing brother, there seems to be something more at work...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Raising Hell
author: Araki, Hikaru
description:
Kenji Sakamoto, a high school student, was trying to contact a current criminal who had committed a terrorist attack in Akihabara, Tokyo. Everything is to follow the disappearance of a childhood friend, Nao, who disappeared. What happened to them? The story is told from a corner of the northern Kanto one year before the incident!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Lockdown Zone: Level X
author: Ooishi, Romy, meshe
description:
Ryoka is awakened by flurry of text messages from her mother! Panicked and rushed, Mom is clearly concerned for Ryoka's safety, but she is not too keen on letting her daughter know why. Her reasoning being that nothing could really properly describe what is happening!

The world might be ending! And there might be a massive new life-form on the roof of their apartment building!

(Source: Denpa)

title: Matsuri no Yoru
author: Nato, Kio
description:
A very short story that tells us why so many people get to the hospitals at the New Year night.

(Source: MU)

title: Seikimatsu Tantei Club
author: Yotsuya, Simone
description:
Fin de Siècle Detective Club is dedicated to the very gay and very passionate love of Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson. I suppose that it could even be called a doujinshi, since it's blatantly based on Conan Doyle's work, and many of his characters make appearances throughout the story. In fact, the main story is split into three stories -- each one focusing on a different aspect of the Holmes/Watson relationship.

(Source: The Pink Panzer)

title: Ghost Hunters
author: You, Sang-jin
description:
They have been maintaining the balance of Yin and Yang since ancient times. Whenever the world is in chaos, there are many cases where evil spirits come to do harm to humans. The gods select talented humans and they are given their own guardian god for them to calm the over flow of Yin. This has continued all the way up to the present, so those that are chosen by god are hunters that eradicate ghosts, they are called Ghost Hunters. 

(Source: MU)

title: Death Trap
author: Min, Song-A
description:
Boredom in middle of nowhere can never be a good thing. And the girls featured in this one-shot prove just that.

A student council president asks a newly appointed priest to help her out with strange events that has been happening around her school. But what it looks like is not what it appears to be. 

(Source: Sura's Place)

title: Detective Conan the Movie: Countdown to Heaven
author: Abe, Yutaka, Aoyama, Goushou, Maru, Denjirou
description: Manga adaptation of the fifth Meitantei Conan movie.

title: Babylon
author: Nozaki, Mado
description:
Zen Seizaki, a public prosecutor at Tokyo District Public Prosecutors Office, is investigating a case of illegal clinical research related to a drug company and a university. During the investigation, he finds a file that Shin Inaba, an anesthesiologist, kept, which includes blood that is mixed with hair, skin, and a paper written with letter F. As he investigates, he realized there's a hidden plot that is connected with a huge election as well as to a certain person who is in charge of it.

(So

title: Talking Arrogantly
author: Sa-Sook
description:
A cocky leader of a gang takes out on others for his own pleasure. A mysterious man starts to follow him. What are his intentions?

(Source: MU)

title: Night Walkers
author: Gokurakuin, Sakurako
description:
The death of his mother leads to Tomoki living with Murakami-san, the Prime Minister. However Tomoki soon learns that nothing is what it seems, least of all Murakami-san himself.

(Source: Bitter Sweet)

title: River's Edge Ookawabata Tanteisha
author: Caribu, Marley, Tanaka, Akio
description:
The Ookawabata Detective Agency consists of three people: the old, bald, boss, the somewhat slovenly man Muraki, and the cute young lady Megumi. Rather than solving crimes, they use their investigative skills and network of people to determine the truth behind rumors and urban legends for their customers. Their range of cases can include anything from tracking down a person from the past to finding a love hotel with a 1-way mirror for voyeurs.

(Source: MU)

title: Detective Conan the Movie: The Darkest Nightmare
author: Abe, Yutaka, Aoyama, Goushou, Maru, Denjirou
description: Manga adaptation of the twentieth Meitantei Conan movie.

title: Zettaijou-senpai no Youkaigaku Kouza
author: Minemori, Hirokazu, Kotarou
description: Those who are troubled by strange phenomenon go to the forty-fourth room of the fourth floor of the fourth hall of Higashisei University’s Literature Department. There they will find Zettaijou Araya, a tall, pale, and handsome collector of all materials related to youkai. Perpetually clad in a black haori, he consults people suffering from supernatural problems. The season is spring, and the university campus is crowded with new students. One day, a freshman by the name of Yunoyama Ayane decides

title: Hamatora: The Novel
author: Fujiwara, Kenichi, Tomizawa, Kayano
description: In this world, there are people known as "Minimum Holders" who are capable of specific "small miracles." A government funded elite academy trains these Minimum Holders in order for them to reach their maximum potential and serve national interests. Once, a student, of great potential named Nice, dropped out. He started a private investigator team with an assistant named Hajime and seemed content solving cases for his clients (which often involve Minimum Holders). A top student of the academy, Mu

title: Detective Conan the Movie: The Raven Chaser
author: Abe, Yutaka, Aoyama, Goushou, Maru, Denjirou
description: Manga adaptation of the thirteenth Meitantei Conan movie.

title: The Special Tropical Parfait Case
author: Yonezawa, Honobu, OmiOmi
description:
Kobato-kun and Osanai-san are now in their second year of high school. They are hiding their "fox" and "wolf" identities and are aiming to be regular citizens, but this summer there is a disquieting atmosphere in the air.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Laborinth
author: Kuurodakousei
description:
When Hitsuji Hitsuji finally gets into her dream art school, she discovers "Laborinth," a bizarre club building on campus. Legend has it that those who enter this cursed labyrinth never return... Get ready for an extraordinary tale of the mysterious club building, brought to you by the brilliant mind of Kuurodakosei!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Reibaishi Izuna: Ascension
author: Okano, Takeshi, Makura, Shou
description: Izuna Hazuki is a 17-year-old high school Itako, a person in tune with spirits, that works in the city as a Reibaishi. There are evil spirits in the world that take advantage of people's insecurities, emotional stress and weakness. These evil spirits take over people and enhance their negative energy, eventually harming themselves and the people around them. Some evil spirits make young girls looking to be in the spotlight into arsonists and other spirits tap into men's sexual desires to make th

title: The Queen of Kisses
author: Lee, Jaeik, Yeongyeongi
description: World-renowned actress Son Yuri has it all: beauty, talent, and now even unimaginable wealth upon her marriage to IT magnate, Dave Chun. But the happiest day of Yuri's life soon becomes the worst when her husband suddenly goes missing after the first night of their honeymoon. With them having been the only two on their yacht in the middle of the vast sea, Yuri is immediately suspected of murdering Dave. Just when the entire world seems to be against her, Yuri is reunited with Lee Dojun, a lawyer

title: Soul Drop
author: Kadono, Kouhei
description:
A strange silver-hair man, Ameya, helps a young boy, Norio. But no-one seems to see this weird man...

A murder takes place in a locked room, with only one clue : a piece of paper filled with an incomprehensible warning
« Within three days I will steal the equivalent value of the life of the person who will be in this room»
Two inspectors working for Sircam insurance, Isa et Senjô, think that the culprit is "Paper Cut". But who is this enigmatic murderer ?

title: Kindaichi Shounen no Jikenbo Gaiden: Hannin-tachi no Jikenbo
author: Funatsu, Shinpei
description: A spin-off of Kindaichi Shounen no Jikenbo introducing a comedic look back at some of Kindaichi's old cases, but this time through the eyes of the criminals he's caught.

title: Shiori to Shimiko
author: Morohoshi, Daijirou
description: The story follows two girls named Shiori and Shimiko who become involved in strange incidents in their town.

title: Panda Tanteisha
author: Sawae, Pump
description: The detective duo of an ikemen and panda-man investigate curious cases of an incurable disease that turns people into animals and plants.

title: Genesis in Our Hands
author: Ogawa, Maiko
description:
My name is Aiichirou Suzaki, a lone wolf and I live to fight! However, one day an annoying girl came to my house and challenged me to a duel... and since that day on my life has completely changed. This is a story about the birth of a brand-new world.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Detective Conan the Movie: The Last Wizard of the Century
author: Abe, Yutaka, Aoyama, Goushou, Maru, Denjirou
description: Manga adaptation of the third Meitantei Conan movie.

title: The Bride of the Demon
author: Ashibe, Yuuho, Ikeda, Etsuko
description:
The continuation of Deimos no Hanayome (which was unfinished), but with new character designs and refreshed artwork.

Deimos was once a handsome god. He loved a beautiful goddess who returns his sentiments. The problem, well, she is his sister. For their crime against nature they were struck down out of Olympus. The brother is now a demon and the sister a rotting corpse at the bottom of the ocean. Deimos must choose between his sister and her living human incarnation. His sister is jealous. The

title: Four Billion Nights
author: Hisa, Masato
description:
1. Four Billion Nights
2. Aru Adauchi no Hanashi
3. Kamaitachi no Hi

title: Poorman, Ark, Billionaire
author: Takahashi, Keitarou
description:
Shigaraki Seiya, a high school student and the daughter of a mangaka, is anxious to become financially independent so as to relieve the burden on her single mother. One day while on the way to school, she has an encounter with "The Spirit of the Chest, Aurelia de Medici," and thereafter finds herself thrown headfirst into a no-holds-barred otherworldly battle revolving around money.

(Source: MangaFreak)

title: B.Q. The Fly Book
author: Kaneko, Atsushi
description:
A new collection of exhilarating adventure by the king of underground manga!
"Bark at the moon", the tale of a terrorist stealing a mysterious liquid from a passenger; "Highway Romantic Vs. Sodomy Diner", evil picture of an American village hiding behind the veil of a peaceful routine a reality made of assassins and crazy men;  "The Drifter", the tale of an uneven alien invasion; "Dead Skater", dark story of a crazy violent kid and a crazy scientist; "The Workers of Hamano Factory", a X-files li

title: H.P. Lovecraft's The Cats of Ulthar and Other Stories
author: Lovecraft, H. P., Tanabe, Gou

title: Tsukidate no Satsujin
author: Sasaki, Noriko, Ayatsuji, Yukito
description: On the island of Okinawa, Sorami Karigaya is a high school girl who lost her father many years ago, and her mother just passed away. Two months after her mother's death, an attorney from Hokkaido arrives at her residence, claiming on behalf of her maternal grandfather with inheritance issues, who had been claimed long dead by Sorami's mother. The attorney explains it as a lie because for some reason she hated her father so much that she didn't even reveal his existence to Sorami. After arriving

title: Sougihime
author: Moto, Naoko
description:
The heart warming story of connections between hearts of those who died and the living. This is a story of the sister & brother named Ash & Dust who manage the BLONDIE Undertaker, a place where the dead might come to live again...and have a second chance with the magical power of Ash.
