But in the shadows, a beautiful and mysterious stranger observes her...

(Source: MU)

title: Hakubo no Chronicle
author: Yuuki, Masami
description:
The story follows a newly hired female public official named Akari Fusegi, who along with a boy obsessed with crime, solves mysterious deaths.

(Source: ANN)

title: Toubou Kyuukou
author: Shinohara, Chie
description:
This volume contains 3 one-shots by Shinohara Chie.  

Toubou Kyuukou:
Natsumi is a young journalist who aspires to get that one big scoop that will put her on the map.  Searching for something that might make a good story, she drives around at night and comes upon a murder scene.  Wanting to find out more, she stops to ask questions of the investigators, but is taken hostage by a guy covered in blood!  Is this story worth risking her own life??

Shissou Toshi:
Keiko wakes up one morning naked a

title: Detective Conan the Movie: The Crimson Love Letter
author: Abe, Yutaka, Aoyama, Goushou, Maru, Denjirou
description: Manga adaptation of the twenty-first Meitantei Conan movie.

title: The Cop Is Too Strong
author: Kim, Kise, Seongjun
description:
Shin Haesu, an officer that specializes in excessive force, suddenly obtains a power that allows him to go 60 minutes back in time. He knew that his father's death was a murder disguised as a suicide on the same day. Haesu goes to become an officer to catch the culprit behind his father's death. That's when a superpower comes to him in the midst of a mysterious accident! A huge shadow gradually comes into view as he solves criminal cases and chases the organization.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment

title: Detective Conan the Movie: Crossroad in the Ancient Capital
author: Abe, Yutaka, Aoyama, Goushou, Maru, Denjirou
description: Manga adaptation of the seventh Meitantei Conan movie.

title: Kyoudai: Shoujo Tantei to Yuurei Keikan no Kaiki Jikenbo
author: Kigitsu, Katsuhisa
description:
Two years ago, Akagi Kei's older brother Keiichi, who was a policeman with a bright future ahead of him, mysteriously vanished. The police eventually closed the case, but they never found any sign of what happened to her brother. After that, Kei was very busy as the oldest child in the house, especially since her mother worked nights, so it took her a while to recognize a strange new voice that was calling to her...

It was her brother, or at least her brother's skeletal ghost. Now she knows tha

title: Tantei ni Narutame no 893 no Houhou
author: Sakamoto, Akira
description: Mikuriya Jin leads Nakajima Mamoru and some gangsters in solving troubles for their clients.

title: God of Dogs
author: Ishihara, Satoru
description:
The notoriously vicious Chinese Mafia has lost its next rightful heir . . . to sudden suicide!  Now the esteemed "God of Dogs" Tsai family must race against the ticking clock and hunt down the child of the deceased eldest son in order to preserve their ancient, sacred legacy.  Meanwhile, the mysterious Archer has been convicted of killing his father and is on his way to jail.  What will fate reveal for the powerful Tsai clan's criminal dynasy AND this strange young man?

In God of Dogs, a feared

title: Unblossomed
author: Danchu
description: Gyeongseong, 1920—the early days of colonial Korea. When a young Japanese boy is found dead at a local school's lantern festival, fingers start to point towards Kim Mugyeong. Despite the mounting pressure, Mugyeong refuses to talk, forcing officers to search for information elsewhere. Just what secrets have these two boys been hiding, and why does Mugyeong refuse to talk? In the midst of tumultuous social and political conflicts, the youth are just trying to make do. And while they say that some

title: Messiah: Seiiki Ishuu
author: Hiyoshimaru, Akira
description: In the fifth unit of the special police bureau lies a group of special individuals known as the "Sakura." Formed for the purpose of carrying out secret missions, they gave up their nationality, erased their past and concealed their real identities. There will be no salvation for the "Sakura" who failed in his mission, except for their one and only "Messiah"—the only existence that can pull them back from the path of death…

title: Gengetsurou Kitan
author: Ima, Ichiko
description: Shouichirou Tsurugi is the master of an well-established, upscale miso shop. He's a noted "prodigal son" and an eccentric "Jack of all trades, master of none." He's also the patron of a suspicious male geisha, Yosaburou, who will do anything for money and has no talent, except for telling ghost stories. It may or may not be true that the young master is making amorous advances toward Yosaburou! Every night, the parlor of a restaurant in the red light district called Ghost Moon Tower showcases my

title: Monogusa Neneko no Taida na Tanteichou
author: Hisasi, Maisaka, Kou

title: Whoever Steals This Book
author: Fukamidori, Nowaki
description: Descended from a long line of book collectors, high school student Mifuyu is surrounded by books in every aspect of her life. Her great-grandfather established the famous Mikura Hall, a library in the heart of town, and even the townspeople are all avid readers. There's just one problem—Mifuyu hates books! But when a thief in Mikura Hall triggers an ancient curse, she's left with no choice but to reclaim the stolen books herself...by entering the very stories she despises! With the help of the m

title: The Orphan's Long Night
author: Fibi, Dori
description:
Deep in the mountains, a body is discovered. When this unidentifiable "thing" becomes linked to a case of stolen remains, a mysterious entity known as "Hiruko" emerges... A uniquely crafted, unprecedented Japanese tale of the bizarre, rendered with unparalleled artistry.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Fate
author: Sim, Soo-Jung
description:
From [RC-SCANS]:

Shin-Young abruptly wakes up from a nightmare just to find a man, named Ji-Hoo, sleeping in the same bed. If that wasn't bizzare enough, the two of them find out that they were engaged ever since birth. Was it a mere coincidence or was it a work of fate that has not yet finished...?

title: Spy Classroom Short Story Collection
author: Tomari, Takemachi
description:
Klaus reveals he is married to a member of Lamplight, but the identity of the bride remains unknown. In an effort to uncover the truth behind this strange secret, the girls review some of their recent smaller adventures to find any revelatory clues—until the investigation descends into a full-on battle royale! Get a peek into the girls' daily lives in this collection of vignettes!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Daiteito Étranger Sousasen
author: Nanakamado, Anno
description:
New cop Asuku finds himself assigned to a special unit of inhuman police agents, tracking down similarly inhuman targets. Only time will tell which will kill Asuku first, a rogue criminal... or his partner.

(Source: Japanzai)

title: Cool Shock Old B.T.
author: NISIO, ISIN, Demizu, Posuka
description: Koichi and B.T. are back again... This time, their retirement plans include a voyage to the stars! But how will they overcome the puzzle their old nemesis has left for them inside their spaceship...?

title: The Outstanding Demon
author: naked ape, Edogawa, Ranpo
description:
The story takes place in 1924 in Tokyo. A handsome young trader named Kinnosuke Minoura learns that his fiancé is murdered in a locked room. The elite doctor Michio Moroto, who's been in love with Minoura for a long time, asks to help solve the case.

(Source: ANN)

title: Fushigi na Techou
author: Mizuki, Shigeru
description:
Oneshot that revolves around a magical notebook: when a person's name is written on that notebook, the said person dies. 

(Source: MU)

title: Ijime no Kejime
author: Ikegami, Nao
description:
A black notebook arrived for Amano, a high school teacher. What was spelled out there was the story of fierce bullying that one of the students who Amano was in charge of received. After 17 years, Amano, who quit teaching, continued to search for the student who was a victim of bullying, but he has yet to find out where he is. At that time, his classmates at that time began to be killed one after another...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Dr. Brain
author: Hongjacga
description: Since his youth, Sewon Lee has been fascinated with neuroscience, but now he's taken it to the next level. He's developed a method to hack directly into the brain and extract memories from the bodies of the deceased. When a private detective approaches Sewon about using his discovery to solve crimes, the young scientist sees an opportunity to test his limits. But what he doesn't see is the danger ahead. As Sewon becomes embroiled in investigations, he realizes just how dangerous the mind can be.

title: Kaitou Lupin Den: Aventurier
author: Morita, Takashi, Leblanc, Maurice
description:
The story is set in France in the early 20th century, called the Belle Epoque (Beautiful Era).

In the country of art that boasts the splendor, there was a thief, who repeatedly involved in stealing in genius ways. The protean and elusive man, in appearance was a Modus Operandi, fearless, twisted, and extremely bizarre. The name of the thief with a thousand names and faces is Arsene Lupin! A classic of Maurice Leblanc has been revived by Morita Takashi!

(Source: MU)

title: Opera no Kaijin
author: JET, Leroux, Gaston
description: Based on Gaston Leroux's "The Phantom of the Opera".

title: Sherlock Holmes no Chousen
author: Doyle, Arthur Ignatius Conan, Komusubi, Haruka
description: Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson are solving many criminal cases but one thing is weird: All the cases are verly likely to each other. So who is the mastermind of all these cases?

title: Strange Pictures
author: Aiba, Kikou, Uketsu
description:
Sasaki, a member of the occult club, is told by his junior colleague Kurihara about the existence of a certain blog. The blog has many "pictures" drawn by "Yuki," the blogger's wife, along with an ominous message: "The crime you committed." A chilling story that unravels the mystery hidden in nine pictures! When the mystery is solved, all the incidents will be connected.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Shinigami Tantei to Yuuutsu Onsen
author: Saitou, Misaki
description: Shishigami Takashi has, for a long time, met with murder cases wherever he goes, hence the nickname of "Shinigami" detective.

title: The Mask
author: Kakinouchi, Narumi
description:
When the clock strikes midnight, the door opens. This is when the phantom awakens, wandering, looking for the most beautiful dancer.
Loosely based on "The Phantom of the Opera." 

(Source: MU)

title: Secret Chaser
author: Akiyama, Tamayo
description: Follow the story of Tatsurou Shinozaki, a priest and private investigator who works to solve strange mysteries involving mystical influence. One day a woman comes to his church looking for the mysterious red penguin. She uses a post-hypnotic suggestion on him so that when the phrase "red penguin" is mentioned, he begins to hallucinate. As the journey to uncover the red penguin begins, secrets are uncovered about Tatsurou's past, including a shadowy society that may be linked to his suddenly unre

title: Neo Psychic Experiment: SCI-FI HARRY
author: Toujou, Asami, Iida, George
description: Harry McQuinn has always been an outcast at his school. One day started out no different than normal, except a classmate named Catherine stood up for him when the local bullies were ragging on him. She gets Harry to open up to her and is amazed when Harry shows her his unique ability of telekinesis, the ability to move things with his mind. Catherine is amazed at this ability. Unfortunately, Harry doesn't realize his powers have a dangerous side-affect to them: Every time he uses them, someone c

title: Yasha Gozen
author: Yamagishi, Ryouko
description:
Noriko has the feeling somebody’s watching her. She thinks it’s a Yasha (a demon) that she might have angered. But who is the person who is really watching her? And what has happened to her parents?

(translated from: karémanga)

title: Yuureisen
author: Ishinomori, Shoutarou
description:
Hayato's city is devastated by a giant robot, his parents are killed in the massacre. The only friend left to him is his dog Jack, the only things left are mom's shoe and a picture of a man and a woman who, as his father tells him on his deathbed, are his real parents. Now Hayato wants revenge on the one who is said to have sent the robot: the terrible Ghost Ship which threatens ships and is rumored to wish to exterminate everything.

(Source: ANN)

title: Gulf Jungle
author: Tamura, Yumi
description:
This volume contains three one shots (the first and third are related) from mangaka Tamura Yumi's "Tamu Tamu Variety Theater" collection.  This volume is the fourth of the series.  

1) Wangan Jungle:

Childhood friends Kanoe and Konoe are invited to a reunion of their elementary school class at the newly opening amusement park named the Wangan Jungle.  They go, but mysteriously, no one else shows up.  As they get ready to leave at closing time, they suddenly feel incredibly tired.  The next thi

title: Nanatsu no Kururi
author: Shiomi, Chika
description: Sumiremaru, Renji and Magari traverse the land, helping people journey into death.

title: Matohazure Q-doubu
author: NISIO, ISIN, Iwasaki, Yuuji
description:
After a spree of students have been injured by an indiscriminate serial archer, Yumi Ishii has had enough after the 11th victim was hurt. She will stop at no lengths to bring the Q-dou Club to justice, whom she believes are the culprits!

With the Q-dou Club members being Aarou Achiya, a modern archer delinquent; Yamato Kouinji, a traditional archer that creeps on women; One-Eighty Yuge, a gambling darts player; and the mysterious club leader, Q-dou Gen, who is...?!

Who is the culprit behind th

title: Bogle
author: Taira, Shino, Ichiju, Yuko
description:
There's nothing harder than starting fresh at a new high school… except maybe having to hide your secret identity as a cat-burglar! Asuka is just your average, ordinary girl, except for her tendency to steal from evil-doers as a midnight vigilante.
(Source: Go Comi)

title: Kanata no Kimi no Te
author: Wata, Rainy, Kajii, Fuku
description:
Yuudai, a rounin student, returns for the first time in a while to the town where he spent his childhood summers, and unexpectedly runs into an old friend, Shun. Yuudai is shaken when a memory that he had been buried in the back of his mind is jolted loose. That's when a child suddenly appears and tells him something strange...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

author: Kuwata, Noriko
description:
888 follows Hisago, Tsukumo, Shimeki, and Kobayashi-Kun, Shimeki's cute doggie. These four run a detective agency. Though they usually don't get a lot of customers, Hisago's dad still gives them money every once in a while so they stay afloat. But when they do, boy are they big cases (they have to find a lost pet).

There's no blood in this story though Shimeki does get kidnapped by his ex-wife and is forced to make dinner for her with a knife to his head. There are no mysterious deaths or high

title: Detective in Different World
author: Katazoto, Kamome, Sou, Ichirou
description: This is the story of a detective mystery fanatic who, upon dying, gets reincarnated into a different world.

title: Dream Gold
author: Nakanishi, Tatsurou
description:
In a world where technology and magic fuel the dream for riches, the Knights of the Dark City are sent out to find the hidden treasures that the world craves. Kurorat Jio Clocks, the clever rat of Higurashi Street, will join the Knights in their frantic hunt for wealth, and for the ultimate prize - Dream Gold. All who search for treasure search for Dream Gold, but this quest will yield one winner...

(Source: ADV)

title: Shin Jikenya Kagyou
author: Taniguchi, Jiro, Sekikawa, Natsuo
description: The continuation of the "hard boiled type" adventures of the private investigator Joutaro Fukamachi.

title: Light Novel
author: Narushima, Yuri
description: Sasakura Ryuu is a college student who also writes a particularly bloody series of light novels. One day, he meets a mysterious young fan with the name of one of his characters, "Mikato." Since Mikato is one of the characters Ryuu is planning to kill off in his next novel, this raises some questions about what, if any, responsibility Ryuu has towards his fans and what they might take away from his work. These questions only grow worse when murders begin to occur that blatantly copy specific even

title: Linoa by the Window
author: Hagino, Makoto
description:
The manga about a "new encounter" is set in a rural town in Bavaria, Germany. A traveler visits the town and meets a mysterious girl who frequently escapes from an orphanage. The traveler also keeps a secret of his own.

(Source: ANN)

title: Ougon Musoukyoku
author: Morozumi, Junka
description: An adaptation of the Umineko no Naku Koro ni fighting game of the same title.

title: Z
author: Aoike, Yasuko
description:
The adventures of Agent Z, the newest recruit to Major Eberbach's alphabet soup of subordinates.  These stories take place in the Eroica universe, but they are serious espionage adventure tales and Dorian and his crew do not appear.

(Source: Eroica Fans)

title: Mahoutsukai no Musume
author: Nasu, Yukie
description:
The story revolves around Suzunoki Hatsune, a normal high school girl... or so she strongly wishes, because she has no desire to succeed her stepfather as the strongest onmyouji in modern Japan. Still, she has the ability to see spirits, and as luck would have it, her emerging abilities are pointing her to a terrifying truth behind the deaths of her parents... and her stepfather may be involved!?

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Yakushiji Ryouko no Kaiki Jikenbo
author: Kakinouchi, Narumi, Tanaka, Yoshiki
description:
The story revolves around Ryouko Yakushiji, a 27-year-old multilingual investigator that graduated from Tokyo University's elite Department of Law, and the bizarre cases she faces while working for the Tokyo Metropolitan Police. Yakushiji not only has to deal with supernatural beings in her line of work, but also her rival Yukiko Muromachi, another equally talented and beautiful police investigator.

(Source: ANN)

title: Uryuudou Yumebanashi
author: Hatsu, Akiko
description: The Rain and Willow shop is an antique store that is owned by a certain elderly man whose grandson assists him with the management. The grandfather is a man of business, while the grandson is a calm, quiet boy with soft unfocused eyes who has the ability to see things that are "not of this world".

title: Dorobou Night Trick
author: Yukiji, Yucha P
description: Based on the Vocaloid song "Dorobou Night Trick": —What will I steal next? The highly popular Vocaloid song that started on Nico Nico Douga is becoming an original comic!! Companies distinguish winners and losers according to the laws of economics established by adults. In order to destroy that system, the phantom thief Noel infiltrates the casino "Jailhouse"! No-one can escape her aim. The curtains open on the great thief show!!

title: Kao no Nai Onna
author: Takahashi, Yousuke
description:
A series on the organization's strongest female killer, the "Faceless Woman," and how she challenges other killers.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Mystery Minzoku Gakusha Yakumo Itsuki
author: Yamaguchi, Masakazu, Kanari, Youzaburou
description:
Itsuki is an assistant at the Folklore Research Institute and is always caught in mysterious cases as he pursues his studies. Follow along as he tries to unlock these mysteries that are tangled with old beliefs and local customs using his keen professional intelligence.

(Source: JDorama.com)

title: Domino
author: Toono, Nooto
description:
At the scene of a terrible murder, only Toudou is able to find the surviving little girl in the closet—his niece Tsubasa. Four years later, Toudou and his father are caring for Tsubasa, who no longer speaks, and Toudou continues to work as a police detective. He's assigned to a new partner, a young woman with a promising future, Saeki. As Toudou and Saeki team up to solve murder cases together, they will also both have to confront their own painful pasts.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Tsukimizuki Rikai no Tantei Satsujin
author: mebae, Akatsuki, Senri
description: There's a new wheel-chair bound student at school who has returned after an illness, and she immediately kisses Tsuzuki Ui, who she calls "Rei-kun." He soon deduces that she is a daughter of a wealthy family, and a person he once beat at an internet murder mystery game. She is apparently fixated on him, since he was the only one who ever beat her, and she has now come to see him in person. Her plan is to have a real-life murder mystery game, and her current focus is on the supposed suicide of Ts

title: 300 Million Yen High School Student
author: Katou, Yuuta
description:
Mitsuki is a high school student who works hard for the sake of his sick younger sister. However, without any parents, money, or knowledge, the only thing that comes to him is to work for an illegal business or a part time job maliciously exploiting and preying on the weak. Just when he's about to despair at the unreasonableness of the world, a beautiful woman who calls herself a detective appears. She decides to change Mitsuki's life of poverty...!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kukulcan The Greatest Strategy
author: Takada, Shinichirou
description:
Lipton joins the Second Kukulcan Corps. He longs to ride the Kukulcan in the sky with his fellow Kukulcan airmen, while unifying with these other soldiers in slightly lecherous behavior during this youthful story. And while the Kukulcan Corps are an all-male society, Lipton learns that the soldier he bunks with, Tsubasa Chino, is actually a woman? This flying fantasy love comedy could actually become a romance manga!

(Source: Beaglee Inc.)

title: Akechi
author: Iizuka, Keita
description: In a modern reimagining of the Ranpo Edogawa series, used bookstore owner Kogorou Akechi helps his childhood friend and detective Eiichirou Namikoshi solve crimes in Tokyo.

title: Grimm no You na Monogatari: Trude Obasan
author: Morohoshi, Daijirou
description:
1. G no Nikki
2. Trude Obasan
3. Natsu no Niwa to Fuyu no Niwa
4. Akazukin
5. Tetsu no Heinrich Mata Kaeru no Ousama
6. Ibara Hime
7. Bremen no Gakutai
8. Rapunzel

title: Rengoku Game
author: Fukuhara, Renji, Kitano, Hiromu, Ezaki, Sugoroku
description:
A mysterious event causes a number of people in Ikebukuro to collapse, but after they gain consciousness they explode and die! Ryuuji and his friend Taizou Miyauchi are determined to find the cause after their friend meets their explosive end in front of them. But instead of finding answers, they are given a death sentence and transported to a strange world by a mysterious child. To return home they must compete in, and survive, the Purgatory Games!

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Moss
author: Yoon, Tae-Ho
description:
After the death of his estranged father, a young man travels to a strange countryside town to take care of the funeral arrangements. With his own life in shambles, he decides to stay but finds the village people less than welcoming. Their odd behavior and the things his father left behind, leads him on a dangerous path to a truth that might be better left buried.

(Source: Spottoon)

title: Yami wa Tsudou
author: Matsumoto, Yoko
description: Six lost souls gather in a candle-lit room with a mysterious host. None of them know exactly how they came to be there, but there's only one way out. Each of us follows a path preordained by destiny. If the souls are judged to have lost their path by mistake they will be returned to it. But if destiny says their time is up: they have to move on. (Source: M-U)

title: Tasogare no Amrita
author: Ariki, Eiko
description: In a boarding school where talented young boys are gathered together, Tatsumi has the best grades and is the "president's favorite." However, his place was just stolen by the pretty boy Azuma who's rumored to be getting the president's attention. Tatsumi is irritated by this, but is forced to yield to Azuma whose personality completely changed from the harassment he's been receiving. Ever since then, Tatsumi's been scared of Azuma. Tatsumi ends up in the same room as him but slowly realize where

title: Sokubakuai: Kareshi wo Hikikomoraseru 100 no Houhou
author: Shoji, Hiroyuki

title: Tantei Book: Kage
author: Saitou, Takao, Tatsumi, Yoshihiro, Matsumoto, Masahiko, Takahashi, Macoto, Sakurai, Shouichi
description:
A collection of gekiga stories from various authors from the days of kashihon manga. Considered to be an extremely influential series in the evolution of manga, being one of the first of the gekiga genre.

(Source: MU)

title: Hokuriku Ghost Story
author: Watsuki, Nobuhiro
description:
One day, teenager Nakai Kunta meets a ghost in the school. The girl, Houzuki Yuzu cannot rest in peace until her corpse is found – and it’s up to Nakai to solve the mystery of its whereabouts…

(Source: MangaUpdates)

title: Onkai no Miyako
author: Kayase, Shiki
description:
The temple protects the City of Sound by having hymns sung every day.  But why does the sound echo throughout the temple? Why does the song seem like a requiem?  And why are the hymns so important that..the city will collapse if they stop?! 

(Source: The Zero Alliance)

title: Noushou Sakuretsu Girl
author: Yoshida, Erika, Rerulili, Nazuka, Kudan
description:
'Welcome, to the Human Zoo' When an ordinary high school student Ichii Hana woke up, she was in a cage with her classmates. And there she was entered into a death game involving use of her mobile phone!!

Along with a classmate with the same name, yet complete opposite in personality, Inusawa Hana, she challenges the game!?

'I'll definitely stay alive. By throwing away this stale body'

(Source: Amazon)

title: Mahoutsukai ni Taisetsu na Koto
author: Yoshizuki, Kumichi, Kareno, Akira
description:
Yume Kikuchi, a girl who can use magic, goes to Tokyo to be an apprentice mage to the handsome Masami Oyamada (a professional mage). In Tokyo, Yume learns about magic, helping people, and various other things on her way to being a mage. But she soon also finds out that even just magic alone isn't enough to make someone truly happy...

(Source: ANN)

title: The Villain Profiler
author: RAZEN, Jeongyong
description:
Lee Shinyeok lost his mother to a murderer and had an accident. After stacking up knowledge in a mysterious space where he could learn and study for 15 years, he wakes up from a coma. This is the story of a genius who uses his 15 years of knowledge and skills to unravel the injustices of the dead, and of those who are a dangerous threat to people in becoming a profiler; the pinnacle of a profiler.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Danzai no Dragnet
author: Oda, Suzuka, Fushino, Michiru
description:
The "end of the century mystery" manga takes place in a Japan where an unknown infectious disease has killed more than half of Japan's population. The interests of two men will align to work together. Ruslan is a coroner with good looks, and Sanajima is a police officer in the Hyogo police department who is investigating the mysteries of bizarre murders.

(Source: ANN)

title: Nenkin Ningen Hitomoji
author: Mase, Motoro
description:
The "dramatic bio horror" manga is set in a world where a new disease is spreading through humanity, one which turns humans into amoebas and slime molds when they are too stressed. Whether someone lives or dies during the process is a roll of the dice.

(Source: ANN)

title: Deathbound Duke's Daughter
author: Munashichi, Senoo, Terasu
description: One evening in early spring, eight-year-old Erika Aurelia realizes she's the detestable little villainess from an otome game called Liber Monstrorum: The Winter Maiden and the Phantasmic Beasts. As if that wasn't bad enough already, Erika's role in the game is to pester the main character... and then die in order to kick off a mysterious series of events! These incidents are different in each love interest's route, and seven routes means seven deaths to avoid. Not one to throw in the towel, Erik

title: When the Clock Strikes Z
author: Sakaki, Ichirou, Katsudansou
description:
When hardcore FPS enthusiast Hiroaki Dewa pulls off his VR headset and steps outside for the first time in ages, he realizes that the whole world is in ruins! Soon after, he coincidentally runs into horror junkie Otoha Judou, and the two of them team up to endure the zombie apocalypse. One fateful night, a VR AI known as "Raven" leaves them a cryptic message: "Survive, and humanity may flourish once again." Follow these ragtag oddballs as they cling to hope in a hopeless world!

(Source: J-Novel

title: Agatha Christie no Meitantei Poirot to Marple
author: Christie, Agatha, Ishikawa, Morihiko
description:
A manga adaptation of three Agatha Christie stories.

The ABC Murders
4:50 from Paddington
Death in the Clouds

title: Holmes of Kyoto
author: Mochizuki, Mai
description:
Half a year after moving to Kyoto, high school girl Aoi Mashiro brings her late grandfather's old scrolls to Kura, an antique store nestled in Kyoto's Teramachi-Sanjo shopping arcade, for an appraisal. One thing leads to another, and she winds up working there part-time. The manager's son, Kiyotaka Yagashira—nicknamed the "Holmes of Kyoto"—is uncannily perceptive, and together, they solve strange cases relating to the antiques brought to them by clients.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Nanashi: Nakushita Nani ka no Sagashikata
author: Katayama, Shuu, Fujino, Harumi
description:
The manga adapts Harumi Fujino's "Nanashi Series" online occult horror stories. The stories center on the protagonist Haru (a pseudonym for the author), and his friend Kyousuke "Nanashi" Nanashima, who possesses strange powers.

(Source: ANN)

title: Mononoke: Nopperabou
author: Ninagawa, Yaeko
description: Manga adaption of the Nopperabou arc.

title: Loups=Garous: Kihi Subeki Ookami
author: Kyougoku, Natsuhiko
description: Virtual reality. Murder. Werewolves. And teen girls! In a future where nothing is as it seems, can old legends come true? In the near future, humans will communicate almost exclusively through monitors, making real interaction a rarified and weak occurance for those living in a near totalitarian society. In this new world of communication, children are only allowed to interact personally on school grounds. So when a serial killer starts slaughtering junior high children the communication routes

title: Bokura wa Satsuibiyori
author: Hattori, Mitsuru, Saihate, Tahi
description:
Bokura wa Satsuibiyori centers on Akane, a boy who is drawn to murders, and his classmate Hikari, a girl who has committed murder in the past.

(Source: ANN)

title: Shinkyoku Soukai Polyphonica: The Black
author: Yonemura, Kouichirou, Osako, Junichi
description:
Polyphonica "the Black" is finally made available as a "hard-boiled" detective comic. In this city the police have joined forces with spirits to investigate crimes, resulting in the formation of a specialist unit—the "Spirits of the Dead" or "Ghost" Division.

A murder occured in a quiet residential area, and the victim's daughter vanished from the scene leaving only mystery in her wake.
The victim's contracted spirit was "Leon"... but is he really a criminal?

title: Iliad
author: Nagasaki, Takashi, Uoto, Osamu
description: Searching for the lost island Atlantis.

title: Detective Conan the Movie: The Lost Ship in the Sky
author: Abe, Yutaka, Aoyama, Goushou, Maru, Denjirou
description: Manga adaptation of the fourteenth Meitantei Conan movie.

title: Grasshopper
author: Ida, Hiroto, Isaka, Koutarou
description: Suzuki, who was once a law-abiding teacher, joins a criminal organization called Reijou in order to avenge his murdered wife. But his attempt is thwarted by mysterious man who comes to be known as the "Pusher" because he shoves the criminal into the path of an oncoming car. Suzuki decides to pursue the Pusher. This mystery man is also being pursued by two other hit men; the knife-wielder Cicada and the assassin Whale, whose family is in the business of making people commit suicide. The story is

title: Zenra Otoko to Shibainu Otoko: Keishichou Seikatsu Anzenbu Yuugeki Sousahan
author: Watanabe, Asia, Kouzuki, Hinowa
description: Newly-instated detective Tomohiro Ishida returns home one day to find a naked man in his house. He asks Tomohiro to identify himself, only to vanish into thin air before the startled young man can come up with a response. Soon afterwards, Tomohiro becomes tangled up in an odd situation involving a killer sword that can possess people. Then the same guy shows up again: this time fully clothed and actually physically present. Kyousuke is a member of the supernatural task force affiliated with the

title: Yubikiribako
author: Yuki, Amino
description: One day, Mikage Akihito, an ordinary high schooler, finds the dead body of one of his classmates. From then on, other students started to die, one at a time... Is this chain of despair going to completely destroy their peaceful everyday?

title: Requiem of Subdued Souls
author: Jungyeon, Owollang
description:
"If there is an omen of disaster in the Hwarang, who else could it be besides Seol Yeongrang, who controls spirits?"

Hwarang Seol Yeongrang was prophesied as one who would bring forth disaster. The only way he could return to his ranks is by solving incidents, in turn proving he wasn't the omen he was painted as. And whilst he ventures, a mysterious mad man named Zaha appears. In the era of Silla, where humans, yokai, and spirits roam, a hwarang's requiem unfolds.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment,

title: Shinizokonai no Ao
author: Yamamoto, Kotetsuko
description:
Three stories with afterwords by both the mangaka and the writer (whose original work this manga is based on).

A new teacher proves to be popular with the students and parents. But one of his students feels like he is picking on him deliberately. Around the same time, the student in question starts seeing a blue-skinned... thing that only he can see.

A girl starts staying at home more after a car accident leaves her blind. But is she really alone in the house?

A guy moves into an apartment wh

title: The 11th School Trip
author: Do, Hae-neul, Mingnew
description:
Gajun and Sunwoo, students with supernatural abilities, are trapped in a time loop during their school trip.

After witnessing their friends' deaths, Gajun realizes Sunwoo's death triggers the loop. He becomes fiercely protective, while Sunwoo, confused, tries to protect Gajun in return.

(Source: Manta)

title: When a Thousand Moons Rise
author: Park, Hee Jung
description:
What if you were fated to be murdered in every life? Living in a small countryside town, Nogyung Lee thinks her biggest problem is her unrequited crush on her childhood friend. But Nogyung is cursed—destined to be slain by the same villagers every time she's reborn. With no memories of her previous lives, she must unravel the mysteries of her village and the legends surrounding it in order to stay alive. Can Nogyung finally break the curse or is she fated to relive this tragedy forever?

(Source

title: MuZz
author: Swee Chin, Foo
description: MuZz is the story of Farllee, a girl who wakes up on a train, surrounded by strange creatures, with no idea of who she is or how she got there. She's on the MuZz Express, a train that carries discarded ideas to a land where they hope to live happy existences.

title: Venom: Kyuuaisei Shoujo Shoukougun
author: Shamoji, Shirosaki
description:
Venom, Darling Dance, Failure Girl, and other famous songs by the popular Vocaloid producer Kairiki Bear have been turned into "stories"!

Loneliness is like poison, I have nothing, I'm a failure, I'm a failure, and so on... In a social networking site where girls vent their pain, she comes across a rumor of "Courtship Girl Syndrome," which only teenage girls are affected by. She thought it was just a myth, a disease with a cute name and symptoms like those of a manga character. However, the abn

title: Revives cat
author: Takahashi, Shouma, Mitsuishi, Megane
description:
Two months ago, a horrible incident was caused by a student at a prestigious national school where only excellent students can enter. After the incident, Ayakawa Rika, classmate of that student, began suffering from a nightmare where a girl she doesn't know calls her name while crying. She tries to remain bright at school, keeping the dream a secret and avoiding the story of the incident. Until that day, after school...

(Source: Everystar)

title: My Code Name Is Charmer
author: Kakinouchi, Narumi
description:
Naomi, Makoto, Yuji, and Kaede all have psychic powers of some sort and make up the Supernatural Phenomenon Research Group of their school. They battle the Zeyrey, terrible monsters invisible to most people’s eyes, out to suck the life-energy of humans.

(Source: ANN)

title: Jintori Game
author: Oukami, Mineko
description:
At opposite ends of a certain super-huge site lay two separate dormitory schools; the liberal Aoimiya School and the disciplined Kaburaya School.

These two schools have been rivals for generations, fated to scramble for control over the site in a never ending "Jintori Game"
Teams of students work and fight together, and if a team loses all three members it's considered their school's loss.

When Aoimiya's new "Princess" disappears, suspicion falls on Kaburaya. 
To find out what happened three A

title: Tantei Team KZ Jiken Note
author: Sakura, Megu, Fujimoto, Hitomi, Sumitaki, Ryou
description: Aya Tachibana is a sixth-grader who frets and obsesses over friends, family, grades, and more. One day, she joins the "Tantei Team KZ" with four very idiosyncratic boys she met at cram school. There is the glib and attention-grabbing leader Kazuomi Wakatake, the mysterious "expert of personal relationships" Takakazu Kuroki, the smart and stoic math genius Kazunori Uesugi, and the sweet-hearted Kazuhiko Kozuka, who is good at social matters and science. Aya finds her place among them as the "lang

title: Urban Myth Dissolution Center - Case File: Kune Kune
author: Takahashi, Hideki
description: An original manga story set in the world of Toshi Densetsu Kaitai Center.

title: Global Examination
author: Mu, Suli
description: This is an examination that puts your life at stake. Answer a plethora of questions, pass the exam, and you may live. Two-faced examiner, Qin Jiu, meets the cold examinee, You Huo. In this inhumane system, both of them who have lost their memories go head to head against each other. Despite that, they have a strong mutual understanding. Alarms go off and the system collapses time and time again. During which, their memories gradually return. It turns out that even at the end of the world where t

title: Boku to Kimi no Nijuu Tantei
author: Petenshi, Tsuda, Honami

title: Akurei Tsukai
author: Watanabe, Chihiro
description: Arai Sui meets a fortune teller on her way home who tells her that her wishes will soon come true and they will have a very long acquaintance.  Soon after the fortune teller passes away, and Sui meets Nakajo Anzu who just happens to be the granddaughter of the fortune teller.  Along with their classmate Konoki Sakura, who's mother is a famous psychic, the girls become involved in various adventures involving the supernatural.

title: Black Museum: Crescent Moon, Dance with the Monster
author: Fujita, Kazuhiro
description: Mary Shelley is short of money after the publication of her famous novel. Despite the critical success of the work, the widow struggles to make ends meet and provide for her son's needs. One day, she makes a most astonishing discovery: the creature she had imagined in her novel has come to life, but this time in female form! Mary is then entrusted with a mission by the British secret services: to tame and make presentable this strange creature before Queen Victoria's big ball. The inventor of Fr

title: Echo/Zeon
author: Rikudou, Koushi
description: Starting in 1999, this is the story of the high school life of three friends. Yukari is an ambitious girl who loves money. Takao is a big, kind of timid guy who is also an expert at karate. Kanze has the most spectacular talent of all: she can recreate any sound she hears perfectly, whether it's someone's voice or a musical instrument. The three of them spend their high school days solving (or creating) mysteries, taking on cases at the request of other students. Whether they're dealing with kid

title: Detective Conan the Movie: Zero the Enforcer
author: Abe, Yutaka, Aoyama, Goushou, Maru, Denjirou
description: Manga adaptation of the twenty-second Meitantei Conan movie.

title: Ookamikakushi
author: Natsume, Eri, Masaki, Ryou
description: The story follows Hiroshi Kuzumi, a 16-year-old student who has just moved to the seemingly serene village of Jogamachi. Nestled in the mountains far away from the city, the village is divided by a river that separates old Jogamachi from new Jogamachi. Young Hiroshi soon discovers that the village is ancient as well as mysterious traditions and customs have been kept alive over the ages. Although a bit bewildered by the new environment, Hiroshi begins to settle into his new life. While he has ne

title: The Adventures of Lord El-Melloi II
author: Sanda, Makoto, Sakamoto, Mineji

title: As You Wish
author: Xian, Seoho
description:
Ein Price was 35 when he was murdered. Now he's 19 again and back in college with the man he was madly in love with: Ray Cunnington. After saving a dragon named Null, Ein was given three wishes. The first was a sausage. The second was for Ray to be the last face he saw before he dies. His wish was granted...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Timing
author: Kang, Full
description: For all her life, high school teacher Park Jagi has been able to foresee imminent disasters, but she has never succeeded in preventing them from happening. One day, she forecasts a terrible tragedy at her own school. However, unlike her previous nightmares, this time she appears within the vision to stop the event—alongside three other people she has not met before. With a few days remaining before the catastrophe will take place, Jagi is spurred into action to change the future and begins seeki

title: Psycho-Pass Genesis
author: Yoshigami, Ryou
description: Psycho-Pass Genesis tells the secret story of the creation of Sibyl System through an incident in which the young Tomomi Masaoka was involved.

title: Mabui no Kotowari
author: Koenji, Masahiko, Mori, Yukinatsu
description: A cursed video that circulates on the net, inexplicable repeated massacres in a lost mountain hamlet... the police decides to return in a special element difficult to master: Amamiku Matsuri, a medium originally from Okinawa can "see" and communicate with lost souls, but she was taken away from these cases because of her mental instability and her tendency to violence. But in the course of an investigation, the past catches up to Matsuri: placed in a position of victim, perpetrator and judge in

title: Dias Police: Ihou Keisatsu
author: Sugimura, Shinichi, Nagasaki, Takashi
description: There are roughly 150,000 illegal immigrants and illegal foreign workers in Tokyo. Those aliens have established a shady Metropolitan Government of the aliens, by the aliens, for the aliens. Public institutions such as government offices, courts, tax offices and hospitals exist within the shady government. Kubozuka Saki is the only police officer officially approved by the shady Metropolitan Government. This is a story of a mysterious man who protects and sometimes punishes aliens who can only l

title: A Will
author: Konno
description: In a world where people can only die from diseases and old age, Nen, a teenager had witnessed his parents die unnaturally with his own eyes. Although pained by his past, he now sets off on a path to discover the truth behind his parents deaths.

title: Mononoke: Bakeneko
author: Ninagawa, Yaeko
description: Manga adaption of the Bakeneko arc.

title: Let me watch your heartbeat.
author: Tanahashi, Namoshiro, MITA
description: A story of a medical college female student who is obsessed with hearts...

title: Ningyou Touge
author: Houjou, Yutori, Mochizuki, Kako
description:
A group of high school students visit the inside of a mountain on an agricultural trip. While staying at a farmer's home, they learn the rural life. However, the village doesn't exist...? A shudder runs down everyone's spine as a lot of inexplicable events happen in the village, that now restricts entry. What are the high schoolers fate?

(Source: COMICSMART, translated)

title: Reinousha Minato
author: kyo, Hayama, Tooru
description:
In our era, science is prospering more than ever. However, lurking in the corner of our world are paranormal creatures known only by a small number of peoples. Those creatures are called "Strangenesses". Obviously, some undertake the job to hunt down the Strangenesses. Shinto priestesses, monks, their designation varies, but among them is a man completely different from everyone else.
Minato Kujou is a cynical and sharp tongued young man who has no spiritual abilities at all. He is looked down u

title: Dance of the Scales
author: Aki, Haru
description:
After losing her parents to a heretic trial, Vivian lived quietly alone while concealing her intelligence. However, one day, a villager is suspected of being a Heretic. Cyril, a newly arrived clergy member, persistently demands answers from Vivian...?! An unlikely duo forms to bring the truth to light!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Danganronpa: Kibou no Gakuen to Zetsubou no Koukousei
author: Spike Chunsoft, Touya, Hajime
description: An adaptation of the trial version of Danganronpa: Kibou no Gakuen to Zetsubou no Koukousei, which features a different victim and killer.

title: Guuzou Jihen: Hato ni Himei wa Kikoenai
author: Misao, Ninjamu

title: Mou Ii yo
author: K
description: Kataoka (male) and Sato (female) have been friends since they were little. Kataoka has much better hearing than the average human, and he says Sato's voice is the most noisy of all. He has grown into a teenager able to hear everything from far around him—the good and bad. Now that the two of them are teenagers, Sato is affiliated with the school newspaper club, and Kataoka has mostly isolated himself. When the newspaper club decides to look into the truth behind some 'supernatural' rumors, Sato

title: Aria of the Sea
author: Hagio, Moto
description: A sci-fi series with ecological preservation themes. Colin had watched helplessly as his beautiful brother and popular top student, Abel, drowned at sea during a freak storm. So he is totally relieved when Abel later reappears only to find out that an alien life form has entered his body, turning his personality topsy-turvy and high-strung! Dark secrets about the real Abel surface, aggravated even more by the discovery that he is now a receptive channel for the musical genius of their new and my

title: Bungaku Shoujo Short Stories from DVD
author: Nomura, Mizuki, Takeoka, Miho
description:
Short Stories that included in Limited Editions of Bungaku Shoujo Movie and Memoire DVDs. 

Bungaku Shoujo Heian-hen Kakitsuzuru Boku to Yomigataru Kanojo - Bungaku Shoujo Movie
Mermaid wa Amai Romance ga Suki - Memoire I
Snow Queen wa Ai wo Yurusanai - Memoire II
Belle wa Tsun to Kao wo Somukeru - Memoire III

title: Reto the Protector
author: Sanbe, Kei
description:
Clad in a blood-soaked coat and with no destination in mind, a young boy named Reto wanders into an Ainu village amidst a blizzard, whose residents provide him with much-needed shelter. All he has are two things: the memory of his mother dying before his eyes, and an ancient hunting knife without a blade...

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Item
author: Minhyung, Kim, Junseok
description:
A mysterious camera that shows the future. Ghost lights of unknown origin. And people slipping into unexplainable comas. This is all the information detective Seo Sungmin has as he pieces together the mystery of his girlfriend's vegetative state. But investigations hit a standstill when he's found with blood on his hands... Now on the run, will Sungmin be able to solve this supernatural case and bring the real criminal to justice?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kuro x Hitsuji: 12-nin no Yasashii Koroshiya
author: Kine, Wosamu

title: Lupin III: Tankoubon Mishuuroku Sakuhinshuu
author: Monkey Punch
description: A collection of previously uncompiled chapters of Lupin III, Shin Lupin III, and the 5-part Sexy Lupin III series.

title: Hiroki - Harusaki Meiro
author: Hoshino, Kana
description:
Hiroki and Kanata have been together since they were children. One day Hiroki is caught up in an accident while trying to save a little girl. The next thing he knows, he is looking down on his own body. Seperated from his body, Kanata, and everything else, Hiroki tries to figure out just what is going on.

Why is he outside his body which is living on as if nothing has changed, how can he convince Kanata that he is there, and who is the strange girl, Fhalei, who keeps appearing for him?

(Source

title: Le Vin, Wine Burglar
author: Kibayashi, Shin, Okimoto, Shuu
description:
A five man band of thieves whose specialty is wine travel the world, appearing here and there under the name "Phantom Thief Levain" to save bottles of unparalleled wine from the villains who hoard them!

(Source: Manga Box)

title: Professor Munakata's British Museum Adventure
author: Hoshino, Yukinobu
description:
“The Stonehenge megaliths have been stolen!?” So exclaims Professor Munakata at the outset of a rollicking adventure set at the British Museum, a bizarre plot to force the repatriation of the museum’s prized objects.
(Source: The Economist).

Information can be found under more info.

title: Chronos: Jisedai Hanzai Jouhoushitsu
author: Yuzuki, Shou, Kaminaga, Manabu
description:
The National Police Agency Security Bureau has a secret organization known as the Next Generation Crime Information Centre. Their job is to stop murders before they actually happen, by using a certain girl's precognitive dreams.

(Source: MU)

title: Lily Trigger
author: Tamaki, Nozomu, Kanoe, Yuushi
description: The main Jayson in counterterrorist group during mission meets the girl. Mission has been broken. The girl is taken away by the authorities and hold it as an animal. Its awakening was not usual-now the world or should accept it, or it will be destroyed...

title: Psycho Doctor Kai Kyosuke
author: Okimoto, Shuu, Agi, Tadashi
description:
Kai Kyousuke is a talented psychologist and former assistant professor. His office may be a mess, but he is both skilled and dedicated to helping people who are in psychological pain. He and his assistant, Kanno Azusa, get to the bottom of each patient's case. His first case in this series is a woman whose physical pain may be a manifestation of her distrust for her lover...

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Red Garden ～Whereabouts of Deep Darkness～
description:
Four girls find themselves trapped between life and death, forced to kill in order to exist.

A novel adaptation that has a different narrative emphasis to the anime series, though the characters and setting are the same.

title: Yojigen Sekai
author: Matsumoto, Leiji
description:
A sci-fi manga created by Leiji Matsumoto in 1995.

Note: The one-shot Eisei 2-ren Dokubou was collected in Comic S: Hayakawa Shobou Souritsu 70-shuunen Kinen Comic Anthology★SF-hen.

title: How to Live as a Civil Servant in Murim
author: Geulsseuneun Gigye, KZV
description: One day, Yeon Woo-hyeok falls into the martial world and becomes a civil servant. He is a seasoned player of the martial arts detective game, Great Hwan-Guk's Famous Bodyguard. Without any warning, he finds himself reincarnated as the bodyguard from the game. Fortunately, he realizes that the game's events are unfolding exactly as he had memorized them. As he begins solving cases, he starts adapting to his new life as the bodyguard. But his joy is short-lived when he discovers his ability, "Yeon

title: Shin Megami Tensei III: Nocturne - Konton
author: Haccan, Boogey, Toumon
description: The story follows high school student Shin Managi who, after visiting his teacher in a hospital, witnesses the end of the world. After this mysterious event he is granted supernatural powers, becoming half-demon and is able to recruit other demons to aid him.

title: CUTTING
author: Haneda, Daisuke, Mo
description:
Kazuya is a teenager who is worried about himself acting differently in his daily life then what his heart actually believes. One day he encounters Mio, a serious suicidal girl who slits her own wrist. 

He is then attracted to her uncontrollably and the two became lovers soon after Kazuya's confession. After spending some time with each other, Mio's personalty is changed bit by bit, right before she was murdered...

title: Associate Professor Akira Takatsuki's Conjecture
author: Sawamura, Mikage
description: Naoya Fukamachi is a university student whose ability to infallibly detect lies has left him friendless and isolated. But when he writes a paper about a strange festival he wandered into as a child, he catches the fancy of his folklore studies professor Akira Takatsuki, a handsome and eccentric man with a passion for all things mysterious. Soon, Naoya finds himself working as Akira's assistant, helping him to interpret an array of unexplainable phenomena, from haunted objects and cursed effigies

title: Hosutan he Youkoso
author: Tateno, Makoto
description: A boy becomes an employee at a very unusual host club where they solve mysteries.

title: Nichoume Rojiura Tantei Kitan
author: Kobayashi, Tetsuya
description: One night, Alice enters her master's bedroom to find him gone. After waiting 3 days with no word from him she finds a number for a detective agency. She later meets Chocola from the agency and together soon find their masters. This 4-koma revolves around the activities of these two girls and the detective agency, including artificial humans, vampire hunters, romcom and a bit of gender confusion.

title: My Dog Is a Death God
author: Aozaki, Ritsu, Chinen, Mikito
description: God of death, Leo, has been dispatched to Earth on a mission to save human souls, and has found himself at a small hospice called Okanoue Hospital. For this task, he's been granted a special form: one with four legs, a tail, and a keen olfactory sense. Thanks to his canine assets, Leo can seek out patients at the hospice who are plagued by a lifetime of regret. With his wet nose and doggy good looks, little death god Leo eases patients into their next life, setting them free of both the quiet hi

title: Love Dester
author: Sakaki, Kenji
description:
If you can't confess your true love, it means "death"!! Boys and girls now face a terrible ordeal as subjects of experiments with no exit...!!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Elite!!: Expert Latitudinous Investigation TEam
author: Shinjou, Mayu
description:
Sachi Imafuku is a policeman working in a countryside. He is a sole survivor of a plane crash twenty years ago and has escaped unhurt from three accidents. One day, Imafuku is appointed to the criminal division of Tokyo Metropolitan Police. There he meets two young leaders of Special Wide Area Investigation Section.

(Source: Mainichi)

title: Psycho-Pass Asylum
author: Yoshigami, Ryou
description:
Psycho-Pass Asylum contains four short stories. The first is about Guseong Choi's early life in North Korea. The second is about Kagari Shuusei's life, complete with his cuisines. The third one is about Yayoi Kunizuka and Shion Karanomori's relationship. The last one is about the daily life of Nobuchika Ginoza as a young Inspector.

(Source: Psycho-Pass Wiki, edited)

title: Chang An Huan Ye
author: Han, Lu, Mian tang, Xiong
description:
During the period when the Tang Dynasty was at its peak of success, imperial court general, Huangfu Duanhua, was whisked away into a series of bizarre and supernatural events after his friend accidentally stepped into a store owned by a Persian merchant. This then led to many incidents that were kept sealed by the empire for a thousand years...

Court disputes, strife in the royal family… As the wheels of the perilous history are set in motion, where will they lead?

(Source: Esthétique)

title: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
author: Stevenson, Robert Louis, Variety Art Works
description:
A strange case occurred in London at the end of the 19th century. What is the true face of the vicious criminal roaming the city? The famous masterpiece epitomizing the phenomenon known as split personality is adapted into comic format!

(Source: Jmanga)

title: The karte of Medical student Sakutaro Kanbe.
author: Ayamine, Keu
description:
Inspector Amano Tasuku encounters a bizarre case: a corpse with the insides removed was thrown away on the street. In order to request an autopsy Amano goes to the medical faculty of Imperial University and meets Kanbe Sakutarou, a beautiful boy with a love for the dead.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kakeru
author: Takeshita, Kenjirou
description: Daiba Kakeru has always felt like he entered a new world whenever he ran. Tiring himself out by running would cause something like a runner’s high and his five senses would go into overload, causing them to be hyper sensitive. He would be able to notice tiny details, hear ridiculously faint or far sounds and his body’s reaction time would be incredibly quick. Kakeru has had a crush on his classmate Natsume for months now and he's finally able to ask her out, only to find out that she ran away fr

title: Ornitho
author: Suehirogari
description:
In part 1, a new teacher seems to be almost *too* easy to enslave, scaring off the students. It turns out she has secrets to keep and her own agenda at the school. It takes the headmistress's personal involvement to resolve the mess.

In part 2, a group of students turn their eye towards the new Student Council President, tricking and forcing her to agree to do random sexual things for 6 months. Trapped between her commitment to the student body and her friends and classmate's manipulations, she

title: Kamakura Monogatari
author: Saigan, Ryouhei
description:
Isshiki Masakazu, a mystery writer living in Kamakura, is also a skilled detective. Together with his wife Akiko, he interacts with the demons, spirits, gods, buddhas, and aliens of Kamakura. His acquaintances and friends range from affiliates of the Police to mysterious animals. Adults and children will enjoy this work of mystery as he solves difficult and strange cases with a variety of characters as his side.

(Source: Jmanga)

title: Danshou no Grimm
author: Kouda, Gakuto, Mikazuki, Kakeru
description:
It is said that all unexplainable mysteries that occur in our world is part of the fragments of "God's nightmares." When these nightmares floats into people minds, they are mixed together with their fear, ill intentions and insanity. Bit by bit as the world is manipulated, it creates the tales of nightmare.

 Shirano Aoi, a boy who treasures his ordinary daily life and Tokitsuki Yukino, a girl who is haunted by her past encounters each other in "Cinderella's Nightmare," which was created by huma

title: Gibbet Room
author: Shida
description:
A girl's memories, emotions and humanity are shattered like so many pieces of a puzzle. Lacey, a girl who's lost everything falls into a labyrinth of chaos. To step inside, is to step into a world of chaos and death. The Gibbet Room. Even so, the girl opens the door, to find what she has lost, herself.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Meikai no Pendulum
author: Sakihata, Io
description:
A series of murders has been happening during the red moon. People say that it’s the work of the “Death God with a Red Scythe”…the title character of a popular mystery novel!?

(Source: The Zero Alliance)

title: Tokyo Dennou Tanteidan
author: Ishizawa, Katsuyoshi, MONQ
description: Spin-off novel based on Vocaloid "Tokyo Dennou Tantei Dan" song.

title: Midas Eater
author: Ooiwa, Kenji
description:
19-year-old Shiguma is having a really bad day. He's lost a bet, lost his job as a bartender, and been saddled with taking care of a nerdy looking customer, Senri, who is passed out drunk. Things only get worse when he and Senri are chased by a giant monster. Luckily, Senri happens to be the reincarnation of Midas, Lord of the Underworld! Will Shiguma be able to survive the new turns his life is taking?

(Source: B.U.)

title: Smoking Gun: Minkan Kasouken Chousain Nagareta Enishi
author: Takeya, Syuji, Yokomaku, Tomohiro
description:
Nagareta Enishi is an eccentric, donut-loving forensic scientist at the private Chiyoda Forensic Science Laboratory. Nagareta mostly deals with civil issues and unsolved cases. His first few involve proving the truth behind an incident of public-transport groping and determining whether a 5-year-old case was a suicide or simply an accident. However, there's also a deadly mystery to be solved from Nagareta's own past...

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Ningyoutsukai
author: Murata, Eeji
description: While walking alone one night, a man runs into a mysterious puppeteer. Soon after the meeting, everyone he knows begins to act oddly.

title: Hero Detective Nick
author: Zaki, Mitsunori
description:
Nick Spade, a detective in a city where super heroes are exist. However, his work is walking dogs and investigating cheating cases. One day, the client who visited him is a former well-known super villain. What request would a super villain make to an ordinary detective?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kamen Byoutou
author: Chinen, Mikito, Nicomichihiro
description:
Shuugo Hayami is a doctor at a nursing hospital, which was once a psychiatric hospital. One evening, when he was on night duty, a man in a clown mask breaks into the hospital, and he is not alone. He is with Hitomi Kawasaki, a university student who has been shot by the masked man. The masked man tells Shuugo to treat Hitomi, and also takes the 64 people in the hospital hostage. Soon, Shuugo and Hitomi try to escape from the hospital, and they encounter mysterious cases one at a time.

(Source:

title: Where on When,
author: Mikomo, Kouji
description: A high school student searches for mystical objects using a pendulum made of a coin and makes an unexpected discovery.

title: Es no Kaihou
author: Kurata, Emi
description:
Mei Kashiwara has been feeling something strange lately... Just as she is trying to make sense of this strange feeling, a girl from their school, Michiko Kawabata jumps off the roof and commits suicide. Mei, who witnesses the incident, starts calling herself "Michiko Kawabata," and her classmate Tatsuhiko Karaya is tangled in this mystery. Is it a psychological problem, or a psychic phenomenon? A work that focuses on deep psychology.

(Source: MU)

title: Silent Möbius QD
author: Asamiya, Kia, Shigema, Kei
description: Set seventeen years after the original manga series, a new generation of AMP serve on the front line between Lucifer Hawk and humanity.

title: Murders at the House of Death
author: Miyokawa, Masaru, Imamura, Masahiro

title: Rengoku Hime
author: kaya8, Fujiwara, Yuu
description:
Another world exists one level below the one we live in, the Rengoku. Rengoku is filled with a poisonous gas called "ren." Although "ren" is harmful to the human body, it brought many new possibilities to mankind.

Artemisia also known as Alto is the first princess of the country Ei. She has an abnormal body which is a doorway connected to the Rengoku. Because of this her body emits "ren" uncontrollably, bringing death to the people around her. As a cursed princess, she is locked up in the castl

title: Break It
author: Komeko
description:
A mysterious man, Hosumi, who suddenly appeared when Satsuki, a rural high school student, is in the middle of beating up some local punks.

He's terrified but he obeys Hosumi's orders since he's strong than Satsuki. He can't help but follow the mysterious man. And he even took Satsuki to his home!!? Despite being questioned, he can't keep up with the situation. He doesn't understand what's happening right now. Who on earth is this guy...? Moreover, Hosumi was a police officer.

A heartwarming b

title: Revenge of the Soul Eater: Cast Out as a Weakling by My Sword Saint Father
author: Yuunagi, Gyokuto
description: Sora Mitsurugi's life isn't going as planned. Disowned for incompetence by his renowned Sword Saint father, dumped by his fiancée, and banished from his island home, he sets off to prove himself as an adventurer on the mainland. But when his new so-called-comrades deceive him and use him as bait for a dangerous monster, he finds himself on the precipice of death. Just before his demise, a raging power courses through his body and he is reborn as the legendary dragon, the Soul Eater! Now, with hi

title: So wa Reirei no Yuki ni Mai
author: Ishihara, Satoru
description:
This story in set in the Taisho era (1912-1926).

Two years after the famous author Uro vanished, his last manuscript is found at the house of competing author Otogai, who seems obsessed with (or is it possessed by?) his supposedly-dead rival. By a strange turn of events, three acquaintances; an illustrator, an editor and a stage performer, end up investigating Otogai's odd behaviour. They discover that the writer's garden appears to be haunted by a mysterious camellia bush...and camellia was Ur

title: Alive
author: Momoi, Yuzuki
description:
Akira Hondou was shot to death by the U.S. military for a crime he did not commit. However, he somehow survived and became a teacher at a girls' high school. The objective of his assignment to this school? The key to that is in the hands of Hibiki Tsukishima, an ordinary high school girl in the art club... The story accelerates as Hondou, an out-of-the-ordinary egoistic gentleman, gets involved in his surroundings.

(Source: Cygames, translated)

title: Kuroinu O'clock
author: Endou, Minari
description: Onoda Aki is a high school boy, who can accurately predict a time of death. One day he finds out about his grandmother's imminent demise and looks for a better end for her. His searchs lead Aki to "Black Dog" company, which arranges an ideal death for whom, who already fated to die.

title: Gekijouban Ataru: The First Love & The Last Kill
author: Terai, Akane, Sakurai, Takeharu
description:
A young man afflicted with autism has an uncanny ability to see through details that normal people don't see. He becomes involved with police investigators and ends up helping them in some of their cases. This manga is adapted from a TV drama series.

(Source: MU)

title: Hanamamoru Kemono
author: Momono, Miku
description: Since her birth, Chika has got a mark in form of a flower on her décolleté. She is a student of a noble college, but she lost her parents. The only thing left, is her cat, which disappeared. While searching for her friend, she meets a demon who offers help, but getting her chastity as an exchange.

title: 203-goushitsu no Jinko-san
author: Yamada, Nari
description: Jinko is a girl with a strange gift. She can see and talk to ghosts. She's living in an apartment room 203 together with her parents. Lot of curious ghosts visit her room, hoping Jinko can help them reveal their veil of death.

title: The Ultimate Time Sweeper Mahoroba
author: Matsumoto, Leiji
description: Yo Haguro, a recurring character of Leiji Matsumoto's mangas, works as a secretary onboard the luxury cruiser ship, "Revenge of Earth." On this ship, World War II is still happening, as people onboard still have issues with the conclusion of the original conflict. When Toshiro Oyama, a photographer and son of a WWII photographer, starts working on the ship after being contacted by Yo, he soon realizes that there's more than one unusal ship, when "Revenge of Earth" is being tracked down by the gh

title: H.P. Lovecraft's the Unnamable and Other Stories
author: Lovecraft, H. P., Tanabe, Gou

title: Million Joe
author: Ichimaru, Iroha, Toguchi, Ryoji
description:
Million Joe is the best manga of all time. A long running shounen action adventure series centering on a boy named Nyack and his quest to uncover the secret of Million Joe, known for its heavy use of foreshadowing and resolving old plot threads in a way that you can tell the author planned it out years in advance. Not only has this made it one of the best selling and most loved manga in Japan, if you include the anime and merch, it supports a trillion yen industry annually.

This is not that man

title: Kogan no Mouten
author: Onodou, Amanosuke, Hayama, Seri
description: Spinning up a different take on mystery manga. It's up to "you" to figure out the mistakes the perpetrator made.

title: Bloody Eye: Sarasarete Shine
author: Koga, Kei, Arashiyama, Nori
description:
A reporter working for a weekly tabloid is getting involved in a bizarre serial murder case where a red eye symbol is left behind on every victim.

(Source: Manga Mogura)

title: The Troublesome Guest of Sotomura Detective Agency
author: Kusama, Sakae
description:
Kei Matsuda is a private investigator who specializes in quirky cases centered on his local neighborhood around the shopping arcade. He's recently taken on a new roommate (and lover) named Kamiko who is unemployed, ruthlessly horny, and was actually a classmate from his past.

While the two work together to solve cases, they carry on in what starts as a strictly physical relationship... until Matsuda finds that this temporary situation he has entered with Kamiko might be turning into something m

title: Waver(s)
author: Yamamoto, Kazune
description:
At a high school deep in the snowy mountains, a teacher was killed. There are 28 suspects. They all have superpowers.

(Source: Kadokawa, Translated)

title: Snowilybell
author: Jiji
description:
Rozariol, who was looking for a master to serve, meets the daughter of the Dewberry household, Snowbell, and becomes her servant. "You must not tell lies." This is the only rule that the servants must follow. However, Snowbell often tests her servants on that condition, thus the cruel "judgement" begins.

(Source: AQUA Scanlations)

title: The four seasons.
author: Mori, Hiroshi, Nekome, Toochika
description: Story about Magata Shiki, a character from S&M series.

title: Yamataika
author: Hoshino, Yukinobu
description:
While visiting the Seifa Utaki, the foremost sacred grove of Okinawa, the young woman Miwako is drawn into a cave and called into her power while the earth quakes beneath her. Miwako, who was born on Kudaka Island, the "Island of the Gods," is apparently a living embodiment of the ancient shaman-queen. What destiny awaits the newly awakened Miwako?

(Source: MU)

title: Shinkyoku Soukai Polyphonica Black
author: Osako, Junichi, BUNBUN
description:
Set in the same timeline as the Polyphonica Crimson series.

Each title is written in the format Shinkyoku Polyphonica title Black (神曲奏界ポリフォニカ title・ブラック )

1. Inspector 
2. Silent
3. Player(s)
4. Triangle
5. Resolution
6. Patient
7. Memoirs (Memowazu / メモワーズ )
8. Reliance
9. Isolation
10. Liberation
11. Adoration
12. Promised
13. Advent

Following the authors death in 2010, the future of the series is unknown.

title: Gakkou no Kaidan
author: Ogawa, Kyoumi
description: Hanako, Kinjiro, and another major ghost in the Seven School Wonders are talking about scary stories and rumours that happen in their school.

title: Pinky Punky
author: Monkey Punch
description:
Jun Jun, independent private eye, solves hi-tech crimes and busts criminals using her feminine wit and charm, and also with the help of her homemade gadgets. An occasional enemy is Dr. Nekura, AKA the most evil genius in the world, who's desperate to prove he's better than everyone (especially Jun Jun).

(Source: MangaDex)

Included one-shot: Gyakuten Watson

title: Or, My Great Detective
author: Dokuta, Pepako
description:
High schooler Momo Odagiri leaves her island home to attend high school on the mainland. Having grown up on a boring island, Momo dreams of becoming a detective and is always on the lookout for cases. After moving into her first apartment, she meets the mysterious beauty Kotone Akaishi and falls for her at first sight. Declaring she'll make the reluctant Kotone her "assistant" against her will, the two form a buddy team to solve small everyday mysteries together.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Cool Shock B.T.
author: Hitsujiyama, Juuichirou, Matsutani, Yuuta
description:
Middle schooler Koichi Mugikari befriends the "Wicked Boy" B.T. after the latter saves him from a pair of extortionists. The two end up becoming involved in an incident with an arsonist live streamer.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Kaidan to Odorou, Soshite Anata wa Kaidan de Odoru
author: Ryukishi07, Tomohi
description: The story is set in a middle school in Shishibone city. Tomohiro Miyajima, the main character of the story, and his group of friends are busy studying for an exam. One day, in search for a thrilling mystery as well as easy money, they take several donation boxes and fabricate a curse to scare everyone: "Ohone-sama's curse". After scrawling 骨 (bone) all over the chalkboards and spreading rumors of the curse, the donation boxes are quickly filled and the curse becomes a major legend of the school.

title: Secret Agent Holmes
author: Inuki, Eiji
description:
Kenichi Nishikagi, Mako and Kitahara Kogoro Akashi are normal kids - or so it seems.
In truth, the three members of the secret special unit of the Tokyo police and solve complicated cases! Holmes, Marple and Kogoro, as are three call themselves called whenever the "normal" police no longer progresses. A faithful companion and helper can be found in Harada commissioner who is not necessarily the brightest, but takes heart in the right place and the help of three from one or other dicey situation.

title: G'Day
author: Choi, Yong Sung
description:
Having lost all contact with his sister, Shiyoung, a worried Shion sets out to see what is wrong by arriving in Australia, where his sister was staying. While staying at the share house his sister was living, he starts to sense that the people there have something to do with his missing sister.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Kimi to Tokei to Uso no Tou
author: Ayasaki, Shun, Nishinoki, Hara
description:
"The girl I love died."

From the morning he saw that nightmare, everything began. High school sophomore Kijou Souchi is struggling to search for his friend who has been absent from school for days. What kind of mystery lies behind this?

(Source: MU)

title: Ghost Face
author: Hyung, Min-Woo
description: Thousands of the world's most ruthless criminals are locked away in the ruins of a city on a wind-swept island called Sodo. Out of the writhing mass of vice and violence, the strongest of the ganglords have clawed their way to the top and set themselves up as local gods of the prison island. The corporate city-states which jailed these dangerous men and women rely on the unending tides of gang war to keep the criminals stranded—but since only the strong survive, the island instead serves as an i

title: Moriawase Girls
author: Suzuki, Sanami
description:
1. Anraku Isu no Kaiju Tantei
2. Shiroi Majo to Yukimi Ocha (The White Witch and the Snow-Viewing Tea Party)
3. Kurenai no Shizuku Ame no Machi
4. Writer Ghost
5. Shiroyukihime to 70-nin Kobito
6. Kimi no Koe ga Kikoenai
7. Shufu to Asakusa
8. Mahou Shoujo Bitch Bitch

title: Ghost Story Loop
author: Yagi, Jun, Katou, Tsunami
description: Azusa Yuunami doesn't believe in ghosts or curses—but she's more than willing to photograph supposedly haunted locations for her brother's website collecting local spooky folklore as long as he keeps bribing her with sweets. A fateful visit to an abandoned well, however, lands her right in the middle of her own terrifying ghost story. Tracking the mysterious figure appearing in her photographs reveals the true nature of her curse—she must relive the same day over and over again, and her only hop

title: KoKkuRi-san ga Tooru
author: Okuse, Saki
description:
The KoKkuRi who draw the blood of the "Clan of Deception" consist of three women—Ko (fox), Ku (Dog), and Ri (Badger)—with Rikako Oomori at the center. They go to the windy town of Shinjuku for a showdown against a motley crowd of apparitions that eat nests.

(Source: MU)

title: A Woman Who Abandoned Her Face for Revenge
author: Fujimori, Harumi

title: Kappa no Sanpei
author: Mizuki, Shigeru
description:
Sanpei is a young carefree boy that lives alone with his grandfather deep in the mountains.

One day, when Sanpei takes a nap whilst floating down the river on a makeshift raft, he is mistaken for a Kappa and gets pulled underwater by a group of 'fellow' Kappa that are worried about him being spotted by humans, before whisking Sanpei away to the underwater Kingdom of the Kappa.

Upon arrival, Sanpei is soon discovered to actually be a human and is immediately is sentenced to execution.
Realizing

title: Xevec
author: bose, Shimouchi, Toota
description:
2057, Hemisphere, a man-made city in Tokyo Bay, has wiped out virtually all crime by introducing the quantum AI system "XEVEC", through which the "law" acts as a physical force to protect all citizens. Hemisphere is a "utopia", an ultra-nomocratic society in which the righteous are rewarded and permanent peace is guaranteed. Or so I thought. Until that incident...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Poolside Memories
author: Honda, Sango
description:
When their classmate's expensive watch goes missing during swimming class, the prime suspects are the three students who sat out that day: Taewoong, Mitsuki, and Sakuma. Together, they set out on the hunt for the lost watch, but what they find is...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Ottori Sousa
author: Kotegawa, Yua
description:
The story is about a Detective named Akiba who crosses paths with a high school idol named Mizuho. He was assigned to protect her. But he's also a young detective and a bit unorthodox. For the first two volumes Mizuho ends up getting involved in Akiba's other cases but eventually it progresses into a friendship, and eventually a relationship.

(Source: MU)

Included one-shots:
Volume 7: Arcana (pilot)
Volume 10: Silent

title: A Tempest of Cage
author: Matsumoto, Mikan
description: Ten years have passed since the tragic death of Takahisa Umezaki, the eldest son of the Umezaki family. Although he had a weak body, what brought on his demise was a nasty storm and unstable ground near a cliff. Although, in Yoshihisa's mind, the catalyst for his brother's death was Kai's sudden betrayal. It has been ten years and Takahisa's death still lingers in their minds. Yoshihisa tracks down Kai and tries to force the truth out of him. Why did Takahisa die? It has been ten years and Yoshi

title: Tantei Higurashi Tabito no Sagashimono
author: Sugahara, Ryuu, Yamaguchi, Kouzaburou
description: The sound, the smell, the taste, the texture, the temperature, the weight, the pain. A detective who can see things that are not visible to the naked eye, this is the story of Higurashi Tabito's search for love.

title: Meitantei nanka ja Nai: Koukousei Tantei Battle Royale
author: Morita, Shunpei

title: Sharakuna: Kaiki Shinrei Kenbunroku
author: Nagano, Akira
description:
