A young editor, who faints with anything scary, ends up being in charge of the mysterious novelist Sharakuna! The elusive author claims he is in a slump and needs an actual "horror experience" to finish his manuscript. He convinces the editor to join him in visiting many haunted hotspots.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: About a Place in the Kinki Region
author: Usui, Tsukasa, Sesuji
description: My friend is missing. Before he disappeared, he was working on a magazine about the paranormal—his first real job as an editor. With almost no budget, he'd resorted to digging through back issues and unused research material, looking for inspiration. As he did, a terrifying truth began to emerge about a certain place in the Kinki region. I have collected the relevant articles, interviews, and other excerpts in this book. And once you have understood everything, I would like to ask for your coope

title: Murder Innocence
author: Ueda, Hiroshi, Kumagai, Jun
description:
The manga centers on a female lawyer who is the second-youngest bar passer at 20 years old, and who has remained undefeated in all her cases, with each one resulting in a not-guilty verdict, even for those charged with murder. As a result, she remains an outsider in the legal community despite her victories.

(Source: ANN)

title: Paprika
author: Tsutsui, Yasutaka
description: When prototype models of a dream-invading device go missing at the Institute for Psychiatric Research, it transpires that someone is using them to drive people insane. Threatened both personally and professionally, brilliant psychotherapist Atsuko Chiba has to journey into the world of fantasy to fight her mysterious opponents. As she delves ever deeper into the imagination, the borderline between dream and reality becomes increasingly blurred, and nightmares begin to leak into the everyday real

title: Virtual Beast: Comic Side
author: Hoshino, Wakako, Fujiki, Rin
description:
Since youth, Shin had a special ability to foresee dangerous situations. When his sister, Nao, was kidnapped by the people from a research center, Shin finally realized that he was not actually human, but a "virtual beast" created in a genetic experiment. To solve the complicated mysteries revolving about himself and save his sister, Shin and his good friend Tatsuki embark on a perilous journey.

(Source: Vampire Knights)

title: Meitantei Shiro Series
author: Serizawa, Naoki
description: Shiro is a haunted and invincible student who helps an agency of detectives.

title: Meitantei Shikkaku na Kanojo
author: Fushimi, Tsukasa, Hasumi, Elan, Issue
description:
There is a boarding high school. Konoha meets a girl on the entrance ceremony day. Her name is Karen and she suddenly says to Konoha, "You're the culprit." According to her, the mysterious thief who sent theft notice to the school the other day is Konoha. She doesn't know what's going on, but Karen believes that Konoha is the culprit.

(Source: HimeyaShop)

title: Rem le Rose no Majo
author: Shimotsuki, Haruka, Kamikou, Chizu, Hiyama, Nao
description:
Roshelle, a kind-hearted young man living in a village, was soon to enter a knight school for nobles. However on the day of the banquet which was celebrating his passing the entrance exam, he went outside with his brother, and walked into the forbidden shrine where he was cursed by a witch. In order to relinquish the curse, that is said to bring him his death within 7 days, Roshelle went alone into the castle in the misty forest where the witch was said to reside...

Sleeping in the castle was A

title: The Sherlock Holmes Story
author: Kwon, Gyo-jung
description: The story of the famous Sherlock Holmes revisited by Kwon Gyo-Jung.

title: Danshou no Grimm
author: Kouda, Gakuto, Matsuzaka, Yutaka
description:
It is said that all unexplained mysteries that occur in our world are part of the fragments of "God's nightmares." When these nightmares float into people minds, they are mixed together with their fears, ill intentions and insanity. Bit by bit as the world is manipulated, it creates the tales of nightmare.

Shirano Aoi, a boy who treasures his ordinary daily life and Tokitsuki Yukino, a girl who is haunted by her past, encounter each other in "Cinderella's Nightmare," which was created by humans

title: Nante Suteki ni Japanesque
author: Himuro, Saeko, Yamauchi, Naomi
description:
Princess Ruri is in trouble. Her dad, the great general of the powerful Fujiwara family is trying to set her up to married with some noble man. Ruri is 16 years old now, in the Heian era, she's getting old to get married, however, because of her personality, everyone see her as an odd princess. Lucky for her, Taka-akira, her childhood friend doesn't mind marry her and the wedding date is set. However, on their wedding night, something comes up to halt their big day.

Included one-shots:
Volume 9

title: Legend of Exorcism
author: Fei Tian Ye Xiang, Wrap
description:
Having lived his entire life on Mount Taiheng, half-yao Kong Hongjun is at last presented with the chance to explore the human world. He is assigned three tasks: uncover his father's murderer, eliminate the Black Jiao and its yao tribes that have infiltrated Chang'an, and return the Heart Lamp to a descendent of the Chen family. However, on his first night in the city, the Heart Lamp is mistakenly absorbed by military general Li Jinglong.

After receiving a mysterious invitation to join Chang'an

title: Poisoner Home
author: iwo
description:
Tateyuki Chouno is devastated when his apartment and extensive collection of insect specimens burns to the ground one evening. But his luck turns around when a chance leads him to meet famed entomologist Izumo Kusanagi. Chouno is floored by the kind hospitality of Kusanagi and his beautiful daughter Touko. However, the warm atmosphere of the estate belies a sinister secret. What is the true nature of Dr. Kusanagi's research? And is Chouno already trapped in a deadly web of terror?

(Source: CLLE

title: Le Chevalier D'Eon
author: Ubukata, Tow
description: A novel retelling of the Le Chevalier D'Eon story by Ubukata Tow. Not a direct adaptation of either the anime or manga series.

title: Rack: 13-gakari no Zankoku Kikai
author: Ibaraki, Baitou
description: High school student Shou Shintou, son of the Superintendent General of the Metropolitan Police, is known for his extraordinary deductive skills and the ability to solve even the most difficult cases. In reality, though, his brilliant judgements are based on solid proofs and confessions—brought to him by the Special Investigations Division 13, specializing in questioning with the use of tortures.

title: Is it A Sin to Turn a Blind Eye?
author: Hioka, Yen, Kimizuka, Chikara

title: Fushigi Hunter
author: Kuroiwa, Yoshihiro, Iizuka, Yukihiro
description:
Raimon Ryuuta and Kuuko are sibling. Their parent is a treasure hunter, so since they were little they lives in a shrine with their parent's best friend who is an old man.  

Ryuuta and Kuuko are interested in anything strange, curious issues. Together they set up their business as a Fushigi Hunter, to solve cases of strange paranormal activity people asking them for help.

title: Orca on the Other Side
author: Studio koemee, Ugonba
description:
Marlin Trout is an organization established to stop suicides in Japan, where the number of suicides has drastically increased due to the development of social media. Wakame, a slightly airheaded staff member, is constantly pushed around by his uncooperative partner, Umi. They are the strongest team with the best record, but they have a certain "history" together...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Hardboiled Scrambled Egg
author: Kinoshita, Sakura
description: A collection of short stories by Kinoshita Sakura, mainly featuring Loki and his friends from the Enjaku Detective Agency.

title: Jugai
author: Soumoto, Sou
description:
A manga plot that's base on 2 girls development, whic  includes fighting, survival and destruction!

Aihara Kasane, a girl who discover her mysterious power, leave her home and travel to a place where everyone name it as "Jugai", in other word call "Curse Street"
Only fighting and battling among them in order to survive!

Nogihashi Yuana, a girl who's unknown of her mysterious power suddenly awakes one day, when she's close to people, her power will affect them and end up killing them even thoug

title: Myojin Tales
author: Jellybean
description:
This is a chronicle of a man named Myo-Jin who seeks to reenter the Heavens. Myo-Jin was one of god in heavens but fell down to earth. So he wants to find a way back to heaven.

There are four main characters: A man who searches his own self, a woman who crave absolute power, a woman who dreams of life, and a man who seeks to reenter the Heavens.

(Source: Sura's place)

title: The Detective & the Fortune Teller
author: Noramame
description:
One day, private detective Kanako Udagawa receives a request from client Yuiko Shinonome to conduct surveillance on her fiancé. But when Detective Udagawa drops by the fortune-teller that the fiancé's been visiting on the sly, she encounters a boundlessly bubbly woman called Sakura! See the slapstick suspense unfold with this pair of polar opposites!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: J. Boy
author: Noujou, Junichi
description: A man with no memory and who might be the "J.Boy," a robot made to look like the current godfather of a powerful mafia, was put in jail in Taiwan. Here, he will encounter a man who wants him to play billiards.

title: Daishoya Saei
author: Yamashita, Tomomi
description: During the Edo period, although the movement to educate commoners was growing, many unfortunately still could not read or write.  Thus, daishoya, or people who made a business of reading and writing for hire, were a big help to the illiterate.  Saei is one of these daishoya, but his job is not quite as simple as it seems...or as innocent...

title: At the End of Death
author: Sincham
description: Death is just the beginning for Gwon Jun. After committing suicide, he doesn't find himself in the afterlife but rather, in a cold, surgical room. He's strapped to a table and there's a figure staring down at him. Is this the person who saved his life? But why? Jun is not dead but he's not exactly alive either... This strange state of being that Jun is in seems to be a part of some sort of research being done by the mysterious man who saved him. As the two of them live together in isolation, the

title: No.6: Saikai
author: Asano, Atsuko
description: It's been two years since Nezumi promised Shion they'd meet again and left No. 6. In this follow-up to the original story, Shion is now the chief of the Reconstruction Committee, where he worries about both the unstable political situation in the city and the mysterious assassin targeting him. Overwhelmed, he longs for Nezumi's assistance, only for Nezumi to reappear just when he's needed the most. Reunited at last, Shion vows that if Nezumi leaves again, they will be going together. But first,

title: My memory is inside of you
author: Kijitora, Nukoji

title: Babel
author: Shigematsu, Narumi
description: The year is 2050, and all books have been digitized in a virtual Bibliotek. Oreson’s dad has the job of fixing the digital books that “break”. One day a chained book is brought to the house by 3 hooded figures, and Oreson opens it at the urging of a strange man despite his father’s warning. A plume of black light consumes his father as Oreson loses consciousness, and when he comes to everything is gone. Now an adult, Oreson is training to repair the Bibliotek himself, in an effort to understand

title: Amai Wana: Soshite Dare mo Ai wo Shiru
author: Hiiro, Reiichi
description:
What will a group of six good-looking men do when they found themselves trapped on a resort island? Will they find the master-mind behind their imprisonment?

(Source: MU)

title: Survey Report of Goblins and Evil Spirits
author: Kuraichi, Hiya
description:
Sakaki has just been transferred to the 3rd Sector of the "S City Crisis Management Bureau," where he decides to team up with his old buddy Kunugi to conduct a survey of the sector... Uh... What's this about an investigative agency for life-threatening paranormal events!!

The thrilling, spine-chilling, and sometimes heart-stopping adventures of a pair of supernatural detectives!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Sherlock Holmes: Gishi no Oyayubi
author: Higuri, You, Doyle, Arthur Ignatius Conan
description: A one-shot based on the classic Sherlock Holmes short story "The Adventure of the Engineer's Thumb."

title: Into Illusion
author: Yoshihara, Rieko, Tateishi, Ryo
description:
Takumi, Kouki, and Jin are three boys living a normal high school life, until the day when a traumatic car accident turns their lives upside down. Caught up in a phenomenon that twists the boundaries between the realms of the supernatural and the world of man, their fates seem to be sealed…and yet they survive. What does their mysterious survival mean, and how will it change their lives?

Note: Half novel, half manga series.

title: Quiz
author: Iino, Yoko, Asada, Torao, Aiuchi, Mio, Seki, Erika
description: A woman's young son is kidnapped and the only clue to his disappearance is a note starting with the words "This is a quiz." What follows is a fast-paced and stylish whodunnit which leads chief investigator Kaoru Kiriko of the Special Investigation Team down a trail of increasingly perplexing riddles that all the while seem to mock the efforts of the police. Street-smart Kaoru may be the kidnapper's intellectual match, but as she gets closer to her mark, she finds herself becoming the hunted rath

title: Cool Shock Guy B.T.
author: NISIO, ISIN, Demizu, Posuka
description:
The spin-off stars an adult B.T., who is employed at Dinosaur Hotel in Las Vegas as a magician. After watching B.T.'s magic show, Koichi Mugikari learns that B.T. is actually employed for helping the hotel's casino handle gamblers who have unusual winning streaks. 

(Source: JoJo Wiki)

title: Kesshou Monogatari
author: Maeda, Tomo, Maeda, Sakae
description:
Touu, a half-human youkai with a fondness for sweets, manages a pawnshop in a secluded part of town. Wan Lon, the bad-tempered young man who has become Touu's manservant for some unknown reason, gets all the troublesome jobs pushed on to him.

The shop deals in human emotions. Any forbidden or irrepressible emotion that is tormenting the customer will, with their permission, be turned into crystal and pawned. Of course, it doesn't hurt that these beautiful crystals happen to be the sweet-toothed

title: The Man With Seven Faces
author: Ishinomori, Shoutarou, Koike, Kazuo
description: Based on the popular Japanese film series, Kazuo Koike and Shotaro Ishinomori's manga pays homage to Bannai Tarao, a famous detective who can take on seven different faces to catch and outwit his foe. Published after the success of Kazuo Koike's Lone Wolf and Cub, this manga tells the story of an aging Bannai Tarao desperately seeking a young and worthy man to become his successor.

title: Makoto
author: Gouda, Mamora
description: A medical examiner has the ability to see the dead. Due to his job, he sees them a lot and in turn solves the cases of the few who died suspicious deaths.

title: Baiyaku Kakebachou Kuzuryuu (2015)
author: Ishinomori, Shoutarou, Miyagawa, Akira
description:
Remake of the original series from 1973.

The manga follows a man named Kazuryuu. Kazuryuu's mother, who was murdered, left him with a memento of the mystery of the "sculpture of the nine-headed dragon." Kazuryuu becomes a medicine seller and an assassin named "Baiyaku" in order to travel Japan and find out the secret of his birth, his name, and his mother's murder.

(Source: ANN)

title: Who Killed "Okudera Shou"?
author: Kawata, Yushi, Yukito
description:
The story is set in 1995, and centres on the murder of the titular character Okudera Shou, a boy who lived in a remote provincial town divided by small-time territorial gangs. Shou was bullied and taken advantage of by the gangs even as they began to behave strangely, indicating a shift behind the scenes.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Police Station: Rashoumon
author: Nakayama, Masaaki, Yajima, Masao
description:
"Rashoumon" is the last gate for humans to pass in life. Detectives of Toto Police Station have an urge to fight against something beyond crimes.

(Source: MU)

title: Yorozuya Toukaidou Honpo: Tokubetsu-hen
author: Saenagi, Ryou
description: This is an extra from Yorozuya Toukaidou Honpo. Nanaki and Ao from Chou Shinri Genshou Nouryokusha Nanaki appear in the manga, too.

title: Moon & Blood
author: Yazawa, Nao
description:
When high schooler Sayaka awoke one morning, she found an unexpected guest at the family kitchen table - Kai, a cool, handsome, aloof, and so-called family friend of Sayaka's father. His temporary stay in her household and attendance to Sayaka's school is more than she's bargained for. But what secrets does Kai hold? What are his true intentions for his sudden appearance into Sayaka's life? Where does he disappear to every night? And what's up with that black cat?
(Source: DMP).

title: Nazotokihime wa Meitantei♥
author: Anan, Mayuki
description:
The story centers around Hinami, a bookish, eyeglasses-wearing girl, and her two friends. When there is a mystery to solve, she transforms into the clever Nazotoki-hime.

(Source: ANN)

title: Accidents
author: Yamada, Takatoshi
description:
An unexpected truth lurks in a wound caused by a giant accident. This is a human drama about Kujira, an accident investigator, who uses fearless reasoning and indomitable conviction to get to the bottom of the mystery.

(Source: MU)

title: Hiiro no Sasayaki
author: Ayatsuji, Yukito
description:
Saeko,a parentless teenage girl, is to go to the strict boarding school.
And there she encounters a serial-murders case.
Who is the killer? Maybe...she?!

title: Sleeping Beauty
author: Enomoto, Tsubaki
description: The story about Yuki, the girl who lost all of her memories, because of a traffic accident when she was 17-years-old.

title: Hell Is Dark with No Flowers
author: Michio, Yoru
description: Seiji Toono sometimes sees the people around him as monsters. It is a curse that had driven him to a life of despair, living out of internet cafés with nowhere to call home...but all that changes one twilit evening when he stumbles across a huge European mansion. There, Seiji meets a bewitchingly beautiful boy dressed in a kimono with a white peony motif on the shoulder, who introduces himself as Shiroshi Saijou. This mysterious young man seems to know more about Seiji than he does himself, and

title: Shousetsu Gekijouban Psycho-Pass: Providence
author: Fukami, Makoto
description:
While attending a meeting as a Chief Inspector of the Public Security Bureau, Akane Tsunemori received a report that an incident had occurred on a foreign vessel, and this was the beginning of a big and unexpected case.

(Source: IMDb)

title: Kobayashi Shounen to Futei no Kaijin
author: Kamijyo, Akimine
description:
The manga is based on renowned Japanese mystery novelist Ranpo Edogawa's 1925 short story The Case of the Murder on D. Hill. The story is the first in Edogawa's series about the fictional private detective Kogorou Akechi. In the original short story and series, the character Yoshio Kobayashi leads the Boy Detectives Club and is Akechi's apprentice. The boy often dresses in disguise as a young woman to help solve mysteries.

(Source: ANN)

title: Lovely Death
author: Lee, Eon
description:
"Today, we die." Four young women have gathered at a guesthouse to commit group suicide. Equipped with strong rope, a playlist, and apathy for life, Yeon and her friends seem to have a foolproof plan. Yet when they finally meet Death, Death rejects them and takes away their right to self-extermination. They may regain that right under one condition: they must retrieve someone who escaped Death at the same guesthouse years ago. The thing is, that person now lives in a prison.

(Source: Lezhin Ent

title: In Hand
author: Akato, Ao
description:
Tetsu Himokura is a scientist who specializes in the study of parasites. He loathes people and is very sadistic. Tetsu bought a huge botanical garden in Hakone which he converted into his home and lab. He holes up in the conservatory where he researches his favorite parasites. His right arm is fitted with a black robotic hand. However, it is not known how this artificial hand came about. He is an eccentric genius who solves a series of difficult cases with astounding scientific methods.

(Source

title: Gosick: Gray Wolf Tanteisha-hen
author: Sakuraba, Kazuki
description: 1931, New York. Victorique and Kazuya now live new lives as private detective and newspaper reporter. Victorique is asked to handle a case regarding a string of murders related to gangs, while Kazuya heads to a news coverage of a well-known psychiatrist famous for "curing the psychological traumas of patients by using the science of the heart." The mystery of the serial murder case lies in the fact that the scenes of the crime, the methods of killing used and the profiles of the criminals vastly

title: The Mystery of the Missing Slow Glass
author: Manose
description:
When a "window" crafted from special glass is mysteriously stolen... A mystery that untangles the threads of "time" and "heart."

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Yougisha A no Hanayome
author: Tooyama, Ema
description:
Hana moves back to her family home after her husband passes away. She had a hard time everyday but that's until she met a famous painter, Aoi. In order to escape her current life, she accepts a remarriage with him. But he has a secret!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Guardian Garden - Mamori Hito no Niwa
author: Ichikawa, Ryunosuke
description: Incoming high-school girl Kisaragi Hinata works at the flower shop her father owns with her best friends. Her mom died while she was still a baby and her dad disappeared 10 years ago, leaving her without a family. She is usually very happy, but still can’t shake off the trauma of losing a family. One day, she gets kidnapped by an organization that seems to know some secret about Hinata. Lucky for her, two beautiful people that have extraordinary abilities and some kind of connection with her dad

title: Grace Rosa
author: Higurashi, Kinoko
description:
Grace Rosa is an assassin, driven by a single thing: discovering the secret of her adoptive father's disappearance. He trained her to become a lethal killing machine, able to wield any weapon she can get her hands on, before inducting her into the ranks of the shadowy organisation known as Alterna. But could the very people she serves as a hired gun have something to do with him vanishing? And to what lengths will she go to enact her vengeance on the people who have wronged her?

(Source: Titan

title: The Challenger to Great Old Ones
author: Yano, Kentarou
description: A series of short stories based on the Cthulhu mythos.

title: Saint
author: Akaishi, Michiyo
description:
16 year-old Mishima Haruhi rescued a guy drowning in Yokohama Harbor, who has no memory of who he is or how he got there. Even more mysteriously, he seems to have extremely special powers including the ability to heal others. The only clue they have to his past is a bracelet he is wearing with the number "33" inscribed, but it is not long before people threatening to take his life force them to dig deeper...

Included one-shot:
Volume 1: Doyoubi ni wa Kitto Iku kara

title: Ihotose Box
author: Miyao, Ikumi
description:
A man stumbles upon a mysterious box in which a town of minuscule people from long ago live.

(Source: MU)

title: Gadget
author: Etou, Hiroyuki
description:
Shuichi Toriga, a junior high school student with a knack for electronics repair and an interest in UFOs, has met the girl of his dreams. Manami has the voice of an angel--or, at least, the voice of a distant race! After attracting the attention of some friendly aliens, Manami will rely on Shuichi's help to uncover whatever mysteries lie hidden behind the stars and inside her CD player. This must be a match made in heaven, or at least in a different galaxy!

(Source: ADV)

title: China Girl
author: Kobayashi, Kaoru
description:
At Inokashira High School, Kouichirou is assigned by his teacher to take care for the welcoming party for the female foreign student from Hong Kong who is going to study in his class. While he's having headache with the class's condition, he heard something loud. The source of that noise are one huge Helicopter and 3 more planes, and the girl who step out from that helicopter? She's Fang Ran, the heiress of the Chang Family, the richest family in Hong Kong.  

Fang Ran noticed Kouichirou and ask

title: The Fugitive Lawyer, Makoto Narita
author: Natsuhara, Takeshi, Takada, Yuu
description:
The human suspense story follows a lawyer named Makoto Narita who is wanted for crimes he did not commit. Narita now helps people in trouble, even as he searches for the person who committed the crimes for which he was framed.

(Source: MU)

title: I Don't Remember That.
author: Aiba, Mouko
description:
Takuto has lost all his memories after he met with an accident. While he found himself without anything to depend on, that's when a man named Yuuki appeared claiming, "I am your lover." This is the start of an overly dangerous romance as Takuto begins his confinement-like cohabitation with Yuuki! Just what is Yuuki's true identity? And what is the truth behind Takuto's accident?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Wagashi no Anne
author: Igari, Soyoko, Sakaki, Tsukasa
description:
The story revolves around Kyouko Umemoto (An for short), who starts working at a Japanese sweets shop located in the basement of a department store. There, she interacts with many different mysterious customers while being surrounded by sweets filled with essences of history and fun.

(Source: ANN)

title: Onmyoji and Tengu Eyes
author: Utamine, Yoshiko
description:
Paranormal incidents heat up when two mysterious men cross paths in Tomoe, a small town in Hiroshima with a long history of supernatural encounters. Misato Miyazawa is a strikingly beautiful young man with a troubled past. Born to a distinguished family of onmyouji—specialists in divination—Misato is no stranger to the occult. That's why he jumps at the chance to join the Abnormal Disaster Unit in Tomoe's Town Hall Crisis Management Division, a unit more commonly known as The Spirit Hunters. 

E

title: Hard & Loose: Shiritsu Tantei Toki Shouzou Trouble Note
author: Kawaguchi, Kaiji, Caribu, Marley
description:
A detective thriller in which former boxer Shozo is thrown into a web of intrigue when he picks up a ringing phone in a room whose occupant he is supposed to be following.

(Source: Anime Vice)

title: Mary Godwin
author: Park, Suhlah
description:
1816 in Genf: After a nightmare Mary Godwin beginn to write the novel Frankenstein. Mary is inspired by Jean, her masked servant with mysterious origins. Since he is in the house many strange things happened. He helps her with his ideas, so she can continue to write. Can Mary write the novel to the end without the help of Jean? 

from mangaupdates

title: Dorokei
author: Fukuda, Shuu
description:
Tsutomu Madara is a rookie detective at the Third Investigation Team of the Tokyo Police Department. His section deals mainly with petty crimes which leads Tsutomu to lose all his enthusiasm for the job. One day, he meets a master thief, Garasu Kemuri, who helps him solve cases.

(Source: MyDramaList)

title: Kitsutsuki Tanteidokoro
author: Ii, Kei, Minami, Shinya
description:
A ghost was seen on the 12th floor of the Asakusa Juunikai building. A newspaper article featuring the sighting brought together Takuboku Ishikawa, who runs a private detective agency to support his family, and his assistant Kyosuke Kindaichi to solve the case.

(Source: MAL News)

title: That Summer is Ending
author: Tamura, Yumi
description:
This is the second of Tamura Yumi's series "Tamu no Nandemo Capsule".  It contains a series of one-shots.

1) Ano Natsu ga Owaru:

During an elevator accident, Hidemi's friend Natsuko dies, but Hidemi seems to think there was perhaps something more to her death than met the eye...

2) Champagne Target:

Niwako is a rising star of Shibata Production, a small talent agency.  Even though her agency is not the biggest, she is the agency head's favorite and with his skilled help, her career is defini

title: Yumegari
author: Mokona
description:
Tatsumi Hōjyō is a 17 year old dreamcatcher (yumegari) from the Houjyo clan who has to investigate the dreams of others and sometimes participate in them. A yumegari is bound by fate to a yumemori, one who watches the dreams of a Yumegari and prevents them from falling into an eternal sleep.

When Tatsumi's mother and father, the preceding yumegari and yumemori, die in the execution of their duties, Tatsumi inherits the job. At the risk of being caught in the dreams, as happened with her parents

title: Silent Eye
author: Akaishi, Michiyo
description: Makimura Airi is a very independent and strong top model.  She falls in love with photographer Daiki, and through his influence, retires from the model world to pursue her new dream of becoming a great photographer herself.  But immediately after she decides this, Daiki is asked to accompany a journalist to war-torn Chechnya, and suddenly goes missing...All Airi has now is his Nikon F5 camera that was recovered from the scene, but something is very strange about the camera.  Could it be that Dai

title: Double Casting
author: Shin, Yeong Woo
description:
A rising boss in the underworld is forced to lead a double life as a police officer and a gang boss in order to find the killer of his brother.

(Source: MU)

title: The Shadow Warrior
author: Matsumoto, Leiji
description: Theatre of the events is the Chinese mainland in the late Ming period. Shisanmei, a beautiful woman with no memory reaches a lawless zone, dominated by bandits of all kinds. With the "Swords of the Seven Stars", a gift from an old hermit, she embarks on a new journey escorting Anji, a boy who aims to rescue his father that is wrongfully imprisoned. Soon a third mysterious element joins the singular group of travelers...

title: Vampire Detecive
author: Mitsunaga, Yasunori
description:
Aoki Juurou finds murder victims a little too often, causing some cops to suspect him of being involved.

At the opening of this story, he discovers the body of the idol Komori Erie by following the strong scent of her blood. After dealing with the police, Aoki takes the details of the case to the mysterious shut-in Hisato. If Hisato can solve the case, he can take justice into his own hands...

(Source: MU)

title: Loups=Garous: Kihi Subeki Ookami
author: Kyougoku, Natsuhiko, Higuchi, Akihiko
description: Virtual reality. Murder. Werewolves. And teen girls! In a future where nothing is as it seems, can old legends come true? In the near future, humans will communicate almost exclusively through monitors, making real interaction a rarified and weak occurance for those living in a near totalitarian society. In this new world of communication, children are only allowed to interact personally on school grounds. So when a serial killer starts slaughtering junior high children the communication routes

title: Boku ga Kimi wo Korosu made
author: Yanagisawa, Yukio
description: The story takes place in Japan, in a world where murderers are imprisoned in a closed space and executed in the same manner as the victims, and the execution is broadcast live. The newly sentenced death row inmate, Kaoru Oda, is a murderer who strangled his lover to death in a love affair. Kouhei Mizutani, a prison guard, is selected and ordered to carry out Oda's execution simply because of their similar physique. Mizutani gets close to Oda by modifying his face into that of Watase, the victim

title: Futari ni Omakase
author: Yagami, Hiroki
description: Jun Kusakabe and Sayuri Kawamura are female police officers in tight mini skirt uniforms. They fight like men.... No, no, they are even better. Jun will sometimes go a bit too far and gets really wild after a couple of drinks. Soft-spoken and well bred, Sayuri is from a very wealthy family. She cannot stand what is wrong and will do anything to fix it. The pair are like chalk and cheese, but they make ideal partners to solve difficult cases. Sometimes strong and sometimes cute, they can make a d

title: Eve, New Generation
author: Fujima, Takuya
description:
From Divine Sanctuary:

The story begins with the death of a young girl. To find the reason why she needed to die, 3 good looking girls and a detective try to find a killer who seems to know something about it. But did she really die? And since one of the girls looks exactly like the dead girl...will they succeed to find that man...? And can the detective protect the double?

title: Tsukuyomi
author: Seno, Haruki, Ota, Tadashi
description: When people pass away, they leave behind something called a "tsukishirube", or a footprint of their death, but not everyone is able to see these footprints or believe that they exist.  Only a small number of people, called "tsukuyomi", possess the special ability to read these "tsukishirube".  Sakuya Isshin is one of them...

title: Good Night, See You in My Dreams
author: EErun
description: A long corridor bathed in red... A ghostly figure lurking in the shadows... Dozens of hands, their long, spindly fingers grasping at your throat... Sounds like the stuff of nightmares, right? But it's not the kind of thing that troubles Seongha. She's just your average high-school kid with a head full of exam stress. Her classmate Isu, on the other hand, has been plagued by that very dream for years. And it's taken its toll, leaving her exhausted and alone. So one day, when Seongha finds herself

title: Zettai Shounen
author: Hamazaki, Tatsuya, Tobe, Sunaho
description: Aizawa Ayumu is a young boy, who is sent to a small town called Tana to live with his father for a while. Even though he doesn't want to go, he agrees to do so when his mother offers him a mountain bike. Ayumu used to live in Tana before, and now his memories of the time are shrouded in mystery - apparently something happened when he was a child. Enter Miku, a young girl who knows more than she tells, weird glowing lights floating around, reflections of UFOish objects in the eyes of cats and dog

title: Kimi no Tame no Eden
author: Shasendou, Yuuki, iro
description:
"Please... Kiss me."

Yuusei Hakozaki carries the memory of being kidnapped and confined along with six girls during his childhood. One day, as an adult leading a peaceful life, a girl suddenly appears before him and demands a kiss...!? Yuusei is told of a single "rule": He must kiss the girls once every 24 hours. If he fails to do so, their heads will explode and they will die. To save the girls from their deadly fate, Yuusei starts a communal life with them where he must "kiss them every day."

title: Jekyll to Hyde to Saibanin
author: Morita, Takashi, Kitahara, Masaki
description: In 2009, a new justice system began that is based on judging each other. A young judge searches for the truth hidden behind this system.

title: Saredo Tsumibito wa Ryuu to Odoru: Rinbu
author: Mitogawa, Wataru, Asai, Labo
description: The series takes place in an alternate world, staged mostly in the city of Eridana, whose territory is half in the Tseberun Dragon Empire, and half in the Lapetodes Seven Cities Alliance. Each half is separated by the Orielal River. In this world, special abilities called spell formulas (咒式, jushiki) exist, which are essentially chemical reactions augmented through special weapons that cause a magic spell-like effect. These special weapons are called Magic Staff weapons, and are as varied as reg

title: Einstein 1904
author: Ooi, Masakazu, Demise, Takao
description: The year is 1904, in the heart of Switzerland's capital, Bern. Self-proclaimed genius, detective, and professor, Albert can detect the most minute details in any scenario and come to a rational conclusion. The recent murder of Russian soldiers by a mysterious oriental is no exception. The mysterious oriental, who turns out to be Japanese, proclaims that he is innocent of murder. Why? Because the Russians were already dead to begin with. Follow Albert as he seeks the truth in this mystery that cr

title: Tenshi no Saezuri
author: Kishi, Yusuke, Baku, Sakuzou
description:
Sanae Kitajima is a psychiatrist specializing in end-of-life care. Her boyfriend, Takanashi, who once struggled with a deep fear of death, returns from an Amazon expedition profoundly changed. What happened during the expedition? What is the true meaning behind his cryptic words, "I can hear the whispers of angels"?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Dreaming Flower Garden
author: Ooya, Kazumi
description:
[From FCTranslations]:

When Momoe visited her old school, she remembered an event occurred there when she was still a student. Twenty years ago, rumors said there's one man who came to the girls' dorm by night, search for his very own targets, and steal their soul. To find out the truth, Momoe, who teamed up with three other friends, is determined to find this intruder. One rainy night, she found a naked young man near the church, and it turned out he has a lot of connections with the one Momoe

title: Hoshi no ko Chobin
author: Ishinomori, Shoutarou
description:
Chobin is a funny creature that falls on the ground after the capture of his home planet by the tyrannical forces of Brunga, a demonic figure in a dark coat with bat-like wings.

(Source: MU)

title: Kishibe no Uta
author: Ima, Ichiko
description: A town in ancient China has fallen under a curse and all the water resources are drying up. In order to save everyone, a young girl has been picked as a sacrificial lamb for the water God Kahaku, who resides in a far away places called Suiko. The girl and his bodyguard En travels to Kahaku to prepare for her sacrifice, however, everything is not what it seems.

title: Partners in Crime, Partners in Love
author: Jiunuanchunshen, Shunu Sente
description: When medical examiner Yarra Lin meets detective Kelsey Song, what starts as a fiery clash between them gradually turns into a deep connection and partnership. Together, they bear witness to the lives of a host of ordinary people: an innocent girl who died unjustly, an elderly mother waiting in the mountains for her criminal son to return, a timid rookie cop who risked his life to confront an armed robber... They fight for justice for the living and give a voice to the dead, uncovering countless

title: Zoufu no Hanataba
author: Ishida, Umi
description: A horror mystery involving different species. The story begins when middle schooler Ryuunosuke visits his grandmother's house on an island. As Ryuunosuke walks past the stairs leading to the second floor at his grandmother's house, a strange, plant-like thing extends down from above. Intrigued, Ryuunosuke tries to climb the stairs, but his uncle stops him with an unfamiliar expression, saying, "What are you doing?" and "You'd better not go up." That night, however, Ryuunosuke's curiosity drives

title: Doctor Strange
author: Haruichi
description: In Doctor Strange, arrogant genius surgeon Stephen Strange learns the mystic arts from the Ancient One after a career-ending car accident.

title: Stalker Koui ga Barete Jinsei Shuuryou Otoko
author: Kesera, Sera, Monma, Tsukasa

title: Gainen Dorobou
author: Tanaka, Ikkou
description:
What happens to a person when they have stolen their "thing without form" found inside them? What will happen to the world? This is a city where many robbers are rampant, and private detective Uro Kisaragi steals better than anyone!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Nanka Youkai!?
author: Katsushika, Hokusei, Satomi, Kei
description: Hide (Hi-De) meets a mysterious girl named Miru and soon find out that she has special power. Miru will sneeze whenever she sense spirit or detect that some strange occurrence are caused by the something paranormal. The two travel together and encounter all kinds of paranormal activity causing by ghost, demon, human spirit and divine being .

title: Kanbayashi & Kirika series
author: Morino, Aki
description:
In the middle of searching for his ideal Lady X, Kanbayashi Toshihiko, a young popular writer meets a popular teenage artist, Kawamoto Kirika. Together they solve a lot of cases and go through many things.
With Kirika's help, will Kanbayashi find his Lady X?

One-shot included in the books: 
Tenshi to Yuurei (volume 1), Remix (volume 3), Otome Shinkaron (volume 5), Digital Kankei (volume 6), Nobara (volume 7), Anemone Meikyuu (volume 9), Akinomiyajima Satsujin Jiken (volume 10), Last Child (volu

title: How to Protect the Young Master of Monster Manor
author: Kin, Puddy
description:
No! The beloved young master has died again!

When the young master of a game dies for the 43rd time, the 44th round begins, followed by a strange voice and a new job, character, and storyline. From there, Lynne's beloved child-rearing sim begins to take a weird turn, becoming more like a dating sim! Can she save the young master again amidst these oddities?

(Source: Manta)

title: Mysterion
author: Azumi, Ryou
description:
Enter a world of mystery and alchemy in Mysterion.

Leon Schwarts is a simple sailor, enjoying his time at sea and his breaks on land, while doing his best to avoid sleeping and the nightmares that haunt him. During a trip to London, Leon's boat runs across what seems to be a deserted ship, only to find a single survivor, the beautiful girl Lapis. However, Lapis has secrets of her own that she is willing to go to extreme lengths to keep. This meeting starts a string of events that changes Leon's

title: Gesokon Tantei
author: Karin, Sora, Momoi, Ito
description: A new detective enlists the help of a young shoe fitter with a foot fetish to help solve crimes.

title: From the Beyond
author: Mikomo, Kouji
description: During the first stage of the colonization of Mars, with only workers and workers inhabiting the planet, Dr. Matoi and her staff moved to that remote place to research the influence of the planet on the human psyche. Among the inhabitants, some claim to suffer from particular ailments, leading them to have strange recurring dreams. Once on the planet, the doctor is also affected by the symptoms, dreaming very often of herself in a particular library. Only a chance case will lead her to discover

title: Yakusoku no Neverland: Omoide no Film-tachi
author: Demizu, Posuka, Nanao
description:
Norman and his friends were reunited with Emma, and they all talked about their memories of the past.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: SHI-NO
author: Toujou, Sakana, Kouzuki, Amane
description:
"Excuse me......" Without even knocking the door, Hasekura Shino enters my apartment as if she takes it for granted.

Shino is only a fifth grade elementary school student. As a first year university student, I am also Shino's childhood friend. Despite hating green peas, she is a well-behaved, trouble-free child. That being said, there is a part of her that worries me. She is interested in novelty and abnormal events. I'd rather see Shino behaving self-willingly, my only wish is to see her becom

title: Rebirth, Redead
author: Aomizu, Ria
description:
I, who had lost everything and tried to commit suicide, had my heart stolen and became "immortal." Encountering the supernatural and having my heart stolen, I, the protagonist Meguru Tachibana, begin working at the supernatural countermeasures organization known as the Public Safety Section Zero. This is a tale of the supernatural until I reclaim 'death.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Horror Museum
author: Matsumoto, Yoko, Akagawa, Jirou
description:
This volume contains three one-shots by Akagawa Jiro-sensei and Matsumoto Yoko-sensei.

Doll House:
Strange things have begun to occur around Akimi.  Someone has just moved into the empty apartment right underneath hers, but no one has actually seen this mysterious new neighbor.  In addition, random things keep disappearing from the building such as a desk, a bike, and even her own mother...??

Norou Ningyou:
Mariko is a daughter of a wealthy family celebrating her 16th birthday.  However, Marik

title: Mononoke Mystery
author: Futaba, Haduki, Teniwoha
description:
The series is about the Tsukioka Detective Agency, a group of young "youkai" detectives that specialize in mysterious, supernatural cases.

(Source: sailorenna)

author: Motoe, Keisuke, Aoyagi, Aito
description:
Mathematics are erased from Japan school curriculum. Then an organization appear to be the one to oppose that idea, called Black Triangle, threats the government that the organization will take over the country. To fight them, police forms a team, and among them there is a junior high school girl.

(Source: MU)

description: An adaptation of Arthur Conan Doyle's Sherlock Holmes stories.

author: Momoyama, Hinase, Nakazawa, Takumi, Tsukishima, Souki
description:
The story is set in year 2030 where an incident occur in a giant research facility called LABO which has a nuclear reactor. The incident, which is the meltdown of the reactor locks everything in the facility causing 9 people, 3 rescuers and 6 ordinary people, to be locked inside it. They just have to wait to be rescued since help will come in 9 hours when the system will be recovered. The problem is... they only got "magic potions" against radiation for 6 people.

(Soruce: MU)

title: Doctor G's Island; Fallen Angel: White Melody
author: Takashina, Ryouko, Edogawa, Ranpo
description:
This is a collection of three short stories associated with mangaka Takashina Ryouko.  The first story, written by author Edogawa Ranpo, is illustrated by Takashina-sensei, while the latter two are both written and illustrated by Takashina-sensei.  

Doctor G no Shima:
Sayoko is in love with her older sister's boyfriend, Shunichi, but it seems her tutor Moroto-san has also taken an interest in her.  Caught in between these two, Sayoko is thrown into a world of murder, mystery, and horror.  What

title: Sakura Taboo
author: Nekota, Yukari
description:
One day, police sergeant Satsuki Rena is sent to pick up her new superior, the "Destroyer" Sakurama Shinobu, from the airport. He earned his nickname due to his apparent habit of causing the ruin of his superiors. Rena is surprised to find that he is a friendly and ordinary-seeming man. However, the morning he arrives, his superior in his new office is shot to death in a crime that mimics a murder attempt from 19 years ago.

It doesn't seem like it could have possibly been Sakurama's fault, but

title: Heaven Above Heaven
author: Hyun, Kang-Suk, Jeon, Joong-Won
description:
Seventeen years ago, nine Grand Masters of the Martial Arts raced to a remote mountaintop, determined to prevent a terrible prophecy. It had been foretold that on this very night, in this inhospitable place, a child would be born.

author: Mizuki, Shigeru
description:
When a 2nd moon suddenly looms overs Japan, the brave Professor Uetsuto volunteers to take a rocket up to the mysterious moon to investigate. Unfortunately the Professor meets a horrifying fate and is sent plummeting back to Earth.

The circumstances surrounding the Professor's fate are far too suspicious to ignore and his son, a student in biological science, decides to get to the bottom of the controversy himself.

Professor Uetsuto's devious rival, Professor Dorai, has other plans though and

description: Amalgams: fearsome tactical weapons deployed to the front lines of battle. As the leader of a special investigation unit tasked with hunting down rogue Amalgams, Theo Starling has no love for these tools of war. In a strange twist of fate, he's assigned a partner named Eleven, who looks like a young girl—but she's actually an astonishingly lifelike Amalgam. And though Eleven is incapable of understanding human emotions, Theo must cast aside his reservations as they work together to uncover a ter

title: Invisible
author: hatsuko, Iwaseki, Takamichi
description: Due to a former friend, Souhei—a second year in high school—is isolated in class. He does not get along with his sole remaining family, his aunt. Even the one person who understands him and whom he has secretly fallen in love with, his childhood friend Haruka, has become someone Souhei's hand can't reach. Furthermore, ever since he met a mysterious girl called Maki, his isolation in class has sped up. Souhei, who lost his place to belong, realizes that his own body is not reflected in others' ey

title: When the Villainess Turns Detective
author: Abyu, Ryujin
description:
Seohyun is a Korean detective who was closing in on a serial killer when they both plunged off a building together. But then, she wakes up inside a novel as Himena Sylvester, a villainess doomed to a tragic end. Determined to change her fate, she sets out to repair Himena's reputation, earning unexpected admiration along the way. But just as her new life begins to turn around, she uncovers something she missed—the serial killer fell into the novel with her, so a crime spree is about to begin!

title: Witch's Island
author: Potato
description:
When Hannah gets a high-paying job as a tutor for Eilie, a noble young lady, she expects to start a new, peaceful chapter of her life. However, strange things begin to occur at the mansion, and she quickly realizes there's more to it than meets the eye. What secrets are the inhabitants of this remote island hiding? In the darkness of mystery, there may be witches playing tricks.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Horror Collector
author: Yuuki, Niko, Satou, Midori
description: The internet is full of creepypastas, cryptid sightings, tales of paranormal activity, and unsolved disappearances. These are mostly rumors and pranks fueled by trolls—entertainment. But the unlucky few learn the hard way that some legends are true. Many of these unfortunate souls are doomed, but their luck may change if they cross paths with the boy in the red hood. He roams from town to town and appears wherever strange things occur. Is he a light in the dark? Or living proof that monsters are

description:
A suspicious man named Odagiri, who's known as a "Fairy Doctor," is looking for a specific fairy. One day, he happens upon the home of a grandma who owns a very lovely garden. The fairies he met there were...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

author: Eihi, Nonaka, Misato
description:
Late one night in the school building, Kamishiro Yukisuke, who holds a healing power, had an encounter with Kuroto Satsuki, who was fighting a strange zebra-man. Unknown to them, the two ability holders were bound by fate.

A bad sensed murder occurring at the same time, a hamster that can speak, a half invisible younger sister and a spaceship crash. After finding out about the two power holders, a classmate Okuda Emi invited the two of them to the 'Occult Research Club' where many individuals g

title: Heart Break Detective Momose
author: Nardack, Misaki, Saginomiya
description:
"There is no such thing as everlasting love."

Being involved in a certain incident, Nonomura Tsukumo became Chiyoda Momose, aka the break up detective's assistant. "Break up detective" chooses the detective reasoning club's activity room as home base. The two's objective is to find out the truth behind their client's break up. Because of the break up detective's rumor spreading around school, more and more clients come to seek their aid.

Solving the lovelorn mysteries, a youthfulness campus re

title: Kabukicho Hysteric Dreamer
author: Sekino, Aoi
description:
Hitomi couldn't stand living with her mother and her boyfriend anymore. She decided to go to Kabukichou to see her older sister Onee-chan, who works at a hostess bar. Onee-chan had texted her "COME TO KABUKICHOU!" but Hitomi had no idea where she lived. When she reached Kabukichou, Hitomi was led by a mysterious cat who can speak to a large statue called K-chan. There she sees an image... that K-chan is destroying the city.

The cat, Chibi, tells Hitomi that the image will come true in a year, u

author: Harayasu
description: Urban legends have come to life, manifesting as phenomena called "Folklore." The mysterious Thompson Agency is dedicated to identifying and capturing these beings to minimize their harm to humanity. Thompson agents Emma and Yuliya are assigned to a sleepy branch in the countryside. While horrific atrocities are committed by Folklore in Tokyo, our heroes clean basements and fix the locals' toilets. However, it is in Folklore's nature to appear wherever humans gather. Myths, rumors, and fairy tale

title: Stanley Hawk no Jikenbo: Persona

description:
The serial murders of young homosexual men make an uproar in the city. While struggling to solve the case, "thug detective" Stanley Hawk finds himself trapped in a strange cat-and-mouse game with his Chief of Public Affairs, the cold beauty Alistair Rosefield, and the PD's counselor, a Japanese psychologist named Jin Misao.

(Source: MU)

title: Root Double: Before Crime*After Days - √Before
author: Momoyama, Hinase, Nakazawa, Takumi, Tsukishima, Souki

The story is set in year 2030 where an incident occur in a giant research facility called LABO which has a nuclear reactor. The incident, which is the meltdown of the reactor locks everything in the facility causing 9 people, 3 rescuers and 6 ordinary people, to be locked inside it. They just have to wait to be rescued since help will come in 9 hours when the system will be recovered. The problem is... they only got "magic potions" against radiation for 6 people.

1. Kimi no Kaeru Basho (The Place Where You Come Home)
2. Hoshizora Rider (Starry Sky Rider)
3. Akaneiro no Sora no Shita (Under The Red Sky)
4. Sumireiro no Yoake Mae (Before The Violet Dawn)
5-6. Wakuraba Engage

title: Aisare World: I really, truly surrender to you. - Fuyumihara Hisamabu no Kaiketsu Nisshi
author: Nozomi, Kota, Pikazo, Mika

description:
In the story, a mysterious murder case occurs at a deserted tourist hotel. When the detective who visited this place at the request of the hotel manager arrives to find the truth, something dark is revealed.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Floral Mirror of the Moon
author: Ham, Hyeong Suk
description:
In the 24th generation of Kings of the Joseon Dynasty, a boatman known as Seo-mok unknowingly helped a mysterious woman and Japanese spies who were disguised as rich Korean men to cross a river. But after crossing the river, they tried to kill Seo-mok... Left with no choice, Seo-mok then took the woman hostage--and soon, secrets began to unfold.

(Source: Pinoymanga Scans)

title: Kotei no Himawari
author: Ishikawa, Yuugo
description:
The manga centers on a magazine journalist named Takurou. A place that Takurou used to live in was flooded and became a lake due to a dam being constructed nearby. However, an extended drought period dried up the lake, and Takurou heads to his old, recently-emerged home.

(Source: ANN)

title: Material Polka
author: Kobayashi, Naru
description: Alice and Ruka are heading to an exclusive girl's boarding school together! They realize they may be in over their heads when they arrive at the opening ceremony, where they see that there are markedly less students in each increasing year. Their school dreams turn to nightmares when the ceremony concludes with the student council president executing a student for wearing a slightly too short skirt. Her shattered head explodes into sweets. One thing follows another on that terrifying first day a

title: Fall in the Night with You
author: Hutao
description:
Hated by those around him for seemingly bringing bad luck wherever he goes, Ren Xi unwittingly makes a pact with a witch named Nyx to save his sick mother. But there are consequences... If only Nyx could remember them! It doesn't help that she has amnesia, either. It seems there's something more to Ren Xi's "jinxed" past, too... something scarier than even a witch, and they'll need each other to get through it.

(Source: Comikey Media)

title: Noushou Sakuretsu Girl

description:
'Welcome, to the Human Zoo' When an ordinary high school student Ichii Hana woke up, she was in a cage with her classmates. And there she was entered into a death game involving use of her mobile phone!!

Along with a classmate with the same name, yet complete opposite in personality, Inusawa Hana, she challenges the game!?

'I'll definitely stay alive. By throwing away this stale body'

(Source: Amazon)

title: Tsukimonogakari
author: Nanatsuki, Kyoichi, Asahi, Manyou
description:
The manga's story is about a new police division known as the "7th Division," which handles supernatural cases where criminals get possessed by evil spirits. A group of young police officers with special powers work together to solve these supernatural cases.

(Source: ANN)

title: Strange Houses
author: Uketsu
description:
I've always had a fascination with the occult; you might even call it my specialty. I've been brought in as a consultant on many supernatural and strange mysteries. But nothing could have prepared me for this house. It seemed so ordinary at first, except for that one room. It had no doors, no windows, and was tucked away, leaving anyone to think it was just a wall. I knew that there was something more to it. It shouldn't be there, it shouldn't exist, and yet...

Just what is this house, and what

author: Kim, Junhyung
description:
Kim Seojoon, a freshman college student leading a normal daily life, awoke one day to find himself transported into a fantasy world straight out of a webtoon or web novel or something like that.

As he began to get excited about potentially having the role of a male lead character, a shocking event unfolded before his eyes—a murder of an imperial family. Consequently, Kim Seojoon found himself imprisoned in the world's prison, Gehenna.

Will he be able to navigate the treacherous paths of this u

description:
My life has been sold to two different people. Now I have to live as a different person in the day and night.

(Source: MU)

title: B.A.D.: Chocolate Days

description: A collection of side stories of B.A.D. Beyond Another Darkness.

Sawa, a salaryman working for a black company, wanders into an inn whose motto is "healing." The uncared-for but superb bathhouse girls gently and sometimes violently wrap up his tired body... In a mysterious space that appears only at the time of death, the best service is offered... Mystery Eros!

(Source: Shounen Gahousha, translated)

title: Kizuato

description: Kashiwagi Kouichi recently moved into his cousin's house after the father that he barely talked to in recent years passes away. His cousins are four female siblings ranging in age from adult to a young child: Chizuru, Azusa, Kaede and Hatsune. After their parents died years ago, Kouichi's father and the girls' uncle became their guardian. Kouichi fits perfectly in the household although Kaede seems to act reserved around him. He soon starts having vivid dreams of himself as a homicidal monster.

author: Ryukishi07, Hamashima, Shigeo
description: Year 25 of the Showa era (1950). In the late summer, a young man, Raichi Shiozawa, visits the village of Mishirushi, where old superstitions and folklore still remain. The purpose of his visit is to tutor Matsurika Mishirushi, the daughter of a prominent village family. However, Matsurika is not an ordinary human; she is a monster that eats human flesh. Why this beautiful and graceful girl has turned into a monster? Because of an illness? A curse? Afterward, eight girls disappears all of a sudde

author: Michii, Nokcha
description: Police officer Nohee is an Unliar: she is completely unable to lie. But telling the truth gets tricky when she meets the wanted criminal Yeonho. As a Word Wraith, Yeonho can make others do whatever he wants just by speaking—he can even kill them. Because of this astonishing ability, he's now a suspect in the murder of his adoptive parents. description:
As an intern at a marine research institute, Hyoseo finds himself overworked and overlooked. He's given the job no one else wants: caring for the aggressive orca everyone else fears. Hyoseo finds quiet comfort in the beast's presence, but after he starts speaking to it, strange things begin happening at the facility...

(Source: Manta)

title: Lucky Jou-chan no Atarashii Shigoto
author: Takano, Fumiko
description:
Set in the 1950s, this is the whimsical tale of the girl Lucky and a rather odd department store.

(Source: MU)

title: The Bad Life
author: Baek, Nara, Oscar
description:
A thirst for revenge drags Raymond into a sinister game at his new boarding school, as he finds himself the mouse within a dorm of twisted cats who wish to devour and defile him in the worst ways imaginable.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Tokyo Alternative
author: Otsuka, Eiji, Nishikawa, Seira
description:
In 1945, an atomic bomb was dropped on Tokyo. In 1989, the Shouwa era didn't end.

When a doppelgänger appears and meets with his double, an explosion occurs which changes the worlds history.

Tokio is a mysterious person who travels in time in order to find and stop these doppelgängers. He then meets a female morgue worker and a detective. The three are called by Masaki Urashima, only to be told an aeroplane will explode in two days.

title: Glossy Darkness and Drowning Light
author: Satsuki
description:
The story of a detective attempting to solve a mystery and a man who doesn't know himself.

(Source: MU)

title: Kurokami no Medusa
author: Seki, Yoshimi
description: A girl was haunted by her best friend who died horribly in a train crash. Her best friend had long black hair and it kept haunting her.

title: Mishiranu Machi
author: Matsumoto, Yoko
description:
Stories included in this volume:

1. Mishiranu Machi (見知らぬ街)
A group of teenagers went on a summer holiday and had a car accident. The woke up and found the whole city was empty. How can they escape the eerie place? But more importantly, can they really all go back?

2. Youkoso Mystery Tour e (ようこそミステリーツアーへ)
In the summer holiday, a 15 year old girl Kana went on a vacation on an island, when a certain hotel giving out invitation to join a treasure hunt event with only a ridiculously impossible m

title: Tantei Opera Milky Holmes: Radical Time
author: Muramatsu, Mayu

title: Tenkyuu no Kill Logger
author: Sugahara, Keita, Inoue, Natsumi
description:
Hiromu Morinaga saw his parents killed by a murderer and was injured himself. Fortunately, he managed to survive but since that day, he can see ghostly things. On rainy days, he sees the last moments of a murder victim floating behind the murderer—a "murderer's résumé." Behind the transfer student, Yuzuka, who came to his class, there are a lot of suffering faces... Is the mysterious girl an angel or a devil?

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: The Ear-Taking Maiden
author: Kitano, Wasabi
description:
Ryuhei, now a graduate student, has felt a strange fascination since childhood with a certain folktale in a picture book. As he visits Shiraha Village, where the legend is said to have spread, and continues his investigation, a mystery, as well as creeping suspicion, begins to surface…?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Tennin Karakusa
author: Yamagishi, Ryouko
description:
Okamura Kyoko is drowning in complete psychosis, but how has she ended up like this? Her childhood wasn’t hard, she swam in complete happiness… What has caused her illness?

(translated from: karémanga)

title: Spy Classroom 2nd Period: Daughter Dearest
author: Takemachi, Benishake
description:
With the killer virus successfully retrieved from the Galgad Empire, the girls are ready to go on even more missions! The only problem is...Klaus refuses to take them on any! Can these fledgling spies prove their skills once again and face the new evil lurking in the shadows...?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Gankutsuou Comic Anthology
author: Akira, Norikazu, Miyagi, Tooko, Shino, Natsuho, CJ Michalski, Minami, Haruka, Asou, Kai, Kunieda, Saika, Asato, Eiri, Fujikawa, Ruri, Katagiri, Atsuko

title: Slipping Calendar
author: Muro, Ayako
description: Saki Noze works in the Department of Public Relations at Yayagi University. Though he lacks charisma and general social skills, his colleagues care for him like a loving child. Saki Noze is an anxious and timid person. But he knows all that. What he doesn't know is why this young man in front of him is acting so frantic. Who even is he?! Let's rewind... Saki Noze works in the Department of Public Relations at Yayagi University. His facial expressions are hard to read, he lacks social skills, and

title: Mahoutsukai Syd & Lid
author: Kiki
description:
From Storm in Heaven:

Magicians, people with magical powers that have caused their kind to be hated and feared throughout the centuries. This manga contains their tales -- of magic for both good and evil, the struggle to fit into society, and a dark past that haunts them both.

The series includes:

1) Romanesque Variee 
2) Mystic Variee
3) Classical Variee 
4) Sweet Variee 
5) Silouette Variee 
6) Crescent Variee 
7) Secret Variee
8) Fantastic Variee
9) Nostalgic Variee

title: Kneel down and lick my shoes.
author: Tenkawa, Ai

title: Video J
author: Akaishi, Michiyo
description: A few years ago, Kirishima Juri's parents and younger brother were murdered right in front of her eyes. Ever since then, she has been unable to laugh. Running desperately away from her family's killers, she meets a video journalist named J through her boyfriend Kengo, who unravels her fate towards a new direction...

title: Speed
author: Akishige, Manabu, Kaneshiro, Kazuki
description:
Revolves around a group of high school delinquents who unaccountably fight on behalf of various strangers that they befriend in a single meeting. In this story they come to the rescue of Okamoto Kanako who can't believe that Uehara Ayako, Kanako's tutor, really committed suicide. 

(Source: MU)

title: Umineko no Naku Koro ni: Saigo de Saisho no Okurimono
author: Ryukishi07
description: A compilation of comedic and serious Umineko no Naku Koro ni short stories originally released at fan events and in the Shinsou Kaimei Dokuhon guidebooks, which were later adapted into Umineko no Naku Koro ni Tsubasa, Hane, and Saku. Also includes a newly written short story meant to be a prologue to Hotarubi no Tomoru Koro ni.

title: Kyoko Shimazu Author's Edition
author: Shimazu, Kyouko
description: A collection of Shimazu Kyouko's short stories filled with human drama.

title: Lunar Cat
author: Oumi, Shinano
description: Luna was one day saved by a man who trained him to become a killing machine, since then, our hero does mission for that guy organization as an assassin. One day he is given a mission which implies 'latching' onto a private detective by the name of Nishina Tougo with the objective of killing a scientist who created some dangerous drug... (Source: M-U)

title: Prosecutor Who Doesn't Know the Law
author: Irwolbi, Chang
description:
Im Taesan, the second in command of the Waryong Association, possessed the body of prosecutor Kang Bareun, who is in a coma due to a traffic accident. Upon waking up, Taesan discovers that there are suspicious circumstances surrounding his death. He starts to unravel the conspiracy hidden behind his death using his connections and combat skills from his previous life, along with the intelligence and wealth from his current life.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Quo Vadis
author: Shintani, Kaoru, Saeki, Kayono
description:
From ancient times, there exist vampires and the immortals who hunt them. The kind vampire Odin finds his ancient teacher; but now she has the form of an adorable child. As they try to move forward with their own plans, they must avoid the attention of Sofia, one of the immortal vampire hunters.

(Source: MU)

title: The Disowned Queen's Consulting Detective Agency
author: Nagase, Sarasa, Hachipisuwan
description: When it comes to light that Octavia de Reine isn't a legitimate member of the noble House of Reine, she swiftly finds herself disowned. At first she takes this in stride...until her power hungry father and ex-suitor start vying for the house full of mysterious heirlooms that her doting grandmother left her. Little does her family know that she's destined to inherit an even greater legacy. Olivia hopes to follow in Granny's footsteps and become a famous detective, after all! She'll face off again

title: Keizoku/Manga
author: Arai, Rie, Nishiogi, Yumie
description:
Graduating at the top of her class, elite detective candidate Jun Shibata is transferred to the section that handles cases deemed "unsolvable" by the department. Her partner, though a well-respected and experienced detective, has grown complacent after unsuccessfully pursuing these cases that many consider an exercise in futility. With her upper class breeding, her colleagues don't expect much from her either, but she suprises them all with her motivation and astounding powers of deduction.

(So

title: Just Listen to the Song
author: Fujimoto, Tatsuki, Tooda, Oto
description:
A student presents his crush with a love song that he wrote, recorded himself performing, and uploaded to YouTube, and he tells her to watch it before giving him a reply. When he returns to school the next day, he finds that the girl has shown the video to the entire class over LINE. Amid the jeering of his classmates, she snidely apologizes to him and explains that his video was hilarious enough to warrant sharing.

However, his decision to remove the upload is curbed after a ghost is spotted w

title: NTR: Netsuzou Trap
author: Kodama, Naoko
description:
While their boyfriends wait outside, Hotaru Mizushina passionately kisses her childhood friend, Yuma Okazaki, in a bathroom stall. Under the pretext of practicing for their boyfriends, Hotaru continues to tease Yuma—but could she have other motives for doing so?

Despite an ongoing relationship with her boyfriend, Yuma cannot stop thinking about Hotaru ever since their kiss, and complicated circumstances between these students arise.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: The monster of 1st grade, class A.
author: Hideki
description: When Tarou Jimi is assigned as the homeroom teacher of class 1-A at an all girls' high school, the rest of the staff feel sorry for him. On the surface, class 1-A is full of pretty and talented girls on the cusp of adulthood. But under the pretense of grace and elegance, the girls of 1-A are akin to the spawn of the devil, known to drive all their homeroom teachers to resignation. Every teacher they have had has already been forced to quit with poorly disguised bullying and blatant blackmailing.

title: School Days
author: Sakazuki, Homare, 0verflow
description:
Every day when he rides the train to school, Makoto Itou can't help but notice the beautiful Kotonoha Katsura, but he is too shy to talk to her. There are rumors of a charm at his school in which you take a picture of your crush, set it as your phone background, and if no one sees it for three weeks, your love will be realized. So Makoto takes a picture of the raven-haired beauty, and he continues to admire her from afar. 

However, when Sekai Saionji—the girl who sits next to him in class—sees

title: Musume no Tomodachi
author: Hagiwara, Asami
description:
Kosuke has lived to play the ideal self as a father at home and as a manager at work. However, his life changes 180 degrees when he meets his daughter’s friend. In front of her, Kosuke was able to be his real self and his worn-out heart was healed. However, He knows that these are feelings that should never be held. The story of the Middle Aged Man Meets Girl, presented to the modern people who suppress themselves in society, begins.

(Source: Mangasushi)

title: Uwa-Koi
author: Itosugi, Masahiro
description:
Yukiteru Tamaki and his childhood friend Yuno Kirishima are in a relationship, and outwardly, things seem perfect. But Yukiteru has a secret: he has actually been sleeping with their friend, Rena Saotome, ever since she confessed to him. Though Yukiteru plans to tell Yuno, he soon finds himself juggling both girls, with Yuno being none the wiser.

But things get more complicated when Kaori Yumeno sees Yukiteru and Saotome having sex on the rooftop. She agrees to keep quiet—for a price. The price

title: Mishiranu Joshikousei ni Kankin sareta Mangaka no Hanashi
author: Kitada, Ryouma
description:
The story of a mangaka who becomes imprisoned by a mysterious high school girl.

Included one-shot:
Volume 2: Fetish Senpai@Kaihatsuchuu

title: Pleasure & Corruption
author: Someya, Yuu
description:
High school can be a stressful time for many teenagers, and as such, a lot of them take up hobbies to help them cope with the trials of everyday life. But for sophomore Zen Minedara, his stress-relieving hobby—taking upskirt photos of the girls around him—could land him in jail.

Zen knows it's wrong, but he can't stop. In his mind, nothing else can bring him relief. However, when he snaps an upskirt photo of the beautiful class vice president Ayame Houjou on the way to the station, she catches

title: Yosuga no Sora
author: Mikaze, Takashi
description: After losing their parents in an accident, Haruka and Sora, his younger sister, move to the town where their grandfather lived. They visited his house many times when they were kids and they still remember it. Nao, their old friend, Ryouhei, his classmate, Akira, a miko at a neighboring shrine, and Kazuha, Akira's close friend, welcome them. Nothing has changed. The good old memories and silent atmosphere heal Haruka's sadness. However, his peaceful life gradually changes. A secret promise made

title: Rengoku no Toshi
author: Tawara, Kyouhei
description:
Makoto is in love with his childhood friend Ai. However, every night he is plagued with a strange dream where there is a station he does not know. The curtain to a chilling suspense story of love and survival opens.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Bradherley no Basha
author: Samura, Hiroaki
description:
Every year, Lord Nicola A. Bradherley, one of Europe's leading aristocrats, sends his coach round to various orphanages to adopt little girls and trains them to join his opera troupe. But most of these girls never make it onto the stage—a far more sinister fate awaits them, sacrificed in the name of the greater good.

(Source: MU)

title: Billionaire Girl
author: Katsura, Asuka, Hasekura, Isuna
description:
Kei Takato, an ordinary university student searching for part-time work, receives an irresistible offer: to act as a mathematics tutor for his professor's niece, Yukari Fujioka, twice a week and for ten thousand yen per hour. Taken aback by this lucrative deal, Kei accepts. 

Young, cute, and baby-faced, Yukari is an alluring girl. Little do people know, she is also a high school dropout who has amassed a gargantuan fortune of 170 billion yen through the stock market. However, despite her immens

title: Nanoka no Kare
author: Toumori, Miyoshi, Tekkotsu, Saro
description:
When Nanoka was in middle school, she got her first confession. Feeling that the boy really liked her, she started dating him. Only to find out later that he only used her to show off in front of his friends. Betrayed, Nanoka is now in high school and hesitates getting into another relationship.

Though a chance encounter with a stranger's breakup in a fast food restaurant soon changes her mind. Both her and the stranger were betrayed in their first relationships...and this brings up a different

title: Ibitsu
author: Okada, Kazuto
description:
There is something a bit twisted inside of the teenage girl Madoka. It comes out one day when she has to deal with a groper on a public train. He may be scarred for life by the time she's finally through with him. But for her, at least, this encounter may only be the beginning...

(Source: MU)

title: Kimi no Sei
author: Chatani, Ami, Sakurairo
description: On a blind group date, promiscuous college student Takaya Manada falls head over heels for Yurina Mikami. Conversely, Yurina appears shocked to see him, and she leaves the date after he confesses his love. Takaya later recalls that he used to bully Yurina in elementary school, which led her to change schools and develop a bitter hatred toward him over the years. Intending to redeem himself, Takaya asks her to go out with him once more. She agrees, but with an ultimatum: he must do everything she

title: Lost+Brain
author: Ootani, Akira, Yabuno, Tsuzuku
description:
This is the story of a very smart student called Hirama Ren who is used to always getting the top results in his school, and is the chairman of the student's council. One day, he walks past a group of bullies and asks them to leave—and because of that, they decide to teach him a lesson. They decide to beat up a couple of guys and they reported it to the teachers, blaming him.

Hirama becomes enraged by it and so he decides to attain some power that could allow him to change the world to a world

title: Lust Geass
author: Takahashi, Osamu
description: Souta Takatsuki and his neighbor Rikka Amanome have been like brother and sister since they were kids, but his feelings for her run much deeper. With her birthday coming up, he wants to find the perfect gift, which presents itself in the form of a book from a mysterious shop he happens across. The owner doesn't even charge him, saying he'll return to pay eventually... Souta is wholly unprepared for the insatiable passion the book inspires in Rikka, and it seems the ultimate price of this gift ma

title: Mata, Kataomou.
author: Tachibana, Roku
description:
"A one-way route." A weird strange feeling. A love story about the girl who was always confessed to by her childhood friend, how will she reply, from a long time confession?!

(Source: MU)

title: Bottom-Tier Character Tomozaki
author: Chida, Eight, Yaku, Yuuki
description:
With the username "nanashi," Fumiya Tomozaki is the number one player in Japan in the online game "Attack Family," also known as "Tackfam." Despite having such a prestigious title, he struggles in high school due to a lack of social skills. He blames the perplexing mechanics and unjust rules of life for his lack of friends, forcing him to give up and consider himself the lowest-tier character in the "game."

Fumiya was surprised to learn the identity of the number two Tackfam player after a fate

title: Hina Change
author: Kajikawa, Gaku
description:
Hina Amano has just started going out with her crush, Makoto Kagami. Thoughtful and kind, Makoto is everything that a girl could possibly want, and she could not be happier. However, there is a secret looming over their relationship, one that not even Makoto knows: the person inside Hina's body is actually Makoto's friend, Ren Takizawa.

Eleven years ago, Hina and Ren were childhood friends who discovered that they could switch bodies. But, like friends sometimes do, they drifted apart until hig

title: Boku no Namae wa "Shounen A"
author: Hioka, Yen, Kimizuka, Chikara
description:
A teacher's murder at the hands of his student is the talk of the town. Due to the perpetrator's youth, the media censor his name and dub him "Boy A." His purported motive is simple: he disliked his teacher.
