author: joana, Yet Saram, Massstar, Park, Karin, DEY, Kim, Yongjin, Lim, Jinguk, Rangddo, Danwoo, Oenunbagi
description: An anthology of horror short stories by various authors.

title: Deathboy Shitarou
author: Knife, Senno
description: A collection of horror stories that revolve around a common character, a boy named Shitarou.

title: Do Aphorism
author: Kujo, Karuna
description:
Like the original manga, the new series centers on Naraka High School, a school that only admits students who can see an island in the sky. While it is allegedly a prestige school where graduates are guaranteed to get excellent government jobs, the students are forced to fight for survival in order to graduate.

The new main character is Hiroshi, a 15-year-old boy who can see the island in the sky. He and his friends enter the school as a test of courage but he alone returns.

(Source: ANN)

title: Suburban Hell: Kougai Jigoku
author: Kanafuro, Tarou
description:
You who enter here, abandon all hope... The seven stories of Suburban Hell, where all the protagonists are consumed by obsession and madness, take place in an ordinary suburb. Trauma, cults, precariousness, betrayals, and murders make up the charm of this collection of hardcore horror. The style, very dark, leaves no room for hope and reveals the horror of human nature, governed by hatred and madness.

(Source: Editions IMHO, translated)

title: The Dog that Barks at Death
author: Kira, Kokyou
description:
One day, Dad brought home a dog. The problem was where he found it... Thus begins a strange tale sparked by a single dog.

description:
Collections of short stories by Kenya Suzuki. Loneliness is a common element in these stories, but they all espouse the secret hope that we can share warmth with other people.

The stories are about: A college student starts dating a girl who may or may not be feeding him bugs, a painter is seduced by his patron so that he can create his masterpiece, a demon in training gets a crush on the human girl at the video rental store, and two boys bond over their love of movies. author: Kanzaki, Masaomi, Aro, Hiroshi, Manabe, Jouji, Tagami, Yoshihisa, Shinohara, Udou, Takemoto, Izumi, Tsuzuki, Kazuhiko, Satou, Gen, Yano, Kentarou, Miyahara, Nao

title: I want to become a dog
author: Sanjou, Tomomi
description:
A collection of ero-guro stories by Sanjou Tomomi.

1. Akachan wa Daare?
2. Ana no Naka (In a Hole)
3. Inu ni Naritai (I Want to Become a Dog)
4. Mushi Shoujo (An Insect Girl)
5. Koibito Ningyou (A Lover Doll)
6. Bijo to Kaibutsu (Beauty and the Monster)
7. Koufuku e no Shinryaku (Aggression To Happiness)
8. Kyoufu! Uroko Shoujo (Fear! A Scale Girl)
9. Kawahagi Collector (A Leatherfish Collector)
10. Imomushi (A Green Caterpillar)
11. Mori no Hanayome (A Bride of a Forest)

title: Poppy Playtime
author: Oda, Kazuki
description: Momomaru and Momoko head to a toy factory to solve its mystery...

title: It Is Painful!
author: Ochazuke, Nori
description:
A collection of painful events that people have experienced sorted in the "Pain Level Scale," from 1 to 6. What level of pain can you tolerate? Is it 1? Or is it 6? Let's go to the theme park of pain...

(Source: Media Factory, translated)

title: Human Protection Company
author: Jjaljjal-i, Told
description:
During the fourth civil service exam, Lee Yeon-woo barely survives the "Human Qualification Exam," which turns humans into beasts, and receives a job offer from a suspicious company called the "Human Protection Company." Can Yeon-woo, investigator in the anomaly research team of the Humanity Protection Company, which isolates, secures, and studies abnormalities to protect humanity, safeguard the human world and survive until the end?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Amagoushi no Yakata
description: Manga adaptation of the visual novel of the name.

title: Nightmare in the Art Room
author: Kirima, Moccori
description:
1. Bijutsushitsu no Akumu (Nightmare in the Art Room)
2. Ayashii Kanashibari (Suspicious Sleep Paralysis)
3. Toshokan Chikan: Hatsujou Seito to Kagai Jugyou, Majime na Sensei mo Wakai Nikubou wa Kobamenakute... (Library Molester: The Excited Students and Extracurricular Lesson. Even a Serious Teacher Can't Refuse Young Dicks!)
4. Oishiku Meshiagare (Eat Up!)
5. Joudan ja Nai! (It's Not a Joke!)
6. Kowaku (Fascination)

title: Jigoku no Mizu
author: Mizuki, Shigeru
description:
Tokyo University Professor is suddenly awoken in the middle of the night by what appears to be an enormous 6 sided dice sitting in his garden. 

Perplexed by this sudden appearance, the professor, with the help of some locals, set about cracking open the dice to see what's inside with ghastly consequences.

Curiosity soon turns to despair as the Professor realizes that he has just unleashed a grudge bearing water demon from the Himalayas that has come to Tokyo in search of his blood!

title: Delicious
author: Kim, Minso
description:
Vegetarian food columnist Chaekyung Shin is a man of mysteries. He spends most days tucked away in his rundown apartment, cooking, writing, and humming to his favorite tunes. But fans can't get enough of his food—his dishes are known to tickle the taste buds with flavors that vegetables alone can't quite achieve. So, what is his secret...? Only those invited to dinner get to find out.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Yume Yume Utsutsu
author: Mitsuki, Kazumi
description: After losing her older brother, Mikako begins living her cousin, Yuiko, while at the same time, more mysterious incidents happen...

title: Dohii! Obake ga Boku wo Penpen Naguru!
author: Oshikiri, Rensuke
description:
1. Dohii! Obake ga Boku wo Penpen Naguru!
2. Sharekoube ni Me wo Irero!
3. Kotatsu Obake
4. 4444
5. Zekkyou!! Norowareta Shinya Taxi
6. Kyoufu!! Hitokui Mansion
7. Youkai Jansou
8. Kyodai Mahjong Jigoku Ezu
9. Shuunen no Kurenhoutou
10. Akumu no Mental Care
11. Shinken 10-dai Shaberaneba
12. Kagerou no Hibi
13. Kyoufu no Shuugaku Ryokou

title: Utsukushiki Vampire
author: Asuka, Sachiko
description:
Lilah, an Austrian Count's daughter, is approached at a ball by Justine, an enchantingly beautiful woman of fellow Habsburg descent. The two quickly become friends, but little does Lilah know that Justine's keen interest in her may become a death sentence.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Pieces of Humans
author: Shin, Eui-Chul, Cheon, Beom Sick
description:
"Healed Zombies," those with rotting bodies but sound minds, are desperate for living humans; not just to kill but to receive transplants of their healthy body parts and survive! Fragmented spirits, fragmented bodies, and fragmented humanity... this is the desperate survival of broken people, left only with pieces of humans!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Real Onigokko JK
author: Minatsuki, Yomogi, Sono, Sion
description:
Based on the novel Real Onigokko and Sion Sono's movie version, changing the original story from people with the family name of "Satou" becoming targets to JK (female high school students).

(Source: Asian Wiki)

title: Todenka
author: Otsuka, Eiji, Nato, Kio
description:
Eiji Otsuka presents a comical horror fantasy based on the theme of urban legends. This tells the story of a young folklore scholar’s success in solving cases assigned by the urban legend problems handler, nicknamed “Todenka,” along with the help of Slit-Mouth Woman and Man-faced Dog. 

(Source: JManga)

title: Tokyo Senritsu Kitan
author: Andou, Romeda, Hino, Chihaya, Okuda, Waku, Seto, Umiko, Katou, Susu, Sukeyama, Sakishita, Senmu, Koiwo, Jino, Anji, Kazu, Takuma, Inaba, Sakimoto, Saki, Ura, Tamaji, Bonno, Nuis, Iku, Gao
description: A BL horror anthology drawn by various mangaka.

title: Mansect
author: Koga, Shinichi
description:
Humans grow and age. They change. But always we are the same person, the same creature. Not so with insects, whose powers of metamorphosis alter not only their shape and size, but also their very beings. And now, because of one young man's unhealthy obsession with bugs, humans also find themselves transformed into disgusting, decrepit, bloodsucking insect monsters!

(Source: Living the Line)

title: Ushiro
author: Mimori, Tokio, Bingo
description: This horror spirit fantasy series follows the strange master-servant relationship between high-school girl Nanako Nishizaki and death god Ushiro Reiichirou, who captures the souls of the dying using mysterious methods and abilities. But the bright and positive Nanako doesn't want anyone to die.

title: Sin
author: Kim, Jae-Hwan
description:
Sin is about three Ghosthunters: 
Namgung Seog-Jin, a well-build catholic priest, Seodunami, who was born with the strength from darkness and who was taught occult arts by his mother and the last: Gumiho, an originally hunted ghost, who changed sides after meeting Seodunami. Their mission is to redeem ghosts so that they can leave either to hell or heaven. 

The art and story is from Hwan Kim, who might be known for his illustration of King of Hell and Hero. 

from mangaupdates

title: Halloween Densetsu
author: Watari, Chie
description:
A tragedy happened on the night of 31 October. A young woman went mad and killed all of her family.
What is the connection between this tragedy and a few similar tragedy before that? Why did it always happen on the night of Halloween?

title: The Gordian Knot
description:
Source: Yesasia.com

To win or to lose,
to deceive or to be deceived

By changing your way of thinking
you can solve many difficult problems,
this is the so called "Cutting the Gordian Knot"!!

To conquer the collectors who are only willing to give out their collections by gambling with them.  And here comes the super child prodigy in solving problems 祐樹!! Using tricks to deceive many swindlers. A bright story about gambling.

title: Smile, It's Just a Dream
author: Torimura
description:
This is a cruel, gloomy, and bizarre story about a certain midsummer dream. 

"This feeling is unrequited that it made me suffer... So I kill that person." It was that kind of dream that Kanae had been witnessing...

(Source: Torico, edited)

title: Welcome to Undead Park
author: Koogi
description:
The largest theme park in America has been overrun by a zombie virus. Sung-heon finds himself trapped with his daughter among zombies and foreign tourists with whom he cannot communicate. In this unprecedented disaster where any moving living creature, not just humans, is turned into a zombie, Sung-heon struggles with his injured leg to save his daughter. They must survive—against the zombies, and each other.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Kyuuketsu! Kuromajou
author: Hino, Hideshi
description: Aya Hanamura is a perfect student at an all-girls school. One day, a voice calls out to her and puts her in a trance. She doesn't remember that she received a crystal ball from an old lady. Now every night, Aya has nightmares where she is in a trance-like state, walking to a feudal castle to get her blood sucked by the vampire samurai nobleman.

title: Tomodachizukuri
author: Eto, Pirika
description:
Tomoko Mochizuki, a high school girl bullied by her classmates, finds an abandoned doll on her way home one day and decides to take it with her. To her surprise, the beautiful doll has a will of its own. Listening to Tomoko's wishes, it begins acting to turn her classmates into "friends"...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: The Soul Guardians
author: Lee, Hyeop, Lee, Woo-hyeok
description:
Hyun-Am trains in Tai Chi Qigong in order to fight the water ghost that killed his sister; Father Park, unable to save his friend's daughter from an unknown evil spirit, chooses to become a priest walking the path of asceticism; Jun-Hoo, the only survivor of Eastern Sea Esoteric Buddhism, is a genius who has inherited all the magic of the five guardians of Esoteric Buddhism; Seung-Hee, who has a secret, gets involved in a mysterious case due to her father.

An occult fantasy in which individual

title: Kyowaku Asobi
author: Tatsumi, Doroko
description: Takeshita, a new teacher, finds the erotic appeal of Wakamatsu, one of his students, very uncomfortable. He learns from his co-workers that Wakamatsu lives at a brothel and is advised to simply ignore him. But straight-laced Takeshita tries to reach out to him in sympathy, provoking interest from Wakamatsu as well. But what could Wakamatsu mean by "I'm better than the girls around here"? A blood-curdling ero-suspense story!

title: Oshiire no Shounen
author: Mimori, Takahashi, Yousuke
description:
Included one-shot:
Volume 1: Oshiire no Shounen (pilot)

title: Kuufuku na Bokura
author: Tomoyasu, Kunitarou
description:
Humans are nearly extinct, and zombie society is on the verge of a food crisis. Wataru, a zombie whose quirk is that he has retained his human intelligence and emotions, hatches a plan to achieve a breakthrough in the food crisis. His ambitious plan is to find surviving human males and females, breed them, and begin farming humanity (food)! However, the first surviving woman he manages to locate is his ex-girlfriend, for whom he still harbors feelings even now!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Watashi ga Kieta!
author: Watari, Chie
description:
1. Watashi ga Kieta
A girl is going to take an entrance exam on school. But when she reached school after getting into a little accident on the way, someone is already sitting at her desk.
2. Tojikomerareta Zekkyou
Because of a landslide on the road, we ended up at a strange old house in the middle of nowhere. The furniture and books date back to the 19th century but it still reeks of new wood and ink.
3. Kao no Nai Shounen
When I was hospitaled because of an accident, I met a mysterious young b

title: Broadway of the Dead Jombie: Doutei SOS
author: Sugimura, Shinichi
description: When a swarm of female zombies descend upon Nakano Broadway, a bunch of Otaku, virgins, and all-round blockheads find themselves becoming mankind's final hope of salvation!

title: The Sleepless Torture Tower: Chapter of Clown
author: Akuno-P, Soga, Shina
description:
What do you do when you have lost everything? Lloyd Lowell has found his answer. In Leon City, people are drawn to the torture of tower, Torcia Tower. There, it is rumored, lies treasures which can bring you fortune, fame and, most importantly—eternal life.

However, nothing goes as planned when Lloyd enters the tower...

(Source: MU)

title: Obake no Oyatsu
author: Oshikiri, Rensuke
description:
1. Ittai Naze! Kouchou ga Watashi wo Osou!!
2. Tokyo Twilight Zone
3. Giga Knife

5. Misshitsu Obake
6. Yamero! Saru wo Ijimeru na!
7-8. Piko Piko Shounen
9. Beautiful
10. Rei ni Aitakute

title: Joyuurei
author: Takahashi, Hiroshi, Takaminato, Motosuke
description: A young director, Murai, works with two actresses playing sisters. He clearly has a bit of a crush on Hitomi, the older actress, and keeps a photo of her by his bedside. The younger actress, Saori, is inexperienced and playful.

title: Bloody Lily
author: Anan, Mayuki
description:
1. Bloody Lily
2. Shikaeshi Jitsugen Game
3. Toumei Shoujo to Shoujo
4. Hokenshitsu de Miru Akumu
5. Futago Mitai na Futari
6. Akuma no Hon wa Yuuwaku suru

title: Kitaro Tai Akuma-kun
author: Mizuki, Shigeru
description:
Written five years after Akuma-kun Sennen Oukoku, this one-shot tells the story of how the now deceased Akuma-kun has managed to take command of all the beasts residing in Hell.

With the minions of Hell on his side, Akuma-kun attempts to take over the human world and unite both dimensions as one. Naturally, the human world is not too keen on this idea and before long, Kitaro, with the help of all of Japan's Yokai, set about to stop Akuma-kun once and for all in an almighty battle!

title: Shark Panic
author: Saimura, Tsukasa, Sharkmura, Zookasa
description:
Seven classmates reunite in their hometown for the first time in a while. They rent a recreational boat and experience a fleeting sense of freedom, but in the sea lurks a giant man-eating shark. One after another, the youths fall prey to the shark. And when the boat breaks down during the shark attack, it's a desperate situation in the open ocean!

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

title: Yukei Seikyo Kukla
author: Mifune, Asato, Tazawa, Koji
description: A Japanese boy moves to a town in Russia after being adopted by his father ex-girlfriend, known there as "the lady of the Mountain". But who is this woman? What powers is she hiding?

title: The Non-Existence
author: Jeomsim
description: The world has been overrun by an unidentified virus, turning many people into cannibalistic monsters. The screams of dying people are drowned out by the cries of these monsters. Kim Jong-do, a boy who had lived a gloomy life due to his congenital lack of presence and inability to attract the attention of those around him, survived the end of the world as even the monsters ignored him. For some reason, he was able to communicate with a few of the monsters. In doing so, he managed to alleviate his

title: Hellbound 2: The Resurrected
author: Yeon, Sang-ho, Choi, Gyu-seok
description:
Five years have passed since a blameless infant was spared from a demonstration, saved by her parents' self-sacrifice. Yet what should have ended the religious hysteria has instead fueled a new wave of feverish cult practices by the ever-growing Arrowhead. As society teeters on the brink of further chaos and long-dead sinners inexplicably begin returning to life, the government steps in behind the scenes to tip the scales.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Burgess no Otome-tachi
author: Fuyunaga
description:
Volumes:

1. Burgess no Otome-tachi: Waiwakushia no Shou
2. Burgess no Otome-tachi: Dinomischus no Shou
3-4. Burgess no Otome-tachi: Anomalocaris no Shou

title: School-Live! Anthology Comic: Goku
author: Rui, Tamachi, Zara, Hozuno, Miyako, GAN, Miyama, Okara, Kagamitsuki, Hatopopoko, Gumichoko, Inoue, Ka-ku, Tachitsu, Tetsuko, Yoshino, Kai, Nagaoka, Taichi, Tokiwa, Rokugou
description: An anthology of Gakkougurashi! by various mangaka.

title: Cinderella at Midnight
author: Koiwa, Mihoko
description: A girls horror comic about an evil and spoiled girl named Ruri whose beautiful face hides her jealousy and greed as she leaves a trail of death and destruction in her path.

title: Six Days of Me and Eve
author: Morino, Ion, Yanase, Izuru
description:
Leopold, a young boy, wakes up from a scary dream to find himself alone with his maid Eve in a dark and spacious mansion. He lives his life in the mansion, keeping the strange promise he gave to Eve, but gradually, mysterious events begin to take hold of Leopold.

(Source: Micro Magazine, translated)

title: Hidden Face
author: Matsumoto, Yoko
description:
One day, Onozuka Miki receives a call from her older sister, Tatebayashi Midori, from whom she was separated years ago.  Midori desperately begs for her help, afraid that a killer is after her life!  Miki quickly transfers schools to Midori's posh private boarding school, but not two days pass before she is swept into a whirlwind of unexplainable murders...

Note: Included in vol. 2 is a one-shot by Matsumoto Yoko-sensei titled "Nemesis no Yoru" about a group of students who spend 5 days on a de

title: I Am the Only One Who Is Not Attacked in the World Filled with Zombies.
author: Saburou, Uraji, Rokuro
description: Yuusuke is an office worker with a dislike for people, preferring to do his job alone and in silence. When the company he works for suddenly goes bankrupt, he loses his job, and with that, all his motivation disappears, and he becomes a complete shut-in. On one of the rare days he decides to leave his apartment after a week-long video game binge, a mysterious man attacks him and bites his arm. Though Yuusuke manages to escape back to his room, he comes down with a fever and becomes bedridden for

title: Oneechan Bara Kurenai
description: The dead have risen to feast on the flesh of the living, and just when it seems that all hope for humanity has been lost, bikini girls with machine guns take one last shot at saving mankind from certain extinction. In the near future, a deranged scientist named Sugita has conducted a series of experiments intended to reanimate the dead. Unfortunately for the entire population of the planet, these experiments were a resounding success. Now, as a massive, shambling army of the undead launches a bl

title: Kaigan
author: Itou, Mimika
description:
A collection of short stories by Mimika Itou for Hontou ni Atta Kowai Hanashi

1. Jisatsu no Rensa
2. Noroi no Hate
3. Tatazumu Shoujo-tachi
4. Shi wo Matsu Onna
5. Kaigan
6. Inori no Koe

author: Aoi, Miharu

title: Yumeyume: Onmyouji Kidan
author: Aramata, Hiroshi, Kugo, Naoko
description: One volume containing two stories about Abe no Seimei, the longer one dealing with a demoness who fell in love with him...

title: Mijika de Okita Kowai Hanashi
author: Maita, Nao
description: There's always something wrong and twisted behind every Japanese folk legend...

title: Real Onigokko
author: Yamada, Yuusuke, Sugiyama, Satoshi
description:
An odd murder case that only targets persons with the family name "Satou" occurs in Japan. Meanwhile, high school student Tsubasa Satou winds up in a parallel world during a fight with a gangster. Everything seems almost the same, but his friends and classmates are somehow different from who they used to be.

Tsubasa Satou can not comprehend what is happening around him, but when he sees a girl getting killed in front of him by a persuer, he finds out that he is now in a world where the Lord of

title: Honoo no Mirage: Kaikou-hen - Mashiroki Zankyou
author: Kuwabara, Mizuna, Hotaka, Ran
description: Prequel of Mirage of Blaze revolving around Kagetora and Naoe's first encounter set 400 years ago.

title: Jack: The American Ghost
author: Han, Jihye, Ahn, Jeongeun
description:
Young Ma Go-eun and her father are about to be evicted from the haunted house they've run throughout the years. But Go-eun is not about to let the park owner demolish their haunted house and her memories of her childhood and her mother. She resolves to go to the United States to surpass trials and get a million dollar cash prize awarded to those who can survive a stay in Ghost Jack's House.

(Source: MU)

title: Mind Eyes
author: Hayami, Tsubasa
description:
Aya has the ability to see other people's emotion. One day, a man moves next door to her and there is something mysterious about the man as Aya senses weird visions from the past and future from him. What is behind his motive and is Aya able to prevent it from happening?

(Source: MU)

title: The Day the Goddess Fell
author: Tamura, Yumi
description:
A collection of one-shots by manga-ka Tamura Yumi.

Megami ga Ochita Hi:
Monika works at "Safari Island" a huge nature park in the middle of the ocean, where people can come to see African animals of all kinds while staying at resorts.  She loves the animals she works with as well as her now retired grandfather.  Everyday she works hard to make sure the park runs smoothly and that her grandfather is as happy as he can be, but a helicopter that crashes into the island scarily changes everything..

title: Divi-Dead
author: Morino, Izumi, Cs Ware, Uchida, Masataka
description:
His name is Ranmaru Hibikiya. Today is his first day at Asao Private School...

His uncle is the dean of this school. About a month ago, he paid him a visit and offered me enrollment at his school. Seeing that he's been out of school for a long time, he accepted his offer. What was the catch? He asked me to keep an eye out for him. Bluntly, he was to be his spy...No problem.

Well actually, there was a problem. Once he arrived, he started noticing some disturbing things. There was violence and m

title: Sairai
author: Kadono, Tamio
description: A blacksmith loses his daughter during an offering to a mountain god, so he spends the next forty years preparing to get his revenge.

title: Declaration to Madonna
author: Tamura, Yumi
description:
This is the 6th volume of Tamura Yumi's "Tamu no Nandemo Capsule Series" (a collection of her one-shots).  

Madonna ni Tsugu:
Mizusawa Karen, a very skilled archer, was taken in 5 years ago by her father's good friend, the head surgeon of the Tokyo police department medical hospital.  On her 16th birthday, however, her adoptive father tells her that she has a bomb implanted in her heart that is set to go off in a week.  Now she and two friends must find her real father to have any hopes of surv

title: Aiyoku no Eustia: Auld Lang Syne
author: August, Ponjiritsu, Okita, Kazuhiko
description: Novel about Caim's past, when Borts Grado was still alive.

title: Jigoku Koushien
author: Man☆Gatarou
description: It's every high school baseball team's dream to go to the legendary Koshien Stadium Tournament. For the first time in years, Seido High School has a chance—star player Gorrila Matsui has finally given the team an opportunity to succeed. Most delighted at this prospect is Principal Kocho. His hopes are dashed, however, when the Headteacher reveals to him that the first game will be played against the infamous Gedo High School. Gedo is notorious for its brutal killings during games. They hardly pl

title: Mugengai
author: Mizusawa, Yusuke
description:
Maki Hyousuke is a humble puppet maker by day, and a potent shaman by night. Follow him on his adventures through the dark depths of Japanese occultism and monsters, as he struggles to exterminate the many evil spirits that dwell in our realm.

(Source: Manga Reborn)

title: Kuroi Hohoemi
author: Hosokawa, Chieko
description: Risa kisaragi and her beautiful sister Mana are best friends, but a deadly curse falls on Mana... And the two sisters end up in England.

title: Kaidan BL
author: Koiwazurai, Shibito, Rocky, Kirima, Moccori, Nakaoka, Naka, Fujiokayu, Anmin
description:
Ghost stories aren't just scary! An anthology compiling ghostly boy's love stories.

(Source: MU)

title: Raten - Birth
author: Yamaguchi, Masakazu
description: As long as one processes its power, one's dream will come true. Since The Arm of Kannon has this kind of power, everyone is dying to obtain it. And one day, a high school student accidentally gets a hold of The Arm of Kannon...

title: Odoro: Youko to Tanonaka no Hyakkikou Jikenbo
author: Kigitsu, Katsuhisa
description:
Kondou Youko has strangely pale eyes, just like her grandmother did before her. On her 17th birthday, she begins to see strange things that can't be seen by anyone around her. The first thing she sees is a child with a bandage over his eyes, who seems to be asking her for something. Is his situation merely tragic, or is his presence possibly dangerous for Youko?

Youko meets a college student, Tanonaka Kyouichi, who studies urban legends, folklore, and things of that nature. He believes her acco

title: Eden no Saigo ni
author: Knife, Senno
description:
1. Eden no Saigo ni
2. Shinderu Family
3. Umi wa Maneku yo
4. Jigokujou no Ousama
5. Kuro no Rakuen

title: UFO Mushroom Invasion
author: Shirakawa, Marina
description:
A flying saucer crashes deep in the mountains of Japan. Wary of the hyper-intelligent beings they find inside, the government hides from the public all news of the alien craft. But it's not the strange visitors themselves that they should be afraid of—the real danger is the parasitic spores smuggled aboard! Will Earth survive the UFO MUSHROOM INVASION?!

(Source: Living the Line)

title: Takara no Yome
author: Kondou, Youko

1. Ishi no Akago

6. Kimi yo Shiru ya Minami no Kuni

author: Saitou, Ryouga
description:
The beloved girlfriend he thought he had broken up with is somehow at his house. But she’s hiding a secret...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

3. Kokuen no Tochi

6. Isourou

title: Joker
author: Ohnishi, Kouichi
description:
Joker features an alternative history of the famous Sangoshi. It combined real and mythological history in ancient China.

Instead of following the normal story, the author totally changed the fate of Zhuge Liang. The series also covered a number of rituals and ancient monsters in the Chinese myth.

title: Scariest Tales of Horror
author: Yokoyama, Mayumi, Komuro, Eiko, Sakamoto, Isao, Mizoguchi, Ryouko, Makihara, Wakana, Nanase, Rei
description:
Warning! This is a collection of seriously scary tales!

A mysterious day in a certain town. The price of a promise. The desire to accelerate the progress of mankind. This collection of tales explores the strange possibilities of our reality. Warns against overambitious desires, and reminds us why horror opens our eyes to the wider world. It's sure to send a chill down your spine!

(Source: Shogakukan Asia)

title: Gakuen Hyakumonogatari
author: Hino, Hideshi
description:
Aya, the ace swimmer and captain of the swim team, is suddenly attacked by a vengeful water spirit!  All the moisture in her body is drained and she instantly becomes a mummy.  The human ideas that haunt the school bring about various phenomena.

A collection of short stories about the terrors of a familiar school.

(Source: Goma Books, translated)

title: Watashi ga Mita Mirai
author: Tatsuki, Ryou
description:
1. Jiba

title: Sukkuto Kitsune
author: Yoshikawa, Utata
description: Jikka, along with her best friend Yuzuru, becomes embroiled in the world of the supernatural when Tonau, the fox deity of Nanatsumori Shrine claims her as his bride.

title: Mushihime 2: Hiruko
author: Hokazono, Masaya, Satomi, Yuu
description:
At the end of the battle, Insect Princess Kikuko disappeared along with Ryoichi. The town seemed to have regained its peace, but... Kikuko's genes continue to carry life, and finally, a new Princess is born who will bring terror to the world.

(Source: Home-sha, translated)

title: Mienai Silhouette
author: Matsumoto, Yoko
description: Chiyako's brother, Takaya died in a fight. While everyone in the hospital is sad about his death, Takaya wakes up. Soon Chiyako found out that there's something different about her brother.

title: Houkagogakari
author: Kouda, Gakuto, potg
description:
When the midnight chime rings, we are captured in a "Houkago." In there, there is neither a correct answer nor a goal or a stage clear. Only our dead bodies are piled up.

One day, elementary school student Kei Nimori witnesses his name suddenly written on the blackboard in the classroom along with the mysterious word "Houkagogakari"... In the peculiar school called "Houkagogakari," where monsters are recorded and suppressed at the risk of their lives, the "midnight fairy tale" of boys and girls

title: Darkness Psycho
author: Takashina, Ryouko
description: A mysterious blind man with supernatural powers named Kou Kiryuu meets up with a mysterious girl with unexplained powers to solve puzzling cases.

title: Uriko-hime no Yoru Cinderella no Asa
author: Morohoshi, Daijirou
description:
1. Uriko-hime to Amanjaku
2. Miruna no Zashiki
3. Cinderella no Kutsu
4. Akuma no Susuketa Aibou
5. Chikusei

title: A Crooked Man in the Graveyard
author: Iwasaki, Neri

title: Koko wa Kazoku ga Kieru Machi
author: Kanzaki, Yuuya
description:
The suspense horror manga tells the story of a happy family that moves into a house in the suburbs and in the contract, it states that they must make every effort to create the "ideal family."

(Source: ANN)

title: Z
author: Aihara, Kouji
description:
The "panic horror" manga is set in contemporary Japan after a zombie outbreak. The omnibus of short stories depicts the tragedies that befall a bullied child, a yakuza member, a couple, and various other characters. The first chapter revolved around the zombie extermination police force, a young boy, and his classmates who have been turned into zombies.

(Source: ANN)

title: Kouyasai
author: Yamamoto, Yamato, Tasaki, Rei
description:
Journeying through the 18 islands and gathering the scattered tales is my job as a storyteller.

During every Winter solstice we gather around the island master's keep, sharing our tales until dawn, this is known as Koyasai, the yearly festival for story tellers!

Let me share a dark, hidden tale with you, a story about the dreadful monster... This year, near the abandoned island master's keep, the Koyasai that only belongs to the two of us is about to begin!

(Source: back cover of the novel)

title: Akago Higan
author: Iinuma, Yuuki
description:
Umeko Tachiki, a doctor who is trusted by her patients and adores children. She has expressed her desire to have a child with her husband. One night, tragedy breaks out in the hospital when monsters begin appearing and killing everyone, and the source of all the monsters are the babies in the hospital.

(Source: ANN)

title: Scramble Doumei
author: Matsumoto, Yoko
description:
A highschool detective special interest group meets up with all sorts of murders and mysteries, including supernaturals. Included is a dog with an attitude.

(Source: MangaUpdates)

title: Yuurei Gakkou
author: Watari, Chie
description:
Story 1: A small shrine behind the school was struck by a lightning.In the same time, two student found mutilated on the same area.

Story 2: A girl suddenly could see a lot of ghost on her school. One day through the class window she saw a girl falling from the school roof but she couldn't see anything on the ground. A few days later she saw the same girl falling again from the roof.

Story 3: One day Sanae has a dream about her dead classmate, who was bullied by the whole class, who ask for he

title: Onigami no Sumu Ie
author: Watari, Chie
description:
Story 1: Worried about her brother, Aya decided to visit his fiance house only to discover that there are something strange about the fiance's house that perhaps connected with her brother disappearance.

Story 2: A young boy who is haunted by Franz Liszt ghost.

Story 3: Yurie is haunted by a dream where she witness a murder. The dream is strange because the wound she received in the dream shows up as bruises in real world.

title: G Gai Kitan
author: Tanuma, Yuichiro
description: A mysterious "man" solves mysteries involving the supernatural.

title: Ijou Shitai Kaibou File
author: Ishikawa, Oreo, Tsukasa, Shiori
description:
Forensic pathologist Sayori Somei has the idiosyncratic ability to hear the voices of corpses. However, her daily life is interrupted by a creepy corpse brought to her by Detective Takemoto. And no wonder: that creepy corpse turns out to be a cursed corpse.

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title: Akibattalion: Sen no Shikabane, Natsu, Owari no#
author: Hamazaki, Tatsuya, Yuunagi, Inafune, Keiji

title: Mononoke
author: Niki, Hideyuki
description: A collection of short stories featuring the Medicine Seller during the Edo Period.

title: Sura's Beloved
author: Shin Yuri
description: In the deepest depths of the mountains, there lies a small village where budding physicians learn how to help those in need. It is a place Cho-ah calls home, and he expects to spend the rest of his days there. However, everything changes when a mysterious, heavily wounded man appears out of nowhere. Cho-ah does his best to nurse the stranger back to health, despite the misgivings that his fellow students have about him. The man's name is Mujin, and it soon becomes clear that the only person he t

title: Kamioroshi
author: Sarachi, Yomi, Odou, Akihiko
description: Rumors about love fulfillment charms sold by a Shinto shrine, and the students who came there for an extracurricular activity. Among them were Kuryuu Izumi and Shikiyomi Mikoto. Those two are matchless geniuses among the other students from the same school year but, they always end up exchanging cynical words when they meet each other. Those two's relationship had nothing to do with a love fulfillment charm. The other students were a strange bunch. Believing in the charm's power, and conscious o

title: Naname no Ongaku
author: Kawahara, Yumiko
description:
Guided by the mysterious words "diagonal music," this manga depicts the growth of young girls who participate in aircraft races.

(Source: MU)

title: Nyuukyo Jouken: Tonari ni Sunderu Yuujin to Kanarazu Nakayoku shite Kudasai
author: Akairo, Mash, Nefune, Hayase
description:
"Wanted: People who don't care what happens to their lives! Monthly salary: ¥150,000 *Must live on-site"

With no savings or home left, and wandering aimlessly, Takahiro stumbles upon this job listing—managing an apartment unit as a live-in caretaker. The employment condition: "You must get along with your neighbor." What awaited him was a "neighbor" who clearly isn't human.

"This is a story I heard from a friend..."

Every day, his neighbor tells him "ghost stories"—fictional tales of events t

title: Warashi
author: Terasawa, Daisuke
description: One day, Anko brought her friends to visit her grandmother who lived in a countryside. At night, Anko had a dream about Warashi, a monster whom she had met during her childhood. Next morning, her grandmother gave her an amulet and warned her not to go near the Temple of Dragon. Ignoring the warning, Anko went to the temple and encountered a horrifying evil monster. At the time of life threatening situation, Warashi showed up from the amulet to rescue...

title: Akuma no Juusanya
author: Sone, Masako
description:
Madeline, an 11-year-old girl, lives out of the way in a remote mansion in the woods of southern England with her younger brother Dion, her beautiful mother, and their servant Moira. One day, Madeline meets and befriends some village children. At that time, the gossip was full of rumors of a number of murders in London, said to be the work of a vampire. Whereupon, an eerie shadow creeps into Madeline's peaceful and happy surroundings...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: The Literary Fragment
author: Yoshizawa, Tomoaki, Hanazono, Ran, Abogado Powers
description: While vacationing with his adopted daughter, Private Detective Susuki becomes trapped in a secluded ski resort with a few other vacationers after a storm closes the place down. All is well until one of the guests is found brutally murdered. Being the good investigator he is, Susuki gets to work to find the killer. While digging for the killer, Susuki uncovers a lot of dirt on the other guests and even finds out a thing or two about his own past. But, as Susuki struggles to find the killer, the o

title: Hakuryuu Izayoi den
author: Kamiya, Yuu
description:
Two strange encounter with one unfamiliar name confused Rui. First she unconsciously blurted out when she saw a guy in her school, another time is when she heard a woman cries that unfamiliar name out just right when Rui saw the sword her father who is an archeologist shows it to her. With this sword Rui never know that it could transport her back to the old Japan where her father's troop is having a war with another. 

Note: Included in the back of this manga ,there is also an Omake which is a

title: Ghost Stories Game
author: Mire, Solfa
description:
"Welcome to the game, player."

The story is about a boy named Kang Min who lost his brother due to a game called "Ghost Stories Game." Five years later, he receives a mysterious phone call telling him to participate in the game if he wants to find his brother. After accepting the offer, he begins to encounter various ghost stories. Giving up means death, and the only way to end the game is to reach the ending. Will Kang Min be able to find his brother by reaching the ending?

(Source: Naver Cor

title: Saibou Shinkyoku: Cell of Empireo. - A Certain "0.5"
author: Mushino, Sunagimo, Fukao, Narabu

title: Reikan Shoujo wa Hako no Naka
author: Kouda, Gakuto, Fuyuno, Haruaki

title: Collapsing World
author: Dashu Jiang
description:
This manhua is a collection of short stories by this author. It is almost similar to the German Brothers Grimm's stories. However, these hold no morals but are more of a twisted outlook on life.

(Source: MU)

title: Again
author: Kang, Full
description:
Four years after the incidents of Timing a new mystery arises that presents new dangers to those who are still left alive.

(Source: MU)

title: Golden Darkness
author: Kakizaki, Fumi
description: A collection of 3 short stories involving Espers and the supernatural.

title: Outer Zone: Re:Visited
author: Mitsuhara, Shin
description: The elven-eared Misery is our guide to the Outer Zone, a place where reality and dreams collide (similar to The Outer Limits or The Twilight Zone). Humans, and even animals, sometimes find themselves wandering into this place on the edge of reality. For example, the first story involves a manga assistant who buys a love doll that is more than it seems, and the second is about a poor abandoned cat who is trying to find a way to survive in a cold park. Each chapter focuses on a different encounter

title: Message of Murderous Intent
author: Matsumoto, Yoko
description: When she was young, Shiraishi Masago had a special ability to sense people's feelings and thoughts, but she grew out of it once she moved in with her new family after the tragic death of her own parents.  Or so she thought...  While at school one day, she senses a murderous intent so strong that she faints.  Scared, she tells her friends Shinohara Kei and Hidaka Satoru, who both tell her not to worry.  But when a club member turns up dead at their school festival, she's convinced that what she f

title: Mite Wa Ikenai
author: Imai, Yasue
description: Collection of horror story by Imai Yasue

title: @Baby Mail
author: Yamada, Yuusuke, En, Sachizaki
description: The story happens when females get a text message of baby's cries, they will become pregnant for no reason. Yet, none of them can survive over the first three months into their pregnancy, and strangely, their baby from the womb will also disappear...

title: Rika to Jiraiya
author: Maeda, Toshio
description:
Rika to Jiraiya is a 10 chapter mini-series that tells the story of an old man who, together with the aid of his grandson, seek to protect their village’s lone surviving female from a horde of vengeful zombies. 

(Source: tentaclelounge.wordpress.com)

title: Reconquista
author: Ankoromochi, May-Be Soft, Maezono, Haruka
description:
There is a town on a reclaimed island. It was developed as an international residential area, but it's a ruin now. And there is a rumor that if you walk around there at night, a girl in school uniform will appear and cut off your head....

(Source: Himeya Shop)

title: Fushigi Tsuushin: Toilet no Hanako-san
author: Mogi, Hiromu, Nanjou, Akimasa
description: Every elementary school has lot's of mystery especially about ghost. In this series you will get a different image of mystery that given by another school mystery series.

title: Kuro to Kuro to Shiro no Prunelle
author: Yukina, Funa, Nyalra

12. Toumei Neko
13. Hana Sudare

title: Joou no Rakuin: Horobi no Kuni no Yotogi Miko
author: Katou, Cathy
description:
On Himon Island, where the legend of the Cursed Ancient Princess of Evil—the Immortal Princess—sleeps, shrine maiden Mikoto steps into a forbidden forest. In that very moment, an unprecedented earthquake strikes, awakening the curse...!?

Thus begins the battle of Mikoto and the lecherous Self-Defense Force officer Tatsumi against the cursed Immortal Princess!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Mizuki Shigeru Youkai Collection
author: Mizuki, Shigeru
description:
Collected together for the first time, this Manga boasts all 14 One Shot stories that Mizuki Shigeru drew between 1964-1974.

Until now, each One Shot was long considered impossible to find and were very much sought after on the used comic circuit.

The title of each one shot and its publication date are as follows:

1) Yoka Alaune (妖花アラウネ) (04-01-1968)
2) Genshi-san (原始さん) (10-??-1969)
3) Fuku no Kami (副の神) (12-??-1965)
4) Kaze no Kami (風の神) (07-??-1966)
5) Yosei (妖精) (06-??-1966)
6) Kage Onna

title: Oku no Oku no Mori no Oku ni, Iru
author: Yamada, Yuusuke, Sakina, Haka

title: Morpheus no Kyoushitsu
author: Shiina, You, Mikami, En
description:
In Kishimori Naoto's class, many of his classmates see a classroom in their dream. And the one who were eaten by a monster in their dream won't wake up anymore. Together with his cold childhood friend Kuze Ayano they are trying to solve the mystery that lies behind all those dreams. But, Naoto finds out that only in his dreams there is a door. Ayano feels it's not right to open that door but Naoto.

(Source: Crazy Cake)

title: Kako no Anata wo Yuukai Shimashita
author: Nekoi, Yasuyuki, Aguni, Tsubasa

author: Sakamoto, Isao
description:
1. Akemashite, Goshuushousama desu
2. Yoshiko-chan
3. Kanojo wa Mainichi Tobioriru
4. Watashi ga Ichiban Suki na Sekai
5. Tesou
6. Tenkousei no Sachiko-san

title: Black Alice
author: Nakamura, Satomi
description:
The manga centers on Alice, who might be a friend to humanity, but also might be an enemy. She approaches others about their worries, and helps them to make their wishes come true with magical items. But those with evil in their hearts misuse the items, and their wishes backfire.

(Source: ANN)

Included one-shots:
Volume 1: Beauty Suppli, Itsudemo Issho
Volume 2: Recycle Appli, Kusari Onna
Volume 3: Migawari Appli

title: salacious Prisoner of Grimm's fairy tales
author: Aida, Mayumi
description:
1. Rapunzel
2. Match-uri no Shoujo
3. Pan wo Funda Musume
4. Shinigami no Nazukeoya
5. Amefurashi
6. Kindan no Tobira

title: Oni Otoshi
author: Uguisu, Sachiko
description:
When your wife starts to cook with a lot of enthusiasm even though it is not an anniversary... Be careful, because it is a signal for the "Oni-no-Oshiro" ritual.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: The Beauty in the Haunted Temple
author: Nie, Chongrui
description:
A young painter traveling around decides to have a rest in ruins of a temple. Everything is so beautiful, so quiet. But at night, these ruins become the kingdom of a devilish grandmother, who uses the beauty of a young woman to trap people. And then the worst may arrive…

(Source: MU)

title: Aka Ihon to Kuro Ihon
author: Hokazono, Masaya, Noroi, Michiru, Thyme
description:
1-4. Boku no Ie [Thyme]
5. Birabira [Noroi Michiru]
6. Jigoku Fujoshi [Noroi Michiru]

title: Shiryou no Hanayome
author: Watari, Chie
description:
1. Shiryou no Hanayome
For years he has been searching for his missing bride, and finally he finds her - a beautiful bride in a red kimono.

2. Ma o Yobu Ie
A house that always bring misfortune. [The same house from the 2nd story in Yuganda Kishi]

3. Yuuyake no Requiem
It's beautiful... a red sunset, big and round... a miserable sunset...

title: Shin Karura Mau!
author: Nagakubo, Takakazu
description:
Caught in the conflict between the Mikogami Family and the Kuroe Family, twin sisters Maiko and Shouko will need to use the full extent of their supernatural abilities and investigational skills to uncover the truth behind a bizarre demonic ritual disguised as a murder in Wakayama Prefecture.

(Source: MU)

title: Seki Yoshimi Horror Collection
author: Seki, Yoshimi
description: A collection of Yoshimi Seki's horror one-shots.

title: King's Prophet
description: A king visits an isolated temple to search for a prophet.

title: Yuurei na Kanojo to Shinrei na Boku
author: Nangoku, Banana
description:
Cameraman Genji is someone who loves ghosts and the supernatural but he can't see nor feel them! He wants to someday capture them on camera, so he moves into a place that might be haunted. He gets lucky, there is a female ghost around his age who had died in his new place. Ever since he was able to get a photo of himself and the ghost, he now wants to get to know her as a potential girlfriend! But is this ghost enthusiast too much for her to handle!?

(Source: LuffyNoTomo)

title: After Zero
author: Okazaki, Jirou
description:
Short fantasy, science fiction, or horror stories, often concluding with an eerie or unexpected twist.

(Source: MU)

title: Haunted Campus
author: Kushiki, Riu, Yamauchi, Shizu
description:
The story follows Mototsu Yagami, a college student who can see ghosts but doesn't want to. In college, he meets Koyomi Nada, who was his junior in high school. Out of unrequited love for her, he follows her into the "occult research society," which is full of eccentrics who fill their campus life with the occult.

(Source: ANN)

title: Marika
author: Kuroda, Minoru, Koide, Sachiko
description:
Marika Hana's dog Bobby is killed by a mysterious being in the middle of the night. Around the dog's body were mysterious white stones that Marika's father had seen before high in the mountains. This is the story of the strange and supernatural goings-on that follow.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Namidako-sama no Iutoori
author: Yamamoto, Lunlun
description:
In the early Showa period, the story begins when a young girl is found dead in a creek in Tokyo. Officer Sawatari, the police officer in charge of the investigation into the body, catches the eye of one Namidako Inukai, the founder of a new religious organization.

(Source: ANN)

title: Harapeko na Majou: Saty to Parvati
author: Isoya, Yuki
description:
A dark fantasy about two witches who are trying to fit in with regular humans even though they have an appetite for something quite unusual...

(Source: Clairparfait)

title: Silhouette of Darkness
author: Knife, Senno
description: Follows the case files of Professor Kinkakuji and his sidekick Midori who specialize in dealing with supernatural mysteries.

title: Perfect Blue: Awaken from a Dream
author: Takeuchi, Yoshikazu
description:
Delve deeper into the dark underbelly of super-stardom, where fame comes at a steep price. In this sequel anthology to the hit psychological thriller, Perfect Blue, creepy fans thrust their idols into struggles of life and death. Gruesome body switches, bloody fan letters, and a stalker in a terrifying rabbit costume–it’s a life of fame and misfortune that lies in wait for these hapless pop stars.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kokuyou no Ayumi
author: Mizuki, Sora
description:
The people in this town are hiding something... Asahi, the protagonist, has returned to her hometown for the first time in seven years. She is excited to see her beloved childhood friend Haruhiko after such a long time. Nervous about her first day at the new school, Asahi sees something terrifying outside the window...

(Source: COMICSMART, translated)

title: Jashin Sensen Restructuring Boy
author: Kikuchi, Hideyuki, Hosoma, Shinichi
description:
In order to repair the synergy that was distorted by the evil deities in the ancient past, a young boy named Shuri has appeared in the present day. But the evil deities have set the "Groundskeepers" in place to stop him.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Kagami no Naka no Yami
author: Takahashi, Miyuki
description:
Story 1: Natsumi always sees an apparition of a monk in her house that scared her. One day a shadow holding a scythe started to follow and target her.

Story 2: Ever since she was a kid, Hayasaka Rumi always have a hunch when something dangerous about to happen to her. Her gradma said that those hunch is an ability that is granted to each 1st child of Hayasaka family by a tengu.

Story 3: Lately Kumiko often have a strange and sad dream about someone who was crying and called out to her.

Story

title: Shagara
author: Haraguchi, Kiyoshi
description:
Chisato walks into a store only to find all the people inside have been turned into something absolutely frightening! Her ESP's summoned a mad monster known as "Shagara!" Get ready for a healthy serving of some sci-fi violence horror!

(Source: Manga Reborn)

title: Yomizuka no Kaii-san
author: Midorikawa, You, HIJIKI
description:
Yomizuka Junior High School is in a rural town. In it is a strange school club called the Mystery Verification Club. The club has two members: Toramaru, who has chuunibyou, and Miko, who is more normal. But their club activities, which began out of mere curiosity, eventually begin to involve all kinds of people...?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Semi wa Taiji ni Kisei suru
author: Dr.Poro
description:
Yuri Tachiba, doctor by profession. She came to a small, isolated island separated by the sea to research a certain insect. There is only one way to escape these insects which parasitize people and invariably take their lives after a few years...

(Source: Shounen Gahousha, translated)

title: Rokushiki Tensou Ataraxia
author: Kago, Shintarou
description:
Shigure Konno is getting bullied in class. One day, however, she leaves her physical body and is able to enter the world of spirit. Shigure can now look inside people's minds, discover their innermost secrets and even manipulate them... When the seeds of trouble sown in the hearts of good citizens blossom, bizarre incidents will happen...

(Source: Mangadex)

title: Tel Me Terumi Tell Me: Jagged Fuzzed D.N.A.
author: Saki, Hiroto, Okada, Tai
description: "Time is complete".  When the star of misfortune falls, a door to a new world will begin to open.  Rumors of man-eating goats...continuous murder crimes, one after the other more and more cases appear.  Soon Terumi, a high school student who has lived his life in relative peace, will soon start on his road to his destiny.

title: Shishou Series: Shishou to Boku to
author: Takauchi, Yuuga
description: A gag comedy based on Uni's horror manga Shishou Series.

title: Undead King
author: Yoon, Joon-shik, Baek, Ji-woon
description:
In a post-apocalyptic world, a group called the Nemesis infected the country with a contagion that transformed the population into flesh-eating zombies. A mysterious man known as the Undead King tries to fight back with a group of survivors and supernatural creatures called gangshi. A young high school boy finds himself drawn into this fight and struggles to stay alive while also trying to protect a young girl ganshi named Yoo Yoo that was left in his care.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Hengen Taima Yakou Shin Karura Mau!
author: Nagakubo, Takakazu
description:
Under the blessing of an entity known as Karura, twin sisters Maiko and Shouko investigate supernatural cases and fight against ghosts and demons using the powers of the Holy Book and the Earth Book. They usually receive help from their known colleagues, such as exorcist Yami no Shiguruto.

(Source: MU)

title: Haiiro no Iris
author: Iwata, Hiroki, Satou, Toshiyuki, Touto, Seiro

title: The Dog that Barks Inside
author: Lee, Sunee, Geumgi
description:
Jeongwoo has been unable to sleep for a while now—ever since a ghost started showing up at 3 am every morning, biting its nails. Upon seeing this ghost, Jeongwoo is unable to go back to sleep. He struggles and battles with this lack of sleep as well as his fear. Trying to backtrack, in order to pinpoint the moment when all of this started, he recalls the incident that happened when he had drinks with his childhood friend Heewon...

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: Haunted Tales
author: Jinmi
description: Yang Gidam, a freshman at Soleum College, has always been fascinated by and drawn to the occult. It is only natural, then, that he finds himself joining the on-campus Ghost Story Club. Unbeknownst to him, however, his involvement in such activities has already been noticed by Seo Neul-Ham, an upperclassman with a cold aura who can see ghosts. One day, as if by fate, the two become entangled and are drawn into a spooky turn of events. How will this unlikely pair fare when the ghost stories that Y

title: Banhyang: The Remote Island
author: Piggy
description:
Sehim's field trip to Banhyang Island takes an ominous turn when a fierce storm leaves everyone stranded. As three students inexplicably vanish amidst the storm, Sehim and his friends scramble to find out why. But, their desperate efforts only seem to drag them deeper into the island's sinister secrets— every revelation intensifying the chilling forces lurking on the island, their chances of leaving the island seem uncertain by the day.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Itomo Tayasuku Okonawareru Juusansai ga Ikiru Tame no Oshigoto
author: Saiga, Ryuu, Shokachuu
description:
The work is a crime story that portrays a 13-year-old serial killer, Shoutarou, whose job is to kill. A young man, Akito, whose sister was killed by a small group, one day met with Shoutarou and finally helped with his work. After learning about Shoutarou's work, Akito asks him to find the people who killed his sister and get rid of them.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Spoonman
author: Asada, Torao
description:
Spoonman, Rain, and Sunny - three people with unspeakable pasts. This hardboiled story chronicles their journey South for their various goals.

(Source: MU)

title: Horror Collector
author: Satou, Midori
description: The internet is full of creepypastas, cryptid sightings, tales of paranormal activity, and unsolved disappearances. These are mostly rumors and pranks fueled by trolls—entertainment. But the unlucky few learn the hard way that some legends are true. Many of these unfortunate souls are doomed, but their luck may change if they cross paths with the boy in the red hood. He roams from town to town and appears wherever strange things occur. Is he a light in the dark? Or living proof that monsters are

title: Gyeongseong Creature: The Unwithering Flower
author: Mo.I
description: A mystery hangs over the remote island of Manwol. The locals have all perished after being turned into monsters in an experiment by the imperial army. But Geumran, a young deaf girl, inexplicably survives, recovering her hearing and gaining incredible strength. Though she kills all of the soldiers in cold blood, Geumran soon learns that the same fate that befell the villagers awaits her too. Finding those responsible for the experiments thus becomes her only hope for survival... and vengeance.

title: Genshi-san
author: Mizuki, Shigeru
description:
1. Genshi-san
2. Reigata Shuujutsu
3. Tatari

author: Minatuki, Tunami
description:
He was my love at first sight in the convenience store. "Sure, once it's summer, I can go out with you," he said. Summer love? Wouldn't it be exhilarating?! Yes, it is certainly exciting in many ways... Maybe with a few tears.

(Source: Torico)

title: Hitomi no Oku ni Sumu Mono wa
author: Shimousa, Kunio
description: A man's past comes back to haunt him.

title: Series Itsuki
description: Collection of stories revolving around a young high school student by the name of Itsuki with mysterious psychic powers who helps people change their destinies.

title: Hokenshitsu no Akumu
author: Shigaki, Mayumi
description:
Consist of 4 horror story:

1. A group of boys test their courage by walking alone in cemetery complex. At first they only want to scare one of the boy a bit but it turn to something much fatal and scary.

2. The school infirmary is famous for its ghost stories so Matsumoto was a bit afraid when she has to spend the morning resting there because of anemia. Then instead of seeing any ghost she saw mice, mice and a lot of mice.

3. Yamagishi met a new transfer student and they become a close frien

title: Kaiki Tantei Sharaku Homura
author: Nemoto, Shou
description:
In Shimoyama Middle School, the Experiment Club and Karate Club each only have one member left, and as a result, must share one classroom. These two students, Homura Sharaku and Yousuke Yamazaki (a.k.a Karate Kid) together solve numerous impossible mysteries that they happen to run into!

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Jack o' Lantern
author: Seki, Ayumu
description:
In a 19th-century Irish orphanage, children are succumbing one after another to a deadly epidemic. Realizing her own time is near, Coco flees with nowhere to go. On her escape, she is taken in by Jack-o'-Lantern, a devil from folklore passed down through myth.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kajiba no Majo
author: Koishi, Chikasa
description:
The detective Kasumi and her human assistant Atori find themselves pursuing a case that involves the disappearance of multiple young girls. What happened to them, nobody knows—yet.

(Source: MU)

title: Odoronbaa
author: Hino, Hideshi
description:
The mask of Hannya, a jealous she-devil located in an old antique store, scrutinizes the darkness of men's hearts and knows the secrets of all the objects that have been accumulating there since time immemorial. Prepare well because certain death comes at odd times, and whether you are a young man or a tired old man, whatever she finds you, she will take you with her to hell.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Mogami-ke no Kijitsu
author: Sakai, Kaori
description:
On a cold winter night, the siblings return to their parents’ home after learning that Ginji, the second son of five siblings, has died.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Miren no Tonbo
author: Saitou, Ryouga
description:
Exterminating an enormous infestation of dragonflies. He thought his first job as a psychic's assistant was an odd job unrelated to spirits.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Hijuumura
author: Munakata, Kaoru, Shiroki, Ren
description:
Takuya and Miki return to their hometown for a friend's wedding anniversary, but as they arrive, Takuya receives a call from their friends, whom they were unable to contact through the whole trip. Due to bad reception, they can't understand what's been said, but only the words "help" and "Hijuumura" are clearly heard. Since the police isn't of any help, Takuya and Miki leave to rescue their friends, but soon find out that that was place not meant to be entered...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

author: Yoshikawa, Utata
description: Follows the comical supernatural adventures of 4 roommates, Toudou Shinobu, Saiga Kunimitsu, Nagumo Kazuharu & Kitashiro Mitsugu who all live in haunted Shinonome dorm.

title: Shin Sukkuto Kitsune
author: Yoshikawa, Utata
description: Takes place 3 years after the end of Sukkuto Kitsune. Jikka & Tonau have twins, a boy named Tasuku and a girl named Kirie.

title: Akumu no Shoutaijou
author: Nekojima, Rei, Ootsuka, Akira
description:
There exists a shop called The Dream's Invitation, where any soul in need can come by and have anything they wished for. Every single person who sets foot inside the shop is guaranteed to get any item needed to solve their problem. However, the payment for those items are either the soul of their loved ones, or even their own...

(Source: Elex Media Komputindo, translated)

title: Dollhouse
author: Totsuno, Takahide, Yaguchi, Shinobu
description:
Yoshie, who lost her daughter in an unexpected accident, encounters a certain doll at an antique market. She dotes on the doll as if it were her real daughter, and her emotional wounds gradually begin to heal. However, when the couple has a new daughter, the doll starts to unravel their family’s happiness.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Kigoku no Yoru
author: Katou, Cathy
description:
In an isolated village, there dwells a demon that devours people and rapes women to death...! What was supposed to have been a fun excursion for childhood friends turns into a hellish landscape when they stumble upon a cursed abandoned village.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Nagaraja

description:
This world is ruled by the Dragon King. As the fish in the river were dying due to the dragon's blood, a virgin girl is offered up as a sacrifice to the Dragon King. As our heroes set out to investigate, they discover something sinister and inhuman...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

In this unbelievable paradise where strange events unfold, and the shocking occult thriller experienced by the protagonist Yeongdo, who finds himself there.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

Hayato comes from Tokyo to the village to accompany his friend Takumi on a trip back home, but he feels something is off about the villagers' strange cold demeanor... Takumi's grandmother warmly welcomes him, and in the middle of a peaceful dinner, the moment she says "you have brought the Buddha closer," Takumi's face changes color and disappears that night. From there, Hayato becomes embroiled in a s

title: Kyou no Hon
author: Takaminato, Motosuke
description: These are the scary stories that are going on around us. Horror stories that make the hair stand up and afraid to look back. Be careful of you with dark corners, dimly lit rooms, relics and other mysterious things. Prepare with terror at night...

title: Dakini
author: Omi, Ayuko
description:
Ever since she lost her parents in a fire two years ago, Natsuki has been seeing horrible nightmares, where an unknown boy pierced by tree roots calls out to someone named "Dakini"... Meanwhile, students around her start dying... What has Natsuki forgotten?!

(Source: Manga Reborn)

Volume 1: Mou Ichido Natsujikan

"Makina-san, let's play." After chanting these words and tapping the card three times, a mysterious yet beautiful vengeful spirit named Makina-san will appear.

An ordinary highschooler named Ryousuke Togawa investigates the haunting that has been troubling his best friend. In the face of the menacing spirit, he does the charm taught by his upperclassman, Nishijima. Suddenly, Nishijima herself appears from thin air, declaring she is Makina-san.

(Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

title: Kyoufu no Kuchibashi
author: Koga, Shinichi
description:
Saori grew up in a family with a crazy custom of feeding dead family members to crows. One day, Saori mistakenly believes that her only best friend, Kiyo, has betrayed her and dies in an accident. Saori's resentment turns into a swarm of creepy crows that begin to attack Kiyo and her classmates..!

Murder is in the air, a mystery's trail is marked with feathers and it's quickly running cold. Cheolmin Han is an office worker who suspects that he's losing his mind...or is he seeing the truth for the very first time? Who are these bird-faced, bloodthirsty creatures he's confronted with? Why are they hunting him? Where do they come from? What do they want? Who will believe him? Most importantly, how will he survive?

Commit a sin, and a "bug" attaches to you!

Misao is a young boy who can see the "bugs" that attach themselves to people who have committed sins.
Small bugs for minor sins, large bugs for grave sins...

Through these bugs, Misao is able to measure the weight of a person's sins. However, he gradually begins to see bugs that defy these rules, and at the same time, strange incidents start occurring around him...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Chimidoro Yakata
author: Hino, Hideshi
description:
Next door to a peaceful and happy family is a creepy western style mansion that everyone calls the "Ghost House." Children go missing, and a strange family moves into the "Ghost House." Is there any relation between this family and the missing children...?

(Source: MU)

When he was a child, Hideki Tahara had a chance encounter with "Bogiwan," a monster feared by his late grandfather. Now that he is a working adult with a family, a formless visitor appears... When he is confronted by a junior coworker who loses his arm, uncanny phenomena at home, and unseen horrors, what he clings to is...

With almost no budget, he'd resorted to digging through back issues and unused research material, looking for inspiration. As he did, a terrifying truth began to emerge about a certain place in the Kinki region. I have collected the relevant articles, interviews, and other materials in this book. And once you have understood everything, I would like to ask for your coo

title: Generation Tank
author: Adachi, Tsuyoshi
description:
When a comet strikes the earth and a mysterious disease starts to kill off humanity, bugs rise from the earth and begin the extermination of mankind. Now it's up to those left alive to fight back against the horde.

(Source: MU)

title: Meiko no Asobiba
author: Okada, Sakumo
description:
Set in 1973, the story depicts the "dangerous games" played by Meiko, a young girl who possesses a mysterious eye. Meiko uses this eye's power to complete certain "jobs" with her father.

(Source: Comic Natalie, translated)

title: Shinde Hanami ga Sakihokoru
author: Kuroe, Yui, Rairaku, Rei
description:
Sakurasuke Hanazaki lost his family in a fire when he was young and has been alone in the world ever since. He was taken in by the distant relatives of the Haruhara family and lives with Haruhara's parents and siblings, Yoichi and Yomari, as if they were his real family. One day, at the summer festival at a shrine where he went with Yoichi and Yomari, they are attacked by mysterious creatures created by a young man named Manshu who kills people...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Moguland
author: Mizu Potato
description:
Mogu decides to join his childhood friend for a resort part-time job on Mongura Island. Although he is disgusted by the domineering attitude of the other participants, what he is more concerned about are the holes of the mysterious flesh-eating moles all over the island, the eerie spider lilies, and the smiling islanders. What is the true nature of the fear that suddenly attacks the participants from underground, where they cannot see even 1mm ahead? Terror is coming from beneath.

(Source: Coam

description:
For Na-Young, school was her only haven from her harsh home life. However, that was only before these "things" appeared one night in school.

Touko Ozawa wakes up inside an unfamiliar ship. Her memory is hazy, and there is a needle mark on her arm. There, she encounters two young people, Chisato Mikanagi and Hitomi Mikami. What they have in common is that they have no memory of how they got there. Inside a ship echoing with the sounds of inhuman footsteps and the eerie cries of "Gitagido Detaderaba...", who exactly took them and for what purpose...? In search of answers, the youths begin their exploration.

Yamamoto, who works in a convenience store, has developed feelings for a girl who comes to order steamed meat buns every day. At the same time, he starts to get pranked by the neighbor opposite his house. Where will his feelings take him?

Argie Mirage, a boy who carries the past of his family's death at the hands of a Gundam, meets Volco Warren, a boy who wishes to rebuild the Gundam his family left behind.

To destroy a Gundam. To rebuild a Gundam. In the midst of the two boys' intersecting fates, the Astaroth will awaken from its 300 year slumber

description: This is another story in the Full Metal Panic universe, set some years after the events with Sousuke and Kaname. Ichinose Tatsuya is a pretty normal high school boy, who lives with his father and little sister Yukari. He has a tendency to fall in love with foreign women, which has never turned out well for him. One day, while up in the mountains driving a Power Slave to help out with his father's company, he runs into yet another beautiful foreign woman, called Adelina. He lends her a hand and i

title: Asura Cryin'
author: Akizuki, Ryou, Mikumo, Gakuto
description:
The main character, Natsume Tomoharu, takes the opportunity to live on his own when he enters high school. Although he appears to be a normal high school student at first glance, there is one thing about him which isn't normal. He's haunted by the ghost of a young girl, Minakami Misao.

Tomoharu moves to his new place of residence, Meioutei, and starts enjoying a carefree high school life. But this is all ruined when a beautiful girl named Kurosaki Shuri appears with a trunk which Tomoharu's bro

title: Aldnoah.Zero Gaiden: Twin Gemini
author: Satake, Kiyokazu
description: Around the same time Slaine and Trillram went down to New Awara where Inaho and the others were, up at Sapporo, Hokkaido, twin Martian Knights sisters who pilot a Kataphrakt unit from the Vers Empire were landing in the town where the twin siblings Mizuki and Haruya Mikage live...

title: Buster Dress
author: Sadamatsu, Ryuuichi
description:
At the end of the 22nd century, the human race has created a new colony called Second Earth. After a mysterious terrorist attack, a unit made up of Buster Dress, an incredibly intelligent A.I. mech, have been deployed to investigate. Haruto Aoi, along with his BDD-223 Gunhawk embark on a journey to solve this mystery.

(Source: MU)

title: Asura Cryin'
author: Mikumo, Gakuto, Watanuki, Nao
description:
Natsume Tomoharu is a normal high-school student in every way with one exception: he's being followed by the ghost of his best friend, Misao.

After moving into his brother's old house, Tomoharu expects to continue living his normal life but is one day left with a mysterious and locked briefcase without any instruction. At first he plans to leave it in storage, however his house is soon invaded by multiple groups of people after the briefcase. Although still not knowing the purpose of the briefc

title: Kakumeiki Valvrave
author: Tsuchiya, Karegashi
description:
True Calendar (T.C.) 71 - A new age where 70% of the human population lives in space thanks to the development of "Dyson Sphere", a city in space.

The world is divided into two main powers: The Dorssia Military Pact Federation, a power which grew out of a military alliance, and the Atlantic Rim United States (ARUS), which grew in power as it expanded its trade agreements. The minor nation of JIOR has declared neutrality between these two forces and maintains its peace through economic prosperit

title: Jinki:Extend
author: Tsunashima, Shirou
description: Akao Hiiragi lives in Japan, and she has lost her entire memory except for three years ago. But one day she meets a mysterious man named Ryouhei who tells her that she is a "cognate;" a person with special powers that enable them to pilot robots called Jinki. All across the world, a mysterious phenomenon is occurring, known as the "Lost Life Phenomenon," where an entire town is destroyed from a series of mysterious nuclear-like explosions. Akao discovers that this is not a natural phenomenon, an

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam 00I
author: Tokita, Kouichi
description: A Gundam 00 side story. Planned to replace 00F in Gundam Ace. The story focuses on Innovades and Innovators.

title: Seigi Keikan Monju
author: Miyashita, Hiroki
description: Monju, the last representative of the Japanese police force, can not believe his circuits! He has been assigned to a police station in a rural area. Aside of being forced to team up with Junpei Yamagashi, a young police officer obsessed with women and whether or not he's balding, he also needs to defend himself against hostility towards him. When a perverted voyeur gets reported the robot places his suspicions immediately on his partner. But Junpei won't stand for the accusations and is determin

title: Love Fighter Shuravan
author: Aoki, Hayato
description:
In near future, humanity discovered incredible ore with unlimited energy, "Iliosdaite." In ten years since its discovery that core energy became an alternate fuel supporting the whole world. But, a lot of Monsters and evil organizations were eager to get their hands on Iliosdaite. That's when a Hero rose up to protect the peace. His name was... Love Fighter Shuravan.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Gundam Legacy
author: Natsumoto, Masato
description: A series of short stories that take place between Universal Century 0079 to 0093. The stories jump around to different characters and side stories that take place from the original Gundam and up through Char's Counterattack.

title: Gate Keepers
author: Gotou, Keiji, Yamaguchi, Hiroshi, Gonzo
description:
After attacked by an alien, saved by a girl, and discovers he has extraordinary powers, Shun Ukiya has had a hell of first day of school. Realizing what this new power is all about soon becomes one of the less important things that threaten Earth. 

(Source: ANN)

title: Heat Guy J
author: Ogishima, Chiaki
description:
Daisuke Aurora works with the special division of peacekeepers in the city of Jewde, one of the largest cities on the planet. He and his android partner, Heat Guy J, team up to make sure that anything illegal stays off the streets and out of circulation.

However, their presence doesn't sit too well with the local mob leader—a ruthless, unbalanced, well-armed son of the late Don, who is out to prove that he is not too young to take over the family business. In the city that never sleeps, will Da

title: All-Purpose Cultural Cat-Girl Nuku Nuku
author: Takada, Yuuzo
description: Atsuko Natsume is the most popular girl at Futaba University. But she has a secret. She is Cat-brained Android created Kyusaku Natsume. Created to showcase his genius. Atsuko known as Nuku-Nuku protects Kyusaku and his son Ryunoske from the machinations of Mishima Heavy Industries. Also a side story set during the OVA Universe.

title: Kidou Senshi Z Gundam Define
author: Kitazume, Hiroyuki
description: Ensign Reccoa Londe has provided the AEUG with information regarding possible mobile suit development at the civilian colonies of Green Noa. Lieutenant Quattro (Char Aznable) with his wingmen Lieutenant JGs Apolly (Andy) and Roberto (Ricardo) head to the colony to investigate. On Green Noa 1, Kamille Bidan is rushing to the spaceport where the Temptation, a ship a former One Year War ace is on, is docking. He's hoping to get an autograph from the famed Captain Bright Noa. As Bright explains that

title: Robot Izonkei Joshi no Meewaku na Nichijou
author: Kawada, Akio

title: To Make This World A Flower
author: Kazumi, Yoshiyuki
description:
Continuation of Konohana with a different main cast.

Ryotaro is a boy who loves robots and lives out in the country with his three sisters but he's headed to Tokyo for high school. Before leaving, he runs across a humanoid military robot and has a fateful encounter with its pilot, a cute teenage girl who calls herself La Vie en Rose. Ryotaro will almost certainly meet her again in Tokyo, considering his family connection to the production of these humanoid robots--his father worked with them.

title: Developers: Kidou Senshi Gundam - Before One Year War
author: Yamazaki, Housui
description:
Years before the One Year War, Zionic Co. was developing a new type of piloted robots (later became Mobile Suits) using thermonuclear reactor shielded with Minovsky particles as the power source. For safety and secrecy reasons, the project was outsourced to Hosioka, a small steelworks which looked ridiculously lousy at the first sight.

(Source: ANN)

title: Psalms of Planets Eureka seveN: New Order
author: Oonogi, Hiroshi, Miyama, Fugin
description: An alternate retelling of the end of Eureka seveN, in which Eureka attempts to give her memories to the Scub Coral, to prevent the breaching of the Limit of Questions.

title: Code Geass: Fukkatsu no Lelouch
author: Ogasawara, Tomofumi, Taniguchi, Koujirou
description:
The long-awaited "Resurrection" arc of the "definitive" version of the Code Geass manga has started!

Lelouch and Suzaku have finally accomplished Zero Requiem. What awaits them beyond the peace that the boys risked their lives to build...!? The story begins with a completely original story that depicts the blank period until the resurrection!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Mazinger Angel
author: Nagai, Go, Niina, Akihiko
description:
Mazinger Angels chronicles the adventures of four women who pilot giant robots in the Mazinger vein. The concept is a spoof on the late 70's and early 80's popular TV series Charlie's Angels.

Three of the robots, Aphrodite A, Diana A and Minerva X are from the original Mazinger Z series, while Venus A is from the Great Mazinger series. Their pilots are also traditional characters from Go Nagai's universe, Sayaka Yumi and Jun Hono from Mazinger Z and Great Mazinger respectively, and Hikaru Makib

title: Heroic Age
author: Warabino, Kugeko
