author: Oomori, Kouzou
description:
A collection of three stories that showcase some events of Char Aznable's past and the men fighting around him.

1. Char Senyou Zaku II vs. Rick-Dias (Zaku II Char Aznable Personal Use vs. Rick Diaz)
2. Ryousangata Zaku vs. Gundam (Mass Production Type Zaku vs. Gundam)
3-5. Char Senyou Zugokku vs. GM (Z'Gok Char Aznable Personal Use vs. GM)

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam AGE: Tsuioku no Sid
author: Yatate, Hajime, Tomino, Yoshiyuki, Nakanishi, Hiroshi
description:
In A.G. 151, the space pirates "Bisidian" have taken advantage of war to extend their power. The Bisidian are associated with Ract Elfamel who supports them in finding the treasure. Once they have located the treasure, Captain Angrazzo ordered his son, Wivik Lambro, to come up a strategy to retrieve the treasure Bisidian has been looking for for some time, but when he infiltrates a certain asteroid in pursuit, who should be lying in wait but federation veteran Largan Drace's platoon! 

(Source:

title: Vandread: The Second Stage
author: Akane, Kotetsu, Mori, Takeshi, Kuroda, Kazuya
description: Though Hibiki and crew defeated a super-huge battleship of the earth in the last of the first stage, they noticed five battleships further aiming at Mejeiru and Tarahk. And, crew of Nirvana learnt Tarahk and Mejeiru which were their home had been faced to the crisis of Karitori (reaping). Travel to their home is speed up so that they may inform of the crisis. On the way, current information of the earth having been brought by girl Misty who had come to travel with them was worse than they can im

title: Buddy Spirits
author: Kuroiwa, Yoshihiro, Kishimoto, Miyuki, gyuo
description:
In 202X, robots have become essential partner for humans. One day, a silver security robot went out of control regardless of its emergency shutdown and people were in panic. The robot military unit "SARF" established in the metropolitan police begins their mission!

(Source: Hero's web)

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam Unicorn: Bande Dessinee - Episode:0
author: Fukui, Harutoshi, Oomori, Kouzou
description:
The prequel manga is based on the "Sengo no Sensou" (The Postwar War) short story that appears in the 11th volume of Harutoshi Fukui's original Mobile Suit Gundam UC novels. The story centers on the Neo Zeon remnants' hijacking of the Sinanju Stein mobile suit.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title: Valvrave the Liberator: Under Taker
author: Kansai, Ryouji
description:
Spin-off of Kakumeiki Valvrave.

The protagonist is Hinomoto Jin, jealous towards his classmate Haruto for his ability to control the Valvrave. He and Ota Nao, a beautiful and popular second year student who lacks confidence in herself, become the pilots of a Kagerou, a unit based on Valvrave II, under L-Elf's commands.

title: Beast Wars Neo: Super Lifeform Transformers
description:
On a primitive planet with fauna similar to Terran dinosaurs and Ice Age critters, one of the angolmois energy capsules spread by the explosion of the Nemesis has affected the locals. A gang of evil dinosaurs have been transformed into Destrons, and a battered Lioconvoy is too injured to stop them. So he transfers his energy into a mammoth named Big, charging him with continuing the good fight. 
(Source: Dave's Transformers Page).

Contains 9 manga chapters and 3 text stories.

author: Shiki, Satoshi
description:
A "reprint + epilogue" of an older Shiki Satoshi work.
Future, 2018: courier Kamikaze and terrorist group L-Mess contend for "Shepard", a cyborg.

title: Front Mission - The Drive
author: Ootagaki, Yasuo
description:
One of Two Manga's Based on Square Enix's Strategy RPG Series

"Front Mission"

title: Baldr Sky Dive1 "Lost Memory"
author: Tanaka, Kouji
description: The manga adaptation of the Baldr Sky Dive1.

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam MS Boys: Bokutachi no Zeon Dokuritsu Sensou
author: Takayama, Mizuho
description:
Universal Century, October 0079. Kurt Blatt volunteered for the Principality of Zeon forces and with the sergeant Alexei were assigned to the engineering battalion. They believed that Zeon would win but have just been through the Battle Of Odessa.

(Source: Gundam Wikia)

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam AGE: Climax Hero
author: Takamisaki, Ryou

title: Submarine Super 99
author: Matsumoto, Leiji
description:
In the future the world is taken over by the Ocean Empire. The Earth's only hope lies with the Super 99, a submarine designed by Dr. Juzou Oki.

The story follows Susumu Oki, the chief mechanic of the SS-99 and the adventures he and the other crew members take on the SS-99 to save Earth. 

(manga-updates)

title: Transformers: The Battle of Star Gate
description:
Near the end of the 20th century, the Transformers form an alliance with the humans. Together they start to develop a large transportation gate named "Trigger" as a symbol of amicability. However, the Decepticons have their eyes on the gate, and so does somebody else. 
(Source: Transformers Wiki)

title: Mobile Suit Gundam: Operation:Troy
author: Yatate, Hajime, Kondo, Kazuhisa
description:
The story of Kidou Senshi Gundam: Operation:Troy opens with the space colonists' brutal battle for independence from The Earth Federation. Advanced ECM has rendered range sensors and communications useless, resulting in the rise of new war machines called mobile suits. These ultimate instruments of destruction, capable of metal-clashing hand-to-hand combat, completely redefine modern warfare.

(Source: Gundam Wikia)

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: MS Senki Reboot
author: Kondo, Kazuhisa
description:
Frederik Brown is a mobile suit trainee in one of Zeon's schools, but always had a hard time keeping up with everyone. Ten months after training hard, he's thrust into actual combat for the first time together with Zeon's declaration of war. He becomes witness to the horrors and atrocities associated with war first hand as he fights to stay alive.

(Source: zeonic-republic.net)

title: Danball Senki Wars
author: Fujii, Hideaki
description: Year 2055, 4 years after the events in Danball Senki W. LBXs have become the world's largest hobby, big enough for pro leagues to be established, and people to make their entire living off being an LBX player. 14-year-old Arata is a new transfer student at Kamui Daimon Integrated Academy on Kamui Island, near Japan. Known to be the most prestigious institution in the world for raising LBX players and mechanics, entrance to the academy requires an extremely competitive hurdle of being the champio

title: Super Robot Taisen OG: The Inspector - Record of ATX
author: Yatsufusa, Tatsunosuke
description:
It's been six months since the L5 Campaign, the conflict that pitted humanity and aliens with the whole earth sphere at stake. Now that the true threat is gone the remains from old conflicts that have kept discord among people from even before the aliens arrived have started to resurface and thus the fight is far from over...

(Source: MU)

title: Rakuen Tsuihou: Expelled from Paradise
author: Urobuchi, Gen, Yasugi, Masayoshi
description:
In a future where a massive disaster has devastated Earth, most of humanity has abandoned their physical bodies and relocated in digital form to DEVA, an advanced space station orbiting the ravaged planet. Free from the limitations of traditional existence, such as death and hunger, the inhabitants of this virtual reality reside in relative peace until Frontier Setter, a skilled hacker, infiltrates the system and spreads subversive messages to the populace.

Labeled a threat to security by autho

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam Burai
author: Isobe, Kazuma
description:
The people are tormented by the Onikigumi, a group of thugs who act as pawns for the shogunate, collecting money in a manner similar to extortion, and the existence of the mysterious "Iron Machine Hunters" who target the iron machines of these evildoers has become a hot topic of conversation. The story begins when wanderer Kotetsu Kisaragi meets Suzuno, the daughter of an iron machine smith, and witnesses the evil deeds of the Onikigumi, who threaten her home.

(Source: Gundam Wiki)

title: Busou Shinki
author: Kuga, Boncho, Kametani, Kyouko, Arai, Teruko, Akiya, Yukie
description:
An original story building upon the Busou Shinki franchise.

In 2039, following an accidental death, a 15 cm high female robot appears in front of the detective responsible for the case. She begins looking into the hidden truth behind the incident.

title: Gundam Pilot Retsuden: Soukyuu no Yuusha-tachi
author: Yatate, Hajime, Tomino, Yoshiyuki, Oki, Hajime
description:
Chronicles the lives of four prominent pilots of the Principality of Zeon before and during the One Year War.

(Source: Gundam Wiki)

title: Kidou Senshi Z Gundam Gaiden: Shinpan no Mace
author: ROHGUN, Kamino, Junichi

title: Mobile Suit Gundam 0080: War in the Pocket
author: Tamakoshi, Hiroyuki

title: Kiss Players
description: As 2006 settled in, Earth had been rendered completely devoid of Transformers, and the rebuilding of Tokyo was underway. However, Galvatron's impact was revealed to have had a much greater effect than anyone could have predicted—the blast caused by his impact had scattered his Unicron-empowered cells throughout the planet's atmosphere. When they came into contact with other animals and objects, from marine life to cars, they fused with them, becoming one of many monstrous creatures referred to a

title: Shin Tenchi Muyou! Ryououki Gaiden: Tenchi Muyou! GXP
author: Kajishima, Masaki, Shirane, Hideki
description: Seina Yamada is unlucky... so unlucky that when he stumbles upon a recruiter looking for his senpai Tenchi he gets taken instead. Forced into the Galaxy Police, his luck begins to change. A natural to randomly jumping near pirates, he is assigned his own decoy to draw out pirates. His luck brings him into the lives of four women who have a habit of cancelling out his bad luck, turning it into good. Armed with this luck, they pilot the most powerful ships in the Tenchi Universe to defeat the Da R

title: Skull Killer Jaki-ou
author: Ishikawa, Ken
description: Part of Ken Ishikawa's Kyomu Senki (Records of Nothingness) series. Revolves around a biomechanical mecha called Jakio.

title: Huan Jing Shaonu Alice
author: Xiao, Nai Zhong
description: Many years ago having faced the Queen of Hearts, Alice goes back to Wonderland once again to save it from mysterious robot army of the Oz empire.

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Koubou no A Baoa Qu
author: Ark Performance
description:
The story takes place in U.C. 0084 in the form of a video documentary. It is based on interviews with soldiers and officers of the Earth Federation and the Principality of Zeon who participated in the final battle of A Baoa Qu during the end of the One Year War in U.C. 0079.

(Source: Gundam Wikia)

title: Kurogane no Linebarrel 0
author: Shimizu, Eiichi, Shimoguchi, Tomohiro
description:
1. Kurogane no Linebarrel Bangai-hen: Nankai yori Ai wo Komete
2. Koutetsu no Hana
3. Android Musume.
4-8. Tennen Bishoujo Mecha Roboko-chan!

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Zero no Kyuu Zaku
author: Okamoto, Kazuhiro
description:
Universal Century 0079. The original Duchy of Zeon end of the war a year dominated army, was starting to show color in the color of the border on the success of the federal military mobile suit development. In addition, the forced conscription of boys to girls in order to ensure personnel guileless yet lost the war.

(Source: Gundam Wikia)

title: Uchuu Senkan Yamato
author: Hio, Akira
description: Created by Akira Hio nearly in the same time as the original Space Battleship Yamato, this version contains re-imagined story focusing on war with Gamilas, instead of voyage towards Iscandar.

title: The Third
author: Hoshino, Ryo
description: The series is set many years after a devastating war, which killed 80% of the Earth's population. Earth is being watched by a group of beings known as The Third from a city called Hyperius. They are named after a red jewel-like eye on their forehead (Space Eye) that serves as a port for data access and other types of communication. These beings are committed to protecting the humans from harm. One of the main ways is to protect the humans is to control the amount of "technos" or technology that

title: Vandread: The Extra Stage
author: Akane, Kotetsu, Mori, Takeshi, Kuroda, Kazuya
description: Extra Stage is the long sought "after" novel containing various stories chronologically set before, during and after the anime.

title: Mazinger Z: Interval Peace
author: Nagai, Go, Osada, Kaoru, Ozawa, Takahiro
description:
The manga takes place in a world where the use of Super Robots is questioned. Koji is a former pilot with his companions faced with both personal and outer conflicts. They were once heroes but peace was achieved, bringing their robot's use into question. Can this peace even last and can it even lead to true peace...?

(Source: Mazinger Wiki)

title: VS Knight Lamune & 40 Fire
author: Yoshizaki, Mine, Akahori, Satoru
description:
Baba Lamunade is followed home by two strange peddler girls who give him a CD-rom game. After he beats "The Legend of Lamuness", the girls come out of his computer and bring him to DokiDoki Space. He is the third descendant of the hero Lamuness who must stop Don Genosai from resurrecting the great evil Abraham. Accompanied by PQ, his advisor robot, and Parfait and Cacao, he must pilot the Kaizer Fire mecha. However, he needs another pilot, and Da Cider is chosen as the second pilot.

(Source: AN

title: Beast Wars II: Super Lifeform Transformers
description:
All across the universe, the forces of the Maximals and Predacons  are at war... and the Maximals are on the losing end! At the central headquarters of their army, a Convoy receives report after disastrous report from the battlefield, and thinks of the small team of warriors led by Lio Convoy, fighting to keep the Angolmois energy of the planet Gaea out of the hands of Galvatron... 
(Source: Transformers Wiki).

title: Mazinger Z 2022
author: Nagai, Go
description: A remake of the original Mazinger Z manga in celebration of its 50th anniversary.

title: Metroid EX: Samus and Joey
author: Izuki, Kouji
description:
Metroid EX: Samus and Joey centers around Samus Aran, who lost her Power Suit upgrades to Greed, a creature of the same species as her nemesis Ridley. With the help of Joey Apronika and Diesel, Samus works to recover them in perilous adventures across the Extreme Galaxy.

(Source: Wikitroid)

title: Mobile Suits Gundam: Red Giant 03rd MS Team
author: Eijiri, Tatsuma, Kansai, Ryouji
description:
Universal Century, Decemeber 0079. After the failure to capture the Federation HQ at Jaburo, the remaining Zeon forces on Earth conduct a retreat. On their way back to space to reunite with the rest of Zeon's forces in space, a Federation unit consisting of three red giants appear.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Transformers G-2: Aratanaru Tatakai!!
author: Tanaka, Masahito
description:
The Generation 2 wars begin as Megatron and his Decepticons attack Earth in search of forestonite!

(Source: Transformers Wiki).

title: Transformers: Galaxy Force
author: Iwamoto, Yoshihiro
description:
With Cybertron on the brink of destruction, the war between the Transformers is inadvertently drawn to Earth! Can the Autobots keep the map of the Ancient Power out of Megatron's hands?

(Source: Transformers Wikia)

title: Henkei! Henkei! Transformers
description:
A cube-shaped object heads towards Earth from space, heralding things which are to come...

As three students head to school, they gossip about the latest mystery, cars being driven without drivers, as reported to the local TV news station by a schoolmate from a different class. One of the kids is Wataru Hoshinoumi, a 5th grader at the town's elementary school who aspires to become famous. 

(Source: Transformers Wiki)

title: Macross Plus: TAC Name
author: U.G.E, Moriya, Naoki
description: Manga adaption retelling the events of the anime adding more information and characters backgrounds and past.

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Day After Tomorrow - Kai Shiden no Memory yori
author: Kotobuki, Tsukasa
description:
U.C. 0105—within Zum City a One Year War memorial exhibition is about to be opened, and a very special guest is invited to talk about his experiences during the first Space war of the Universal Century—his name: Kai Shiden! Kai is both pleased and honored to be present and recalls his past on board of the White Base.

(Source: Gundam Wikia)

title: ZOIDS: Wakusei Zi
author: Shiozaki, Yuji
description: Kugo, ace pilot of Galaxy Quest, detects an unidentified SOS signal during one of his training sessions. Tracing it back to its source, he ventures down to the mysterious Planet Zi and finds himself surrounded by a new metallic species - the Zoids! As if meeting theses "living machines" aren't strange enough, when Kugo later tries to rescue a wild Zoid from certain death, he discovers he is able to pilot it, even when he has no experience in handling one! Did the SOS signal reach Kugo by chance,

title: Transformers: Full Throttle Scramble Power!
description:
The Decepticons are up to their old tricks again, this time threatening the peace of the world with an all-powerful electromagnetic cannon called the Omega Whip. Optimus Prime dispatches Hound and his human partners Toru and Jenny to follow the electromagnetic trail and locate the Decepticons' hidden base.

(Source: Transformers Wiki)

title: Saraba Uchuu Senkan Yamato: Ai no Senshi-tachi
author: Hio, Akira
description: Manga adaptation of the "Farewell To Space Battleship Yamato" movie, created by Akira Hio.

title: Cyborg 009: Call of Justice
author: Kimura, Akihiro, Kamiyama, Kenji, Higaki, Ryou, Sunayama, Kurasumi, Doki, Harumi
description: The Blessed, a group of people who possess superhuman powers and intellect, and have manipulated human history since ancient times. Their goals are unknown and they cast a dark shadow over the world. Though few people believe in the Blessed's existence, one journalist named Lucy Davenport heads to Texas to contact a certain family, and she meets the cyborgs who escaped from the clutches of Black Ghost and have defended humanity from them and other threats. The cyborgs themselves have been freed

title: Mazinger Z
author: Nagai, Go, Outa, Gosaku
description:
The manga focuses on a plot more similar to the anime starting with Koji checking on his grandfather after Baron Ashura had activated a bomb. With his dying breath, Dr. Kabuto gives Koji the Super Robot Mazinger Z. With the threat of Dr. Hell looming, Koji fights against his Mechanical Beasts and lieutenants with help from Sayaka Yumi and, to some degree, Boss.

(Source: Mazinger Wiki)

title: Uchuu Senkan Yamato: Aratanaru Tabidachi
author: Hio, Akira
description: Manga adaptation of the third movie, created by Akira Hio.

title: Transformers: Allspark
author: Tsushima, Naoto
description: A modern retelling of the Transformers Generation 1 cartoon.

title: Neppu Kairiku Bushilord: The Rising
author: Fujima, Takuya, Wataru, Shima
description: Earth asteroid early 21st century, "Verne" in the past clashed with the effects of pollution on earth spoke of humanity and a devastating blow. The collision of the planet, while significantly lowering the surface and bring down the old continent "land and sea" to the emergence of a new earth. Human beings are the only contamination of land and sea rival warlords over the Warring States era. (Source: M-U)

title: Uchuu Senkan Yamato
author: Hijiri, Yuki
description: The third and last out of three Yamato mangas published in 1974, serialized in Terebi Land and created by Yuki Hijiri. This short manga tells the alternative story of the first season of Space Battleship Yamato.

title: Cosmic Break
description:
This manga was created based on the MMORPG Cosmic Break.

Episode 1. Scrap Of Peace
Episode 2. The Strongest Wing In The World
Episode 3. Sacrifice -Part I-
Episode 4. Sacrifice -Part II-

title: Mobile Suit Gundam Formula 91 Prequel
author: Oono, Junji
description: In the futuristic setting of U.C. 0123, the Earth Federation Forces have developed the F91 Gundam, a cutting-edge mobile suit equipped with a Bio-Computer. Dr. Monica Arno and her team work tirelessly to overcome the F91's instability issues. Meanwhile, a mysterious organization called the Crossbone Vanguard emerges, led by Iron Mask and Supreme Commander Meitzer, with ambitious plans to change the world.

title: Beast Wars Metals
description:
A terrible space battle between Cybertrons and Destrons over a primitive planet has left scattered handsful of both sides stranded, and Metal Convoy's body has been shattered almost beyond repair...and captured! Can a desperate journey by Rhinox into the Matrix bring Convoy back? 
(Source: Dave's Transformers Page).

title: Uchuu Senkan Yamato: Kanketsu-hen
author: Hio, Akira
description: Manga adaptation of the "Final Yamato" movie, created by Akira Hio.

title: Frontier Line
author: Tagami, Yoshihisa
description:
Six tales of mecha war and redemption. Civil war has broken out on the planet Sodom, and the only way to survive is by using the mechas left behind by a mysterious alien race. The two sides must find common ground in their humanity or they will annihilate each other.

(Source: ANN)

title: Mobile Suit Crossbone Gundam X-Eleven
author: Hasegawa, Yuuichi
description: Chronicles the final battle of the series main character Curtis Rothko and explores what he was doing during the events of Mobile Suit Crossbone Gundam Dust.

title: A.O.Z. Re-Boot: Gundam Inle - Kuro Usagi no Mita Yume
author: Fujioka, Kenki
description: U.C. 0091. Following the end of the first Neo Zeon war, Neo Zeon remnants who refused to follow Char Aznabale's reborn Neo Zeon have formed a new faction called ReZeon. ReZeon absorbed the remaining members of the now defunct Titans faction, and fled to Mars under the command of supreme leader Alicia Zabi. Now the Titans remnants plan in secret to initiate the "Inle's Wings" plans.

title: [Un]hero
author: Kim, Jae-Hwan, Jo, Seung-Yeop
description: The Damned Devil's Army are rampaging around the world and the only person who can stop them is the Earth Warrior.

title: Shin Senkan Yamato
author: Kajiwara, Ikki, Dan, Tetsuya
description: Based on the novel by Ikki Kajiwara, this manga, created by Tetsuya Dan, tells the story of captain Okita and his two sons who use a modified battleship Yamato to save Japan from the evil forces of Dr. Kira.

title: Mobile Suit Gundam: Battle Operation Code Fairy
author: Takagi, Shuuei
description: With the North American front turning into a lost cause in the late stages of the One Year War, Kycillia Zabi secretly puts together an elite mobile suit squadron, later nicknamed "Noisy Fairy" because it only contained female members. After many battles the Fairies create a legendary reputation, form unbreakable bonds with each-other and stand against a Federation squad created to take them out: "Witch Hunt Squadron."

title: Yamato yo Eien ni
author: Hio, Akira
description: Manga adaptation of "Be Forever Yamato" movie, created by Akira Hio.

title: Karakuri Onigami Akatuski
author: Sakaki, Ichirou, Taka, Tony
description: The era of Toyotoshi clan rule has ended, bringing about a period of lasting peace governed by the Tokugawa clan. There is no longer a place for the gigantic war machines known as automaton armors to wage combat except for a young upstart by the name of Akatsuki takes the black automaton armor Kougetsu to extract revenge on his foes. In events unrelated to this, Shiori Kuchiha, the war god of the Shogunate, travels to the distant Aki Province to investigate a string of unexplained disappearances

title: Kyattou Ninden Teyandee
author: Hamada, Yoshimi
description: Plot of the Kyattō Ninden Teyandee manga is the continuation of the anime series. The new plan of Ko'on-no-Kami to overthrow the Shogun is in action, Karamaru gets kidnapped, Wanko-no-Kami and Nyanki get fired from their position and everything goes wrong. What happens then - find out in this manga.

title: Plamo Kyoushirou
author: Yamato, Kouichi, Craft-dan
description: The story follows Kyouda Shirou, from settling an argument with plamo battle to becoming the Japan representative of the 'World Simulation Tournament' and the battle at Hobbytopia. Along the way original plamo designs were created which began the MSV series and BB Senshi series.

title: Mobile Suit Crossbone Gundam: Love and Piece
author: Hasegawa, Yuuichi
description: An anthology series of stories set at various points in the Universal Century involving characters and events from Yuuichi Hasegawa's long-running Crossbone Gundam series.

title: Rockman: 4-koma Daikoushin
description: Random 4-koma comedy stories set in the Rockman universe. The manga has several short comedy stories, some based on games and others originals, drawn by Hitoshi Ariga, Kazuhiko Midou, Izumi Mito and Akihiro Tominaga.

title: Gate Keepers
author: Gotou, Keiji, Arai, Ryuuji
description: The year is 1963 and the earth is in danger; Invaders are plotting to infiltrate Earth and wreaking havoc when they appear. Normal weapons have no effect. Mankind's only hope are the "Gate Keepers", human beings with the ability to wield incredible psychic powers. Shun Ukiya is one such Gate Keeper. He was leading a normal high school life, but those days are over - If the Earth is going to stand a chance he, and other Gate Keepers just like him, are going to need to band together and fight.

title: Calm Breaker
author: Iwase, Masatsugu
description:
The carefree Toshiya Sakazaki inventor works in the company Kamata, engaged in the production of armaments. Divorced from Chisato Arita, who also works in the same company, Toshiya races against her to see who builds the better war robot.

Sakazaki creates a robot combat with artificial intelligence named Sayuri. She is shaped like a teenager and all that does is arouse the jealousy of Chisato. Although it has at its disposal a wide range of devastating attacks, Toshiya's error was introduced pr

title: SM Girls: Saber Marionette R
author: Akahori, Satoru, Negishi, Hiroshi, Kuroda, Kazuya, Hasegawa, Katsumi
description:
Jr., the heir of Romana and his battle sabers Cherry and Lime, who have girl circuits are enjoying their peaceful life in Romana. Suddenly, the evil Star-Face and his sexadolls attack Romana in order to take over so Star-Face can become the next High Official. In order to truly become the next High Official and ruler of Romana, he must first eliminate Jr. This begins a battle for, not only Jr.'s life, but for all of Romana.

(Source: ANN)

title: Choujuushin Gravion Zwei
author: Shimo, Fumihiko, Ishihama, Masashi, Kabashima, Yousuke, Miura, Takehiro
description: After Gravion was able to use its ultimate attack, the Zeravire threat seemed to have temporary stopped. However when it rises back up all of a sudden, the Earth Gult and its trump card, the super robot Gravion, is needed to defend this world again. All this while, the EFA is planning to create their own weapons to counter the Zeravire, the Grand Trooper. Now as they attempt to fend off the Zeravire, the people of the Earth Gult and EFA must protect their future as well as confront their pasts,

title: Junk Force
author: Komatsu, E-ji, Kakinuma, Hideki
description: After the last world war (2100-2104), the earth has become a desert place to live. Even more : the scarce resources left are destroyed by the ZPT system to clean the earth for the return of the Mars colonists. Louis (the only boy in the gang), Liza, Mill and Wooty, together with the Android Mamet, have accidentally found each other with the same target. They search for the source engine of the ZPT to destroy it and thus stop the useless destruction of the remaining cities and people on earth. In

title: Babel Nisei: The Returner
author: Noguchi, Takashi, Yokoyama, Mitsuteru
description:
After 40 years, "Babel II" is miraculously back! This time, the enemy is the world's most powerful military nation, the United States of America! A supernatural battle of modern warfare vs. Babel II breaks out...!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Super Robot Taisen OG - Divine Wars
author: Kimura, Akihiro
description: Adapting the story of the Divine Wars saga, this time focusing on the SRX team.

title: Dino Getter
author: Hoshi, Kazumi
description:
Dino Getter is a manga series by Kazumi Hoshi for the 40th anniversary of Getter Robo. It introduces the Dino Getter Robo in an original eight chapter story about a battle between the Dinosaur Empire.

(Source: MU)

title: Heavy Object EX: Gunshin Taguru Sanshimai
author: Kamachi, Kazuma, Nagi, Ryou
description:
Quenthur and Havia came back from their one week vacation. The next stage that awaits the two is the experimental battlefield Madagascar, a huge island on the east side of the African continent. Quenthur and the others have been sent to destroy the second-generation object from the Faith Organization: Trinity Style. The worst tropical night ever begins now!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam Unicorn Episode EX2: Shishi no Kikan
author: Tamakoshi, Hiroyuki, Fukui, Harutoshi
description: An adaptation of the Shishi no Kikan script/drama CD, which takes place between the events of Gundam Unicorn and Gundam Narrative and focuses on Riddhe Marcenas.

title: Yamato III
author: Masuo, Takayuki
description: Loose adaptation of the third season of Space Battleship Yamato, created by Takayuki Masuo.

title: Orichalcum Reycal Duo
author: Tsunashima, Shirou
description: The story of the manga revolves around male college student Mitsuaki Sakugi, who makes his poor living from making figures. One day, he receives putty as a reward from his teacher after sculpting a figure that would be used as a sample in class. That night, after making a figure out of the putty he received, the figure suddenly comes to life. The figure calls herself Reycal, and explains that she is a being called an Orichalcum. She explains that Orichalcum are beings that were born to grant the

title: Sora wo Kakeru Shoujo Prologue: Akiha
author: Suzukaze, Ryou

title: Kyouka Ningen Monogatari: Mad Wang 1160
author: Morishita, Kaoru
description:
Mad Wang 1160 takes place in the year UC 1160. The three main characters, Shiva Yips, Decoder S. Wallenstein and Mell Mekanika awake from cold sleep (cryonics) in each of their colonies and are swallowed up in the Earth vs. the Outer Space Alliance's battle.

(Source: Gundam Wiki)

title: Zoids SS
author: Iwase, Masatsugu
description: Tys and her older brother Kai have spent most of their life sheltered in a small village, playing games with their two Mirage Foxes.

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Isekai Uchuu Seiki - Nijuuyonsai Shokugyou OL, Tensei-saki de Kycilia Yattemasu
author: Tsukiji, Toshihiko, NOCO
description: A 24 years old office lady is reincarnated into Kycillia Zabi, will she be able to change the fate of Zeon?

title: Danball Senki Gaiden
author: Takei, Hiroyuki
description:
1. Danball Senki Kaidou Jin Gaiden
2. Danball Senki Boost Gaiden
3. Danball Senki Wars Gaiden

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam 0083: Stardust Memory
author: Yatate, Hajime, Tomino, Yoshiyuki, Kadoya, Mitsuru

title: Q-Robo Transformer
author: Imaki, Shouji
description: A 4-koma gag manga based on Transformers.

title: Wadachi
author: Matsumoto, Leiji
description: Collection of short, humorous stories by Leiji Matsumoto.

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: N-Extreme
author: Minakuchi, Takashi
description:
One day, Sai Amagi and Chikage Ebihara are transported to another world by a mysterious woman who wants them to save the world. From the cockpit of the N-Extreme Gundam, these two are surprised by the world they witness.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Voices of a Distant Star: Words of Love/Across the Stars
author: Kanou, Arata
description:
The word, "world"...

I vaguely thought it meant anywhere there was cell phone reception.

It's the year 2046. Mikako Nagamine and Noboru Terao are middle school classmates, tentatively sharing an unspoken first love—but unbeknownst to him, Mikako has been recruited into the UN Space Force, and instead of going on to high school, will join the spacecraft Lysithea to search for alien Tarsians. As she travels further and further to the outer reaches of the solar system, the time it takes for a tex

title: Amadeus Code
author: Azuma, Mayumi, Nakanishi, Tatsurou
description: This series is on hiatus.

title: Aoi Umi no Tristia: Hontou no Takaramono
author: Komatsu, E-ji, Jet, Yowatari, Kanou, Keita
description:
An ocean city, Tristia. 
Tristia used to be prospering playing an important role of the maritime trade, and it was as beautiful as to be praised as "marine jewelry". 
However, that was a long time ago. 
The attack of the dragons deprived the city of their original brightness. The people in Tristia worked hard to reconstruct their city, but everything they did went wrong, and the city became desolated on the contrary. 
At the end of their hope, they asked a Great Artisan for the recovery of the c

title: Denkou Ozuma
author: Matsumoto, Leiji
description: SF manga created by Leiji Matsumoto in 1961. It is the first of his works where Space Battleship Yamato makes it's appearance.

title: Soukou Kihei Votoms: AT Stories
author: Sono, Yoshihiro, Okajima, Masaaki
description:
A collection of short side stories of the Soukou Kihei Votoms series.

1. The Last Bitch Standing at Tyglem, 7213
2. Koko ja Nai Doko ka
3. "Death from Above" at Sol Highlland, 7209
4. Warera no Iru Basho
5. "Starved Pack" at Jingle, 7212
6. Kaerubeki Tokoro
7. "Giant Footsteps" at Alemor, 7208
8. "The Killing Field" at Woode, 7214
9. Tamashii no Yukusaki
10. "A Fisherman's Tale" at Cove, 7222

title: Side Story of Gundam Z
author: Kondo, Kazuhisa
description:
An alternate retelling of the events from the original Zeta Gundam series. After The One Year War against the Principality of Zeon, Sayla Mass, Char Aznable's sister, was taken hostage by the titans whose main mission is to hunt down remnants of Zeon.

(Source: MU)

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam F90 Cluster
author: Konoya, Kiyoshi
description:
Universal Century 0121 - A battle known as the "First Oldsmobile War" erupted on Mars. The Earth Federation Forces 13th Experimental Combat Group thought they had quelled the Mars Independent Zeon Forces. But the battle for the Fastest Formula is far from over!
A new tale from F90FF, beginning on Mars... Where all Formulas converge!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Mobile Suit Crossbone Gundam
author: Tomino, Yoshiyuki, Hasegawa, Yuuichi
description: A prequel oneshot set before the events of the Kidou Senshi Crossbone Gundam. The story focuses on Kincade trying to convince Zabine to join the Crossbone Vanguard in their war against Jupiter.

title: Sengoku Gyouha Dullahan: Kagen no Keishousha
author: Katou, Takuji
description:
The story is set in a parallel world of the Sengoku era. Date Masamune rides a giant robot called Ouryuu. However, the robot is too strong for the young Masamune to control, which leads to the death of many people. Fearing the power of Ouryuu, the other daimyo form an alliance against Masamune in order to destroy Ouryuu.

(Source: MU)

title: Busou Shinki 2036
author: BLADE
description: It is the year 2036. Mankind enjoys a life not so different from ours. However, people are accompanied by new partners, the 15cm tall "Shinki." They live side-by-side with people both as companions to share experiences and feelings with and as warriors to fight together. Those fighting Shinki are called Busou Shinki.

title: RideBack: Cannonball Run
author: Kasahara, Tetsuroh, Kuga, Boncho
description: In the future, an organization called the GGP has taken control of the world. Rin Ogata was a promising up-and-coming ballet dancer, but suffered a serious injury while dancing and decided to quit. Years later in college, she comes across a club building and soon finds herself intrigued by a transforming motorcycle-like robotic vehicle called a "Rideback". She soon finds that her unique ballet skills with balance and finesse make her a born natural on a Rideback. However, those same skills also

title: Brave Universe Sworgrader
author: Tsunashima, Shirou
description: The story revolves around Taira Yunokami, a boy in fifth grade who helps his father run a food truck. One day, he meets a famished girl in a park on his way to school. After helping the girl, the city is suddenly attacked by Glutton, an inter-dimensional threat that endangers the world. Amidst the chaos, Sworg, a young member of the Space Administration Bureau Braver, saves both Taira and the girl. Sworg has come to Earth to pursue the enigmatic and malevolent Glutton. When fate brings Sworg and

title: Heavy Object: Dengeki Comic Anthology
author: Kobayashi, Tetsuya, Ozaki, Yuusuke, Ishizaka, Kenta, Matsuri, Seishirou, Yoshida, Hajime, Kamoto, Tatsuya
description: An anthology comic of Heavy Object by various mangaka.

title: Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn Testament
author: Fukui, Harutoshi, Kosai, Takayuki
description: A compilation of side stories from Kidou Senshi Gundam Unicorn.

title: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Revival of Zeon
author: Kondo, Kazuhisa

title: Gunparade Orchestra
author: Sanadura, Hiroyuki
description: A sequel to Gunparade March. About fifty years ago, an alien race, known as the "Phantom Beasts," appeared on Earth and began to kill all humans. A student draft was declared, and high school students were recruited to become mecha pilots to fight these aliens. Gunparade Orchestra features the teenage mecha pilot soldiers of the 108th Guard Squad, a weak unit stationed in Aomori. Ishida Sara has arrived to be their new company commander, and she's determined to get their team in shape! If she ca

title: Choukijin Ryuukoou Denki
author: Terada, Takanobu, Fujihara, Masaaki
description: The story is about the original mecha, RyuKoOH, in relation to the Super Robot Wars franchise.

title: Special Police Winspector
author: Seino, Shuiichi
description:
Based on the live action law enforcement metal hero show in Japan.

Brian, a robot made at the same time as Biker and Walter of the Tokkei Winspector task force, has been brainwashed by a renegade scientist by the name of Professor Hirosaki. Can the members of Tokkei Winspector beat the brainwashed Brian, or will he destroy all the motorbikes in the world? Only time will tell. 

(Source: MangaUpdates)

title: Mahou no Shoui Blaster Mari
author: Ikeda, Kei
description: Universal Century 0079, Zeon Elementary School fifth grade student Mariko, meets the Red Comet, who is mounted on a white horse that gives magical powers. When the colony falls into crisis, Mariko becomes the beautiful Ensign Blaster Mari, and pilots the Zaku I to defend her home against the Federation's GMs.

title: Kokumei no Golem
author: bose
description:
"I will create a human."

In 19th Century, The British Empire is full of prosperity as a result of the "Third Industrial Revolution" by Golem technique. Golems changed everything associated with "automatic" life and people's daily life turned rich. But who could expect that the existence of "Automatic Doll" would bring a "finale" to the world?

When a girl who wants to be a Golem engineer, Ashley, meets Gibson who's a genius engineer, the gears of fate start to revolve...!

title: Shinseiki Evangelion: Eva & Eva 2 Anthology
author: Katsura, Asuka, Yabuki, Gou, Hayashi, Fumino, Gotsubo, Ryuuji, Tamaoki, Benkyou, Betten, Court, Takuma, Tomomasa, Kikkawa, Kabao, Takezaki, Tony, Takahashi, Osamu, Kodama, Miki, Iwasaki, Masakazu, Takeuchi, Motoki, Konoya, Kiyoshi
description: An anthology comic of the video games Shinseiki Evangelion and Shinseiki Evangelion 2 by various mangaka.

title: Gundam EXA VS
author: Chiba, Tomohiro, Tokita, Kouichi
description:
Some time after the events of Gundam EXA, Sthesia Awar informs Leos Alloy that she discovered a new GA data cluster from a computer outside of Jupiter X. The two dive into the new data and find themselves in the Universal Century, during the attack on Side 7. However, after entering the colony, they find that the inside was in ruins, and the RX-78-02 Gundam has been destroyed before it could be activated by Amuro Ray.

The two discover a faint life sign in the colony, the source of which is Them

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Cucuruz Doan no Shima - Doan to Rolland
author: Oono, Junji

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Zeon no Saikou - Remnant One
author: Kondo, Kazuhisa
description:
In U.C. 0092 the "Cerberus Squadron," of Newborn Neo Zeon—a Newtype unit led by Brown and Meyer—are ordered to capture Fifth Luna.

(Source: Gundam Wiki)

title: X-Bomber
author: Nagai, Go, Kamohara, Naoki
description:
The year is 2999, and the Solar System has just seen the end of Space War 3. An alien cruiser sweeps through Earth's defenses and issues an ultimatum - hand over the (F-01) or face destruction. Fortunately Star Fleet's last hope, the X-Bomber beats off the cruiser, but the question it asked remains: what is the F-01? When a mysterious space sailing ship appears near Pluto and is attacked by the alien cruiser, Star Fleet Command recognizes that there is more going on than they realize. 

(Source:

title: Avenir wo Sagashite
author: Tomino, Yoshiyuki
description:
Set in the near future, where outer space is dotted by small space colonies, Japan's political scene is dominated by the military, and has transformed into a military state. A mysterious humanoid machine appears in the skies over Tokyo, and issues a message over the radio, "a message from Avenir."

(Source: MU)

title: Betterman
author: Yamada, Shutarou, Yonetani, Yoshitomo
description:
A deadly virus known as "Algernon" has attacked humanity with vicious meaning. At the forefront of the battle is the mystifying Akamatsu Industries—disguised as a heavy machine factory in Tokyo, this undercover organization uses neural enhanced weapons known as NeuroNoids to battle Algernon. Also helping with their secret efforts is the mysterious mutant who is only known as "Betterman."

(Source: ANN)

title: Silbuster
author: Sahara, Ikkou
description: The time is the not-so-distant future and the planet Earth is under attack by an army of merciless aliens. Its only hope is the Starlight—a craft originally designed to realize man’s dream of traveling between the stars—and it’s genetically altered human pilot Mitsuha (codename: Silbuster). Inside of her and her four siblings lay the secret to completing the ship’s light wave engine. Only then can the alien threat be destroyed once and for all. Unfortunately, the creatures are well aware of this

title: Kidou Senshi Z Gundam Four Story: Soshite, Senshi ni...
author: Kitazume, Hiroyuki, Endo, Akinori
description: Six years after the conclusion of the One Year War (UC0086~0087). A girl who lost not only her parents, but her own memory by a colony dropping thanks to the Zeon, is recruited into a Newtype research institute (the Murasame Labs). After aimlessly wandering, she becomes test subject No. 004 (aka "Four"). Here she is trained to become a strengthened human with two other subjects (No. 005 Jill Ratokie and No. 006 Amari Garfield). The intense training killed many people, and yet through it all Four

title: Terrestrial Defence Corp. Dai Guard
description: Dai Guard is a giant, anti-heterodyne robot owned and operated by a private corporation. Can they keep Dai Guard away from the military while fighting Heterodynes AND staying out of the red??

title: Night=Hawks!
author: Konomichi, Ayumi
description:
Set during the One Year War, it follows the story of young officer 1st Sgt. Brown Chaamin, who is part of the Earth Federation Forces' "Night Hawks" 13th independent shock troops. This force is composed of pseudo-Newtype (reinforced by drug administration) mobile suit pilots, and outfitted with specially modified machines. This unit was formed as part of the V-RX program.

(Source: Gundam Wikia)

title: Kyouka Ningen Monogatari: Another Z Gundam Story
author: Morishita, Kaoru
description:
The story is set in U.C. 0088 on Island 7, an independent research colony used by Anaheim Electronics to test Mobile Suit technologies for Newtypes.

(Source: Gundam Wiki)

title: Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn: Bright Noah Story
author: Katsuragi, Hiyon

title: Tetsuzin
author: Ochiai, Naoyuki
description: Together with his robotic pet, atom, Sho Tobio travel from Japan to Dong Bei City in People Republic of China. tetsuzin-1His mother, Saeko, is a scientist graduated from MIT who is sign to reevaluate Japanese weapons left in China as the result of Japanese colonialism years ago. Some of those armors are producing dangerous gas. Moreover, the sentiment for Japanese is stabbed inside local people’s mind. It’s amazing how Saeko still manage to get her 10 year old son in that kind of area. Sho was b

title: Mutekitekki Spin-chan
author: Dai, Amon
description:
It will be the first year of high school for Tooru and as such, she decided to go live with her grandpa to be close to school. But it turns out that the old man is a robot engineer with a peculiar dream... for which he created the robot assistant Spin! What will happen to Tooru from now on!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Penetrator
description: Fictional Space War loosely based on WWII. Story centers on the lives of a 4-men squadron.

title: D4 Princess
author: Harada, Shoutarou
description:
Doris Ruridou is young princess who had just entered Teito Academy. She is also a Panzer, a person with special abilities and fights with a weapon called a "tool." Shortly after entering, her older sister shows up to teach her how to fight as a Panzer against other Panzers who challenge her.

(Source: ANN)

title: Mobile Suit Crossbone Gundam: The Truth of the "Thunderbolt of Zeus" Project
author: Hasegawa, Yuuichi
description: Parodic retelling of the events of the Kidou Senshi Crossbone Gundam: Kami no Kaminari Keikaku no Shinjitsu from the perspective of one of that manga's side characters.

title: Blue Gale
author: Itou, Akihiro
description:
Follows the continuing adventures of Rag Urao set years after the 1980s anime Sentou Mecha Xabungle.

Contents:
- Blue Gale
- Sentou Mecha Xabungle Gaiden
- Ariel
- Yuusha-ou Gaogaider

title: Tokyo Annihilation War
author: Kiryuu, Gou
description:
They were instructed to kill each other in the city of Tokyo until 10,000,000 people were eliminated from the city. This genocidal game known as "Save the Earth" happens every 4 years. An over-populated city is randomly chosen to become the forced killing grounds of its denizens, and each person has to kill the other. They have no choice, and no escape. Akira Suwa must now fight to protect his loved ones and himself in this genocidal game.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title: DT Eightron
author: Hinoki, Iderow
description: In the year 2187, the planet Earth, caused by global warming is leading the human civilization to certain destruction. As such people are unable to live on the Earth's surface so they created domed cities, but as time goes by, war and unstable land condition parted the dome cities and they lose contact with each other. Shuu is a teenage boy from Datania, a school-type city dome controlled by Zero, a data program, with the help of his human assistant Nines, and later Berk. They forced the childre

title: Koukaku Kidoutai: Stand Alone Complex - Tachikoma na Hibi
author: Yamamoto, Masayuki, Sakurai, Yoshiki

title: Odaiba Chuuton Kichi no Yousei: Strike Princess
author: Poco, Fuyuki, Fuyuki

title: Mobile Suit Gundam: Cucuruz Doan's Island
author: Yasuhiko, Yoshikazu, Takeuchi, Kiyoto
description:
After a covert mission goes wrong, Mobile Suit pilot Amuro Ray and his comrades are stranded on a remote island. The battalion was sent to a land called the Island of No Return to clear off any enemy forces, only to find a group of children and an enemy mecha attack. Now Amuro must find a way for them all to escape this mysterious land, but not before meeting a strange man—Cucuruz Doan.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Kidou Senshi V Gundam Gaiden: Odelo Henrik kara no Tegami
author: Okamoto, Kazuhiro
description: As Odelo Henrik witnesses the end of the battle of Angel Halo and the final battle of the war, he sees his life flashing before his eyes and starts recalling everything that brought him to this point. A new manga celebrating the 30th anniversary of Mobile Suit Victory Gundam's airing!

title: Chouseishin Gransazer
author: Nishikawa, Shinji
description:
Billions of years after an advanced human civilization was destroyed by aliens, twelve direct descendants of the civilization's warriors called "Sazers" have their powers awakened and form four tribes: Fire, Wind, Earth and Water. At first, they wage war on each other, but after learning the truth of their ancestry, the GranSazer tribes unite to protect Earth from the alien forces bent on once again extinguishing all life on the planet.

(Source: ANN)

title: One-man Army Gatse
author: Kobayashi, Motofumi
description: After nuclear war broke out in the 1980s, a long nuclear winter descended on the Earth. Thirty years later, mankind has survived, but is engaged in an unending battle, even though the entire planet is in ruins. Arnold Gatse, the famous one-man army, is given a mission to defeat the enemy forever, by destroying the diglycidyl fortress at the heart of their base.

title: Koukidou Hishou Heiki: Busou Yousei Fairia
author: Saitou, Shinya, Futsuka

title: Mobile Suit Gundam Narrative
author: Takeuchi, Kiyoto
description:
U.C. 0097, one year after the opening of "Laplace's Box." Despite the revelation of the Universal Century Charter that acknowledges the existence and rights of Newtypes, the framework of the world has not been greatly altered.

The conflict later dubbed the "Laplace Incident" is thought to have ended with the downfall of the Neo Zeon remnants known as the Sleeves. In its final battle, two full psycho-frame mobile suits displayed power beyond human understanding. The white unicorn and the black l

title: SD Gundam Sangokuden Brave Battle Warriors: Souseiki
author: Iwamoto, Yukio
description: Side stories that aren't included in the anime.

title: Aldnoah.Zero: Extra Episode
author: Takayama, Katsuhiko, Sekine, Ayumi
description: Side story booklets included with volumes 3 and 8 of the limited edition Blu-Ray/DVD release.

title: Front Mission Series: Gun Hazard
author: Matsuda, Taishuu
description: A collection of stories revolving around the characters of Front Mission Series: Gun Hazard.

title: Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny
author: Gotou, Riu
description: C.E. 71: After the terrible battle of Yakin Due, an uneasy peace rests between the Earth Alliance and the Zaft Empire. But even as Cagalli and Athrun visit Chairman Durandal to cement the tentative cease-fire, Zaft terrorists plot with Neo Roanoke to drag both sides into all-out war. The plan: storm Zaft territory and steal several Gundam Mobile Suits. But that’s only the beginning. They’re also scheming to engineer a catastrophic event, one designed to drive the Earth down a bloody path. Now th

title: Chou Denji Taisen Victory Five
author: Hasegawa, Yuuichi
description:
The crossovers of "Chou Denji Robo Combattler V", "Chou Denji Machine Voltes V", and "Toushou Daimos".

The manga consist of 2 parts:
Part 1: Jewelion, a murdered couple of Valerian and Boazanian's daughter tried her parent's revenge and destroy the peace treaties of Earth, Planet Campbel, Planet Boazan, Planet Baam. Combattler V, Voltes V, and Daimos fights against Jewelion's attack.

Part 2: An evil Campbelian who is a model of android Great General Garuda came over with Daltanious in "Mirai R

title: God Bird
author: Hasegawa, Yuuichi
description:
It is 35 years later from the battle of Brave Raideen and the Demon Empire, and battles of Combattler V, Voltes V, and Daimos. The peaceful city where the battle of super robots was forgotten was disturbed by two Gante, the giant stone demons which appeared suddenly. Akira Saezuri, an eighth-grader girl heard mysterious voice and became new pilot of Reideen. 

She revivies Akira Hibiki sealed for 35 years, and fights with Combattler V, Voltes V, and Daimos against; Mari Sakurano possessed by Bar

title: Gasaraki
author: Yatate, Hajime, Takahashi, Ryousuke, Nozaki, Tooru
description: In ancient Japan the Gowa family create a demonic Armor in order to defeat their enemies. Hundreds of years later this armor is exploited by the Gowa in the development of Tactical Armor for military usage and the usurpation of Japan.

title: Mobile Suit Gundam: Blazing Shadow
author: Uzumaki, Tomomi, Itakura, Toshiyuki
description:
Four years after the end of the One Year War between the Principality of Zeon and the Earth Federation, Cain Ragnard, a war orphan whose parents were killed by Zeon's attack on Side 7, has joined the Earth Federation Forces. For the vengeance of his parents, Cain joins the special force Shadows to hunt down the remnants of the Zeon menace. One day his team is sent to Earth to eliminate Zeon remnants in the Middle East, however, an act of betrayal changes everything...

(Source: Gundam Wiki)

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED: Freedom Astray
author: Chiba, Tomohiro, Tokita, Kouichi

title: Sunmusu: Girl's Battle Bootlog the Comic
author: Kashi, Kindaichi, Akira

title: Shin Kidou Senki Gundam Wing: 0.5 Point Half Preventer-7
author: Sumisawa, Katsuyuki, Asagi, Sakura
description:
AC-197. Peace has returned to the people. And from this point on in history, weapons known as mobile suits, including the Gundams, were never seen again in the Earth Sphere. However, as long as mankind exists, there will always be battles. And that is precisely why an organization called the Preventers must exist. Heero and the others of PREVENTER-7 embark on a new operation to extinguish the flames that threaten to consume the perfect peace.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Big O: Lost Memory
author: Yatate, Hajime, Ariga, Hitoshi
description:
A side story of The Big O which takes place between volumes five and six of the manga adaptation.

(Source: Wikipedia)

title: Super Comic Gekijou: Kishin Houkou Demonbane
Hakaiou: GaoGaiGar tai Betterman
author: Kimura, Takahiro, Takeda, Yuuichirou, Nakatani, Seiichi

author: Kondo, Kazuhisa
description: A manga adaptation of the game Mobile Suit Gundam Online.

title: Saishuu Kikouhei Metal Slader Glory: Amia no Omokage
author: ☆Yoshimiru
description: The manga is set after the events of the game and further expands upon its back-story.

title: Million Kingdom
author: Nibutani, Yuuto
description: Million Kingdom tells the story of an android who spends his entire life protecting his village from several giant robots that constantly attack the place, but at one point, the android discovers that it was created by the same organization that made these giant robots, which causes it to question his role and what side it should fight for.

title: Juushinki Pandora 0
author: Kawamori, Shouji, Satelight, Saotome, Ageha
description:
The manga will be a prequel to the anime, and will center on Guren Din during events of the Xianglong Crisis.

(Source: ANN)

author: Yatsufusa, Tatsunosuke

author: Kinutani, Yuu, Tsushima, Naoto, Fujisawa, Naoyuki, Hoshi, Kazumi, Ishikawa, Yuujin, Sakamoto, Hayato, Yoshioka, Hidetsugu
description:
When a spacetime warp sends the Autobots and Decepticons to the Japan of another dimension, they get involved in Mazinger Z's fight against Dr. Hell and Baron Ashura.

(Source: Village Books, translated)

title: Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn: The Noble Shroud
author: Shiroishi, Kotoni

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Senkou no Hathaway
author: Tomino, Yoshiyuki, Uroaki, Sabishi
description: In Hathaway's Flash, Hathaway Noa, still haunted by his past actions (not to mention the spirit of deceased Newtype Quess Paraya), joins a terrorist organization called Mafty and adopts the false name "Mafty Navue Erin." The organization Mafty is fighting a terrorist campaign against the Earth Federation government, and they are eventually able to acquire the incredibly powerful prototype Ξ Gundam, which Hathaway becomes the pilot of. Using the Ξ Gundam, Mafty attempts to attack a meeting of hig

title: Chou Keroro Gunsou: Ultra Cool Gekitou!! Keroro Robo Daikessen
author: Shido, Yutaro

title: Bullbuster
author: Nakao, Hiroyuki, Itami, Hishio
description: A young engineer, Tetsurou Okino, is transferred to a vermin extermination company called Hato Industries with the new robot Bullbuster that he developed himself. There, Hato Industries, a small company with little money, and its president Tajima are against a mysterious creature. There are fuel costs for robots, labor costs for pilots, and of course, wasting even a single bullet is unacceptable. Between their ideals of extermination and the reality of budgets, what does the future hold for Hato

title: Mobile Suit Gundam: Silver Phantom Gravure
author: Katsuragi, Hiyon, Kansai, Ryouji
description: U.C. 0096. As the conflict between the Earth Federation Forces and the Neo Zeon remnants, known as the Laplace Incident, draws to a close, a new mission is given to the unofficial mercenary unit Argent Keel, which undertakes missions for both the Federation and Zeon alike: the assassination of a high-ranking Federation official. It was by no means a major operation. However, this job shakes up the existence of Argent Keel, which has remained silent for a long time, and unearths the truth that ha

title: Super Comic Gekijou: Koukidou Gensou - Gunparade March
Hyper Senshi Gundam Boy
author: Yamato, Kouichi, Craft-dan
description:
Taiga Amachi, a diehard SD Gundam fan, joins the Gundam Research Group (also commonly known as "G-Group"). He does battle in a Gunpla battle simulator against the many enemies aiming to take down G-Group.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Mashin Eiyuuden Wataru: Shichikon no Ryuujinmaru
author: Fujii, Hideaki
description: A manga adaptation based on the ONA of the same name.

title: Get Truth: Taiyou no Kiba Dougram
author: Ootagaki, Yasuo
description:
The year is 152 S.C. The colony planet of Deloyer is in turmoil. In the midst of the upheaval, Crinn Cashim, a boy born into a powerful family on earth, learns of a scheme by his father Donan. Forced to choose between family and friends, Crinn chooses to join the guerilla fighters of the Deloyer rebels. Crinn pilots the newly completed combat armor "Dougram," and joins the Sun Fang Corps. His heroic efforts turn things around for the rebels and their counteroffensive.

However Earth forces Capta

title: SD Gundam Sangokuden: Fuuun Gouketsu-hen
author: Tokita, Kouichi
description: It was the times of war in the continent of Mirisha, a time where the three kingdoms of Shou, Gou and Giga struggle for power and authority. Before the three countries become established, the rebellion of the Yellow Scarves has allowed Toutaku to seize control over the government, he killed Reitei  the emperor of that time and stole the "Gyokuji," then promoted himself to Prime Minister spreading tyranny through the land. But a year after, the anti-Toutaku spirits are on the rise because of the

title: Busou Tensei Bishoujo to Gattai shita Ossan Densetsu ni Naru
author: Kisa, Kazuyuki

title: Bullbuster

description: A young engineer, Tetsurou Okino, is transferred to a vermin extermination company called Hato Industries with the new robot Bullbuster that he developed himself. There, Hato Industries, a small company with little money, and its president Tajima are against a mysterious creature. There are fuel costs for robots, labor costs for pilots, and of course, wasting even a single bullet is unacceptable. title: X-Bomber
author: Nagai, Go, Ono, Makoto
description:
In the last years of the third millennium, the solar system is recovering from a devastating interplanetary war. Suddenly, a new enemy arrives in the solar system, intent on destruction and conquest. Against them stands the Earth Defense Force and its top secret X Project.

(Source: ANN)

title: Legend of the Far East's Savior
author: Kurogin, Hotokeyomo
description: At the end of World War II, a demon-summoning ritual drastically altered the face of the earth. Now, a hundred years later, demons rule the world, and humanity fights back using magicite-powered armored mechs. In the year 2055, a boy named Keita Kawakami enrolls in Japan's military academy. Possessing memories of an alternate modern era, he successfully pilots a prototype mech that no one else has even been able to activate. When Keita is suddenly deployed to the battlefield, he uses the knowled

title: Shin Sakura Taisen the Novel: Hizakura no Koro
author: Mugi, Ayumu
description:
In 1938, the world is at peace following the Great Demon War eight years earlier and the Shanghai Combat Revue now protects Tokyo. However, Sumire Kanzaki, a retired actress and original member of the Imperial Combat Revue's Flower Division, senses that the demons are about to threaten Tokyo once again. So, she decides to establish a new Imperial Combat Revue and personally recruit some potential members.

(Source: TV Tropes)

title: Butterfly of the Distant Day
author: Miyagi, Tooko
description:
Gifted pianist Saki wants nothing more than to see his young cousin—the talented Riya—succeed as a professional musician. So why is a (handsome) face from Saki's past suddenly threatening to tear him away from reality? Will this fragile butterfly finally learn to ride the winds of change with grace and maturity—or will he get swept away in a reckless moment?

(Source: Digital Manga Publishing)

title: Hanasaku Minato
author: Hayashi, Seiichi
description:
One of Hayashi's early contributions to the alternative manga magazine Garo, Flowering Harbour is a love story filtered through the aesthetics of enka music, known informally as "Japanese blues". 

(Source: Breakdown Press)

title: Sleeping Pizzicato Forest
author: Yukimura, Alto
description:
Emily has lived a sheltered life. Longing for a life like the protagonist in her beloved novel who shares the same name, Emily leaves home on her own and travels to the villa inherited from her great-great-grandfather on Hazama Hill. There, she finds a sleeping boy. Named Shura, he says he was given the house key and deed to the villa from a backpacker...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Bokutachi Otoko no Ko
author: Kirishima, Ai, Nerisuke
description: Based on the drama CD series of the same name, Bokutachi Otoko no Ko follows three boys named Seri, Ren, and Tama who dream of becoming top idols. Little did they know they would come together under Barney's agency to form the cross-dressing idol unit, UNBALANCE. With the help of the Barney's agency president, Fujishiro Ryuichi, and their manager, Yuji Takigawa, they will become Japan's top cross-dressing idols!

title: Ossan Idol!
author: Mochida, Mochiko, Kino, Ichika
description:
Despite his kindhearted nature, 36-year-old Miroku Oosaki is hardly attractive. After losing his job due to his appearance, he has been an otaku NEET for the past decade and weighs a whopping 120 kg. However, support from his loving family has kept his spirits up during this unfortunate situation.

Miroku was content with this lifestyle until he came across a video of people dancing. Inspired, he decided to hit the gym and dance as well, eventually slimming down to an attractive hunk! After acci

title: Hypnosis Mic: Division Rap Battle - side F.P & M+
author: Momose, Yuuichirou, Jou, Kiiko
description: Following the conclusion of the first Division Rap Battle, Ramuda Amemura and Jakurai Jinguji return to their respective divisions, further honing their rapping skills for the next tournament. After gambling all of his money, Dice Arisugawa finds himself without a single yen to pay back his debt to his friends. Moping around, he meets a mysterious person who offers him cash in exchange for transporting boxes to a Yokohama port at night. Ramuda and Gentarou Yumeno assume the worst when Dice reque

title: Starmyu
author: Hidou, Ren, Hinata, Rin
description:
The series tells the story of the five students; Yuuta Hoshitani, Tooru Nayuki, Kaito Tsukigami, Kakeru Tengenji, and Shuu Kuga as they struggle to enter the musical department of Ayanagi Academy, a school focusing on music.

(Source: Wikipedia)

title: Takt Op. Destiny: Haruka Tsuioku no Anna - Harmony of Hope
author: Kino
description: Takt Op. Destiny: Haruka Tsuioku no Anna - Harmony of Hope is based on the Takt Op. Destiny anime, and the story is told from the viewpoint of Anna Schneider.

title: THE IDOLM@STER relations
author: Ueda, Yumehito
description: iM@S manga that revolves around Miki from when she was scouted by the producer until she joins the 765 production.

title: Band wo Kubi ni Sareta Boku to Oshi JK no Seishun Rewrite
author: HC Stylus, Miura, Miu

title: Mikansei No. 1
author: Majiko!
description: Rebellious 23rd-century girl Neo has big dreams of being a singing star, but her unusual fashion sense and personality keep her from making it big. When she finds herself transported to the 21st century, she finally gets her chance from a producer to sing with the guff Saya. If they put on a wonderful concert, they'll be the next big stars... but if they mess it up, they'll be nobodies forever!

title: Kiniro no Corda: Daigakusei-hen
author: Kure, Yuki
description:
Kiniro no Corda: Daigakusei-hen is set three years after where the previous series ended. Our favorite characters have moved on to college and are all pursuing the new goals that they have set for themselves. Far away in Austria, Tsukimori continues to keep in touch with Kahoko while steadily expanding his violin techniques. Comparing herself to the rest, Kahoko finds herself in distress! Will she be able to follow her heart and discover her own path as well?

(Source: Muses Scans)

title: Aitte Yatsu wo Utatte Miyouka
author: Nagayama, Ei
description: First year high school student Ari is fascinated by Youta-kun, the leader of a popular indies band, and ends up joining the band herself as a keyboardist.

title: PLAY!
author: Hanamizawa, Q-tarou
description: A heavy metal guitarist and a high school choir's soprano were tricked into forming a girl pop band.

title: Love Live! Sunshine!! School Idol Diary
author: Kimino, Sakurako, Kiyose, Akame
description: A novel series based on the TV series bundled with special limited edition Blu-ray discs volumes 1, 3, 5, and 7. It tells the different point of views of the characters in the story.

title: Shuumatsu no Koe
author: Agasa, Reiji
description: Rei Ametani lives his life day by day waiting for the sweet embrace of a merciful death. Although a former childhood trumpet genius, he now sleeps through classes—a much more ordinary lifestyle than his former one. This peace is suddenly interrupted, though, by a note found in his shoe locker. Believing it to be a fake love confession, he humors the sender by showing up at the appointed meeting spot. To his surprise, Sora Kamizono shows up with an unusual plea: she needs his help to destroy the

title: Go! Go! Heaven!: Jiketsu Shoujo-tai
author: Obara, Shinji, Umino, Yuuko
description:
Aya, Julia, Michelle, and Himiko don't know each other, but they all have the desire to end their lives. They meet through a site on the internet and decide to organize a rock concert. It will be unique in the sense that they want to die on stage, or at least that's what they plan to do. But will fate decide otherwise?

(Source: MU)

title: Nadeshiko Doremisora
author: Miyabi, Akino
description: Miya Nekoma made a bold high school debut in an attempt to change from her once "infamously" boring self. As a part of the change, she decided to join the school's Light Music Club, but on her way to sign up she is intercepted by the energetic shakuhachi flute player Hiyo Takemi who introduces her to the world of Wagakki, or traditional Japanese instruments. After the two attend a concert from one of Japan's leading traditional/modern fusion bands, Miya becomes enamored with the Tsugaru-shamisen

title: Hypnosis Mic: Division Rap Battle - side B.B & M.T.C+
author: Momose, Yuuichirou, Umami, Zaurus
description:
Following the events of the First Division Rap Battle, Ichirou Yamada and Samatoki Aohitsugi return to their normal lives, vowing to improve their rap skills in anticipation of the next Division Rap Battle. However, a mysterious new drug called "Grasshopper" begins to pop up on the streets of Ikebukuro and Yokohama. The drug induces violent mood swings and hallucinations, even causing its users to lose their minds and suffer a heart attack when they overdose.

Samatoki is tasked with eliminating

title: Karaoke de Utau Oneesan to Issho
author: Yamori, Shiki.

title: The Apartment
author: Arisawa, Ryou, Macomber, Debbie
description: When Hilary got a place on the San Francisco Symphony as a flute player, she decides to move into her own place to escape her restricted life with her over-protective mother. Although excited at her new found freedom, it doesn't last for long. The next morning, the quiche she left in the fridge for breakfast was gone, her milk had been used and an unfamiliar bag was in the living room! As she stood confused, a handsome man she had never seen before appeared in front of her and says to her angril

title: Wake Up, Girls!
author: gum
description: Green Leaves Entertainment is a tiny production company on the verge of going out of business in Sendai, the biggest city in Japan's northeastern Tohoku region. The agency once managed the careers of magicians, photo idols, fortune-tellers, and other entertainers, but its last remaining client finally quit. In danger of having zero talent (literally), the president Tange hatches an idea of producing an idol group. On the brash president's orders, the dissatisfied manager Matsuda heads out to sco

title: The Dawn in Moscow
author: Hwang, Jangmi, Lee, Shano
description: After giving up everything and going against his parents' wishes to pursue his dream of becoming a concert pianist, Siyoon Lee is met with a crippling end to his short-lived career when a car accident leaves his right hand immobile. Finding no reason left to live, he attempts to end his meaningless life. But, instead of meeting his maker, he awakens in the company of a large group of Russian servants. Thrown into this new life as Russian heiress, Tatiana Yuryevna Belchenova, there is one thing t

title: Ukare Bakemono no Hogaraka na Hatan
author: Takahashi, You, Ryuuguu, Tsukasa
description:
Ikuya Magasa is a freshman in high school with no dreams or particular interests, and so he just lets the days pass by. On their way home one day, his friend Kaze Amaba makes a shocking confession.

"Truth is, I'm a tengu."

Amaba had longed to live in the world of humans, and in order to remain there, he invites Ikuya to start a band. From then on, Ikuya's normal days started to become more and more abnormal…

title: SCRAMBLUES
author: mame march
description:
Haru Kurosaki once heard a stranger's song in high school that made him decide to finally follow his passions. Now, he's a graphic designer who's recently been put in charge of designing a CD jacket for the prodigy musical artist Eddie Astley.

On the outside, Eddie is intimidating and aloof—but when Haru spots him at a rock concert, he realizes how wrong that assumption is. As he sees beyond Eddie's surly exterior and catches a glimpse of the man beneath the affectation, Haru begins to think ab

title: Straight no Chaser
author: Ishizuka, Shinichi
description: Shuuhei is an endlessly enthusiastic pizza deliveryman with almost no ambitions or skills, and he's determined to date Hitomi, a high school girl who made the mistake of kissing him once. Her disinterest can't stop him from loving her, though! When he asks her what she likes in a man, one of the things she mentions was the ability to play a musical instrument. In response, he decides to learn to play the trumpet. But learning about the trumpet and jazz music is going to change his life in more w

title: Fly High
author: Sugiura, Kei
description: A collection of four funny and romantic short stories.

title: The Rock 'n Roll Band
author: Urasawa, Naoki
description: Chaos ensues after Take's guitar, which belonged to his late uncle, gets stolen.

title: Magic-kyun! Renaissance
author: Mio, Junta
description:
A world where art becomes magic. In this world, people who can inspire passion with their Magic Arts are called Artistas, and are employed in show business. In Hoshinomori Private Magical Arts High School, where Artistas are taught, a strange new student named Kohana Aigasaki transfers into the school.

Kohana is placed on the planning committee for the school's yearly Hoshinomori Summer Festa cultural festival. She spends her romantic school life with six other boys who aim to become entertaine

title: Afterschool Wind Orchestra
author: Usa, Yuichiro
description: Yoshitoshi Heion, 15 years old, average guy, finally begin his high school life. He hadn't been part of any club activities during all his school life. But he meets Rina Fujimoto at his new school and she seems to want to be part of the wind orchestra. Problem: It has been disbanded last year. How will it turn out ?

title: Puri x Puri: Himegimi wa Ouji-sama
author: Kiritani, Miki
description:
Kaguya Yuki is an ex-member of the idol group Kirakira * Moon. Set up by the other members who were jealous of her popularity, Yuki was banished from the entertainment world. She vows to make a come-back to take revenge against Kira * Moon!! …But for some reason, she ended up becoming a member of the male idol group ZAST as a new male member, Fuyutsuki Kaguya...!?

(Source: Aerandria)

title: The iDOLM@STER: Innocent Blue for Dearly Stars
author: Reiichi
description:
This manga adapts Mizutani Eri's route from the game The iDOLM@STER Dearly Stars.

Eri Mizutani,mostly known as ELLIE on Internet, is a hikikomori that spends most of her time chatting on the Internet with people that she hardly knows. One day she receives a message from a producer named Ozaki who encourages her to debut as a real idol. Eventually she is able to build up the courage to meet Ozaki.Then she makes her debut at the 876 productions. She meets Ai and Ryo there and decides to give up h

title: Tsuki to Sekai to Étoile
author: Takagami, Yuriko
description: Yozora enters the Moonlight Academy with the dream of becoming an etoile just like Umiyuri, whom she has admired. However, unexpected happening begin occurring...

title: Destinies Cross
author: Azumi, Moka
description:
Kazune joins the band KEEL and becomes their vocalist. But only after a while he is leaving to join the band BLANCA. Why is Kazune leaving suddenly? What will the members of KEEL think of him?

(Source: MU)

title: The iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls
author: Ayana, Yuniko, Ueto, Sou
description:
There are many idols with long-established talent agency 346 Production. And now the company is starting a new program, the Cinderella Project!

Girls leading normal lives...

They are chosen to be aspiring idols and see another world for the first time in this Cinderella story. Can they all climb the stairs that lead to the palace?

The magic begins now...

(Source: Daisuki)

title: Swingin' Dragon & Tiger Boogie
author: Haida, Koukou
description: One night in Fukui during an air raid in WW2, young Suwa Oto sees her jazz-loving older sister, Ineko, dance to bassist Odajima Tatsuji's music. Ineko later attempts suicide by drowning, and though rescued, is by war's end a shell of the sister who taught Oto to sing, and Odajima disappears. To reunite the two, Oto, now a student, carries her sister's bass across her back to Tokyo. When Oto's singing catches the attention of a troupe, she plays on a US military base and learns the troupe's bassi

title: The iDOLM@STER 2 Nemuri Hime
author: Akane, Kotetsu
description: A manga based on The iDOLM@STER 2 Chihaya's route.

title: Kanade: Aoharu Band Yuri Anthology
author: Asami, Yuriko, Gouto, Sora, Takeshima, Eku, Matsuda, Hikari, Ameno, Yuama, Takase, Waka
description: A yuri anthology featuring youthful girls who are part of a band.

title: Dadadadaan
author: Mapollo 3-gou
description:
Sadame Hino's life has always been dictated by his stern father. Though he was destined to follow in his father's footsteps and become a physician, Sadame realizes that is not what he wishes for himself. To ensure that future can never come to pass, the boy purposely fails every one of his high school entrance exams, sending his father into a fit of rage as he disowns his son.

Now freeloading off a stranger, Sadame has no idea what to do with his life. When his roommate has to move back home, S

title: Nibelung no Yubiwa
author: Matsumoto, Leiji
description: A sci-fi retelling of Wagner's "Ring of the Nibelungen," starring Captain Harlock.

title: Piano Lesson
author: Asou, Natsuko
description:
A lovestory about a student and her piano teacher. When the young student falls in love, she founds out more about her teacher. does she really love her? 

(Source: MU)

title: The iDOLM@STER Shiny Colors
author: Shinozaki, Akira
description: Follows the idol group Illumination STARS at 283 Production.

title: Guitar Shop Rosie
author: Takahashi, Tsutomu
description:
Guitar Shop Rosie is a guitar repair shop run by Angus and Malcolm, two brothers who aren't great at making money but who love AC/DC and rock music.  Guitars from all sorts of backgrounds and circumstances are brought in for repair.  This series portrays the stories behind the guitars being repaired and the shop's customers.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Included one-shot:
Volume 1: Guitar Shop Rosie (pilot)

title: Shinkyoku Soukai Polyphonica: Eternal White
author: Takadono, Madoka, Fujioka, Youko
description:
In the continent of Polyphonica, spirits materialize in the world, surviving on the music that is played by humans, and live together with them. While the spirits don't appear often, some spirits have enough power to materialize in human or animal forms and live together with humans.

Dantists, who play special music called "Commandia," are widely respected in this world. They are usually in contract with powerful spirits. The story of Shinkyoku Sōkai Polyphonica Eternal White revolves around th

title: The iDOLM@STER Dearly Stars: Splash Red
author: Sakano, Anri
description:
Ai, wishing to become an idol as famous as her mother once was, has been participating in tests at various talent agencies, but she has failed every single one of them. Her inability to even begin to follow into her mother's footsteps becomes a complex to her.

As Ai bursts into tears, alone in a public park, she is approached by 765 Production idol Haruka Amami, who was a special judge at one of the tests Ai has taken. Having sensed something special about Ai's singing, Haruka comforts her and

title: Zombieland Saga Anthology
author: Madara, Sai, Minakata, Sunao, Taguchi, Kenji, Kiyoshi, Saya, Yoshibe, Akuro, Tatsuhiko, Saburouta, Kumichou, Mekimeki, Akakokko, Banjou, Azusa, Kakemaru, Kakeru
description: An anthology comic of Zombieland Saga by various mangaka.

title: Variation
author: Takemiya, Keiko
description: A history of the musicians Wolfgang Rechter and Edoard Soltie.

title: To the Other Side of the Glare
author: Takemiya, Jin
description:
1. Worst Kiss no Tsukaikata
2. Mabushisa no Mukougawa
3. Yurhythm
4. Mousou Artifact
5. Mix
6. Idol-tachi no Kyuusoku

title: Mahou no Stage Fancy Lala
author: Kasuga, Rurika
