description: One day, nine-year old girl Miho Shinohara is given two stuffed dinosaurs by a stranger. The stuffed dinosaurs come to life and present her with a magic sketchbook and a pen. Within limits, and subject to varying degrees of control, she can draw in the sketchbook and bring the drawings to life. Miho can also transform into a teenage girl, whom she names Fancy Lala. Fancy Lala is scouted by Yumi Haneishi, the president of the talent agency Lyrical Productions, and begins the long road to stardom.

title: Benten Rock You.
author: Watarai, Keiji
description:
A Japanese goddess of old takes a keen interest in Anamori Izumi and her ability, a more powerful form of synesthesia. The goddess has a request for her, one which will require her to break out of her shell...and learn how to play the electric guitar.

(Source: Batoto)

title: Hatsune Miku - Project DIVA: Omnibus Comic
author: KEI, TNSK
description: Manga adaption of the Project DIVA games.

title: Shinkyoku Soukai Polyphonica Crimson
author: Sakaki, Ichirou, Kannatsuki, Noboru
description:
In the continent of Polyphonica, spirits materialize in the world, surviving on the music that is played by humans, and live together with them. While the spirits don't appear often, some spirits have enough power to materialize in human or animal forms and live together with humans.

Dantists, who play special music called "Commandia," are widely respected in this world. They are usually in contract with powerful spirits. The story of Shinkyoku Soukai Polyphonica revolves around the new Dantist

title: Tenshi no 3P!
author: Mizutani, Yuzu, Aoyama, Sagu
description: Nukui Kyou is a first year high school student hikikomori. His hobby is making vocaloid songs and uploading them online. One day he receives a mail from a fan asking if they could meet up with him. At the meeting place, 3 elementary school girls were waiting for him. The 3 of them want to form a band, and ask for Kyou's help.

title: Island Rock
author: Manose, Miharu
description:
Uncomplicated rock 'n' roll for the complicated heart! The curtain rises on this remote island, where a tale of youthful band life begins.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: West Tokyo Metal Bros
author: Sezawa, Nobuko
description:
Haruo is a high schooler from Biei, Hokkaido. When he was younger, expressing his emotions wasn't easy, but one day metal set him free. Since then, he's been honing his skills day in and day out, but now it's for him to decide on his next stage in life…?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Rhapsody in Red
author: Amidamuku
description: A story about a boy who decides to play piano to express himself.

title: About a Love Song
author: Natsuno, Hiroko
description:
Band member Hoshina wants to do something with music but struggles to write love songs. Recently, his co-worker at a convenience store and a college student, Seto-kun, has been dazzling with purity and... Healing. On a day that Seto-kun is sad and drenched in the rain, Hoshina takes him home and spends the night with him. But the next morning, it turns out that Seto-kun is "younger" than he thought he was...!

Hoshina is shaken with regret. Although Hoshina tries to be sincere in his mature and

title: Superstar Associate Manager
author: Park, Kyungwon, Lee, Jaeguk
description:
Hoyeon Cheon is an associate manager at Korea Capital, a finance company where his career is stagnating. One night, stuck with the cleanup after a long evening of karaoke with colleagues, he decides to sing one more song. Little does he know that the ghost of the wild-child rock star Jihyeok Han has been waiting, hoping to find the perfect vessel for his superstar aura...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Tonkatsu DJ Agetarou
author: Koyama, Yuujirou, Epyao
description: Agetarou works at his family's tonkatsu restaurant in Shibuya, but he's not very excited by the work. One day, he takes a delivery to the staff of a night club, and the worker lets him in to enjoy the club for a while. Agetarou finds that he loves the club, with its relaxed people and cute girls, all enjoying the music supplied by the DJ. He continues going to the club, until the night comes when the guest American DJ Big Master Fly puts on a show. Agetarou is inspired by Big Master Fly, and rea

title: Lapis Re:LiGHTs
author: Hiroichi
description:
Based on a mixed media project that blends fantasy, magical girl, and idol elements, Lapis Re:LiGHTs will follow a group of students as they train to become idols. Together, they'll use the magic of music and the magic of... well, literal magic... in their performances.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Fool on the Rock
author: Tamaki, Chihiro
description: Ever since he was kicked out of his previous friend's rock band, Hoshino gave up playing the guitar... until he couldn't take his high school student's life anymore which led him to decide to create a new band. Maybe they will never become famous, maybe they will face a great amount of difficulties for months before being able to play live, but that's not important! What is important, is to enjoy yourself, let out everything, to feel music sound within yourself!

title: Bakumatsu Rock: Howling Soul
author: Ueda, Shinshu
description: The Tokugawa shogunate uses the brainwashing "Heaven's Songs" by the top idols in Shinsengumi to subjugate the country and its people. In this Japan, writing or singing any songs besides the "Heaven's Songs" is a capital offense. Ryouma Sakamoto and the other rockers rise up and change the world with rock 'n' roll for freedom and justice.

title: Polyphonica: Cardinal Crimson
author: Sakaki, Ichirou, Ocelot, Hirokawa, Tomo
description:
In a place called Polyphonica, humans and spirits live side by side. Young musicians create magical sounds with their music, which binds the spirits to them. A struggling student named Phoron accidentally summons a spirit he met in childhood but later forgot about. Phoron could use all the help he can get, but this feisty spirit may prove to be more than he can handle!

(Source: CMX)

title: Unsung Hero
author: Uratani, Mizuki, Taigami
description:
The stage is set when Ichirou Gomen, a newbie producer of the record company Gaia loses yet another production opportunity to inexperience. Wanting to pass on his childhood dreams of stardom to a fledgling singer, he toils learning the process day by day through failure.

However, his life is sent into a loop when he follows a beautiful performing voice, the voice of Jam Hiiragi, playing live to a group of homeless people at a streetside. Wrangling the prodigy talent and her bratty complications

title: Superstar wo Uttate.
author: Usuba, Kei
description:
"I don't know if I want to rap. I don't have anything I want to sing."

Yukito Ooji, is a 17-year-old drug dealer living on the streets of Osaka in a hopeless environment, killing his emotions. He lost his mother, a drug addict, and his beloved sister when he was a child, leaving him alone in the world, but he has a best friend who believes in him. Will he be able to get out of his helpless situation?

(Source: MU)

title: Love Live! Sunshine!!: School Idol Diary
author: Kimino, Sakurako, Oda, Masaru

title: Present from Lemon
author: Katsura, Masakazu
description:
Young Lemon Sawaguchi has a gift for music: whoever listens to him can't help to be carried away by his marvellous ringing voice.
Lemon's only ambition is to realize the dreams of his father, who died before he could start his career as a professional singer.
Which won't be an easy task...

title: Unfinished Love Song
author: Akota
description:
Kazari is a popular vocalist in a band. He has a "secret" that he can't tell anyone. Koutarou, a younger rookie guitarist, joined the band as a new member through the introduction of Kei, a member of the same band. From the first time they met, Koutarou was interested in Kazari and tried to close the gap between them forcefully. Although he felt it was bothersome, he continued to brush him off, saying that he would be happy to hang out with him if it was just for fun.

One day, Koutarou saw an e

title: Bespoken
author: Happy B
description: For indie band vocalist Hoyeong, music is everything—his passion, his life, his identity. But when the charismatic CEO of a famous fashion label, Yijun Lee, approaches him with an unexpected offer to model for his brand, Hoyeong's world is turned upside down. As their creative worlds of music and fashion collide, Ho-Young finds himself drawn into a whirlwind of emotions, desires, and unexpected connections that challenge everything he thought he knew about himself. In the tension between fame an

author: Nishiuma, Soushi
description:
Anzu is a high school girl who lives her days in a "comfortable environment" provided by her mother, where she is not allowed to go against her mother. Influenced by her late father, Anzu loves listening to music, and looks forward to visiting the listening corner of a CD shop, hiding it from her mother. One day, Anzu meets a man playing the guitar. This is the first serialized work by the 22-year-old, who won the Newcomer Comics Grand Prize.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: 666 Dopes
author: Satou, Sato
description:
Love even the scars.

Rings, chokers, black nails, and countless piercings in his ears—Akane is an eccentric member of the struggling band 666DOPES. Though Toui is at his mercy, he takes good care of him out of his weakness for love. Akane repeatedly hurts himself and demands painful sex. Confused but wanting to love him, Toui becomes curious to find out about the trauma he hides in his heart.

"Why do you hurt yourself?"

"No reason."

But a dark past lurks behind Akane. Between Thanatos and Er

title: No Sound World
author: Ii, Ichino
description:
Chitose is quite popular and yet he has nothing he could get himself into and had no experience of falling in love. This made Chitose annoyed with himself. One day after school, he found Noiri in the music room playing the piano, and decided to learn the cello from him. It was just something that started from a whim, but as they spend time together, Chitose fell for Noiri. But it seems, Noiri is hiding a secret...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Aiming for the Moon, Becoming the Star
author: Nakaoka, Naka
description:
Still a high schooler, Misumi is a skilled pianist with dreams of becoming professional. But, after a traumatic experience in his past, Misumi struggles to perform in public. When Minatobe suddenly begs Misumi to teach him how to play the piano, Misumi gradually overcomes his fears and through their friendship and then relationship.

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

Included one-shot:
Volume 2: Eureka

title: Sono Te ni Muse ga Yorisou
author: Toriumi, Youko
description:
Working as a piano tuner, Yuzuru had met various kinds of pianist. But when the music of a unique and eccentric pianist Rion reaches his ears, he knows that he won't be able to escape from the latter's charms. And when Rion confesses his love and convey his desire to make Yuzuru as his official piano tuner, Yuzuru find it as something that is hard to believe. Does Rion like him for who he is or his skills?

(Source: MU)

title: Sora Tobu Violin
author: Mihara, Kazuto
description:
The series follows a bitter young man who doesn't care for music. One day, a mysterious girl appears before him.

(Source: ANN)

title: Yonkoma Starlight
author: Makimaki, Mawaru
description: A four-panel spin-off story following the adventures of the 99th Graduating Class from the main series of Shoujo☆Kageki Revue Starlight.

title: Paradox Live Stage Battle "Comic"
author: naru
description:
In the near future where hip-hop culture has grown saturated, a phenomenon known as Phantom Lives has entered the scene. Using accessories made from a material called Phantom Metal, rappers create beautiful illusions of their lyrics from their own DNA and emotions. However, this activates so-called Trap Responses that force them to relive their past traumas. A decade ago, the legendary Club Paradox, run by the rapper duo BURAIKAN, dominated the scene but then suddenly vanished.

Now, as Club Par

title: Plaster cast idol group of Gods and Heroes
author: Nanai, Takana
description:
Miki Ishimoto, a recent college graduate, is so excited to have landed her first job! Although she's inexperienced, she's to be the manager for a new boy band. Miki thinks life couldn't be going more smoothly, until she finds out that her new boy band members are all... Greco-Roman stone busts?

Join leader Saint George, talented Hermes, passionate Mars, and the pretty boy Medici as they take the entertainment world by storm in Sekkou Boys!

title: RAiSe!: The Story of My Music
author: Shiihara, Ryuu
description: The story of how RAISE A SUILEN was formed.

title: Tokyo 7th Sisters Comic Anthology
author: Rokushou, Kokuu, Nagian, Tsukudani, Norio, Suzuka, Hanatsuka, Shiori, Hoppege, Koruri, Nekomint, Takahara, Yu
description:
An anthology of Tokyo 7th Sisters by various mangaka.

In the year 2032, the legendary idol unit "7th Sisters" suddenly retired from the industry and disappeared. That was the end of the idol industry... until two years later, when a young glory-seeking employee is appointed to be the leader of Tokyo's next generation idol studio, "777 (Three Seven)," commonly referred to as Nanastar.

However, the city continues to believe that idols are a thing of the past, and Nanastar is no exception. Their

title: "Aruto" no "A"
author: Akaishi, Michiyo
description:
Aruto Kashiwayama is a budding pianist. She lodges at a famous conductor's house. Aruto's relationships with the conductor's son Hokuto and her first love Masaru are revealed.

(Source: MU)

title: VS.
author: Yamada, Keiko
description:
Sometimes it takes a person who has shared your dream to make it come true. For Reiji, a gifted violinist with no formal training, success may be the key to escaping from his miserable home life. Mitsuko was also a prodigy until an accident left her unable to play. Now she is going to help Reiji achieve the goal she could never attain. Passions and rivalries play out against the backdrop of the music world, while Reiji's family background provides intense, emotional drama. (sorce: CMX)

The fina

title: BanG Dream! Yonkoma: Bandori!
author: Shiroi, Hakuto
description: BanG Dream! Yonkoma: Bandori! is a 4-koma manga featuring the characters from BanG Dream!

title: Utae! Erinna
author: Satou, Futaba
description: Ancient Greece. In a time when women were not even permitted to step foot outdoors on their own... Erinna is a bit of a strange girl who aspires to join the ranks of Greece's finest artists: the poets. Taken under the wing of Sappho, the greatest poetess of her day, Erinna wholeheartedly ignores her maidenhood and domestic training to throw herself into song and harp! She'll be participating in a choir competition in the spring, but...?! Set in an Ancient Greek girls' school, experience the stor

title: Boy Evolution
author: Kusanagi, Toshiki
description:
Asou Mizuki is the most popular singer in the country at just 16 years old. However, he is actually a father of a 14-year-old, and 29. He passes by as a young boy, and a very innocent and loved by the population, but once he gets home, becomes the bossiest guy around.

His son, Sana, is always bossed around by his father, and on many occasions, made to go to his father's work because he is lazy, or has a hangover.

But he finds a girlfriend at his father's work...

title: 88rhapsody
author: Sorai, Mone
description:
Miya, a keyboardist in the band Aldebaran, awakens to find an unknown man sleeping next to him...! The man's identity is Ritsuki, a music student, who is expected to be a pianist with a promising future. However, the pressure crushes him and he falls into a slump. Miya, who was born into a musical family and has gone through a similar experience, feels compelled to help him...

(Source: Kedama Scans, edited)

Included one-shot: 27star

title: Beethoven Reborn
author: Woojin, Jayeongi
description:
Only music sustained me from the maddening pain. If only I could hear my music... with my own ears... Even as my soul was falling apart, I prayed to God... and prayed again.

Ludwig van Beethoven, considered the greatest composer in human history, closed his eyes like that. And 180 years later in Seoul. The saint of music, known as an immortal genius, has been reborn. And then he began to hear the voice of an angel. "Dobin... Dobin..."

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: THE iDOLM@STER -Your Mess@ge-
author: Kusakabe, Rei
description: A manga adaptation of the Idolmaster Live for You! XBOX game.

title: Sound! Euphonium: Welcome to the Marching Band!
author: Asada, Nikki, Takeda, Ayano

title: Ten kara Kita
author: Ishii, Asuka
description:
A short story about a female aspiring singer to follow her grandfathers footsteps and an angel who follow the orders of his father an elder angel who met female singers grandfather when he was young.

(Source: MU)

title: Love Live! Flowers*: Hasunosora Jogakuin School Idol Club
author: Tsumumi

title: Love Live! School Idol Diary Special Edition
author: Kimino, Sakurako, Takami, Yuuki

title: Ami! Nonstop
author: Kitagawa, Miyuki
description:
Ami is a normal school girl. One day with her friends, she got stopped for an interview by a camera crew who thought Ami was really cute.

Shortly afterwards, Ami meets a blond boy who goes to her school named Nozomu. He seems to show some interest in her too. However, after she went to the 'Darwin', a group of two boy singers, concert, she met another Nozomu.

Very soon after the encounter with Darwin, she then got roped into the entertainment world as there were many people already interested

title: BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!! Swaying in the Rain, Looking for the Sunshine
author: Yuama, Haibuchi, Yotsuji
description: A prequel to BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!! depicting the formation of CRYCHIC from Soyo Nagasaki's perspective.

title: Zettai Donkan
author: Unita, Yumi
description:
Taki Kanon and Nakamori Ryou met through a piano in their first year of high school. Nakamori played video game songs beautifully, while Taki's talent lay in piano tuning. They were in the same class, and they spent a lot of time together at a piano. But shyness and misunderstanding plagued the formation of a more serious relationship. Over the years, will they be able to find a way to make the paths of their lives finally converge?

(Source: Mangahelpers)

title: The iDOLM@STER: Cinderella Girls - Rockin' Girl
author: Hama-chon
description: Based on the iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls mobile game. The story focuses on Riina Tada, Kanako Mimura, and Rika Jougasaki.

title: 22/7+α
author: Kasai, Nao
description: A collection of original stories not seen in the anime.

title: D4DJ: The Starting of Photon Maiden
author: Benino, Atsu

title: Ensemble Stars!
author: Akira
description:
The main plot of the novel follows the game's main story, but in the novel readers are now given insight on Anzu's thoughts, as well as more in-depth characterization of some characters.

(Source: The English Ensemble Stars!! Wiki)

title: Arty Square
author: Oki, Mamiya
description: The member of the band "Asgard" are making music just for fun, but one day they get their chance: A big deal with a major record label! Can they manage it to be a professional band?

title: Song of Friends
author: Iwashita, Keiko
description:
Akane is a nice and cheerful girl whose dream has always been to become a singer and reach many people with her voice. To achieve it, she even gave up on having a normal and fun time with her high school friends... until one day she meets a girl, Fumi, and by befriending her undergoes major changes in her life. This is the story of their friendship and their shared love for music.

Included one-shot: Tomodachi Enja

title: Asayake Refrain
author: Matsuda, Hikari
description:
Kokoro is a high school girl whose hobby is quietly uploading her original songs to the internet. When an unexpected character responds to her song, her blinded youth suddenly picks up with a boom!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Star Dream Idol Project
author: Baixiong, Yantou hstone
description:
The shining lights, the magnificent stage! Friendships created through singing, making a future through dancing, the girls embark on their journey towards their dreams! One who has lost status due to a scandal is hiding a plot behind her back. A pair of bosom friends, separated by fate. A girl who tries to exonerate her mother sets off on her journey for a talent competition. When the stage turns into an empty battlefield, she uses her voice to chase after her dreams.

(Source: SideWalk Group)

title: Hashikko Ensemble
author: Kio, Shimoku
description:
The story takes place at a technical high school. The protagonist, who has a voice complex, is approached by a classmate who wants to start a choir club.

(Source: ANN)

title: Studio Chizu's Belle
author: Hosoda, Mamoru
description: Suzu, a seventeen-year-old high school student living in rural Kochi Prefecture, has kept the world at arm's length ever since her mother's death years ago. But at a friend's urging, she decides to dip her toes into another world: U, the largest online community in history. As her avatar, Belle, Suzu reveals her hidden singing talent and instantly becomes a global internet sensation, leading her to cross paths with a mysterious beast known as the Dragon. Who is this ferocious yet lonely stranger

title: Kuchibiru ni Uta wo
author: Mori, Taishi, Nakata, Eiichi
description: The story follows Kashiwagi, a stunningly beautiful, self-described NEET (Not in Employment, Education, or Training) part-time teacher who went to a music college in Tokyo. Her old middle-school classmate Matsuyama is now the advisor for a middle school chorus club on Nagasaki Prefecture's Gotou Islands, but she has to go on maternity leave. Matsuyama asks Kashiwagi to take over the club for one year. The chorus club had only female members before, but the arrival of Kashiwagi suddenly attracts

title: Tansansui-bu
author: Kamijyo, Akimine
description:
The story centers around Shintarou Taki, a boy who just entered high school. While wandering around looking for an after school activity to join, he comes across the wind instrument band. The members are all somewhat odd. Plus, there is a secret within the band that no one else knows.

(Source: ANN)

title: Gekijouban Wake Up, Girls!: Shichinin no Idol
author: Machida, Touko, Hirokawa, Tomo
description: Green Leaves Entertainment is a tiny production company on the verge of going out of business in Sendai, the biggest city in Japan's northeastern Tohoku region. The agency once managed the careers of magicians, photo idols, fortune-tellers, and other entertainers, but its last remaining client finally quit. In danger of having zero talent (literally), the president Tange hatches an idea of producing an idol group. On the brash president's orders, the dissatisfied manager Matsuda heads out to sco

title: Hypnosis Mic: Division Rap Battle - side D.H. & B.A.T+
author: Momose, Yuuichirou, calamarium
description:
With the Second Division Rap Battle around the corner, the matriarchal Party of Words finalizes the details of having a six-team tournament. To earn one of the spots in the competition, the Dotsuitare Honpo crew—Sasara Nurude, Rosho Tsutsujimori, and Rei Amayado—must survive the preliminary matches first. However, such is easier said than done, as Rosho's stage fright makes him question his usefulness to the team.

Meanwhile, Bad Ass Temple starts gearing up for the preliminaries, but each membe

title: Shinkyoku Soukai Polyphonica Crimson S
author: Sakaki, Ichirou, Kannatsuki, Noboru
description: A prequel series focusing on the school days of Phoron.

title: A Bouquet for Cowards
author: Inomiya, Miya
description: Kaoru Yase is a third-year college student and part-time florist doing his best. Running late to class one day, he accidentally bumps into professional pianist Kouichi Sumizome and spills his drink onto the pianist's sheet music. While Koichi easily waves off everything as an accident, Kaoru is adamant about reimbursing him for the damage done. After a few stubborn tries, Kouichi relents Kaoru's offer of a personalized bouquet. Does a friendship then bloom between the two or maybe something more

title: Sono Shukujo wa Guuzou to Naru
author: Matsumoto, Yousuke
description:
It unfolds here... The story of a girl who gave up on being an idol. Himemiya Sakurako is a student from Elizabeth Girls' School. She is popular in the school for being the role model of a lady. However, that was merely a mask she wore...?!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Glamorous Voice
author: Minase, Masara
description:
One day Kento, a vocalist in a small band, is scouted by a talent agency to become a part of a professional band. The problem is, he knows the guy that the band is going to be centered around, the prodigious Takatou Karou....and does not like him a tiniest bit?

(Source: MU)

Included one-shots:
Volume 2: Kokoro to Karada no Hazama (The Interval Between the Heart and the Body), Midara na Sasayaki (Indecent Whispers)

title: Million Doll
author: Ai
description:
Million Doll revolves around Suuko, an idol-loving hikikomori (shut-in) who has one ability: to make any idol popular through the power of blogging. She puts her sights on the Fukuoka's idol Itorio and tries to make her sell more, but she is impeded by the charismatic idol Ryuu-san and the underground idol Mariko.

(Source: ANN)

title: Love Beat
author: Kaida, Bora
description: A couple of musicians get caught in the rain on their way home and decide to stay at an Internet cafe for the night.

title: Miss Monochrome: Motto Challenge
author: Fudeyasu, Kazuyuki, Toono, Nana
description:
"Miss Monochrome" is an original character design from seiyuu Horie Yui. In March 2012, she first used the "Miss Monochrome" character as a 3D virtual singer to sing her songs at her concert Horie Yui wo Meguru Bouken III ~Secret Mission Tour~. Later, the character appeared in a range of merchandise as well as in the social network game Girlfriend (Beta).

According to the setting, Miss Monochrome loves only the monochrome style, dislikes all kinds of color, and always dreams about changing the

title: Crush
author: Tateko
description:
Kyo is a college student living alone in Tokyo, completely absorbed in making rap beats. One day, his childhood friend Mana from back home shows up at his door. As they suddenly find themselves living together, Kyo must confront both his conflicted feelings and his music.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Shine Post: Did You Know? The Most Ordinary, Natural, and Unique Magic to Make Me an Absolute Idol
author: Rakuda, Kawasemi, Makiko
description:
The idol unit "TINGS" has big dreams, but only small achievements, and is not very popular. The best manager in the world was supposed to be their savior, but... "I'm not interested in being your manager." The man who shows up is Naose Hinaki, a man with no motivation. However, he has a special power...? This is a story of you and the girls shining brightly to become "absolute idols." The best idol entertainment begins here!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Cinderella wa Nemurenai
author: Kurahashi, Erika
description:
A girl whose dream is to be a world renowned pianist. A guy who is a popular pop star. Would it be love at first sight? Rin just moved back to Japan, and Yuya, a popular artist lives next to her. Unhappy incidents between them happen and Rin's crush, Ryochi falls for another artist, Akaya! She is upset but her relationship with Yuya seems to improve. Will she fall for Yuya in the end? And will she become a world renowned pianist?

(Source: SweetLove)

title: Outer Halo
author: Kanai
description:
When his band breaks up and Sora is feeling lost, he happens to attend a concert where he reunites with Naoharu Tamaki, an upperclassman from his middle school. "I know that voice..." A vivid memory from 10 years ago comes back to him. But there's a huge distance between Naoharu, shining in the light of the stage, and Sora, standing in the audience... The faint memory of his first love is reflected in these glittering lights. Sora and Nao's love story begins with a fated reunion.

(Source: Kodan

title: When You Play the Last Chord
author: Taguchi, Hiroto
description:
Hisashi Kunomiya slipped into the abandoned hotel at midnight, ready to end it all, when the sound of a guitar suddenly broke the silence. There in the darkness, a girl played alone...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Love Live! Sunshine!! Comic Anthology Sweet Lily
author: Kurukuruhime, Gratin-dori
description: An anthology of stories centered around the idol band Aqours by various mangakas.

title: Change!
author: Soda, Masahito
description:
The manga centers on Shiori Kozono, a high school girl who leads a prim and proper everyday life. But one day, she follows her friend Miki into a club, and she finds a contest where girls use words as weapons. Shiori steps into the world of freestyle rap battles!

(Source: ANN)

title: Kamisama mo Shiranai
author: Uchida, Kazuna
description:
Due to Yuto's sudden death, Eiji, his elder twin brother, who was merely a college sudent, was forced to substitute for the charismatic vocalist of a popular rock band. The guitarist, Toru, who loved Yuto, painfully watches Eiji, who resembles Yuto, while at the same time, Hikawa, who is Yuto's lover and also the producer of their band, tries to have sex with Eiji as he doesn't know the truth. And then...?

(Source: Countless Time)

title: Ongaku to Manga
author: Oohashi, Hiroyuki
description:
The story revolves around a rock band formed by a trio of punks, none of whom had prior experience with musical instruments.

Included one-shots: Yama, Ramen, Manga

title: Seiten High School Idol-bu!
author: Kaneda, Yousuke
description: Misaki, a former delinquent transfers schools in hope of changing her life. But everyone is afraid of her until she meets Akira, the club chief of the idol club.

title: Melody of the Boundary
author: Sugimoto, Iqura, Miyata, Toshiya
description:
Kyousuke and Kai are two up-and-coming musicians. However, the day before their big debut, Kai passes away in a terrible traffic accident. Three years later, Kyousuke has all but given up music when his supposedly deceased partner appears before him as if nothing happened. Kai reminds his friend of the magic of music, encouraging him to start playing again. Can Kyousuke overcome his past and bring the color back into his world once more?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Sounds Like
author: Soyeon
description:
The hidden genius Cha Su-in returns five years into the past after his one and only brother is murdered. He then decides to enter "Pick Band 2," the sequel to the band audition his brother won—and the very stage where his brother's killer made their debut.

"You will never debut peacefully."

The long-suppressed geniuses' revenge begins.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Composi!
author: Yoshimura, Tsumuji
description:
A war rages through the city, where battles are fought with music. Theo is disappointed by his brother Will's refusal to take part in the war, despite his talent for composing battle music, and decides to take matters into his own hands by using the music Will has composed.

(Source: MU)

title: D@YS OF Jupiter: THE IDOLM@STER
author: Asa, Natsumi
description: In an era of competitive Idols, there's one idol group that gazes over all of them, overwhelming the masses and leading the idol world, the incarnation of Zeus himself… “Jupiter”.

title: Visual Prison: Comics
author: Mintozushi
description:
After the death of his grandmother who raised him, Ange Yuki travels to Tokyo to pursue the ghost of a childhood dream. His favorite vocalist, Guiltia "Guil" Brion of the band ECLIPSE, was once active in that city. Although Ange does not believe he has what it takes to sing himself, he wishes to follow in his idol's footsteps.

While in Harajuku, Ange witnesses an unbelievable live performance by ECLIPSE, which has now been reduced to only two members. As he is caught up in the music, the rival

title: Paradise Noise
author: Sugii, Hikaru, Akinashi, Yuu
description: When I dressed up as a woman and posted a music video on the internet, I suddenly became famous as a mysterious high school girl net musician (although I'm really a guy). I thought it was okay as long as I didn't show my face, but my high school music teacher, Misao Hanazono, discerned my identity, and I was blackmailed. My high school life—which should have been uneventful—was noisily and annoyingly colored by the three girls I meet through Hanazono-sensei: Rinko, the "twisted genius pianist,"

title: 17 Easy
author: Saitou, Rin
description:
Asahara Yuu attends a private high school for the fine arts.  Her parents are professional musicians and she herself is a good pianist.  With her talent and looks, everything has come easy for her, but when her parents force her to live in the school dorms with the visual art students while they are away for the year, things take a very sharp turn...

Note: Vol. 3 of this series also contains a one-shot titled "Gozen Oji no Saishuu Ressha" about a guy photographer who is wondering whether it is

title: Hop Step Sing!
author: Kodama, Rei, Asube, Yui
description:
Shy Niina Nijikawa loves to sing, but hates to perform—the thought of an audience scares her speechless—which leaves her dreams of being an idol dead in the water. But when a classmate introduces her to the world of VR, her world opens up... and she finds that becoming an idol—a VR idol—is within her reach after all!

(Source: Kodansha Comics USA)

title: Can't Sing a Love Song.
author: Abe, Hachita
description:
Chihiro, who quit his previous band due to a failed love affair, has been a vocalist in his current band for two years after being invited by Mikumo. Chihiro has been asked to sing a love song many times, but for some reason he has always refused. In their final year of college, job hunting started to get them busy, and before the band part their ways, Mikumo confesses how much he loves Chihiro's voice and asks him to rethink the idea of singing a love song for the last time.

(Source: Gentosha

title: Uchuu no Dekigoto
author: Tashiro, Shintarou
description:
A fish-faced scientist hears pleasant music in the distance. As the captivating melody draws him closer, he realizes its true value and decides to capture it—sending it off to a distant neighbor.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Sunnyside
author: Furukawa, Youya
description:
Back in high school, Shinonome-senpai was the shining star of the light music club. But when Sumi reunited with her 3 years later, something about her had changed completely...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Shine Post: Nee Shitteta? Watashi wo Zettai Idol ni Suru Tame no, Goku Futsuu de Atarimae na, Tobikkiri no Mahou
author: Buriki, Rakuda
description:
The idol unit "TINGS" has big dreams, but only small achievements, and is not very popular. The best manager in the world was supposed to be their savior, but... "I'm not interested in being your manager." The man who shows up is Naose Hinaki, a man with no motivation. However, he has a special power...? This is a story of you and the girls shining brightly to become "absolute idols." The best idol entertainment begins here!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Nordiska Sonata
author: Takemiya, Keiko
description: A collection of music-related oneshots, one of which is called Vienna Concerto.

title: Bra Bra Ban Ban
author: Kashiwagi, Haruko
description:
Shirahase Ayumu is a shy junior high school trumpeter. He isn’t the popular kid, and he has trouble speaking with other people, but when he has that trumpet he feels on top of the world. One day when playing alone in a park after running away from a social function he spots a girl playing the French Horn, whom he can’t keep up with.

After entering high school, he discovers that this girl is Seryuu Yuriko, a fairly gifted musician who has attempted repeatedly to give it up because her mind enter

title: Jun
author: Kim, Keum-suk
description:
This is the true story of Jun, who was born with autism in a country, South Korea, which views disability with extreme suspicion.  After years of trying to "cure" their son, his parents discovered his great passion for traditional music, and through his extraordinary talent, Jun will be able to fully express himself as he has never done before.

(Source: BAO Publishing, translated)

title: >5:00 PM Revolution
author: Takemiya, Keiko
description: The story of Rin, a young dancer.

title: Dungeon & Girls Band
author: Araido, Kagiri
description:
The band Mayonnais has never had an audience at their live shows. So they pray to God for someone to listen to their performance, but who appears before them?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Rappa Rendan
author: Tamura, Ryuuhei
description:
The story will focus on a man named Otonashi, who gave up on the way of the piano.

(Source: ANN)

title: LiveRevolt
author: Sakura, Yuki, Sejima, Haruki
description:
"It is obvious that we can listen music for free." In a such world, events offering live music have started gathering attention once again. In a training school for live events, Kanadegaoka Jogakuin (Kanadegaoka Girls Academy), girls are struggling to reach the top.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Little Challenger: Wake Up, Girls! - Side I-1 Club
author: U.G.E, Machida, Touko
description: Spin-off with I-1 club's point of view.

title: 37ºC: Boku no Ichiban Suki na Mono
author: Okano, Fumika
description: Guitarist Kai's father passed away when Kai was young, leaving his mother and younger brother as his only family until recently when his mother remarried.  Now, Kai and his brother have been living with their stepfather and new stepsister, Miyu, for about a year.  It's the kind of happiness Kai had always wanted for his family ever since he was a child and he certainly cannot rock the boat.  That's why it is absolutely imperative that no one find out he is in love with Miyuu.  Still, he can't he

title: Love Song Unlock
author: Fujimura, Ayao
description: Guitarist Kouhei is always fighting with his other band members due to wanting to go a different direction. Then while he's at a local music venue, he hears an incredible singing voice and falls in love at first "sound." He doesn't know who the voice belongs to or where it came from, but when X mysteriously appears, Kouhei unconsciously gets hard. He searches desperately to find him again, but his only clues were X's voice and a tattoo on his left arm. After several months with no luck, he runs

title: The Lobster and the Salmon
author: Toritome
description:
Ebisawa, who plays guitar and sings in a band, was inspired by Shake's guitar playing and singing in "The Salmons." Determined not to lose, he pushed himself harder. Though his efforts paid off and Ebisawa gained popularity, the seemingly unbridgeable gap between himself and Shake eventually broke his spirit...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: The iDOLM@STER Million Live!: Theater Days - Brand New Song
author: ima

title: Koko ga Genkai no Oval Gakuen
author: Ooi, Masakazu, Maki

title: Kirai de Isasete: Manager to Otoha
author: Hijiki
description: A spin-off of Kirai de Isasete featuring Otoha and his manager.

title: Root∞Rexx: Honey Melody
author: Mikanagi, Touya
description: Legendary band REXX was only popular when releasing their debut single. They never revealed their faces. A taciturn boy who found a CD of REXX's that was never publicized, and a group of band who named themselves REXX tries to revive the band!

title: Gakusei Shoujo
author: Kishida, Mel, Sugii, Hikaru
description:
A novel fantasy genre based on music. The MC is taken back in time to the 1800s by a devil under the pact made by Johann Wolfgang von Goethe. According to the devil, Goethe's request is for his body to be replaced by MC's, and then his soul to be implanted into MC's body and to slowly take over. As such, MC shares memory and knowledge of Goethe. The devil will claim Goethe's soul (which is now MC's soul) the moment MC declares he wishes time to stop due a state of ultimate bliss.

(Source: C.E.

title: Go-On!
author: Akishige, Manabu
description: Ryou Katase is a high school student who has always been treated as an errand boy by his juniors on the baseball club. He has always been an unpopular guy and people even often mistakenly call his name. His life however is forever changed when Nagano, a female classmate who happens to be his high school crush, lends him Weezer's first album and when he meets Yomogida, a wild, insane, and unpredictable guy who asks him to form a band.

title: Nerima Daikon Brothers
author: Kondou, Takamitsu, Studio Hibari
description: The somewhat rough Hideki, former idol Mako, and cool host Ichiro live together on a stage in the middle of a daikon field. Their dream is to build a concert dome there to perform blues music to the masses, but they're just too poor to get anywhere.

title: The iDOLM@STER Million Live!: Blooming Clover
author: Inayama, Kakuya

title: Paradise Noise
author: Sugii, Hikaru, Shino, Akisato
description: When I dressed up as a woman and posted a music video on the internet, I suddenly became famous as a mysterious high school girl net musician (although I'm really a guy). I thought it was okay as long as I didn't show my face, but my high school music teacher, Misao Hanazono, discerned my identity, and I was blackmailed. My high school life—which should have been uneventful—was noisily and annoyingly colored by the three girls I meet through Hanazono-sensei: Rinko, the "twisted genius pianist,"

title: Be Maximum
author: Sakazaki, Toshiki
description:
Kabata Ikumi and Uesugi Keishou aim to be the idols of tomorrow!  Both are members of the same talent company and take singing and dancing lessons together. While Ikumi joined only recently, Keishou has been a member for years and has considerable talent.  Their personalities clash and they are quick to disagree and fight.  After only a month of training, Ikumi's big debut has been decided.  However, he's been paired up with Keishou!

(Source: shinkeikaku)

title: Musume. Monogatari
author: Tanaka, Rika, Kanzaki, Yutaka
description: Based on the real-life members of the J-POP group Morning Musume. The stories themselves are also mostly based on true happenings in the group's history.

title: Love Live! School Idol Diary: School Idol Quest
author: Kimino, Sakurako, Takami, Yuuki

title: Sound of the Sky
author: Yamamura, Hajime
description:
One day a strict conductor was having a hard time achieving the sound he wanted from the orchestra he was leading. During a over-long rehearsal, he was late coming back from a break, and his little daughter Hibiki conducted the orchestra briefly in his place. Everyone was moved by the beauty of the music she directed, including the young violinist Kuzumi Akio, who only happened to be there watching.

Nine years later, Akio is entering college as a violinist, though he feels he has lost his passi

title: Shinkyoku Soukai Polyphonica White
author: Takadono, Madoka, Nagi, Kasumi, Kinako, Hiro

title: 30cm Star
author: Kitano, Eiichi
description:
An ordinary high school student, Mido Kosuke, learns that the gloomy girl Amemiya Kano in his class is a guitar genius and a vocalist of the rock band "Gradius" under the stage name "Kana."

(Source: MU)

title: Hibi Rock
author: Enokiya, Katsumasa
description: The story follows the adventures of a boy who until has rock music, he manages to survive everything: to the school, which for him is very hard, to bullies, to the fact of not having a girlfriend.

title: Terukan Boys
author: Nakahara, Yuu
description:
A crime comedy centered on Satoshi, Ryohei, and Kota, who formed a band called "Terukan Boys" in high school. Beyond the age of 30, the three had in common that they were struggling and living in reality while walking their respective paths.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: MegMeg☆Singer Song Fighter
author: CAFFEIN
description:
This is the (imaginary) beginning story of the crazy popular Vocaloid Character GUMI!! By some freak incident, the now-cyborg schoolgirl has her eyes set on her idol debut as "Gumi" under the mysterious organization, "Intane Group"!?

(Source: ComicWalker)

title: Shoujo☆Kageki Revue Starlight Comic Anthology: Nine Stories
author: Imai, Tetsuya, Hami, Kabocha, zinbei, Haruhana, Aya
description: An anthology comic of Shoujo☆Kageki Revue Starlight by various mangaka.

title: Idoroll
author: Tsutsui, Taishi
description: This series is on hiatus.

title: Idol Incidents
author: Natsuki, Coco
description:
Increasing income divide, creeping environmental pollution, unsolvable waste issues, childcare waiting lists being discussed without those concerned, repeated corruption… The government, smeared by vested interests, can't do a thing against the many problems and sources of discontent. It's in this situation, with Japan cornered with no way out, that idols rise up to save the day!

The Heroine Party, Sunlight Party, Starlight Party, Bishoujo Party, Wakaba Party, Subculture New Party, and SOS Part

title: Shousetsu IDOLiSH7: Ryuusei ni Inoru
author: Tanemura, Arina, Tsushimi, Bunta
description: A collection of short stories based the IDOLiSH7 franchise.

title: iDOLM@STER SideM: Dramatic Stage
author: Bandai-Namco, Katou, Michiru
description: From the mobile game The iDOLM@STER SideM. Dramatic Stage tells the story of 315 production idols, in particular the units DRAMATIC STARS and High×Joker.

title: Kono Koe wa Itsuka no Owakare
author: Fumi

title: Ore to Omae ga Furachi na Wake
author: Unohana

title: The iDOLM@STER Shiny Colors: Coherent Light
author: Ohara, Hiroki
description:
Asahi Serizawa, Fuyuko Mayuzumi, and Mei Izumi, members of the idol unit "Straylight," openly declare themselves as rivals. While they occasionally clash, they further polish their talents, shining even brighter.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Dorothy Band
author: Hongjacga
description:
One strange day, Dorothy and her boyfriend, Toto, are swept away by a mysterious tornado to Munchkinland, an imaginary country filled with music-loving dwarves. Encouraged by the Good Witch of the North, Dorothy and Toto decide to start a band and embark on a journey to Oz, the famous record company. Along the way, the couple encounters a gifted scarecrow guitarist, a tin bass player, and a drumming lion. Together, they are the Dorothy Band!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Miku Pure Voice
author: Igarashi, Kaoru
description:
"My name is Miku, I'm 13 and I love to sing. My story gets underway after arriving at a local broadcasting station to watch the shooting of a popular television series, and getting lost on the set. Next thing I know, I run into popular comedian Kaname Ukyo, and the rest is history!"

(Source: MU)

title: Butai Shoujo☆Kageki Revue Starlight: The Live Seiran - Blue Glitter
author: Ayasugi, Tsubaki
description:
Faced with the upcoming National High School Drama Championships, the students of Seiran struggle to uncover what it is they lack to seize victory.

(Source: MU)

title: Miihaa Paradise
author: Tada, Kaoru
description:
Thanks to her friend Mari, school girl Narumi is introduced to the world of visual rock. She is immediately enthralled by the wild music, strange clothes and cool guys. Narumi soon becomes a rock-enthusiast too, and goes with Mari to all the concerts and meets all the rock stars, including Ichirou, the lead singer from Mari’s favorite band, ‘7th Gate’ and Kyousuke, the lead singer of a rival band, ‘Misfit’.

The story follows Narumi as she learns more about Japanese visual rock bands, finds hers

title: Kira☆Kira
author: Ueda, Kiku
description: Manga based on the Visual Novel.

title: Hinabita♪ Rin to Shite Saku Hana no Gotoku
author: CUTEG, Yanagawa, Keishou

title: Healer Girl: Espressivo
author: Oono, Imo
description:
An established discipline on par with conventional medical approaches, "vocal medicine" is the practice of using songs to treat health conditions and injuries. Young people around the world strive to master the art and become "healers" to help people through the power of their voices.

This series is a spin-off of the original Healer Girl anime.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Wake Up, Girls!: Leaders
author: Kashiwagi, Kano
description:
Starting from the events of the Wake Up, Girls! movie, the story shows the perspective of Yoshino Nanase and Kaya Kikuma, the leader and sub-leader of the group.

(Source: Wikipedia, translated)

title: Kimi no Iro
author: Suzuki, Sanami
description: Totsuko is a high school student with the ability to see the "colors" of others. Colors of bliss, excitement, and serenity, plus a color she treasures as her favorite. Kimi, a classmate at her school, gives off the most beautiful color of all. Although she does not play an instrument, Totsuko forms a band with Kimi and Rui, a quiet music enthusiast they meet at a used bookstore in a far corner of town. As they practice at an old church on a remote island, music brings them together, forming frie

title: Yandeka
author: Yorita, Miyuki
description: Mio Ninagawa is a member of a yankee biker gang, who one day crashes into an expensive car on accident. So she can repay him, the owner of the car demands that Mio compete in the idol audition TV program that he produces—and to find out who's behind a letter threatening to kill the winner of the audition.

title: Sasaki-san ga Kieta Hi no Uta
author: Sayahoshi, Mikaru, Komejima, Yuu

title: Suishou no Hibiki
author: Saitou, Rin
description:
Included one-shot:
Volume 1: Suishou no Oto

title: Maestro
author: Sasou, Akira
description:
Kousaka is a violinist who is looking for a new orchestra to perform with as he’s tired of his current one. He, along with others, answer an ad for a new orchestra only to find an abandoned warehouse and a crazy old man constructing the rehearsal space. And no conductor. Kousaka takes over as first violin when the old man interrupts and criticizes him.

Turns out that the old man IS the conductor and musical director, and he’s put together this orchestra with lofty goals in mind, and has told th

title: Play Loud,
author: Haida, Nanako
description:
"I don't want to make music anymore."

Satoshi, a boy with a hoarse voice, appears in front of Akito, who thought so. But moved by his voice, Akito begins to write songs again. Slender and friendly as a dog, Satoshi grows closer and closer to Akito, who takes good care of him. Then one day, Satoshi appears with a large amount of luggage in his hands, asking to stay at Akito's house...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Lu Over the Wall
author: Yuasa, Masaaki, Mihagi, Senya
description:
In the seaside village of Hinashi Town, Kai Ashimoto's grandfather is one of the locals who reinforces the legend that mermaids lurk near Merfolk Island and consume humans. Due to allegedly attracting merfolk and subsequently causing the death of the elder's mother, music is seldom discussed in the Ashimoto household. Even so, Kai finds solace in making looped beats on his laptop and uploading them to the internet.

Despite his reserved and glum demeanor, Kai is approached by Kunio and Yuuho Ebi

title: Those That Have Wings
author: Yamato, Waki
description: Although hailed as a musical prodigy since he was very young, Fukao Kairi, now a conductor/piano major at a conservatory, seems to have lost his passion for music.  He skips class and lessons left and right and has not participated in any major competitions for years.  His friends are concerned for his future, but it is only when Kairi meets Miyamura Ruka and encounters her undying love for Shion that he starts to change little by little.  This story is about love and its true semblance.

title: Wake Up Deadman
author: Kim, Yong-Hwan
description:
Saving the life of the girl he loves, Sahu incidentally turns into a zombie. And now he's trying to survive in a stone jungle, believing that one day he will sing for the world.

(Source: MU)

title: The End of Rain
description: The End of Rain was distributed at Comiket 73 by Kogado as a spin-off of their visual novel Symphonic Rain. It is an anthology containing four short stories written and illustrated by various people.

title: mf: Mezzo Forte
author: Himawari, Souya
description:
A set of short stories, including:

1. A drunken game of cards leads to some unexpected results
2. Shouji is in love with Miwa-chan who is in love with Shuuhei. A love triangle of childhood friends.
3-5. Introverted Ritsu and extroverted Souta both play saxophone in their school band. But Souta also plays jazz in some local clubs. One day he invites Ritsu to hear him play...

title: This Must Be Love
author: Lee, Eumsae, Dodo
description:
After her show, singer and radio host Hana Ban receives a cassette player from a fan. But being just one among many gifts, she doesn't think much of it—that is, until the press of a button sends her to the 80s! There, she meets the cassette player's owner, who happens to be the late musician Jaeah Woo. However, Hana meets him at a time when he hasn't yet become famous and is on the verge of quitting music. Will she be able to convince her idol not to give up on his dream and save his life?

(Sou

title: Nakagawa Shouko Monogatari: Sorairo Days
author: Hara, Asumi
description:
The story will deal with Nakagawa's coming-of-age as she dealt with grade-school bullying and the passing of her father.

(Source: ANN)

title: Shouwa Fanfare
author: Rikachi
description:
A young girl named Sayoko fascinates people with her brilliant singing voice in the early days of the Showa era. In an effort to make people recognize her, she starts wanting to sing in talkie films. It's then that she happens to meet a piano prodigy, Asami, who disregards her singing as bad!!

The curtains rise on the birth of the story of a songstress that glitters with the dreams and love of a young girl in this historical tale.

(Source: Tokyo Otaku Mode)

title: Bokutachi no Mozart
author: Yoshi, Masako
description: Inoue is a young student whose secret passion is the cello. One night of drinking, he collapses in front of a rather special coffee whose clients are all fans of music and are part of the orchestra of the city. They immediately offered him to join the band. But Inoue has a problem: he has not learned to read music! He wants to progress, however, especially for the lovely Tamoto. But apparently, she is already in love. How will he get her attention?

title: from Y to Y
author: toi8, Mikami, Yasuaki, Jimmy, Sam P

title: Giniro no Harmony
author: Hiiragi, Aoi
description: Kotoko gave up the piano because she hates practicing, but she still loves music and the sound of the piano. And now shes met a rough and tumble boy who has some skill as well…

title: 89-banme no Ongaku
author: Shinoda, Meiko
description: "89th of the keyboard is played, the most beautiful sound in the world."

title: Dahlia
author: Ozaki, Minami, Aikawa, Nanase, Kudou, Kikuka
description:
The manga revolves around Izumi Kubota, a 19-year-old woman who was born and raised in Shounan, and Reiji Yamashita, a 27-year-old cameraman. The manga follows these two people who fall in love with each other at first sight after a predestined meeting.

(Source: ANN)

title: Like A Rolling Stone
author: Miyaya, Kazuhiko
description:
1-6. Like A Rolling Stone
7-11. Byakuya

title: Tutti!
author: Katagiri, Ryou
description: Story about three students who want to make music together.

title: Talkative Amadeus
author: Takeuchi, Masami
description:
From the Ultimate Manga Guide:

Rio Midorikawa and Usou Ogata took violin lessons together. The sound of Rio's violin reflects her talent and has a deep effect on her audience.

title: Natsu Utopiano
author: Hosoya, Yukino
description:
Arata returns to her parents' home to take over the family business of piano tuning. There she meets Kyoko, a woman who seems to refuse to interact with others. She later learns that Kyoko is the daughter of an international pianist. And thus, the two inexperienced musicians gradually deepen their relationship through piano. Moving closer and further apart, they live their lives, reveling in the momentary understanding and cohabitation.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Included one-shot: Asa ga

title: Music and Comics and a Human being
author: Toda, Seiji

title: Sasurai no Taiyou
author: Fujikawa, Keisuke, Suzuki, Mayumi
description: Two baby girls were born in the same hospital: one of them is the daughter of an aristocratic family while the other belongs to a depraved household which lives in the slums of the city. However, the nurse-in-charge, Michiko, secretly switches the two babies due to a personal grudge, resulting in a change of fates of the girls from then on. Many years later, the lives of the two girls continue to be intertwined with each other, with the rich Miki ill-treating the poor Nozomi, yet both of them ho

title: Desperado
author: Matsumoto, Daiji
description:
Kaoru Shiina, an ordinary high school student who lives in a tedious town where school is boring and there are no place to go to play, his only salvation is the live house where he watch local bands play. His ordinary life started to change when he decided to buy an electric guitar and met the mysterious transfer student, Michiya Kurosu, who owns a black Gibson Les Paul full of knife scars.

(Source: MU)

title: Fureru Yubi wa Piano
author: Hasebe, Yuri
description:
Fureru Yubi wa Piano
Mamiko is a piano teacher with mostly young students, but also one adult businessman, who unfortunately does not have much talent.  Why does he want to learn in the first place?

Mitsumecha Yaa yo
Mimura Miho has a very large bust.  Because of that, she's often not taken seriously by the guys she truly likes, including her current crush, her boss Sugisaki.  

Urumu Tsukiyo ni
Misaki, who has had trouble sleeping at night, accidentally calls Lunarium, a strictly non-sexual se

title: always Chopin in my pocket
author: Kuramochi, Fusako
description:
Heroine - Asako Sue

Music comic: Love story. 

A famous Japanese pianist Aiko Sue's daughter Sue Asako struggles to grow as a pianist and as a person through struggles and interacting, and understanding others around her.

title: Niji no Natasha
author: Yamato, Waki
description: The story centers around a girl named Natasha during the war in Japan. She is a half-European and half-Japanese. She has incredible voice and excels at singing. Moreover, she is also the long-lost daughter of the Japanese baron, who sent an extremely talented musician, Kaoru Sanjou, to find Natasha in Shanghai. These two fell madly in love and went through many obstacles during the feudal war in order to be together. A great story about love, passion, hatred and war.

title: Shoujo☆Kageki Revue Starlight: Saikai Eyes - 74th
author: Ayasugi, Tsubaki, Miura, Kaori
description:
The story focuses on the past of Sawa Souda and Kyouko Yakumo when they were students together at Seishou Music Academy (Sawa being a third year, 74th class and Kyouko being a first year, 76th). It also introduces two new characters, Ichika Saegusa of the 74th class, and her seven year old sister, Chizuru Saegusa.

(Source: Shoujo☆Kageki Revue Starlight Wiki)

title: Koi ni Yami, Ai wo Utau
author: Sazamedzuke

title: Dokidoki Shiyou yo!
author: Hirose, Natsume
description:
(from shoujo-manga.com)
Shiina ITO is a 16 year old high school girl who, like all her friends, is a big fan of the boy-band ‘Woozy’, especially the lead singer, a really cute guy named ‘SUY’. One day when running late, Shiina keeps running into creepy guys trying to bother her. She gets away from them, but as another one was approaching her, she ran away, leaving her wallet behind. The guy picks up the wallet, reads her info, and smiles. When Shiina gets home, she is in for a surprise. The guy

title: Exit
author: Fujita, Takami
description:
VANCA is a band created by vocal Takuya and unusually tall guitarist Ooshi Kouchi. Anyone who comes near the band becomes involved in their affairs! VANCA knows no limits, and continues to grow, taking the world by storm.

(Source: MU)

title: We can't just live on a prayer.
author: Shinanogawa, Hideo

title: Tsubame to Umi to Dolce
author: Sugata, Uri
description: Tsubame, a high-schooler who possess an extraordinary sense of pitch, had become fearful of singing, something she once loved to do, due to her childhood trauma. However, on one evening, she came across DJ Yuma, who aims to be a composer, and upon sensing her hidden talent, he demands that she sings his song. DJ Yuma forms a band with his best friend Shiori, who aims to be a filmmaker. "'For some reason, his music makes me feels at ease" Yuma and Shiori, the two bishounen, gave Tsubame the coura

title: 88/2: Piano Four Hands
author: Arima
description:
Mitsuru Fujita, a girl who loves piano, has entered high school and is sharing a dorm room with Kanade Kobayashi, a former rival who used to be proclaimed a piano prodigy. However, Kanade has come to hate piano, because of trauma she experienced when studying abroad. Mitsuru invites Kanade to play a duet on the same piano...

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Sumire-sensei wa Ryouri shitakunai
author: Ookubo, Hiromi
description:
Sumire Shirayuki, a piano teacher who won't lose to anyone in terms of beauty and dignity. However, contrary to her image, she is on the path to becoming a bachelorette in her 30s with no money and no boyfriend! And on top of that she has to cook for herself...?! What if she could find her fated "cooking prince"?! Someone who can sympathize with her true personality!

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title: Houkago, Voca-ken de!
author: Benino, Atsu
description: Mira Sasaki is a first-year high school student who wants to have the youthful experience of being in a band. She tells a teacher that she wants to join the pop music band, but to her surprise, it has been disbanded! In fact, almost all music-related clubs had been wiped out! Facing this unprecedented circumstance, Mira joins the only active music-related club: the Vocaloid Research Club. She doesn't have the slightest clue what "vocaloid" means, but her worries are quickly put to rest. She is s

title: I'm Singing Above the Cloud, Waiting for You.
author: Murata, Yayuu
description:
The story revolves around the sudden disappearance of a masked artist with an excellent voice, who turns out to be a high school girl.

(Source: ANN)

title: The Life of a Man Who Headed Toward Stradivari
author: Yamamoto, Osamu

title: Pavé Rose
author: Jyabachip
description:
While waiting for her friends on the street one day, university freshman and band music enthusiast Ahyeon Do reunites with former high school classmate Lee Haerang, who's now... the vocalist of a band? Having only hung out with Haerang once during high school to see a live show together, Ahyeon still has some unanswered questions about him... Why did he drop out of school after the show? How did he end up in a band? But most importantly, what does he think of her?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ooedo!! Un♥Plugged
author: Inamitsu, Shinji
description: Japanese high school Rocker Grrl goes back in time and has adventures in Old Tokyo.

title: It's a Colorful Discord
author: Kagami, Eri
description:
Watanabe Soichiro is a cowardly boy with a bad temper. He enrolls in the Piano Department of Meisei Gakuen to play the piano, his only skill. Soichiro wanted to live a quiet high school life, but was spotted by a piano-obsessed female student named Otsune Fujioka. However, thanks to her support, Soichiro got a chance to play the piano in public. That day, Soichiro was in front of a large audience!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Azuma-san to Itakura-senpai wa Koi wo Suru.
author: Nakamura, Yukichi
description:
1. Azuma-san to Itakura-senpai wa Koi wo Suru.
2. Azuma-san to Itakura-senpai wa Koi wo Suru.: Yuki Moyou
3. Azuma-san to Itakura-senpai wa Koi wo Suru.: Another Story
4. Yuujou Jihen
5. Azuma-san to Itakura-senpai wa Koi wo Suru.: Tomodachi Gokko

title: Kiniro no Corda: Starlight Orchestra Comic
author: Yatsuhachi, Hachi

title: Orokamono no Ai no Uta
author: Janome
description:
Tomizou Tomita is in a band. After a night gig, Tomita runs into a fortune teller, who tells him a fatal encounter is just about to happen, someone unexpected will show in his band... Is it a friend, or maybe a new love? Could it be that the encounter has already happened?!

(Source: MU)

title: Brass of Shellol: Shinsei Kyousou no Himekishi
author: Kuwashima, Rein, Koregane, Ryuuji

title: Katte ni Shiyagare!
author: Makimura, Satoru
description:
Atsuko is a talented pianist who decided that she would not go out and play the piano in the final round of a Piano Competition. Upset and frustrated she tells her mother and instructor that it was because she just now realized that she doesn't like playing the piano. Trying to get away from everyone at the competition she runs, ending up in Harajuku where she is stunned by it's music scene and the bands playing in the area.

This is all new to Atsuko. Ever since she was little she's spent her l

title: Chuck and the Girl
author: Saitou, Yuusuke
description:
"I remember. A town encircled by the hills and sea. A dreamy time with someone special..." 

My name is Amy. I moved from Los Angeles in America to Yokohama with my mom. Am I lonely? No, not at all. I mean, isn't it cool to live in a foreign country? My grandma is cool too, so it's great! I'm going to live here!

Just a step before adolescence. One girl's experience of simply dazzling light and shadow.

(Source: Two Virgins, translated)

title: Oto no Kyoushitsu
author: Yamamura, Hajime
description: Series about the lives of students at a music college.

title: Mamiana Shijuusoudan
author: Makimura, Satoru
description: The Koizumi siblings have a father who is a professional violinist and a mother who is a professional pianist. Unlike her older brothers who have musical talent like their parents, Karin is a poor student at her music high school. She is proud of her twin brother Kazune, who is beginning to follow their father's footsteps into the professional violin world, but every so often, the seeming gap between them depresses her. This is a heartwarming story about the Koizumi family who love and support e

title: Shousetsu Suite Precure♪
author: Oono, Toshiya
description: An after story which takes place one year after the original series.

title: Mademoiselle Mozart
author: Fukuyama, Youji
description: This is a fictional re-telling of the life of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, with a new twist. Mozart was actually born a girl, but her father chose to pass her off as a boy when he witnessed her early genius in music. The main story begins when Mozart is 25, working successfully as a musician in Vienna. "He" is wildly popular, especially with the ladies, but "he" mostly avoids them in order to protect the secret of "his" gender. Unfortunately, another local composer, Antonio Salieri, suspects that Mo

title: Ura-ban! Uraizumi High school Wind band Club
author: Tozakura, Nagomi

title: Setsuna Trip
author: Ousaka, Nozomi, Last Note., Satsuki, Yamai

title: Glass Heart
author: Taguchi, Shouichi, Wakagi, Mio
description: Akane Saijou, a drummer who was ousted from her previous band just before her debut, is unexpectedly chosen by Naoki Fujitani, a reclusive and brilliant musician, to join his new band, TENBLANK. Together with band members Shou Takaoka and Kazushi Sakamoto, the band gains fame through Fujitani's distinctive compositions and their electrifying performances. As TENBLANK rises to stardom, they face numerous challenges, and Akane's journey from obscurity to stardom unfolds as Fujitani's secrets emerg

title: Sennen no Hanamichi
author: Hanabusa
description:
In 1523, a man became enamored by the angelic singing voice of the songstress Miko and believed that a thousand years was being added to his life from listening to her sing. He decides to dedicate his life to supporting her no matter what; yet, tragedy eventually rips his beloved idol away from him. Five hundred years later, the same man is still alive but is now rooting for the up-and-coming masked singer known as SuZu.

Having lived through many eras and supported many idols, the man is shocke

title: Kimama ni Idol
author: Kotani, Kenichi
description: A slutty idol success story depicting the success of three beautiful girls who aim for entertainment debut as an idol singer with 70 million yen prize winning lottery.

title: Canon of Youth
author: Inoue, Masato
description:
1-3. Seishun Canon (Canon of Youth)
4-5. Yuuutsu Trumpet (Trumpet of Melancholy)

title: Mirai no Bokura no Tame no Sonata
author: Sagara, Sou, Wakasama
description:
What is talent? What is a way of life? A bittersweet youth music story begins!

In her childhood, a girl with a terrifyingly remarkable talent crossed paths with Youichi Fuzuno, who then strayed from the path of music. He continued to live a life where he couldn't immerse himself in anything. However, he was warned that if he continued like this, he would have to pay for his tuition. At that moment, his classmate Hitamura asked him to create songs for a music posting site. Although Fuzuno intend

title: Musume. Monogatari: ALIVE!
author: Kanzaki, Yutaka, Hoshino, Mayumi
description: The sequel to Musume Monogatari. It features the 6th Generation, as well as the graduations of Abe, Tsuji and Kago.

title: JOKER
author: Nomura, Akiko
description: Nakazono Erii is a high school student who loves enka!  She is a talented singer and happily performs requested enka songs while she mans the front counter at her family's public bath house.  When the vocalist of the band JOKER fails to appear for their cultural festival performance Erii is quickly recruited as JOKER's new vocalist!

title: Springs
author: Yonehara, Hideyuki
description: G-union is a rock band and two of the band's old friend is also an actor and a manga artist. This is their story before the band is officially form, dated back when everyone were in high school, before all of them success in their life.

title: Scramble☆Star
author: Yamada, Shiro
description: Kana Kanzaki's younger brother, Kanata Kanzaki, is the lead of the new idol group, RUSH. On the day of their initial debut, he went missing and Kana was asked to take his spot...?

title: Bowing!
author: Kyukkyupon
description:
Rio Kubote is a young girl who was proclaimed a violin genius. It looked like a future promised as a performer, but when she lost sight of her goal and got bogged down and frightened on the stage, she escaped to her mother's countryside... The boy Rinne met in the area, Ten Asakura, had a genius "ear." A girl who lost sight of a sound and a boy who seeks a sound. The meeting of two people makes harmony in the sky high country town! Authentic string story!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Kimi wa Ore no Oshi ja Nai
author: Asada, Kyouma

title: Idol Kyuukou
author: Tokiwa, Ran
description: A story about the struggles of a new member of a big idol group.

title: Luminous☆Idol
author: Shouji, Takashi, Matsuuni
description:
"Please make us shine brightly!"

A few years after making promises with three girls in his childhood days. After losing his musical partner Kai in an accident just before their major debut, Kyousuke has distanced himself from music and lives without motivation. Three years later, Kai suddenly appears before Kyousuke, unchanged and as outspoken as ever.

Scenes from the day to day life of "Ketchuppers," a band named for its lead guitar player Wakatabe's love of ketchup. Besides steadfast singer Hashitani (Tani), flaky Wakatabe (Waka) is accompanied by Tachin, Sakai and Hino. Together since high school music club, they've hit the big time thanks to their talent and the efforts of their manager, Ida.

The story of Reo, who's aiming to be a musician, and Suzu, a student at a famous university. They're polar opposites, but due to mishap, they become roommates...?!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

author: Sano, Akira
description: Totsuko is a high school student with the ability to see the "colors" of others. Colors of bliss, excitement, and serenity, plus a color she treasures as her favorite. Kimi, a classmate at her school, gives off the most beautiful color of all. Although she does not play an instrument, Totsuko forms a band with Kimi and Rui, a quiet music enthusiast they meet at a used bookstore in a far corner of town. As they practice at an old church on a remote island, music brings them together, forming frie

The story follows Yo!Hey, a boy who raps to the beat of his farts.

Only in death did I realize the meaning of my life.

Daehwa Kim is a piano prodigy who drops out of a prestigious performing arts high school due to a lack of passion. Just when he finally discovers his love for the piano at 30, he gets into a fatal accident, only to wake up as a high school student again! Can he turn his fate around this time?

description: Sick and bedridden, the zaibatsu tycoon Tomiko senses that her death is near and must nominate an heir among her three granddaughters. To decide who will receive her whole fortune, she launches a challenge: whoever will give her best in the next three months will be the winner. Shizuka, the oldest granddaughter and owner of several business companies, and Reika, the second oldest and a genius scientist, are sure that it's going to be a battle between the two of them. However, Erika, the youngest

The main character is Satsuki Fujishiro, a high school boy who is neither good at his part-time job nor at his studies. His only pleasure is to copy the dances and songs of his favorite idol group. One day, Minami, a popular boy at school, asks him to join a young boy's idol group because of his ability. The story depicts Satsuki's to act courageously in order to be needed by someone.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Included one-shot: Gurukan

title: Rock 'N' Girl of the End
author: Ishiyama, Reach
description:
After his son dies, it falls to Raizou, a near-elderly ex-soldier, to raise his granddaughter Hikari, a blind girl who takes up the guitar to fulfill the dream of Raizou and her late father.

The rock music the two play will shake the world...!!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: P.S. Lovin' Song
description: A collection of short stories.

title: Sing My Crush
author: Gumdung
description: Han Baram and Lim Hantae first met the day Baram quit his guitar academy after an incident with the teacher. Now, six years later, the two are close, but Baram secretly has feelings for his best friend. Baram has tried to move on from the past and his crush, but when their former guitar teacher plays Baram's song on TV and claims it's his, he is forced to confront his past and tell Hantae what really happened that day. Will Baram finally stand up for himself... and confess his crush on Hantae?

author: Isshiki, Makoto
description:
The spin-off manga centers on Satoshi Mukai, who once competed with Kai Ichinose in the Chopin Competition. Satoshi was so moved by Kai's performance, that he decides to pursue a career in the world of musical tuning. Satoshi needs to survive in an ordinary society while possessing a rare talent.

(Source: ANN)

title: Orebushi
author: Tsuchida, Seiki
description:
Following the life of the recent high school graduate, Ashika Kouji, this story depicts the life of a shy and naive man moving to the big city to become an enka singer. Leaving his only family, his grandmother, in his home town in Aomori, he now has to survive a life in Tokyo by himself. He realizes his true talent as he makes new friends and faces new challenges in his new life.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Fluorite Star
author: Suno, Natsuko
description:
Suzu fell in love at the live house that day...

The man was none other than the vocalist, Youji, who came to stand in for one band at the live. Youji was as hard to understand as he was alluring, but Suzu summoned all his courage to ask him to join the band and unexpectedly won him over. Like a moth to a flame, Suzu is carried away by the man's overwhelming sex appeal and starts a physical relationship with him, but...

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

title: Yume-iro Cast
author: Sakuma, Ren
description:
The first serialization of a popular romance rhythm game! Madoka, a new screenwriter, is supposed to make a musical with the talented cast of the Yume-iro Company!?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Roku Gen Shoujo
author: Wakatake, Abishi
description:
My dad is a famous guitarist. Sometimes, he shows up out of the blue, and teaches me how to play guitar.

Mom hates Dad and the guitar, and she takes it out on me... But I won't let that stop me. Even if I'm scolded, even if I'm bullied—so long as I have this, I'll be just fine.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Kang Moo-Jae inherited the best blood in the music industry. However, he was frustrated when he witnessed the overwhelming musical talent of Jin Yu-Seong, a hearing-impaired man... A fierce competition between two boys begins for a single spot.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Together with band members Shou Takaoka and Kazushi Sakamoto, the band gains fame through Fujitani's distinctive compositions and their electrifying performances. But he's missing something, his music just feels bland. One day, he starts to understand when he hears the Dave Brubeck Quartet's "Take Five" and meets three eccentric characters: a drummer, a pianist, and a trumpet player. With their help, Jay starts to understand that music is never as beautiful as when it's played in a band, and that a

There is a place in heaven that is a "new Vienna" where classical musicians gather. The story follows Beethoven, who will meet other musicians like him, like Mozart, Liszt, Ravel, Bach and many more!

She wants to fulfill the dream of her late sister, Yeseo, who passed away a year ago. A girl who lost her way and found herself in that mysterious place met "Deemo," a man dressed completely in black. There, every time they played the piano a tree would grow taller, leading them to the place where the girl would have to return. As the weight of his innumerable failures in life take their toll, Etsurou Kurosu comes to a sole solution—take his own life. Tying a belt around a wall hanger and setting it around his neck, he lets the noose do its work. However, he panics and his flailing creates a hole in his wall. Through this hole he sees his beautiful neighbor Rio Miyaichi, and peeping at her daily life soon becomes his obsession.

author: Itosugi, Masahiro
description: Aki Sora revolves around Aki Aoi and Sora Aoi, a pair of close siblings who have shared an intimate bond since childhood. During their coming of age, they each come to realize the true depth of the love they feel for each other and consummate that love in secret. They keep their younger sister, Nami, Sora’s twin in the dark about their new relationship. Despite the huge difference in their relationship experiences, Saki has had onl

title: A Girl & Her Guard Dog
