author: Terasawa, Buichi
description: An all color sequel to the original classic.

title: Tetsuwan Atom Bekkan
author: Tezuka, Osamu
description: A collection of Tetsuwan Atom short stories.

title: Wakusei
author: Mizuki, Shigeru
description:
A mysterious planet appears over Earth, bringing with it unparalleled bliss. If you can afford the space trip, that is.

(Source: MU)

title: Kurofune
author: Ohara, Shinji, Kuroda, Iou
description:
The 2nd collection of short stories by Kuroda Iou.

1. My Teacher and I
2. Too Young
3. Koutetsu Kraken
4. Jitensha Franken
5. Toshi no Hanareta Otoko
6. Night of the Living Dead
7. Extracurricular Lessons
8. Nikujaga Yamero!
9. Saikin Douyo?
10. Zou no Matatabi
11. Saraba Universe

title: Uchuu Kazoku Carlvinson
author: Asari, Yoshitoo
description: When a motley band of traveling performers have a deep-space collision with another spacecraft, they find that the sole survivor of the other craft is a humanoid infant. They decide to raise the child as their own on the nearest planet as they wait for other members of the girl's race to come and find her. Corona-chan grows up as their daughter, and the manga details her five-year-old adventures with her fuzzball mother, her robot-soldier father, her living-central-nervous-system pet, and the ot

title: Azur Lane the Animation: Anata no Aoki Kouro ni Shukufuku wo
author: ichinomi

title: Halloween Night
author: Takabatake, Enaga
description: Some robots go trick-or-treating.

title: Stellvia
author: Akizuki, Ryou
description:
The Stellvia Space Academy is one of several Space Foundations dedicated to saving Earth from a wave of supernova explosions that is scheduled to hit the planet in 70 days. Shima Katase is a newly-enrolled student at Stellvia with exceptional skills as a programmer but lacklustre talent as a pilot. Her dream is to be chosen as one of the elite pilots needed to help save the earth, and Stellvia is her story.

(Source: Amazon)

title: Maou 2099
author: Murasaki, Daigo, Akashiro, Kiiro
description: The cyberpunk metropolis Shinjuku—a massive city-state bedecked with neon signs, towering skyscrapers, and the latest cutting-edge technology. It is here, in year 2099 of the Fused Era, where the legendary Demon Lord Veltol has his second coming five centuries in the making. But this landscape is nothing like the one he conquered all those years ago, for the fusion of magic and engineering has elevated civilization to dazzling, unprecedented heights. Veltol may have been reduced to a historical

title: Star Red
author: Hagio, Moto
description: At the end of the 23rd Century, a girl stares at a red star in the sky. Her name happens to be Red Star, born on Mars. The series tells of Red's adventures at the center of the Milky Way. (Source: Prisms)

title: Baroque
author: Ogawa, Yayoi
description: Kabayama Atsushi was a child prodigy, but now he's just a regular high school boy. One day, a mysterious man from another world named Trance appears before Atsuhi and asks for his cooperation. Apparently Atsuhi is the chosen person who can save the world—by sleeping with Trance's "sister," Tsubasa! Already confused and overwhelmed, Atsushi is also targeted by a woman with strange powers that seems to know Trance and is determined to kill Atsushi. Does the world's fate really depend upon Atsushi

title: Qualidea Code: Sonna Sekai wa Kowashiteshimae
author: Sagara, Sou, Kantoku

title: Majinou Gallon
author: Tezuka, Osamu, Nagai, Go
description: Based in the original work of Osamu Tezuka.

title: Capricorn
author: Manabe, Jouji
description: In the blink of an eye, high school student Taku Shimamura finds himself transported to the bizarre world of Slaffleaze, where intelligent creatures govern and the ruling class, led by the villainous Zolba, is plotting the invasion of the world they know as Capricorn, the Earth. Joining together with the oppressed Slaffleaze peasants, Taku must find a way to stop Zolba`s dark forces before the way to the unsuspecting Earth is opened. In order to do so, he must first gain the love and trust of th

title: Spring Weapon No.1
author: Hasegawa, Tomohiro
description:
An evil organization of androids called Numbers is threatening to take over the world! Luckily, a top secret defense force of specially trained operatives called MAPPO (Monster Attack Professional & Pacific Organization) is there to stop them. So what happens when a MAPPO agent in high school gets a new classmate that's a wacky-looking Number?

(Source: VIZ Media)

Included one-shots:
Volume 4: Saishuu Heiki Kon-chan
Volume 5: Shimatsuya K

title: Hatsune Miku: Future Delivery - Little Asimov and the Green Thing Left Behind
author: Miyama, Fugin, Ooshio, Satoshi
description:
In the distant future, Asumi—a girl who has no clue to her memories but a drawing of a green-haired, ponytailed person—finds her only friend in Asimov, a battered old delivery robot. The strange companions travel the stars together in search of the mysterious ''Miku,'' only to learn the legendary idol has taken different forms on many different worlds!

(Source: Dark Horse)

title: Mr. Mega Man
author: Kawata, Yushi, Yukito
description:
Rockman-san follows the every day life of a grown-up Rockman as he deals with the tumultuous demands of an adult world. Older versions of Roll and Robot Masters make up the supporting cast.

(Source: Rockman Corner)

title: Iriya's Sky, Summer of the UFOs
author: Akiyama, Mizuhito
description: Asaba Naoyuki is an ordinary high school student. As a member of his school's press club, he's just spent the summer camping outside the local military base, in hopes of seeing the UFOs that are secretly kept there, according to local legend. Returning to school, he meets a strange girl, Iriya Kana, and gradually comes to realize that she is more than merely strange - and that a dark secret lies beneath the world that he knows.

title: 100-man Pound no Ai
author: Shimizu, Reiko
description:
1. 100-man Pound no Ai
2. Funeral March
3. Otoko no Ko Onna no Ko
4. Shimizu Reiko no Konjaku Monogatari
5. Kiss Me Vanpanella
6. Foxy Fox
7. Sansaro Monogatari

title: The Exo-Drive Reincarnation Games: All-Japan Isekai Battle Tournament!
author: yuztan, Keiso
description:
Being reborn in another world is a tournament sport in this hilarious, action-packed isekai series!

In the not-so-distant future, isekai is a way of life. The world has perfected how to hit an average teenager with a truck to launch them into a new world for a fantasy adventure. But once that's done, how do you keep it entertaining? Set up a televised tournament, of course! Roaring crowds can follow a chosen Hero through his death, rebirth, and quest to save another world, armed with special te

title: Hoshikuzu no Sorakil
author: Iwashiro, Toshiaki
description: Arata, a former karate disciple, and his little sister Himari are camping in a forest when they witness the appearance of a spaceship, that kidnaps them. They meet up with Sorakil, a rather bizarre alien who claims to be an agent of the Galactic Federation, demanding the brother and sister's help to protect Earth.

title: Who Fighter with Heart of Darkness
author: Takizawa, Seihou, Conrad, Joseph
description: WHO FIGHTER is a WWII manga, with two complete stories and one short vignette. The title story tells the experience of a Japanese fighter pilot who shoots down a strange fireball over Japan during WWII. What follows is a strange and twisty tale, and the only thing more odd than the suspicious G-men investigating the incident is the fireball itself. Are the bizarre events that follow the result of this alien phenomenon, or are they all in the pilot’s head. There is strong evidence to suggest both

title: Little Fluffy Gigolo PELU
author: Mizuno, Junko
description: Pelu, the Little Fluffy Playboy, is comic tale of a cute extraterrestrial creature that comes to Earth determined to find himself true happiness in the form of a human bride. Our hero's search takes him from the surface of his fantastic alien planet to an off-kilter modern Japan where Pelu meets aspiring singers, sassy girls, paint-sniffing bad boys, and the body-switching students of a mysterious high school. Artist Junko Mizuno unleashes her unique graphic storytelling sensibilities on a tale

title: Kikaider Code 02
author: Ishinomori, Shoutarou, Meimu
description:
On the surface, Jiro appears to be a normal teenage boy — he's riddled with self-doubt, has trouble making friends, and owns a guitar he doesn't know how to play. But he's really Kikaider, a super-powered android with a secret "Gemini" device implanted in his brain to help simulate human qualities. Professor Gill, a former associate of Kikaider's creator, is hunting for the Gemini device… and he'll go to any lengths to recover it!

(Source: CMX)

title: Ilegenes: The Genetic Sodom Ilegenes
author: Chrono, Nanae, Kuwabara, Mizuna
description: The original light novels that the Ilegenes manga are based on. This takes place after the manga events when the characters are around the age of 30.

title: 1984-nen
author: Variety Art Works, Orwell, George
description: Winston Smith works for the Ministry of Truth in London, chief city of Airstrip One. Big Brother stares out from every poster, the Thought Police uncover every act of betrayal. When Winston finds love with Julia, he discovers that life does not have to be dull and deadening, and awakens to new possibilities. Despite the police helicopters that hover and circle overhead, Winston and Julia begin to question the Party; they are drawn towards conspiracy. Yet Big Brother will not tolerate dissent - e

title: Ginga Eiyuu Densetsu Gaiden
author: Michihara, Katsumi, Tanaka, Yoshiki, Kasahara, Akira
description:
The story is staged in the distant future within our own Milky Way Galaxy, approximately in the 35th century. Unlike other science fiction stories, there are no alien civilizations. A portion of the galaxy is filled with terraformed worlds inhabited by interstellar traveling human beings. For 150 years two mighty space powers have intermittently warred with each other: the Galactic Empire and the Free Planets Alliance.

(Source: Wikipedia)

title: Thunder Mask
author: Tezuka, Osamu
description:
Tezuka himself is a main character in this one, about a mangaka who finds himself in a science fiction story about robots and transforming creatures.

(Source: MU)

title: Eve no Nemuri
author: Yoshida, Akimi
description: It's been 18 years since Rin died. Alisa, who is Sei and Lou May's daughter, lives with her mother, her brother Shinji, and Ken in Hawaii. Shinji is Ken and Lou May's son. Shinji knows Alisa isn't Ken's real daughter, but Alisa doesn't. Alisa sometimes sees a phantom boy. One day, she sees a boy point to the sky, where she sees a plane. By the plane, Rie, Shin's son, comes to ask Ken for some help. He also knows Alisa is really Sei's daughter. Alisa is called "Dragon's daughter." Rie says a prop

title: Mechanized Infantries 8-Fukujin
author: Fukushima, Satoshi
description: Kidou Ryodan Hachifukujin is set in the near future where Japan has been subjugated by China and now fights against its former ally America under the Chinese banner. Fukujin, literally "luck god," are special armor suits that are impervious to most conventional weapons. The story follows new recruits in the army of Japan, in a war torn future. There's an eccentric girl, a pacifistic guy, an advanced suit of armor impervious to all weapons figure in a story about war, violence, and militaristic s

title: Planetary*
author: Sakura, Maro
description:
The Planet Group is formed of powerful families that represent each planet in our solar system and the central Sun Family. Midori is the eldest son of the Earth Family, who is just now entering his high school life in the Planetary Academy. Other than his family name, however, Midori has little going for him. He doesn't get good grades and is shy and socially awkward.

His low self-esteem isn't helped by the general disdain his father and younger brother openly show towards him. All they want is

title: Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha: The Movie 2nd A's - Tribute Comics
author: Fujima, Takuya, Hasegawa, Kouji, Higa, Yukari
description: Collection of stories from the different Nanoha series to advertise the release of Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha the Movie 2nd A's that were included in the official movie guidebook.

title: Do Androids Dream of Love?
author: Hidaka, Ryou
description: "I'll do anything for you, Riko." After her father's death, Riko suddenly finds herself living with his parting gift: a male humanoid robot called Akito. Booting up this high-functioning robot turns Riko's calm and mundane life upside-down! Although she finds him annoying, the more she watches him, the harder it gets to turn him off... Then, one day, the curious and rather touchy-feely Akito says... "Can kissing convey my love for you?" ...What's with this robot? Turns out he has a secret functi

title: Mugentou
author: Nakagawa, Yuukei
description:
Kooru, a young elementary school girl from Tokyo, is suddenly given the news that she will be moving to Mugentou along with the rest of her family. It's a mysterious secluded island lost to the times and cut off from the rest of civilization. It lacks the many technological advances but has abundant natural life and beauty complemented with many magical and paranormal phenomenons.

Follow along and see where Kooru's imagination will take her.

(Source: MU)

title: Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth
author: Fukuda, Ikumi
description: Takumi Aiba, a new Cyber Sleuth, takes on an account raiding case as part of his assistant job at Kuremi Detective Agency, and sets out to the man-made cyberspace known as "EDEN" to recover the accounts of the victims with the help of his Digimon.

title: Grand Finale
author: Unreal
description: After global warming destroyed the Earth, humanity set off for the uncharted planet paradise known as "Arcadia." Crew member Yeongsu Dong wakes up from stasis to find himself the lone survivor, orbitting the planet in the debris field of the wrecked ship. He gets to the surface, where he is immediately attacked by wild creatures, and gets caught in the civil war among the native Arcadians. He must learn to communicate and survive in this strange new world, and find a way to stop an apocalyptic c

title: NieR Replicant ver.1.22474487139... Project Gestalt Recollections
author: Eishima, Jun
description:
From director Taro Yoko  and writer Jun Eishima comes this novel expanding upon the world of the critically acclaimed game NieR Replicant ver.1.22474487139...

The protagonist is a kind young man living in a remote village. In order to save his sister, Yonah, who fell terminally ill to the Black Scrawl, he sets out with Grimoire Weiss, a strange talking tome, to search for the "Sealed verses."

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Mushi-Uta
author: Iwai, Kyohei, LLO
description: Mushi-uta's story takes place in the near future. Ten years before the story's opening, strange insect-like creatures known as "Mushi" began appearing. The Mushi are able to consume peoples' dreams and thoughts in return for supernatural powers. Protagonist Daisuke "Kakkou" Kusuriya encounters a young girl named Shiika Anmoto. The two, in time, become quite close. However, unbeknownst to Kakkou, Shiika is an escapee from a secret prison known as GARDEN where those possessed by the Mushi, known a

title: Classroom☆Crisis
author: Takano, Masaharu, MONTWO
description:
With aims to one day reach out into the stars, humanity has colonized all the planets of the solar system. This story of young high school hopefuls is set in Fourth Tokyo in a Japanese Martian prefecture. Iris Shirasaki is a third year student/aspiring test pilot. Mizuki Sera is her peer/mechanic and Mizuki's brother Kaito is their homeroom teacher and the young director of the program developing their talents.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Galaxy Angel Party
author: Ootsuki, Yuuko, Asahina, Yuzuru, Nakahira, Guy
description:
The Angel Troupe is just about done with their current mission to deliver over a million dollars to the Bank of Transbaal, when Milfeulle accidentally opens the hatch and loses it in space. In order to keep their jobs, the Angel Troupe needs to raise money, and fast!

(Source: Broccoli Books)

title: Rock Me Amadeus
author: Inabe, Kazu
description:
Otoya, a student at a prestigious music high school, can't stand classical music. Why would he, when rock is so much cooler in every way? It's got beat, drums, speed, everything that classical just doesn't have. But what if listening to classical music could summon beings from an alternate dimension to do battle? Not so boring now, is it?

(Source: Batoto)

title: Kiteretsu Daihyakka
author: Fujiko, Fujio F.
description: The main character is a scientific genius boy named Kiteretsu, who has built a companion robot named Korosuke. He frequently travels in time with his friends and Korosuke in the time machine he built. Miyoko is a girl in his neighborhood who is basically his girlfriend. Tongari is his rival, who happen to share some similar traits of Honekawa Suneo. Buta Gorilla (Kumada Kaoru) is a typical neighborhood bully, who also share similar traits of Gian (Takeshi Goda) except that he often antagonizes K

title: Star Wars: v. 1
author: Hiromoto, Shinichi
description:
Contains original stories set in the Star Wars universe featuring characters from the six films. This work shows you many different sides of the familiar franchise, featuring everything from comedy to tragedy to despair to redemption. (Source: Waterstones)

The following stories are in Star Wars Black;
    * Perfect Evil Part 1 by Hiromoto-SIN-Ichi
    * Tantive IV by Formalin
    * Evil Eyes by Nao
    * Dear Anakin by Furi Furi Company 

Also contains three illustrations by Kia Asamiya, Yuji K

title: Fate/Grand Order: Saber Wars II Bangai-hen - Jane & Ishtar - 100-man Kounen no Nagareboshi
author: Moriyama, Daisuke
description: The story of Jane and Ishtar, two space bounty hunters.

title: Watashi no Kairos
author: Karaage, Tarou
description:
After being sentenced to death, the girl Gladiolus was sent to a planet inhabited by robots and is forced to fight as a gladiator to win her freedom!

(Source: MU)

title: Be My Baby
author: Kie, Jin, Jeonghae
description:
Dr. Sunwoo Lee is one of the nation's finest scientists, who dreams of a world where every human (including men) can conceive a child. Unfortunately, he eventually has to shut down his project. During his now ample free time, he happens to run into an old crush, a friend's older brother, Eungyo. In any other world, this situation may be normal, but not when Sunwoo's (extremely vocalized) desire is for Eungyo's sperm!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Tempest
author: Aniya, Yuiji
description: After a solar storm destroys the Y chromosome, the male sex dies out. But the women find a way to cross ova each other to survive. But after almost 2000 years, a boy is suddenly born: Hime. Hidden, he grows up and wants nothing more than to be a normal girl and his great love Kou to tell the truth. However, the chromosome decay seems to spread to the female sex. Researchers are working hard on a path back to give birth to men. Can frozen sperm be the solution?

title: Denma
author: Yang, Youngsoon
description:
Silverquick is an intergalatic courier delivery services corporate that hires quanx with special abilities as their delivery men. Dike a.k.a the Merciless Death of Planet Urano becomes indebted to Silverquick, and becomes trapped inside a body of a small child named Denma. He takes off in a journey of making interstellar deliveries in hope of paying off his debt and reclaiming his body...

(Source: LINE Webtoon)

title: Imuri
author: Miyake, Ranjou
description:
The governing race, the Karma froze the planet Roon as a result of war and emigrated to a neighboring planet. Four-thousand years later, the ice covering Roon started melting and the Karma began migrating back to Roon. This is a heroic fantasy that portrays the young boy, Dulk, who gains the power of wonder sealed in the darkness of history, and comes face-to-face with his destiny.

(Source: Japan Media Arts Festival)

title: Hanaizawa-chou Kouminkan-dayori
author: Yamashita, Tomoko
description:
Decades ago, the tiny town of Hanaizawa was cut off from the rest of the world by an invisible wall, a wall that nothing living can pass through. The younger residents have grown up only knowing the outside world through what they see and hear in the media. These are the stories of their everyday lives, the good and the bad, as they live out their days in a tiny town that no one can enter and no one can leave—a town which, by its isolated nature, is destined to fade away.

(Source: Dead Scanlati

title: Manaka the Human and the Slaughter Robot
author: Iori, Nao
description:
For the future her parents expect of her, Yui, a high school student, spends each day with machine-like precision. But one day, she meets a fearless girl with a body that's half robot...

A story of two girls: a girl who seems like a robot, and a robot who seems almost human.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Star Wars: Leia, Princess of Alderaan
author: Haruichi, Gray, Claudia
description:
The never-before-told story of how young Leia Organa comes to join the rebellion against the evil Empire.

A young Princess Leia spends her days learning the ways of politics, aiding those in need and preparing for the traditional ceremony in which she declares her intention to one day rule Alderaan. But as Leia prepares herself to be named the heir of the throne, she becomes aware of the growing distance between her and her parents, who behind closed doors are leaders of the newly formed rebell

title: Mother 2: Ness no Boukenki
author: Itoi, Shigesato, Itoh, Benimaru
description: A manga based on Shigesato Itoi's cult video game "Mother 2" ("Earthbound" in North America) and illustrated by Benimaru Itoh.

title: Silver
author: Suetsugu, Yuki
description: During the prefecture tournament competition, in the midst of the cheering in the gymnasium, the scream of Aoba who collapsed echoed through it. Aoba, who was terribly injured who only lived life as an athlete went into despair. In the midst of that, a classmate, Gin, who is a little strange, nominated Aoba as a volleyball member for the ball tournament. "I want to play with you"... is how the two of them met and now, they are discovering the reason why and the real love. A sweet and painful, mi

title: Cyborg Roggy
author: Miki, Yuu
description:
Ten years ago, artificial biological implants known as "augmentation parts" were introduced into society. At the time, no one suspected the sinister turn of events that would come about because of body augmentations. And as the politicians and police stood by, the world watched as cyborg criminals, otherwise known as "augs," turned the world on its head...

(Source: VIZ Media)

Included one-shot:
Volume 1: Kaizou Ningen Roggy (pilot)
Volume 2: Kaizou Ningen Roggy (pilot 2)

title: Fukanzen Shinsei Kikan Ilis
author: Kasukabe, Akira, Sazane, Kei
description:
Three quarters of the world, is the world of the dead. The world has been invaded by phantoms. One day, a boy named Nagi finds in the mountains of scrap wood a mechanical teenage maid girl. He immediately takes her home to repair her. The first things that Elise, this mysterious mechanical maid, says is, "Good morning, Nagi." Who is this mysterious silver haired girl? The fate of the world rests in their hands.

(Source: MU)

title: Kantai Collection: Tomarigi no Chinjufu
author: Hiroichi
description: Kantai Collection manga featuring heavy cruiser sisters Suzuya and Kumano.

title: Super Taiheiki
author: Tezuka, Osamu
description:
Super Taiheiki is a science fiction action drama in which a boy who has come from the future fights against villains in the late Edo period using unique inventions.

(Source: Tezuka Osamu Official)

title: Deep Forest
author: Tashiro, Hokekyo
description:
There is a large virtual space called "Deep Forest," where many people go as avatars. Origa is a schoolgirl who has become an explorer in Deep Forest in an effort to discover the reason behind her mother's death. Luckily, she has a famous hacker as a partner and guide, a monkey avatar called Jr.

Deep Forest is a dangerous place, contested by the company she believes is responsible for her mother's death, hackers, and others. Origa has a difficult path to travel in order to uncover the truth.

(

title: The Irregular at Magic High School: Plan to Assassinate Tatsuya Shiba
author: Satou, Tsutomu, Ichino, Yuyu
description:
The manga features a new heroine named Yuki Hashibami, a magician assassin who is not a magician herself. She challenges Tatsuya in the story.

(Source: ANN)

title: Log Horizon Gaiden: Kushiyatama, Ganbaru!
author: Touno, Mamare, Hirasawa, Geko, Yamamoto, Yamane

title: CtG: Zero kara Sodateru Dennou Shoujo
author: Gangudou, bun150
description:
In the VRMMO CtG (Cradle to the Glaive), Kasugai Yuu has married with Miifa, a girl whom he just met. But after that, a child named Haruha was born and started to grow up?! More over...

"I'm coming, Papa!"

"Oh, Kugimiya..."

Even in the real world, the real Haruha and her mother Miifa, rather Kugimiya, also appeared! Living in the same roof, Yuu and Miharu, in-game and in real life, have to raise and educate Haruha, the one who can change the fate of humanity?!

title: Ninja Slayer Series
author: Warainaku, Bond, Bradley, Ninj@ Morzez, Philip
description:
Ninja...

Ninja were...
merciless demi-gods, ruling Japan with their karate in the age of ninja tranquility.
But, "some" committed a forbidden form of hara-kiri storing their souls at Kinkaku Temple for future resurrection.
Their lost history was falsified and concealed and the truth about these ninja was long forgotten.

Now, in the future where the universalization of cynbernetic technology and electronic networks are God, suddenly, sinister ninja souls, resurrected from thousands of years pas

title: Ryuu
author: Oze, Akira, Yajima, Masao
description: After having vivid daydreams of a barren and far off world, a teenage delinquent finds himself transported to this world after a near fatal accident.

title: Fake Rebellion
author: Sasaki, Yuuchan
description:
The Human Empire fell to ruin, leaving behind a dystopia controlled by the current Machinery Empire. In this wasteland where human life is deemed worthless, a wandering boy meets a princess in hiding. When tragedy occurs, the fallen rise, and a journey begins. Thus begins the story of two children and their fight to restore hope for humanity.

(Source: MU)

title: Dezi-con
author: Oda, Tomohito
description:
Hoshino Shiho is known in school as a major delinquent, and there are even three students who repeatedly ask her to be a part of her 'gang.' While Shiho does talk pretty rough, and she does beat up bullies when they're in her way, she really doesn't think of herself as a delinquent.

One night, in her family's hot spring inn, a spaceship crashes into the bath house. The alien from inside, "Dejiraoki Seco Omega," claims he has come to conquer and destroy Earth, as he has destroyed many planets be

title: Gekka no Utahime to Magi no Ou
author: Haneda, Daisuke, Ooba, Kagerou
description:
What kind of future awaits the boy who holds two powers that can change the world?

A technological revolution was brought about by The Last Witch, to the world of magic, with the introduction of 'science'. Lyle, a boy wielding the powers of both magic and science, was caught between his childhood friend, the noblewoman Maria who was pressing forward into an era of science, and Lunaria, a girl of the Phantasm race, a symbol of the age of magic.

Two different girls, from two different eras and a

title: Taitei no Ken
author: Yumemakura, Baku, Dohe
description: Yorozu Genkurou, wandering warrior, possesses an huge sword which makes him redoubtable to his enemies. While he crosses a dark forest, he suddenly sees the fall of what looks very much like a spaceship. Since, he is constantly being attacked by strange ninjas and ambitous fighters. Indeed, he will soon realize that his assailants are nothing else than aliens landed on Earth to find 3 artifacts made of Orichalcum, an alien substance with powerful mystical virtues. And one of the artifacts is the

title: Akai Kiba: Blue Sonnet
author: Shibata, Masahiro
description:
Komatsuzaki Ran is not a normal girl. Raised by wolves, psychic powers, the ability to turn into Akai Kiba (The Red Fang)...and a lot of people after her.

(Source: MU)

title: Code-Ex
author: Sakaki, Ichirou, Harao, Yumiko
description: Yuma Saihashi is a Miko who lives at the shrine. She is a lone wolf who distances herself from others and refrains from making friends. During her free time, she gives massages to the elders in the neighborhood but refuses their gifts. Like her friend Chinami, she can emit electromagnetic waves. Her power is not as strong as Chinami's but she can control it better. (Source: M-U)

title: Shiroi Pilot
author: Tezuka, Osamu
description: The White Pilot is a science fiction war story in which twin brothers fight each other in a twist of fate. Dr. Posk of Migurusha Kingdom, who was killed by the secret police, has twin sons. After his death, one of the boys is found and looked after by the Queen, becoming "Prince Marus," while his twin brother is sold to an underground factory as a slave. In the factory, he is raised as "Ban Daisuke," a son of Ban Shunsaku. Daisuke, along with his father and seven fellow slaves, robs the factory

title: Fushigi na Shounen
author: Tezuka, Osamu
description: Saburou Oonishi, an ordinary boy known as Sabutan, is a member of the Anpaka Gang made up of naughty boys in the neighborhood. Sabutan is nearly forced to become the leader of the Anpaka Gang, but refuses. As punishment, he is made to walk through a dark underpass, still under construction, alone. The underpass is a place where mysterious phenomena are said to happen from time to time. Sabutan is absorbed into the wall where some tiles have come off, and strays into a four-dimensional world. The

title: Yukikaze: Sentou Yousei
author: Tada, Yumi
description:
A coda to the OVA and novel of the same name, this six-chapter manga gives us a deeper glimpse into the back-stories of Rei Fukai, James Bukhar, Tomahawk John, and other members of the F.A.F.

However, some of the details about the characters' pasts and relationships appear to deviate from the sequence of events as seen in the anime. Therefore, this manga should only be read after having first watched the anime or read the novel, and treated as an alternate story of sorts.

(Source: MU)

title: Haiyore! Nyaruko-san Comic Anthology
author: Yagami, Yu, Sakurano, Minene, Haruse, Hiroki, Suemitsu, Dicca, Kanan, Asuka

title: Eclipse Hunter
author: Yu, Wo, Ya Sha
description:
"I live to protect my gege."
"If so, then dear didi, I live to protect your freedom. Go, do anything that will make you happy. If you want to destroy the world - I will prepare the ammunition. If you want to destroy me, before you kill me, call me gege one last time."

(Source: oddsquad.org)

title: Doctor Märs
author: Tezuka, Osamu
description:
The story of a scientist kidnapped by Martians to help them with their experiments.

(Source: MU)

title: Mai-HiME EXA
author: Suzukaze, Ryou
description: An alternate version of the original Mai-HiME manga.

title: Laws of the Universe
author: Tanaka, Kuu
description:
At the edge of the universe drifts a solitary vessel. Within its confines, a man serves an "eternal imprisonment." Through the endless passage of time, he becomes the first to create "something" unprecedented in space...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Fuwari! Don Patch
author: Sawai, Yoshio
description: A spin-off of Bobobo-bo Bo-Bobo starring Don Patch.

title: Destronaut
author: KENT
description:
Spaceship "Kinjo" lands on the Moon, carrying classified intel. After all contact with the ship and its crew is lost due to the spread of a mysterious biofluid, it's up to the last master swordsman left alive, Tomura Tadamitsu, to retrieve the ship's cargo.

(Source: MU)

title: Neko de Gomen!
author: Nagano, Akane
description:
Shiraishi Yayoi was a relatively unremarkable school girl, although a little clumsy, before a experimental accident changed her life forever. She was forced against her will by her father, self-proclaimed genius physicist, Shiraishi Sensei into a teleporter with a cat , and like in the movie "The Fly", she combined with the cat.

Now, whenever she gets excited about anything, a pair of cat ears and a tail pop into existence. In the "catgirl" form, she has super powers, but the major drawback is

title: 86: Mahou Shoujo Regina☆Lena - Tatakae! Ginga Koukou Senkan San Magnolia
author: Asato, Asato, Somemiya, Suzume
description:
A new 86 series spin-off set on the stage of the "Galactic Navigating Battleship San Magnolia"! To protect that ship and its people from their enemy, an army known as the Legion, the Handlers (Magical Girls) along with their partners the Eighty-Six (Guardian Spirits) run through the cosmos!

And so, the battle of the Magical Girl Lena is about to begin...!

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Yokohama Station SF
author: Tanaka, Tatsuyuki, Isukari, Yuba
description:
In a future where Yokohama Station covers most of the island of Honshu, there are two ways of life-inside the station and outside. Life within the station is strictly controlled, and those who fail to follow the rules are expelled to the harsher world outside. When one of these exiles receives a temporary ticket to go into the station, he's also given a mission to find the leader of a group determined to free humanity.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Star Children
author: Kida, Masashi
description:
In a near future where humans have safely traveled to Mars, the space program is looking to go to Jupiter for the first time in history. For Subaru Yuuto, Amami Kosei, one of the elite astronauts of the crew of Jupitonia (the ship heading to Jupiter), is not only a person that he looks up to but is also a dear friend of many years. But tragedy strikes and a malfunction causes an explosion in Jupitonia and the ship goes missing in deep space, most believing the crew to be dead.

Even with the dev

title: Magi-Cu 4-koma: Robotics;Notes
description: The cast of 5pb's Robotics;Notes adapted into the 4-koma format. The science may be negative but the antics are decidedly silly.

title: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei: Escape-hen
author: Yuzuki N', Satou, Tsutomu
description: The arc follows volumes 24 and 25 of the light novel.

title: Kyouran Kazoku Nikki
author: Akira, x6suke
description:
Thousands of years ago the God of destruction, Enka, died saying thats its child would destroy the world.Thousands of years later the potential children of Enka are found (some human, some not) and take part in the Peaceful Family Operation in order to discover who the true child of Enka is and stop them from destroying the world by teaching them the importance of family love.

The novels depict the not-so-normal life of a "family" that includes a catgirl "mother," a lion "son," a living land-co

title: Corrector Yui
author: Asamiya, Kia
description:
A schoolgirl gains self-confidence, new friends, and a cache of chic outfits when she becomes the computer-programming magical girl, Corrector Yui. She must stop the rogue A.I. Gurossa (Artificial Intelligence computer program) and his hench-programs from taking control of the global computer network. In this future, all human activity is supported by computers, so it's possible to control the world using the network.

(Source: MU)

title: Me and the Alien Mumu
author: Miyashita, Hiroki
description:
A cat-like alien from a distant galaxy, MuuMuu, arrives on Earth. His goal is to learn about home appliance technology on Earth to recover the technology his species has lost. The protagonist, Sakurako, has a typical university life, but everything changes with MuuMuu's arrival! What begins as an unexpected cohabitation quickly turns into a whirlwind of chaotic events. The chemistry between Sakurako and MuuMuu leads to a super-spectacular, appliance-filled, and cat comedy adventure.

(Source: Po

title: Biscuit Frankenstein
author: Akira, toi8
description:
1999. The "end of the world" that was talked half in doubt since Nostradamus' prediction was finally proven wrong.
But unknown to the public, an abnormal phenomenon was starting to spread. A "Disease" which disturbs the normal cell division process, making young girls' body rot alive, slowly killing them. And a beautiful and grotesque being born from this disease, guided by a hapless fate, starts walking on the borderline between good will and ill will, with the wafting sweet scent of death.

title: Juuki Kouhei Xenon
author: Kanzaki, Masaomi
description:
A dramatic story set in contemporary Japan, about a guy with amnesia, who finds out he was turned into a super-cyborg in a corporate weapon research program. He goes on a mission of revenge. A little shallow, perhaps, but a good example of shounen SF/action manga. The manga ended abruptly, because the magazine it was being serialized in changed its target public and it was decided that Xenon didn't fit in anymore.

(Source: MU)

title: Metroid Prime: Episode of Aether
author: Matsumoto, Hisashi
description: This manga is based on the video game Metroid Prime 2: Echoes. It is a summarizing story of what happens at the beginning of Metroid Prime 2.

title: Space China Dress
description: Shaolin Space, a place that's said to be where all martial arts in the universe originated from. And within this planet... a most sacred place among martial artists, Mt. Kunlun. And on top of that Mt. Kunlun, there's Kunlun Headquarters. And if you go down... a long way, inside a small run-down dumpling restaurant, our heroine lives.

title: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei: Douran no Joshou-hen
author: Satou, Tsutomu, Higuchi, Mei
description: The arc follows volumes 21 and 22 of the light novel.

title: Star Wars: The Mandalorian
author: Oosawa, Yuusuke
description: Years after the fall of the Galactic Empire, a solitary bounty hunter is given a simple mission. Find and return the Child to the Imperial Remnant, all that remains of the once all-powerful Empire. This mysterious orphan has a power that can possibly turn events in their favor, and acquisition of that power is paramount. Instead, the bounty hunter goes on the run with the Child to protect him from the forces that would do him harm. Here is the story of The Mandalorian, and his desperate quest to

title: The Irregular at Magic High School: Plan to Assassinate Tatsuya Shiba
author: Satou, Tsutomu, Ishida, Kana
description:
The novels feature a new heroine named Yuki Hashibami, a magician assassin who is not a magician herself. She challenges Tatsuya in the story.

(Source: ANN)

title: Kangoku Senkan: Hidou no Sennou Kaizou Koukai
author: Kusunoki, Rin, Lilith Soft
description: Lieri Bishop, an up-and-coming New Solars Commander and her aide, Major Naomi Evans board a battleship to earth to report the Neo Terrors' crimes to the Universal Federeation. The captain of the ship who is of the Neo Terrors, Donny Bogan, has had a grudge on them since four years ago when they had sabotaged a kidnapping mission on earth and got him arrested. So he has his chance and brainwashes them. Now when the lights change in the battleship, their personalities switches to one that suits th

title: Junk Planet
author: Shiina, Karuho
description:
A collection of 3 one-shots by author Shiina Karuho.

Garakuta Planet:
Mitsuru wishes on Tanabata Day that she will be truer to her feelings about her crush Kou-chan.  Enter Maekawa-kun who has come to help her achieve love!  The only thing is, he's not from Earth...?

White White:
Shino likes Yamazaki-senpai, who has a reputation of being a real playboy.  But Shino knows that these are just rumors b/c she has seen how in love he is with one particular girl...

Asayake wo Sanpo:
On one of Akari'

title: Senpuu Z
author: Tezuka, Osamu
description:
Z is the son of a scientist killed in a duel with another scientist. He is trying to right the wrongs of his father, but will people let him do it?

(Source: MU)

title: The Dog Created by the Professor
author: DUO BRAND.
description: In a futuristic world, Professor Tsukise has created the living machines known as Chimera. On the eve of their public unveiling, Tsukise struggles to accept the ethical ramifications of his creation. Should the Chimera be released to the public and more importantly, what should happen to his own Chimera, Kusanagi? (Source: Blissful Sin)

title: Aruji no Kigen
author: Park, Sung-Woo, Kihara, Hirokatsu
description:
On earth's last day the survivor is a hikkikomori?

(Source: Batoto)

title: Mechanical Buddy Universe 1.0
author: Katou, Takuji
description:
An android whose mission had been long completed finds a child abandoned in the ruins of a war-ravaged city. Amidst a dystopian world, a machine and human become mother and son.

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Legend of Regios
author: Amagi, Shuusuke, Miyuu
description:
A series set in the past world of Chrome Shelled Regios.

Failed on the development of space shuttles to let human go to space, wars arise everywhere on earth for the already running out materials, foods, and resources. In all of those riots, a research team "Alchemist" continues on developing a Subspace Creator System (Aurora Field).

Hundred of years pasts since then, Aurora walls are limiting the world people can go and nobody knows what lies behind those walls. And a research on "the other s

title: Chikyuu Taisen
author: Tezuka, Osamu
description: In an era where man has conquered the speed of sound, the speed of light is naturally what man wishes to conquer next. Dontaro Aranami is the son of a world-famous pilot. One day, when he and his father attempt to go at light speed, his father nearly dies. Dontaro and his mother go overseas to send him to a Swiss hospital when a military group attacks their train. This group, led by Colonel Gorbo of Uramecia, is plotting to seize rule of the land for himself. This is only the beginning of a larg

title: Tengoku no Hakoniwa
author: Hiruno, Tsukiko
description: In a post-nuclear world where most of the earth is uninhabitable, a girl named Lily lives in an underground cave. To keep her company is an android called Selene, who has been owned by Lily's family for multiple generations. Together, they have supported each other for nine whole years in what is otherwise an incredibly lonely world. However, both of the girls harbor the hope that survival will one day be possible in the outside world. Holding onto this belief is easier said than done, though, a

title: Comic S: Hayakawa Shobou Souritsu 70-shuunen Kinen Comic Anthology★SF-hen
author: Tezuka, Osamu, Yoshitomi, Akihito, Ishinomori, Shoutarou, Matsumoto, Leiji, Nagai, Go, Hagio, Moto, Azuma, Hideo, Tori, Miki, Nishijima, Daisuke, Tsubana, Imai, Tetsuya, Miyazaki, Natsujikei, Tsunamino, Yuu, Yokoyama, Eiji, coco
description:
A sci-fi anthology comic which celebrates Hayakawa Publishing's 70th anniversary.

Note: Story 1 was collected in Daichi no Kaoyaku Bagi, story 2 was collected in Yojigen Sekai, story 5 was collected in Hanshin, and story 15 was collected in To, Aru Hi no Sugoku Fushigi.

title: Tytania
author: Tanaka, Yoshiki, Gantetsu
description: After venturing into outerspace, humanity have built many planetary cities. Most of these cities were affiliated to the Interstellar Federation, and it became the biggest force in the galaxy. Therefore, people believed that the Age of the Federation would last long. However, the situation changes when a tribe called "Tytania" secedes from the Federation and receives the title of Lord from the Emperor of Vardhana. Tytania obtains a victory over the Federation, and they assert that the Empire cann

title: Only Sense Online: The Silver Muse
author: Yukisan, Aloha, Zachou
description: A side story of Only Sense Online that focuses on Myu.

title: Worlds
author: Fujisaki, Ryuu
description:
1. Hameln no Fuefuki
2. Worlds
3. Tight Rope
4. Shadow Disease
5. Soul of Knight

title: Ascribe to Heaven
author: Sugisaki, Yukiru
description: A world where mankind has become an endangered species. On a planet well known as "Flickle" resides a single human girl, Minii, who lives among the world of robots. One day she encounters a human prince and his guardian who falls from the sky.

title: Shiromaru
author: Hako, Isse
description:
A white, round SOMETHING has appeared in the Sea of Japan! The notoriously lazy Harusame gets appointed as the mysterious marine creature "Shiromaru" handler along with two quirky companions! While Harusame wants nothing more than to avoid human interaction, his encounters with Shiromaru force him to confront the past... A coming-of-age sci-fi drama for anyone who finds this world hard to live in!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Tetsuwan Adam
author: Azuma, Ryuukou
description:
It is the year 2045. To escape a dying Earth, mankind conducts a mass exodus to Mars. But an enemy surpassing human imagination lies in wait for them in space.

(Source: ANN)

title: 11 of Me
author: Go, Jiae, Yeong, Jaeyeong
description:
To Gibeom's surprise, the mechanical calculator he bought working at a junkyard turns out to be a time machine! With the time machine, he sets out to find and bring together his past selves. Currently, all 11 versions of Gibeom are living together peacefully, but unexpected problems materialize as Gibeom(s) interacts with people outside of his circle...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Shin Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei: Cygnus no Otome-tachi
author: Satou, Tsutomu, La-na
description:
The series moves away from the Shibas and focuses on Alisa Iba, now Alisa Juumonji, the half-sister of Katsuto Juumonji, who came about due to their father having an affair before remarrying after the death of his first wife.

(Source: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei Wiki)

title: Dysmatopia
author: Sato, Yoshimi
description: The story begins in the near future, where a social mobile network called the "Kizuna-Topia" controls all communication and surveillance in the wall-bound city. In this city, two sisters, Enna and Yayako, come face to face with the ongoing man-hunt for young, healthy children. They kidnap and take these kids to the white tower to extract their brains and sell their bodies. This man-hunt, led by the local police known as the "Jikei," is counteracted by the mysterious being only known as "The Witc

title: Death Hunter
author: Hirai, Kazumasa, Kuwata, Jirou
description:
A fierce, ruthless, aggressive and evil creature, the cosmic life form "Death" appears before the human race. An epic tale depicted by the brilliance of Hirai and Kuwata's on humanity's collapse and the birth of a new human race!

(Source: MU)

Included one-shot:
Volume 4: Lir kara Kita Akumu

title: Terra Formars 1
author: Tachibana, Kenichi, Sasuga, Yu
description: Terra Formars 1 tells the story of the BUGS1 mission to Mars in 2577.

title: Piron no Himitsu
author: Tezuka, Osamu
description:
1. Piron no Himitsu (The Secret of Piron)
2. Oyama no Sangorou

title: The Upgraded Boyfriend
author: Agasa, Reiji
description:
Ever since he was young, Leo struggled with many things that came easily to others. Both in his daily life and at work, he grew tired of himself for always causing trouble for those around him. Then one day, Leo got into a terrible traffic accident. When he woke up, he discovered that his brain had been replaced with a machine...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Koukaku Kidoutai: Ghost in the Shell Comic Tribute
author: Yamamoto, Masayuki, Kinutani, Yuu, Boichi, Takezaki, Tony, Tadano, Nobuaki, Inoue, Tomonori, Imai, Yuu, Koike, Nokuto, Ooyama, Takumi
description: Anthology of short stories created by various mangaka to celebrate the release of the live-action Hollywood Ghost in the Shell movie adaptation.

title: Ginga Eiyuu Densetsu: Eiyuu-tachi no Shouzou
author: Michihara, Katsumi, Tanaka, Yoshiki
description: Continuation of Reinhard von Lohengramm's quest to rule space.

title: 22XX
author: Shimizu, Reiko
description: About a robot, Jack, who appears frequently in Shimizu's SF stories. He's a robot with very human-like psyche. He once believed that he was human and he can even consume food, unlike many of the other robots of those times. While performing bounty-hunting duties on a strange planet, he has a flashback to the time he believes he was human... In this flashback, he and his partner are imprisoned and are given scarce food everyday. They share that meager meal, half and half. Yet as the days pass, th

title: Puberty Organism Vega
author: Hayashiya, Shizuru
description:
1. Heart Cooker
2. Shishunki Seimeitai Vega 0
3-5. Shishunki Seimeitai Vega
6. Sono Onna, Uchuujin ni Tsuki

title: Might Through Death
author: Senoo, Shippo, Monkey
description: "Revive, Human." Ai Shinogami, the weakest recruit in the United Galactic Army, was supposed to have died on the battlefield. However, the chest pierced by the Kaiki, humanity's enemy, has healed, and the torn arm has reattached itself. On the verge of death, Ai made a contract with Nosferatu, the king of the Kaiki, to coexist with him inside his body. Through this contract, Ai can revive even after dying multiple times, and his physical abilities continue to enhance as he becomes one with Nosfe

title: Compiler
author: Asamiya, Kia
description:
COMPILER is a story about the Igarashi brothers Nachi and Toshi, and two beauties from another dimension, Compiler and Assembler. Originally sent to conquer Earth through a game of destruction and creation, Compiler and Assembler ended up deciding that living in our world is more fun than conquering it. They moved in with Nachi and Toshi. A growing relationship began to develop between Nachi and Compiler, and Toshi and Assembler, though none of them can bring themselves to admit it outright.

Me

title: Vandread Special Stage
author: Akane, Kotetsu, Mori, Takeshi, Gonzo
description:
Vandread Special Stage collects together several humorous side stories, as well as a final story arc where the Nirvana meets up with the rest of the Mejere pirates, so Hibiki must go in disguise...

(Source: MU)

title: Arikai Annu
author: Fuzuki, Takahiro
description:
The story is about a girl and her grandfather who take care of a nest of giant ants. When a huge velvet worm shows up uninvited, they have to rally the ants in order to defend their home.

(Source: Watson Scan)

title: Gaia Gear
author: Tomino, Yoshiyuki
description:
Gundam Gaia Gear is the story of the resistance group Metatron's struggle against the Man Hunting Attachment (MHA) police force of the tyrannical Earth Federation in the year UC 0203. To improve their chances of winning, Metatron creates a memory clone of the legendary Char Aznable. Char Afranche, aged 19 years, assumes command of Metatron and pilots the Gaia Gear Alpha after learning the truth of his origins.

Gundam Gaia Gear was written by Tomino Yoshiyuki and features mechanical designs [mos

title: The Story of Letters
author: Torino, Shino
description:
1. Ichigo to Anemone (Strawberry and Anemone)
2. Shiroki Shisha (The White Messenger)
3. Higara (Periparus after)
4. Schrodinger no Koibito (Schrodinger's Sweetheart)
5. Hoshi no Hayashi ni Tsuki no Fune (Stellar Wood and Ship of the Moon)

title: The End of Us And
author: Koruse
description: Included one-shot: Soredewa Minasan Yoi Shuumatsu wo

title: Hinadori Girl
author: Matsuzawa, Mari
description:
Experience the robot maid occupation like you've never seen it before in Hinadori Girl. Support Robot: Sally 001 has just been completed by boy technophile Yoshiki. Yet her "hinadori" or Fledgling personality makes her ill-suited in her role as a maid and leaves Yoshiki very smitten with her. Evil teachers and jealous sisters round this quirky cast of slapstick literature.

(Source: DrMaster)

title: When the Fireball Falls for the 100th Time
author: Shioyage, Sakuso
description:
The feeling of being watched... Mysterious phone calls asking for advice from strangers that started out of the blue... And a life-changing encounter that would alter everything?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Getsumen to Heiki Miina
author: Gonzo, Nylon
description: After establishing contact with extraterrestrial civilizations, it was found that humans were the only race to develop various sports. The number of alien sports fans grew dramatically, and the most fanatic of them regularly harass stadiums for taking part in a game, or demanding a good show, etc. Finally a treaty was settled, ruling all interferences towards other planets' cultures illegal. Rabbit Force, a group of rabbit-themed henshin girls, became responsible for enforcing the treaty and cap

title: Agartha of true metallic element
author: Tokitoh, Kanade
description:
The Magane infection turns humans into "Magane," monsters of corrosive iron. The Magane prey on others by devouring or infecting them. They consume entire villages, leaving no survivors of their destruction... until Alma and his group of friends appear. They possess powers far above those of a normal human: the power to kill the Magane. Alma and company save the young Tenkou from infection, and he soon becomes their guide to the legendary "Agartha of Shintetsu."

(Source: Fallen Syndicate)

title: Strike Witches: Otome no Maki
author: Shimada, Humikane, Nanbou, Hidehisa, Ueda, Hashigo

title: Girl's Interstellar Adventure
author: Yoruno, Hitsujigumo, Agarizaki, Yuiko
description:
A spaceship in the shape of a horse-drawn carriage travels across the galaxy. Riding in the carriage is Ridley, the scientist who built this eccentric spaceship, and her partner Watari, a shy girl. The two leave Earth, which has become uninhabitable due to environmental pollution, and set off in the carriage. Their goal is to find a safe planet to settle.

However, all the planets they visit are very strange! A planet with a god who can bring all things back to life, another planet where the luc

title: Myther
author: Yatsuda, Teki
description: In the 2nd year of the Enka era, a scientist has invented Myther, a device designed to create the ideal personality. With it, people can become their ideal selves and break away from their weak selves. However, below the surface, Myther Crime—a hidden social issue—has emerged, in which those who abuse Myther suffer from mental collapse and carry out horrific acts of violence. Kyou, a member of the Special Intelligence Agency, directly controlled by the Japanese authorities, works in secret to fi

title: S.F. and Fancy Free
author: Tezuka, Osamu
description:
A collection of short stories, full of irony, ideas, and the fun of science fiction.

(Source: Tezuka Osamu Official, translated)

Included one-shots: Dauberman, Shammy 1000, 7-ka no Kyoufu, Aka no Tanin

title: Midori no Hoshi
author: Shinzou, Keigo
description: A story about a part-timer working at a space shipping company who crash lands on a planet inhabited by frog-like beings.

title: Bouken Rubi
author: Tezuka, Osamu
description:
1-9. Bouken Rubi
10-13. Jungle Taitei

title: Aliens
author: Kabuto, Junichi
description:
Thirteen-year-old Ai Kiyomiya has always been told to act normal in order to receive love and affection from her callous mother. However, this simple task is a tall order for Ai when a person suddenly falls from the sky and gets run over by a truck in front of her eyes. Ai tries to calm herself down, but the mysterious arrival pleads her not to call the "humans" as she heals herself.

The being calls herself "Nike" and is part of an intergalactic species known as "Entity A"—often labeled as one

title: Strike Witches Gekijouban: Kaeritai Basho
author: Shimada, Humikane, Nanbou, Hidehisa
description:
In 1945, Yoshika Miyafuji, who lost her witch powers during the Strike Witches' last assignment, has been studying to become a doctor. Shizuka Hattori, one of her cadets in the Imperial Fuso Navy, then arrives to deliver a message: Yoshika is to be transferred for study abroad in Europe. 

(Source: Kadokawa)

title: Ultra Kaijuu Gijinka Keikaku: Galaxy☆Days
author: Bakutendou
description: A gag manga featuring anthropomorphized versions of kaiju from the long-running tokusatsu series Ultraman.

title: Redefining the META at VRMMO Academy
author: Akita, Hika, Hayaken
description:
Nothing like a bit of modding to change the weakest class in a VRMMO into the strongest!

Our game-loving protagonist, Takashiro Ren, enjoys nothing more than taking the weakest classes and wimpiest skills, only to flip their inadequacies on their heads! After hearing from his MMO buddy about a special school that provides lessons in VRMMO games, he decides to enroll. Like second nature to him, he quickly picks the so-called weakest job, Symbologist. Just as he’s setting about transforming it in

title: Shangri-La
author: Ikegami, Eiichi
description: In the middle of 21st century, the global warming changed Tokyo into a tropical city and the devastating squalls made it impossible to live a civilized life in the city. The government decided to abandon Tokyo and evacuate people to a gigantic layered megalopolis "Atlas", but the small capacity of Atlas gave rise to a huge number of refugees and the anti-government guerrillas. Houjyou Kuniko, the leader of the guerrilla, took up the arms and confronted the government to stop the Atlas project.

title: The Moonlight
author: SHOOWA
description:
A collection of short stories.

1. Getsuei (The Moonlight)
2. Homo-ren Sentai: Mamorun jyaa (Homo Rangers Regiment)
3. Zai Kakushi (Hidden Sin)
4. Jugurino Juguno
5. Nigemizu (Mirage)

title: Strobe Lights
author: Aoyama, Kei
description: In the night train, Tadashi Hamazaki revives how he met his ex-girlfriend Mika Machida... in an extraordinary way.

title: Atlantid
author: Yamaji, Hidenori
description:
1882, London. An injured woman safeguarding a powerful ring is fleeing a dangerous organization. The ring is pick-pocketed by a local thief gang, and she passes out from her injuries before being able to recover it. When she awakes, she finds that the young thief has taken care of her, and a boy named Sari, who has no memories of his life before the gang took him in five years ago, has the ring.

When the organization tracks them down, he wears the ring and unleashes its power. However, he can't

title: Toaru Majutsu no Index x Dennou Senki Virtual-On: Toaru Majutsu no Virtual-On
author: Kamachi, Kazuma, Hibipon

author: Nekobyou, Neko
description:
This is a spin-off of the series Night Wizard. It has completely different characters.
Ryuunosuke changes into a female wizard when he senses monsters called Emulators.
(Source: MU)

title: Radio Heads
author: Mukoura, Hirokazu
description: At the Ozu Technical High School, students ranging from first years in their teens to fifth years already in their 20’s are bred to become engineers. Togawa Sumiji is the president of the Robotics Division and is just as gifted and passionate as all the other nerds in his school. But something about Sumiji makes him stand out from everyone else. And with the robot competition drawing close, it’s time for him to shine as the president and lead his members into building the greatest robot in histo

title: Avengers: Zombies Assemble
author: Komiyama, Yuusaku
description:
The Avengers team gets together to throw a surprise party for Tony Stark. Things take a turn for the worse, when zombies appear on site, and the heroes ditch the celebrations to stop the outbreak. Facing a legion of the undead, some of the superheroes become infected themselves.

(Source: ANN)

title: Star Wars: v. 2
author: Hiromoto, Shinichi
description:
Contains original stories set in the Star Wars universe featuring characters from the six films. This work shows you many different sides of the familiar franchise, featuring everything from comedy to tragedy to despair to redemption. (Source: Waterstones)

Star Wars Silver contains the following stories;
    * Perfect Evil Part 2 by Hiromoto-SIN-ichi
    * Oh!! Jawajawa by Hitoshi Ariga
    * Star Wars -Phantasmagoria- by Baron Ueda
    * Vader vs. R2 & 3PO by Makomo Nakatsuka
    * Dark Je

title: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei: Koritsu-hen
author: Kitaumi, Tsuna, Satou, Tsutomu
description: The arc follows volume 23 of the light novel.

title: Scatter: Anata ga Koko ni Ite Hoshii
author: Arai, Hideki
description: A young, unemployed, seemingly unmotivated young man is moving through his life. As a teenager, he and some of his friends formed a "Boyz 4 Men" club, which was based on a hatred of sex and women. As arguably the most opinionated member, his view of sexuality as an adult is far from normal. After a highly sexual encounter in a park at night, he has decided to attempt to draw perverted fetish manga. This brings him once again to the presence of a woman from the park, Sawada Kazumi. She's a manga

title: Battleship Girl
author: Ijou, Kouu, M.WOLVERINE
description: Yukikaze is just a young girl but her and her friends have the incredible responsibility of being the naval force of her nation. As part of Seiran Team 3 of the Wadatsumi naval base, Yukikaze and her female friends, Isokaze, Nowaki and Takao, all attend the naval academy. But in this world, they do not work on ships, instead, they themselves are the weapons, able to travel across oceans at high speeds and engage in warfare using their equipped artillery. When an enemy nation attacks the base to

title: Kimi wo Shinasenai Tame no Storia
author: Gin, Toriko

title: Necossas: Six
author: Shiono, Etorouji
description: One night an android which looked like a cat (a Necossass: Six type) suddenly appears in Katsuhiko Katsu's room. The android said she comes from the 22th century and that Katsu has left a note in a time capsule that he wanted to live with a robot-cat.

title: Jeep and Wagon
author: Tashiro, Kenji
description:
With 18th century Paris as the stage, in the age of automates, the city is attacked and put under siege by a maniacal Count and his giant automate. It's up to Jeep to take up her family's destiny and call upon the support of her imprisoned uncle to defeat the wicked Count before he destroys Paris and its people!
(Source: MU)

title: At Home Happy System
author: Ogura, Muku, Kobato, Mebaru
description: You can get a feeling for someone... even if it's not human.

title: Kangoku Senkan: Hidou no Sennou Kaizou Koukai
author: Fuse, Haruka, Lilith Soft, Kagami
description: Lieri Bishop, an up-and-coming New Solars Commander and her aide, Major Naomi Evans board a battleship to earth to report the Neo Terrors' crimes to the Universal Federeation. The captain of the ship who is of the Neo Terrors, Donny Bogan, has had a grudge on them since four years ago when they had sabotaged a kidnapping mission on earth and got him arrested. So he has his chance and brainwashes them. Now when the lights change in the battleship, their personalities switches to one that suits th

title: Mimoza de Sarada
author: Morio, Masami
description:
Mimoza's grandfather was worried about her until the time of his death. Before he dies he tells her that since she was too vulnerable and easily lied to by everyone to never trust people. He also leaves behind Kyle, a robot, to protect her from others. Thanks to Kyle, Mimoza no longer feels alone. But will she ever discover the secret this robot hides? 

(Source: Aria)

title: Ookami Rise
author: Itou, Yuu
description: In the near future, the state of Japan has disappeared. The island is now split in two. The north is administered by Russia and the south by China. The border between the two countries is delimited by a buffer zone, demilitarized and emptied of its inhabitants. It is there, in this forbidden zone, that the Wolang have found refuge. These 49 fugitives are the result of failed experiments by the Chinese army, which wanted to transform them into biological weapons to be used against its Russian nei

title: The Tale of a Time Gone By
author: Matsumoto, Leiji
description: Collection of 24 short stories on the theme of time published in Play Comic in the 70s.

title: World's End Blue Bird
author: Seina, Anji
description:
After a meteor hits Earth, Tokyo is saved by a powerful sorcerer. Years later, the city ends up split between the haves and have-nots—with the sorcerer's descendants ruling over them all.

Ray, a handyman from the slums, will take on any job for the right price. One day, he meets Guang, an extraordinarily pretty, secretive, and arrogant man from upper society. After spending a night together, Ray finds himself protecting Guang, which may cause him more trouble than the money is worth...

(Source

title: Asuka@Future.Come
author: Shimamoto, Kazuhiko
description: A young boy from the future meets a girl of our time. Their school life will completely change...

title: Die Quarry Proie
author: Swee Chin, Foo
description:
A short full-color oneshot by a Singaporean mangaka about people making a video game, then entering that very same game and struggling to exit.

(Source: MangaUpdates)

title: Tokyo Interstellar Immigration
author: Mado, Guchimoto
description:
The Tokyo Interstellar Bureau of Immigration: Japan's finest cosmic border patrol team, busting their butts on the daily to keep Planet Earth safe. Ride along with Lein and Ann, two high school girls who kick ass, hunt down aliens, and look dapper while doing it!

(Source: VAST Visual)

title: Takeru
author: Terasawa, Buichi
description: The exploits of Takeru Ichimonji, the summoner of Spirit Words, explode across the pages of this first-ever full-color, computer graphic comic!

title: Dancer no Kiroku
author: Wada, Takashi
description:
A man is on a research expedition in an underwater city, where he discovers a holographic recording of a ballerina.

(Source: MU)

title: Hakushi no Fukakai na Yaen
author: Kinoshita, Sakura
description:
A little boy with amazing scientific knowledge lives in a lonely mansion with his butler. But their seemingly peaceful existence is quickly shattered as researchers, military personnel, and killer androids start pursuing the boy, determined to seize his experiments and harness his knowledge to their advantage. 

(Source: M-U)

title: Tokyo ESP Gaiden: London ESP
author: Segawa, Hajime, Mori, Tetsuya
description:
Heeding her father's words, Azuma Minami escaped from Tokyo to continue their path of revenge. Accompanied with Kouzuki, they traveled west, all while carrying the Ark in their secure possession.

(Source: Novel Updates)

title: Sex Warrior Isane Extreme
author: OKAWARI
description: In the future, mankind has fallen into corruption and degradation. In a world slipping slowly into madness, sexual depravity and violence have become the norm. Violent times call for violent responses and now only a shadowy organization of inhuman godly beings, The Committee, has begun to rein in a world of decay. But in order to save the world? Or to satisfy their own twisted desires? No one can tell. Isane is one of their agents, a top Mediator with a mutant arm genetically re-engineered by th

title: Ryuusei no Rockman
author: Itagaki, Masaya
description: Subaru is grieving the disappearance of his father and questioning the unusual partnership he has gained with the AM-ian War-Rock. By combining their powers, they are able to transform into the EM Wave Human named Rock Man and battle crime.

title: Shin Uchuu Senkan Yamato
author: Matsumoto, Leiji
description: In 3199, 1000 years after the events from the first anime series, all the people on the Earth are faced with crisis again. When mysterious presence calling herself Yo Haguro gathers together the descendants of the original Yamato crew, the legendary battleship is restored to protect all human beings from new villain - Darqueen.

title: Nippon Furusato Chinbotsu

description: An anthology of comics, based on Sakyou Komatsu's best-selling novel, Nihon Chinbotsu (1973); a story of Japan slowly sinking into the sea, represented strictly in a derisive mode.

title: Space Pirate Sala

description:
Sarah is a most terrible pirate knight who dances her way around the galaxy empire that has been ravaged by war. In the galaxy ruled by a number of power-hungry rival warlords, an evil sadistic web is woven around Sarah, who is slowly guided down to her destruction. When the silver knight Sylia comes across the evil aristocrats who have run the gamut of corruption in the galaxy and the slave traders of darkness, the demonic twins, a desperate predicament is visited upon Sarah!!

(Source: dlsite)

title: RD Sennou Chousashitsu
author: Shirow, Masamune, Miyano, Momotarou
description: Real Drive is a "neo-futuristic science-fiction suspense" story set in A.D. 2061, when a new, more secure information network called the Material Network (or "Metal") has taken over human society. However, aberrations begin to crop up as individuals chafe against the rigid system, and so-called "cyber divers" are dispatched to investigate these incidents. The main characters are the cyber driver Mari, an "intuitive girl" named Minamo, the team's head Eiichirou, the combat expert Souta, and the a

title: Genocidal Organ
author: Itou, Keikaku

The war on terror exploded, literally, the day Sarajevo was destroyed by a homemade nuclear device. The leading democracies transformed into total surveillance states, and the developing world has drowned under a wave of genocides. The mysterious American John Paul seems to be behind the collapse of the world system, and it's up to intelligence agent Clavis Shepherd to track John Paul across the wreckage of civilizations and to find the true heart of darkness—a genocidal organ.

(Source: VIZ Med

author: Iwai, Kyohei, Shirabi
description:
Two years have passed since the transformation of Tokyo. Highschool student Akizuki Renji along with the popular idol Yumiie Kanata became "invaders" whose job is to invade "Critical Zone: Tokyo." At the dead city known to be controlled by "the enemies of mankind." Can the promise sworn between Renji and Kanata be fulfilled!?

(Source: Translated from official description)

title: Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth - Hacker's Memory

description:
Keisuke Amazawa goes to the DigiMarket, where he remembers how he got his partners, Betamon, Tentomon, and Gotsumon. Not happy, he challenges the owners of the market and has to fight against their Triceramon, Tyrannomon, and Monochromon.

(Source: Digimon Wiki)

title: Tenken

description:
The world has been annihilated and an evil bestial deity must be appeased. Saki, a young girl, trying to escape destiny, finds refuge in an unusual and rough line of work. But she has been chosen for an unthinkable role; a princess must be sacrificed to the monster Yamata-no-Orochi at the 50 year Tenken Festival. Can Manaka, the man who is in love with her, follow her into this abyss to save her from fate; only to discover the dark secret of the ceremony?

(Source: One Peace Books)

title: Chrono Code

description:
Three people cross time and space to find each other, and to try to change destiny. But with a powerful satellite, a secret code and the future police out hunting, one girl with amnesia, who may be the key to everything, must discover the true nature of her past... and her friends.

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Scum of the Brave
author: Rocket Shoukai, Nakashima723
description:
In contemporary Tokyo, Mafia bosses are now "Demon Kings," and "The Brave" are now legally authorized to hunt them. "Angel of Death" Yashiro, a freelance Brave, is roped into going up against a Demon King in Shibuya, by Aki Jogamine, a high school girl who is an apprentice Brave. But behind it all is an evil conspiracy that has permeated the entire city!

(Source: Mantra)

A battle ensues over life and death, machines or clones, create synthetic hearts or grow them? Two boys, Sei and Oishi, fall madly in love for Yuko. Her loss wreaks havoc in their young lives as relentless memories cease to fade. As a result their tender hearts are dedicated to a dream that no one will ever suffer their excruciating pain again. But, is what they had thought been a lie? Is there still a chance that their suffering may end? Will mercy and love prevail?

(Source: One Peace Books)

Jammed packed with awesome sex scenes (most are even more intense than those depicted in Slut Girl). Probably Isutoshi’s most personal work. The “H” is very hentai, with lots of group, dp, lesbian, spoof, and more... but with a good amount of gags/comic relief thrown in as well! (source: Taken Thor-Hammer)

In this matriarchal society, the story unfolds of a slave who fights to build a nation where men and women can coexist. Stimulation and pleasure! From holding mass to proselytizing and even cleaning up after magical combat!? Agnese Sanctis's group has joined the Anglican Church and they have been given some "odd jobs" to complete by a priest with long red hair.

"I don't like the sound of this. I really, really don'

Six months later, in a certain Asian village, a young girl named Zhihan discovers an old man who fell from the sky...but the strangeness doesn't end there. While every other girl appears to like guys, Hanamura Taka is an exception. And then she meets Sakura-kun, a person from her new job... and he asks her to keep a secret for him.

(Source: Elision-Scans)

title: NG from here on!
author: Izumi, Mio, Matsuda, Yuuko
description:
Haru who's allergic to boys transferred to a class full of ikemens and bishounen! Will romance spark between Haru and the boys?

(Source: Winter Translations)

title: Shinbun-bu no Komatsu-san
author: Mizuno, Minami
description: Komatsu Akina is a passionate photographer for her school's newspaper club. When Aoi-kun of the Student Council confesses to her, all of a sudden she has this huge decision to make. Since she has never dated before, Komatsu is confused as to whether or not she should date the extremely popular Aoi-kun, who is constantly surrounded by pretty girls. She continues to struggle with her own lack of confidence and her budding feelings for Aoi-kun, but decides that sometimes she just has to take a leap

title: Akai Michi
author: Andou, Yuki
description:
Kazuka is your average high school girl with the exception of having an irregular personality. She wakes up one morning slightly later than usual to find a red thread attached to her finger...

And for her, it isn't "who" is at the other end, but "what" should she do about it...

(Source: In.Difference)

title: 2 Kaime no Hajimete no Koi
author: Kumagai, Kyouko
description:
Yumika’s first love was her tutor Shin. As she hope to meet Shin once again, which really happens, how will Yumika proceed on to confess to Shin about her feelings… 

(Source: Midnight Scans)

title: A Springtime with Ninjas
author: Hasegaki, Narumi
description:
Benio is the heiress of the richest family in Japan, and tradition holds that she must marry the first person to kiss her. So that she can attend high school, Benio is assigned the ninja Tamaki as a bodyguard, but he turns out to be quite the player. It's not always easy for a strong-willed rich girl and a smart-alecky ninja to get along in this romantic comedy about a pure young lady and her smoking-hot knight.

(Source: Kodansha Comics USA)

Included one-shot:
Volume 1: Ninkoi (pilot)

title: Boku no Kotori-san
author: Kusanagi, Mizuho
description:
Nagomi Mameshiba (18), for the first time in his life, he invites a girl to his house with "oden" as bait. Just what is he planning? Can he convey his feeling with an oden dinner?!

(Source: Cave Scanlations)

title: Bye-bye Mitsubari
author: Satonaka, Mika
description:
My childhood friend who loved messing with me moved away 10 years ago but now he's back. My everyday life is filled with sweet despair!

(Source: Winter Translations)

title: First Love Monster
author: Hiyoshimaru, Akira
description:
When fifteen-year-old Kaho Nikaidou leaves her sheltered home to start life anew in Tokyo, the last thing she expects is to nearly get hit by a truck! Saved in the nick of time by a handsome stranger, Kaho falls head over heels for him and boldly confesses her feelings. The handsome object of Kaho's affection agrees to go out with her, but her newfound bliss is short lived when it turns out that her new boyfriend... is a fifth grader?!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: 17-sai, Natsu.: Seifuku no Jouji
author: Watanabe, Shiho
description:
1. 17-sai, Natsu.:  Seifuku no Jouji
2. 17-sai, Fuyu.: Osanajimi
3. 17-sai, Haru.: Tsumeeri no Yokubou
4. 17-sai, Aki.: Houkago no Mitsu

title: Iyada nante Iwasenai
author: Nanajima, Kana
description:
Anzu currently works part-time at a beach house however when it comes to serving male customers, she can't help but be cold and shy. When she accidentally spills a drink on one of them, a male co-worker saves her who ends up being her childhood friend Rei. Anzu is happy to reconnect with Rei, however, Rei might be after a bit more...?

(Source: Shoujo Crusade, Chibi Manga)

Included one-shot:
Volume 2: Vitamin Shounen

title: Kimi wa Maru de, Ano Hana no You de.
author: Gotou, Misaki
description:
On the day of the junior high entrance ceremony, Hinagata Nazuna fell in love with a second year student, Ichikawa Nao. Unfortunately, her love was short-lived as she discovered that he already had a girlfriend, the basketball club manager. As time passes, Nazuna decides to let go of her unrequited love for him and aims to find a new love interest. However, on the first day of her high school entrance ceremony she unexpectedly comes face to face with the boy who broke her heart years ago…

(Sour

title: Bloody Kiss
author: Yagami, Rina
description:
For some strange reason, schoolgirl Wakaba has no memories of her first love. She wears a pendant, but unable to recall its origin, she can only assume it to be a gift from him. Whenever she stares at the ornate key, it brings to mind the sound of a sobbing boy along with the scents of roses and blood. These clues seem insufficient to identify the boy from her past, but fatefully, she soon finds herself in a reminiscent situation. 

One day, Wakaba comes across a beautiful boy crying in the scho

title: Asahi-sempai's Favorite
author: Machino, Iroha
description:
Poor first year high school student Matsuri has an awkward encounter with her older brother's extremely popular friend Asahi one day after she gets out of the bath! Ever since then, whether she's home, at school, or wherever, Asahi seems to meddle with her…! Her days have gotten a little sweeter, flirtier, and naughtier when she spends them around Asahi, and it's awful!

(Source: Tokyo Otaku Mode)

title: Manin Densha to Watashi to Kare
author: Suzuki, Temari
description:
The packed morning train isn't a good place to be if you're small; a fact that high-schooler An knows all too well. So when a boy rescues her from the crowd one morning, she should be grateful... right? The only problem is, he treats her like a little kid! Who is her rescuer, and what will happen when she meets him again...?

(Source: Shoujo-Sense)

title: R-18 Love Report!
author: Sugi, Emiko
description: Riko Mitsumi is sixteen year-old girl who is pretty and a good student. She would be like most girls if she wasn't constantly dreaming about sex and using a pseudonym to write about it. (Source: M-U)

title: Hajimari no Natsu
author: Hoshimi SK
description:
