author: Wakuhara, Niko
description:
Kotone, who thinks of herself as an average office worker, is fascinated by dazzling and mysterious things. Meanwhile, it's revealed that Shishidou, a good-looking superior in the company, is the enigmatic "Love Deity"! Hearing the rumor that a person's wish for love instantly comes true if they pray to him, Kotone seeks out Shishidou.

(Source: ShoujoHearts)

title: Proposal no Riyuu
author: Winters, Rebecca, Kasuga, Kaoru
description:
The billionaire's pregnancy proposition! Andrea is about to lose her last chance to have a baby -- and so is stunned when her sexy boss, businessman Gabe Corbin, suggests he can help her become a mother! Now they have six months to conceive -- and in that time Gabe plans to prove to Andrea that he'll make the perfect father... and husband!

(Source: FictionDB)

title: Onna no Ie
author: Torikai, Akane
description:
The story centers on 29-year-old Arika, who was just dumped by her boyfriend, and her 25-year-old younger sister Sumika. The two return to their mother's hometown of Osaka since their mother has a serious illness. Her mother suddenly gives Arika a "mother's order": Arika must move with her and Sumika to live together in Tokyo. The manga tells the story of the "women only" household of two sisters and their mother. 

(Source: ANN)

title: Frozen Terrain
author: Hinase, Yuuki
description:
Iroha works at a small family bakery downtown, and she has her eyes on the cute, younger part-time staff member, Ippei. He looks a little... actually, very scary, but once you get to know him, he's a total sweetheart. Iroha's always smiling and being nice to people, but deep down, she's hiding her true feelings. Ippei's kindness envelopes her and gradually warms her up... A cute, sweet, and warm love story with a younger guy!

(Source: Renta!)

Included one-shot: Sono Hitomi ni Utsushite

title: Passionate Fantasy
author: Kendrick, Sharon, Fuyuki, Rurika
description:
Kitty has an ulterior motive for applying to work as a live-in chef for Darius Speed, a world-famous movie director. Darius is a thief! He is planning to make a film based on a script he stole from Caro, an elderly woman who helped Kitty in her time of need. But Caro has no evidence, which is why Kitty decides to infiltrate Darius's home to get the script back. But looking into Darius's beautiful eyes, Kitty finds it hard to believe this man is capable of such a thing....

(Source: Jmanga)

title: Tsutaeru Toiki
author: Miyazono, Izumi
description:
Shino became the librarian clerk she aspired to become but she is in a group with Tsuzuki, who gave her a very bad first impression. In the half year to come, she has to endure Tsuzuki's poisonous tongue and his mean heart. But although she hates him, when she is near him, her heartbeat quickens. One day, Shino kisses him in his sleep...?

(Source: MU)

title: Dr. Shiina's Wildlife Encyclopedia
author: Tootsuki, Shiya
description:
Shiina is a serious man who has wanted to be a zoology professor since he was a child. He was infamous forcarrying around many massive books and now Shiina works diligently to train future zoologists at a university while looking after his childhood friend, Chitose. Chitose is also an associate professor of biology and walks around everywhere with penguins, making him quite infamous as well. This manga focuses on the trials, tribulations, and future of the young associate professor, Shiina.

(So

title: Love and Fashion Given by My Boss
author: Natsuna, Hono
description:
Yuzu Kosaka, an office worker at an apparel company, has a complex about not looking good in cute things. She likes to look at cute clothes and has a desire to try them on, but... She just can't bring herself to try them on because she thinks they "don't suit her." One day, she wanders into a ladies' clothing store to buy a gift for a friend, and out of the fitting room comes Yuzu's boss, who is famous for his chic and handsome looks!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Today's Cat Matters
author: Iwamichi, Sakura
description: It's all about the lives of the author's family of cats.

title: Princess of Convenience
author: Hashimoto, Takako, Lennox, Marion
description: In order to buy the highest quality yarn, fashion designer Jessica travels to the Principality of Alp'Azuri in Europe. While admiring the picture-perfect beautiful landscapes on a drive through the country, an out-of-control car smashes into Jessica's car at full speed and knocks her out! When she regains consciousness, she finds herself at the royal palace. Alp'Azuri's Prince Raoul's fiancee died in that crash. Jessica blames herself for her death, but Raoul firmly asserts that it is not her fa

title: Ai♥Heya
author: Miyazono, Izumi
description:
1-3. Ai Heya
4. Pure Love (純恋, Junai)
5. Springtime Sleep Remedy (春眠処方箋, Shunmin Shohousen)

title: Landreaall
author: Ogaki, Chika
description: Siscon. Power-phobia. Son of the great General Luccafort. Son of a general. Wether-crown. Fourth-in-line for succession. The titles, accolades, expectations, respect, and envy for DX Luccafort keeps coming. But all he wanted to do was win Marion's hand. Landreaall follows DX, his sister Lon, and his bodyguard/brother Rokkou as they leave their home in the countryside and brace themselves to take on whatever their famous last name brings them.

title: Story of Herself
author: Tanikawa, Fumiko
description: A series of short stories centered around a different woman in every chapter.

title: Fumi-chan no Rakuen
author: Satomaru, Mami
description:
Fumi is a novelist with writer's block. Now she's shacking up with a man in an old house in the countryside. Nighttime picnics, frolicking in the river, harvesting vegetables—they eat lots of delicious food, sleep peacefully, and have sex wherever and whenever the mood strikes. It's like a never-ending summer vacation.

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

title: Dark Seed
author: Konno, Kita
description:
Wizards are never a single entity. That is, they are composed of a partnership of the "holder" and "caretaker" of the stone.

Celeste is the "holder" of the stone, and she's in a hurry to become an independent wizard. But her partner, Chris, is not the easiest person to work with...

(Source: Gentosha Comics)

title: Awatenbou no Yoreyore Santa Claus
author: Yamamoto, Kana
description:
On a Christmas night, a man sneaked into an apartment room and managed to finish his goal. However, during his escape from the balcony, he encountered a girl standing at the balcony next door. Thinking that he would get reported to the police, what he heard was instead...

(Source: Aoitenshi Scanlations)

title: Sword Dancer
author: Nagawa, Tomo
description:
Golden-haired and blue-eyed Heilong is the clan's most powerful and fearsome assasin; however, he left the group with his blind best friend, Pailong. Nowadays, the two of them are doing street dance performances, but the clan continues to hunt for them... to bring Heilong back!

(Source: Hyper Parfait)

title: ROCK
author: Okazaki, Kyoko
description:
Rock and Astro meet, fall in love, and decide to marry after their first night together. Between romantic comedy and hallucinated fairy tail, Kyoko Okazaki blows a wind of hysteria in the fashion world and it's nights saturated with music and drugs.

(Source: Librairie Dialogues)

title: Dekiai Osananajimi wa Watashi no Otto de Stalker!?
author: Azuki
description:
Aoi married her childhood friend, Ren, who she's loved since she was younger. However, Ren has never once touched Aoi. She has tried to seduce him in the past to no avail. One day, she goes into his locked room, and what she finds changes the course of their relationship forever...

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title: Sultan no Koukeigi
author: Hoshiai, Misao
description:
Sheikh Najib blasted into Rosalind Lewis's life and staked a sultan's claim on her son! Her denial of the boy's royal lineage was met with deaf ears -- and relentless kisses. When danger threatened, mother and child were whisked into Najib's exotic world, a faraway place where protection meant marriage. But with every night in the arms of her sheikh "husband," Rosalind's secret threatened to surface. Would the truth bring a bitter end -- or a heartfelt vow?

(Source: Shojo Manhwa Scans)

title: Yesterday, Yes a Day
author: Iwamoto, Nao
description:
During the winter break of her first year in high school, Haruno Konegi's childhood friend, Takiji, comes home to their village after pursuing his studies in Tokyo. Konegi, lonely from her mother being in the hospital, and Takiji, who is living away from his family, start spending time again together, just like in the old days. Just like friends, just like lovers, a wonderful diary of youth.

(Source: Aerandria Scans)

title: Kare to Koi nante
author: Mimori, Ao
description:
Miku just got off the phone with her co-worker and the manager who is also her boyfriend. They made out with each other right in front of her, in broad sight, earlier that day. Saying it'll feel awkward if they saw each other again at the shop, telling her to quit her job. She quits.

Betrayed by a man and without a job. Why is this happening when she did nothing to him? She can't take this anymore and spots a guy sitting across the road. Maybe she'll try hitting on someone handsome for once. An

title: Keeping Luke's Secret
author: Mori, Hinoto, Mortimer, Carole
description: Out of the blue, Leonie is asked by Rachel, a renowned actress, to write her biography. Although she has published a biography once before, she has no idea why Rachel chose her as the author. Her doubts about the job deepen with Rachel's son, Luke, who for some reason relentlessly intimidates her. As Rachel was unmarried when giving birth to Luke, it was one of the biggest scandals at the time. While being aware of his hostile attitude, Leonie is drawn to his cold green eyes, and she decides to

title: Mistress Bought and Paid For
author: Graham, Lynne, Okada, Junko
description: Supermodel Lydia took part in a fashion show organized for a charity for disadvantaged children. But the money from the show disappeared, and it was Lydia's mother who stole the money! Lydia cannot accept that this is what happened, even after being investigated by the police...because she blames herself for her mother's unhappiness. It is the wealthy Christiano who lends Lydia a helping hand in her time of need. Although his intentions are to spend the night with her! (Mangafox)

title: Doom: Satsujin Keisatsukan no Danzairoku
author: Koga, Kei, Shinou, Ryou
description:
Dan Hiroki, the Chief of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department's 1st Investigation Division. An elite among elites with a brilliant career, his hidden face is that of a serial killer who enacts vigilante justice upon sinful villains.

(Source: Coamix, translated)

title: Saiindoku: Sister to Vampire
author: Akatsuki
description:
One night, while Sister Alicia is looking after the church alone, she is attacked by a beautiful vampire named Albert. Since then, night after night, he sticks his fangs in her skin and she finds herself doing indecent things with him, right in front of God.

(Source: MU)

Included one-shots:
Volume 1: Sakurayoimachi, Yahanmae
Volume 2: Noraneko/Nocturne

title: Sensei, Ote wo Douzo?
author: Takanashi, Sora
description: This one-shot is a short but sweet age-gap romance about a girl named Hina who has suffered from social anxiety ever since she was a kid. Back then, her nursery school teacher Satoru-sensei encouraged her and helped her face her fears. Hina later grew up to become a nursery school teacher herself thanks to Satoru-sensei's influence. But when Hina gets a job at the same nursery school as him, Satoru-sensei doesn't seem to recognize her at all? Furthermore, her old fears start to return when Hina

title: Nothing But Loving You
author: Sakurazawa, Erica
description:
Nanako, an up and coming model, falls in love with another model named Etsushi...who, alas, turns out to be gay. Meanwhile, Nanako also discovers that another young actor is deeply in love with her and she is unable to choose between him and Etsushi. Her indecision leads her to a state of depression until the two men come together to encourage her and help her make decisions about her future.

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Acting on Impulse
description:
Small-town girl Trudy Baxter is ready to take on New York City. She's looking for excitement, adventure...and incredible sex! She wants to experience every little thing -- and every type of man -- the city has to offer. Her first target -- sexy Wall Street hunk Linc Faulkner. Only, once she gets Linc into her bed, she's reluctant to let him go....

Linc Faulkner has never met anybody like Trudy. She's so spirited, so sexy, so damn uninhibited! She's his every fantasy in the flesh. Only, Linc kno

title: Kokage-kun wa Majo.
author: Komori, Youko
description:
Yumeko, a daydreaming high school girl, lives with her family in one of the apartments in a rundown and scarcely populated housing complex. The person who manages the housing complex, Kokage-kun, a hikikomori, lives on the rooftop of the building, and he happens to be a witch.

Yumeko often asks Kokage-kun to use his magic to help her whenever she has any kind of selfish wish. For example, when her crush, a heart throb senpai from school, suddenly notices her and asks her out on a date.

(Source

title: The Spaniard's Woman
author: Ayabe, Mizuho, Hamilton, Diana
description:
Sebastian Garcia is shaken by the overwhelming attraction he feels for Rosie Lambert. Maybe it's because she seems innocent and trustworthy, so unlike the many fortune hunters who've pursued him before?

Soon Sebastian makes Rosie his woman. So how can Rosie tell him the real reason for her sudden appearance in his life, when it could destroy his faith in her? And she may be pregnant with his child....

(Source: fictiondb)

title: Best Sex
author: Nanba, Atsuko, Hidaka, Sarii, Mikimoto, Rin, Hirose, Emu, Ouchi, Rika, Aikawa, Hiro
description:
A collection of 6 stories about love relationships and sex.

Story 01 - Saikyou no H
Story 02 - Cinderella in Love 

Sourse: WataameShoujo

title: Watashi no Oujisama
author: Nagae, Tomomi
description:
1 Volume, 5 short stories. 

1) My Prince (Watashi no Oujisama) : A rich man and a poor man appear before Hanako, an office lady who used to be rich. She wavers over which man to choose. Her feelings are comically described. 

(Source: MU)

title: Married Under the Italian Sun
author: Takayama, Mayu, Gordon, Lucy
description: Angie has played dumb under the stage name of Angel with her drop-dead gorgeous looks. Freshly divorced from her cheating millionaire ex-husband, she is through with all that and is ready to start a quiet life in a beautiful Italian Villa, an alimony from her ex. But there is one thing that annoys her. Vittorio, the former owner of the estate does not try to hide his disdain for her whom he believes to be a "dumb glamor girl." Disagreeable he may be, she must seek his cooperation to preserve the

title: Moumoku no Koushaku Reijou ni Tensei shimashita
author: Aogami, Kazuki, Namiko, Makoto
description:
I was born weak and passed away at the age of 18 due to illness. Before I die, I made a wish to be born again. It came true but was born blind. Little by little I came to know the gaps between the previous world and present one thanks to my fiancé. This is the story of the Duke's only daughter.

(Source: Novel Updates)

title: Ike Ike! Sakura
author: Nagae, Tomomi
description:
Sanabi Sakura was on her way to her university admission exams when she got a serious nosebleed. Fortunately she was helped by a cute guy, Shuji, who lent her his knee for some rest. After getting admitted to university, she looked feverently for Shuji and luckily managed to get into a Goukon with him. But will he accept her confession? 

(Source: MU)

title: Sicilia de Aishite
author: Hoshino, Masami, Morgan, Sarah
description:
"Come with me," her husband demands. Stacia hasn't seen Rico in over a year but he hasn't changed at all. His arrogant attitude, his alluring eyes... The free-spirited art lover Stasia and the workaholic billionaire Rico fell passionately in love, but Rico's sister's cruel lie ruined everything. But when his sister is involved in a serious accident she calls for Stacia. Perhaps she is trying to make up for what she did? Stasia makes her way to Sicily, where memories of love await her.

(Source:

title: A Husband to Belong to
author: Ai, Marito
description:
Marla and Jaicey are twin sisters. They were separated at birth and reunited 24 years later, but Jaicey asks Marla to keep it a secret. She doesn't want her loving adopted family to know about Marla yet. Jaicey's brother, Jake, regards his sister's new "friend" with suspicion and is mean to Marla, but she is just happy to have a family of her own, after years of loneliness. How could she have known that more suffering awaits her...? 

(Source: MU)

title: Man of Ice
author: Asou, Ayumu, Palmer, Diana
description: A fake engagement with despicable man! Berrie meets her stepbrother Dawson whom she detests so much at her friend's party. A billionaire Dawson, with his still arrogant and domineering attitude, proposed her with an unexpected offer. Which was to act as his "fiance" for a certain amount of time...

title: Betrothed to My Sister's Ex
author: Murasaki, Mai, Tobirano
description: Marie has spent her life living under her sister's shadow as the two grew up in an impoverished baron's home. Every nice thing went to Marie's sister, leaving her without even a proper dress! And right when her sister was being married off to a wealthy Earl–tragedy strikes and Marie's sister is killed en route. With the dowry already spent, it's decided that Marie will take her sister's place and become the Earl's betrothed. But, when she gets there, she finds there's been a serious mix-up—the p

title: Yawareta Princess
author: Sanazaki, Harumo, Lennox, Marion
description:
Penny-Rose, a stone mason in the Principality of Castaliae is summoned by the Queen. She asks Penny-Rose to marry the prince... but only for one year. To succeed the throne, the prince needs to marry a woman of "unimpeachable virtue". Startled by such a sudden request, Penny-Rose hesitantly accepts. Despite knowing he is to marry another after her, she is slowly drawn to the prince, and eventually falls in love... 

(Source: Jmanga)

title: Caribbean Desire
author: Yonetani, Takane, Williams, Cathy
description:
Before she passed away, Emma's mother told her that she has a wealthy grandfather. Emma gets close to him without revealing her identity, but she meets Conrad, a man mentored by her grandfather. Emma is immediately turned off by Conrad's arrogant and dangerous appeal. However, when her grandfather takes a turn for the worse, he comes up with an unlikely idea...

(Source: JManga)

title: Love♡Training: Renai Taishitsu Kaizen Kouza
author: Yokoyama, Mayumi
description:
Iroha Imaichi is a 29-year old graphic designed troubled by her cheating boyfriend. She's always being supported by the hot advice columnist Tamon. She finally breaks up with her boyfriend at his advice. Seeing how depressed Iroha is, her friend Keiko sets her up with Tamon...

(Source: Clairparfait)

title: The Diary about Ayame's Easygoing and Aggressive Days.
author: Machi, Mai
description:
The manga centers on Ayame and Tsubaki, who are researchers at a lab in the biology department of T University. Ayame is a "returnee." He does things at his own pace and is a "dinosaur otaku," and Tsubaki is his older colleague who is an enthusiast of studying the skeletons of birds and dinosaurs. The manga follows their slightly strange romantic relationship.

(Source: ANN)

title: Koi no Mae ni, Amaku Hajimete. Hikaeme Elite-kun ga Watashi ni Dake Hatsujou Shiteimasu
author: Kosame
description: Childish Rui Sasaki is 25 years old, single, and a virgin. All she wants is to fall in love like everyone else and have sex with a nice boyfriend! While lamenting over this during drinks with her childhood friend, Naoko, she met Ritsu, a modest and handsome man. He was kind enough to listen to her complaints and take care of her drunken self. Suddenly, an intoxicated Rui falls on top of Ritsu and kisses him...?! For two beginners in love, each with their own issues, is it possible for love to st

title: Family Play
author: Kitakata, Kuniaki
description: A series of short stories from mangaka Kitakata Kuniaki. As the title says its' all about family play. The stories range from brother and sister play to father-daughter and mother-son encounters right up to the whole family. While each story could be read as stand-alones a few end up having their characters interact with characters from the other stories.
genre: Drama, Girls Love, Slice of Life

title: Daisy Luck
author: Umino, Tsunami
description: Daisy Luck follows the lives of four long-time girl friends, one who is now a housewife, one who is a baker, one who is an executive, and one who is not working. They're all about to turn 30. (Source: Animeraider)

title: Mirror Image
author: Hashimoto, Takako, Darcy, Emma
description:
To Karen Aylward, newspaper magnate Hal Chissolm was a monster. He'd refused to marry Kirsty, her pregnant twin sister, so that Kirsty had given up their son at birth--to be adopted by Karen.

Then Kirsty was fatally injured in a terrorist attack. And from her deathbed she had told Hal about their child. It was the first Hal had heard of him.

He wanted the son he had never known and he threatened to take him away unless Karen agreed to marry him. To her he had seemed to be a man of no feeling,

title: Kimi no Hada wo Kowasu Yoru
author: Kitagawa, Miyuki
description:
If you place a photo of yourself with your lover in a particular photo frame, the two of you will get married. Or so the famous glasses-wearing author Kiriyama Akihito claims when Maaya requests a photo frame just like it. When she breaks a 500 thousand yen flower vase, Akihito is the one who pays her debt!

Also featured:
Dear... Side: M
Dear... Side: R
8 Jikan Taikyuu Koibana & Nanyakaya

(Source: Midnight Scans)

title: Tobi and Ryuuko
author: Yasui, Marie
description:
The manga centers on Tobi, who lives an unchanging daily life with a talkative bag named Baku, until a girl named Ryuuko appears in front of him.

(Source: ANN)

title: Dekiai Zentei, Keiyakukon. Iwashiro Bengoshi wa Ai ga Dekasugiru!?
author: Chikuwa, Tsubomi
description: After retiring from 3 years of idol activity, Touko Kunihiro decided to focus on live-streaming as her next career. Honestly, she never imagined this kind of future! Touko, who became involved in some trouble, received help from a young lawyer named Yuuji Iwashiro. After briefly meeting, they jumped into a loving relationship. Yuuji, a kind and enchanting gentleman, is a cool beauty and hides his real feelings from Touko... A doting-couple premise! The former idol Touko Kunihiro and the unfriend

title: The Millionaire's Revenge
author: Kobayashi, Hiromi, Williams, Cathy
description: Laura and Gabriel were passionately in love - even though she was the daughter of a wealthy family, while he was a mere stable boy. But when Laura's parents reject the penniless Gabriel's proposal to marry their daughter, he disappears in despair. 7 years later, Laura is burdened by huge debts left by her late parents when Gabriel, now a successful and wealthy investor, appears before her. He is not the man she used to know, as he coldly declares: "I bet you never thought this day would come. Wh

title: Receptacle
author: Kurosaki, Rendou
description:
Two female friends talk together about their sexual preferences and problems with their respective boyfriends.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Full House II
author: Won, Soo-yeon
description:
They say marriage is the happy ending of a beautiful love but isn’t it also the beginning of a new story?
A year has passed since Ryder and Ellie got married. And our couple is still deeply is love with each other even though there are people who are still against their marriage. This story is a continuation from the original series, this time it is a journey for Ryder and Ellieo to find trust and love through many obstacles and hardships….

title: Ridge: The Avenger
author: Kishimoto, Keiko, Banks, Leanne
description:
Dara helps her godfather, Harrison, with his campaigns for a U.S. presidential election. Being blessed with beauty and intelligence, she soon gains popularity as Harrison's poster girl. But it also means she is a target of political enemies. Therefore, Harrison hires one of the best bodyguards for her-- Ridge Jackson. Dara is stunned when she sees his shadowy gold eyes. How seductive he is... Isn't it more dangerous to be with this sexy guy than to be a target of political rivalry?

(Source: MU)

title: The Cinderella Inheritance
description: When the wealthy Alfred Wingate dies, his personal assistant, Cynthia, is utterly confused. He has left her his mansion in his will! Cynthia thought she was in love with Alfred's grandson Graham. But when she finds out he is cheating, she breaks off the engagement. But the terms of the will won't allow her to refuse the inheritance, and she's stuck with the mansion. On top of all this, Graham's brother, Rick, treats her with contempt, believing she tricked his wealthy grandfather! (Mangafox)

title: Ai no Tetsujin
author: Katsumoto, Kasane
description:
It all started with one mistaken email. Just after registering her cell phone, she received an email. At first glance it didn’t seem like spam but a whole hearted, profound declaration of love. To me the vague distinction between real love and just playing around is a huge shock.
(Source: StarryHeaven)

title: Arcana - Akuma
author: Kayase, Shiki, Nagawa, Tomo, Saeki, Yashirou, Magami, Guriko, Mikawa, Verno, Sekka, Akanatsu
description:
The Zero-Sum Original Anthology Series features themed oneshots from various mangaka that publish in Ichijinsha's Zero-Sum and Ward magazines. Volume 12 theme: Demons.

1. Demon’s Kiss by Inui Miku
2. We’re the First Year Demons! by Kari Erika
3. The Demon Breaks the Flag by Saeki Yashiro
4. Kimi to Boku to Sekai no Owari by Kayase Shiki
5. Contract Day by Mikawa Verno
6. Wednesday Swing by Sekka
7. Tower Hill’s Lonely Rose by Yukihiro Utako
8. Demon’s Job by Ninagawa Tomo
9. Mushroom and Kappa

title: Sheikh ni Sarawarete
author: Sanazaki, Harumo
description: "If you ever set even one foot in my kingdom...I'll take you away and put you in the world's most beautiful cage!" This is a bittersweet memory of Jasmine's ex-lover, Sheikh Tariq. When she visits his desert homeland, he sweeps her away to his rose-colored palace, as promised. She dreams of reconciling her love for him, but will Tariq's heart want her back without knowing why she left him once before?

title: Chijou no Seppun
author: Kisaragi, Hiiro
description: Is it pleasant to be object of obsession of a perfect man? This is the start of a cohabitation story between a woman who thinks "It's more fun to be fulfilled with my interests rather than love," Waka, and a man who has an unrequited love while doing everything he can to persuade her, Shinobu! Waka, who's a librarian, was looking for a place to move into with her huge collection of books. In the midst of that, she suddenly reunited with Shinobu, a researcher, who suddenly kissed her back in high

title: The Italian Doctor's Mistress
author: Kishimoto, Keiko
description:
Passion drives successful Italian neurosurgeon Carlo Rossi in work and in play.

Desire ignites him when he sets eyes on Danielle Blake; he wants her.

Heat suffuses Danielle when Carlo makes love to her, awakening her senses for the first time.

Carlo insists on his rules: no commitment, no future, just a brief affair. But when Danielle must leave Italy, can he let her go?

(Source: MU)

title: The Seduction Project
author: Lee, Miranda, Nakayama, Sara
description:
The wanting...

When Molly transformed herself into a striking redhead, the entire male population of Sydney stood up and took notice! But her new look was for Liam Delaney's benefit alone; she loved him and she wished he felt the same about her.

However it was passion that Molly inspired in Liam! And the fact that he thought she had another male admirer only made him desire her more. Though Molly had never rushed into a physical relationship with any man, perhaps the time had come for seductio

title: Domesticating Luc
author: Takayama, Mayu, Paul, Sandra
description:
Dog trainer Julie is in trouble. Workaholic business tycoon, Luc is planning to find another home for Puppy, a huge mastiff he has inherited from his grandmother. For that, Luc hired Julie to give an intensive training for Puppy for 6 weeks, staying at his home. No way! He has to look after his dog. As Julie works hard to develop intimate relationship between Luc and Puppy, she finds herself gradually falling love with him. She has to remember that Luc needs her only as a dog trainer...

(Source

title: Secretary on Demand
author: Williams, Cathy, Nagasaki, Maoko
description:
At his beck and call -- day and night!

Kane Lindley is a regular customer at the restaurant where Shannon works. When an incident results in her getting the sack, Kane comes to the rescue and offers her a job!

As well as being his secretary, Shannon also finds herself caring for his young daughter. In fact, he even persuades her to move into his home! But all the while Shannon is fighting her attraction to her boss, playing the part of a responsible, diligent employee -- until Kane proposition

author: Itou, Youko
description:
1. Shouganai kara Aishite Ageru
2. Aishiteru tte Iwasete Miseru
3. Chanto Aishiteru yo
4. Motto Zutto Aishite Hoshii
5. Marugoto Zenbu Aishichatte

Tsukuyomi-kun no Kindan Oyashoku centers on the relationship between foodie and expert chef Tsukuyomi, and a 27-year-old female personal gym trainer named Soyogi. They meet up regularly so Soyogi can re-energize herself on Tsukuyomi's food, but they have established an agreement that forbids any romance between them.

(Source: ANN)

title: Oujo-sama to Bodyguard
author: Chihara, Esu, Linz, Cathie
description: The outside world must be so exciting! Princess Vanessa, of Volzemburg Kingdom, will become queen one day, and she's lived a life without freedom. Even when she visits New York on her royal duties, all she can do is smile elegantly and adhere to her strict schedule. As a 20-year-old young woman, she tires of her restrictive life, but with the help of a friend, she manages to escape for a few days. Walking through this exciting city, eating junk food and falling in love...all for the first time.

title: Steve Jobs
author: Yamazaki, Mari, Isaacson, Walter
description: The manga begins in 2004 with the late Apple company co-founder Steve Jobs traveling to Colorado to surprise author Walter Isaacson with a request: to pen his life story. Isaacson muses if Jobs is comparing himself with Benjamin Franklin and Albert Einstein, the subjects of two Isaacson biographies. The author puts off writing Jobs' story until he receives a call from Jobs' wife Laurene with shocking news: Jobs has cancer.

title: Yuukaikon
author: Shiiba, Nana
description:
Kasuka and her father are trying to hold on to their small coffee shop against redevelopment. When her father was hospitalized for the stress, Kasuka was kidnapped by the heir of the development company and locked up in his apartment. He doesn't just want Kasuka's land, he wants her to marry him, too!

(Source: MU)

Included one-shot: If no Sekai

title: Eien wo Sagashite
author: Sala, Sharon, Chihara, Esu
description: After her beloved mother's death, Honor faced a lifetime of loneliness... In the presence of others, she holds back her tears and strives to keep her mother's restaurant going, but her tears won't stop flowing when she is alone. "Are you alright?" a kind voice asks. The voice belongs to a man named Trace. Even though they have never met, Honor is comforted by his gentle eyes and warm hands. She is quickly drawn to this man, until she finds out the brutal truth. Trace befriended her for a purpose

title: M-shiki Princess
author: Sakai, Miwa
description: Kanako is an unattractive and not-so-capable office lady, until the day her mother passes away and she turns out to be the sole heiress of the old and elite Kinaga house. So suddenly, Kanako has not only to uphold her duties as an heiress, but to turn into an attractive lady so that she can marry accordingly to her new status. Thanks to the family valet and her own efforts, she manages somehow, but even in the middle of her new-found glamor, her world still continues to revolve around her valet…

title: The Billionaire's Secret Baby
author: Ogimaru, Masako, Devine, Carol
description: Why is Jack Tarkenton here? Meg doubts her eyes. Why would he turn up at her husband's funeral of all places? Jack, the son of an affluent family that rivals the Kennedy's, spent a passionate night with Meg 5 years ago. From this union, their daughter, Katie, was born. Jack does not know about Katie, and Meg does not intend to tell him. However, now that he's approached Meg, this exceptionally wealthy and handsome man intimidates and overpowers her. Even though she never wants anything to do wit

title: Woman in the Attic
author: Isoya, Yuki
description:
A collection of interlinked one-shot stories, Yaneura no Majo tells the story of students from Sannosan High School as they are preparing for the Culture Festival.

(Source: Dazzling Scans)

title: Watashi wo Sukisugiru Yuusha-sama wo Riyou shite, Konse koso Nagaiki suru Tsumori Datta noni (Tabun, Mata Shippai shita)
author: Kotoko, Kumanomi, Kei
description:
I use the hero who fiercely loves me, and in this world I aim to live long!

"Please, use me."

Lizette, a count's daughter, is a "recaller," or a holder of previous lives' memories, and she is on her fourth life. In her past lives, always on her 20th birthday, she would be killed and eaten by the same demon. So to live a long life in this one, Lizette retreated to a remote countryside sanctuary, where monsters don't appear, living quietly and peacefully.

However, one day, she, once again, met

title: Strange+
author: Mikawa, Verno
description:
Kou comes to a slum neighborhood in search of his elder brother Takumi and finds him to have become the head of a private detective firm. Kou is drafted by Takumi to do errands and chores in the detective firm, and they come to meet various interesting people...

(Source: MAL)

title: Kako e no Tobira
author: Darcy, Emma, Oosawa, Maki
description:
Had she found her identity or her destiny?

Rebel had been fortunate to be adopted-by the James family. The Australian clan fully supported her search for her mother's roots--even though it took her to England.

But when Rebel arrived at Davenport Hall, the English manor where her mother had stayed as a five-year-old war orphan, she was surprised to discover the earl actually seemed to be expecting her.

Hugh Davenport was not what Rebel had imagined--he was far too handsome and sexy. And Rebel,

title: Shouhin wa Okuman Chouja!
author: Itoh, Kako
description:
"You've been chosen to date a billionaire!" Beth is startled to receive such a phone call. It appears her neighbor entered her in a competition without telling her! The prize is a date with Kane, a famous billionaire, but Beth is not interested and rejects this golden opportunity. The news reaches Kane and his heart is ignited-- no woman could ever reject him, could she? His pride hurt, Kane vows to win over Beth's heart! 

(Source: MU)

title: Pretty Boy Jun's Tender Loving Coaching
author: Fudono, Fudou
description:
When an annoying guy at work mocks her lack of femininity, Shoko gets dead drunk and begs for help from Jun, a boy at the bar whose beauty could outshine any girl, until she's talked him into coaching her on how to power up her feminine side. But Jun gives her two conditions: she has to live with him, and he gets to touch her breasts... This beautiful younger man's super erotic touchy-feely coaching is steadily training my body!

(Source: NTT Solmare Corporation, translated)

title: Wife by Agreement
author: Makimura, Jun, Lawrence, Kim
description: "Hannah, will you marry me?" The proposal from Ethan, a man she loves, should have been the happiest moment of her life... If the marriage wasn't just a contract. Hannah was hired as a nanny after Ethan's wife passed away, then Ethan asks her to be "a mother to his children." Hannah wants to be loved as a woman, but it seems Ethan cannot forget about his late wife... When will he realize Hannah's true feelings? (Source: Jmanga)

title: Daddy Long Legs
author: Katsuta, Bun
description:
Set during the Showa period, an orphan named Itsuki is offered some unexpected support! The only condition is to write a letter every month... A fun-filled romance based on “Daddy Long Legs” and compiled with 3 other works.

(Source: An Endless Story)

title: Hey, Tell Me You Without Me
author: utu, Kotoko
description: Will this love culminate in happiness or despair? Toruka is in a relationship with Iori, an ideal, high-spec boyfriend who is the envy of everyone, and with her days going smoothly, publicly and privately. One year into their relationship, Iori proposes to her, saying, "I want you by my side for the rest of our lives." She feels elated, but then she discovers that someone has been stalking her. She enlists the support of her childhood friend Jin to find the culprit, but...!? 24-hour surveillance

title: Yandere-kei Otome Game no Sekai ni Tensei shiteshimatta you desu
author: Hanaki, Momiji, Shikiyuri
description:
As a precocious child, Licorice suffers from a strange sense of deja-vu. On the day her father told her about her fiancé, she realizes that her fiancé was actually a character from an otome game she once played in a previous life.

"I am the heroine's rival from that game? And in the bad ending, I get stabbed to death? What a joke."

The protagonist is determined to avoid the yandere around her.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Hikari no Umi
author: Kodama, Yuki
description:
Collection of five short stories revolving around mermaids and mermen.

Sayonara Spangles:
Natsuki and Ec-chan are friends with a mermaid who dreams of growing legs. With the help of a spell book and Natsuki's crush, Mizuno-senpai, the girls hope to fulfill her dream; unfortunately, the plan brings some unwanted complications.

(Source: MU)

title: Fukufuku Fu-nya~n
author: Konami, Kanata
description:
A story featuring the everyday life of a domestic cat owned by an old lady who runs a local provision shop.

(Source: The Cat Mummy)

title: I'm an Entangled Mob: Seems the Way to a Prince Is His Stomach!
author: Ocat-sama, Mizume
description:
"Mira, get this... I'm the heroine of this otome game world!" At Spica's confession, memories of a past life flash before Mira's eyes. Spica says that Mira is only a mob character in this world. In which case, the love interests and game events aren't a concern, and Mira is free to live quietly and enjoy fine cooking—supposedly. But a late night bowl of udon sets life on a different course... and now a mob character's cooking has a main character by the stomach?!

(Source: AlphaPolis)

title: Getting Worked by a Yakuza in a Bathhouse
author: Takashi♂
description:
My father passed away with a debt of 10 million yen and now I'm the one who has to pay it all back to this Yakuza called Hebizuka...?! "You're the only person I'm nice to, Miyako..." I'm left on edge with this young Yakuza clinging to me, but I'll keep the bathhouse running today and onward!

(Source: NTT Solmare)

author: Oda, Ryou
description:
Hanako is a high school girl who wears a Noh mask due to family circumstances. Although she looks scary on the outside, Hanako's school life is filled with love, friendship, and Noh masks! She doesn't care about the looks from those around her!

Ako has a somewhat distant relationship with her family, and one day she gets a call from her father about a bit of a crisis.

(Source: MU)

author: Torino, Shino
description: Momota Taichi (17) first wore a skirt one summer day. As a model student, with an older girlfriend, his sudden action disrupts the peace of his classmates and teachers. The only one who finds it fun is his classmate Shirai-san, known for being a bit odd.

title: Harutsuge to Yuki Musuko
author: hagi, Yumibe, Sanae
description:
"As Yukionna-sama's living sacrifice, you shall call upon the arrival of spring."

In Fuji Village where the legend of Yukionna remains, preparations begin on the morning of New Year's Day for the ritual to be held on the coldest day of the year. The young men who have inherited the blood of Yukionna, thus named the Three Houses of the Gokusho, spend their days until the ritual aiding the living sacrifice, the Revelation of Spring. In this enclosed world bound by laws and tradition, the young me

title: Mimei no Girl
author: Urino, Kiko
description: A dialogue-centric drama between two girls.

title: Saikai wa Nigaku, Ai wa...
author: Natsu, Yoshimi, Ross, Kathryn
description:
When Lauren Martin had set out to get an exclusive interview with Cole Adams, millionaire owner of a recording company, she hadn't anticipated them making headlines—as a couple. But their relationship had ended bitterly six months later, when Lauren realized their lives were taking very different paths.

Since then, she'd resumed her career and reshaped her life. Until her editor assigned her to get the inside scoop on Cole's impending marriage—an assignment that Cole had specifically asked that

title: Mein Ritter
author: Katayama, Shuu
description: Andrea Marcos is a young man looking for someone to translate a mysterious letter left to him by his late mother. His search leads him to viscount Theodore, a young, prodigious but hot-tempered and grouchy young man, fluent in 8 languages and a popular author of illusionary stories. To make things more interesting, not only does the viscount not believe in anything paranormal but the letter was apparently delivered to Andrea by fairies...?!

title: Dobugawa
author: Ikebe, Aoi
description: A look into the lives of the various residents in one quiet community.

title: The Haunted Bookstore: Gateway to a Parallel Universe
author: Shinobumaru
description: Kaori lives in an otherworldly bookstore with her adoptive father. Together, they provide books to the strange denizens of the spirit realm. But Kaori's peaceful days come to an end when she rescues an injured boy from the streets—a human, like her, from the mortal realm. The boy's name is Suimei, and he's an exorcist, the natural enemy of all spirits. Can Kaori convince Suimei that the line between human and spirit is far hazier than he thinks? A touching supernatural tale where humanity and Ja

title: Mahoko! Quit Being So Bossy!
author: Miura, Hiraku
description:
Mahoko and Chise have known each other since they were born. They were next door neighbors, the best of friends, and spent a lot of time together, and gradually, Mahoko developed feelings for Chise. But when Mahoko confesses to him, Chise makes a shocking confession of his own: he tells her that he likes men.

As the years pass by, Mahoko's friendship with Chise remains strong, despite his self-centered ways. But one day, during an argument with Chise, he grabs her and steals her first kiss, lea

title: Hanazakari no Niwa
author: Kunieda, Saika
description:
Masaki Tachibana leaves home in order to escape an oppressive existence with his father. He shows up at his grandfather's house, uninvited, and decides to live there. A garden that he saw in dream; his grandfather and his bodyguard, Harada; an old mansion inhabited by a beautiful, strong-willed girl...

At this point, the curtain rises on a mysterious drama of love and hate!

(Source: MU)

Included one-shot:
Love Letter

title: Stone Cold
author: Mori, Motoko
description:
Karin Mochizuki is an attractive woman lawyer. Because she is always calm and collected and never lets her feelings show, she's been nicknamed Stone Cold (a woman colder than a stone). This volume contains four stories about incidents involving Karin. 

From Baka-Updates Manga

title: Wagaya wa Kiseki de Afureteru
author: Hata, Akimi
description:
1-3. Wagaya wa Kiseki de Afureteru
4. Akai Lace to Shiroi Gohan
5-6. Unhappy End Love

author: NRMEN
description: Himari and Issa have been friends since childhood and made a promise together. After so many years does Issa still remember?

title: A Dream Between the Sheets
author: Kirato, Ruka
description:
Tender caresses and kisses exchanged in a hotel suite. They get each other's feelings perfectly, like they've found the one they've been searching for their whole lives. He loves every inch of her, causing her body and soul to melt away in the intense feelings he invokes in her.

Yukino, who worked as store manager of a cosmetics store, enjoyed and was good at her job, but still felt that something was missing. When shopping one day, she helps out what appears to be a tourist and ends up spendin

title: Akuma no Namida
author: Shirohito, Rita
description:
A demon is ordered by the king of the demon world to collect tears from a human being. When he arrives in the human world, he encounters a man named Cole, who he believes will be his perfect target.

(Source: MU)

title: Baku
author: Bikke
description:
A long time ago...

There was a disease that would cause nightmares and kill people. Doctors and wizards threw in the towel, unable to find a cure. All of a sudden, mysterious magicians appeared. These magicians ate the nightmares of those who suffered from them. It was said that those who had their dreams eaten were able to sleep peacefully.

This is the story of "Baku."

(Source: Iskultrip Scans)

title: Powerful Persuasion
author: Shibata, Ayako, Mayo, Margaret
description: A job offer from the U.K.'s largest advertising agency comes totally out of the blue for Celina, so she decides to take the job interview out of interest. There, she meets an outstandingly gorgeous man, Luciano, who is president of the company. Celina is alarmed by his irresistible charm and wants to refuse the job, regardless of the unusually high salary. But she has no other choice but to accept Luciano's offer in order to finance her sister's tuition. It is too late when Celina realizes that

title: Mahou ga Toketa Asa ni
author: Asou, Ayumu, James, Julia
description:
Carrie Richards has stepped into the glittering life of Greek billionaire Alexeis Nicolaides. Luxurious hotels, designer clothes and rare jewels are all hers.and what they share in the bedroom is explosive. But the consequences of one night lead to a shocking end to Carrie's fairy tale. She discovers Alexeis is not her Prince Charming - he's a man who'll make her his, no matter what the cost!

(Source: fictiondb)

title: Inukai-san wa Kakure Dekiai Joushi: Konya dake wa "Suki" wo Gaman Dekimasen!
author: Itosugi, Joe

author: Shinohara, Chie
description:
Story about a mirror princess/demon. It seems that a new condo building was built on a certain location where this princess was housed and worshiped with a stone monument but it was moved due to the new construction. One room in particular seems to have a direct link to the princess who calls herself the owner of the pool of time. Beware when mirrors are placed opposite of each other because you may just be drawn in her world and powers.

(Source: MU)

title: The Expectant Princess
author: Bagwell, Stella, Ogata, Rin
description:
The happiness of the royal family of Edenbourg, waiting for a baptismal ceremony of the king's first grandchild, is broken by bad news - the king has been in a traffic accident. Princess Dominique runs to the site in search of her father, accompanied by the family's High Counsel, Marcus Kent, who offers to escort her. Her heart races, as she has admired Marcus since childhood, but he abuses her respect with harsh words.

(Source: M-U)

title: Until You Bear My Child: The Substitute Bride and the Beast Soldier
author: Kanzaki, Yuzu
description:
"I'll have you birth my child in place of your sister." I thought that there is no love in marriages... but the fingers of this cold-blooded soldier are unexpectedly sweet, passionate and fierce...

(Source: WWWave Corporation)

Ceska, a multilingual speaker who understands every language, attends an academy for the children of royalty and rulers from various nations. She also works as an interpreter. Junko was deceived by her lover, who she didn't know was married. Because of it, she loses her job as a teacher. Junko's mood doesn't clears up, even when she won 5 million in the lottery, and she becomes desperate... In that moment Haruto appears in front of her, a handsome mysterious young guy.

"Would you like to spend your life with me for a fee?"

description: Courtney, a young horse farm owner, is glammed up to mingle with high society at a racecourse, hoping to find an investor for her business. Socializing with the rich, dolled up in a frilly dress, puts tomboy Courtney out of her comfort zone, but she has no choice. She has to find a way to repay the debt her deceased mother left her. Twenty-five-year-old office lady Kanna Nishimura is no longer willing to tolerate her coworker and boyfriend, Keisuke. In just under a year, he has cheated on her three times. After their official breakup, Keisuke calls her drab and ugly. Despite feeling justified in her rage and ending the relationship, Kanna takes his comment very personally. She wonders aloud to her close friend Miki if she would have been treated differently if she had any sense for fashion.

Sara can only see her stepbrother Natsu when he comes back home once a year. Each summer feels the same but something will happen in this one. This story shows how their relationship as step siblings in the past affects their present.

(Source: MU)

author: Asa, Natsumi, Kai, Tooko
description: In a certain kingdom's knights order, there's a young man who's slightly different from the others. He is able to use a very special magic called "puppeteering" which allows him to manipulate his own body. Using this magic, he is always protecting a friend who always gets mistaken for a girl. Except, the "real" girl in this story isn't his friend; it's him! Impersonating a girl; his age, his status, his life-span, it's all a lie! His friends get flustered by his ability to do unbelievable things

An omega named Saimon marries into the prolific Hanabusa family, a major conglomerate, but is unable to produce an heir for his alpha husband Seijuro, and is shunned as a "Megaera," a creature that brings ill fortune. One day, Saimon is summoned by

title: The Hotel at the Dangerous Hill
author: Hagio, Moto

The Abunazaka Hotel isn't a ordinary place. It becomes the heart of its customers and a place you long to return to. The various lodging customers meet the mysterious owner of the hotel and soon they are sucked in by this place between love, perplexity, and decision.

(Source: MU)

title: Anata ga Ireba
author: Yoshimura, Akemi
description:
Toriko Tsukigata is a beautiful girl who judges guys solely upon their appearance. One day her life changes: Someone tells her that she's the eighth reincarnation of Princess Kaguya, who is a playgirl. To pay for the sins Princess Kaguya commited in her past life, she has to find a guy whom she really loves. If she fails, Toriko will become a hundred-year-old grandma.

(Source: MU)

title: Nodoka no Niwa
author: Akiyama, Kaori
description: A love story between a graduate student with little confidence in herself, and her college professor.

title: The Italian's Price
author: Takase, Ryou, Hamilton, Diana
description:
She's really a mouse...but he thinks she's a tiger!

Cesare Saracino is bent on revenge! He doesn't realize that the woman he forces back to Italy is not the thief, but her identical twin, Milly Lee.

With Cesare watching her every move, the usually mousy Milly struggles to masquerade as her sexy twin. And when desire unexpectedly flares between them, Milly is powerless to refuse Cesare's advances. Will the truth come out in the heat of passion?

(Source: MU)

author: Shibamura, Yuri, Akizuki, Ichiha

Later, a few people whose lives had been saved by the "police inspector" received another text, asking for help. This is how a group of three disparate people, high-schooler Natsumi, Shogo, and the gangster Teru, found themselves together, taking cues from a mysterious texter as they tracked down a criminal. author: Aimoto, Mizuho
description:
Shinobu Asakura has never been able to read or write—and not for lack of trying. It's made getting and holding down jobs difficult, and he's constantly berated by people who think he's simply slacking off when he's just trying to keep up. But a chance meeting with a café worker who introduces a new word to Shinobu's vocabulary—dyslexia—may just change the course of Shinobu's life forever.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

author: Darcy, Emma, Hayasaka, Amii
description: Kathleen's dream was to be a vocalist. That was until the accident that left her with an injured leg. Despite this, her music teacher, Sister Cecily, takes her to an audition. Kathleen is a classical musician, but the audition is being judged by Morgan Llewellyn, a world-famous musical composer. Kathleen performs as best as she can, but the fiercely masculine and overbearing Morgan coldly tells her that she could never be a star

author: Kugatsu, Karihito
description: To be the demon king would sound like a glorious privilege. The status of royalty, a castle full of riches, and scores of minions at the ready sounds like great living doesn't it? All's well that sounds well, but for the current demon king, his status brings him nothing but torment. Time and time again, a "valiant" hero will invade his home, defeat his lackeys, beat him up, and then proceed to loot his belongings—a cycle that knows no end! One day, when yet another hero appears in his castle, th

author: Asou, Mikoto
description: In high school, Hiromi Hashiba studied so much, and cared so little for her appearance, she earned the nickname, “Nerd Hashiba.” Now, having entered T University, Japan’s most prestigious university, she’s decided to get rid of her old image and debut a new life in college. However, her radical look and behavior stand out too… (Source: B-U)

title: Mama wa Tenparist
author: Higashimura, Akiko
description:
A manga about the difficulties of raising a child.

The author of this book sometimes felt "tenparu" while raising her son. "Tenparu" means that when sudden accident happen we can't fix it soon and feel desperate and rushed. So she calls herself a "tenparist."

title: A Substitute Marriage with an Admirable Husband
author: Tatsumoto, Mio
description:
Sometimes all it takes is a little push from fate to find your true happiness... 

Miya has an older sister, Mirei. Mirei is elegant, proper, and polite, the family's jewel. Miya, however, is none of that. She is scolded for being childish, wearing old kimonos, and having no manners. But even she admires her older sister, especially because Mirei will marry Kenichiro Hirose, Miya's first and lifelong love.

author: Nakamura, Sachiko, Kawazoe, Mariko

Yui Kiryuu is a street performer who relies on (and takes pride in) her beauty and dancing skills. In order to save her friend Cecille, she makes a contract with a creature from another world - a Tinas. Her end of the bargain, however, is the thing she treasures the most...

(Source: Kindan-no Aku)

author: Yamagata, Satomi
description: This volume collects six short stories by Yamagata Satomi about girls between the ages of seven and sixteen and how these girls deal with the challenges of growing up, such as parental abandonment, the misunderstandings of teachers and other students, and nascent sexuality.

title: Noenoto
author: Suzumoto, Jun
description: Kanoto is one half of a pair of identical twins. The other half, Kanoe, died at birth, and has since been haunting him. Kanoto can't make up his mind whether or not he hates the troublemaking smartmouth that's his older brother, but...

title: Angelic Runes
author: Tateno, Makoto
description:
A traveler in search of his father chances upon a pair of twins about to be buried by their village. The villagers claim the two are cursed but he rescues them. He soon finds out what makes the villagers fear them: the siblings can hear the devils and angels speak. But he has his own secrets as well...

(Source: MU)

title: Mahoutsukai no Reikoku
author: Ninomiya, Hikaru
description: A mature tale of a young female college student.

title: Tramp.
author: Fujiwara, Yuu
description:
People who have a birthmark associated with pirate treasure are legendary. This was already a legend among the pirates. The story is started to begin...

(Source: MU)

author: Ikeda, Riyoko
description:
The story is taken from the famous Nordic saga, but is based on the adaption of Richard Wagner's Der Ring des Nibelungen, a cycle of four epic music dramas.

Central element of the story is of course the stunning Ring of the Nibelung, guarded in the depths of the sea by the nymphs of the water. According to the legend, the owner of the ring will get an enormous power that can challenge even the gods. The hero of the manga is Siegfried, who grew up in the woods with the blacksmith Mime (a dwarf),

title: Professor Busujima's Egg
author: Kanou, Ruri
description:
Rune believes that good children get spoiled except for her. She decides to run away from home. On the train she took, she encountered an odd stranger named Busujima... who keeps on insisting that she's an egg!

(Source: Hyper Parfait)

title: Our Love Doesn't Need a Happy Ending
author: Yajima, Fuyumi
description:
Daiki Tomita likes movies, but the real reason he's still kept up with his university's film club members after they all graduated is his unrequited love for fellow member Koharu Kobayakawa. He's been hesitant to risk their friendship by asking her out, but when Koharu breaks the news that she doesn't have long to live, Tomita must decide whether or not he's willing to let her go without ever telling her how he truly feels...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Yoi Akete Romanesque
author: Takase, Waka
description:
Tokyo in the early Showa era. Genichiro has been assigned to supervise the popular author Yuzuru Nijou. However, he is surprised to discover that the author he thought was a man is really a younger woman...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: The Crimson Kitty And The Forest Watchdog
author: Haru
description: In this town, animals live like people. Misha, a cat, finds a fixer-upper deep in the forest and decides to repair it and make it her home, but she isn't making much progress. After a run-in with a hulking, muscular dog (?) named Hati, Misha makes a deal with him: assist her with repairs, and he can live there as well. Misha finds living with the strong, silent Hati to be a breeze, and the two set to work on the house. However, something starts to seem off about Hati. When Misha presses him for

Cinderella by Mistake! When a case of mistaken identity landed Katie Canton in the Braddock world of wealth and power, she couldn't resist the temptation to mingle with the famous family. Especially fascinating eldest brother, Adam. Getting the commanding C.E.O. to loosen up was a worthy cause—until Katie realized the danger of opening her heart to a man whose master plan did not include M

title: Vengeful Seduction
author: Midori, Yukako, Williams, Cathy
description:
"Your father embezzled company money. Marry me if you don't want me to disclose it." Four years ago, Isobel married a man she didn't love without telling the truth to Lorenzo, who she truly loved. Soon after her husband dies in a traffic accident, Lorenzo appears! He went to the U.S. after they broke up and has achieved great success. He now offers to acquire Isobel's father's company, which is in financial difficulty! "I rejected him four years ago. Is this his revenge?"

(Source: JManga)

Shichi is surprised by this unexpected partner. However, she gradually becomes attra

author: Isezaki
description: Asahi Hiiragi suggests helping Uzuki to get over her extremely shy personality. Uzuki gets painfully embarrassed. She works as cleaning staff because it doesn't require her to talk to people. One day, Asahi asks her to dinner and he confesses his feelings to her. He's an employee at a security company. author: Aomori
description:
Tiny, adorable hard worker Anzu Igarashi can read minds. She's been very good at tuning most of them out, but there's been one mind she just can't help but listen to—stoic, no-nonsense Izumi, who can't stop fantasizing about her! How can she resist temptation when Anzu gets stranded in close quarters with Izumi and his passionate thoughts?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

description: Saki Asahina has a secret... though everyone at work thinks she's a true beauty, once her makeup comes off, she's as red as an octopus! Having been cruelly bullied in the past for how she looks, Saki has put years of effort into perfecting her makeup game! Now she's never lacking in attention (or the gossip that comes with it), but she has yet to catch the eye of her boss, Fujimichi Bansho, who she's had a crush on for years. One night, while out buying beer and with her makeup off, Saki finds h

While it hasn't all been cupcakes and mochi, she's proud of her hard-earned skills—until the day her boss assigns her to mentor the new hire, Ryoma Shindou. From the moment they meet, Shindou leaves a bitter taste in Rinko's mouth. His sharp tongue and bad attitude grate on her nerves, and worse yet, he insists he doesn't need her guidance at all. The most infuriating part? He's right. Shindou isn't

title: Kouman to Henken
author: Mochizuki, Reiko, Austen, Jane
description:
The story follows the main character Elizabeth Bennet as she deals with issues of manners, upbringing, moral rightness, education and marriage in her aristocratic society of early 19th century England. Elizabeth is the second eldest of five daughters of a country gentleman landed in the fictional town of Meryton in Hertfordshire, not far from London.

(Source: Wikipedia)

title: Aisare Jouzu Keikaku
author: Tenmaru, Yuu
description:
Every time I fall in love I always act really worried! I want to get to know you and get closer to you! I’ll stay strong and get closer to you even though my heart keeps pounding. Please, tell me all about your good times, your happiness, your pain and your love…! 

(Source: StarryHeaven)

title: Shishi to Cinderella
author: Sasaki, Misuzu
description:
Yvain has been working as a maid in the Sandell household since she was 15. One day she accompanies her employers on a luxury cruise ship. Who would have thought the ship would sink! Yvain is swept away by the strong currents of the sea... When she awakens, she finds herself on the Island of Lions, where the mysterious yet alluring marquess, Juan, lives...

(Source: MU)

Okazaki Shimako is an office worker for a fashion company who believes her boyfriend is going to propose to her on Christmas Eve, and is planning on quitting her job. Instead he dumps her by phone right before their date. As she's home trying to understand what has happened her younger sister whom she hasn't seen in 18 years shows up…

As a result of complications with her first love, Minato has remained a virgin even as a working adult. Turning her back on men, she spends her days adoring a hot guy in a game. However, one morning she wakes up to find a guy who looks just like her first love right next to her. Who is this man? Does this mean she will have another chance at love?

(Source: Clairparfait)

Volume 2: Uchi no Neko Shirimasen ka?

author: Kunieda, Saika
description:
Marika is impulsive and hates to lose. She's also a woman who falls in love easily. She falls for a sexy older man, a cool classmate, and a beautiful wealthy man. And the man she chooses in the end...? A romantic love story, from the love of her student days to her marriage.

(Source: Presence Dear)

When Hinata, a female university student, starts living on her own after entering college, she finds herself in a city that's perfectly livable but dull and boring. Thinking she'll just spend the next four years of university here, she shrugs it off... until one day, she encounters Kage, a young man taking photos of seemingly ordinary spots around town.

description:
Mizuka met a strange boy when she was 13. He was her first love. But when the summer ended, even if they promised to see each other again, Mizuka never saw him again. Twelve years later, Mizuka meet the same boy again. She's so happy until she found out that he has a twin brother...

(Source: Sound of Jewels)

Quincy wouldn't have seen this coming in her wildest dreams. What ordinary girl-next-door would? One minute you're sitting down to tea in your kitchen, talking with a friend, and the next-the man of your dreams comes knocking at your door, and he's looking for YOU.

Jubei is a painter of cats in Edo. Accompanied by Nita, a mythical two-tailed monster cat that can speak human language, Jubei encounters various cats in the city of Edo.

Subaru is enrolled as a art major in the department of education at university. She's energetic and good-natured. There, she meets a rather ill-natured honor student who is enrolled in the same department as her. What's most surprising though, is that it turns out that this disagreeable boy is her next-door neighbor at her new apartment! Just what lies in store for Subaru's daily life now?

(Source: Clairparfait)

It is the Taisho period. A straight-laced man named Shougo works as a teacher for an all girls school, and lives with his black cat named Kuroi-san. Then one day, his nephew brings him a tight-lipped servant who doesn't talk. Is this beginning of a curious, and slightly warm life of a man, a cat, and a girl?

They suffer between Love and Duties.

From thrilling Kunoichi comedy to the distress of a poisonous French queen, master Kamata Kimiko transcends time and space and brings you stories about delicate, earnest and sturdy maidens!

Stories included: Swan Ninja Art Anecdotes, Edo Love Dance, DOLL, Promise to Race, Arisu.

Takeda Hiroaki is a good-looking average high school student with a cute girlfriend. Gokokuji Akira is a class president and smart on the outside but behind that elite appearance, he works for male escort company "M Project".

Though out Hiroaki's whole life, he didn't have any hobbies or didn't care about getting involved in anything. One day, his lazy everyday life turned 180 degrees when he got involved with Akira.

(source: manga-updates)

Kiichi and Kanoko are brother and sister who have just lost their parents. They move to the deep countryside, to the home of their relatives the Toba family. And who is Toba-sama? A hearth-deity who has been watching over the Toba house for 150 years. He uses abusive language and is very ill-disposed, but he's a softie at heart and has a strong protective side. And this deity names Kiichi for his successor!

The life of the two siblings is about to change at 180 degrees! A countryside-life fanta

title: Mr. Cinderella
author: Hinase, Yuuki
description:
If you can't find your ideal prince, why not transform a guy into your ideal man? Ms. Fune has her eyes set on her dowdy boss, Mr. Ninomiya. Convinced that he'll be easy to seduce, she's shocked when he tries to convince her that there are more suitable men out there for her. She may have set the trap to catch her boss, but she ends up becoming ensnared in love herself! Will this feisty young woman be able to win an older man's heart?

(Source: Renta!)

Included one-shot: Frill to Button

Himitsu x Himitsu is a collection of short stories involving many different couples and their sex life. Their everyday situations are told with humor and fun.

30-year-old Reina Hirota's chill life of snacking and binge-watching TV shows gets a wake-up call through a forgotten childhood dream buried in a time capsule. Suddenly, her content solitude seems more like a forever-solo voyage, prompting her to crawl off the couch and start husband hunting—not just to find love, but to help her family find their groove again. Now, if only she knew what she wanted—not just in life, but in a guy, too.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

The "cynical slapstick comedy" one-shot follows the troubles of Rikuto Shindou and his "mother," Shuichi Shindou. Riku is now in high school, and he is freaking out because his mother is supposed to come to school tomorrow for an interview with his teacher. Shuichi then decides to crossdress for the interview.

Princess Lailah's ruse to deceive the prince by impersonating her sister works, but it turns out he has other plans for her. Rika likes to drink. She goes to this bar to find a "man with a wrist watch" who once comforted her when she got drunk. But the only man who talks to her at the bar is Masa, who's an unshaven older man... One night, Rika finds herself in a strange place after she passed out, and sees the man she was looking for kissing her and caressing her body... But when she wakes up, the man next to her was not whom she expected!

Even though this is a story from the recent past...a man who suddenly appeared in my room seems to be "Hikaru Genji." Yes, the one from the Heian period, the insanely popular young nobleman who is the main character of "Genji Monogatari."

At first I thought he was a suspicious guy in cosplay, but after I had bashed him over the head with a metal bat, I decided to watch over him for a little bit. Soon he became like a parasite, and if he weren't so elegant and shy...

description: A collection of stories from Izumi Kyouta. The book is made up of several tales with the first story a three-parter titled Kiss or Kick? which details the sex-filled activities in a karate dojo between students.

title: Sanctuary of Red Leopard
author: Nekome, Toochika
description:
"If you expose our secret, I shall kill you." After an accident on a mountain, Takatou is helped by Ritsu, a woman with a red birthmark under her right eye. "If consumed, they become an elixir." Having learnt the legend of the Red Leopard, Takatou seems to become obsessed and continues to search for Ritsu. Thus begins the love romance of these two trapped in a legend.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

The manga centers on Tsubaki Kanno, a 25-year-old straightforward woman who works at a stationery shop.

author: Ueno, Haruna

Momiji Akiyama, 27 years old. One day, she was suddenly bothered by a drunkard who was then driven off once she broke out in her dialect. The policeman who witnessed this came to realise his fetish for dialects and became emotionally attached to her?!

Now, Momiji has found herself in a bewildering but heart-throbbing situation thanks to this clumsy policeman's single-minded displays of love!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Mellow Boy Friend
author: Yonaka, Bebe
description: Ruika is a comic artist who's not exactly satisfied with her job at the moment. She's concerned she's not following her dreams. One night, she runs into Hina, a friend she hasn't seen since high school. Hina's become a hunky heartthrob of an actor, but on the inside, he's still the same aloof guy he was when they were younger. author: Shinjou, Rino, Sunagawa, Amemichi

Only one person could be the father, and it's her handsome, but strict supervisor at work, Director Ishiki. The incident happened a few months ago when she was celebrating a job well down with him after a huge project they worked on together. Perhaps they were feeling a bit too relaxed, but once a few drinks hit, they ended up sharing a kiss. The unexpected so

author: Nashizuki, Uta

Serika's younger cousin, Taichi, 6 years her junior, had passed his university entrance exams and until he's found a place to rent, Serika will be looking after him. Although he appears to be as pretty as a girl and a sweet angel, he's grown into a sadist devil in the time they haven't seen each other! He suddenly hugs her and kisses her—Serika's self control is on the brink of collapsing before Taichi, who has grown into such a splendid man.

author: Minami, Shizu
description: Riko Kurita, a 30-year-old university administrator who's dying to get married, meets archery club captain Daisuke "Mr. Serious" Shimizu. Daisuke asks her out and confesses his love, even though they've hardly spoken. Plus, he's a university student ten years her junior! But, when Daisuke prepares an "action plan" for dating through marriage, Riko realizes it's time to take a chance on this guy. "Marriage" is the word she always wanted to hear from her ex, so Riko can't help but start a relation

title: Baby☆Ote wo Douzo
author: Hata, Akimi
description:
Novice Nailst, Sonomi, does everyday odd jobs with clichéd customer service of the best quality, but has no customers. That girl, while on an errand to pick up one bottle of nail color met Shinji by chance. The course of the events, Sonomi became his lover, is this the beginning of her days being abused by this malicious man!? This is a compilation of 2 one-shots, her first comic!

(Source: Shoujo Kreuz)

Included one-shots: Natural ni Koi wo Shite; Boku no Mono

Three manga adaptations of Takarazuka Review productions:
- Turandot: Loosely based on Puccini’s opera of the same name. After Prince Calaf’s homeland is destroyed by war, he flees and lives the life of a vagabond. After hearing rumors that his long lost father has been spotted in Peking, Calaf makes his way there.
- Angel’s Smile, Devil’s Tears: Loosely based on Goethe’s Faust. The fallen angel Mephistophles resents humans, believing them to be unworthy of God’s love. Determined to prove himsel

author: Yoshihara, Yuki
description:
• Sekai wa Futari de Dekite Iru
Youko is a succubus from hell and her rocket lands on the earth to feed off man's efforts. But one day, she met an ultra-refined priest and...

Office lady Mayumi passionately loves... her supervisor's work ethic? Her friends think it's weird that Mayumi isn't physica

title: Kagami no Mukou
author: Ogata, Tomio
description:
Rumors say that inside a dusty room in an old manor, a demon inside a mirror can grant any wish in exchange for years from the wishmaker's life. While he is powerful, the demon only seems to grant wishes pertaining to appearance. His sole companion is a young, disfigured girl named Nio who has never asked for anything in return. Intrigued, he asks Nio what her wish is, only to find that her answer is something he cannot quite understand.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Anata no Ai ni Yararetai
author: Katsumoto, Kasane
description:
The good-looking high schooler Junnosuke can get every girl he wants. But after sleeping with them, he never looks at them again. But his classmate Shiori has true feelings for him. Will she throw the world out of balance?

(Source: MU, edited)

title: Janome no Me
author: Morimoto, Kozueko
description:
Touko Tsukishiro inherited the power of the "Nightblade Eye," which allows her see and exterminate evil spirits. She helps out at her grandmother's antique store "Janomeya" by conducting exorcism rituals. Touko travels to the island of Mizuhai, to investigate a case where "the chief priest of the shrine has not woken up for a month," and she is surprised by the beauty of the sleeping priest they call "Kiyora-sama"...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Dog Signal
author: Miyauchi, Saya
description:
A dog trainer's job is to bring dogs and people together. Miyu Samura, an indecisive young man, meets Shinichiro Niwa, a miracle-working dog trainer, while walking the dog forced on him by his ex-girlfriend. The chance encounter will greatly change Miyu's life! Thus begins the story about the growth of a new dog trainer!

(Source: MAL News)

title: My Lover Is a Closet Otaku
author: Taamo
description:
The story centers on a straight-laced and serious man who slowly starts to become a "fudanshi" (guy who loves boys-love stories) after he starts dating a girl.

(Source: ANN, edited)

title: Lil' Leo
author: Hagio, Moto
description: Two-year-old Leo is not your average house cat. One day he notices his young neighbor Tatsuru on his way to elementary school and he then decides to follow him and enroll himself! After receiving his own backpack and school supplies, young Leo realizes that anything Tatsuru can do, he can do as well! Leo can go to school! title: Yonoi Tsukihiko's Happy Hell
author: Sakurada, Hina
description:
For the sake of her family's farm, Hanabata Mikan has been arranged to marry the heir of a food and holdings company, Yonoi Tsukihiko. Mikan refuses, saying she already has a man she loves, only for Tsukihiko to laugh in her face! He finds romance and love unnecessary and has no intentions of changing his views. But Mikan can't get married to a man who doesn't believe in love...right? Is this pair doomed to rot, or can a love ripen between two total opposites?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: The Wind Up Garden
author: Kayase, Shiki
description:
Tucked away in the mountains and cut off from the rest of the world, Rosa Academy is your typical boarding academy—at least on the surface. And like most schools, it has its share of urban legends. But, as Raum and his friends—Tulli, Yan, and Karel—are wont to find out, there is more than meets the eye...

(Source: Storm in Heaven)

title: Good Choice Umetaro
author: Saitani, Umetarou
description:
Ah! Adolescence, the time of the first love! The discovery of love relations and sexual relations, one unforgettable moment. Discover a multitude of young couples in original situations !
source : www.doki-doki.fr - official french publisher. translated from french)

title: Never Say Ugly
author: Toaru, Arako
description:
Tomoko was called "ugly" back in her school days. And what really makes her seethe is the fact that the "pretty" girl who bullied her, Rika, is now a successful beauty influencer. But Tomoko sees a whole different world reflected in Rika's eyes... These two women with different pasts, looks, and approaches both take the world head-on in this story of sisterhood and overcoming beauty discrimination!

(Source: Kodansha)

title: Batsu Koi
author: Tsukiko
description:
If your pure and romantic loves just end up messy, then you should just indulge in shallow relations for relief! At least, that's what female lawyer Kahori thinks, but then due to unforeseen circumstances, she finds herself at a crossroad in life... Is it possible for an independent female lawyer nearing her 30s to find love?

(Source: Clairparfait)

Shizuka, a shy office lady, was invited by a colleague at the company to go to a joint party, but she felt suffocated by the glittering atmosphere around her.

"I'm always dull and have an equally dull self who always wants to help people."

She wanted to escape from such a reality, and on this day she suddenly got inspired.

"I want to change this time!"

author: Uehara, Hachi, Crane

Lara Bradley, a renowned mage, sets off to defeat a low-risk monster with her young apprentice Alistair, who never stops proposing to her. But instead of a minor threat, they encounter the world's most dangerous creature—a dragon! In a desperate bid to save Alistair, Lara faces the dragon alone and casts a spell that turns herself to stone.

It should have be my first time, but for some reason, my body reacts to the pleasure like it knows it all too well! This isn't me!
