Simeon, the heir to an earldom, is highly accomplished in scholarly and military arts—and he's gorgeous. So why did he propose to such an unremarkable noblewoman? Nakagawa Makoto is a serious city hall official who secretly draws shoujo manga as a hobby. One day, he meets a high school girl, Kouzuki Kureha, at a restaurant, and ends up showing her his work. Touched by Nakagawa's manga, Kureha forces him to go to a publishing company in Tokyo!

This is the beginning of an banging off-road journey...

(Source: MU, edited)

"From today, you're my dog." The bright and bold Momota has been selected to be a personal secretary for their company's hot, young president who is notoriously known to be unrelentingly harsh and borderline dictatorial. Her days are now spent busily keeping up with the president's tough demands in her efforts to be his favorite dog. Until she finds out about the president's biggest secret, that is.

Amidst the busy atmosphere of the café and making nice with the Prince (and putting up with his fetish for all things miniature), Snow White has also a rival, Rosé, the owner of another café “The Red Hood”. A heartful comedy about a man who quit his old company job. While he's looking for another job, he starts working part-time in an izakaya and meets the people there.

A normal junior high school girl, Nozawa Nao falls in love with Itami-senpai, who is in love with the school's poster girl, who is in love with a popular rock band vocalist...When will this vicious cycle ever end?!

The manga centers on a woman named Haiji, whose eccentric grandfather has just passed away, and left her his mountain cabin. Her grandfather worked with a man named Kirishima, who didn't fit Haiji's image of mountaineers at all. Haiji plans to visit the mountain cabin, but finds difficulty with the unforgiving climb. Once she makes it, the sight she sees changes her, and she makes a decision.

Oodaka Tsubasa is an energetic young boy who is eager for his brand new high school life in the boarding school. After a certain coincidence, he saves his next-door neighbor in the same dorm from an attempted suicide. Tsubasa later learns that this suicidal is known as "Kamibako" (Paper Box), a famous ex-game commentator who is trying to take his own life for unknown reason.

The meeting between these two polar opposites soon raises the curtain of a "poisonous adolescence"...!

It was the happiest day in the world. Our sad and fleeting "love with a deadline" has begun.

In the winter of his freshman year of high school, Akito Hayasaka is diagnosed with a heart disease and told that he has little time left to live. In the midst of despair, Akito meets Sakurai Haruna, who is hospitalized at the hospital. Haruna, too, is seriously ill and has only a few days left to live. She is a 24-year-old woman who was just sacked. He is a 15-year-old teen. When the grandmother whom she dearly respected passes away, both the woman and the teen came to stay under a single roof. Will they ever find their safe heaven?

There are four office ladies working at Toaru Computer Parts Maker. They met "The Wolf," "The Irresponsible Man," "The Devil," and "The Prince"!! A love story about Ninette, a baroness, and Till, her escort.

The story begins when Ninette, whose political marriage has been consummated, is reunited with Till, who has become a duke and her fiancé. Ten years before their reunion, Ninette's stepmother and stepsister had taken over her house, and she was living with Till in a cabin in a corner of the mansion. Peking in the 20s - the time in which the old customs and fresh wind mix. What is the true reason for the rage of older brother Ruhai on young Mr. Rushan from house Tai with his love to the theater ...?

The dreams and the real life of the people who have made a mistake to the old dramatic art of the Peking opera are shown with the history all around famous actor Yang Luoxian. The splendid stage stands for the highest luck for the time being, and also for the everlasting admiration...

Jo is your average manga artist slash divorcee, a dime a dozen in Japan. At least that's what he'd like the outside world to believe. But his editor Nichika knows his terrible secret, a secret which she threatens to expose unless he puts a ring on her finger.

What is Jo to do when he is still deeply traumatized by a past divorce? Why, marry her of course! After all, don't people say to "Keep your friends close, and your enemies closer?"

In a world where Ogres, Wolves, Foxes, Crows, and Humans coexist, Hana is a valiant and kind girl living her best life as a cafe worker. He claims she is his "Flower of Fate" and suddenly asks for her hand in marriage, but will Hana accept his proposal that easily...?!

Robbed of the person I love and my way of life, to whom should I direct my wrath at having everything taken from me?

author: Ono, Natsume

The manga tells the story of four men of retirement age who live a country life deep in the mountains. One day, a mysterious woman appears in the town, and each of the men are gradually charmed by her.

(Source: ANN)

5. Mitsuai Appointment

Chidori is the heir to a household that has practiced Japanese tea ceremony for generations, but she has no personal interest in these traditions or carrying on the family business. She’s more enamored with modern and foreign trends and attends an American university. However, she’s called back to Japan and has to endure her strict mother and uncomfortable, constricting kimono.

Chidori meets a local kimono merchant and cleaner, Saiuchi Tsumugi. Although Tsumugi always maintains a polite smile,

title: Dracul
author: Hakase, Mizuki
description:
The story centers around a young man whose father was a vampire. 

(Source: ANN)

title: Hitodenashi no Kokoro
author: Pepu
description:
Set in the Taisho era, a girl named Kokoro has a very unpleasant skill. She abnormally attracts perverts! Her life since childhood has been filled with ups and downs, and at the age of 17, she decided that she couldn't live a normal life due to her condition. But then she unexpectedly meets someone who might be able to change the way she feels! A love story develops between a not-so-normal girl and an equally not-so-normal boy!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Becoming the Demon Lieutenant General's Stand-in Bride: Once an Heir Is Born, We Must Part
author: Hachikumo, Rin
description:
In place of her twin sister, Lady Tsukiko ends up in a marriage with Kishi, a young man who rose in the ranks as a lieutenant general. He's also known as the "Demon General" due to his ruthlessness. Since her childhood, Tsukiko has been sickly and deemed as a failure by those around her. After meeting the general only once, she was emotionally supported by his kindness. But now he tells her after she's provided him with an heir, they must get a divorce?!

(Source: Ohzora Shuppan)

title: Hebi Ichigo no Kanzume
author: Kawachi, Haruka
description:
An OL (office lady) with a broken heart decides to visit her childhood friend in hopes of staying overnight only to find a man living in her friend's house as her "roommate". 

(Source: Stiletto Heels)

title: Futarime no Oujisama
author: Wakuhara, Niko
description:
Koharu is in love with her venture IT company's president Ayato. She's on bad terms with his beloved cousin, the genius programmer Yuiya, though, because she's convinced Yuiya is trying to get in her way. However, when he helps her with an important presentation, she starts seeing him in a different light...

(Source: Clairparfait)

Included one-shot: Amai Kioku wa Nioitatsu

title: First Love Reset
author: Kuroda, Urara
description: Ako and Hiro were always together. Ako was so sure that Hiro reciprocated her feelings, but after he rejected her, it left a deep scar in her heart. Ten years have passed since then. Ako decides she needs to spread her wings and forget all about what happened. Right when she's having trouble convincing her dad to let her move out on her own, someone comes to the door. It turns out to be Hiro, her first love, and they haven't seen each other since the rejection. But, since Ako's parents trust him

title: I Confess to You in My Dreams...
author: Umeko
description: Mr. Shima can always depend on Chitose for speed and consistency. Chitose loves helping out, too. She hates the thought of Mr. Shima having to work overtime because of her mistake. Chitose is very fond of Mr. Shima, but has trouble showing it. Her face stiffens whenever he's near, and her wording becomes harsh. Mr. Shima probably thinks she's an ice queen!.. But during a company dinner party, Chitose and Mr. Shima drink a little too much and... wake up next to each other in Chitose's room! Ah we

title: Ayakashi Parade Game
author: Shimotsuki, Kairi
description:
The story centers on a group of youkai and the members of a basketball team known as the "Hiroe Industry of 5 Fouls" who always lose.

(Source: ANN)

title: Ossan's Love
author: Yamanaka, Umebachi, Tokuo, Kouji
description:
Souichi Haruta is a 33-years-old single man who isn't popular with women. He works at a real estate office and lives with his parents. However, one day, his mother walks away from him and he has to live independently. Souichi doesn't know basic things such as cooking or washing his clothes. He then decides to live with Ryouta Maki, a coworker who is good at housekeeping. One day, Ryouta and Musashi Kurosawa, a gay coworker, both confess their feelings to Souichi.

(Source: MyDramaList)

title: My Brother's Friend Likes to Flaunt It
author: Aizen, Mana
description:
1. Oniichan no Tomodachi ga Roshutsu-kei Danshi Dattara (My Brother's Friend Likes to Flaunt It)
2. Yukata no Kareshi ni Yokujou shitemo Ii desu ka? (Is It Okay to Be Excited by My Boyfriend in a Yukata?)
3-4. Dokujo, Himo wo Hiroimashita  (A Lonely Lady Picks up a Freeloader)
5. Hontou Iu to Kekkon shitai (To Be Honest, I Do Want to Get Married)
6. Hajimete no Kareshi ga Roshutsu-kei Danshi Dattara (My First Boyfriend Likes to Flaunt It)

author: Miura, Hiraku

2. Lolipop★Baby
3. Ningyou-hime
4. Kamisama no Dekoboko. (Ningyou-hime Bangai-hen)

title: Permission to Love
author: Sakurada, Hina
description:
Hana Yoshizawa has only one goal in life: to find her soulmate. Dreamy, distracted and hopeful, she wishes to find someone to share those feelings with; although she has no luck. After several failed love affairs, she does not lose sight of her ideal and share that desire with others. Therefore, she doesn't bother trying to convince her subordinate, Takada, that soulmates do exist and that he will find his someday...something Takada is not really interested in, nor does he believe they exist.

I

author: Tani, Mizue, Yamaguchi, Izumi
description:
Can memories ever be repaired...?

Tired of her work and love, Akari has moved to the town where she spent a little time of her life there. At the corner of the desolate shopping district, she meets the owner of a watch store that has a strange plate on the display window. Thus, Akari starts her new life...

(Source: MU)

author: Isoya, Yuki
description: The plot revolves around a woman with a broken heart called Nanami who meets two handsome men in Mt. Fuji while they are looking for whales. A story about love and sea life.

author: Kusanagi, Toshiki
description: Transfer student Rin Habikino has always been troubled by the rumours that he causes the deaths of people who become close to him, so he decides that he won't make friends with his new classmates. While he is on his way home one day, a strange man covered in bandages approaches him with a warning. The man claims Rin is a death god and that he is about to become involved in battles against the Dark Arcana's opposing force, the White Arcana. In order to defend himself, Rin must use his ability to

title: I Got Reincarnated in a Delinquent Manga, Why Is the Gang Leader Feeding Me?
author: Bisu, Mugicha, Poyoko

author: Miura, Hiraku
description: Shizuru Kohinata has a hard time expressing on her face how she feels. As a hotel housekeeper, she is scolded by guests for lacking remorse after making a mistake, and her coworkers denigrate her for being emotionless and scary. Shizuru's used to this treatment... and yet, today seems to be her limit. Tears start rolling down her cheeks and won't stop flowing, even in front of the owner of the hotel, Seishirou Kamiki. As the handsome VIP consoles her in her sadness, Shizuru finds herself waking

title: Berna and Garland
author: Katsumoto, Kasane
description:
Nanae lost her vision when she was 27 years old. But she never lost her dream to be a good wife and mother. Berna, a guide dog, helps her to reach all of her dream.

A really nice, beautiful, and touching story of life.

(Source: MU)

title: Kahogo na Wakadanna-sama no Amayakashikon
author: Kodachi
description:
Io Tsuruoka, a chef apprentice at a long-established inn in Asakusa, has been in love from an early age with Yukito, the young master and heir to the inn. One day, she is shocked to hear a rumor of marriage talks involving the young master, but unbelievably, he proposes to her...?

It's the start of the sweet newlywed life of the young master at a long-established inn and a pure girl apprenticing to be a chef.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: My Favorite Author Became My Sugar Daddy!?
author: Natsuyagi, Shizuku
description:
After a friend asks her to go on a questionable date in her place, Ran Yoshizaki hesitantly decides to go in order to help her father pay back his loan.
However, she was given an aphrodisiac without her knowledge and is about to be taken to the hotel! Just when her chastity is in danger, it's none other than a regular at her part-time job and a person she looks up to, writer Haruyoshi Mikami, that saves her! With an uncontrollable heat overflowing from within her, Haruyoshi gently whispers into

title: Flowers In Bloom!
author: Ross, Molico
description: Upon graduating from an all-boys high school, Tobishima Ichita (18) enrolls in the manga course at an art school. Ichita's genre of choice is Boy's Love (BL) and he has always wanted to connect with girls who love BL just as much as he does. As such, Ichita heads to his first day of class with a dream in his heart! When he arrives, though, his nerves get the best of him—he can't seem to have a normal conversation with a girl. What's more, his class is nothing but girls...! What will become of Ic

title: Yakuza's Very Superficial Training
author: Kuruwa, Aki
description:
Patissier Haruka decides to make a secret contract with Kazutaka Suou, a member of the yakuza Suou group who is a regular at her store, to repay the debt of the store she inherited. Kazutaka is young but already the leader of his group, and he also fell madly in love with Haruka's sweets. Craving both her sweets and her body, Haruka cannot get help but get involved in the underworld...

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

description: Aya is pretty busy with her relationship with Tetsuo (leader of the great Paster Rangels) and her longing to look like a cool and mature person. Can her feelings deal with Tetsuo's work?

Another story from the world Mizu no Senritsu, which mainly revolves around ‘Song’, a sub-character in the game. There will be tons of other popular characters from the game as well! 

(Source: Osuwari Team)

author: Okai, Haruko
description:
Cafe Waikiki is so empty that owner-chef Yori swears he's been hearing voices. Why isn't he getting any customers? His cooking can't be that bad, and it's not like he's in the wrong location, so what other reason could there be for this to happen?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: The Girl & the Super Gay Boner
author: Yamada, Aihi
description:
"It's a woman's body, but why does yours look so delicious?" I'm courted relentlessly by gay, who should've been my enemy. No! Why did he get hard because of me...!?

(Source: WWWave Corporation)

Although he does not reveal his identity and seems to be involved in the war for the throne, Roseline quickly falls in love. After a turn of events, he unbelievably becomes the new Emperor! As soon as he conquered the capital, he came and marries Roseline. They spend many nights together, teaching each other pleasures with their bodies. However, no matter how much love they have for each other, being the

Then out of the blue, he receives a request to ghostwrite the memoirs of the vanished pop idol Haruka Masaki. Sakura gets cold feet when he hears that Masaki requested him personally, wondering what she would want with someone like him. But while he's thrown for a loop by her uninhibited personality, the distance between them gradually shrinks. However, once the inte

title: Uta Koi. Ibun Uta Hen.
author: Sugita, Kei
description: A collection of shorts stories, parody of Chouyaku Hyakunin Isshu: Uta Koi.

author: Tsurezurebana, Azuma, Midori

Leila is a woman who used to work in an office. Now, she's suddenly fallen into a new fantasy world called "The Dragon Kingdom." While falling out of the sky, she was saved by a giant dragon and decided that from now on her name is Lylac. Now she will live in the castle of the king of this nation, the Dragon Lord, and have the opportunity to work. However... the workers never take breaks and are constantly overworked!

Lylac, with her kitchen servant status and knowledge of modern cooking, tries

title: Anata no Ai nado Irimasen
author: Touma, Ryou, Aratama, Ran

"Go Back to the One You Love... Don't Worry About Me."

Even knowing she would only ever be a wife in name, Rachel agreed to marry the kingdom's famed knight and commander of the royal guard, Hendrick—a man she had long admired from afar. But the loveless marriage slowly began to eat away at her soul, leaving her only one source of strength: her beloved son, Lancelot. One day, however, a tragic accident claimed her life... On the night of her birthday, Liliana gave her virginity to Izar. She wanted her guardian, whom she had been in love with for ten years, to love her back for even a moment. But it was a huge mistake—Izar proposed to her, not out of love, but because of their night together. Liliana was then shipped away to Switzerland to be trained to become the "perfect wife." An obedient, chaste and unloved wife... No matter how much she loves him, he never reciprocates...

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.

And then she'll bought an apartment at the mansion "Hitori-sama." She always thought that becoming an OL is the way to become a woman. that's why she was confident about her future... but then some problems happened! That's because of her colleague Kujou Aoi... he's too confident and a problematic person... and he's

description: Yoshida Tamako was the youngest of 11 children.  When she turned 3, she was taken to the Gion district of Kyoto by the Okami of a traditional Maiko/Geiko house.  It is there that Tamako changes her name to Sakiko and begins her long journey to become one of the top maiko in Gion history, "Sakuya".  Another wonderful work by Yamato Waki-sensei that details the beauty of Kyoto and traditional Japan and let's us also see into the often secret world of Kyoto's maikos and geikos.

Included one-shots:

Mei, motivated by her feelings for her first love, Sena, has just achieved her dream of becoming a maid. She finally gets to reunite with Sena, now a butler, only to be confused by his cold attitude, which is unlike the kind and nice personality she used to know. Then, he kisses her all of a sudden...?!

(Source: Ohzora Shuppan, translated)

Niko Shinjoji is the young lady of a mansion and Takashi Kurono is her devoted butler. He has served her since she was 4 years old but how they relationship will change now that she's 25 and he's 35.

In a mountainside bakery, the young shopkeeper Konta meets Mamita, an alien whose spaceship crashed and is looking for food. Konta winds up taking the stranded alien in as his little brother. This is the diary of a baker and an alien as they live together as "siblings."

(Source: Shodensha, translated)

title: The place between O and K

Somewhere in some place...

Akihabara, which is located between Okachimachi and Kanda, became favorite place for teens to spend their time or even take a part-time job. This is a compilation of a stories between those teens who have formed amazing bonds in Akihabara.

In the Femme Fatale no Musuko-tachi series:

3. Yuuutsu na Joushu (When Da Silva Breaks the Rules)

title: No sex necessary

description:
Will blackmail keep them together or separate them forever?

Fiancée wanted; no love necessary is the perfect job for Tara Palmer. For commitment-phobe Cole Charteris, the word marriage isn't in his vocabulary until he meets Tara, the woman who answers an advertisement to pose as his fiancée. But playing a loving couple when there's no love, only blackmail doesn't make for love everlasting.

On Valentine's day, the top ikemen of the school, Hiko, is the most popular among the girls again this year! At this time, the girls all gather, aiming for Hiko... "Take this! My heart's desire!" Reverberating through the hallways is a passionate confession. And the person who delivered the handmade chocolates was his childhood "boy"-friend!

description: Yohei’s father has been training him to become a ninja since he was a young boy. One day, Yohei is given his final test – to defeat his father.

title: Gou Gou datte Neko de Aru
author: Ooshima, Yumiko
description:
After Ooshima's cat named Sava suddenly dies, she finds it difficult to continue creating manga. However, with the help of a new kitten named Gou-Gou who shows up, she's able to get over the loss of Sava and eventually feels inspired to continue her work. When she gets the horrible news that she's been diagnosed with cancer, she's devastated at first, but soon finds some new perspective on life and death.

(Source: MU)
genre: Award Winning, Slice of Life, Memoir

title: Kodomo no Asobi
author: Minami, Q-ta
description: Jun is a little girl like many others. She lives in Japan, province, and grew up experiencing the joys and pains of childhood. Teenager, she shares with her friends in the school of mundane moments, and yet, without her become aware, marks the assertion of her personality. After college, she must find her career path: a winding path and unexpected, after which it will prove ... through manga.

When he arrives at his villa with a beautiful woman in tow, a quiet widow appears in front of him. Widowed Liz, who's in charge of managing the villa's garden, isn't Cam's type, but he can't get her out of his mind. When she cries at the memory of her late husband, it shocks him. title: Shindou-ke no Jijou

The "cynical slapstick comedy" one-shot follows the troubles of Rikuto Shindou and his "mother," Shuichi Shindou. Rikuto has grown up without many friends because they always call him a liar after finding out his "mother" is actually a man. Riku is now in high school, and he is freaking out because his mother is supposed to come to school tomorrow for an interview with his teacher. Shuichi then decides to crossdress for the interview.

(Source: ANN)

title: Eighth Time's the Charm to Get Me on the Road to Romance with the Prince Who's Supposed to Hate Me: "Just Think of Me as Decoration!"
author: Zaneri, Sakano, Mamu
description:
"Just when I was finally resigned to my fate... romance suddenly blooms in my eighth life?!"

In order to broker a peace with an enemy nation, Princess Fiona is sent off to be the concubine of their crown prince, Othniel. Her new husband treats her as little more than a political hostage, and she is soon executed on false charges, or poisoned, or worse... Yet no matter how she meets her end, she always goes back to the same day and restarts her life from there. Determined to survive her eighth l

I'll get infected. These Desires are getting into my body...

Makoto Takamori, homeroom teacher of the special class, is being captivated by Hozumi Souma since half a year ago. "You won't bore me" he says while coming closer...
In the end, when their pupils have met, desire enters her body like a contageous disease. Thus, she can't run away...

description: Chubby and plain, Taeko's biggest worry is whether she'll ever have the courage to tell her crush how she feels. Then one day a mysterious cousin comes to stay and Taeko's world is shattered. Cast out of her own home after her mother's death, Taeko stumbles into the night and is hit by a truck. When she wakes up, she's greeted by a doctor who promises to turn her life around. And thus begins a tale of revenge and intrigue that's a roller coaster of cracked out soap opera fun from start to finish

Mizuki Ikuta goes back to her hometown after struggling to find a job and place to live. She runs into her childhood friend Asahi, and is then taken in as an apprentice at his fathers studio and begins her new life as a gargoyle maker while living in the apartment next to Asahi.

Former rich young lady, Erica, is now in the midst of a life in extreme poverty. When she participated in a celebrity party at Nariyuki, she reunited with Kotaro, a rich man who who was once her servant. Kotaro has refined himself and has become a handsome president, but are things what they seem...?

Saori finds herself at a new school after her dad gets transferred for work. She makes friends right away, and her homeroom teacher, Mr. Nakashima, is really sweet and good-looking... The only problem is she's a terrible student. After failing another test, she visits her homeroom teacher for some tutoring, but he's acting... differently than usual. "He's nothing like I thought he was! He's a jerk

description:
Are sweets and cats the key to peacefully calling off an engagement?!

Seren, the eldest daughter of a duke, has grown up being teased for her plain looks, nicknamed "Princess Drab" in comparison to her younger sister, who is a real beauty. One day she overhears her fiancé, Prince Helios, and his friends talking about how her sister would make a much better wife.

In order to avoid marriage with the prince, Seren plans to become a top-level magician and gain the freedom that comes with the title

As luck would have it though, Rei, the school troublemaker who also turns out to be her brother's dorm roommate, sees through her ruse on her first day! Prepared to be sent home immediately for her action

title: Navin and Prince in the Castle of Phantom Flame

Navin, a 13-year-old girl who lived peacefully in a small village in the mountains, lost everything in an instant. The invasion of Adele's army led by Prince Lucian saw her village burned, her friends enslaved, and her mother beheaded before her eyes. Burning with hatred, Navin is picked up by Lucian, her mother's enemy, and forced to swear loyalty to him. She serves him in the closest place possible, in order to kill him one day.

Rio is a fashionable and cute twin brother. His sister Shio thinks she is plain and not as cute as Rio, and has found her free-spirited brother, who dresses in women's clothing, annoying. One day, a candid photo of Rio is featured in a certain magazine, and so begins his career as a readership-selected model. After losing his wife and child, Kouichi runs a cafe by himself. One day, he meets a mysterious and beautiful boy who has run away from home. His true identity is Ennosuke Kitagawa, a leading male player of female roles, who has absconded from the world of popular theater. Ennosuke proposes that he live and work at Koichi's cafe for the time being... Kouichi, who missed his chance as a father, and Ennosuke, a star female impersonator who is hiding from the world, begin living together...?

A siren prince, Heaven has it all—talent, beauty, and powerful abilities. But one day, the fairies attack and he's forced into hiding, dressing as a woman and selling snake oil to get by. The surviving sirens dream of revenge and the return of their royalty... but Heaven's got other plans.

I'm Nagisa Shiratori, an idol! Tossing people around is a hobby of mine. Is there a strong and cool boy out there somewhere?

Following the emperor's unjust massacre of her family and her own miserable death, Laliette Bellua wakes up to find that she is in the body of her 12-year-old self. Natsune is a sweet and caring doctor with a peculiar trait... He naturally lactates milk that's not only curative but also delicious. In fact, it's so good that practically all the men of his village are dying for a drink!

description: An anthology of erotic stories.

author: Koyubi
description: One day on the train to work, Mayama, a company employee, found his hand pushed against the chest of a young man dressed as a woman, against his will. The next day, he was coerced into a game of "molesting" with a photo taken the day before used as leverage. Tsukasa, a college student, can only feel aroused on the train due to his past trauma. title: Shachou! Watashi wa Anata no (Dansou) Hisho desu.
author: Kitamiya, Mitsuyuki
description:
Rei Usui was looking for a high-paying job to help pay off her father's debts when a mysterious man makes an offer with a salary that's too good to be true. He wants Rei to dress up as a man and become the private secretary for his son, Minato, in order to help Minato overcome his fear of women. However, Minato turns out to be rather arrogant and unpleasant. Will Rei be able to complete her cross-dressing secretarial duties without Minato finding out?

author: Maekawa, Kazuo, Okada, Sayaka
description: Golden Sakura follows Takuya Saotome, a skilled but low-earning and nearly unknown mahjong player, whose girlfriend tricks him into taking on five million yen in debt. He does not know how he will be able to repay the money, but Nabe, a friend running a gay bar, suggests a plan to earn money by becoming a female professional mahjong player. Haruchika Sakamoto is a first-year highschool student who has transferred to the martial arts school Masurao Academy. He has a certain secret however; violence gives him pleasure! Though he would like to have a peaceful school life, the hot-blooded students of Masurao challenge him one after the other to the academy's famed duels!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

description:
An eighteen-year-old girl named Noori is to dress up as a boy and go to a boys' high school at the request of Mrs. Hong, for whom her grandmother worked as a house caretaker. Her striking resemblance to Mrs. Hong's son made her the perfect substitute to attend the school in his stead while he recuperated from a motorcycle accident.

author: Samura, Hiroaki

Set in the Soviet Union in 1920, the mysterious girl named Belka and the quiet boy Shchenok help a Socialist Party member to escape from the secret police. Their aim is to infiltrate into a certain mansion that holds what they seek, but the secret police immediately capture the two. Will they be able to find what they seek and endure the torture of the secret police?

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Asahinagu
author: Kozaki, Ai
description: Everyone wants a fresh start in high school and that applies ten fold for Toujima Asahi. She hopes that she can create a new image of coolness at Futatsuzaka High School; a school that used to be all girls until recently, which explains the female population being 5 times that of the male and the extracurricular activities being female oriented. title: Yo-kai Watch
author: Konishi, Noriyuki
description:
Keita Amano's average elementary school life is turned on its head when he finds a capsule machine on the way to school. Upon opening a capsule-shaped rock from the machine, Keita frees the youkai Whisper, who expresses his gratitude and declares himself Keita's personal butler from then on. Whisper also bestows upon Keita the Youkai Watch, a device that allows its user to see and make contracts with the youkai around them.

Soon, Keita sees a wide variety of youkai causing mayhem in his everyda

title: 12-sai.
author: Maita, Nao
description:
The story begins with Hanabi, a sixth-grade girl who is neither an adult nor a child. She deals with issues such as accidentally witnessing her homeroom teacher kissing, and worrying about experiencing physiological changes before her friends. The manga depicts a 12-year-old girl's innocent worries and first love.

(Source: ANN)

Included one-shot:
Volume 2: Hitotsu Hana Saitara

Story revolves around high school freshman Shingo Susa as he is invited by his crush from middle school Sayuri Shiroyuki to the school's supernatural club. Over the course of the series Susa begins to gain supernatural powers, something that prodigy Rei Uryuu, attempts to awaken to bring out the psychic giant, Susanoou to destroy humanity and establish a new world order.

(Source: MU)

title: Scenes from Awajima
author: Shimura, Takako
description:
Awajima Opera School—where countless girls from across the country flock in hopes of one day standing on the big stage. As they work toward achieving their dreams of stardom, their time at Awajima is filled with as much friendship and admiration as competition and jealousy. The precious feelings of girls who are at once both classmates and rivals, tenderly captured in the portraits of an ensemble cast!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Spiritual Princess
author: Iwamoto, Nao
description:
Akihime, the daughter of Ryokuhouzan's Long-Nosed Goblin, lives with her mother in the lower world and is attending junior high school. She continually refuses the offers of her childhood friend, Shun, who wants her to train with him in the mountains in order to become the Long-Nosed Goblin, because Akihime's heart is just too filled with her feelings for her classmate, "Takeru-kun."

(Source: Antebellum Scanlations)

Included one-shot:
Volume 1: Te wo Totte, Sono mama de

title: Kiiroi Hon: Jacques Thibault to Iu Na no Yuujin
author: Takano, Fumiko
description:
This collected volume was named after the longest of the four stories that it contains: a drama about an adolescent girl who falls in love with Roger Martin du Gard's saga, Les Thibault. The remaining stories capture various fragments of everyday life with tenderness and humor. Through the kaleidoscope of its feminine views, The Yellow Book touches the readers heart by attending to what, in sum, makes up life—the little things of our every day.

(Source: Kotonoha)
genre: Award Winning, Drama, Slice of Life

title: Puniru Is a Kawaii Slime
author: Maeda-kun
description:
This is the story of Puniru the slime and Kotarou, a middle school student, until they cease being friends...

Kotarou Kawaii is a second-year middle school boy. When he was in elementary school, a slime he created came to life, and for the past seven years, he has been spending time with the slime named Puniru as his "friend." However, there is one problem for Kotarou...

Over the seven years, both have grown significantly, and Puniru has transformed into an incredibly beautiful girl!

Besides

Beauty parlor and jewelry store, restaurant and pharmacy, hospital and shoeshine. Everything you need to live is here. The Room Key is all-powerful. You can use it to buy food, jewelry, and to clean your clothes, all without a single reach of the wallet.

As a new morning comes, the being continues beating. Supplying blood into every extremity from its center.
genre: Award Winning, Drama, Slice of Life

title: Chameleon
author: Kase, Atsushi

(Source: MU)

title: Baribari Densetsu

Circumstances have intertwined the fates of five strangers. As a team of five, they make their living running a freak show. As a family of five, they live on a small boat together. In the midst of a terrible war, they add to their number the kudan, a monster rumored to tell the future.

(Source: MU)

author: Yumemakura, Baku, Okano, Reiko

10th Century.

description:
Set in the political unrest of 1960s Japan, a group of young revolutionaries seek to overthrow the world order by any means necessary. But the path they walk is not of glory, but infamy; the events that unfold will shock the nation of Japan to its very core!

Weaving together both detailed research and dramatic elements, Yamamoto Naoki delivers a powerful new take on the most troubling and infamous episode of the history of Japan's radical left-wing student movement.

(Source: MU)

Sawako Honna, 42, single; she works hard at a film promotion company. One night, all of a sudden, her heart palpitates, and her body goes cold... Could it be that she's going through menopause!?

Not as hard-working as in your 20s. Not as flippant as in your 30s. The mental and physical changes, and the obstacles you face in your 40s. Sudden illness, menopause, fatigue you can't get rid of, changes in working patterns, money worries, life plans for the future...

"What will happen to me tomorrow

Shunsuke's mother runs a women's apparel busines but the shop is in need of manpower.

St. President school is one of the richest schools around. Everybody in this school respects the Yuukan club, the most popular and richest group in the whole school. This includes Miroku Shouchikubai, Yuuri Kenbishi, Seishirou Kikumasamune, Noriko Hakushika and Karen Kizakura. But it was that exact unwavering sense of righteousness that convinced the chief of police that Reiji was a perfect fit for a top secret undercover mission. At first, it's all fun and games as he gets used to his new form, but then the novelty wears off and the hunger sets in. The team operates as a highly-stratified society, where the player's performance determines his annual salary. Natsunosuke is one of the highest paid players in the game. In the course of his duties, he strikes up a unlikely friendship with inmate Mitsuru Watase, a man sentenced to die for the revenge murder of the man who killed his parents, and slowly begins to wonder about the necessity of the death penalty and the meanings of concepts like repentance and forgiveness. Based on close and careful rese

(Source: ANN)

With a martial arts expert for a father and a mother with an enthusiasm streak you’ve rarely seen – their son Musashi is born to be super strong, fast, and trains harder than anyone – so how can he not become a champion?

Emiru has no knowledge of the social welfare system, and she struggles to carry out her work. She agonizes over whether she is suitable for her job or not. One day, a man who she is assigned to help commits suicide.

(Source: Asian Wiki)
genre: Award Winning, Drama, Slice of Life

title: Gekka no Kishi

description: One day, a young man named Himuro Shousuke shows up out of nowhere, claiming he wants to become a shogi master. When he is told that he must follow the appropriate channels to become a pro shogi player, he produces a recommendation from a highly respected master, Mikami Sankichi. Shousuke claims he trained with Sankichi in Kochi, and now he's ready to skip the early steps of becoming one of the elite. People are understandably skeptical, but Shousuke begins to beat the skilled players they match

Momoko Sugisaki works for the Little Snow Sick Child Care Service, providing in-home day care for sick children. She has a hard time making pleasant facial expressions, and she struggles with the question of when it's okay to break the rules if it's what the child needs. As she grows through her personal challenges, she is able to make a difference in the lives of the young children and parents who depend on her.

The aunt of Kumi, Michiko, was once a prima ballerina, and perhaps, the girl has inherited her talent…

He will inherit the property of the noble Oshikouji family, but prefers practising Kendou. He enters a school for training Kendou swordman, but the seniors of school are very harsh and intolerable.
