Tomo-kun, an office worker, is neighbors with Aki-san. Aki often comes over to Tomo's house to drink alcohol with him, but when she gets drunk her secret is revealed, she's actually... part cat! As Tomo-kun continues his life, other part-animal Oneesans will come to drink with him.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

"This is our competition!"

Two editors are fighting to get Inawashiro-sensei to finish his manga in time, but a possible romance sparks between the two editors. What will become of them?

title: Penguin Girl
author: Takahashi, Tetsuya
description:
Follow the adventures of Nankyoku Sakura, who seems to be obsessed with anime and manga. She started her first day at school wearing a school swimsuit, cat ears, and a maid tiara and called it her "pajamas." She's also insanely rich, apparently. 

(Source: MU)

title: Car Graffiti JK
author: Sakishima, Enoki
description:
After a bike accident lands her in the hospital for a month, it seems that Miki's high school debut has ended before it could even begin. With no other clubs to turn to, Miki and her best friend Haruka are invited to Risa's club room. However, they didn't anticipate the 2CV...

(Source: MU)

title: Mahou no Yama
author: Taniguchi, Jiro
description: Kenichi's father is dead and his mum is in hospital. Because of this situation, he will spend summer days staying with his little sister at their grand-parents house. Here he will have the opportunity to express his feelings for his parents and his true wish.

title: Kai to AlternaRock
author: Nako
description: Despite being an excellent office worker, Makino Akane’s serious personality has left her isolated in the company. Seo Makoto, a part time employee who also plays in an alternative rock band who isn’t afraid to talk to the standoffish Makino. This is the story of two office ladies, as they slowly grow closer.

title: The Girl Without a Face
author: Tearontaron
description:
Her boyfriend thinks she's the cutest girl around, but her expressions can be a bit hard to read... Despite the miscommunications, there's one thing that always comes across—their love for each other.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: I Was Human
author: Nakagawa, Yuukei, Kikonomi
description:
The year is 2222, yet there are no hover cars, time machines, or other much expected novelties of the future. That is, with the exception of the Soul Foundry; a colossal tower where a new medical practice takes place—the transplantation of souls between bodies.

title: Welcome home. I'm home. See you Tomorrow.
author: Momozuki, Suzu
description:
Souta is a part-time employee who has just moved into an old apartment and finds that his neighbor is a little out of the ordinary. Time here seems to flow with such slowness that he can feel so much happiness that we might die!

A love story between two neighbors.

title: Tomodachi Login
author: Itou, Nanami
description:
Chuunibyou girl Ayame-chan is enjoying a country life filled with nature with her simple and innocent friends! The delusions of Ayame-chan with regards to her friends, also explode! It seems she still haven't thrown 3D out of the window yet....

(Source: MU)

title: Horan

title: Akai Koi

description:
Hiroshi and Takuya have been childhood friends forever. When Takuya asks Hiroshi to be more than friends, will their friendship be able to withstand? Or have they always been soul mates?
(from B-U)
genre: Boys Love, Slice of Life, Erotica

title: Dracula's on the Night Shift
author: Wagahara, Satoshi, Asakusa, Tsukumo
description:
Vampires, who cannot be exposed to sunlight, have been able to integrate into modern society by only going out at night. Yura Toraki is a vampire who works the graveyard shift at a convenience store in Ikebukuro. One day, he happens to save a woman named Iris, who turns out to be a member of an order of vampire exterminators! Before he knows it, Yura is living in the same apartment as his should-be nemesis!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Travel
author: Yokoyama, Yuuichi
description:
In Yuichi Yokoyama's Travel, the storyline is as linear as it is sharp: it is the long, silent and crystalline description of a train ride undertaken by three men. Travel is a journey into the contemporary Japanese psyche—a brilliant, wordless graphic novel.

(Source: PictureBox)

title: Kyou, Curry!
author: Shimano, Yae
description:
Haruse Urara is a little girl who helps her papa with his curry shop. Traveling in the car that makes up his shop, they sell curry all around a small, supernaturally quirky island. Two teenage girls—the rambunctious and cheerful Subaru, and the shyer, less adventurous Yoriko—also work with Urara and her papa. Each day, they come up with new curry flavors and get to know the strange, friendly, and occasionally magical inhabitants of their tiny island!

(Source: MangaHelpers)

She's rescued from the brink of death by an elderly retired noblewoman who lets Margaret live at her mansion. What awaits her there is a stark contrast to her previous life: relaxed and laid-back countryside living! Sure, there's the whole fact that she was summoned to this world as a special being known as a Spirit Caller, but she couldn't care

20-year-old Michiru Amatsuki moved to Tokyo due to a change of career. She decided to live in a woman-only share house "Stella House Haruno" with people of different age and occupations. It's always fun when there's delicious alcohol and meal!!

However, Yuushi's tender age makes him doubt his place as a lover to this mature adult who never expresses his feelings… Fear, insecurity and jealousy will assail young and earnest Yuushi who chases after the years that separate him from the man he loves… But sometimes the most immature and desperately in love is not always the obvious one… 

(Source: MU)

In the world, people can be classified into three types: strong carnivores; middle carnivores and herbivores.

Somi Han is referred to as "Invisible girl." She befriends a fellow herbivore, Yujin Ko. However Somi Han feels that Yujin Ko is more like a tiger pretending to be a rabbit. Meanwhile, the entertainment industry is in an uproar with the appearance of a fanfiction writer called Foxstar. With incredibly detailed and accurate information about the personal lives of many of Korea's hottest

title: Shinyuu tte Soko made Shinakucha Ikenai no?

description: Takahashi Kento and Tanaka Issei have been friends since elementary school. When Issei learns that he has a disease that will cause his penis to shrink, he asks Kento to help slow the progression of the disease by massaging his prostate. At first, Kento is opposed to the idea, but after realizing that this is the only way to help his friend, he agrees.
genre: Boys Love, Comedy, Slice of Life

title: Souiu Toshigoro ni Nacchatta Toshi no Sa Shimai

Two sisters, with ten years separating them. Once close, they grew distant with time. As the younger sister enters high school, their relationship once again begins to change. This time in an unusual direction.

(Source: MangaDex)

A story about a tea house run by the childish British maid Shiori, together with three employees, the countryside girl Minae, Rich girl Mari, and the super-shy Anzu.

genre: Girls Love, Slice of Life, School

title: A Little Love Story
author: Sawa, Misono
description:
Nakamura Yukiko is a 13-year-old middle school student, who lives together with her mother and her big brother. Since her mother got a new job, her family has recently moved from a small village in the mountains to the local town. Yukiko, however, misses her friends from the village and has problems adapting to the fast-paced town life. Will she ever come to like her new home?

(Source: Batoto)

As Chiharu grows up, he becomes best friends with Satoshi, another child from the childcare center. However, when his first love is unrequited, how do things between Satoshi and him change?

Otome Danshi no Houkago Lesson (Girlis

A cat that seemed like a stray who had taken up residence on the battlefield, happily playing with an empty bullet cartridge like it was a toy. This is the story of one man and one animal living in a deadly battlefield, trying to make the days a little more lively.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Takao's homeroom teacher, Mr. Kanda, offers to comfort Yuki and suddenly kisses him, whispering, "I've been watching you all this time." Feeling sad and lost, Yuki lets Mr. Kanda make love to him... Kokura Hikari is a first-year high school girl who loves rifle shooting. She entered Chidori High School because it had a shooting club, but finds that the club had been disbanded. She had only one day to find enough members to reform the club, but luckily was able to find three other first-year girls who she had met at a competition in middle school.

Thus begins the daily activities of the Chidori High Shooting Club.

Will Kazuto be able to find the courage to confess his crush before Jun graduates college and stops frequenting the shop? Eliza, a young lady who is only interested in food, is brought a delicious gift by a delinquent named Misaki. She's scary... but she can't resist the allure of good food!

She soon discovers that he is in the same school as her, that his name is Ibuki and that he is a year older. Believing it's destiny, she tries to get closer to him but it turns out that he is hiding a secret...

Senmu no Inu contains six short stories that may especially appeal to readers with an appreciation for stories about relationships, character, and understanding other people. These are stories for thinking and feeling adults.

2. Meisou Kazoku Fire (The Astray 'F' Family)
3. Kimi ga Iru dake de (As Long as You Are Here)
4. Chanoma no Love Song (Living Room Love Song)
5. Oyaji Low Teen (Teen Papa)
6. Orei ni Kaete (As Way of Thanks)

title: Tounan Kadobeya Kare no Koi
author: Agata, Ito
description:
1-3, 7. Tounan Kadobeya Kare no Koi
4. 20-punkan no Himitsu
5. Mannequin wa Warawanai
6. Yopparai Mislead

title: My First Lost Love
author: Takagi, Ryo
description:
1. Hajimete no Shitsuren
2. Hajimete no Kokuhaku
3. Hajimete no Kenka
4. Hajimete no Kuchibiru
5. Hajimete no Otoko
6. Hajimete... ja Nai?

title: Sakura Device
author: Yoshitomi, Akihito
description:
Sakura Device is a harem-style comedy that revolves around a 14-year-old boy's daily life with his older sister and his childhood friend's sisters. The boy is trying to think about his future and become an upstanding adult, but the girls around him may or may not know this, and are always getting in his way.

(Source: ANN)

title: Mahou Onna ga Kuru
author: Hagio, Nobuto
description: Sakazaki Riko, age 31 and also known as Magic Girl Collie, is lonely. Ever since she was a child, she used her magical powers of being able to turn into an adult to help people and solve cases. It has been decades since she started and Riko is now 31 years old and single. The one magic power she had is now useless as she's already a grown up. Find out what happens to a witch after her prime who goes off to search for someone special.

title: Love Only You
author: Kanda, Neko
description:
"Can I just be near you - as a friend?"

But to Yuki friendship meant lots of unnecessary physical contact. Will Yamato be able to patiently endure all these seemingly casual touches?

Included one-shots: Deep Night Lover, Shitsukeraretai hodo Suki
genre: Boys Love, Comedy, Slice of Life

title: I Wish I Could Forget My Past Life: The Countryside I Dreamed of Living in Is Actually a Terrifyingly Dangerous Place! @comic
author: Oshima, Tsumugi, Hoshihata, Asahi

title: Shigeki-kei My Hero
author: Ryou
description:
Enter Hiroto Minase, the hero—or rather, Blue Knight—of the action TV series "Knights of the Holy War: Grand Knights." And he's feeling blue, alright. He just wants to get to know his stuntman, Takafumi Imagi, but all his attempts to invite him out for drinks have been declined without fail. One day, Minase spots Imagi out on the streets and runs after him—and into a gay bar?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
genre: Boys Love, Slice of Life, Erotica

title: Change the World
author: Yamaguchi, Izumi
description:
A tomboyish girl finally meets a boy who tells her to be what she wants to be, not what others see her as. 

(Source: Chibi Manga)

title: Kurayami no Shutter Speed
author: Hayakawa, Nojiko
description: It's been a while since these two appeared, but from the one they'll pass on the baton...

title: Papa and Daddy's Home Cooking
author: Toyota, Yuu
description:
Sengoku Akira, a chiropractor, knows nothing about raising a child but finds himself in just that position when an ex-girlfriend suddenly entrusts him with their daughter, Airi. Together with his friend Harumi Masahiro—a divorced manga editor with a young son of his own—Akira figures out that the first step to being a good single dad is...knowing how to make good food. How hard can it be?

(Source: MU)

title: Love and Nosebleed
author: Shiomi, Rose
description:
1-2, 6. Ai to Hanaji
3-5. Onaji Hikari wo Mitai to Negaeba
genre: Boys Love, Slice of Life, Erotica

title: Gokuchuu!
author: Konparu, Fujishima, Pepo
description:
After being caught by the police with illegal possession and commerce of "Hump", Haruno Urara was sentenced to 1 year in prison and now she will have to move to a new cell. Will she be able to make friends with her new inmates?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
genre: Comedy, Girls Love, Slice of Life

title: Yuushibu. - Yuusha ni Narenakatta Ore wa Shibushibu Shuushoku wo Ketsui Shimashita.
author: Sakyou, Jun, Yuzuki, Gao
description:
Raul could not become a Hero since the demon lord was already defeated just before his Hero exams came around. His dreams dashed, he now works at the magic shop Leon in the royal capital. One day, a young job-seeker shows up, looking for work. Now only if they weren't the child of the demon lord.

(Source: MU)

title: Katakoto no Niwa
author: Gori-man
description:
Alice is a transfer student from overseas and can't speak Japanese. Fujimura is a student who can't speak English. Because of the language barrier, Alice became isolated in the classroom, and Fujimura has become in charge of taking care of her. Is there a way for them to understand each other?

(Source: MU)

title: Mangaka-sensei to Zashiki Warashi
author: Nukku
description:
After moving in his new place, a mangaka is now pretending he can't see the Zashiki Warashi​ who was already living here.

(Source: MU)

title: Plant∞Plan
author: Yugi, Iro
description: Yuuya is sent seeds from his mother and he decides to plant them.

title: Tomodachi Ijou
author: Okazaki, Mari
description:
Life is hard enough as it is without the complcations love interests bring. However, it becomes even more complicated when the interest in question is a friend. How does one choose between what is right and what is wrong? The male friend you've always been with or the one that's recently come back?

This is a set of five short stories about the trials and tribulations of five different women.

(Source: Blue Flor)

title: Elfen Lied Tokubetsu-hen
author: Okamoto, Lynn
description: A special story included in the Elfen Lied Blu-ray Box.

title: Be Our Guest
author: Azuma, Yuki
description:
It covers the adventures of two teenagers, Karin and Reiji, as they try to run Karin's family restaurant when the only adult around, her mother gets sick and is unable to do the job. Both kids know how to cook but the boy, Reiji, is better and he doesn't let Karin forget it.

(Source: MangaFox)

title: Nostradamus Love
author: Fuyukawa, Tomoko
description:
Nostradamus prophesied that the world would end in the seventh month of 1999. Today is July 21, 1999. Ever since she was little, Maruyama Sakura has put her faith in this prophecy, and believed she will die at age 19. Consequently, nothing has seemed all that important to her. As the final days of her final month tick down, Sakura is whiling away the last of her time. Then Sakura meets Mori. She has ten days until the end of the world.

(Source: Kissmanga)

title: 4-koma Koushiki Anthology: Nagi no Asu kara
author: Tachi, Kitsune, Choukan, Mitsuki
description:
A 4-koma anthology of the Nagi no Asukara, chronicling the various situations that happen to Hikari, Manaka, Chisaki, Tsumugu, and Kaname.

(Source: MCAnime.net)

title: Tenjou no Shita ni Koi
author: Ichikawa, Ichi
description:
After spending most of his life residing in New York due to his parents' work, Yuito Kanzaki is moving back to Japan on his own. Unfortunately for Yuito, he has rather overbearing parents who also happen to be good friends with their boss. As a result, arrangements are put in place for him to move in with their boss' children.

The rather disorganized household that is to become Yuito’s new home consists of the four Ooji brothers—and is far from Yuito's ideal living situation. The eldest brother
genre: Boys Love, Slice of Life, Erotica

title: Sakazuki-san Chi no Gikyoudai
author: Saho
description:
Youichi's a gruff, taciturn boy who attends a school full of delinquents; Chikage is naive, friendly student of a prestigious academy. These two very different boys become stepbrothers and suddenly find themselves living under the same roof. This is a comedy about their day-to-day lives.

(Source: MU)

title: Gi(a)rlish Number
author: QP:flapper, Watari, Wataru
description: College student Chitose Karasuma is determined not to do boring things as she enters the adult world. To this end, this bad-mannered beauty barges into a facility that trains would-be voice actors and actresses, somehow landing a job at "Number One Produce," a seiyuu agency managed by her older brother, Gojou. In Chitose's mind, she's poised for greatness, but finds herself at a loss when she continues to only get minor roles. As she clashes with other girls in the agency, including a cunning ai

title: Silva.
author: Bakutendou
description: A happy-go-lucky girl named Silva wielding a scythe and claiming to be part of an evil organization transfers into a normal high school. She befriends her classmates, skirmishes with the heroes of justice, and helps to recruit new members into her organization. It's a comedy full of good and evil (which is which is sometimes difficult to tell), dubious magical girls, hopeless adults, and pudding.

title: Jigoku Koi Suchou
author: Oomiya, Miyami
description: Life in hell is like peaceful, ordinary life in some ways. The kids live in a place like a dorm, and they go to school. However, every person that has fallen into hell has some kind of punishment. Etou Juri falls constantly into hopeless love, sometimes even with inanimate objects. Hida Mari is compelled to always eat carrots, which she hates. Andou Natsumi is ridiculously popular, so that even the textbook problems are about him. Soon a newcomer joins them, Nakamura Mikoto, who frequently mangl

title: Love Buzz
author: Shimura, Takako
description:
Pro wrestler Fuji Kaoru disappeared one day during a match. Now five years later she shows up again at her old gym unnanounced, with her five-year-old daughter in tow. But not everyone is ready to welcome her back with open arms, especially her former best friend Yuri, whose anger and hurt at Kaoru's betrayal are far deeper than Kaoru ever imagined. 

(Source: M-U)
genre: Girls Love, Slice of Life, Erotica

title: Ms. Aoi is 16 Years Younger Than Me
author: Uruhiko

title: Mizu no Iro Gin no Tsuki
author: Yoshida, Motoi
description:
Mori, a cheerful playboy in his sixth year of college, has just fallen in love with a high school girl named Hoshi. From that starting point, Mizu no Iro Gin no Tsuki portrays the relationships among Mori's friends and acquaintances.

(Source: MU)

Note: Volume 1 contains work originally collected into a tankoubon entitled Mizu to Gin.

title: Koko wo Isekai to Suru!
author: Inaki, Tomohiro, Yatomi
description:
If there isn't an alternate universe, then we'll just make one! Yuudai Yatsusaka, an enlightened high schooler who lives by the motto: live life in moderation. Kotonoha Jougasaki, the eccentric girl who wants to be in an alternate universe. It seems like the meeting of these two polar opposites will cause a huge disturbance in Yuudai's mundane school life! It's a weird story of an Isekai club that establishes an alternate universe... ish!

(Source: MU)

title: Daishinyuu
author: Oshima, Towa
description:
The story will center on two junior high school girls who first met in elementary school. They do not get along or like each other whatsoever. Despite that, a bond strangely develops between them.

(Source: ANN)

title: Al to Neri to Sono Shuuhen
author: Ono, Natsume
description:
Alvin Dolce (nicknamed Al) is a self-proclaimed third-rate politician who is currently living together with his lover Neri. Things go well for the two until an impending campaign run urges Alvin away to Milano. Neri, uninterested in politics, turns down Alvin's invitation to join him there, and Alvin, distrusting Neri's loyalty in the relationship, takes off for Milano alone. Contains other stories about Al and about the boisterious and loveable people in his life.

(Source: Stiletto Heels)

title: I Bought a Mountain.
author: Endo, Tatsuya, Jitsukawa, Emu
description:
I'm Satsuki Mochizuki, 27 years old. After being unexpectedly dumped by my boyfriend, whom I thought I would marry, I tried solo camping and surprisingly found it quite enjoyable. In a twist of fate, I end up buying a mountain, only to discover it's an unexpected fantasy world. Now, I aim to escape from tent life and embark on a slow life in this otherworldly existence, prioritizing a tranquil lifestyle over romance.

(Source: Kakuyomu, translated)

title: Urban Cross
author: Kousaka, Akiho
description:
A short story about two lovers whose free times never seem to overlap... 

(Source: M-U)

title: Tamayura
author: Satou, Junichi, momo
description: Sawatari Fu, also known as Potte, recently moved to her late father's hometown and is restarting her life at her new school. She is typically nervous and shy but when it comes to photography, she is extremely passionate, especially since it makes her feel still connected to her dad. Fu becomes close friends with Kaoru, Norie and Maon and they spend the best times of their lives together.

title: Real Purple
author: Park, So-Hee
description:
This is the story of two siblings, Joo-won and Hee-won, and one man determined to take Hee-won's heart. Both of Joo-won and Hee-won feel isolated after their parents separate due to infidelity and remarry, placing both of them in new families. However, Hee-won's new step brother, In-hyuk, notices Hee-won's suffering. Is he determined to take care of her, or is there something more?

(Source: NOIR)

title: Golden Time Gaiden: Nijigen-kun Special
author: Komatsu, E-ji, Takemiya, Yuyuko
description: Nijigen is a freshman and Banri's friend. He gains his nickname at the tea ceremony club's welcoming party after declaring his despair of the three-dimensional world and that he would live for the two-dimensional world from then on. His nickname in high school was "Satoutaka".

title: Tsuki no Yoru
author: Taniguchi, Jiro
description:
14 pages short story which originally appeared in AERA COMIC'S "Nippon no Manga" anthology. To get anything else besides the pretty pictures out of this short story, one should have read Natsume Souseki's Sanshiro.

(Source: Manga-Sketchbook)

title: Atsui ze Pen-chan
author: Fukumoto, Nobuyuki
description: Watanabe Yuuichi, also known as Pen-chan, loves mahjong. It's just too bad that he's not very good at it. Follow Pen-chan's wins and losses (mostly losses) in a series of short tales about his friends, family, co-workers, and local yakuza until the final conclusion where Pen-chan makes the biggest gamble of his life...

title: Shio ga Mai Ko ga Mai
author: Abe, Tomomi
description: A comedy set in a seaside country town about a group of students in their second year of high school.

title: Chirori
author: Koyama, Aiko
description:
Set during the Meiji period, Chirori follows the titular attendant of a coffee shop in Yokohama. It’s a story about hard-working girls throughout the seasons.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Tonari no 801-chan
author: Kojima, Ajiko
description:
Tonari no 801-chan is narrated by Tibet, a twenty-eight-year-old company employee and boyfriend to Yaoi, who also works in a company. Yaoi is a twenty-two-year-old fujoshi, a female otaku who is a fan of anime and manga series featuring yaoi, or romantic relationships between men. Tibet, who is an otaku himself, initially met Yaoi over the Internet. When she obsesses over yaoi, a small green furry monster comes out of a zipper from her back as the manifestation of her obsession.

(Source: MU)

title: Dekoboko Girlish
author: Hara, Ayumi
description:
At a glance, Oriko Amano is a cool, handsome male university student, whilst on the other hand, Natsuo Koike is small and childlike in appearance. However, the truth is that Oriko is actually a girl, and they are both twenty years old!

Dekoboko Girlish is a 4-koma that follows the daily lives of Oriko, Natsuo and the other members of their university's classical theatre group.

(Source: MU)

title: Are Physical Relationships Possible between Childhood Friends of High School Students?
author: Konya, Yukio

title: Sumikko no Sora-san
author: Tana, Kanoka
description:
This follows the story of a boy who has returned to his family's home in the country after failing to make his dreams come true. He thinks his way through his predicament with the company of his pet turtle, Platon. More complications arise in the form of a neighborhood kid Sora, who has, for some reason, decided that he is God.

(Source: MU)

title: Mizu to Gin
author: Yoshida, Motoi
description:
A man sees a girl with a raincoat on one day while he was playing his guitar in the streets. Later on the man meets the girl on the streets and he takes her home.

All the chapters contains the same characters, but each chapter focuses on a different set of characters.

(Source: MU)

title: Kouen
author: Otomo, Katsuhiro
description:
Social misfits On, Hanaken and Shinta spend an afternoon in the park shooting the breeze. As they wonder what direction life will take them, a chance encounter with an older generation leads to confrontation.

(Source: MU)

title: Welcome to Cafe Griefseed!
author: Hina, Kotori, Magica Quartet
description:
Showcasing delicious sweets and a colorful atmosphere, Café Grief Seed welcomes a variety of patrons through its doors. On a whim, Madoka Kaname and her friend Sayaka Miki visit the restaurant after seeing it being featured in a magazine. They quickly befriend the three employees of the establishment and eventually become interested in working at the café.

Seizing the opportunity, the apathetic store manager Kyuubey extends a job offer to Madoka and Sayaka, believing that their hiring will impr

title: Danshi Koukousei wa Kyou mo Onaka ga Suiteiru
author: Hanatsuka, Shiori
description:
High school boys are pretty active, whether at school or during their leisure time, so it's no wonder they're always hungry! And what better way to deal with it than to learn how to cook for themselves so they can eat whatever they want, whenever they want?

(Source: MU)

title: Past Heaven
author: Hanatsu, Yaya
description: Yuu visits her friend Ayumu's home for the first time and learns that she lives alone. What follows is a story of holding on to the past and learning to move forward.

title: Furin Shokudou
author: Yamaguchi, Masakazu
description:
The manga centers on 35-year-old businessman Ryuuichi Yamadera. Ryuuichi travels around the country on business trips, and his sole entertainment is trying different foods at local restaurants. He also ends up sleeping with the various married women he meets at the restaurants, while also being married himself.

(Source: ANN)

title: My Father Is a Unicorn
author: Suzuki, Monaka
description:
Uno Issei is still in high school when his mother remarries. His mom's new husband, Masaru, is a nice enough guy, he just happens to be a unicorn. Sometimes in the form of a talking horse, sometimes in the form of a beautiful man, Masaru is determined to run the household while his wife is away and win Issei over. For better or worse, now Issei is stuck teaching this unicorn man how to be a good dad in this idiosyncratic comedy about the magic of family.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Suki desu, Zenbu Kudasai
author: Suyama, Torico
description:
Two old friends meet after long separation. Maruyama asks Osawa for a favor and he agrees but with certain conditions...

Included one-shot:
Hanbun wa Anata ni

title: Is Kichijoji the Only Place to Live?
author: Maki, Hirochi
description:
Story centers on twin sisters Miyako and Tomiko Shigeta, who work as real estate agents in the Kichijouji neighborhood in Tokyo, an area that is consistently ranked #1 as the place where those already living in Tokyo want to live. The sisters assist women searching for an apartment, but direct them to neighborhoods in Tokyo aside from Kichijouji. The story follows the worries of new clients as they move, and showcases the charm of Tokyo neighborhoods.

(Source: ANN)

title: Gold Pollen and Other Stories
author: Hayashi, Seiichi
description: Seiichi Hayashi (b. 1945) was a leading figure in Tokyo's hotbed of avant-garde artistic production in the 1960s and '70s. He is best known for his lyrical and experimental manga for Garo, the famous alternative comics magazine. The present volume collects a handful of Hayashi’s most important manga from this period, including “Red Dragonfly” (1968), “Yamauba’s Lullaby (1968), and “Gold Pollen” (1971). Published here in their original full color, these stories mix traditional Japanese aesthetics

title: Yuzu no Koto
author: Arai, Shou
description:
People tend to look different when they return to school following a summer break. This is especially true for Ichigo's best friend, Yuzuki—who is now attending school as a boy. Shocked and utterly confused, Ichigo struggles to process why "Yuzu" decided to change his gender. Meanwhile, Yuzu has to deal with the new attention that is not always kind to him. Navigating this situation may be difficult, but there is no challenge these two friends cannot overcome.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Times Two
author: Akira, Shouko
description:
When you\'re in love, life feels like it\'s multiplied times two! These five short stores of budding high school romance explore the confusing emotions that arise in the first tentative phases of love.

Love at First Touch: Love is in the air at Filed Day, and Eri can\'t figure out what draws her to Kohei

Expiration Date 2001: Miwa\'s secret crush Kenta gives her a soda, and she decides that the date on the bottom of the can must be symbolic. Could this love taste sweet , or will it go sour?

S

title: Pan de Peace!
author: emily
description:
The "cute and soft bread four-panel manga" centers around Minami, an airheaded girl who is starting high school and who loves eating bread for breakfast. Baked goods bring happiness everyday to her and her classmates the reliable Yuu, the pastry-baking Fuyumi, and the independent Noa.

(Source: ANN)

title: Sayonara, Otokonoko
author: Shimura, Takako
description:
One day, 25-year-old Hajima Kanade wakes up to find himself in a child's body. While his live-in lover Kawata Yuuki freaks out, Kanade tries to take it as calmly as possible. Before they are able to figure out what to do, Yuuki's younger brother knocks on their door. Will Kanade be able to keep his cool?

(Source: MU)
genre: Boys Love, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: Rakka Ryuusui
author: Sanada, Ikki
description:
After learning that she had passed the entrance examinations to enter the Sakuraba Girl's High School, Hayama Akiho, while attempting to escape from club recruitment staff, experiences love at first sight when she meets the president of the kyuudou club, Hokaze Minatsu...

Rakka Ryuusui is a 4-koma yuri comedy, and the setting is that of the kyuudou club in the school and its members.

(Source: MU)
genre: Comedy, Girls Love, Slice of Life

title: Washio Sumi wa Yuusha de Aru
author: Takahiro, Mottsun*
description: In the year 298 from the era of the gods, elementary school girls Sumi Washio, Sonoko Nogi, and Gin Minowa are tasked with an important mission. They are to become heroes and fight Vertex, a mysterious enemy that is attacking Shinju-sama, the god tree that protects Shikoku, the only area in the world that is still habitable. What they don't know, is that this fight will cost them more than they could have ever imagined.

title: Gin no Kutsu
author: Shinomiya, Shino
description: This is the story of Jun, a six-year-old boy. Life, from the point of view of a little rascal with two loving dads and a pair of adorable friends.

title: Porno of Yankees
author: Fujimura, Ayao
description:
1-4. Yankees Porno
5. Shitagau hodo ni
6. Kanjiru hodo ni
7. Hibiku hodo ni

Note: Story 5 was collected in b-Boy Shachiku.
genre: Boys Love, Slice of Life, Erotica

title: Two Smiling Faces
author: Aoki, Ume
description:
A short one-shot about a girl who catches a strange disease, and her boyfriend's worrying about it. 

(Source: M-U)

title: Preferably My Prince
author: Lee, Sang-Eun
description:
Woo-jin is headed home for a memorial service. Da-hong is searching the countryside for someone she used to know. Their paths cross when Woo-jin ruins Da-hong's fruit basket (which she had bought as a gift) by accident, and ends up taking her to her destination in his car as an apology. Unexpectedly, the place Da-hong has been searching for is Woo-jin's own home?! What is their relationship to each other...?

(Source: Springtime Scans)

title: Yet Again Girls Comedy
author: Horoda
description:
After spending nearly a year as a shut-in, Koto enters the first year of high school for the second time. Together with fellow repeating students Shiki and Tomoe as well as reserve army cadet Kaede, Koto's experience of school life is rather different from the norm but delightful in its own way.

(Source: MU)

title: Gad Sfortunato
author: Ono, Natsume
description:
What is being sought after cannot be felt even on the fingertips. This is a series about the extravagant lifestyle of a tattoo artist named Gad, and the circle of people who revolve in it.

(Source: Stiletto Heels)
genre: Boys Love, Slice of Life, Erotica

title: Dullahan-chan wa Kubittake
author: Kimura, Mitsuhiro
description:
I'm Dullahan Itoshino, a normal girl who can take her head off. From today onward I'll be a middle schooler! I hope I'll get closer to my destined one; but sometimes my heart suddenly beats faster, I want to run away, and my body and mind feel torn apart... is this the thing called "puberty," I wonder?

Heart (head) and body apart, a story about puberty and love begins!

(Source: MU)

title: The Other Side of the Window
author: Aoki, Ume
description:
Kei Sonofuji is trying to get a new start by changing her image before getting into high school. But just as it seems everything is going to go well, she gets sick and has to miss the first week. Just as she thinks she's missed out on everything, she gets a surprise from one of her classmates!

(Source: MU)

title: Kawasemi-san no Tsuri Gohan
author: Masanoshita, Kiyomasa
description:
High school student Kawasemi has transferred to the countryside, spending her days alone due to her shyness. One day, she is approached by her classmate Misago, a so-called "countryside Yankee," and is taken to the mountains. Kawasemi is afraid of what she would do, but then MIsago starts fishing?

(Source: MU)

title: Shiba Occhan
author: Nekomaki
description: A story about Shiba Occhan (Uncle Shiba). Men who become like dogs after marriage.

title: Futoukou no Nichijou
author: Kuon, Makoto
description: Saotome Amane is in her second year of high school, and again she's happily skipping school! She loves her internet, games, and anime—your run-of-the-mill shut-in. But she's different to the average NEET, being a 16-year-old schoolgirl makes her superior! ...At least that's what she thinks.

title: Watashibito
author: Matsukawa, Nao
description:
A consciousness jumping from person to person every night leads the lives of its hosts for one day at a time.

(Source: MU)

title: Hakka Shoujo
author: Miura, Yasuto
description:
Fumi Koito used to be raised by an old housekeeper named Hatoko Natsuyaki. He would call her "Peppermint Nanny" because she would eat all his leftover peppermint candy drops—which he hates to eat—then breathe into his nose because he likes the smell.

Now Fumi is in his mid-20's and living on his own as a cram school teacher. One day a little girl no more than nine years old shows up at his house. It turns out she is his old nanny who misses cooking and tending to his every need but because she

title: Ken-chan to Neko. Tokidoki Ahiru
author: Nekomaki
description:
Little stories about a boy named Ken and his daily life in 1976 with his stay-at-home mother, working father, cat Momo... and sometimes a duck.

(Source: Lovely Strange Dark)

title: Toshishita no Senpai-chan ni wa, Maketakunai.
author: Nametake
description:
The story of an ordinary college student's interactions with his senpai at work, who happens to be in high school.

(Source: MU)

title: Kanon: Another Story - Wonderthree
author: Key, Kijima, Renga
description:
An alternate retelling of Key's classic work, Kanon, where it asks: what if Yuuichi didn't lose all his memories of 7 years before? And what if he was really a sarcastic freak? And what if it had really bad artwork? Do not read if you don't know the original story behind Kanon.

(Source: SCX-Scans)

title: Bungo Stray Dogs Official Comic Anthology: Kanade
author: Sora, Kakeru, Sakura, Roku, Kanai, Neco, Adachi, Imaru, otakumi, Obata, Tsunechika, Barako, Hatsuse, Shiro, Tsuchida
description: Official anthology featuring Bungou Stray Dogs characters by various mangaka.

title: Kimi ni Chiisana Uso Hitotsu
author: Yoshioka, Ririko
description:
Chise and Akari are twins. They are so identical in appearance that people around them cannot tell them apart except for their parents and their childhood friend, Mayuki. The two sisters however, have their own personalities. Chise is shy and timid, making her unapproachable; Akari in contrast, is energetic and expressive, making her popular amongst boys in their school. But since they are so identical, boys often confess to Chise by mistaking her as Akari.

Akari doesn't show interest in the bo

title: Ore wa Busamen: Nekotsuzuri
author: Yukue, Moegi
description:
Busamen is a stray cat who's ugly and loves women, but inside is cool and handsome(!?) On the other hand there's Ikemen, a prideful and beautiful cat (but he's cowardly). Which one will be the most popular among pretty women? Watch their fight unfold!

(Source: Ikemen Scans)

title: Ano Yoru no Pool
author: Pukupuku
description: A social outcast finds human connection in a classmate who's also different.

title: The Love of Calendula
author: Natsuno, Hiroko
description:
Even though Chihiro is Shuuto's cousin, his neighbor, and a guy, Shuuto has had feelings for him for five years. Shuuto knows nothing good could come from these feelings. That doesn't stop Shuuto from kissing his cousin...and touching himself. When Chihiro catches Shuuto kissing him, Shuuto soon realize his unrequited love might still have hope.

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)
genre: Boys Love, Drama, Slice of Life

title: Maou no Koi, Mamanaranu.
author: Tirori
description:
Entering high school, Fujimura Kotone dreams of making friends and finding love. However, her classmates avoid her because of her scary demeanor. One day, a group made up of two girls and a boy come into her class and kneel before her, proclaiming, "It's an honor to meet you, Demon Lord!". With their antics, will she be able to obtain the normal love life she desires?

A reincarnation romantic comedy that transcends space and time!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: One more time One more chance
author: Sakisaka, Mea
description:
Ao has fallen in love with the new teacher Hayato. But before this love can start, an unexpected cruel fate is awaiting her...

(Source: Chibi Manga Scans)

title: Shiki wo Taberu Onna
author: Ooi, Masakazu
description: A story of photography, motorcycles, travel and food.

title: The Rip-Off Izakaya
author: Shiwasuda, Akikawa, Takimi
description:
Snuggled in a friendly traditional commercial and working-class neighborhoods of Tokyo is the izakaya pub, "Bottakuri." In this special restaurant with an ill-fitting name, one can find tasty sake and delicious food, as well as the sort of empathy and respect that's hard to find these days...

(Source: AlphaPolis)

title: Minori & 100 Ladies
author: Fujisawa, Kamiya
description:
Minori Sakura is just a very average girl. Yet despite being the only commoner in her school, could it be that she's actually become popular among the young ladies she so admired...!?

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Not Love But Delicious Foods Make Me So Happy
author: Yoshinaga, Fumi
description: There is a Japanese saying that goes, "Hana yori dango," or "dumplings over flowers." And no one is more of an advocate of this adage than mangaka Y-naga, a woman whose life revolves around her intense work and equally intense sleep schedule. The only thing that can rouse her out of this infernal cycle of deadlines and being dead to the world? Food. As Y-naga and her friends visit restaurants around Tokyo to satisfy their appetites, their individual approaches to food add an extra dimension to t

title: Here She Is, the Saint in Japan.
author: Shuu, Shinae, Mana
description:
She was supposed to have been summoned as a saintess, but was thrown into a country called Japan. Rei Natsukawa, a.k.a. Alexandra Ollier, hides her magic power as she works for a small company in modern Japan. She says that she'll be happy with a peaceful and uneventful life, but several small obstacles stand in the way of her lifestyle. This is the ordinary, yet not-so-ordinary story of a powerful mage.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)
genre: Slice of Life, Supernatural, Adult Cast

title: Aosora
author: Raiku, Makoto
description:
The story starts with three friends, they all do art together, trying their hardest, but as the story progresses, the narrator begins to think that life isn't worth it and he doesn't need to try hard anymore. 

(Source: MU)

title: Sayounara Minasan
author: Nishimura, Tsuchika
description: A woman gets fired from her job after refusing to go on a date with her boss.

title: Adachi to Shimamura: Koushiki Comic Anthology
author: majoccoid, Mizusaki, Hiroaki, Kumo, Suzume, Arima, Yoshikita, Popuri, Yuino, Chiri, Yuzuhara, Moke
description: An anthology comic of Adachi to Shimamura by various mangaka.

title: Fullmetal Knights Chevalion
author: Arashida, Sawako
description:
When the Fullmetal Knights Chevalion defeated the Death Universe, peace returned and the Chevalion members returned to their normal daily lives. Well, except for their leader, Retto. For some reason his suit won't come off. So he's stuck as Chevalion Red, and he has problems controlling his powers.

(Source: DDProgress)

title: Kami no Toride
author: Tezuka, Osamu
description:
1. Gachaboy Ichidaiki (Gachaboy's Record of One Generation)
2. Kami no Toride
3. Sukippara no Blues
4. Tokiwasou Monogatari
5. Toiu Tegami ga Kita
6. Doubutsu Tsurezuregusa (Essay on Idleness of Animals)
7. Dotsuitare (Bassui)

title: Fallen Words
author: Tatsumi, Yoshihiro
description:
In Fallen Words, Yoshihiro Tatsumi takes up the oral tradition of rakugo and breathes new life into it by shifting the format from spoken word to manga. Each of the eight stories in the collection is lifted from the Edo-era Japanese storytelling form. As Tatsumi notes in the afterword, the world of rakugo, filled with mystery, emotion, revenge, hope, and, of course, love, overlaps perfectly with the world of Gekiga that he has spent the better part of his life developing.

These slice-of-life st

title: Chi's Sweet Adventures
author: Konami, Kanata, Natsume, Kinoko
description: Full-color web series based on the 2016 anime Koneko no Chi: Ponponra Daibouken.

title: Mitakihara Youchien Mahou-gumi
author: linco, Magica Quartet
description: Upon escaping into a parallel world, Homura Akemi discovers that she has become a kindergarten student! The differences do not stop there: at Mitakihara Kindergarten, Mami Tomoe is a teacher; Madoka Kaname is another kindergarten student; and Kyuubey is the principal of the school. Despite the bizarre changes in this world, Homura believes this is a rare opportunity to finally make intimate memories with her close friend. But with frequent unexpected signs threatening to lead her astray, Homura

title: Pure Marionation
author: Takagi, Nobuyuki
description: Pure Marionation is the story of Anon, a "marionette" or android cute girl. Ostensibly, she is enrolled in Waffle High (no, seriously, that's the name) to test out her AI, codenamed ALIS. Immediately, Anon's secret is discovered by classmate Miamo, who is sworn to secrecy and determines to protect Anon from...I'm not sure what. (Source: Ozaku)

title: Touken Ranbu: Hanamaru
author: Hashino, Saru
description: The year is 2205. The "historical revisionists" have begun attacks on the past in their plot to change history. The Saniwa, who have been charged with protecting history, can imbue life into objects. Strongest among these are the Touken Danshi. The story centers around their cheerful lives.

title: Rokuhou-dou Yotsuirobiyori
author: Shimizu, Yuu
description:
At the popular Japanese-style tea house Rokuhoudou, customers can count on receiving not only excellent food and drink, but—if they wish for it—a helping hand in solving any problem that may be plaguing them. Serving in Rokuhoudou are four men who are consummate professionals in their individual fields: tea expert Sui, latte artist Gure, pâtissier Tsubaki and chef Tokitaka.

(Source: MU)

title: Papa Sex Caraméliser
author: Kusabi, Keri
description:
With his armful of secrets, Kurisu was busy with work and childcare, but when he met the good-looking patisserie, Niina...!?

(Source: Exiled Rebels Scanlations)
genre: Boys Love, Slice of Life, Erotica

title: Aki
author: Oosaki, Mitsuru, Nikaido, Aki
description:
Mahjong is all Nikaido Aki knew growing up. With her parents operating a Mahjong shop where people would gather to play the game, it served as a good time for Aki, her older sister Rumi and their family. But when their mother leaves them out of the blue, their father is forced to close the shop and he leaves Aki and Rumi with relatives. With no real goal in life and not even sure if she wants to continue on to high school, Aki has to figure out what she wants out of her life.

(Source: MangaHelp
genre: Slice of Life, Memoir, Strategy Game

title: Cat Funeral
author: Hongjacga
description: An ex-couple meets again for a single day after a year to bury the boyfriend's cat. A short story.

title: Idol no Akahon
author: Ujiie, Tozen
description: Due to some miscommunication, three girls were recruited to become idols instead of one. As a result, the company decided to make them a group.

title: Mako, Rumi and Chi
author: Tezuka, Osamu
description:
This Manga deals with parenting, depicting the daily lives of cartoonist Ohsamu Tetsuro, who strongly resembles Tezuka Osamu himself, and his family.
The story begins with the birth of his first son. The son is named Makoto (nicknamed Mako) and grows to be a healthy 2 year-old, basking in the love of his orderly mother and careless father. The son is followed by two daughters named Rumiko (nicknamed Rumi) and Chiiko (nicknamed Chii). This story focuses on the increasing hustle and bustle inside

title: Parallel Universe Kitchen
author: Okome, Gohan, Katsura, Ichiho
description:
Touya Asayama, a registered dietician, is suddenly sent to another world with his little sister Momoka. They stumble across a restaurant specializing in healthy food, but it ends up that the people of this world believe that food can't be healthy and taste good at the same time. Armed with his knowledge as a dietician, Touya begins working at the restaurant in hopes of changing the world's view of food and healthy eating.

[Written by Denji]

title: Over Flow
author: Inoue, Kiyoshirou
description:
A collection of stories which each highlight four young women on separate journies of sexual degradation and submission. Some accept it and become willing participants while some break from the experience both spiritually and mentally.

1-2. Kotone
3-5. M
6. Ryoujoku
7. Sorrowful Flower
8-10. Give and Take

title: Tsuzuki wa Mata Ashita
author: Konno, Kita
description:
Haruka and Saya spend their days living peacefully with their father in a small town. However, when a new neighbor moves in, unusual events suddenly start taking place. Strangely enough, they all seem to be related to Haruka and Saya's mother who passed away some time ago...

(Source: Bliss)

Included one-shots:
Volume 4: Li'l Flowers, Li'l Flowers: Tiny Tiny Girl

author: Yukue, Moegi

1-2. Teruteru Bouzu Tere Bouzu
3. Heiten Chokugo
4-6. Motto Kikasete Sono Koe de
genre: Boys Love, Slice of Life, Erotica

title: Kimi no Uta ga Aru
author: Ikuemi, Ryou
description:
After a very public (and humiliating) break-up with her last boyfriend, things couldn't get any worse for 18 year old Emiko. Things start looking up however, when a good-looking guy stops her in the middle of the street to offer her tickets to an upcoming rock concert.

As it turns out, he's just one of three brothers from the Kanita family: Gaku - 18, Youji - 19, and Masaki - 23. A chance encounter with his older brother, Youji, leads to a whirlwind romance. He's impulsive, hot-headed, and even

title: Wasureru
author: Asahi, Yuki
description:
Fukano-kun, a middle school student, has trouble remembering things; however, there is one thing that he can really remember.

(Source: MU)

title: Houkago Nijigenme!
author: Gotou, Yuki
genre: Comedy, Girls Love, Slice of Life

title: Last 10 Millimeters
author: Matsuzaki, Miyuki
description: A girl who Sai accidentally met on a bus drops her lipstick after getting of. Sai then decides to return it to her.
genre: Girls Love, Slice of Life, School

title: Michikusa

description:
1. Michikusa (Lingering On The Way)
2. Choukousoku! Lost Virgin!!
3. Teimou Choutokkyu!!
4. Kiss kara Hajimeru Et cetera
5. Tsukiyo no Hanataba
6. Meguriai... Cosmo: Ai wa Kagerou no You ni
genre: Boys Love, Comedy, Slice of Life

title: Gakuen Heaven: Revolution
author: Higuri, You
description: Itou Keita is a boy with no remarkable talents beyond his better-than-average luck, until one day he receives an acceptance letter out of the blue inviting him to attend the prestigious all-boys academy, Bell Liberty School (BL School). Why has he been admitted to this amazing academy, and how can he possibly live up to the expectations of whoever let him in? As he settles in to his new life, Keita is sure to find companionship in his rather eclectic cast of schoolmates.

title: Glamorous Gathering Takahashi
author: Takahashi, Hirona
description:
1. Glamorous Suteyama
2. Tsumeato ni Ai wo Komete (Scars Full of Love)
3. Hajimete no Seisai (My First Planet)
4. ShiraMari
5. Seigi no Akatsuki (Dawn of Justice)
6-21. Game shita tte Ii jan (It’s Okay to Play Games, Right?)
22. Koi wa Komaku kara (Love Coming from the Eardrums)
23. Rui-chan no Henshin (Rui-chan's Transformation)
24. Parlor Aosaka (Aosaka Parlor)
25. Yuhime Densetsu (The Legend of Yuhime)

title: Nemurenai
author: Fiok, Lee
description: What does your brain conjure up when you're sleepless at night?

title: Youjo Musou: Nakama ni Uragirareta Shoukanshi, Mazoku no Youjo ni Natte "Eirei Shoukan" de Dekiai Slow Life wo Okuru
author: Yoshioka, Sakaki, yocco

title: Strawberry in Soda Water
author: Arai, Cherry
description:
Mannenrou Ladies' Academy is famous for its upper class and posh students. Despite knowing how out-of-place she'd be, the former yankee, Hanaizumi Luna, decides to enroll there. Moreover, according to her underling: "Girls' schools means yuri!! Add in school dormitories? Now that's a world of girl on girl action!!"

And with those words in mind, Luna's new school life begins with a rough start.

And how exactly will her relationship develop with her socially inept roommate, Miyota Kohime...?
genre: Comedy, Girls Love, Slice of Life

title: Tsuyuki-san wa Furaretenai
author: Pikorasu
description:
Tsyuki-san, a girl who can't be honest , and Imao-kun, an extremely honest boy. Tsuyuki-san hasn't been rejected... She absolutely hasn't been rejected...!

(Source: Seikaisha, translated)

title: Super Ball Girls
author: Hiramoto, Akira, Kaneshiro, Muneyuki
description:
Ichiyoshi is tired of his boring life working at the chocolate factory and keeping his greatest desires close to his chest. While walking home on Christmas night, he catches a mysterious Super Ball bouncing out of the darkness. He throws it as hard as he can... and an impossibly beautiful woman appears before him?!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: After-School Bitchcraft
author: Shimizu, Yuu, Ichihara, Kazuma
description:
Ririka Kirise's a style-savvy high school girl who's struggling to keep up in her chemistry class. Looking for some extra help, she opens the door to her teacher's office—breaking his magic barrier in the process! Unbeknownst to Ririka, Renji is actually a sorcerer...and Ririka has the makings of a sorceress herself. Before she knows it, she's wrapped up in the world of witchcraft as Renji's apprentice—and getting into some sticky situations...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Kunoichi no Ichi!
author: Kanazawa, Shinnosuke
description: On a school trip to shinobi-themed Ninjatown, a young man named Ichi Kuno accidentally springs a mystical ninja trap which sends him back to the Age of the Ninja. Having no other path, he must pose as a girl and infiltrate an Kurenai Academy, a school of kunoichi students, to retrieve a mystical scroll that can return him to the future. But when everyone around him is already far better at stealth and infiltration than he could ever imagine being, it's not going to be easy. He'll need to employ

title: Kankin Ou
author: Ashimoto☆Yoika, Masai
description:
A girl who calls herself a devil appeared before a timid student named Fumio Kijima. The girl claims to be a campaign girl from the demon world and she gives him the ability to "summon a room" from nothing but thin air.

At first he doesn't abuse his power and uses it as a convenient ability in his everyday life. But one day he is bullied by his classmates under an unfair pretext and is made to suffer. In the past he would have wallowed in misery and cried himself to sleep, but now he had a powe

title: 6-nin no Shinanai Shoujo to Kanarazu Shinu Unmei no Hito
author: Nakamura, Moto, Nakamura, Nakachi

title: Pink de Pink
author: Azuma, Tesshin
description:
Sanada Akihito, a student from Yotsuho Academy has been haunted by the angry spirit of a dead girl. In the exorcism that a friend was trying to do, the spirit manages to possess a girl from Akihito’s class and now that she has a body, she has worldly desires to satisfy, and Akihito just looks like her previous boyfriend!

(Source: Animexis)

title: Dead Heads
author: Nihei, Tsutomu
description:
First issue of a canceled series; collected (in thumbnails) in Blame and So on (Artbook)

(Source: MU)

title: Bite into Me
author: Mahiru, Teku
description:
Akkun has finally gotten into his dream high school. He can't help but attribute his success to the only teacher who supported him, Chizuru-san. When Akkun visits her to say thanks, he discovers that the doting and beautiful Chizuru-san is no longer a teacher, but is now living the life of a recluse. And after witnessing her lust for blood, he finds out she's a vampire, too!

(Source: Comikey Media)

title: My Wife Is an Oni
author: Yamato, Nadeshiko
description:
His wife is a real demon, literally! Tomoyuki is married to Mitsuki, an Oni from the countryside who can be a bit harsh. But when she and Tomoyuki are alone, that's when her sensitive side comes out. It's those moments that she wants to express just how much she loves Tomoyuki. Dive into the charming slice-of-life of a tsundere Oni and her normal husband!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Out Comes the Devil. Out Comes the Snake.
author: Advenchara
description:
When our hero, Matsubara Yuu, suddenly finds himself moving back to his mother's home, a number of strange things happen to him. He meets Suzu, a beautiful girl who falls in love with him at once, even wanting to have his children. Even if he wanted to run away from the situation, his way was blocked by a huge cow attacking him. In fact, in all of these, he seems to be the cause...

(Source: rpapo)

title: Satan's Secretary
author: Kamonabe, Kamotsu
description:
The Demon King is awake at last and hellbent on world domination—but first he needs a secretary. He finds a human to organize his devilish plot, and she's perfect for the job. So perfect, in fact, that she's steadily losing her grip on her humanity. Thanks to her smarts, super skills, and secretarial wiles, it's only a matter of time before the Demon King's destructive dreams come true!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: In the Heavenly Prison, the Devil Enchants Me
author: Gingami, Meteor
description:
Kaoru Shabana's been coddled his whole life and yearns to remake himself into a splendid grown-up—a true man among men. Seeking a fresh start at achieving independence, he enrolls in a prestigious academy on a remote island. There, he meets Kanra, a tantalizingly tall young woman, who reveals that the school of his dreams is actually a nest of succubi! Reduced to little more than a devil's plaything, can Kaoru escape from this heavenly prison before he's sucked dry?!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Yumekuri
author: Hiro
description:
Yugami Makoto likes to travel to different Hot Springs. On his 100th visit to a Hot Spring he meets a beautiful foreign girl in the bath. Stunned by her beauty, he immediately falls for her. But there is more to the girl than meets the eye. And why is Makoto forced to work at the Inn afterwards?

(Source: MU)

title: Doukyonin ga Kono Yo no Mon ja Nai
author: Nakamura, Enjitsu
description:
The young man's new apartment is haunted, but as it turns out, even the dead have their own personal shortcomings... issues of the flesh included. For the dead have lingering desires, and are more susceptible to the world of the living than what one may think. There's anger, there's hate, there's curiosity... and there's love too. Here he finds a ghastly girl who observes him quietly, certainly desiring something... No wonder the rent is cheap!

(Source: MU)

title: Inugami-hime no Shimobe
author: Mizusawa, Michiru
description:
Inuzuka Taroumaru is a first year high school student who looks like a delinquent. One evening, while he's at his part-time job, he ends up with a white-feathered arrow through his head! He's told that this arrow means he has been chosen as the sacrifice for "Inugami-hime," who lives on top of the nearby mountain. However, this mysterious "Inugami-hime" turns out to be a cute girl who has chosen him to be her servant, not her sacrifice. Their life together is just beginning!

(Source: MangaHelpe

title: Oneechan wa Koi Youkai
author: Aoshima, Kanae
description:
Yuuki Kuwahara decided use entering high school as a chance to live on his own at his father's family home. He went by himself, with the faint hope that he might see the girl who he met there when he was a kid. But an unexpected welcome was waiting for him in the house that was supposed to be empty!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Danshi Koukousei dakedo Gal ni TS Shimashita
author: Taiyou, Marii
description:
Shunpei, a loner high schooler, became a gyaru after saving the god of gyaru from drowning. Through his mother's connections, he was able to transfer to an all-girls school, but it was stuffed to the brim with gyarus! Every day is a sensory overload for Shunpei, who's never even talked to a girl, let alone a gyaru. It's the beginning of an introverted high school guy => gender-swapped gyaru comedy!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Ishuzoku Joshi ni ○○ suru Hanashi
author: Suimin
description:
The only human student at an all-girl school is on a mission to sexually harass each of the monster girls.

(Source: Mangadex)

title: Deatte Hitotsuki de Zecchou Jorei! @comic
author: Yuzuki N', Akagi, Hirotaka
description:
Climaxing exorcism—a good-for-nothing, indecent, and obscene ability to force a struck opponent to be purified and ascend by making them orgasm. In this world where evil spirits and monsters are common and the profession of exorcist exists, the ones who show promise study at the famous Taima Academy.

Enter Haruhisa Furuya, a user of the cursed climaxing exorcism and Misaki Souya, a girl with an evil eye capable of exposing people's secrets. This is the story of how those who were called the wor

title: Ingoku Danchi
author: Jouyama, Yui, Sakusei, Kenkyuujyo
description:
Yoshida is a tiny, frail high school graduate who became an unwilling manager of an apartment complex when his father, the former manager, injured himself. Unbeknownst to him, this apartment complex houses quite a few women with very... unusual sexual preferences. This becomes a problem when a mysterious entity begins giving "Libido Cloth" to these women—skimpy outfits that give them superpowers and cause them to go on lewd rampages! Will Yoshida be able to stop them?

(Source: MU)

title: Onegai, Nugashite.
author: Kawanaka, Yasushi
description:
Anyone who has done a "certain act" in school will become unable to take off their underwear. The only one who can undo that curse is Kamite.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: I Love Yuri and I Got Bodyswapped With a Fujoshi!
author: Ajiichi
description:
Meet Reiji Yoshida: a yuri otaku that loves yuri more than anything else in the world. All he wants is to enjoy his hobby in peace, but trouble ensues when he crosses paths with Mitsuru Hoshina, a fujoshi who is obsessed with boys' love. Hijinks ensue, and a vengeful ghost residing in their school's manga club swaps their bodies! Polar opposites in both personalities and hobbies clash in this exciting first volume—follow the adventures of their comedic body swap experiences!

(Source: J-Novel Cl

title: Ikenai Kanojo no Otetsudai
author: Nakahara, Kaihei
description:
Youhei Terada is an average high school student whose only talent is his ability to see ghosts. One night, he meets "Rooftop Rinko-san," a ghost who resides on the rooftop of his school. Because she was unable to make any friends during her life, does that make her the type of ghost who won't let anyone who meets her leave the rooftop...? It's the story of a hilarious friendship between man an incompetent ghost girl!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Nakanaide Maou-chan
author: Enchi
description:
Demon Lord Astalorin is far from your typical demon lord. One day, the hero appears before her. The undefeatable days of the cute demon lord begin now!

(Source: Cygames, translated)

title: It's So Sweet When I Marry My Organization's Nemesis.
author: Shiime, Uzou, Toshimichi
description:
"...I hate you!"
"What a coincidence. So do I."

The two once belonged to opposing organizations of supernatural power users, and fought for their own opposing goals. Roushi Saikawa, also known as the "Feather Hunter," and Ritsuka Yanagi, the strongest supernatural power user known as the "White Demon." The two spent their days battling each other and had no normal social experience, but...

"I love you, Rou-kun."
"Me too, Ritsuka."

After their organization was disbanded, they somehow started d

title: Koibito wa Hatsujouki
author: Kamon, Saeko
description:

1. A Devil in School
2. Home Tutors Cannot Fall in Love
3. Masturbating Together
4. Fondling Together
5. Super-sized Juliet
6. My Lover in Heat (Koibito wa Hatsujouki)
7. The Real Man
8. The Weekend of a Man Without a Boyfriend

"During yet another endless, boring night, when I was sick and tired of everything, 'that' came for me."

The Governor General of a city in 'The Age of Chaos' finds his louche malaise interrupted by a very interesting and dangerous visitor.

title: Yume Onna
author: Oku, Hiroya, Yamamoto, Hideo
description:
She is popular and has a hunk for a boyfriend, but there is that boy in her class who always stares at her, but never talks to anybody. On the way home that boy loses his phone, she picks it up, but he runs away before she can return it. Inside she finds article on lucid dreaming, and this is where it all begins...

(Source: MU)

title: Kabe ni Mary.com
author: Kobashiko
description: Oomori Youhei, an aspiring light novel writer is sitting before his computer one night, when he then hears someone calling behind him. It turns out it's a famous Mary-san from urban legend! Mary made a mistake when coming after Youhei and mistook him for someone else. But that won't prevent her from still trying to socially kill Youhei...

title: A Diffusion Disease
author: Oda, Hideji
description:
Katsuhiko Tobe faces an odd dilemma. Losing control of his physical self, his body diffuses into nothingness as his disembodied consciousness flows throughout the world constantly contemplating both the world and his current situation. Meanwhile, his best friend Azami Seshimo waits in their native Japan for Katsuhiko's return.

(Source: ANN)

title: Hinoenma's Temptation
author: Haseyoshi, Eria
description:
Our protagonist, after failing the medical school exam, moves to a village to focus on his studies and become a great doctor like his grandfather. However, the place where he will stay is administered by three beautiful sisters who hide a great secret, besides the village itself and its people. Why are there only women!? Why does the youngest want to "eat" me? Why does she have... fangs!? What's going on in this place?!

(Source: MU)

title: Kindred Spirits on the Roof
author: Itou, Hachi
description: Shiina Shiori is a second year student at the Kokonotsuboshi Girls' Academy of Commerce, an all girls school that was built on top of an old castle. Her emotions are thrown into disarray when she runs into her childhood friend Mako, who confessed to her when they graduated from middle school. Unable to come up with a response, Shiori ran, and hasn't been able to face her friend's feelings since. Not able to run any longer, she has to choose whether or not she'll give into the promise of a yurito

title: Uchi ni Kaeru to Itsumo Kukkoro ga Iru
author: Michael
description:
The apartment rented by a high school student so he can live alone turns out to be a "stigmatized property" haunted by the ghost of a female knight!

(Source: COMICSMART, translated)

title: Yuki no Niizuma wa Boku to Tokeaitai
author: Mihoshi, Megane
description: A young man, Yuusuke Sakanoi, who is making a living as a freelancer, is helped by a mysterious beautiful woman when he's about to faint due to heat stroke one day. Yuusuke looks for her and managed to find her, but she's in a soapland!? Her name is Ginka, she is a novice yuki-onna who came to the city in search of spirit and her husband, and the soapland was the feeding ground for the yuki-onna!! What's more, Ginka and Yuusuke will become a temporary couple...!!? What will be the fate of Yuusuk

title: Oni Futatsu
author: Fujimatsu, Mei
description:
In the manga, a demon called "shinki" lives inside each person. Kei, a high school student, hates his shinki, and goes about life trying to suppress his inner demon. But a certain event brings out the shinki inside him.

(Source: ANN)

title: Yummy Yummy in my Tummy
author: Noshime, Nao
description:
Omi Sorasaki is a just a normal high school boy. One day, a mysterious girl transferred to his school. She said to him, "I want to talk to you alone after school." Omi is nervous because he can't believe his mediocre life is about to change with a girl's love confession. Wait, is it a confession?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Reawakened Man
author: Chae, Yongtaek, Kim, Jaehan
description:
If there's one thing Hwan Seok can't stand, it's witnessing injustice. But this time, getting involved with a pair of men targeting his next-door neighbor, Yerin, costs him his life. Three days after his murder, Hwan Seok wakes up... alive! Armed with his newfound ability to be brought back to life after three days, Seok is determined to save Yerin but soon realizes he's gotten himself entangled in a plot bigger and more sinister than he originally imagined...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Nishikaidan no Akuma
author: Takagi, Shigeyoshi
description:
Something sinister lurks in the west staircases. Apparently, a beautiful demon resides in that place whom one should hope to never meet.

Would it be worse to be cursed or to be devoured whole?

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Neo Devilman
author: Yumeno, Kazuko, Yasuhiko, Yoshikazu, Iwaaki, Hitoshi, Hiromoto, Shinichi, Tajima, Shouu, Kuroda, Iou, Kanzaki, Masaomi, Nagai, Go, Egawa, Tatsuya, Nagano, Noriko, Terada, Katsuya, Ishikawa, Ken, Miyama, Noboru, Tori, Miki, Hagiwara, Reiji, Takadera, Akihiko, Kaze, Shinobu
description: Devilman's tribute manga series of original stories by various mangaka.

title: Isekai kara Kikan shitara Chikyuu mo Kanari Fantasy deshita. Ato, Make Heroine-domo Kocchi Minna.
author: Iida, Eisei, Takatsuki, Imashiro
description:
Six years ago, Natsuki Yura was summoned to another world as a hero. After defeating the Demon King and finally managing to return to his original world, he discovered that Earth was actually full of fantasy too—psychics, aliens, angels, gods, you name it... A modern ultra-fantasy saga begins!!

(Source: Bushiroad, translated)

title: Ore no Vaccine dake ga Zombie-ka shita Sekai wo Sukueru
author: Gotarou
description:
Yuu Oikawa, who has been shut up in his house, is certain to die as a virgin at the age of 21. This is because the whole world has become a place filled with zombies... One day, a survivor visits Yuu's house. The woman, who calls herself Sunny, injects Yuu with a vaccine that may save the world from the zombies... but as a result, Yuu gains the ability to turn zombies back into humans by having sex...?

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Totsugami
author: Saitou, Misaki
description: Tasuku can see ghosts, although he'd be happier if he didn't have this ability, especially since it comes with heavy responsibilities.

title: Oniyome wo Metotteshimatta.
author: Awabako
description:
Momotarou returned from his quest, having married the demon princess Ura instead of defeating the demons. The time for coexistence is here.

(Source: MU)

title: SAI:Taker: Futari no Artemis
author: Im, Dal Young, Lee, Soo Hyun
description: In the future, an energy source called "life" has become incredibly important. Certain people are able to synchronize with devices called SAI which gives them the ability to extract life and have super powers. These people are known as SAI-takers. Within the SAI-takers there is an even smaller group, Original-takers. Original-takers have a contract with a magical device, and they can manipulate life without the use of a SAI. These powerful people are also immortal, and they only die if they run

title: Hikari-Man
author: Yamamoto, Hideo
description: Hikari Shirochi, a lonely otaku obsessed with fighting games and PC mods, has it rough fighting to survive at the very bottom of the high school food chain. Nerdy with a weak constitution and electro-sensitivity, Hikari spends more time in the nurse's office than around his classmates. But who needs friends and popularity when you can stay at home working on sweet PC builds... right? One night, Hikari gets the shock of a lifetime that changes everything! Hit by a build-up of static charge, his c

title: Hiniiru
author: Katou, Yuuichi
description:
Ten years ago, a black shape appeared in the sky and destroyed the city below. Kagerou and Momiji were children when the destruction took place, and they have grown together into teenagers beneath the mysterious structure. There is an undeniable attraction between these two friends, but Kagerou is hesitant to confess his feelings because he feels that he is too weak to protect her.

One day, the structure acts again, sending down strange balls that eat people and transform them into monsters. Ka

title: I Belong to You Immoral
author: Akagi, Asahito
description:
Shou-chan is a member of the public morals committee who wants everyone to have a healthy relationship, and is worried about his childhood friend Sayo. Because she carries the blood of a succubus, she often approaches her beloved her Shou-chan in any way to do "lovey-dovey sex." As he persists in having a healthy relationship, which is full of lust and surrounded by questionable students, will Shou-chan manage to keep his sanity?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Royal Servant
author: MasterGin, Chungnyun
description:
"I love you, Master." Born as a servant but falls in love with the man who hates servants. A romantic fantasy between master and servant.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Dotou no Yuushatachi
author: Murata, Yusuke, ONE
description: The evil demon king Osekkai has kidnapped the sweet and helpless princess of the Dokka country. Is there no hero willing to risk his life for her? The one who succeed will get the hand of the princess...

title: Magical Girl Raising Project
author: Edoya, Pochi, Endou, Asari
description:
The highly popular social network game "Magical Girl Raising Project" is a miraculous game that produces real Magical Girls with a chance of 1 in 10000 for each person. Girls who are lucky enough to gain the power of magic spend fulfilling days. But one day, the administration arbitrarily announces that "There are too many magical girls so they will be halved." The curtain will now be raised on the relentless and merciless survival game between 16 magical girls.

(Source: Baka-Tsuki)

title: -rain-
author: Hayase, Hashiba
description:
"Because I love you."

On a rainy day, when Mai got stood up by the guy she likes she met a beautiful girl who told her that she was the Rain and that she had come because of her tears. After that Mai's days were filled with the bitterness of betrayal, only the memory of the girl called Rain can somehow ease her heart. A story of a brief love affair under the rainy season.

(summary by kiumi from The Evil Empire)

title: Get Married So I Can Curse Your Firstborn and Finally Be Free!
author: Inokuma, Shinobu, TABIKO
description: Kuro, a black cat, is a god of fortune down on her luck. She's turned into a "vengeful god" against her will, and the only way to return to her former status is to curse seven generations of the Nishikori bloodline. She's close to being free, but to get there, she needs to make sure the seventh generation actually gets born. That means finding a match for Nishikori Kotaro...which is harder than you might think, because Kotaro is tragically unpopular. Not only that, he insists that the only woman

author: Sakura, Rico
description:
1-3. Sabishigariya wa Yume wo Miru
4-5. Koi Kiru Futari
5. Untiltled

author: Tokishiba
description:
Human beasts Yagi and Okami live on a planet called Serian, which is just like Earth. They were sent out on infiltration training to Earth together when they entered high school. They were once close with each other, but now there's nothing but fights between them whenever they open their mouths.

The story starts three days after they've arrived on Earth prescribed with human shifting medicines and estrus prevention pills. Incidentally, Yagi entered his estrus period, but his reactions were wei

author: NOBEL

title: Akai Hana
author: Himegi, Mika
description:
Having fallen in love with a sick mortal, a vampire still strives to find love.

(Source: MU)

title: Oniichan no Koto ga Sukisugite Nyan Nyan Shitai Brocon Imouto dakedo Sunao ni Narenai no
author: Ooha, Maiko
description:
Saya is an average schoolgirl in every way but one; she's got a HUGE crush on her older brother. She's never been able to raise any flags with him (mostly due to her habit of beating him to a pulp whenever she sees him), but one day, she wakes up in the body of a cat that he brought home! Could this be her chance to make her beloved older brother fall for her?

(Source: MU)

title: Welcome to Succubus High!
author: Knuckle Curve
description:
When high school student Takeru Inubou is transferred to a new school, he is shocked to discover that not only is it an all-girls school, but all the students are succubi! Can an average guy like Takeru handle the carnal appetites of his devilish classmates while maintaining his purity?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: There is something odd about her
author: Yoshitomi, Akihito

1, 7. Ashita no Atashi (Tomorrow's Me)
2. Mienai Atashi (Invisible Me)
