author: Nishino, Juutarou
description:
Having given a magical Tengu mask to a human boy when she was little, Tengu princess Arazunaya Jirou is told by her father to go get it back. Nariyuki (the boy), now a high-schooler, doesn't want to give it back. Slapstick comedy ensues.

(Source: MU)

title: Isekaigaeri no Ossan wa Fusei Skill de Fathercon Musume-tachi wo Torotoro ni
author: Takahashi, Hiromu, Suzushiro, Nazuna
description: He was summoned to another world in the spring at the age of fifteen years old, and when he successfully defeated The Demon King, he was already thirty-two years old. He had finished his role in another world and returned to Japan, but the reality that had been waiting for him was the label of "middle school graduate with a seventeen year blank period." He couldn't find a decent job, and had no choice but to spend his days working part-time. It was then that a beautiful girl who claimed to be a

title: Watashi, Elite Tenshi desu ga Nankoufuraku na JK ni Komattemasu!
author: Noyama
description:
Ariel is an angel, a being that exists to reward good deeds by granting small wishes that appear over people's heads. But one day, she encounters a girl whose wish neither she, nor any previous angel, could read. Aiming to grant Kirara's unknown wish, she descends upon the human world to meet her personally, but Kirara's mind isn't as innocent as her mountain of good deeds may suggest.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Back to the Mother!!!
author: Furumoto, Takeru
description:
Former idol Touko Minayoshi retired at the peak of her popularity, going down as a legend in the world of show business. Years later, she is living a normal life as a happily married wife with a son named Yuu. But one day, returning home from school, Yuu discovers that his mother has transformed into a strange creature, and despite his best efforts, he is unable to figure out the reason.

Years pass, and the threat of Touko's situation being exposed appears. Now, the teenaged Yuu finds himself s

title: Mielino Kashiwagi
author: Ootani, Noriko, Akimoto, Yasushi
description:
Can't find a way to break up with your boyfriend/girlfriend? These people will help do it for you.

Kashiwagi has a special ability. When she touches someone, she can see their future romance. But, Kashiwagi doesn't know about romance herself and can't determine whether the scenes she sees is a happy or sad ending. Kashiwagi works at a cafe, which Sano manages and Konno works as clerk. The cafe is known as the "break-up cafe".

(Source: MU)

title: The Lesser Irregular Returns From the Demon World
author: Torikai, Yasuyuki, Tasurou
description:
Hiroto Domori is a seemingly weakling Irregular who doesn’t have any magical or spiritual powers. But what most people don’t know is that he just got back from the demon world and is the world's strongest demon killer. This "weak" demon killer goes up against an unrivaled enemy who attacks innocent people.

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Watashi ni Uso wo Tsuite
author: Aoyama, Goushou
description:
Tell Me A Lie is about a girl, Terumi Arai, who has the ability to read a person's mind when she looks into their eyes.

(Source: MU)

title: Welcome to the Maneater Dungeon the Comic
author: Tendo, Masae, Hitotose, Arata
description:
Ostracized and attacked by his home village after the death of his mother, the half-human half-demon Elliot establishes himself as a dungeon lord with the help of his father's succubus.

(Source: MU)

title: Caterpillar Girl and Bad Texter Boy
author: Sanzou
description:
Beautiful, smart, and kind Suzume Kikuo is perfect in every way, the girl of anyone's dreams. But when she asks out her socially awkward childhood friend Akane, his response is a shocker: "You're too perfect." What's a girl to do, except transform into a giant caterpillar and try, try again?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Endless Eden
author: Tateo, Retsu
description:
Angela wakes up in an abandoned warehouse. Confused and dazed, she has no memory of her past or any concrete idea about how she got there. Angela through a series of seemingly inconceivable events, Angela learns that she has been chosen as the next vessel for the great demon queen. The only thing preventing the queen from taking over her mind and body is her virginity. Will Angela be able to avoid temptation or will the Demon Queen Lilion be unleashed to ravish the Earth?

(Source: SCX-Scans)

title: Zansho: Kitoh Mohiro Tanpenshuu

4. Yogoreta Kirei na
5. A to R
6. Papa no Uta
7. Pochi no Basho

title: I Want To Be Called a Vampire!
author: Pyaa
description:
Vlad Academy is abuzz with the news of a new transfer student. The student, Aoi, decided to enroll in the school in pursuit of her childhood friend Yuuna since they had not seen each other in six months.

Surprised by Aoi's sudden appearance, Yuuna explains why she had distanced herself from Aoi: Yuuna is a vampire—and so are all the students of Vlad Academy. Although Aoi accepts Yuuna's confession, Yuuna informs Aoi that she must hide her identity as a human, as not all vampires on campus are f

title: Dead Account
author: Watanabe, Shizumu
description: Always ready for a fight! Destruction for destruction's sake! The online streamer Aoringo is a troll, making the worst of the worst of boundary-pushing flamebait content and raking in the revenue from the hate-watchers. You may think he's nothing more than a bottom feeder and a drain on society, but in reality, he's high school dropout Souji Enishiro, a caring older brother with a sweet tooth who loves nothing more than his little sister. His viral videos? Just a way to pay his sister's medical

title: Amentia
author: yangmo, INI
description:
Lee Wee-jin normally endures each of his his high school days as a servant his perfect sister Lee Wi-na. However, he has a secret he can't share with anyone—that he can materialize his delusions as he pleases. When he needs to relieve stress caused by his sister, he materializes a version of his own sister in order to punish her.

But one day a black-haired transfer student says the following to Wee-jin while wielding a knife against him: "You damn delusioner that materializes delusions, we wake

title: Hacking Ghost: Karada ni shika Kachi no Nai Gakuen
author: Rokuichi, Masai
description: In an era where one in every twenty people has awoken to a "special ability," Hiroto Takigami is a weak ability user who can only communicate with spirits. However, for some reason, his stepsister Rei, the most powerful ability user, harbors deep hatred toward him. The moment he graduates from an ability training institution and gains full control over his power, Rei will kill him. He only has one year left to live. That's when a spirit appears before a despairing Hiroto and reveals an unexpecte

title: Klan
author: Tanaka, Yoshiki, Fukaki, Shouko
description:
In ancient times, at a lake somewhere in the middle of Eurasia, lived people (ハムランムル) with the ability to transform into animals. But soon internal quarrels forced the population apart into four tribes, which then scattered all over the world. Their descendants prospered, including a certain Hidaka, a high school student who would be completely unremarkable if not for his unnatural appetite.

However, a British aristocrat, Earl Linford, wishes to subjugate all clans by establishing the supremacy

title: Neko Mata
author: Kamon, Saeko
description:
"Aren't you always thinking about that guy?!"

An arrogant Bakeneko (cat monster), named Kuro, is taken in by ordinary honor student Noeru. Kuro however leaves Noeru alone in a classroom after turning him into an erotic beauty with his powerful ero-magic.

Things get complicated when he ends up sleeping with cool guy Shouei, the person he's secretly in love with! The dutiful honor student becomes a lusty boy... Erotically sweet and troubled high school days ensue! 

(Source: MU)

title: Sanzennenme no Kamitaiou
author: Katou, Fumitaka
description: 3000 year old god decides she wants to quit being a god so she becomes a high school girl.

title: Yume Yume Shinjuu
author: Kojima, Lalako
description: For someone who has no recollection of their childhood, Yuzuru's been having the same dream over and over again. One where he and another boy are playing in a small shrine. But he can never figure out who the other boy is. Then one day, his brother Ryosuke brings home a classmate of his, named Takumi. Within the memories that Yuzura can not remember, he realizes that Takumi was his childhood friend and first love. Takumi reveals that he is ecstatic that Yuzuru remembers. Happy to meet his first

title: Dies Irae: Amantes Amentes
author: Minatogawa, Kazuomi
description:
As the Soviet Union marches on Berlin in May of 1945, a secretive group of sorcerers and madmen gathers to perform a terrible ritual. They care nothing for the fate of the Reich. To them, the countless lives lost in the battle are the perfect sacrifice to fuel their spell. After the war, they vanish and are not heard from again, except in rumor. One day, it is whispered, they will return. And on that day, the world will end. Fear the demons in human form. Fear the Longinus Dreizehn Orden.

Flash

title: Kiss the Scars of the Girls
author: Haruhana, Aya
description:
"I'm sure someday, I'll get you to look my way." Danger and uncertainty are common for a young vampire, which is why Emille will be assigned a "Big Sister" on her fourteenth birthday, like all the girls at her school. Deep within a secluded forest, her sister will teach her how to hunt and safely feed on humans. Learning to rely on each other for survival cultivates a deep relationship comparable to that between family-but does theirs have the potential to evolve into something more?"

title: Don't Count Your Tanukis
author: Minase, Mayu
description:
Riku planned to move to Kyoto, together with his childhood friend Momoka. Instead, his parents have him betrothed to the cuddly Tanuki princess Miyo! She can turn into a woman, but being a human is quite difficult: Miyo cooks scrambled eggs with their peel, washes herself in the washing machine and sometimes nibbles on a grasshopper. But thanks to Momoka, she quickly learns what jealousy is.

(Source: Kazé)

title: Kirara
author: Yui, Toshiki
description:
Twenty-four-year-old Kirara is on her way to her wedding when she is killed in a car accident. However her love for her fiancé is so strong that she is permitted to return to earth as a ghost to see him. But she is sent back 8 years in time, to when she and her fiancé first met. However her own meddling in the past may make her 16 year-old-self turn away from her would-be fiancé.

Included one-shots:
Volume 4: Kanojo no Angle, Kanojo no Photo Kiss
Volume 5: Konna Koto ga Attemo Iiyou na Hibi

title: Until the Full Moon
author: Matoh, Sanami
description:
Marlo has a problem. On the night of the full moon, this half-werewolf, half-vampire undergoes a mysterious and terrifying transformation:

He turns into a girl.

Desperate for a cure, his parents call on Doctor Vincent, a long time family friend. But Marlo wants to keep his condition secret from Vincent's son, the vampire playboy David.

title: Yome no Manimani
author: Yuu
description:
A god picks up an abandoned high school girl in the forest and carelessly takes her as a bride.

(Source: MU)

title: Mahoroba Days
author: Chishanomi
description: The Kuga House is the most prestigious deer family in Nara Prefecture. Shiraha, their heir, is attached to childhood human friend, Sousuke. Shiraha is popular and loved by all, while Sousuke is a mere servant of the house. But he is always telling Sousuke how much he likes him. Even though he feels special to be singled out by the beautiful and esteemed Shiraha, he knows that there is a line that he cannot cross. But! During mating season, Shiraha can't control himself anymore and he comes on to

title: The Shape-Shifting Witch's Kiss
author: Funeno, Maho
description:
Tooru has a superpower—he manages to be invisible without any magic at all! In fact, the only one who truly sees him is his childhood friend, Tsumugi, leading Tooru to have the crush to end all crushes on her. But when Tooru's "ability" leads him to accidentally discover a witch and strip her of her powers, he thinks he's screwed...until she offers to help him hook up with Tsumugi. But this witch's powers are revived only with a kiss? One thing's for sure—Tooru won't be invisible for long!

(Sou

title: 1000 Yen Hero
author: Yakiimo Handsome Saitou
description:
Monsters are on the loose! But luckily for the people of Japan, heroes are there to protect them, with powers that run on a rate of yen per second. For Hiasa Sen, however, there are many more important things to worry about, like catching sales on groceries, and his many part-time jobs, all to take care of his little sister. When danger approaches, however, he has a secret power of his own, but it may be more trouble than it's worth.

(Source: Comikey Media)

title: Otogi no Machi no Rena
author: Hattori, Mitsuru
description:
Rena Misaki was a normal girl in high school in the small town of Otogi. But lately she has been tormented by little hamster like imps that cause greatly increased sexual desire. They had been banished from the village long ago by a priest, but somehow they have returned and have taken an interest in Rena. And if that wasn't enough trouble, they are starting to spread. Rena has to find away to get rid of them and have a normal life, before she ends up sleeping with all the guys around her!

(Sou

description:
April is a vampire who is freeloading at Hikari's house. She needs food to sustain her body, and that is...

(Source: Yuri Project)

title: Harapeko Mitsuba-Chinko
author: Nangoku, Banana
description:
8 page short in which a starving student discovers the plant he found in an alley is really a beautiful young man who wants to feed him...

(Source: MU)

title: Alice & Zoroku
author: Imai, Tetsuya
description:
A group of young girls possess a mysterious power known as "Alice's Dream," which gives them the ability to turn their thoughts into reality. Detained and experimented upon, these youths are locked away in secret until one of them manages to escape. Her name is Sana—a girl with the power to ignore the very laws of physics. When this willful powerhouse crosses paths with a stubborn old man named Zouroku, his carefully-ordered life will never be the same again!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Monster Musume Paradise
author: Inui, Takemaru, Shiraha, Mato, Horitomo, Shidou, Mayuru, Tetsuwan, Woopie, AHOBAKA, Tsukasawa, Kuroshiki, Niimaru, Yuu, Rib:y(uhki), Urokozuki, Z-ton, Kirisaki, Byakko, Takayuki, Hiyori
description: Anthology by various mangaka dealing with monster girls.

author: Yusa, Mahiro, Chibimaru
description:
A colorless world, a pure white world, a world where everything is filled with only one color. What ought to be a young man's usual route to school—Sai was suddenly blown away, it was such an extraordinary world.

There, he witness two young girls' fight unfold before him. One of them is a blonde girl he has never seen before, and the other is Mikage Mikuro, an upperclasswoman in his high school. Then, the blonde girl appeared as a transfer student before Sai, who has just returned to the origin

title: Drops of Desire
author: Higashino, Yuu
description: On what should be a routine trip to the nurse's office, Yuzuru walks in on school nurse, Kokuyo, as he's ravaging one of Yuzuru's fellow classmates. Unable to stay away from the dangerous yet charismatic man, Yuzuru finds himself an unwilling resident of the nurse's office, unable to resist the onslaught of pleasure Kokuyo subjects him to or escape the confines of its walls. Will Yuzuru's fear be overcome by the fleeting displays of warmth this mysterious man gives him, or will the realization t

author: Ike, Reibun
description:
1. No.99: Ningen Omocha 
The Marquis Banford and his wife die in tragic circumstances leaving Graham, their butler, with the heavy burden of raising their sole heir, Leonard. Leonard is young and Graham chooses to raise him in a selfish and unrestrained manner. Anything he wishes, his butler will grant. One day Graham returns to the castle with another rare toy for his master. The 99th toy to be presented to Leonard. A human toy.
(Source: Blissful Sin)

2. Ougon Shima (The Golden Island)

title: Yamikagishi
author: Akana, Shuu, Nakashima, Kazuki
description:
The shogunate installed by the Tokugawa is abiding order, the people live in peace and in a relative prosperity.

However, the dark part of the human heart does not cease to arouse their cupidity: it is the ideal doorway for all demons that, by possessing humans, seek to pass into their world.

title: Your Wish Is My Command!
author: Sageum
description:
What do you when you have a burning crush, but can't work up the nerve to tell him? Buy a nice dildo and dream about making sweet, sweet love, of course. However, Chiwoo's plan takes a turn when he finds his toy comes with a special offer: fight monsters with the magic dildo to make your wish come true! Chiwoo will do anything to get closer to his crush, but the monsters he must battle are quite...nasty. Can Chiwoo protect his crush from danger, and save his first time for the one he wants?!

Could you survive as a fish? Yushin, the president of Saseong Group, is betrayed by his boss and thrown into a lake, left for dead. But a mysterious voice calls out to Yushin underwater. "Would you like to start a new life?" He wakes up to find himself as a slimy, scaly largemouth bass tasked with a plethora of quests to fulfill that ultimately promises him one wish. Will Yushin be able to navigate the waters and find a way to become human again?

Sora is a zaraki warashi who wants to see his childhood friend Minami. Sora keeps waiting, but Minami doesn´t coming back from Tokyo. Then Sora hears the news, Minami had an accident and can no longer walk properly anymore. So the zaraki warashi leaves his house in the mountains and goes to the big city called Tokyo.

author: Seijuu, Natsumegu
description: Sukami Kyouichi was born into an exorcist family, and his older sister is an expert exorcist. She's been putting together a notebook where she has written how to handle all of the different monsters she's met in her work. One day, Kyouichi and his friends in the Occult Club at school go to investigate a supposedly cursed shrine, and he ends up needing to be rescued by his sister. Shortly afterward, she goes missing, presumed by many to be dead, and leaves her little brother with only the noteboo

A 14-year-old is planning to confess to her upperclassmen who is graduating. The next morning, she wakes as a 29-year-old single woman, living with 3 sisters: a high schooler, a middle schooler, and an elementary schooler.

Kazuya Satou is a 30-year-old office worker and a virgin. His daily routine is playing eroge while masturbating. One night, he got the "Peeping App" from God. It was not an ordinary app, but an app that could read a woman's heart.

author: Sheena
description:
"I'm a god with a blanket that was born to warm you up."

On a certain day of winter, Minato, a boy who's particularly sensitive to cold, will meet a mysterious woman that will warm his heart to the core!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

author: Hongchi
description: Her blood runs hot, and her temper is even hotter—even when it's the cold of winter. To lift the flaming curse she's carried since she was a little girl, high schooler Ember must find her cold equivalent... But finding a match whose blood runs as cold as hers does hot isn't going to be easy, especially when the only way to turn the powerful curse away is to KISS that person right on their frigid lips. High school dramas usually run hot-and-cold, but there's never been a story as fun and fiery as

author: Oshimi, Shuuzou
description: Two concluding chapters, published in volume 2 of shinsouban version (2013).

A collection of stories about relationships between men and women either of whom just happens to be a zombie.

After Yuuka's suicide, her brother Asaharu is desperate for answers... and his guardian angel wants to help. This divine intervention may be closer to a deal with the Devil, though... "You have to kill Yuuka's killer," she says. "If you do that, I'll bring her back to life." Is he willing to bet his own life for a chance to save his sister? Nina the cat lost the Zodiac Race by one spot, and she's held a grudge for millennia. When she forces a divine do-over, unlucky student Cosmo Lee becomes the reluctant referee. His mission? Not long after, Han

It is very rare for vampires to successfully reproduce by biting their victims; rather, the more reliable method is to give birth the same way humans do, which requires a large blood supply for nutrients. Therefore, when humans develop artificial blood, an opportunity to peacefully coexist with vampires emerges. In exchange for contributing to human society, vampires receive sufficient resources to live comfortably and start families.

Seemingly on a whim, a bereaved Raine decides to adopt orpha

One day, a ronin on his way home gave a bento to a cosplay cat girl. Unexpectedly, the cat girl then decided to stay at his house, resulting in the two living together. Another unexpected thing is that the girl turns out to be one of the mountain shrine Gods... Having to deal with the girl's magic and the teasing from other cats and Gods keeps the main charter’s hands full. Will he ever get a break or will his "big pet" be a burden forever.

No hobbies, no holidays, no girlfriend, Enomoto lives just to work. Although she enjoys high school life, Riko finds it a little boring. It just so happens that these two swap bodies?! Atsushi is a descendant of the guardian deity of the Heian period. While his beautiful childhood friend, Yuki, is the daughter of the shrine erected to protect his family. Luckily, a solution appears in the form of a plucky human named Ina, whose eyes seem to have the mysterious effect of alleviating this condition. Knowing that she's desperate to book a surgery

title: Mieru Hito
author: Iwashiro, Toshiaki
description:
Myoujin is a guide for spirits. Unlike most people, he can see ghosts, ghosts who live and wander in the same world we do. But he's got something even more special up his sleeve: he can touch them. Okegawa Himeno is an ordinary 16 year-old girl studying in Tokyo. But now she's become Myoujin's housemate, infact, he's her landlord. After a close brush with death herself, Himeno becomes able to see the walking dead herself. At least now she's able to meet her neighbours. 

(Source: Be With You Sca

title: Ironna Onnanoko to Kiss wo Shiteitara, Yuri Kiss ni Mezamete Shimaimashita....
author: betock
description:
One day, Kanon Azuma, a first-year high school student who loves helping people, witnesses something falling from the sky. When she went nearby, there was a girl?!

"You are my partner!''

Then, she asked her to do something...? There's friendship, effort, and sometimes battle!? A girl's romantic comedy full of sweet, sour, and passionate "kisses" begins!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Hanafuda
author: okama
description:
Hanafuda tells the supernatural tale of Izuna, a noble turned demon hunter, travelling across Japan to slay the oni that stole the life of his beloved Lady Kiri. Izuna encounters a young fox that possesses the ability to shapeshift and the duo journey together to exact revenge on the oni. Hanafuda, or "flower cards," is a Japanese card game where each suit of cards represents a month and flower. Like the game, each chapter in Hanafuda corresponds to a different suit.

(Source: FAKKU)

title: Tsukumo Happy Soul
author: Ooiwa, Kenji
description:
There were 99 beasts were set on the world that did chaos. They were sealed within "vessels" and they choose their own "masters". Three girls found a vessel and one of them made an all-girl school. Yukiji Shinazuki goes there as a freshman. Tamakichi Shinazuki lives with her and causes chaos all around Yukiji...even at the all-girls school! What's even more surprising about Tamakichi is...read it and 
you will find out! 

(Source: MU)

title: Ushiro no Shindere-san
author: Satou, Yuuki
description: Karugasaki Tora decided to repeat a grade and turn into a delinquent just so he could be popular, on his best friends advice. However, his plan backfired and nobody talks to him in his new classroom. The only thing he can look forward to is seeing the cute girl sitting next to him, but after trying to talk to her she immediately kicked him and threw him out the window. Later the same day, though, he saved her and a little girl from being hit by a truck. No longer able to avoid him, the girl reve

title: Private Magician
author: Takashima, Kazusa
description:
Kasumi's day just keeps getting worse and worse. First he's dumped by a classmate, and then a strange fortune-teller shakes his world as he reveals himself to be in search of a master. And who could the lucky boy be...?

(Source: MU)

title: Fast Forward
author: Porto, Hong, Junki
description:
The final goal is to be the master of time. But in order to become the master, you must kill and steal. The universe has given powers to a select number of people. The only problem is, you can get your powers taken away... along with your life. The keepers of time will need to protect their powers or pay the ultimate price.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Parasite Doctor Suzune
author: Haruki
description:
In a city so over-indulgent and careless, reveling in food and sex and completely unaware of the epidemic of parasites, it's no wonder so many people are infected. Dr. Suzune Arizono isn't exactly a normal doctor. For one, she's actually a veterinarian— but her specialty is parasites, and when those parasites make a habit of nesting inside human genitalia and overriding their senses with lust, her job is bound to get more than a little messy!

As the spunky and beautiful heroine of this sexy sci

title: Generation Witch
author: Isaki, Uta
description:
1% of the population are witches. Most non-magical people look up to these witches and envy their power, but as witches already know, sometimes these abilities can be more of a curse than a blessing. When growing up already requires all the luck and effort a teenager can muster, what happens when you throw spirits, spell circles, and broomsticks into the mix?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Himegami no Miko
author: Kaishaku
description:
Himeko Kurusugawa and Chikane Himemiya are two high-school girls at the prestigious Ototachibana Academy in the fictional Japanese village of Mahoroba. They are also the reincarnations of the solar and lunar mikos. When their ancient enemy the Orochi rises once more, the girls' long-sealed personas awaken to defend the world!

(Source: MU)

title: 1/8 Kanojo
author: Sanshoku, Amido.
description: Mizuki's childhood friend Asuha suddenly finds herself turned into a doll. Will Mizuki who has a passion for collection figurines, be able return her to her real body or just add her to his collection?

title: Togari Shiro
author: Natsume, Yoshinori
description: The only chance Toubee has to escape from the grips of Hell once and for all is to continue his quest to slay manifestations of human evil. His deal gave him 108 days to achieve his goal. This is Toubee's final day.

title: Mao Marimo
author: Tanisawa, Shiki, Horikita, Aoi
description: Mao lives with his three sisters in a village full of the presence of gods. On the day of the village festival in his first year of high school, he was given a divine destiny: to become a girl. While Mao is happy and accepting of his new womanhood, the other people in his life have more trouble coping. His aggressive twin sister Akoya (nicknamed Ako), who used to tease him for being a feminine crybaby, seems to blame herself for his transformation. Both Mao's twin sister and his closest male fri

title: Angel Beats! The 4-koma: Osora no Shinda Sekai kara
author: Komowata, Haruka

title: Akuma no Ikenie
author: Tachibana, Ayun
description:
Hajime lives with the twin sisters of the family of the Komatsu shrine. Inori is of a very spiritual bent and often tries to use her 'powerful' heirloom rosary to protect her friends and family from evil. The other sister, Kanau, is more practical. She often spends time trying to keep Hajime from groping women, which he is always doing by accident.

Amidst strange vampire-like murders in the community, Hajime has had a dream of a hot female demon called Satan that is lusting after his blood. Soo

title: Nejikemono
author: Abaraya, Takeichi
description:
In the country of Kyushu, Hyuga during the Sengoku era, Kagashi is asked to exterminate a fox youkai. He enters the mountains and encounters a strange woman.

(Source: MU)

title: A Summer Night's Dream
author: Kim, Subak, Kan
description: Have you ever wondered if the person you like is dreaming about you? Teacher Yeoreum Han doesn't have to guess—she can make it happen, with her ability to walk into other people's dreams. She can even link the dreams of two people together, and use this ability to play Cupid for her students. But her matchmaking goes awry when she enters the dream of Si-u Park—a lucid dreamer, who realizes that Yeoreum is walking into his dream. Si-u and Yeoreum's lives become intertwined after this incident, we

title: Rengoku no Cartagra
author: Takahashi, Ryou
description: Transfer student Yuuki Yuriya does not participate in church services or Bible study, so he is rumored to be the culprit behind the recent "demonic ceremonies" occurring at Seirei Academy. Truthfully, he has never before been involved with the supernatural—until one evening, when he witnesses an unknown girl jump from the school rooftop. Next to her bloody corpse, he finds a mysterious book containing instructions he feels compelled to follow. Yuuki is shocked when he successfully summons Demon

title: Black Night Parade
author: Nakamura, Hikaru
description: Miharu Hino will be spending this Christmas just like the last: alone and working a dead-end job. All he wants is good employment, but when he meets a Santa Claus dressed in clothes as black as coal, he has no idea he's encountered the real deal...sort of. The Santa Claus dressed in red makes Christmas happen for good children everywhere, but his darker counterpart handles the holiday for the bad kids. As a name on the naughty list, Miharu is dashed away to work for the shadowy Santa. The pay an

title: Atori Shou
author: Tashiro, Takuya
description:
Atori has an unusual part-time job... she's a demon hunter! After school, she hunts demons for a mysterious organization named N.U.E. To kill her enemies, she unsheathes the saber hidden within her hair. However, Atori is actually half-demon, but she has forgotten her past. Despite this, she's been able to overcome many difficulties as well as befriend those from both species. Unfortunately, her once calm life is beginning to quake as a terrible shadow now looms over her...

(Source: Imangascans

title: Toshokan no Youkai
author: Hayakawa, Nojiko
description:
Hashimoto, the librarian, has a little kamaitachi on his shoulder that’s been causing havoc in his life. Now, he has to reign his emotions in before the power he inherited from the demon hurts someone he has affections for! 

(Source: Echochi Scans)

title: Kishibe no Yume
author: Yamazaki, Daiki
description: The hunt for a woman that keeps appearing in dreams.

title: Love Dream Mix
author: Kaishinshi
description: Kensuke is your usual high schooler. He's unattractive, unreliable and leads a very boring life. This all changes in one night, when a goddess granted him his wish and make him a popular boy in a different world, and soon after that girls start flocking to him like there is no tomorrow. The first dramatic change in his life came from his new sister and the second was a childhood friend that he had never met before. Things don't not stop there, soon all sorts of weird girls come into his life. Th

title: Sayonara Karada
author: Yamamoto, Hideo
description: A story about a pair of lovers and the cycle of life.

title: Fate/Labyrinth
author: Sakurai, Hikaru, Nakahara
description: Manaka Sajyou, an existence connected to Akasha, is unable to experience phenomena like change and surprise, so she wishes to attempt to "dream." She sends her consciousness through the backside of the World, beyond the end of the world, and into different time and space. She ends up in a labyrinth, hosting a variant Holy Grail War, featuring four Servants and Masters attempting to reach the bottom. Manaka possesses the body of a Master who had summoned a female King Arthur. Saber interacts with

title: Fenrir-neesan to Boku
author: Azaki, Momoko
description:
Haijima Yousuke, bored of life, casually wishes for the world to be destroyed, even though he hates fighting and involving himself with people. And yet, when a terrifying monster suddenly appears and strikes down his beautiful upperclassman, Kitami Touka, right before him, Haijima knows that this time, he must fight. However, there seems to be more to Kitami than Haijima originally thought.

(Source: MU)

title: The Wolf & Red Riding Hood
author: Xuann
description:
High school student Anna wakes up one day to find that she's super hairy, incredibly strong, and craves meat all the time. Her mom thinks it's puberty... until Anna grows ears and a tail. Definitely not puberty. Can she figure out how to stop herself from becoming a werewolf before the full moon?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Tetsu no Senritsu
author: Tezuka, Osamu
description:
1. Tetsu no Senritsu (The Melody of Iron)
2. Shiroi Genei (White Phantom)
3. Revolution

title: Saikyou Series
author: NISIO, ISIN, Take
description: "Overkilled Red" Aikawa Jun. The story of "Humanity's Strongest Contractor" is now being told.

title: Shinigami Doggy
author: Yamamoto, Kana
description: Ken was a normal high school student until he was killed...chasing after a riceball. In the afterlife, he meets a Shinigami named Shin, who grants last minute wishes to females who pass on. Shin agrees to give Ken's life back if he is able to grant ONE girl's wish. But will he complete this job successfully? And what if something goes wrong?

title: Kurokuroku
author: Nakamura, Atsushi
description:
Yusa Chiaki is a ordinary high school student, whose motto is simplicity and frugality. Her favorite character is Uesugi Youzan. One day while going to search for a part time job she gets chased by kappas and a mysterious man rescues her. What will happen to her now?

(Source: MU)

Included one-shots:
Volume 2: Kurokuroku (pilot); Daida Nakajima
Volume 3: Matorito Work

title: Nephilim
author: Hanamaki, Anna
description: Whoever looks upon their nightly figures will meet with certain death. Nephilim - a unique race that turns male by day and female by night. Labeled as "Gods of Death" it is said that whoever glances upon their bewitching night beauty will meet with certain death. Unfortunately for the playboy imperial soldier Gai, such an occurrence earns him a beautiful angel of death named Abel hellbent on taking his life. Then again, having a beautiful girl/boy obsessively chasing after him may not be so bad.

title: All Football Talents Are Mine
author: Hot Six, amber
description:
Ho-yeong dreamed of becoming a professional football player. But God didn't give him the talent, and he died by a lightning strike without achieving his dream. Then, the demon Mammon appeared and gave him the ability to steal the talent of other players.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Shiki Tsukai
author: Takanagi, Yuuna, Zekuu, Tooru
description:
On the day he turns fourteen, Akira discovers his destiny: He’s a shiki tsukai, a warrior with the magical power to control the seasons. He also meets the beautiful Koyomi, another warrior, who is sworn to protect him. For there are evil forces intent on destroying Akira–and the entire universe! 

(Source: Del Rey)

title: Pink Tengu
author: Yukimura
description:
A tengu with peach colored wings suddenly appears before worrier high school student, Kotetsu! The tengu, Momo, says he's always been watching over Kotetsu in order to repay a favor once received from an ancestor of Kotetsu. How will the start of their strange life together turn out......? The odd tale of Momo the tengu and Kotetsu's fluffy, strange love!

Also includes a previously unpublished short comic.

(Source: Nakama)

title: Babel II
author: Yokoyama, Mitsuteru
description: Life seems simple for Koichi, a young student, until he learns that he is the reincarnation of an alien protector who crashed onto the mantle of responsibility as"defender of the Earth", Koichi/Babel teams up with a trio of super-powered alien companions to battle the the dark forces of an evil cult leader. The war to save humanity takes Babel from the deserts of southern Asia to the upper east side of Manhattan and ultimately to a final showdown with "the master" in a hidden base nestled in the

title: Holy Corpse Rising
author: Tanaka, Hosana
description:
In the fifteenth-century Rome, witches have declared war against humanity.

A young man named Nikola, whose parents were cruelly murdered by a witch before his eyes, discovers that he is now the key to winning the war. Using sorcery skills acquired through years of careful study, Nikola must revive twelve witches known as the "First Witches" who will become his allies and weapons to defeat the enemy. But there is one small hitch: in order to revive the witches from their eternal slumber, Nikola

title: Yokai Buster Murakami
author: Ihara, Daiki
description:
Terrifying youkai from hundreds of years ago have been released into the present day. Kuin the exorcist stands tall to protect the peace of this world! But in this war of Youkai vs. Exorcist, regular high schooler Murakami has entered the battle!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Included one-shots:
Volume 1: Senoo no Toubu
Volume 2: Mayonaka Tsukioka Koutou Gakkou

title: Ayashi no Hakoniwa ni Ukabu Tsuki
author: Hasumi, Hana
description:
Shuri Yuuki, a high school teacher forced to resign from the school where he was working because of a certain incident, is assigned to a new post at Karasudai private school. On the first day in the new school, he tried to save a bird from a dog's mouth but the dog transformed into a demon instead. What else is going to happen in this school for wild students who are not human?

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Hard to Say I Love You
author: Shikimi, Bibi
description: Iruma, who has a constitution that allows him to transform into a wolf gets into an accident while in his wolf form and is saved by the veterinarian, Minato. He spends his days being relentlessly doted on by the animal lover Minato, but while he snaps angrily, "Don't treat me like a dog!," he obeys Minato's naughty and teasing orders and is overcome by a sweet, tingling sensation of pleasure and arousal... The warmth of family and the exciting pleasure of submission—this is the story of a lonely

title: Mythic Punch
author: Katsura, Asuka
description: Aritake Deigo has decided to move out because he could not stand living with his family anymore and wants to find a place to live a miserly life of self-loathing. While talking to an apartment agent, he encounters a strange blue haired girl carrying a snake statue. He then starts hearing a voice from the statue and after touching it, he gets knocked out. Upon waking up, he finds out that he has been possessed by Lyssa, the Goddess of Madness. Now, if he can't be happy from the bottom of his hear

title: Rozen Maiden 0
author: PEACH‐PIT
description: Rozen Maiden 0 is set in Tokyo during Japan's Taisho era. It follows a clumsy girl named Okiku who moves from the countryside to work in a large western-style mansion in the imperial capital. One day, she discovers a mysterious doll in the mansion's attic.

title: Kunoichi no Ichi! no Ni
author: Kanazawa, Shinnosuke
description:
High school student Ichi visited a ninja residence on a school excursion and was caught in a strange structure during the tour, slipping to the ninja world. Along with his friends, Ichi who got the "Ninpocho," a key to return to the present age, returns safely to the present age. However, suddenly, a surprise appears in front of Ichi who lives a peaceful life...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Kimi sae mo Ai no Kusari
author: Shinjou, Mayu
description: Shouta Koishikawa and Miono Hasuoka, childhood friends and neighbors, have always been together. At some point, Shouta's heart began to recognize only Miono, but it was around this time that Miono began to be charmed by her science teacher, Professor Kaorumaru. Not entirely what he seems to be, Kaorumaru predicts an immediate future in which Miono's fated love will "awaken another Miono." Later that day, as Shouta attempts to finally confess his love... the demon Ginyasha appears and takes contr

title: Dine With a Vampire
author: Pangin, Pinko
description:
Caught in the clutches of an abusive relationship, Sooin longs to escape. A vampire who finds human blood repulsive, Chi-hwan only drinks the blood of other vampires. When chance brings the two together, Chi-hwan makes Sooin an enticing proposal. Chi-hwan will help Sooin get out of his living hell, and in exchange...Sooin has to let Chi-hwan drink his blood. Will this proposal change both their lives for the better?

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Yururizumu
author: Takeda, Mika
description:
Hibiki Suzuhara....It's the name of the boy who has a special kind of world...The world of Onsen....As he summons one from a hot spring she is not only quite comfortable..She is frikkin hot, with boobs to match her body..Follow them as they take each day together from which disaster strikes...in the form of sticky situations.

(Source: Mangafox)

title: Majo no Yaen
author: Dowman, Sayman
description:
A young lesbian couple ventures into a love hotel to perform an erotic ritual of black magic.

(Source: MU)

title: Kamige tte Souiu Koto desu ka
author: Hirose, Madoka
description:
Anna Senoo recently got a job at a social game company called Kami Games, which turns out to be run by actual gods.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Heaven
author: Nanase, Aoi
description: The main character Haruto who has the marking of a supreme king, unknowingly opened and entered the gate to the world of divine spirits. There he meets Feilen-kamisama who makes a contract with Haruto for an unexpected reason. Later Raika, nation of thunder, comes along and makes things more confusing for Haruto! What happens after this? A riot that flips his life upside down… or flat to the ground… (Source: M-U)

title: Akuma no Puzzle
author: Hagio, Akira
description:
1. Akuma no Puzzle
2. Kare to Kanojo to+1 (Him and Her, Plus One)
3. Karigami no Himegimi (Karigami Princess)
4. Shichigatsu no Hanayome (July Bride)

title: Red List: Keishichou Sotai Sanka PO
author: Kanzaki, Yuuya
description:
Hikaru Kago is a former yakuza roped into cooperation with the police through plea bargaining. Takaomi Togasawa is an elite cop who'd rather be doing desk work. Follow the improbable duo as they survive each day as protection officers in charge of yakuza victims or targets, and find out why their assignment is called "the last bureau before heaven!"

(Source: Death Toll Scans)

title: Sultan Boueitai
author: Otomo, Katsuhiro, Takachiho, Haruka, Takadera, Akihiko
description: A collection of 3 "hard boiled type" stories by Akihiko Takadera, Haruka Takachiho and Katsuhiro Otomo.

title: Notorious Dangerous Lovely Police
author: Momose, Takeaki
description: Miami Guns is an action/parody manga about Sakurakouji Yao and Amano Lu, two teenage police officers living in Miami City.

title: Re:Load
author: Sasaki, Takumaru
description:
A man throws away his past and lives his life separated from others. However, everything changes when he is thrown into a battle to protect a young girl from a criminal organization.

(Source: MU)

title: Love Is Left to the Trace He Chewed
author: Inose
description: Shino and Kazuto are employed as detectives in a police organization that is part of the island country Sakura. The two have known each other since they were children, but during the last few years, Kazuto has been acting strange. Rumors of Kazuto being obsessed with Shino have formed within the jurisdiction. After requesting to be transferred to the same department as Shino, and forcibly getting involved in an investigation, he kisses Shino and pushes him into getting into a sexual relationship

title: Kami no Caveira
author: Amase, Shiori
description:
Tobias is a recruit from BOPE who has his ideals put to the test when he sees his Captain, Shindo, doing everything to accomplish his missions.

(Source: Hyakuro Translations)

title: Siren
author: Yamazaki, Sayaka
description: Manga centers around two officers in the police's mobile investigation team: Shinobu Satomi and Yuki Inokuma. The two are partners and also lovers. At the site of a bizarre murder, they meet Kara Tachibana, a mysterious and beautiful woman, and from there, her derangement begins to derail their investigation.

title: Life... and Then Some
author: Otomi, Chisa
description: Nishiono Keiji is a detective partnered to the beautiful-faced Takatoo. After being sent on a mission to pretend to be lovers, would their relationship exceed that of normal work partners?

title: Kurogane
author: Hirakata, Masahiro
description:
Kurogane the samurai loyally serves a girl who once saved his life but he makes nothing but trouble.

This one shot is not related to the series Kurogane.

title: Happiness
author: Jin, Chul-Soo, Park, Si-hyun, Jung, Seok-hyun, Guma, Choi, Yoon-jong
description:
Saebom, a Sergeant of the Special Forces, and Ihyeon, a Detective Sergeant of Saeyang Police Station, are high school friends who enter into a marriage of convenience so that they can qualify to buy an apartment together, while a mysterious and seemingly contagious virus tears through their city of Saeyang. Saebom and Ihyeon move into their dream home only to find that the new virus that turns people violent and thirsty for blood has come knocking at their door.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Gaksital
author: Heo, Young Man
description:
There's a rumor about a mysterious freedom fighter who wears a Korean Bridal Mask and goes around fighting injustice and dealing out righteous judgement. This mysterious Korean hero is known as "Gaksital."

There lives two Korean brothers, Lee Kang-To and Lee Kang-San. Lee Kang-To serves as a Japanese police in Korea and devotedly serves and respects Japan while seemingly betraying his origins. Meanwhile his brother is a loyal Korean patriot who was beat down so severely by the Japanese police t

title: Charisma
author: Nishizaki, Taisei, Shindou, Fuyuki, Yashioji, Tsutomo

title: Doberman Deka
author: Buronson, Hiramatsu, Shinji
description: The protagonist of the story is Joji Kano, a detective employed by the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department's special crimes division, which handles serious criminal cases. His gun of choice is a customized .44 Magnum-caliber Ruger Blackhawk. Even though Kano and his co-workers are criticized by the media and society, he doesn't mind the criticism at all. Even though Kano has no pity for serious criminals, he holds a gentle respect for children and elderly people, as well as former criminals who

title: The Hooligan and the Night Patrol
author: Nangoku
description:
Aspiring police officer Makoto is currently paying his dues at the Kabukicho police substation. Bustling Kabukicho is no walk in the park, especially with customer-luring Ren. Makoto struggles to stay professional in the face of this hooligan. After a drunken night, he awakens to a pleasant, but confusing, surprise from Ren.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Ammo
author: Yamamoto, Atsuji
description: The overall plot seems to involve a war between Chinese and Japanese gangs. A police-themed action comic whose titular character is Ammo the policewoman, who seems to be tracking down a serial killer preying on prostitutes.

title: Spec: Rei
author: Ryou, Haruto, Nishiogi, Yumie, Ueda, Hiroki
description: Most people in this world utilize only 10% of their brains. There are some, however, who can tap into the remaining unused 90%, and draw out powers that appear supernatural to most others. These powers are called "SPEC."

title: Yuumon no Hate
author: Sanbun, Kyouden
description:
Police women become sex slaves through drugs. 

(Source: MU)

title: Dirty Pair Flash
author: Makihara, Hisato
description:
A compilation of five manga stories.

(Source: MU)

title: The Honey Trappers
author: Yamaguchi, Masakazu
description: Stationed in the country side, Sawajiri Ai, a new recruit to the police force, didn't think she would ever see any kind of action. So it comes as a shock to her when she is transferred to headquarters into a division she has never even heard about: the 82nd division. Also known as the "Beauty Division,"—the female officers all are gorgeous woman with extraordinary talent and skills. They use their God-given body to infiltrate and crush criminal organizations and wanted men. Ai has her work cut o

title: Wilderness
author: Itou, Akihiro
description:
Wilderness concerns several Japanese nationals on the run in Mexico, and is heavily inspired by Hong Kong action cinema and the films of Robert Rodriguez.

(Source: Wikipedia)

title: Face
author: Nishida, Higashi
description:
1-2. Face
3. Sore wa Himitsu ni Shiteokitai (Let's Keep it a Secret)
4-6. Ai wa Nai (Not Love)
7. Tengoku mo Jigoku mo Bangaihen (All of Heaven and Hell)

title: Ooru
author: Hanyunyuu, Jun
description: Kouzou Sanou is a famous mangaka stressed by the end of his weekly manga series isolates himself in a peaceful village, but a editor from his previous magazine wants to try to convince him to try a new series. Somehow they are involved with yakuza and murder cases.

title: Court of Puppets
author: Ryu, Hoon, Ji, Chang-geun
description: Detective Woojin Seo lives in an era where machines can prosecute criminals. Faced with Woojin's murderous temper and obsession with bringing down the cartels, his supervisors place him under disciplinary probation and begin to rely on the machines to enact justice. But he's given an opportunity to lift his suspension as an educational navigator to "Magnum," a military-grade android, that people derogatorily refer to as "C.O.P." or "Court of Puppet." Will this unlikely pair have what it takes to

title: Eden
author: Hocco
description: Undercover NIS agent Seonwu Park is disguised as a café owner in an affluent neighborhood to investigate a drug ring. When he stumbles upon a lead about a drug-fueled party, he infiltrates it under the guise of delivering coffee. However, a lapse in judgement leads him to the brink of disaster until a cafe regular Yohan Seo rescues him. As the heat of the moment escalates, Seonwu and Yohan find themselves entwined in an unexpected physical connection. Realizing that Yohan might have crucial info

title: Government Crime Investigation Agent Zaizen Jotaro
author: Watanabe, Yasuhiro, Kitashiba, Ken
description:
Absolute power corrupts in all ages and all administrations. This is a never-ending truth. The iron fist of graft in the velvet glove of government-run enterprise continues to expand the power of money-mad politicians and bureaucrats who abuse their authority, deceive the citizens, and line their pockets with financial kickbacks.

The newly established Government Crime Investigation Agency (GCIA) vows to prosecute political corruption and uproot the evil that police and the courts have failed to

title: Double Decker! Doug & Kirill
author: Sakakibara, Mizuki
description: The once peaceful city-state of Lisvalletta has found itself beset by a dangerous new drug called Anthem. The side effects of the drug allow the user to enter a state of Overdrive, wherein they mutate into superpowered beasts with inhuman abilities. With the police powerless to stop this new threat, the responsibility falls upon the Special Crime Investigation Unit SEVEN-O. To offset the dangers of this work, the investigators work under the patented "Double Decker" system, which requires them t

title: Matorism: Case Files of a Narcotics Agent
author: Suzuki, Masakazu
description:
Follows a pair of "Matoris," police officers from the Japanese Ministry of Health, Labor, and Welfare who work in drug enforcement.

(Source: MANGA.TOKYO)

title: Hell Buster: Hunter of the Hellsects
author: Maki, Kouji
description:
After miraculously surviving an injury that brought him to the brink of death, police detective Reichi Imawai finds he is followed by an ominous, deathly presence. What’s more, that presence starts giving him orders...

(Source: Media Do International/Beaglee)

title: Heisei Policemen!!
author: Inaba, So-he-
description: Chronicles the daily life of a policeman extremely quiet and reasonable ... too much for their chosen profession. Of course all his superiors just climbing the walls with its tranquility.

title: Deka ni Romance
author: Tobidase, Kevin
description:
1. Deka ni Romance (Police Romance)
2. Deka ni Love Romance
3. Shiawase na Ookami (The Wolf's Happiness)
4-5. Jack-O'-Lantern

title: Gekijouban Psycho-Pass
author: Fukami, Makoto
description: In July 2116, the Southeast Asia Union (SEAUn) and the Japanese government begin to export the Sibyl System to the coastal town of Shambala Float during a civil war as an experiment in spreading the system throughout the world. Under Sibyl's rule, Shambala Float achieves temporary peace and safety, but when SEAUn sends terrorists to Japan, now able to slip through the Sibyl System and attack Japan from within, the shadow of a certain man falls on the incident and Inspector Akane Tsunemori must l

title: VS - Kitakantou Renzoku Youjo Yuukai Satsujin Jiken no Shinjitsu
author: Takano, Hiroshi, Tachibana, Kenichi
description: True story about one of the greatest miscarriages of justice, the case had Sugaya raises serious concerns about the functioning of justice in Japan. Back on the survey investigation.

title: Mammoth
author: Buronson, Konari, Takaki
description: When gentle giant police officer Ippei Hyodo is forced to witness the brutal murder of both his younger sister and police partner, the gentle "Elephant" becomes a "Mammoth" overnight and goes above the law to slowly pick off each man standing between him and his loved one's assassin.

title: Dragon's Patrol Officer
author: Sumiya, Zeniko
description:
A world where humans and fantasies coexist... A human police officer, Hagi Ogihara, patrols the city today with his fellow dragon police officer, Hinagiku! The odd couple of a careless good-for-nothing human and a scary looking but earnest and gentle dragon are on the case!

(Source: LINE Digital Frontier, translated)

title: Eiyuu Densetsu: Zero no Kiseki - Yotsu no Ummei
author: Matsuryu, Tazawa, Daisuke
description: The "Zero no Kiseki RPG" official novel and past episodes that were not mentioned in the game, about the hero of Ao no Kiseki of secret military support [Division] member, in the game, such as the back of the scene name was drawn.

title: Incubus who has too much love
author: Watashiya, Kaworu

title: Nishikida Keibu wa Dorobou ga Osuki
author: Kanba, Mayuko
description:
Jack the Phantom Thief travels the world stealing extravagant treasures, but the most outrageous thing he's stolen was something he never wanted in the first place: the heart of the eccentric Inspector Nishikida, who's in charge of capturing him. Jack, whose real name is Anri, joins the police force to gain access to inside information, and hijinks ensue between the two of them both on and off the job.

Included one-shot:
Volume 1: Santa Claus wa Iru ni wa Iru ga

title: Eiyuu Densetsu: Zero no Kiseki
author: Ichikawa, Takeo, Kashiwa
description:
Lloyd, Elie, Tio, and Randy was assigned to the Crossbell police department in the "Secret Military Support Section". They will confront ordeals in order to correct the darkness of Crossbell, but the "wall" of reality in the city that stands in the way corruption is there.

Based of the video game by the same name Eiyuu Densetsu: Zero no Kiseki.

title: Cult on Demand: Sennyuu Sousakan to 8-nin no Joyuu-tachi
author: Ooishi, Hiroto, Koroshino, Takana

title: Psycho-Pass 3: First Inspector
author: Kanan, Len
description:
Tokyo, 2120. In a society overseen by the Sibyl System, Inspectors Arata Shindou and Kei Mikhail Ignatov of the Criminal Investigation Department's Unit One clash over truth and justice. Kouichi Azusawa, the mastermind behind a string of crimes, sets his sights on the CID itself and launches an assault on the NONA Tower. Division 01 (a.k.a. Unit One) is in peril like never before—a case that will try Shindou and Ignatov's loyalties.

(Source: Psycho-Pass Wiki)

title: Bloody Angels
author: Mizutani, Naoki
description: A manga which follows the lives and experiences of a couple female police officers.

title: Something Evil
author: Uchida, Mikage
description:
Early in the fourth decade of the Showa Period Japan was finally recovering from the destruction of the war, and everyone was focused on nothing more than keeping themselves alive in the chaos.

Chihiro Shindo, the eccentric detective who enjoys observing, meets the beautiful yet crazy boy named Shinobu Hasama. "If you kill someone, you have to come here, don't you?" he says.

(Source: MU)

title: The Young Bandit
author: Yoshida, Sensha
description: A story combining baseball and banditry in a truly unusual fashion.

title: Kakuritsu Sousakan Mikoshiba Gakuto: Misshitsu no Game
author: Kaminaga, Manabu
description: Niizuma Tomoki has been re-assigned to the Special Investigations Counter-Measures Unit after her one month suspension. This basement unit only has two others assigned?! The future of police is entrusted in the hands of the pretty-faced young mathematician called Mikoshiba Gakuto. Objectively weighing the truth of cases from a mathematical approach. Clearly and splendidly exposing the depths of the human heart with numbers!

title: Code Geass: Mukei no Arthur Case File - Beginning
author: Azano, Kouhei, Sakusha2
description: Revolutionary calendar year 98, imperial calendar year 1887, summer. Two young men met in a corner of London. One is Conan Watson, a college student who dreams of becoming a doctor and has just left the countryside for the first time in several years. And the other is Arthur Holmes, an eccentric young man who calls himself an inventor and is driven by his own curiosity. The two of them ended up living together because of a mischief of fate or something else that happened. After a certain inciden

title: Kandou sareta node Tanteiya Hajimemasu! Jitsu wa Boukoku no Joou da nante Naisho desu
author: Nagase, Sarasa, Kamikou, Chizu
description: When it comes to light that Octavia de Reine isn't a legitimate member of the noble House of Reine, she swiftly finds herself disowned. At first she takes this in stride...until her power hungry father and ex-suitor start vying for the house full of mysterious heirlooms that her doting grandmother left her. Little does her family know that she's destined to inherit an even greater legacy. Olivia hopes to follow in Granny's footsteps and become a famous detective, after all! She'll face off again

title: Carbonator
author: Muragimo, Atsuhito
description:
On Earth, everything is constructed with carbon as its basis; we are all carbon based life-forms. As a child, Jacob's father often told him to become just like carbon. It seemed just a bit ridiculous, but was it really?

(Source: MU, edited)

title: Jihad
author: Satomi, Kei, Izuki, Keigo
description: Sakuragi Kasuyoshi recently retired from his career as a bodyguard and is now prepare to get married with his girlfriend. However, she got kidnapped a night before the wedding take place.

title: forced HERO
author: Miyashita, Hiroki
description: Mitsuru Aota, an average Japanese worker, finds himself implicated in testing the government's new legal system. Along with five other randomly selected citizens, they have to apprehend and judge criminals caught red-handed, with the help of the police and an high-tech suit designed especially for this task.

title: Ultra Red
author: Noguchi, Takashi, Nishimura, Junkou
description: Noriyuki Inou is a bright and promising young officer for the JSDF Investigation Division. Among his peers, he is considered especially capable—an expert combatant and highly intelligent operative, though quiet and brooding. His talent is noticed by Hiroaki Nakagou, Chief of the Special Branch for the Tokyo Met Police, and is scouted to join. On his way to meet his sister in Shinjuku for dinner, Inou must run to save her as chaos descends on Shinjuku and it becomes engulfed in explosions and dea

title: Seigi!!
author: Sato, Hideto
description: In a distant future, Natsuzawa Natsu and Morizaki Yuki are two reckless and unlucky police girls who get into a mess everyday. Their department was about to add mecha soldiers into the force, but everything goes wrong when these robots start going berserk. Now, they must solve the case while dealing with a shady organization known as the Dark Devils, composed by people with unnatural powers and abilities.

title: Psycho-Pass 3
author: Yoshigami, Ryou
description: Centered around two rookie inspectors of the Ministry of Welfare's Public Safety Bureau (MWPSB); Arata Shindou and Kei Mikhail Ignatov. These two inspectors are confronted with an ever changing society under the jurisdiction of the all knowing and impartial system of collective consciousness known as Sibyl and a contradiction that exists solely to evince the imperfections of the Sibyl system. Contending with an increasing anti immigrant sentiment, political intrigue, as well as peculiar individu

title: Ashiato Tantei
author: Sonoda, Yuri
description:
In Japan, 80,000 people a year disappear. In this socially themed drama about a duo of detectives, the new recruit Mugino and the brilliant Terasaki set about to find a wide range of missing persons. Under their detective agency's banner of "Specialists in finding people," the two use the evidence left behind and the psychology of the missing as clues, becoming ever-more involved in a battle of wits and test of wills with the missing who have their various reasons to not be found.

(Source: Japa

title: Gyakuten Saiban: Sono "Shinjitsu", Igi Ari!: Gyakuten Tokkyuu, Kita e
author: Kageyama, Naoyuki

title: Night Bird
author: Satomi, Kei
description:
At midnight, when everyone is on their bed, it's time for one man who will transform himself into a charming thief, the mysterious "Night Bird."

Night Bird is a professional high profile thief who can built and used gadgets to steal. Along with his wit, his intuition and his fighting skill, he always manage to get away from the police.

title: Baski
author: Jin, Chul-Soo, Byun, Ki-Hyun
description:
A bank heist... committed by people with superpowers. When this news reaches police officer Young-In Jin, he suspects it could be linked to a meteorite crash he saw with his friends years ago. What are his childhood friends hiding? And why does he suddenly wake up in a strange room? As he digs deeper into the case, some shocking truths are revealed...

(Source: Manta)

title: High-heel Cop
author: Yamato, Waki
description:
Yuuta's grandmother died and on the last day of his grandmother's funeral, amidst the gossip of the relative about who will adopt him, someone spoke it out loud "I will raise this kid." Who's she? She is Meguri Ichiko, the main character of this series.

With posh brand named clothes and her attitude, no one would believe at first that she's a detective, an assistant inspector for the Narcotic Department for the Metropolitan Police Department. Aside from her work, Ichiko does take another thing

title: SP - Keishichou Keigobu Keigoka Daiyon-gakari
author: Haibara, Yaku, Kaneshiro, Kazuki
description: An alternative story to the TV drama SP series, a Japanese television drama based on the real life security police unit of Japan which is responsible for protecting domestic and foreign VIPs.

title: Detective Conan the Movie: Sunflowers of Inferno
author: Abe, Yutaka, Aoyama, Goushou, Maru, Denjirou
description: Manga adaptation of the nineteenth Meitantei Conan movie.

title: Private Investigators of Love
author: Sorai, Mone
description: Problems in love? Don't go to these guys!! A fledgling private eye and his high-strung pretty-boy partner to the rescue! Ginpei Matsuda joined the Natsume Private Investigators to be the "exemplary P.I." he always dreamed of becoming. But his repeated slip-ups earn him nothing but ire from his cruel, cold, and frightening partner, Shun Enomoto. One day, the odd couple take a case to find a young boy's long-lost first-love, and then...!? A labyrinth of love lies just ahead. This frustratingly-tan

title: Joker Series
author: Michihara, Katsumi, Maki, Yuu
description:
Joker is a genetically engineered shape-and-gender-shifter, who created as part of a Special Police Task Force and fights crime of all kinds, but he/she also fits in a little romance around the edges.

(Source: AniDB)

title: Detective Conan the Movie: Quarter of Silence
author: Abe, Yutaka, Aoyama, Goushou, Maru, Denjirou
description: Manga adaptation of the fifteenth Meitantei Conan movie.

title: Your Honor! How About a 4 Year Sentence?
author: Matsuhashi, Inusuke, Kitao, Toro
description: Kitao Taro had a chance to attend court hearing while he was tasked to supervise the maintenance of air condition in a court. After his first hearing, he was fascinated by the realism he felt during the hearing and became a fan.

title: Isekai Kenja no Mazoku Hanzai Chousa
author: Nakajima, Yutaka

title: Wild Dog Misfire
author: Yonghyun, Kim, Junghyun
description:
After his divorce and demotion, Detective Yoon thinks life can't possibly get worse. That is, until his sister asks him to move in with her fiancé Junggu, a former bombmaker trying to get a fresh start. But just as the two misfits become flatmates, Junggu's past comes to haunt him with a bang.

(Source: Manta)

title: Tiny x Machinegun
author: Ninomiya, Ai, Suzuki, Izo
description:
The safest city in the world, New York City. At the top of the police force, Captain Vaneast's police officer Tiny McDaniel works day and night to become a hero that protects the city. She aims to be recognized by her older brother Reigand Mcdaniel, a Vaneast Hero who is often at the frontlines, but as the days go by she has yet to be assigned a decent mission.

Then one day, a black angel descends on New York City to create a nightmare.
Suddenly, bullets are flying in the world's safest city, i

title: Detective Conan the Movie: The Fist of Blue Sapphire
author: Abe, Yutaka, Aoyama, Goushou, Maru, Denjirou
description: Manga adaptation of the twenty-third Meitantei Conan movie.

title: Detective Conan the Movie: The Bride of Halloween
author: Abe, Yutaka, Aoyama, Goushou, Maru, Denjirou
description: Manga adaptation of the twenty-fifth Meitantei Conan movie.

title: Kuramerukagari
author: Tsukahara, Shigeyoshi, SanaTsu
description: This is a story that weaves together people and a town. A coal mining town crowded with small-scale excavators, commonly known as the "Hakoniwa." In this town that changes daily like a labyrinth, there's a girl named Kagari who runs a mapmaking business and a boy named Yuya who dreams of breaking free from the "Hakoniwa." Eventually, the two, along with the unique residents of the town, find themselves confronting a conspiracy that shakes the entire town. The fate of the" Hakoniwa" depends on Ka

title: The Silver: Case #4.5 - Face
author: Korekata, Naoko, Miyamoto, Takashi
description: Applying to join the Administrative Inspection Office, Sakura Natsume, the protagonist, embarks upon six months of training. As part of her training programme, Sakura is tasked with writing reports about unusual crimes. During this process, she interviews Sumio Kodai, a former detective who is now being held in police custody after committing a crime of conscience. "If you don't connect with the darkness inside yourself you can't understand criminals, and you can't become an investigator." Sakur

title: Guard Dog
author: Asakura, Ryou, Kutsugi, Kenichi
description: The story of a private detective that resolves crimes and defends random women that fall in love with him.

title: Karigari!
author: Furukawa, Shiori
description:
Kirishima Mel seems like your ordinary high school girl, however, she is also part of a special investigation team called "K9"—under the direct control of the National Police Agency! With her katana in hand, Mel must take on serious incidents in secret.

But what happens with this one incident!?

(Source: CoyoMoose)

title: Strange Moon
author: Kazaana
description:
"S Division," a separate division created within the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department investigates crimes impossible to explain with science, and with links to mysterious creatures.

(Source: MU)

title: Keiji Yugami
author: Iura, Hideo
description:
The manga centers on slovenly police detective Yukimasa Yugami, and his search for "true justice" as he tackles mysterious crimes and cases that he encounters in the criminal investigation department.

(Source: ANN)

title: Immoral: The Sexual Crime Investigation Squad
author: Sakabe, Shuuichi
description: A nude female body was found in Shibuya, with traces of sexual intercourse on the it. Four women from the Sexual Crime Investigation Squad began to investigate the case, but as they digged deeper into the incidence, they themselves got dragged into the heart of this dark event...

title: Sukeban Deka Who Leapt Through Time
author: Muronaga, Saori
description:
Based on Shinji Wada's Sukeban Deka manga, the Toki wo Kakeru Sukeban Deka manga's story centers on a high school girl named Tomoe, who is talented in karate, but lacks self-confidence and has a timid personality. She gets involved in a riot one day, and a mysterious man tells her to become a Sukeban detective. Tomoe travels across time and space, and meets another Sukeban detective, Saki Asamiya.

(Source: ANN)

title: Focus
author: Chagyo, Yucheong
description:
When I was a kid, there was an older guy that I really liked. He was the only light in my world, but that light plunged me into darkness. Even so, I still yearned for him. Even if I was angry at him, but I still loved him. For 14 years... 

"Why don't you use me, why don't you need me? Why do you keep driving me crazy?" 

"Why do you care about such trivial things?" 

After meeting him, my childhood memories and my true nature started to resurface. I tried desperately to avoid him, but I became

title: Omega's Case File: I Gave Birth to This Baby.
author: Kobaco, Aki
description: Included one-shot: Love Laboratory

title: Deka to Hannin no Otome Game Tensei: Hoshi wa Kouryaku Taishou no Naka
author: Sayo, Ichi

title: Layton Mystery Tanteisha: Katri no Nazotoki File
author: Orito, Kahori
description:
The Layton Detective Agency, a business that helps its clients solve unusual mysteries, is run by Katrielle Layton—daughter of the world-renowned archaeology professor Hershel Layton. Together with her assistant Noah Montoir and talking dog Sherl, Katrielle finds herself unraveling cases involving a newly purchased cursed house, a dress imbued with a "demon's curse," and the zombie of a client's deceased spouse, just to name a few.

Aside from her more quirky cases, Katrielle has been working on

title: Murim Investigation Unit
author: Lee, Choong-Ho
description:
n a town where martial artists - known as "Murim users" - run amok in the underworld, the Murim Investigation Unit, a group of elite martial arts practitioners, acts as a suppression and investigation force. The story begins when one of the senior members comes across a thuggish young man beating up a bunch of gangsters, and decides to bring him in. 

(Source: MU)

title: Great Horse
author: Takahashi, Yoshihiro
description: Great Horse tells the story of detective Soga Kenji, who while being an elite takes it upon himself to investigate a dangerous weapon smuggling criminal ring.

title: Casebook of Kurumi Tokisaki, Magic Detective
author: Tachibana, Koushi, Tsunako
description: Artifacts—magical tools with abilities that surpass human understanding. After dozens of these powerful items are stolen, supernatural crimes begin happening all over Tengu City. Luckily, one girl can solve them all: magic detective Kurumi Tokisaki. Along with her companion Matsurika, Kurumi attempts to unmask the dastardly thief, and in the process, retrieve the Artifacts. However, as each incident is resolved, the identity of their mysterious perp only becomes less and less clear. How will the

title: BUD: Kokkyou Mikakutei Ryouiki Sangoku Sousaroku
author: Wakao, Kazuhiro, Pon

title: Hawk Jack
author: Izaki, Yasuka
description:
Contains several short stories:

1.  Hawk Jack
2.  Misdirection
3.  Nondescript
4.  Mamotte Agetai

title: Sekigan no Shoujo
author: pikomaro, Maya, Yutaka
description:
Sugaru, a remote village that doesn’t even appear on any maps. In this village, there were daughters of a family that inherited the power of a god for more than a thousand years. They were called "Sugaru-sama" and ruled the village for generations.

In 1985, a girl who was a candidate to be Sugaru-sama's successor is found dead with her head cut off. Detective Misasagi Mikage, a beautiful girl with a jade left eye wearing a suikan, takes on the case. Mikage, whose mother is a legendary detective

title: Mr. Boy
author: Yamamoto, Atsuji
description:
Centered around around a feminine-looking young man called Boy, who works as an undercover investigator for the police. His work usually requires him to disguise as a woman.

(Source: MU)

title: Shikeishuu Sousakan: Akutagawa Kai no Jikenbo
author: Yamazaki, Kyou
description: Akutagawa is a death row inmate convicted of 15 counts of murder, though he insists on his innocence. He has a deal with the police: every time he solves a case, his execution is postponed for another day.

title: Sukeban Deka Pretend
author: Hosokawa, Shingi
description:
A spinoff of Shinji Wada's Sukeban Deka manga, Sukeban Deka Pretend centers on Asami, a cheerful girl who attends Takanoha High School. The story begins when she encounters a mysterious yo-yo and a mysterious girl.

(Source: ANN, edited)

title: The Silver Case
author: Suda, Goichi, Takeya, Syuji
description: A prequel one-shot to the visual novel Silver Jiken (The Silver Case), taking place directly before Case #0: Lunatics.

title: Go! The Policeman
author: Sakazaki, Toshiki
description:
Contains several stories:

1.Go! The Policeman
2.Like a Mutation
3.Hanamaru Kids

title: The Case File of Kindaichi Papa
author: Kibayashi, Shin, Satou, Fumiya

title: KOBAN
author: Ishikawa, Chika
description: This is the earliest Koban work and contains Cases 1-11 and a side story about Hanazono that were published in either Jump SQ or as doujinshi.

title: Hold Up Kids
author: Kotani, Kenichi
description:
Kai Masayoshi and Fuwa Masami are smart-aleck detectives. They try to act like the cops from Miami Vice but they aren’t quite cool enough to pull it off. After one arrest that goes wrong their captain adds a third to their group, motorcycle cop Morinaga Mai, a pretty young cop who kicks Fuwa in the groin when he tries to come on to her. They get along just fine after that.

But unfortunately, the drink they take together to toast their new partnership is actually a youth serum created by a mad s

title: The Killer's Interview
author: Gyeongu, Tadat, Kim, Suhyeon
description:
Hajun, who lost his parents and lived with his grandmother, has become a police officer to uncover the truth behind his parents' deaths, but life as a patrol officer is far from the detective career he once dreamed of. It's nothing but exhausting.

"I wish legendary detectives would appear and give me a clue about the case."

Feeling frustrated, he visits the old vinyl house where he once lived with his parents... There, he finds a book that belongs to his father. When he opens the book, what ap

title: Rich Police Cash
author: Kuroda, Sakuya
description:
The manga follows a policeman named Cash who resolves anything and everything with the power of money.

(Source: ANN)

Included one-shot:
Volume 1: Kamigeki!

title: Cthulu Mythos police 24
author: Hakase, Atarime
description:
The "psychic battle story" centers on Tsurushige (in the game, the avatar is either a male or female), a person who awakens one day and finds that they have acquired psychic powers. They receive a red letter from the government, drafting them into a secret "special squad" within the police force, and they begin to face mythical events.

(Source: ANN)

title: Sheriff
author: Aro, Hiroshi
description:
Set in the distant future, the world has undertaken a reform where the police organisation, as a whole, dissolved, and the local police and Metropolitan Police Department officially semi-privatised. Policemen are now called as "Sheriff" and hired by people as security against criminals. Money is given to those who catch the criminals, and this starts the boom of bounty hunters or simply called "Hunters". In comes the lazy sheriff Isuka Shinnosuke, who is hired by Yazama town's mayor.

[Written b

title: Tantei Reijou Julia Moriarty: Seibetsu mo Mibun mo Kawarimashita ga, Tenseisaki demo Tanteigyou Saikai shimasu
author: Oono, Imo
description:
Solve this case: "Why did the detective become a young lady?"

While investigating a certain case, detective Nogami suffers a fatal injury. Just when he thinks he has died, he is somehow reincarnated into another world as Julia Moriarty, the daughter of an earl...!!

​How could this happen? While grappling with this mystery, Julia uses the power of "Retrocognition" (seeing the past) to confront various incidents as a detective lady. An isekai reincarnation mystery featuring a detective-turned-no

title: Detective Wolf and the Awakening Sage
author: Azuma, Midori, Yoshibirokou
description:
The story is set in Japan, 700 years after the age of swords and magic, where science has replaced magic. Social problems caused by magic and magical beasts are on the rise, and the Metropolitan Police Department establishes the Metropolitan Police Department's Magical Beast Control Division to deal with them. Kamishima, a werewolf (lycanthrope), is investigating a horrific case as a detective in the Magical Beast Control Division.

Meanwhile, the great elven sage Sajuel, who had been asleep for

title: Buddy Cat
author: Bukiyama
description:
Eight, a cool and handsome Hachiware cat, and Mike, a sturdy tortoiseshell cat. The two don't seem to mesh with each other but they are the strongest duo, standing up against evil!

(Source: Shounen Gahousha, translated)

title: The boy who came from the kingdom
author: Kamino, Okina, Mattaku, Mousuke

title: Sasaki Agency Series
author: Roka, Kouen
description: There's a reason Emi Shimamoto can't find a job. For as long as she can remember, she's been unable to tell the living from the dead. Resigned to yet another failure, she attends an interview with Moriya Foods, only to find herself strangely attracted to its young president and more determined than ever to get the position.
