Meanwhile, Emi’s brother senses that there is more going on with his sister than meets the eye, and he pays a visit to a certain agency that specializes in matters of the sup

title: Keishichou Soushi: Fuutarou Meiji Gekijou
author: Yamada, Fuutarou, Azuma, Naoki
description:
In the first years of the Meiji era, when Tokyo still named Edo, Senba Heishirou, a former policeman at the Minami-cho magistrate's office, was leading an uneventful life as the kept lover of a geisha. Until he is consulted for a murder case...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Habou no Wadachi: Kouan Chousachou Chousakan Hase Kuuya
author: Nagate, Yuka
description:
The spy suspense manga's story centers on Japan's weakest intelligence agency, as they take on a national defense crisis.

(Source: ANN)

title: Lovers, Cats, and the Killer
author: Jangvanoo, MI-KE
description:
Police trainee Mooyoon starts his career in law enforcement in a quiet suburban town only to notice stray cats and dogs disappear mysteriously. A joint rescue operation between the police station and the fire station brings him close to Taeyi, a young firefighter who happens to be his next-door neighbor. Together, the two begin to track down leads that unravel a much larger menace.

As the mystery intensifies, their bond only grows stronger... until an unthinkable tragedy strikes.

(Source: Lezh

title: Sono Mogari wa Netsu wo Shiranai
author: Nicomichihiro

title: The Manga Guide to Cryptography
author: Hinoki, Iderow
description:
Inspector Jun Meguro has been tasked with tracking down a crafty art thief who leaves clues in the form of perplexing cryptographic puzzles. Lucky for him, his sister Ruko is a math whiz who is willing to teach him about cryptography so that he can crack the case. But can they decode the thief’s ciphers before she steals again?

(Source: No Starch Press)

title: Ayakashi Utahime Karuta
author: Katayama, Shuu, Kudou, Osamu
description:
Detective Akutsu and a high school boy named Shino have recently taken notice of strange occurrences in Shibuya regarding disappearances of high school teenage girls. Shino believes that this may be related to a recent rumor regarding a demon girl named Karuta. The main question is though, is she an ally... or an enemy?

(Source: MU)

title: Detective Conan the Movie: Magician of the Silver Sky
author: Abe, Yutaka, Aoyama, Goushou, Maru, Denjirou
description: Manga adaptation of the eighth Meitantei Conan movie.

title: Bicycle 3000
author: Oh, Se-hyung
description: We follow with anguish the evolution of the investigation and the revelations about this ordinary family. The suspect: a teenager, a bit simple-minded, who works as a fishmonger and goes to the family's daughter. Who, when, where, how? The teen is questioned by the police.

title: Keishichou Tokumubu Tokushu Kyouakuhan Taisakushitsu Dainanaka: Tokunana
author: Namazakana

title: Divine Incursions
author: Kifuru, Oumi
description: In this world, there exist divine beings beyond mortal comprehension. To them, the concepts of good and evil mean nothing. From destructive physical manifestations to the manipulation of dreams and warps in the very fabric of reality, the gods continuously threaten peace across Japan. And humans are completely at their mercy. Agent Katagishi and his junior partner Miyagi belong to a secret government organization tasked with investigating supernatural incidents. It's their job to handle cases in

title: Love Millefeuille
author: Hua Xin
description:
Wang Husky and Zhang Bernard are childhood friends who work in the same Private Detective Agency. But their main job duty is to investigate sweets?! Couple that with soft breaths and adorable animal ears, you get a detective story filled with adventure!

(Source: Tong Li, translated)

title: Detective versus Detectives
author: Matsuoka, Keisuke
description:
Sasaki Rena is a beautiful woman with excellent memory and intelligence. She becomes a private detective and risks her life to chase down evil private detectives, because her younger sister was murdered by a stalker. The person that provided information to the stalker on her sister's location was a private detective.

(Source: AsianWiki)

title: Heat Edge
author: Mochizuki, Reiko
description: Follow the story of Clancy Flint, a private detective, along with his 2 friends, the president of a research & investigation company and a lawyer,  go through a series of events.

title: The Killing Vote
author: Eom, Seyun, Jung, Ipum
description: Detective Joo Hyuk's ordinary life is flipped upside down on the day the killing vote begins, giving citizens a chance to punish killers that evaded punishment. Gaetal, the mysterious figure controlling this system, claims it's justice for the forgotten, while Hyuk and his team try but fail to prevent the deaths. With the increasing number of victims and growing support for the votes, will Hyuk be able to catch Gaetal and stop this madness? Or will he have to witness the demise of true justice?

title: Booyakasha!
author: Narumi, Hako
description: Despite his flashy looks, Detective Kai Kaburagi has a surprising soft side. When tasked with finding a missing college student, Kai's search leads him to a host—Ruka. There's just one catch: Ruka vanished from Kai's own detective agency a year ago with a lingering "I love you" that left Kai unsure if it was genuine. Annoying and fickle, Ruka might be a pain in the ass, but Kai can't seem to abandon him. They have an unbreakable bond that can't be described with just "messy" dating back to middl

title: The Citizen Police 69
author: Yanagisawa, Kimio
description:
In Tokyo, Japan crime is increasing at an alarming rate. In order to crack down on the rising crime rate a "citizen police" force is established. The "citizen police" force consists of ordinary people. One day, salaryman Hoichi is appointed as the 69th citizen police. Hoichi avoids his first mission. Instead, he stops by a convenience store for work and meets an employee there named Momoi. Hoichi's fate is changed by the meeting.

(Source: asianwiki.com)

title: A Troupe of "Twenty Faces" vs. Rainbow Parakeet
author: Nakatani, Chika
description:
The manga centers on expert stage mimic and conman Rainbow Parakeet, who comes into contact with the international crime syndicate the Troupe of Twenty Faces, who are experts at stealing fine art. A detective named Mariko Senri chases both of them in an attempt to bring them all to justice. 

(Source: Anime News Network)

title: Meitantei Madam Holmes
author: Nabeshima, Masaharu, Hanakouji, Yumi
description: Detective Wato has been assigned to the security team for a cruise ship party for celebrities where he meets Madam Holmes, a beautiful and intelligent young lady. But soon after the ship leaves the harbor, a group of terrorists take over the ship. However, Detective Wato soon learns that the entire terrorist attack was a setup masterminded by Madam Holmes to smoke out the real terrorist hiding amongst the guests. And to surprise him even more, he learns that Madam Holmes is actually the great gr

title: Makai Tantei Meiousei O
author: Akita, Yoshinobu, Otsuichi, Iruma, Hitoma, Maijou, Outarou, Mikage, Eiji, Origuchi, Yoshino, Aioi, Ion, Shinjou, Kazuma
description: Say, did you think that humans were the one standing at the top of the food chain? That's a great misunderstanding. The ones who are located at the top of hierarchy of this world are "them" who live inside the darkness. By no means do they come to the surface world, the one we humans live. What we understand about "them" is only that they absolutely hate having their existence to become known to human society. While there are some of "them" with a form resembling that of a human being, there are

title: Nazotoki wa Dinner no Ato de
author: Kawase, Aya, Higashikawa, Tokuya
description:
Reiko Houshou, heiress to a large conglomerate, seems like any other wealthy lady. However, not many people know that she is a rookie detective for the Kunitachi Police Department. In addition, she hides her identity from her incompetent boss, Kyouichirou Kazamatsuri, a flashy heir to his family's motor business.

During an investigation involving her college friends, Reiko has trouble identifying the culprit and their motive. Out of nowhere, a man approaches Reiko and introduces himself as Kage

title: Sword Art Online Alternative: Mystery Labyrinth - Murder in the Labyrinth Pavilion
author: Enta, Shiho, Konno, Tenryuu

title: Tantei Minarai Akio...
author: Murakami, Takashi
description:
Akio has changed his job for some reason, just as he is about to leave middle age. His new job is at a small detective agency, run by his childhood friend, Hirose. Akio and Hirose are curious buddies and they heal the hearts of their clients while solving difficult requests.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Detective Conan the Movie: The Scarlet Bullet
author: Abe, Yutaka, Aoyama, Goushou, Maru, Denjirou
description: Manga adaptation of the twenty-fourth Meitantei Conan movie.

title: Itan no Shukusai
author: Komen, Ieri, Roka, Kouen
description: There's a reason Emi Shimamoto can't find a job. For as long as she can remember, she's been unable to tell the living from the dead, and spirits have tormented her wherever she goes. Resigned to yet another failure, Emi attends an interview with Moriya Foods, only to find herself strangely attracted to its young president, Jan. Though it doesn't take Emi long to realize that something is off with both Jan and Moriya, she's far too smitten to care. Meanwhile, Emi's brother grows worried over his

title: Detective Conan the Movie: Private Eye in the Distant Sea
author: Abe, Yutaka, Aoyama, Goushou, Maru, Denjirou
description: Manga adaptation of the seventeenth Meitantei Conan movie.

title: Culinary de Tonguetive
author: Tsuchiyama, Shigeru
description:
The master of the Izakaya "Arakan" is also a famous detective. In accordance with the veteran police detective Numata's request, he joins the investigations. A grueling detective story blended lightly with cuisine and seasoned with some human drama.

(Source: Media Do International/Nihonbungeisha)

title: The Hanged Man Falls Into Ruin.
author: Fukui, Ken, Nanatsuki, Tamika

title: Minzoku Gakusha: Akasaka Yaichirou no Jikenbo
author: Yoshizaki, Seimu, Nagasaki, Takashi

title: Nazotoki wa Dinner no Ato de
author: Higashikawa, Tokuya
description:
Reiko Houshou, heiress to a large conglomerate, seems like any other wealthy lady. However, not many people know that she is a rookie detective for the Kunitachi Police Department. In addition, she hides her identity from her incompetent boss, Kyouichirou Kazamatsuri, a flashy heir to his family's motor business.

During an investigation involving her college friends, Reiko has trouble identifying the culprit and their motive. Out of nowhere, a man approaches Reiko and introduces himself as Kage

title: Tetsu to Ken
author: Okamura, Kenji, Kaji, Kengo
description:
Two buddies running a detective agency, all the mess they keep falling into and the overdue back rent: will our guys manage to make it through this potentially explosive mix?

(Source: MU)

Included one-shots:
Volume 3: Warae Tatsuo, Tabi Ichiza Yami Nezumi, Hybrid X Gokutou no Hakobune

title: Kodomo Keiji Memetan
author: Moriyama, Ippo
description:
Memetan, a detective who sports a yellow romper better than nobody else. This comic will leave you laughing in disbelief as it follows the bizarre daily life of the ever capable detective, Memetan, who despite being a baby, is unpredictable and is always chasing down criminals. Anybody who's anybody in Tottori-ken knows Memetan!

(Source: Comic Walker)

title: Hundred Note: Night Owl
author: Takarai, Hakaru
description:
The fastidious wimpy crybaby detective, Sumeragi Sento, and his twin assistants, Mete and Yunde Hoshibami, are cloaked in a dubious atmosphere. The detective agency "Night Owl" is willing to take on any request, depending on money and conditions. There is a girl whose organs have been stolen, a top dancer who has disappeared, and surrounded by the presence of money and violence, the Owl eats rats today.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Detective Conan the Movie: Black Iron Submarine
author: Abe, Yutaka, Aoyama, Goushou, Maru, Denjirou
description: Manga adaptation of the twenty-sixth Meitantei Conan movie.

title: Köln Shikei Odo
author: Aoike, Yasuko
description: Depicts Brother Odo's life as a law enforcement officer in Cologne before he became a monk.

title: To Read the Criminal Tells
author: Hayasaka, Gabu
description:
Inspector Amane Ooguro has just been reassigned to Investigation Division 6, which is considered a graveyard for police detectives transferred there. Disappointed to discover that her only partner is a slacker by the name of Ebisu Kei, she soon finds out that he has the ability to read the slightest change in facial expressions, or "Tells" as he calls it...

(Source: MU)

title: Ex-Arm: Another Code
author: Komi, Shinya, Kuma, Atarou
description:
2030, Tokyo. Minami, an officer in the EX-ARM Countermeasure Division, and Shiho, a junior officer in the traffic division, respond to a tip of a suspicious person and find a drug called "Happy" at the scene. By chance, they meet a mother in the vicinity who says her daughter was kidnapped, leading Minami to information related to "Alpha K," a new religious group that is rapidly gaining followers. Then, the EX-ARM task force is called in...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Memorist
author: Jaehoo
description:
With a single touch, Detective Dong Baek can read anyone's memory. Thanks to his supernatural skill, he's gotten cocky over his virtually flawless track record. But a mysterious serial killer ends up mystifying even his supernatural ability, and a genius criminal profiler is brought in to close the case. Dong Baek will have to swallow his pride and work with her if they want any hope of stopping the slaughter...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Vexations: Renzoku Ryouki Satsujin to Shingan Shoujo
author: Otarai, Zero
description:
A dismembered corpse of a naked woman was found on the riverbed at night. It soon turned out that the method of the case was very similar to the novel "Vexations" published in small copies 10 years ago. Investigator Kosaku Kurumiya's younger sister Reimi has a visual impairment. She has contributed to solving numerous bizarre cases by making full use of her sharpened sense and her reasoning power. Will she really get to the heart of an unprecedented case?

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Ryoji Renjo: Gourmet Detective
author: Katou, Tadashi
description:
Ryouji is just supposed to be that private detective everyone hires to solve their trivial personal cases. But why does he have this outstanding cooking skill that mesmerizes every cook he met in the investigation? What is his connection with the famous head from Togawa restaurant? Together with Aoi, the outgoing woman who's also a foodie, Ryouji spread his cooking skill that will bring more taste to Japan's urban culinary!

(Source: Torico)

title: Howling: The City of Nightmare
author: Hyeon, Jae-Kwon, Yuno
description:
Beautiful women are being targeted and horrifically killed by an unknown assailant. Cries for justice pour into the police department but the team assigned to the case is nowhere close to catching the evasive killer. But suddenly a reclusive young man with a mysterious ability arrives to offer his assistance and he may hold the key to finding the answers the police so desperately seek.

(Source: SpotToon)

title: Mitarai Kiyoshi Series
author: Shimada, Souji
description:
Japan, 1936. An old eccentric artist living with seven women has been found dead—in a room locked from the inside. His diaries reveal alchemy, astrology and a complicated plan to kill all seven women. Shortly afterwards, the plan is carried out: the women are found dismembered and buried across rural Japan.

By 1979, these Tokyo Zodiac Murders have been obsessing a nation for decades, but not one of them has been solved. A mystery-obsessed illustrator and a talented astrologer set off around the

title: Genei Shounen
author: Banjou, Daichi
description:
Satowa Akizuki has the strange ability to enter a person's mind, simply by touching them, and his friend Mizune sees his ability as an opportunity to make some cash! Together they've formed a unique detective agency. Their first customer, who is unlikely to fulfill Mizune's dreams of money, is a little girl looking for her missing father.

(Source: MU)

title: Helical Labyrinth
author: Natsu, Midori, Kikuta, Hiroyuki
description:
In Tokyo, a murderer leaves his signature, an "X" on the dead body. When found, the mark appears eerily similar to that of the one seen on the body of the dead wife of Detective Genji Andou. Banned from the investigation, he secretly reaches out to Jin Jinbo, an associate professor at the medical school's genome analysis lab. Who better than a DNA expert to identify this potential serial killer?

(Source: MyDramaList)

title: Hundred Note: Hawk Eyes
author: Ishiko
description:
The strongest king in the city of delinquents, who hates mini-tomatoes and noisy women. His true identity is Jin Shiba, a detective of the detective agency "Hawk Eyes" who possesses the unusual ability of clairvoyance. Working with him are Rui Monokai, a recorder, and Jedo Kareyanagi.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Frost Crack: Renzoku Sogeki Hannin no Suiri
author: Sigsawa, Keiichi, Kuroboshi, Kouhaku
description:
"Do you know about the serial sniper case happening in Japan?"

One day, a man living outside of Japan gets a sudden phone call from a young Japanese police officer, who informs him of a serial murder case involving hunting guns. The overseas man is a former hunter, so the police officer tells him the whole story in detail, asking for his cooperation. The ex-hunter, drawing his conclusions, exposes the criminal's tricks. At first, the police officer rejoices, but before long, he realizes that th

title: Ore no Sora: Keiji-hen
author: Motomiya, Hiroshi
description:
Ippei Yasuda is a rookie police officer. Unknown to his fellow officers, he is the son of a rich and influential family and fiancee to Hitomi Misaki, whose family also has political, business and yakuza connections. Ippei uses unorthodox methods (with little concern about the cost) to bring criminals to justice.

(Source: ANN)

Included one-shot:
Volume 7: Etsuko to Saburou

title: Insect Detective Yoshida Yoshimi
author: Aozora, Daichi
description: A manga about a private investigator that can talk to bugs, who takes on odd jobs from various insect clients.

title: Makai Tantei Meiousei O: Violin no V
author: Ayakawa, Takeshi

title: Sherlock: Her Majesty's Detective
author: Go, Kyung-Oh, Zohan, Gok
description:
A new take on a classic tale, Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Jane Watson attempt to solve a strange and supernatural death in a fictionalized version of 19th century Britain. With the country at war, Sherlock and Jane soon realize that they have uncovered an intricate network of secrets that leads to a much larger and more dangerous plan that puts the whole world at risk.

(Source: SpotToon)

title: Ex-Arm: The Novel - Deus Ex Machina
author: Komi, Shinya, Kuma, Atarou
description: Shin Kagurazaka, a town that escaped the Tokyo Olympic terrorist attacks. From general ikazayas, to sexbot-specialized brothels, or undergound gambling dens, it is regarded as a gigantic entertainment district where one can indulge in their pleasures. In this town, the EX-ARM Countermeasure Division receive reports of a "smuggler," and sends in Alma in an undercover operation. Her target of infiltration is a girl's bar. Meanwhile, Minami encounters a mother who asks for help in finding her daugh

title: Lost
author: Yatsume, Seiji
description:
He's off in search of a certain man's life... Harboring doubts about Dorry, a man he had previously arrested, inquisitive cop Yagi sets off to uncover his past, arriving at a town isolated by winter snow. Despite the town's hostility toward outsiders, he secures the cooperation of a local postman and an orphan with no last name, and begins his investigation...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title: Sto:Rage: Metropolitan Police Department Eye-Ball Investigation Team
author: Andou, Jirou
description:
2019, a year before the Tokyo Olympics. The police face mysterious murders involving burnt victims with missing eyes. Souta Aoba, the young inspector working on this case, must team up with Hitomi Tachibana in a very special unit: the Eyeball Investigation Team. Thanks to a revolutionary technology, this team can download the memory of the living and even the dead.

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Welcome Back, Papa
author: Semimaru
description:
A high school girl is trying to get obsessively close to her kind stepdad. Even going as far as watching him in bed with her mom.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Boku wa Kimitachi wo Shihai suru
author: Chida, Daisuke
description:
Seven women, one man, a suspenseful harem story!

During a class reunion, the school became an enclosed dimension without warning. Yelling and screaming brought no response. 26-year old unemployed Haruka Sato has to survive by cooperating with seven of his former classmates. Soon, the extreme conditions began to eat away at their sanity, and Haruka's hidden desires began to take hold.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kedamono-tachi no Jikan: Kyouizon Shoukougun
author: big brother
description: With her cute looks and successful career, fashion model Airi Hirakawa is content with her life—until she wakes up dazed and bruised, chained up in a room filled to the brim with trash. Her captor is Hirokazu Imai, a crazed stalker and fan who has been watching her for ages. He has her underwear, used sanitary pads, and now her as well. Before Airi is even given a chance to breathe, she is forced to marry Hirokazu. From then on, her days are filled with rape, brutality, and torture; but she neve

title: Joshikousei ni Korosaretai
author: Furuya, Usamaru
description:
The story centers around Higashiyama Haruto, a high school teacher, whose dearest wish is to be killed by a high school girl.

(Source: MU)

title: Diner
author: Kawai, Takanori, Hirayama, Yumeaki
description:
Kanako Ooba is a naive girl who works a menial, low-paying job. Hoping to make more money, she accepts the task of transporting an anonymous duo. Unbeknownst to her, the pair has stolen from a notorious yakuza group—resulting in the three being captured by the group members. Although Kanako always believed that she was living at rock bottom and would never escape it, this desperate situation makes her realize that she wants to live her life to the fullest.

As Kanako is about to be buried alive,

title: Blue Phobia
author: Tsuruyoshi, Eri
description:
After the discovery of a mysterious "sea ore" native to a particular island, the military becomes invested in harvesting the newfound resource. While prisoners on death row are tasked with the dangerous job of retrieving the ore from underwater, soldiers are enlisted to prevent any escapes.

The operation has already been running for 10 years by the time Credo arrives as one of the latest group of guards. However, he realizes that a certain young worker must have been born on the island and, wit

title: Legs That Won't Walk
author: Heuksalgu
description:
Retired boxer Soo-young discovers he has to pay off his father's debt when Tae-seung hunts him down. Fascinated by Soo-young's persistence, Tae-seung offers him an alternative—to learn the ropes and start from the rock bottom. Will this dangerous relationship work, or will this be another living hell for Soo-young?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Silent Miyashita-san's Sexy Channel
author: Mitsudoue
description:
Kei Sakai, a high school boy, had a problem. One thing led to another, and he was deeply uninterested in everything and had no sexual desire.

Then one day, he learns of a mysterious, beautiful girl named Yami, who is the talk of the town on SNS, from a fellow part-timer. Yami is an unidentified internet idol who uploads naughty videos and pictures of herself in outrageous outfits, and has a huge following among men. No one knows her real face, but Sakai recognizes a woman who resembles Yami. Th

title: Nejishiki
author: Tsuge, Yoshiharu
description:
1. Nejishiki (Screw-Style)
2. Numa (The Swamp)
3. Chico (Chirpy)
4. Hatsutakegari (Mushroom Hunting)
5. Sanshouuo (The Salamander)
6. Touge no Inu (The Dog from Prayer Pass)
7. Uwasa no Bushi (The Phony Warrior)
8. Ondoru Koya (The Ondol Shack)
9. Gensenkan Shujin (Master of the Gensenkan Inn)

11. Ooba Denki Mekki Kougyou-sho (Oba's Electroplate Factory)
12. Yoshiboo no Hanzai
13. Shounen
14. Aru Mumei Sakka
