5. Futaba-kun and Futaba-kun

title: Neo Faust
author: Tezuka, Osamu
description: In February 1970, Professor Ichinoseki of NG University, on the outskirts of Tokyo, is very depressed at his failure to discover the truth of the universe despite his 50 years of hard work. Just as he considers commiting suicide, a woman named Mephistopheles appears before him. It turns out that she is actually the Devil and Ichinoseki will make a bargain with her: Mephisto will serve him with her magic powers until he is fully satisfied and says "Stay, thou art so beautiful", at which point his

title: Ibara no Koi
author: Mitsui, Aya
description: On a certain day 16 years ago, a girl was born. The girl was very cute. She grew into a cheerful beauty... Before long, she knew love. A fleeting secret love started, however...

title: Hizashi
author: Azuma, Hideo
description:
A compendium of surrealistic stories with a main view on sexual psychology and the adolescent step to adulthood.

(Source: Gantz Waitingroom)

title: Superior Day
author: Team Getname
description:
What would you do if you found out that your neighbor is a serial killer? But more importantly: what would you do if some unknown third person was trying to make you kill him?!

(Source: MU)

title: Kyouai Shinri Paradox
author: Sakurazawa, Kiyu
description: Assistant Professor Yukinari Tachibana is in love with his little brother. He left the house to hide his feelings, but his little brother Takayuki entered the college where he teaches to follow his brother. Yukinari's heart would go fast just by a simple touch from Takayuki, and while he thought he was hiding it well enough that no one would see, one student noticed. "Aren't you crazy to lust over your little brother?" A student from psychology department, Kazusa Ichijou, started to threaten Yuk

title: Long Goodbye
author: Obata, Yuuki
description:
Trapped into two different worlds, a young boy and a young girl are trying to runaway of where they are. But it's like something kept them captives and there's no way for them to escape from these strange worlds...

(Source: Sound of Jewels)

title: Machiko's Idol Crush
author: Yoshida, Nao
description:
Machiko fell in love at first sight with the tears of an incredibly beautiful boy who was trying to end his life. "With such a pretty face like yours, you should become an idol!" she suggested. From that moment on, Machiko's life would never be the same...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Death Pie
author: Shimamoto, Kazuhiko
description:
Gambling. Mahjong. Death. These are the themes of this fast-paced, undercover-agent-style manga where outrageous life-or-death gambles are made daily occurrences and insurmountable odds are overcome. The most hardcore, action-packed mahjong manga you will ever see.

(Source: MU)

Included one-shot:
Nana-chan Scramble (Nana the Scramble Girl)

title: Night on the Galactic Railroad
author: Masumura, Hiroshi, Miyazawa, Kenji
description: A manga adaption of Kenji Miyazawa's classic Night on the Galactic Railroad.

title: Noise From Upstairs
author: Yangsong
description:
What would you do if your neighbor didn't stop making noise? People think of Si-u Seo as a nice guy, but when his upstairs neighbor refuses to stop making noise, he gradually becomes consumed by his desire for revenge despite the fact that his neighbor is dangerous. Si-u will stop at nothing to ruin his neighbor's life, even if it means burning his own life to the ground.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Battle Royale: Enforcers
author: Asada, Yukai
description:
Twenty years ago, the fascist government of the Republic of Greater East Asia seized control of Japan. In order to terrorize the citizens and crush any possibility of rebellion, the government set up Program 68, a savage military program where Japanese high school students were sent to a remote island and forced to kill each other—the Battle Royale.

After being banned for two decades, Program 68 is back, now under the direction of a sinister government artificial intelligence. The troubled and

title: Yandere Shoujo ni Icha Love sarechau: Anthology Comic
author: Yuuki, Shinichi, Kusano, Houki, Kazumiya, Akira, Yoneda, Kazusa, Manishi, Mari, Mamo, Williams, Shiwasu, Horio, Aonagi, Nobu, Ondy, Shiraishi, Kouhei
description: An anthology of short stories about yandere girls.

title: Zange
author: Inoue, Santa
description:
Yamada Kiyoshi, a struggling family man with a strong sense of justice oversteps his bounds and attempts to stop a public disturbance. Unfortunately for him, he's caught himself in the crosshairs of a violent personality...

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Night on the Galactic Railroad
author: Miyazawa, Kenji, Variety Art Works
description:
Giovanni, along with his best friend Campanella, boards a train traversing the Cosmos and sets off for a mysterious new world. Kenji Miyazawa's timeless literary masterpiece illustrated in manga!

(Source: Jmanga)

title: Kimitachi wa Dou Ikiru ka
author: Haga, Shouichi, Yoshino, Genzaburou
description: Junichi Honda is a 2nd year (15 years old) junior high school student who is known by his nickname Koperu, which was named after the astronomer Nicholas Copernicus. He has excellent academic and athletic achievements, and possesses a fair degree of popularity. His father is a bank executive until his death, and his mother is a maid. After his father's death, Koperu moves to his uncle's house. There are many children of businessmen, university professors, and doctors in classmates, and topics of

title: Danzi
author: Danzi
description:
Danzi, 31, has been living alone now for around 10 months when a sudden call from her mother brings back memories of why she moved out in the first place. In her eponymous comic, Danzi uses her personal diaries to recount her experience growing up with two brothers and emotionally abusive parents. An instant hit in South Korea, this comic confronts issues such as sexism and domestic violence in a way that's inviting, albeit heartbreaking.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Touching The Night Stars
author: Tori, Maia
description: This volume is a companion piece to Hoshi no Yakata.  The third chapter is a prequel to the series, showing Sakurai's past before he became the master of Hoshi no Yakata as well as how the mansion came into his possession.  The remaining chapters feature short side stories that are more loosely connected to the main storyline of Hoshi no Yakata.

title: Shintan Kairou
author: Nagai, Saburou
description:
He was a teacher who knew his student was gay and still desired his body. After running away from everything, he became a wanderer.

He wanted to get away from people, and took the name, Mossan. Yanagida struggled with the pain of being in love with the same sex. He committed attempted rape on a student when he was a teacher, and ran away from there. Before he knew it, he had become Mossan, a pitiful demon who had thrown his past away, but had no choice but to keep on living. He thought he'd los

title: Ringo no Asobikata
author: Kandachi, Kumiko
description:
Minori wonders what the true nature of the relationship is between her childhood friend Tsugumi, who she likes, and her twin sister Kozue.

(Source: MU)

title: Dizzy
author: Tanaka, Suzuki
description:
Series of 4 oneshots, the last 2 were found as extra of volume 3 of Menkui :

1) Dizzy (Menkui)
Koutarou's childhood friend Te-chan invites him to his home. Koutarou thinks it's weird since they haven't hung out together in years, but the carnage at Te-chan's home sends the boys running away together. Is Te-chan really bad? If so, why doesn't Koutarou leave him?

2) Slow Starter

3) Endless Gaze (Gyoshi no Hate) (first extra of volume 3 of Menkui)

4) Muddy Stream (second extra of volume 3 of Me

title: The Chain of Youth
author: Sahae
description:
There are many people who like Baek Yoona, and Yoon Jia is merely one of them. She knows very well that confessing to Yoona with a love letter is nothing more than a release of suffocating emotions. However, Yoona's stunning looks, dazzling smile, and sweet demeanor are only a veil for her true dull state of apathy and utter disdain, even for those closest to her.

Yoona accepts Jia's feelings on a whim and begins dating her, even though a strange sense of revulsion suddenly fills her. Although

title: Fake Humans
author: Kim, Badak, Banyan
description:
Having escaped her abusive mother, twenty-year-old Ji-a lives a modest life with her little sister, Su-a. When Su-a does not return from her field trip under sinister circumstances, Ji-a vows to do anything she can to get her sister back. As she and her high school friend Wonseung delve further into the mystery, they find that there might be a larger conspiracy under the surface—a tangled web that includes a cult, a mystery, and powerful figures that might shake South Korea to its core.

(Source

title: Dogeza Shoujo no Gekokujou: Ikenie Revenge Game
author: Amamiya, Kie, Tanaka, Doriru
description: In a mysterious school, there is a class where students with the lowest grades are sent, named the "isolated class." Akari, an ordinary female student, falls into the "isolated class" due to her friend's betrayal, where she is exposed to irrational senseless violence! However, she stands up to the members who dominate the class with an unyielding heart. At the same time, Akari joins forces with Yuuto, another student who has fallen into the segregated class, and vows to climb out of this mess...

title: To Make You Happy
author: Jeokmok
description: College student Soshin Kang has made a deal with the devil. When poverty and violent loan sharks force Soshin to take up an offer from Aram, Soshin's high school friend-turned-bully, to live in Aram's lavish house with all expenses paid, it seems like a dream come true. Although Aram appears sweet and gentle, in reality she is a cold, manipulative stalker who is obsessed with Soshin and will stop at nothing to keep her to herself. As people around her begin to get hurt, Soshin finds herself in a

title: Ctrl+Z
author: MiTi
description:
What if you had the power to erase people's memories? Would you use it to help those in need? Or would you use it to become the most powerful person in the world? For Kyle, this newfound power was going to change his life... for better or for worse.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Sin Flower
author: Taffy
description:
Haesoo takes care of Dojin after he loses his parents to an evil spirit. As Dojin grows up, he struggles to hide his feelings for Haesoo, but tries to do so regardless by assisting him in his priestly duties. But evil soon creeps into Dojin's heart when he stumbles upon Haesoo's dark secret, whispering to let his desires loose...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Serenade
author: Keum, Kyesoo
description:
A professor living a successful life with a secret. Two students who each have a hold on their mentor: one who knows her secret and another who reminds her of her first love... A romantic thriller that will leave you hanging for more.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Even in Your Death
author: Jinan, Yanggu
description:
Jeongcheol is a gambler, a failure, and now a divorcé after ten years of a marriage that finally collapsed.

Before he can even catch his breath or curse his miserable luck, the very person who started it all returns to his life.

Ji Minyeong, the ex-lover who terrified him, chased him, and yet was the one he loved more deeply than anyone else, appears without warning.

Standing before him with the same chilling certainty as in the past, Minyeong whispers the words Jeongcheol fears most:

"I wil

title: Following Eunju
author: Lee, Cherry
description:
Minjun sets up a fake profile to get Eunju, his crush, to accept his follow request on social media. Now, with her daily activities and whereabouts available at his fingertips, he uses this information to move in as her next-door neighbor. But little did Minjun know, that Eunju's life isn't anything like what she posts online–this sends him down an unexpected path, where he learns that following Eunju turns out to have its consequences.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Tasuuketsu
author: Miyakawa, Taiga
description:
Suddenly, the game begins. Tasuuketsu is a harsh survival game where the majority of players will lose. In order to confront the game's powerful mastermind, The Emperor, male and female players will carve out their own destiny using their mysterious special powers known as Privileges.

(Source: ANN)

title: Fish Tied with Fate
author: Noda, Ayako
description:
Cousins and childhood friends, Issei and Ryouichi. Between bossy heir of a company president Issei and gloomy, always obedient Ryouichi arose a warped master-slave relationship. Letting the adored Issei conquer him, young Ryouichi gave his body over to pleasure. However, a few years later, with these two working at the same company, has the relationship between these two started to change?

(Source: Shodensha, translated)

title: The Golden Spoon
author: HD3
description:
Would you trade your poor but loving family for a life of riches? When Seungcheon gets his hands on a magical spoon that allows him to switch lives with his rich best friend, he thinks it's a no-brainer. But life-altering decisions are always accompanied by a sense of doubt, and with only three chances to change his mind, Seungcheon has to decide which of his two possible futures is worth keeping.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

description:
1. Uchi no Ane ga Baka de Komaru
2. Soko ni Ai wa?
3. Uchi no Ani ga Baka de Nayamu

title: Ranker
author: Taibogi, Shingun
description: Once a winner of the middleweight challenger's decider bout showdown, Junseo Kang is now a retired fighter struggling to overcome his worst nightmare: zombies. Every time fear catches him, he sees others as zombies. Now with the new opportunity rising, he sees his way out: join the ranker game, win the prize money, and overcome his fragile mental. In an all-or-nothing showdown, a total of 100 characters must fight for their players and eliminate each other to get to the top 5 ranks to win the ac
genre: Action, Adult Cast, High Stakes Game

title: Kill Me Now
author: Cosmos
description: Haegu, a proficient and merciless hitwoman, executes a man in front of his own daughter and takes the child under her wing. She decides to name her Mian, the word for "sorry" in Korean, and gives her one mission: "Kill me when you can." From that moment on, Mian decides that she will do this by choking Haegu with feigned love and emotionally manipulating her into submission. But as Mian grows into an adult, she's thrown into confusion as what was supposed to be pure revenge turns into lust... an

title: Unchanged Man
author: Jakpil
description:
As a new transfer in his second year of high school, Gu Dohun faces relentless bullying for no clear reason—but his eyes are set on only one person: his quiet classmate, Jeong Yuwon.

Yuwon tries to keep his distance, but Dohun's strange, unreadable pull draws him in until a sudden, devastating incident rips them apart.

Years later, they reunite as team leader and subordinate. Yuwon tries to keep things professional, but the past refuses to stay buried...and neither does Dohun's gaze. Something

title: Hoshigari JK Ria
author: Tsukimori, Coco
description:
Ria is a bored, horny high school girl who's out to see the world burn as a distraction from boredom.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Planetary Human
author: Jo, Seok
description:
Just the extraordinarily unfortunate life of a high school boy... but misfortune isn't all that's extraordinary about him.

(Source: MU)

title: Suna no Shita no Suimyaku
author: Fukai, Youki
description:
A collection of oneshots falling on the darker, more depressing side of yaoi:

1. 0.02
2. Biter

3. Trillium 
Ryouji is a college professor who is having an affair with Yuzuru, one of his students. One day he asks Yuzuru to live with him, but the next time they meet, Yuzuru coldly breaks up with him. Yuzuru then proceeds to treat Ryouji in ways Ryouji never imagined he would -- as if Yuzuru has become a whole different person. (from Trine)

4. Frosty
5. Shunshou Ataisenkin
6. Suna no Shita no Su

title: Saitsuyo Densetsu Nakane
author: Uehara, Motomu, Arai, Kazuya, Yokoi, Kenji
description: A spin-off about Nakane, who is now a normal working adult. Dissatisfied with his newly restrictive and tedious life, he becomes interested in getting "likes" on social media.

title: Kyouhan
author: Hara, Kyuugo
description:
Sousuke Yamamoto, son of the priest, has been having a hard time with his family. Not only is he troubled at home, but at school too. Mainly in regards to Reina Shiratori, heiress of the largest company on the island and most popular girl in class. She and her friends torment Sousuke, forcing him to lick Reina's feet in the girls bathroom. This leads to a stirring within Sousuke...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Perfect Relationship
author: Akkang, sam
description: Minjae is smart, handsome, and thoughtful. He wakes up early to cook Hyukjoon breakfast and gets home early enough to make him dinner. He cleans around the apartment and makes sure to take care of his adoptive father. And like any dutiful son, he wants to follow in Hyukjoon's footsteps and become a teacher. He'd make any father proud. But Hyukjoon isn't proud of Minjae. Hyukjoon's son died years ago. And the one responsible for his death lives with him. Minjae isn't Hyukjoon's son. He's his targ

title: Tsumi to Batsu
author: Dostoyevsky, Fyodor, Variety Art Works
description: Manga version of the novel Crime and Punishment by Fyodor Dostoyevsky.

title: Secretly, Greatly
author: Hun
description: At the top of his class, Won Ryu-hwan ranks as one of the elite soldiers in the North Korean military. Due to his outstanding talent, Ryu-hwan has been selected for the 5446 Project: a mission to infiltrate the South and gather information on its inhabitants. However, upon deployment, he is utterly disappointed to find out what this truly entails—he must disguise himself as a village bum in Seoul. Fiercely loyal to his country nonetheless, Ryu-hwan dutifully commits to this humiliating role and

title: Lies, Fraud and Psychic Ability School
author: kakao, Nomiya, Yuu
description:
A training school where elite psychics gather. Everything is judged there by the result of the game. Jin, a boy who entered the school despite being incompetent for a certain purpose, is actually the strongest scammer. The ultimate deception entertainment made up of fraud and tactics.

(Source: Dengeki Wiki)

title: Berry Ecstasy
author: Oshima, Towa
description:
Contains 2 stories:

- Berry Ecstasy (Chapters 1-5)
When Shinya meets his friend Toshiaki's girlfriend by chance and suspects she isn't being treated well, he decides she's in need of rescue. But Misa's character is complex and a relationship with her will be more difficult than Shinya could have imagined.

- The Way of the Beast (Chapters 6-8)

After going through one bad experience after the other in school, she finally gets to marry the man of her dreams who loves her for who she is. However, he too eventually seeks out someone better-looking and cheats on her, resulting in their divorce. Oddly enough though... the woman he cheated on Aoi with is the same girl who bullied her throughout their school years...! Now Aoi's on a mission to get revenge on the man who

title: Boku no You ni Juujun na Otouto

description: Tetsuya reunites with his older sister after their mother passes away.

After winning tickets to an old theme park on the outskirts of Tokyo, Casio and his friends brave the eerie rumors surrounding the place for a little winter adventure. However, what was supposed to be a fun day trip takes a horrific turn when one friend lures Casio away from the group—and stabs him to death. While he bleeds out, his friend tearfully begs him to save someone named Asebi.

description: An after story focusing on Kenya and the killer's journal.

author: Yang, Yeo-Jin
description:
Dah-In Hyun, a normal everyday schoolgirl, discovers that she and the other students at Saint Marie have become pawns in a proverbial chess game. When her best friend dies trying to defend herself, Dah-In finds herself trapped in a battle where no one is who they seem, and the line between black and white is blurred.

(Source: Wikipedia)

author: Akasaka, Aka, Hitsujiyama, Juuichirou
description:
The setting is Tsukikagekan, which stands on a solitary island owned by the Fujiwara family. In addition to the members of the student council, Moeha Fujiwara and Kei Shirogane are involved in a battle similar to a werewolf game over a treasure that can make wishes come true!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

author: Takaguchi, Satosumi

Welcome to the future. In tried-and-true sci-fi fashion, the date is given in a time system that we have no reference for, so I can't tell you how far into the future we are beyond saying that it is S.E. 156. Thirty years before our story begins, an ace space pilot by the name of M2 Rimstein was put into an experimental cold sleep until such time as he would be needed.

Azusa Wakaba, the daughter of Azusa Fumiko, famous film actress, jumps into the film industry with her beauty to find the truth behind her mother's mysterious suicide. Wakaba catches the eye of Murase Takayuki, a man on the verge of a promotion to director, and wins the lead role, but Murase loses his job to his mentor, Makiguchi, a master of the film industry. In a world where lust becomes murderous intent and hatred abounds, Wakaba's starring film is in a world full of hatred.

author: Yokota, Sakie, Yokota, Shigeru, Moto, Souichi
description: Megumi is a biographical manga about Megumi Yokota's final days in her home town in Japan. On November 15, 1977 she was kidnapped by North Korean spies and was never recovered. Her fate remains unknown.

author: Ishin
description:
Veteran exorcist Shiren Erihara worries about absolutely everything. One day, he goes on a demon hunt with rookie Hajo, but his anxieties are endless - from wondering if he turned off the gas to worrying about losing the rookie's respect. Can this unlikely duo manage to exorcise a powerful demon?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Voice of Submission: Gehenna
author: Juubaori, Mashumaro
description:
Jyuubaori Mashumaro's follow-up to Voice of Submission. This 7-part series kicks off with a shocker in the first five parts of the series. A young virgin wandering alone at night in a secluded park is dominated and forced to submit to the perversities of a stranger -- and discovers that she likes it!

Part six and seven are stand alone tales. Part six is of a young man who stumbles upon a crazed but beautiful madwoman, locked away in a cage in the middle of the woods, only to be seduced into her

author: Zhang, Xiaoyu
description: How to adapt when you are a different child? Fundamental question, often treated with anguish and pain. To illustrate this, the author tells us two stories. One sees the son of a capitalist during the Chinese cultural Revolution whe receives currently rough jokes from the other boys. He can only bear this situation thanks to his main dream: build a plane and fly away. The daily, average life and interactions of some of a ship's crew as they depart to explore space.

author: Okuse, Saki
description:
Nail is a lonely young boy. Fuyu is after him. Erica is a girl that Nail meets. The three will probably never come to a mutual understanding, but their interaction highlights the unique form of alienation that each experiences.

(Source: MU)

title: KURAU Phantom Memory
author: Hoshi, Itsuki
description: Single volume adaptation of the original BONES anime of the same name.

title: Night on the Galactic Railroad
author: Miyazawa, Kenji, Nagashima, Shinji
description: A manga adaption of Kenji Miyazawa's classic Night on the Galactic Railroad.

title: He, Him & Us
author: Scarf
description:
For the fourth year in a row, Jungsoo failed his college entrance exams. Shunned by family and friends as a failure in life, his one remaining joy is the pretty girl at cram school. But when a new hottie takes the seat next to him, Jungsoo can't help but take notice—he's fallen for a guy! Why can't he stop gawking at this handsome boy? Will Jungsoo be able to concentrate and get into college this time?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Pride
author: Tagame, Gengorou
description:
Ohashi, who is an university student, prides himself with his hot hunk body. One day, Ohashi is taped off by Dr Shibazaki, who is a professor of psychology at his university. But in fact, Shibazaki is also an expert of BDSM, and a skilled Master who trained many slaves in the past. Shibazaki finds that Ohashi has the potential to become a good slave.

(Source: tagame.org)

Included one-shots:
Volume 1: Trap
Volume 2: Trap 2
Volume 3: Yami no Naka no Shamo, Hikokumin

title: Mama
author: Urino, Kiko
description:
A boarding school where only those chosen by God attend. The ones who possess the true ability are said to be granted great honor as well as death… What awaits these children is jealous rivals, arguments with their mothers, forbidden love, and both confidence and confusion over their own abilities. The story of the unfolding powers of the boys who have the voices of angels.

(Source: MU)

title: You Control Me
author: Yamada, Supokon
description:
"Would you let me take control of your nutrition?"

College student Sudo is unable to eat other people's cooking after a traumatic incident. One day, while going to the convenience store he usually frequents, Sudo is handed a homemade bento from a worker at the store he has never seen before. He rejects the offer coldly at first, but opens up after seeing how worried the worker, Hasegawa, is over his health. Around the same time, a rumor starts to spread about a pervert hanging around the univer

title: Dandelion
author: Ochiai, Naoyuki
description:
Yukihito Daigo is a teenage hacker who has been infected by the 'Dandelion' virus, which is said to brainwash humans and give them a new personality, combined with extraordinary speed and physical strength. But is that all there is to Dandelion? Daigo and his friends embark on a mission to discover the truth.

Source: Mangaupdates

title: Control Time
author: OFFCAR, HIPS
description: Raymon has it all: perfect looks, a prestigious family, and unrivaled abilities in the workplace. But beneath his flawless exterior lies a chaotic love life, with a string of unsatisfying, fleeting encounters. His search for the perfect partner ends when a janitor named Winter seemingly saves him from a stalker's attack. Drawn to Winter's striking looks and submissive nature, Raymon proposes a FWB situation, to which Winter eagerly agrees. At first, their relationship seems ideal, but Raymon soo

title: Toxic Burn
author: Lee, Taeri
description:
"It takes more to satisfy me." Dayoung has the looks, the talent, and the wealth to back everything up, but she desires only one thing—having her friend Jae-seung watch her as she embarks on her risque digressions. Whether it's in the library, on the school grounds, or at home, Dayoung calls Jae-seung whenever the mood strikes her. But how does Jae-seung feel about all this? Behind the thrill and the facade are the haunting traces of his past, ever so lasting as a burn.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Ao no Honoo
author: Arai, Rie, Kishi, Yusuke
description:
This is the story of a high school boy named Kushimori who lives with his younger sister, mother, and step-father after moving in with him a few years back. The step-father has fallen on hard times and have become drunk and abusive, and Kushimori is starting to wonder if his step-father is involved in something much worse... like murder...

(Source: MU)

title: Onna no Ana
author: Fumi, Fumiko
description:
1. Onna no Ana
2. Onna no Atama
3. Onna no Buta
4. Onna no Oni

title: One Small Step
author: Jeong, Seonwoo
description: Even the most casual of comments can leave some people with profound scars. One cruel sentence has left Jaeha with a chronic fear of talking to strangers, while another remark has turned Youngwoo into a recluse. A little bit of coincidence and a pinch of nosiness bring the two boys together, marking the beginning of an unlikely friendship. Together, they try to face their demons head on. All they need to do to move on is to take everything one step at a time. One small step, that's all it'll tak

title: Sounan Psycho
author: Aki, Kanya
description:
Lost on a snowy mountain, he awakens to find himself in a small mountain hut, alone with a woman who calls herself a murderer...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: 335KM
author: Eh, Hee
description:
A girl whose wish is to see the ocean. A boy who is afraid of the outside. A school trip that was canceled and a journey to fulfill her wish.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Be My Beta
author: Shin Yuri
description: Choi Yoo-il is no stranger to misfortune. From losing his parents in a freak accident to suddenly presenting as a recessive omega in his twenties, bad things seem to follow him around. But through it all, his only friend Cha Hwan has stood proudly beside him. Hwan lets Yoo-il live with him, and when Yoo-il loses his job, Hwan even finds him a new one. The problem is...Hwan hates omegas. Terrified of losing the only person to ever stand by him, Yoo-il tries desperately to hide the truth. With his

title: Stalker Jokers
author: Ooishi, Hiroto, Ooga, Hiromichi
description:
"Stalker problem" is overlooked as a serious social issue. The number of incidents increase day by day and are far from being solved. The curtain rises on a picaresque story set in a wonderfully distorted contemporary Japan where the warped are gathered and purified with poetic justice. What can purify darkness is darkness.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

description: Muyoung has depended on Heewon for a long time. But he's had enough of freeloading and wants to break out on his own. The only problem is, is that Muyoung's an omega who is having a hard time finding a good job. Plus, his excessive pheromone problem isn't helping. Life for an omega isn't easy. And all Heewon desires is to make Muyoung be unable to live

title: Kyosuurei
author: Murakawa, Michio
description:
In the deteriorated future city of Tokyo, Lena operates an antique shop. She judges the level of energy within each piece, and sells only those antiques that have received an ample amount of love from their previous owners. Read about her life, as she struggles with the various emotions that the previous owners held for their pieces.

(Source: MU)

title: Tenshi Shukushi

description: Yui, codename: "The Killing Doll" is an matchless assassin, programmed with an emotional override that makes him little more than a puppet. Hired out by a ruthless corporation, Yui loses control of himself whenever there's a job to be done. In the precious few moments he has to himself, he tries to build a life for himself with the guidance of a priest and fellow assassin, Miyagi.

title: Kayama-kun no Baai
author: Yamamoto, Hideo
description: Kayama uses the techniques he learned from Homunculus no Me to make his date open up to him.

description:
Shougo Amane, a conman belonging to the criminal organization "Shikiyou," feels superior by deceiving and controlling people. He sets his sights on a new target and approaches her. However, it turns out to be a trap to capture him. On the brink of death, Shougo makes a certain proposal...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

description:
Going on with our lives after having lost someone is always painful. What does it mean to move on without forgetting them? This is a story about survivors struggling to find happiness within their guilt and grief.

(Source: Manta)

title: Colosseum
author: Horiguchi, Yukiko, Dobashi, Shinjirou

From the girl who had surely commit suicide, came a death game.

"On the other side of this door is the colosseum where you will kill each other"

When the girl woke up, before her eyes was a space she had never seen before. Given a handgun and a knife, they were told to kill each other. A mercilessly planned game of death. Of the 30 people gathered, only 1 was allowed to remain--.

When high schooler Hagiwara Yuuto picked up an app called 'Collesseum', he came to know the start of the death gam

title: The Road to Rome
author: Hagio, Moto
description:
Mario was born in Rome, but he remembers nothing about it. He grew up in Belgium with his foster parents and he always performed the leading role at the ballet school. Mario joins a modern ballet company in Paris together with Didi, Raffaella and Sylvia. He falls in love with Raffaella, but the secret of his true father's murder haunts his happiness...

(Source: MU)

title: Charisma
author: Ishihara, Satoru
description: It is a multi-perspective story following several different characters. The central character is Archer Rogue. Archer's entire family is a bit off-kilter. His father Ed is bi-polar due to physical abuse from his father as a child. As a result, he beats Archer at times ("for his own good"), or swings to a scared, child-like persona and is incapable of even feeding himself. Archer's childhood was understandably difficult, and he's a rather closed-off, violent person as a result. His older half-bro

title: Nanatsu no Umi Nanatsu no Sora
author: Aoike, Yasuko
description:
Tyrian's stepfather (a notorious womanizer) decides to remarry, and his victim is a sickeningly sweet and innocent girl named.... Juliet. But the girl is kidnapped off of Tyrian's ship, first by pirates and then by more pirates in the form of our dashing Luminous Red Benedict. The neatly woven threads of conspiracy which have been supporting Tyrian's life begin to unravel, and he flees to Spain at last. Captain Red redoubles his pursuit.

(Source: Translated Treasures)

Note that in Japanese, the number 3 reads 'mi' and 7 reads 'na', so 373 = Minami.

Lee Seonho was falsely accused of parricide for murdering his own father. Seonho, who lived through each day without being able to die, was approached by a mysterious old man and made him an offer he couldn't refuse...

Just by taking off his glasses and directing his sight at the thug... just by doing so, they would die. One day Fujieda Souma saved the childhood friend he had been reunited with, Suzugamori, from a thug, by killing them with the ability 'Basilisk' he had taken from a cursed undead "Lost Man."

title: "Yukue Fumei."

description:
Kaede is an honest working janitor and Ryou is a gigolo living a self-indulgent lifestyle. The two are childhood friends and share a secret they can't tell anyone. They have a dependent relationship where they'll dirty their hands for the other, but what happens when they both end up as murderers...?

(Source: J-Publishing, translated)

title: Vanishing Twin
author: Gaje, Dodal
description:
Yeon Janghwa is a more or less average college student: she attends a pretty good university, is pretty good-looking, and has a nice boyfriend. Her twin sister, Hong-ryeon, on the other hand, is the opposite. Being the good sister she is, Janghwa sets out to help her twin sister... but at what price? The truth is in the details.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: KURAU Phantom Memory

description: A two volume novel adaptation of the BONES anime series.

author: Yoshioka, Chihiro, Kizaki, Shinya
description:
In football, an agent handles contracts and transfers on behalf of pro players. For their ability to move astronomical amounts of money, these agents are known as alchemists. This one has a notorious name: Kyousuke Senzaki. With him is Risa Natsume, a college student tracing her missing brother's footsteps. The lives of pro players and their complex world of money and power are realistically rendered by a sports writer and a football manga artist.

(Source: Japan Media Arts Festival)

title: Run Wild: Sa Ye
author: Wu, Zhe
description: Seventeen-year-old Jiang Cheng is cast aside by his adoptive parents and sent to a desolate northern town to live with his gambling-obsessed, deadbeat father. Arriving with just a suitcase, a pack of cigarettes, and a looming sense of dread over his uncertain future, he steps off the train and into a bleak, rundown place far from everything he knows. title: The Artist Salieri

Life is so unpredictable. Myeong-hwa had everything: the pretty face, the artistic talent, and even a wonderful boyfriend, while Sun-hee had nothing. Ten years later, the roles have reversed and Myeong-hwa is still a poor and unknown artist while Sun-hee is a major figure in the art world. What Myeong-hwa doesn't know is that Sun-hee has secretly been pulling strings to make sure she fails...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Tokyo Game
author: Aoyama, Hiromi
description:
In post-apocalyptic Japan, a nameless mahjong player ascends a massive tower, facing formidable opponents in life or death gambles.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Hoshi no Matataki
author: Kurita, Chika
description:
A girl sees stars in the people and things around her. Some are bigger and shine, others dull and dim like her own. She meets two boys from school one day who show her that all stars can shine brightly, if you see them the right way.

(Source: Atelier du Noir Scans)

title: Tales of Greed Deep
author: Kim, Kkulppal, Nurimaru
description:
Tales of Greed is back with an even deeper story! What if the desires that every human can have become a reality? Will the outcome ultimately lead to happiness or bring about destruction?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: The House Cat
author: Kim, Kyoung
description:
Jill is a house cat who has been with her owner for 10 years. They have a loving relationship and together they deal with the trials and tribulations of daily life.

(Source: Spottoon)

title: Yuugo Final

description: Final season on Yuugo Beppu, a negotiator who has never lost a case. His fluency in several languages and international connections help him keep his vow to complete every mission he takes on.

title: MacGuffin

Lee Soo-ha, who has been locked up in an unidentified facility for a long time, is dragged by strangers and meets a man one day.

Soo-ha starts living with that man, and finds out that he is an Omega who was sold to him, an Alpha. He is concerned about his situation where he has no heat cycle and is unable to conceive due to his abnormal physical condition, but that man doesn't care even though Lee Soo-ha is not doing his job as omega.

As the hatred towards him increases along with the feelings

Taeyoung and Ami, young lovers from a peaceful lakeside town, grew up sharing dreams of fame and freedom. Taeyoung, son of actress Haedo Im, yearns to capture beauty from behind the camera, while Ami aspires to dazzle in front of it. But when Haedo's film director boyfriend comes to town hunting for his next leading lady, the couple's tranquility is shattered forever...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Day of Disaster
author: Lee, Seungchan, Hwansang Teukgeup
description:
In 2009, a resident of a small mountain village is shot and killed, and this murder leads to a series of sinister events. Jeong-u Cho, a boy who was born and raised in the village, begins to feel a mysterious gaze on him, and finds himself caught up in an uncontrollable disaster.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

Sleeping in separate bedrooms is frustrating enough; he doesn't need Laurence showing him what he can't have! Chip knows Laurence used to sleep around with guys all the time. So what made him go platonic all of a sudden? To find some answers, the two seek out the best couples therapist in San Francisco. But the more they talk, the more they realize there's still a lot to learn about each other.

title: Seishin Bunseki Nyuumon Yumehandan

description: Saki is an ordinary high school girl, living a simple life of striving at her studies. The problem is she does not have a good relationship with her parents, and they lash out at her because of it. One day, scared of a group of delinquents who noticed her at school, she accepts and smokes a single cigarette, and somehow she and the delinquents get along comfortably. Troubled by her relationship with her parents, Saki flourishes in her time with the delinquents. That was when the tragic events be

With sales at Xitec Group plummeting, she's been transferred to assist the CEO, who happens to be the cousin of Director Joo. Sun-Hee's family seems to be a perfect, happy family until the day she confesses to her mother that she killed her classmate, Kyung-Ho. After hearing this, her mother has an unexpected reaction.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Ayako

description: A remake of Osamu Tezuka's 1972 series set in the modern day.

A collection of 3 stories:

The Beauty and the Beast with the manhwaga's own twist.

2) Across
Psychological and slightly supernatural pairing of an angsty couple.

3) Soft
A story revolving around roommate drama.

The main character Yuuichi suddenly faces a divorce when his wife Hana says "It's impossible to raise a child with you," but he doesn't understand why she would say this. When Yuuichi wakes up after hitting his head and losing consciousness, he finds himself in the body of Hana near the start of the pregnancy—he will relive his past behaviors from the perspective of his wife.

(Source: Chibi Manga)

title: The White Maidens' Werewolf
author: Ajiichi, Outsuki, You
description: Hakurai Private Academy, a boarding school where young ladies receive a higher education in bridehood. Should the maidens lose their "purity" during the three year course, they are immediately expelled, losing any chance at their dreams of becoming brides. For the girls living at this school, it is a future they consider worse than death. One day, something happens in the dormitory of the student council! In their midst is a two-faced wolf aiming for their purity, and it is up to them to pull ba

title: Nanaokuen wo Te ni Ireta Boku ni Arigachi na Koto.
author: Kawamura, Taku
description:
Itsuki is but an ordinary boy... who happened to have won 700 million Yen from a lottery he bought on a whim. Fearing that he will be in for a bad time if people knew, he thus has to try to live by hiding the truth of his unexpected windfall.

(Source: MU)

title: And Then, She Became Nina.
author: Nanjou, Yoshimi, Nozawa, Takeshi
description: In broad daylight, a horrific mass murder occurs, nearly also claiming the life of Mina, a high school student. Miraculously, she survives after undergoing a heart transplant. As Mina begins to settle back into a semblance of normalcy, she becomes alarmed by an overwhelming surge of murderous intent that she's never experienced before. Unbeknownst to her, the heart she received had belonged to Misako Shimizu, the very perpetrator of the mass murder. Mina's parents watch in confusion and fear as

title: Cross the Line
author: Heo, Yunmi
description: Hayeon Eun, who at 16 years old found herself in jail for arson resulting in a death, is finally released back into the world. But as soon as she's out, she is snatched up by Taeman Ji, the director of a private organization, to whom her stepfather racked up quite a debt. She says she will pay it off in his stead, but because of the low value of the product, Taeman takes her home with him and they end up living together. This is a love story where two people who couldn't take care of themselves

title: To You in the Swamp
author: Hwim
description:
Eunwoo doesn't want to revisit anything about what happened before he left. But going to school and meeting Jaeho is making that very difficult. Will he be able to climb out of the swamp?

(Source: Toomics, edited)

title: Eunsoo
author: Studio Sibo
description:
Eunsoo's life is a fairy tale. She's a ballerina living in New York and her romantic boyfriend just proposed to her with a huge diamond ring. So what if she didn't get the lead role this time? All the other dancers are jealous of her perfect life, and that's all that matters. But when Eunsoo receives a call saying her boyfriend committed suicide, her fairy tale quickly turns into a nightmare she can't wake up from.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Haigo ni Megane
author: Yukimichi, Ouji
description:
It suddenly becomes apparent to Hazuki that his friend Misono absolutely dotes on him. Naturally they're classmates and attend school together. But now he's all grown up. Calling his name Misono says "Oops my bad...I came by mistake." Despite that it seems that Misono suffers from ED and responds only to Hazuki. Hazuki is convinced that what he feels for Misono is "true love" and realizes that Misono is always by his side...

(Source: hakoiriemusume.tumblr)

Included one-shots: Bijin Koukousei:

title: Ojisan to Miiko
author: Asahi, Yuu
description:
A junior high school girl living alone in her grandparents' house. One day a man who claimed to be her father's younger brother arrived. The two of them started living together.

(Source: Toranoana, translated)

title: The Whale
author: 0g
description:
The first time Hanbi visits an aquarium, she is mesmerized by the whale's deep sense of yearning and sorrow. 10 years later, when she feels a similar intense connection to Sunwoo, she believes him to be the human form of that special whale. Smitten with love and pregnant with his child, Hanbi wants to make things official. Only, Sunwoo has no intention of settling down. Why would he, when there are other fish in the sea?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Syndrome
author: Pache, Kimpa
description: Seo Jeong-in, the second son of a wealthy judge's family, fails to get into the university his father wants, unlike his older brother. Consequently, he ends up in a dormitory at a rural cram school catering to upper-class students. Having been aware of his sexual identity from an early age, Jeong-in has been enjoying a free-spirited and indulgent gay lifestyle. However, things turn for the worse when his dorm roommate, Seunghyun, captures footage of Jeong-in in a sticky situation with his friend

title: Cloop
author: Shinonome, Maki
description: A collection of eight short stories from mangaka Shinonome Maki. The collection is sex-filled, BDSM-themed with some set fantasy and one involving a demon.

title: Raise wa Kimi no Mono
author: Kamikou, Chizu
description: Saya is living under strained family circumstances as her father is absent and her stepmother only cares about her own son. Her stepbrother, who is a talented dancer, had an accident and is hospitalized with the doctors thinking he wont be able to walk again. Upset about this as she cares for him, the girl sees a strange figure in his room and soon after a strange man appears before her claiming to be a God of Resentment. He reveals that in a past life he promised her something in exchange for h

title: Mi Diablo
author: Kajimoto, Reika
description: Jake chose to become a cop as a way to cope with his struggles over his mixed heritage and maybe even mend his relationship with his father. When he's assigned to an important undercover case, he crosses paths with Miguel, a man who seems a lot like him, but...

title: Hitokui
author: Kamimura, Kazuo, Aku, Yuu
description:
The story of a girl who dreams of becoming Japan's biggest star. Willing to do everything to achieve her goal, even to devour anyone who stands in front of her. Yu Aku (one of the most influential lyricists and television writers in Japanese history) and Kazuo Kamimura, longtime friends, collaborate in this work that expresses all the cruelty and ruthlessness of the entertainment world.

(Source: Edizioni BD, translated)

title: Mousou Shounen Kansoku Shoujo
author: Ootsuki, Yuuko
description:
Pure and metamorphosis only separated by a piece of paper. This is about as young men and women with a variety of habit the story of their own point of view highlights. Volume I has skin, hands, hair, glasses, boxes and other hobbies. There are blog comments on net as "extremely pure and metamorphosis only separated by a piece of paper to make it too strong in this case are worth reading.

(Source: DM5)

title: Stalker
author: Danwoo
description:
A reclusive, disfigured man stalks a pretty, good-natured housewife. One day, he witnesses this woman's daughter being kidnapped.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Fragrance
author: Yuuki, Ryo
description:
Fumiya is a guy with a lot problems in real life, his job interviews are a disaster  and the relationship with Chiemi,his girlfriend, does not go well at all.

One day, however, something unexpected happens: before the poor Fumiya appears a beautiful and enigmatic high school student, Yuki, telling him: "Do you dare to go ...".

From that moment the life of our protagonist changes radically.

title: I Want You to Kill My Five Papa
author: Nagase, Yousuke
description:
A 30-year-old gig worker spots a prostitute who looks exactly like his first crush from middle school. Determined not to ruin those memories, he keeps his distance, content to just watch her night after night. But when a certain incident pushes him over the edge, he finally decides to approach her. Before he can hand over the cash, however, she gives him a "condition" he never saw coming.

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Volunteer Breeding
author: Kaimeiji, Yuu
description: In special administrative areas exist individuals that take on the role of K9s. One day a mother of two children is called by a government institution and is explained to that she is a K9 and needs to start acting as such.

title: The Devil Princess
author: Harunohi, Biyori, Umiu, Geso
description: She had a dream. Something about it was wonderful and brimming with light. It even felt so...real. But this world with trains, schools, books, movies, and friends isn't her home. Yet, something within her longs for it. When she awakes, she's in the demon world, living as a lesser demon. It's a carefree life—or it was until a more powerful being crossed her path. Then everything happened so fast: the magic summoning circle appeared and she didn't hesitate, she closed her eyes and jumped into it.

title: Satsu Recruit
author: MITA, Yoshimune
description:
In this business, you have to become a demon in order to survive. Even better if you side with a demon that can give you the power to make it to the top.

(Source: MU)

title: Manten no Hoshi to Aoi Sora
author: Nishimori, Hiroyuki, Iinuma, Yuuki
description:
The manga's story centers on Shingo Nakazawa, a high school boy who remains emotionless, even as the rest of humanity is coming to grips with the possibility of extinction due to the approach of a world-ending meteor. In the beginning of the story, Japan thinks itself saved from disaster, only to face another one.

(Source: ANN)

title: Character
author: Nagasaki, Takashi, Iwaya, Akira
description:
Follows an aspiring manga artist named Keigo Yamashiro who dreams of making it big. Yamashiro is extremely talented, but what holds him back is his inability to create any villains due to his overtly cheerful personality. Due to this, he is currently stuck in the position of being an assistant to a manga writer.

One day Yamashiro receives an assignment from his boss to visit a home and sketch the family living there. When Yamashiro arrives at the house he finds all four family members dead, and

title: Psychopath Kanojo to Houkai suru Boku no Nichijou
author: Kfumi, Huilamsi

title: Choueki Ichizen: Shakai no Gomi desu kedo Kansha shite Kuremasu ka?
author: Tanaka, Motoi, Miyatsuki, Arata

title: Tokyo Yamimushi: 2nd Scenario - Pandora
author: Honda, Yuuki
description:
The story of the sequel manga revolves around Kō Nonomiya, a respectable, upstanding salaryman. One night, his subordinate Naoki Takahashi brings him to a cafe where Nonomiya becomes the victim of an outrageous ripoff. Nonomiya then meets Asamura, a debt collector who lives in Tokyo's darker recesses, and the salaryman comes face-to-face with the hidden, crime-ridden underworld of the metropolis.

(Source: ANN)

title: Bloody Lies
author: Baek, Woo, ZO.KILLMER
description:
In a world where vampires and humans coexist, orphaned Eugene seeks recognition from his enigmatic vampire progenitor, Logan. Struggling with his lack of human emotions, Eugene stumbles upon an intimate scene involving Dominic, sparking a desire to reclaim his lost humanity. To learn emotions, Eugene makes an unusual deal with Dominic, blurring lines of desire, loyalty, and sacrifice in a world where emotions are both prized and perilous.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Ore, Gentei Comyushou nande.
author: Kiritani, Noba
description:
I don't have the normal kind of communication problem! If it's kids, I can get along with them just fine—my communication problems are limited! Nashikawa, a high school student with this kind of troublesome disposition, enters a "Volunteering Club," in which he watches kids!? Will Nashikawa be able to overcome his communication problems while being surrounded by quirky club members and little kids!?

(Source: LINE Digital Frontier, translated)

title: Asuka
author: Inazuma, Katsura
description: Azusa Kino is a sincere and cheerful 16-year-old girl who has become the subject of Takamichi Mishima's upcoming film production and his one-sided attraction. Writing the character in his script as "Asuka," Mishima is tasked with trying to recruit Azusa as the lead actress. However, his pure and innocent image of her is shattered when he comes across Azusa making out with her boyfriend. Heartbroken, Mishima gives up on the project, but a chance encounter with Azusa following the incident makes h

title: The Night of Siva
author: Matsueda, Naotsugu
description: By day, Shiba Takumi is the head psychotherapist of a police headquarters infirmary. By night, he kidnaps people and messes with their minds in the name of justice and experimentation. He selects his subjects carefully to be people who make the world around them a worse place. Then he drugs them and whisks them away to his laboratory, where he subjects them to an experimental treatment that changes their personalities. It doesn't always work exactly as he intends, but there's always tomorrow to

title: Iron Tile Jan
author: Saijyo, Shinji
description: An alternate universe story about Kurogane Jan, who becomes a cook and occasional player at the Sanbanchi mahjong parlor.

title: Camellia
author: Minami, Kiriko
description:
Brothers who escape from the violence of their father and live together. The Tsubaki brothers who live alone. A natural sadist brother and a masochist brother only to his brother. Violence, codependence, and extreme love.

(Source: MU)

title: Guilty
author: Kobayashi, Takumi
description: Twin sisters Rima and Riya were supposed to be the same but have one difference.

title: Hard Boiled Angel
author: Lee, Hyun Se
description:
The series is about Jiran Ha, a tough, hard-hitting police officer who is Korea's first female detective. She and her partner, Detective Park, are members of the Hard Crimes Unit, codenamed "Blue Angel." They regularly deal with violent and occasionally sexual crimes.

(Source: Wikipedia)

title: Takunabi: Happy Hello Work at Age 21
author: Yamaguchi, Katsumi
description:
Hagiwara Taku and Maki Teruya are just getting start. After 21 years thinking of nothing, now they have to admit reality: people have to work!

Taku thinks everything would be smooth with Akane, his girl friend since high school. But, as years changing, Akane gets bored that Taku hasn’t decided the future yet choosing to blame it all to fate. Maki used to be artist but now she’s disappearing from showbiz and tries to have job in financial field. She’s chased by her agency every single day and ke

title: Mahjong Hishouden: Naki no Ryuu Gaiden
author: Noujou, Junichi

title: Aru Oshiire Atama Otoko no Hanashi: Mokuhan Mangashuu
author: Fujimiya, Fuhito
description:
"To me, vanishing was eternal release."

A man who left his father's house lost interest in studying, lost faith in humanity, and locked himself in his apartment. So a year passed alone. Everyday, he thought more and more often about suicide, but one day he looked in the mirror and was stunned: instead of a head he now had a wardrobe. His existence became like a wardrobe—small and closed to the whole world.

(Source: Seirin Kougeisha, translated)

title: Yoiko no Mirai!
author: Kizuki, Akira
description: Inoue is in school manga club which don't do club activities at all. One day he gets some scratch and school infirmary, where he meets Aoki. He talks with her about the club, and suggested to make club magazine. Inoue decides to do so. Later, Aoki joins the club, plotting to break it.

title: Planetary Human II: Globe
author: Jo, Seok
description: The second season of Planetary Human.

title: Sacred Dream
author: Zhang, Xiaoyu
description: A writer of science fiction is in a coma following a stroke. But he continues dreaming the most delusional universes. Using a brand new machine, his doctor decides to enter the man's dreams, to bring him back to real life.

title: Koshotengai no Hashihime
author: Nokomi, Kurosawa, Rinko
description: Tamamori came to Tokyo with his sights set on getting accepted to the Imperial University. However, he doesn't pass the entrance exam, and is so undisciplined and wrapped up in endless fantasies that he's kicked out of his boarding house after only two years. Through a stroke of luck, Tamamori begins to live and work at Umebachidou, a used book store. There, he enjoys whiling away his time as a "student preparing for entrance exams" and taking advantage of friends who are also from his hometown.

title: Love Me Love XXX
author: Fujiokayu
description:
Maeda returns to his hometown for a reunion party with his high school club alumni. What kind of memories will fill his mind, and what new memories will he make? The bespectacled, seemingly pure and innocent Maeda may not be the full picture.

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

Included one-shots: Yukizuri (Casual Encounter), Give Me More Love

title: Lunatic Cinema
author: Hoshino, Kana
description: A 11th manga of Ryokunohara series. Hiroki, Kanata amd friends are back. In this manga, they are going to film a movie for the school. Soon each of them started to experience strange paranormal activities. Hiroki, Kanata and Fueko found themselves in another dimension where their film comes alive. Ijima is approached by the 'too nice to be truth' to be Kanata. Takahashi and Kiriko and later, the whole group facing off with the problem that their characters in the film run loose into the real wor

title: God-kun
author: Tono, Kokoro
description:
One day, a poor little girl died. A "god" appeared before the dead girl. The encounter made the girl want to take revenge on the adults.

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Human.Noah no Koe
author: Hoshino, Kana
description: The 12th manga of Ryokunohara Series. The manga started of with Kanata heard a girl crying for help during the night. He noticed the strange weather, the same type of weather before his parent died. He found the girl that is crying for help, and she knows him? He doesn't recognize her and have no clue why she knows who he is. Soon before Kanata helps her, she died, disappeared in Kanata's arm....or it seemed so. The next morning, that girl appear to be a new student in his school. She tries to h

title: Interview
author: Ludovico
description:
A writer suffering from writer's block, and a world trapped inside his head. This was an Interview he never wanted, and definitely not one he expected. 

(Source: Tapastic)

title: Inochigake no Game ni Makikomareta node Kirai na Yatsu wo Norinori de Katappashi kara Koroshiteyaru Koto ni Shita
author: Tomozo, Nakata, Kanata

title: Pine in the Flower Garden
description:
The story of the growing up of a high school student that hates spring and has a phobia for flowers.

(Source: MU)

title: Rotten Pink Law
author: Hiphop Sinsun
description:
With a sharp mind but missing a few screws, university freshman Bae Geumjoo decides to join the club after encountering Jang Haneul. However, as their bond deepens, the shadows of the past start to grip Geumjoo's evolving emotions. Instead of seeking pure love, she yearns for possession, and rather than mere excitement, she relentlessly pursues unwavering certainty. What does Geumjoo truly desire?

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Akihiko Kaku Katariki
author: Ooshima, Yumiko
description:
1. Akihiko Kaku Katariki
2. Long Long Cake
3. Niwa wa Midori-kawa wa Blue
4. Mizu no Naka no Tissue Paper

title: Mona Lisa no Heya
author: Watanabe, Masako
description: Vincent Minnelli is a doctor who has been called to Sweden for university work. One day, when hunting, he shoots a girl, mistaking her for a wild animal. The girl, Joanna, discloses a shocking fact to him before vanishing the next morning. That same morning, Vincent curiously receives an invitation from General Ambrose du Kloster, the current owner of Scorkloster Castle, a lavish mansion by the lake. However, upon visiting said mansion, Vincent notices a girl, Mona Lisa, who looks strikingly sim

title: Hangyoji
author: Takayashiki, Ibuki
description:
Masako just lost her mom. While walking around looking for new specimens for her hobby, she comes across what appears to be an unconscious merboy. As she approaches it, it calls out to her: "Mother..." She resolves to take care of him and brings him home.

(Source: MU)

title: A World Without You
author: Girang
description: There's only one thing that's keeping Han Sekye alive: the blond man in his dreams. No matter how bad it gets, how lonely he is, he can count on the man to come meet him in his dreams and make it all okay. So what is he to do when the man suddenly stops coming? Sekye falls apart and for years, he struggles with depression living on in a world without the man. Then one day, Woo Yijun appears in front of him, looking just like the man in his dreams. And seeing that he is an aspiring actor, Sekye h

title: Reset Game
author: Yoshikai, Kanji
description:
When he wakes up, he is in a white room with no exits and red cubes closing in on him… Why?! Who? For what reason? The person who suddenly appears before him, is she an enemy? Even a childhood friend can't be trusted.

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title: Nineteen
author: Ancco
description: At nineteen, the idea that you have your whole life ahead of you with endless possibilities can leave you terrifyingly stiff. Throwing mobility to the wind, you dull yourself with booze. The grown-ups around you are stunted by their own failures so they act out—with alcohol, too, sometimes with violence. What was once the hope of youth quickly spirals into powerlessness and malaise as the days trickle by. Ancco expertly renders the moment of suspension between the desire to grow up and the fear

title: Cruise - Ishi Yamada Kouhei Koukai-shi
author: Yajima, Masao, Kikuta, Hiroyuki
description:
Cruise is the story of Yamada Kohei, a doctor who gives up a landlubber medical career to serve as a ship's physician, and the people he meets on board Japan's largest luxury liner, the Phoenix. He rejects a university colleague's insistence that he turn to teaching instead, preferring to stay and learn about life as it happens from the ship's passengers.

Big Comic serializes this "beautifully sad human drama." One of the stories compiled in the first Cruise features a passenger suffering from

title: Watashi no Egaku Sekai wa Kowareteiru.
author: Miyako, Hachi

title: Yuutousei no Asobikata
author: Hisaka, Meira
description: Chouka doesn't want to be like her sister who likes to play with boys. One day, she accidentally saw a boy kissing a girl. Because of that accident, she entered an unpredictable situation.

title: Angel Mark
author: Matsunaga, Toyokazu
description: A collection of short stories by Toyokazu Matsunaga.

title: The Cell
author: Hwoalgi
description:
Junsu, a public health doctor serving his mandatory term at Songhwa Prison, thought his assignment would be dull, routine checkups, a few minor injuries, nothing more.

But on his seventh day, the world literally collapses. A mysterious nationwide sinkhole disaster swallows cities whole, cutting the prison off from the outside world. Now trapped inside a fortress filled with men more terrifying than demons, Junsu has only one thought: "I have to get out of here."

Clutching a stolen keycard, his

title: Shoichi
author: Kanda, Takeshi
description: A manga based on the real life adventures of Shoichi Sakurai.

title: In Full Bloom
author: Yeon, Jewon
description:
The kingdom of Juushin is suffering at the hands of a cruel emperor. In order to stop his father's rule of tyranny, the crown prince will enlist the aid of a legendary assassin with reasons of her own for wanting the emperor dead. One ruler, one schemer, and... one assassin.

(Source: Easy Going Scans)

title: Somnia
author: Kuraka, Sui
description:
"You will stay alive inside this happy dream, forever..."

Yasushi, a young man with an incurable disease who has a short life expectancy, is in love with his attending physician. Even though he wanted to be his lover and had a physical relationship with him, the doctor was only giving him the cold shoulder. Nevertheless, every day was a happy day, and Yasushi wished to stay in this happiness until the very end. Yet, it was such a small but sad and cruel wish...

A surgeon who violates the taboo

title: Behind Story
author: An, Narae
description: Taehee Choi dreams of becoming a professional race car driver. However, he plods through life as a lowly high school student. Taehee hates school with such a passion that he schemes of ways to get himself expelled. One day, he witnesses a fellow student Johann suffer a motorcycle accident. He rushes Johann to the hospital and helps the boy to school the next day. But, Johann is the most unpopular kid in class. The other students tease Johann for possibly being gay. Taehee isn't sure, but he slow

title: Beat's Discipline
author: Kadono, Kouhei, Ogata, Kouji
description: A spin-off of the Boogiepop series focusing on Minoru Sera.

title: Deep in the Heart
author: Lillia, Dallae
description:
Was it a one-night stand aftereffect? Dojin Yoon is unable to get turned on after meeting that girl. It's as if she has cast a spell on him, his body was numb. She was the only remedy to free him from the spell: Yuyoung Ha, the mysterious woman who left a strong trail behind from the very first time they met.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Kowai Kurai Ataru kara...
author: Iguchi, Kanon
description:
1. Tsumi no Meikyuu
A circle of sin, where a bit of mischief that lead to suicide happened over and over again.

2. Kowai Kurai Ataru kara ...
There are a fortune teller whose fortune telling is always true. 

3. Otonagari: Yoru wa Kodomo no Jikan
A story about three kids who always hanging out together every night for one hour.

4. Aitai ...
I feel that someone extremely important is going to visit someday. I've to prepare everything.

title: Otobako Garden
author: Yamaguchi, Miyuki
description:
Mary, who doesn't feel she's happy in life in spite of being rich. Sakura, who worries over being considerably slow. For Mary, it's expressing her love through a music box, and for Sakura, it's gaining the courage to be herself ..

(Source: Transcendence)

title: Kore wa Tada no Okurimono
author: Nejiga, Nameta
description:
I've been married for 5 years. I have no children. We sleep in separate rooms. Every day feels somehow lacking. One day, my husband came home with a present. He said it was from one of his colleagues. I liked exchanging presents, so I searched for something to give in return, but...

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

title: Sink for Me
author: Potato
description:
Six years ago, novelist Jung Seon lost everything, including his young son and his marriage. To escape the grief, he moves to a quiet rural village for a teaching gig, where he forms an unexpected, deep bond with an orphan named Hyeon-wu. Just as they grow inseparable, Hyeon-wu vanishes without a word on the eve of his adulthood. Two years later, he suddenly reappears as a charismatic stage actor, ready to script a new, intense chapter in their lives.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: What Don't You Understand
author: Hongjacga
description:
The peculiar story of a writer, a boy, their pets, a hitman, and some old wizard... and just when you thought you had it figured out...
Ale, a man of high reputation among those in the Dark Arts is hired by a famous horror novelist who goes by the name of Nero. Their first meeting is a bit awkward.

Nero finds himself in a bit of a predicament. The body that once was his (whether he liked it or not) is no longer his, but this isn't your typical transformation story.

The entire world is transfor

title: She Pretends to Be a Girl
author: Tanaka, Aya

title: Interview with a Murderer
author: KJK
description:
As a reporter, Clark has interviewed many criminals but never a murderer. Enter Alex, the Triage Killer. A serial killer who kills in three, he agrees to an interview so long as Clark offers one thing in return: himself. Murder after murder, question after question, Clark will learn why Alex kills. And Alex... he will learn Clark isn't as innocent as he seems.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kanjisugiru Onna: Tatsumi Yoshihiro Kannou Kessakushuu
author: Tatsumi, Yoshihiro
description:
1. Iroawase
2. Shitataka na Onna
3. Sasayaku Onna
4. Fuzaketa Onna
5. Kanjisugiru Onna
6. Yanagase no Onna

title: Kimi to wa Chimeiteki na Zure ga Aru
author: Akatsuki, Kakeya, Banpai, Akira

title: Love and Hell
author: Imai, Daisuke
description: "Did you know? Even I get a turn to make my move." Temp worker Rino Amano, 27 years old, used to have a lover. His name was Haruo Higashiyama and he worked full-time at the same company as the manager of the planning department. He was 32 years old, married, and had a two-year-old daughter. While 99% of her knew that this was an unforgivable love that would never amount to anything, the other 1% was clutching her phone, spending her days waiting for him to reach out. One day he suddenly demands

title: Girl Hunt
author: Kaimeiji, Yuu
description: A high school student is one day notified that she's been selected to become a dog. She's slowly treated more and more like a dog by her family, friends and teachers once they are told about it.

title: Milgram
author: Namitsumi
description:
Welcome to Milgram, the experimental prison that will test your ethics.

Currently, in this prison, there are five "murderers." The prison guard, Es, is an amnesiac girl who must investigate the reasons they have been locked up. Gradually, their crimes come to light and the pasts are revealed. And even more so, there is the truth behind the mysterious prison. When all sins are laid bare, can you grant forgiveness?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Inkaden
author: Kamimura, Kazuo, Okazaki, Hideo, Togawa, Masako
description: A biographical anthology series profiling Japanese femme fatales.

title: Noirstorborg
author: Swee Chin, Foo
description:
FSc’s new work “Noirstorborg” headlined the first chapter of Comic Ryu Vol.16 with all eight pages printed in full color.

(Source: The FØØL’s Progress)

title: Shell
author: Kim, Tam-mi
description:
Taehee, who was discriminated against based on her looks, goes to a plastic surgery clinic for a consultation, giving into the tempting proposal when Doha the handsome director steps in and tells her, "I'll make you beautiful." Thinking that this was the shortcut to happiness, Taehee accepts... but will she truly be able to obtain happiness by becoming beautiful?

(Source: MU)

title: Aka no 9-ban [Reijuu]
author: Aihara, Akira, Kazuoki
genre: High Stakes Game, Psychological, Strategy Game
