author: Akaishi, Michiyo
description:
1. Fair Lady wa Namida wo Nagasu
2. W: Kage no Nai Gogo
3. Sono Hi wa Kinyoubi
4. Vivian Lee ga Koroshita
5. 6-byou no 9-gatsu
6. Labyrinthos no Yoru

title: in the bleak and cold world
author: Takano, Suzume
description: A group of schoolgirls find a loaded gun in a paper bag, and they fantasize about murder.

title: Mafia in Closed Room
author: Baek, Ji-woon, Pan
description: High school student Kang Chul-joing awoke in an unknown locked room. He finds himself in a chaotic situation, he searched around the room and found an old MP3 player. What he learned from the message left on the MP3 player was that he was poisoned and that he had only three hours left to live. Kang Chul-joong, who was usually a mystery quiz enthusiast, tries to escape the unknown room by finding clues based on his reasoning skills that he has accumulated over the years. However, the reality is d

title: River in Me
author: Bang
description:
Koki, a tattoo artist, has excellent tattooing and designing technique, but he wasn't interested in people and had a difficult personality. Mia, Koki's only regular customer who had a certain obsession with "pain" stemming from his early life, begged him to tattoo all of his designs on his body. Koki gradually fell for Mia's unhinged and dangerous allure, but his true feelings remained yet to be seen. But what will happen to their faint relationship like a thin spider's thread?

(Source: GOT)

title: The End of Playing House
author: Sakasana
description:
1. Natsu no Atokata
2. Otanjoubi Omedetou.
3. Mayoidori
4. Long Long Tap Only Only Look
5. Ichijou Shunmu

title: Onna Kyoushi
author: Kamimura, Kazuo, Maki, Hisao
description:
Misae, a survivor of the new left-wing group Ten no Koe, travels to Numazu, Shizuoka Prefecture, and begins working as a junior high school teacher, hiding her true identity. However, the classes she teaches are full of troubled students. As she teaches them, Misae gradually awakens to her true calling as a teacher.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Sayounara, Watashitachi ni Yasashikunakatta, Subete no Hitobito
author: Nakanishi, Kanae, Shion
description:
In seeking revenge against the seven individuals who killed her sister, the girl sacrificed her life.

In the rural town of Agata, surrounded by mountains on all sides, Shiori Nakagawa, a student at the local high school, had become a truant due to bullying. One day, Mei Satou arrived at Shiori's house as a roommate. Mei, who kept her heart closed to everyone, confided in Shiori about her purpose in coming to this town.

"I want to slaughter all seven people who drove my sister to death."

Three

title: The First Murder
author: Kanmi
description:
"We are murderers, you know." Mayu is your average high school girl who goes to a prestigious school for young ladies. Her school life there feels fulfilling thanks to her close friends, Oto and Yuu. However, one day, Mayu and Yuu witnessed Oto pushing their class teacher who then fell and lost consciousness. Oto tries to explain that the latter has only passed out but...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: The Man Who Came in from the Sea
author: Satou, Kei
description:
A port town in Tohoku, facing a sea dotted with beautiful islands. Minami grew up there and works for his grandpa, who runs a fishing business. Ever since Minami's father abruptly vanished, grandpa has been like a father to him. On Minami's 20th birthday, a mysterious man appears from the sea...!? That man's true identity is... A story of bloodstained destiny begins!

(Source: GOT Corporation, translated)

title: Murakami Haruki no "Hotaru"/Orwell no "1984-nen"
author: Orwell, George, Moriizumi, Takehito, Murakami, Haruki
description:
1. Murakami Haruki no "Hotaru"
2. Orwell no "1984-nen"

title: Shards of Sin
author: Lee, Seungchan
description:
Five different people are gathered in an abandoned hospital after getting a mysterious phone call, and the mastermind behind the curtains holds their families hostage. He orders them to figure out the one culprit who killed his brother... Or otherwise, they will all die.

(Source: Easy Going Scans)

title: The Bequeathed
author: Kang, Taekyung, Jonoon, Leedo
description:
Yoon Seoha doesn't have time for anything else, what with trying to stay afloat at her job and making plans to take down her cheating husband. That all changes when her uncle passes away, and she's left with their family's burial ground. But upon agreeing to accept this inheritance, mysterious and sudden deaths begin happening around her. Disturbed and frightened, Seoha tries to get rid of the land, only to realize there may be more to this deadly family bequest than meets the eye...

(Source: T

title: Nurse Sheena's Asylum Diary
author: Lee, Raha
description:
The misadventures of patients in a mental ward, from the viewpoint of Sheena Jung, a nurse in the early stages of her career. Sheena works hard to take care of her patients and get along with her colleagues. She treats patients with various mental illnesses, such as mania, depression, delusion, and eating disorders. In the process, she learns how to treat her own self with love and kindness.

(Source: NHN comico Corp.)

title: Douki Enshutsu-ka: Yukiori Tsuzura no Hitogoro Switch
author: Hasama, Poporucha

title: Who Will Die Out of the Five
author: Seijin, Yuuki

title: Paradise Lost
author: Masa, Meal
description: "Within the walls of the mansion, the chairman's word is above the law." On the first day on the job as a bodyguard, Mincheol is taught to obey Chairman's Lim's orders at all times, at all cost. Chairman Lim is God, and the mansion a "paradise" he's built for himself and his beloved daughter. He'll do anything to preserve this world, meaning he won't tolerate recklessness or incompetence... Yet, Mincheol is all those things. He's entered the mansion with an agenda that could destroy the chairman

title: Kick the Bucket
author: Baek, Daekal, Surf Club
description:
Jinseop, a withdrawn and unassuming intern at a large corporation, has a dark obsession: stalking Taeyoung, the charismatic and seemingly perfect deputy manager of his team.

Jinseop becomes fixated, hoarding items tied to him; whether discarded objects or things briefly touched. However, Jinseop's adoration turns to fury when he discovers Taeyoung lobbying the chairman for a promotion. Driven by a sense of betrayal, Jinseop crafts a sinister plan to blackmail Taeyoung to strip away his pride an

title: Outside the Door
author: YD, Gilmong
description:
Reclusive and withdrawn, Tae-jeong has spent years shut away from the world, surviving in the quiet suffocation of his own room. But when his father is suddenly hospitalized due to a car accident, even that fragile isolation begins to crumble.

Grief and fear twist together inside him, leaving only one outlet, an uneasy rush of desire that both calms and consumes him.

Enter Eun-won, the golden boy who has everything Tae-jeong doesn't: confidence, charm, a life untouched by loneliness. He looks

title: Kimi ga Iu ni wa Inu no Koi
author: Sanshou, Uo
description:
A beautiful student council president and an ordinary delinquent. A chilling Boy Meets Boy!

"Listening to what someone tells me, getting praised for it... I just want to live doing only that." Is that nothing more than a sinful fairytale dream?

Yet that is exactly the simple wish of Akira Tamanoi, an ordinary high school boy. Day after day with no dreams, no motivation... Then one day, as a penalty for being late, Akira is assigned to help the student council, where he meets the wise and beaut

title: Doyoubi ni wa Kitto Iku kara
author: Akaishi, Michiyo
description:
1. Doyoubi ni wa Kitto Iku kara
2-3. Ame no Niau Heya
4. Kenzen na Seishin wa Kenzen na Nikutai ni Yadoru Wake de wa Nai
5. Fu-ri-n to Iu Koto
6. Itsuka Tasogare ni Deau

title: The Legend of the Street Mahjong Fighters
author: Moto, Souichi
description: Yorozu is a college student who feels like a total loser. He has no confidence, and he's always either worrying about messing up or agonizing about the things he's already messed up. After going to see his senpai Ken for help, he is thrown into the world of free mahjong parlors, where one plays against total strangers. Yorozu's never played free before, but luckily he has Ken, one of the best players around, to help him learn the ropes. And he's going to need all the help he can get, as the mahj

title: Kare wa Dandan Chi ni Somaru
author: Iguchi, Kanon
description:
1. Kare wa Dandan Chi ni Somaru
Ryuichi was killed on the night after we became lover. What was left of him are the memory I had when we was still a friend and his self portrait.

2. Yo no Naka Kurutteru yo
When a bullying is not forbidden again and become encouraged...

3. Jumon
People often said that their life is boring, but I know a way to make it more interesting. You only need a certain spell to make it more interesting.

4. Requiem
A group of girls confession about their dead friend.

title: Immortal Eye
author: Jang, Sei, Yeonmu
description:
After his wife and child leave him, Park Taesan decides it's time to give up his life as a major player in organized crime. Before he can retire though, he's betrayed by one of his own and brutally murdered. However, Taesan gets a second life when his organs are sold on the black market and transplanted into Yoo Chang, the successor of a major company. With a mild-mannered pushover and a revenge-thirsty thug fighting for control of the same body, will either make it out alive?

(Source: Tapas Me

title: St. Luminous mission high school
author: Aono, Atsushi, Takaki, Kyou
description: Kaihei is a rather normal high school student but soon discovers that his deceased grandfather has left him the chairman position of his all-girls high school, St. Luminous Mission High School. Besides being the only male student on campus, he is also now the young chairman in charge of campus rules, happenings and punishments. When Kaihei arrives however, it seems a student has gone missing. Kaihei, along with his closest friends, are now determined to solve this mystery (without getting the lo

title: Shape of the Nightmare
author: Kim, Yong-ki
description: Jeong Da-eun and Yun Jong-u are the sole known survivors of two killing rampages perpetrated by a mysterious gang. Many years later, an investigation into a possible copycat crime forces them to revisit their trauma. Da-eun becomes determined once again to find her boyfriend, Shim Gyuheon, who went missing after the murders they witnessed. Meanwhile, Jong-u is plagued by the ghost of "Room 203," his former neighbor who came within inches of killing him. His sick brother Jongseok was his only rea

title: Reverie
author: Ryouko
description: Mr. Takasugi is a clinical psychologist at a loss after breaking up with his ex, who he controlled through abuse. He realizes that Isamu, a high school student at his side gig as a school counselor, is the same as him, lonely, and wanting to be needed by someone. He decides that he's the only one who can understand this boy's feelings... While knowing he shouldn't, he reaches out. Meanwhile, Isamu tries to force Mr. Takasugi to become his lover... A story about two lonely souls, a school counsel

title: This Is My Report That When I Woke Up, I Noticed I Was My Wife and Was Pregnant!
author: Kurumatani, Haruko
description:
"I don't need you to raise our child."

I am Seiichi Itou. My wife left me with those words, leaving behind divorce papers. After falling down in a panic, I woke up to find myself in the body of my wife, Kaori when she had just given birth?!

"I'm sure you can do it, Kaori-chan!"
"Can you do more of the housework?"
"Tell me, what should I do?"

I thought I had been doing my part in raising our child, but the fact was that I didn't know anything at all...

This is the next part of the much talked

title: Sixteen
author: Kim, Intae
description:
Injoo Suh, a 29 year old single mother and an office worker, meets a suspicious co-worker and her daily life is shaken.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Lateral: Suihei Shikou Suiri no Tenshi
author: Otono, Yomoji, Okada, Anmitsu

title: Perennial
author: Gunjou, Pizu
description:
Matsuri is a girl who continues to kill others by impulse while her father who is the mayor continues to cover her crimes. Momose is the detective that Matsuri has fallen in love with as well as the son of the man she has killed. Momose does not know this and has already overcome many of the traps she has set for him while he tries to uncover the culprit. In the end, will he be able to reach the truth?

(Source: MU)

title: Shinzou no Nai Kyojin
author: Satou, Shio
description:
This volume contains two short stories, each two chapters long, by Sato Shio.  

Shinzou no Nai Kyojin:
On the giant space ship Exculsus, King Kravitz and his queen, Clara, maintain rule over a very large population of permanent ship residents.  Among Kravitz's responsibilities is to produce offspring with the ship's women, but his failure to produce a child with the queen has led to tension and disquiet on board.  The queen's purchase of a strange telepathic blue-eyed monkey temporarily lighten

title: Kaze no Wa ・Toki no Wa・ Suna no Kan
author: Kousaka, Tomoko
description:
Akira is a special kid. Instead of going out to play like any other kids, he prefers to read difficult books for grown up. However, his parent is deeply concern about him. It's true that he can solves college level difficult questions, but no matter what...he won't talk.

What Akira's parent doesn't know is that Akira is being stalked by a mysterious man that only Akira can see him. That man dress in unusual dress and shows up everywhere even in Akira's room, especially when the subject of god c

title: Dokuro wa Yamiyo ni Ugokidasu
author: Inui, Yoshihiko
description:
An old man with no relatives suddenly has new neighbors. He is touched by the family's kindness, and, momentarily, feels for the first time as if he actually has a family of his own. Until someone murders them. The old man, who has nothing left to lose, turns into a demon of revenge! A story of dark violence!

(Source: Shounen Gahousha, translated)

title: i.d.
author: Kishi, Torajirou
description:
Akiko Hirukawa is a young woman who has lost herself in her everyday life. She works, not particularly skillfully, as both a telemarketer and a model, but she is deeply unhappy. Her only relief is letting out her stress by sparring at a dojo. Will Akiko be able to reconnect with herself and reevaluate her current lifestyle?

(Source: MU)

title: The Color of the Water
author: Maki, Ebishi
description:
Heaven is a city where life and death meet. Lithia, a boy with amnesia, lives there with Setsu, a hitman covered in wounds. He always dresses Lithia in red, is very kind and laughs as if he is about to burst into tears at any moment, which makes Lithia very uncomfortable. But one day, their usual routine changes completely when Romanée, a man who seems to know Setsu's past, appears...

(Source: Taiyo Tosho, translated)

title: Strange Pictures
author: Uketsu
description:
A series of drawings made by a young woman before her death. A child's disturbing picture of his home. A desperate sketch made by a murder victim in his final moments. Each contains a chilling warning. Each reveals a terrible secret, hidden in plain sight. Can you find the clues in these strange pictures and uncover the sinister truth that connects them all?

(Source: Penguin Random House)

title: Tsumi no Koe: Shouwa Saidai no Mikaiketsu Jiken
author: Moto, Souichi, Shiota, Takeshi

title: Sumigahara Uguisu no Ronshou
author: Quzumi, Shiki, Katsuki
description:
Uguisu stands out from ordinary teenage girls. Spending most of her time in the library and never appearing in class, she still somehow manages to score full marks in tests. Though she is difficult to deal with at times, I developed a strange relationship with her.

One day we were entrusted a strange order to investigate whether the genius mathematician Kiryu is actually a magician. We then went to the Kirin Mansion, the place where professor Kiryu resides. And then two days later, professor Ki

title: The Maid
author: Song, Chaeyun, Yengo
description: Kang Hana, a former girl group trainee, gives up everything and decides to have her baby after an unexpected pregnancy. She temporarily leaves the baby in a baby box until she can save up for a housing deposit. But she then finds out that a famous actor-director couple has adopted her child. Determined to get her baby back, she becomes the babysitter in their home. But then she discovers that the wife, Angela, is transfusing the baby's blood—almost like a vampire. Kang Hana decides she must kill

title: Happy Kashiiki
author: Sorajirou
description:
The story follows Hikari, a girl who has mysteriously lost her sense of happiness. As she grapples with her growing sense of dread, her cheerful classmate Kage offers to help her search for her lost happiness.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Sorta Psycho
author: Jagal
description:
Juheon is abducted by a stranger who refuses to explain anything, insisting he must remember the truth on his own. Overnight, his life is stolen from him, leaving him trapped in a room with only his captor's voice, touch, and rules to anchor him. Terror slowly warps into a twisted dependence, and even as he demands to know why this is happening, he can't stop reaching for the very man who tore his world apart.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: J. Boy: Second Season
author: Noujou, Junichi
description: Sequel to J. Boy.

title: Kotoba no Nai Tokoro
author: Ueda, Sakahira
description:
The main character, Koga, was portraying Natsuki Shimai, an overwhelmingly beautiful woman who is constantly rumored. As if to express something that cannot be put into words. "Don't you think I'm more beautiful?" When she said that and turned around, Natsuki Shimai herself was there...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: A Cat's Tale
author: Kim, Hyunjoong, Kwon, Saehim
description:
The truth behind... farm animals?

The animals living on the farm of Saemin's family are not what they seem. Although they put up an act of innocence in front of Saemin's family, they are fully capable of deliberately committing horrifying acts. Told from the point of view of an extremely intelligent old cat, this is a thrilling tale of jealousy, manipulation, and murder.

(Source: Manta)

title: The end of the dream
description:
The future when humans live underground in order to escape radioactivity after the nuclear war.

ESP people who sometimes come into existence were called "P" that meant "Perplexer", evaded and persecuted. 

Stella tries to notice her son's Srow is P and to commit suicide with him. 
However, only Srow survives, and he is taken by Yang who is a close friend of Stella.

title: Beyond Santa's Grave Marker
author: Higuchi, Kishin
description:
It's Christmas Eve. In a busy shopping mall, Ginya, an orphan boy, meets Okuri, a lost girl. Ginya goes along with Okuri, who believes in Santa, to find her father, but then suddenly an earthquake hits the area...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Houfuku Gakuen
author: Akiyama, Hiroyuki
description: A middle school student gets kidnapped and wakes up in a school with no way out. He has to participate in a battle royale with the other students in order to survive.

title: Sushi Kokuu Hen
author: Kobayashi, Doumu
description: The owner of a sushi restaurant discusses googology (the study of very large numbers) with his chefs and customers.

title: Shizumare! Vincent
author: Kairemeku
description: In middle school, Kimie was a loner who spent most of her time indulging in chuuni fantasies, particularly through a poorly-drawn self-insert manga featuring a handsome knight named Vincent. After the embarrassment of the whole class making fun of her art, she burns as much of it as possible, and completely changes her image for a fresh start in high school. However, one of her classmates immediately finds out about her drawings, and she starts getting bullied. Right as her high school life look

title: Daifurinden
author: Matsumoto, Leiji
description:
Utamaro Yoshikawa is an adulterer who takes on requests from men who want to get divorced without paying alimony, and creates evidence of infidelity by having sexual intercourse with his clients' wives himself.

(Source: Wikipedia, translated)

title: Mabushii Sora ni Kiss Shou
author: Takemoto, Kotarou
description: Collection of 10 romance stories.

title: Usotsuki Non-chan, Jigoku ni Ochiro
author: Yamamoto, Saho
description:
The most popular girl in class, Non-chan, was the envy of everyone, rich, fashionable, and knowledgeable. That is, until one fateful day where her lie was exposed... A twisted love story between two young girls.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: The Secret Child Hello Work
author: Sakura, Megu, Suzuki, Osamu
description:
Ai Aikawa is being bullied at school just because she's poor. One day, she's chosen to work at "Chaiharo," a Hello Work for children. The job there can earn big money, but it is frightening. To protect her sickly mother and get rid of the fierce harassment from her relatives, Ai decides to earn money at "Chaiharo."

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Boku ga Boku ja Nai
author: Oseri, Yuuto
description:
"I" can transform into "Cry Hero," a hero who protects people. But "I" also have a life with my girlfriend?!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Nigotta Kusuri
author: Kusaka, Shinya, Yayoi, Yume
description: Himari is a timid girl who had always relied on Kyou, her friend from a broken family. She had always believed that Kyou was strong, but she failed to notice that Kyou was becoming a drug addict.

title: Sobo no Kami wo Kitta Hi
author: Shikabane-sensei
description:
Shikabane never knew his mother. Abandoned by his father, he lived alongside his grandmother as a child in poverty. But thanks to the kindness of the latter, despite a difficult daily life and the blessings of his comrades, he managed to grow and build himself. As an adult, he finally believed he could enjoy life. Unfortunately, when his grandmother seems to show signs of senile dementia, Shikabane loses his footing and doesn't know how to react...

(Source: Akata, translated)

title: Shiroi Tsuki Joshin
author: Fuyumori, Yukiko
description: This manga is the prelude of Ai To Yokubou Rasen. Since they were young, twin brothers Ryuuga and Taiga received different treatment from their mother. Ryuuga was doted on by his mother while Taiga received the opposite. Eventually Ryuuga's Mum started to show her strong love desire to have Ryuuga by her side, eventually both of them engaged in a forbidden sexual relationship. This story is full of forbidden smut stuff, but ought to read this manga as Ai To Yokubou Rasen storyline gets more inte

title: Bathtub de Kurasu
author: Shiki, Taiga, Yanagi, Sue
description:
A 22-year-old woman starts living in her family’s bathtub.

"Humans are too high-strung..."

Medaka Isohara is a girl with a slightly different sensibility from others. She was born small and grew up small, with almost no desires. She has no material desires, no appetite, no interest in romance, and no ambition for the future. If possible, she would prefer to die at twenty...

Supported by her amusing family—a farting father, a mother who has beaten cancer twice, and a mischievous and creative b

title: Violence Family: Mamatomo wa DV Ikka
author: Moriwaki, Aoi
description:
If your friend's family suffered from domestic violence would you help?

Nozomi Manaka moved to a new residential area after her daughter entered elementary school. At the entrance ceremony, she happened to meet the husband Shouichi Sawahara and his wife Megumi, and she became closer with the family. Nozomi is happy to have become friends with Megumi, but she feels uncomfortable with the words and behavior of the family. Is she just too sensitive? Or...

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Killing Mr. Park
author: Sin, Won-seop, Kim, Boiler
description:
Kill your husband and live with me.

One day, Sujin confesses to Min that she wants to kill her husband, Mr. Park, during the company field trip. Min, who has had a crush on Sujin for a long time, agrees to help her with her plan. But on the trip, despite seeming as if she doesn't remember the plan, Sujin acts strangely. What agenda could Sujin be hiding?

(Source: Manta)

title: The Assassins Series
author: Isaka, Koutarou
description:
Suzuki is an ordinary man... until his wife is murdered. To get answers and his revenge, he abandons his law-abiding lifestyle and takes a low-level job with a front company operated by the crime gang Maiden, who are responsible for his wife's death. Before long, Suzuki finds himself caught up in a network of quirky and highly effective assassins:

The Cicada is a knife expert.

The Pusher nudges people into oncoming traffic.

The Whale whispers bleak aphorisms to his victims until they take the

title: Flash Behavior
author: Michii
description:
Can Yuli save humanity?!

Eaters—intelligent creatures from outer space that prey on Earthlings. Problem is, even though they look like humans, no one knows how to talk with them! Enter Yuli, the only known human to date who can communicate with the Eaters. Can Yuli save the world AND her love life?

(Source: Manta)

title: Abyss Cruise
author: Cori
description:
Jun Jung was a bystander who watched his classmates bully Soorim Sung, a student who transferred to Bukak High School at the start of his second year. Although Jun never participated in the bullying, he also never did anything to help stop it. Six months later, Jun's class was picked for Abyss—an escape room on a ship. Jun and his classmates couldn't be more excited, but their excitement soon turns into fear when they realize the person behind Abyss is out for blood...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kill Milu Katalu: Menomiya Hitomiko no Gankyuu Sagashi
author: ukyo_rst, Hiiro, Tomoka

title: Otona no Mondai Teiki Series: Sakebi
author: Momochi, Reiko

title: Keppeki Gamer
author: Amano
description:
A boy suffering from severe OCD has locked himself in his room for the last 5 years. But his life changes when he meets a girl in a wheelchair with her hands deformed. Despite her disability she's a very skilled e-sports gamer playing only with her mouth.

(Source: MU)

title: Ringwanderung
author: Moriizumi, Takehito
description: A young lady working at an isolated mansion sees something she shouldn't have seen.

title: Negative Happy Chainsaw Edge
author: Takimoto, Tatsuhiko
description: Yousuke Yamamoto is a typical underachiever, searching for a reason to live while struggling to come to terms with the death of his friend Noto a year ago. Everything changes dramatically for him one night when he runs into Eri Yukizaki, a beautiful girl hiding a tragic loss of her own, out on the streets. When a chainsaw-wielding giant falls from the sky and engages her in battle, it marks the beginning of Yousuke finally finding his purpose in life.

title: Mom's Never Going Back to Heaven.
author: Inako

title: Kemonoki

1. Tsurishi Nesshou
2. Simple Life
3. Shippaisaku
4. Zange no Yado
5. Aru Yokan
6-7. Nagaremono-tachi
8-11. Kemonoki

title: Hatsukoi, Zarari
author: Zaku, Zakuro
description:
Arisa Ueto is diagnosed with a slight learning disability as well as autism. As a result, she struggles with holding regular employment and feelings of low self-esteem, as if she's good for nothing but sex. This all changes when she starts a new part time job, where she meets a kind co-worker Okamura.

(Source: AniList)

title: Lost in Love
author: Haedan, 33
description: Everyone on campus knows the rich and handsome Jung Woojin, so when a guy like that offers to buy him a meal, Kang Seoju agrees immediately and that might have been the biggest mistake of his life. When Seoju regains consciousness, he finds himself stranded on a deserted island with just Woojin, unsure of how much time has passed. Woojin confesses to being hopelessly in love with him and is determined to make Seoju his, regardless of how Seoju feels. But as their entanglement grows, Seoju starts

title: Watashi no Kanojo
author: Minami, Q-ta, Vigan, Delphine de
description:
Novelist Yuu Kanamori publishes a novel about her mother's death, which wins an award, gains widespread attention, and even leads to an autograph session. On her way home afterward, she meets a mysterious girl named L. From that moment on, Yuu finds herself unable to write and begins to struggle. As time passes, the distance between them gradually closes, and she grows closer to L, who offers her encouragement and support?

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Medical Record of Midnight Blue
author: Shiina, Chika
description:
"I'm having a hard time." "I'm in pain." "I want to die."

Depression, panic disorder, addictions... For all those who are suffering from such difficulties in life that they wish to die, psychiatrist Rinko is busy working to ease their troubles. Then one day, her precious daughter attempts to commit suicide...? Waking up in the body of her daughter, she tries to find the cause.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Niku: Danzai

A queen with an entire class in the palm of her hand, striking fear into the hearts of her subjects with a single glance. "This is wrong," they think to themselves—"This is not fair. We are all equal."—so why is it that not one of them speaks up? If silence is our answer to tyranny, then who will help the helpless?

(Source: SpotToon)

"Being with them is a pain but I have to stay friends with them, and having more friends is better..." Human researcher Ado Arima will teach you how to free yourself from such a curse!

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

Akamemura is an isolated place, where ancient folklore remains. Hayato Misawa, a young doctor who dislikes the din and bustle of the big city, transfers there and gets embroiled in a confrontation with the villagers as soon as he arrives. Ihae, children's story writer and vegetarian, begins each day by eating the leaf of his pet vegetable, "Aechae." Mocked for having top-tier talent but the worst looks, Kim Yeppeum falls into despair, betrayed by those she trusted and robbed of everything she worked for. But then, a seeming miracle transforms her into someone breathtakingly beautiful. In the following days, she watches a dreamlike new life unfold before her eyes. Fame, attention, and endless praise are intoxicating, but something feels off. Soon, she realizes this beauty isn't a blessing. It is a curse.

After a passenger ship sinks, several adults and one child wash ashore near an abandoned lighthouse. Cut off from civilization, they struggle to survive as their situation becomes increasingly dire. Michiru, a high school student who suddenly turned into a tanuki beastman one day, runs away from the human anti-beastmen advocates and makes her way to "Anima City," a city where beastmen live, to search for a way to turn back into a human.

While bewildered about the differences between the human cities and etiquette and that of beastmen, she starts learning about the way beastmen live.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: I Suggested to a Classmate Just Before Jumping Off That We Should "Do XXX."
author: Akatsuki, Yamori, Murasame, Shin
description:
My first love, her name is Kurumi Koga.

She was so much more beautiful and mature than a typical high school student, which attracted a great deal of jealousy and dislike. So much so that she was on the verge of jumping off the rooftop because of all the bullying she received.

So, what can I do to help?

"Why not have sex with me!"
"...You pervert! (yuck!)"
"Maybe so! But are you sure? If you die here, your last memory will be the confession of some pervert you don't even know! It would ruin t

title: Hoshihimemura no Naishobanashi
author: Azuma, Yuki
description:
Hajime Kanzaki, a school nurse, is overwhelmed by urban girls. Thus, he returns to his hometown, but the girls in that village are also...?!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Masuraou
author: Sakamoto, Shinichi
description:
In a little town near Osaka, an old tradition is being perpetuated. Every year, for hundreds of years, the men of the town defy each others in the "grand ceremony of Masuraou". Their weapons? Their courage and their fists! Their goals? Becoming the king of the town!

It's in this atmosphere that Takeshi Yamato, a young high schooler from Tokyo, moves in. Ex-gang leader decorated with an incredible secret, he is decided to forget the past and become a socially acceptable guy... However, between h

title: Genjitsu de Love Comedy Dekinai to Dare ga Kimeta?
author: Hajikano, Sou, Katakei
description: "I want to have a romcom-like experience." Haven't all romcom lovers who enjoy light novels thought this before? Being all lovey-dovey with the heroine, and leading a fulfilling high school life with the best of friends. However, there's no way something that exciting could happen in reality. I have no younger step-sister, no childhood friend, no classmate who's an idol, no mysterious senpai, and not even a male best friend character. That being the case, what can I do? Obviously, I have to put

title: Becoming a Princess Knight and Working at a Yuri Brothel
author: Hinaki
description: Talk about your extreme career changes! Naruse Soushi, a middle-aged man and private secretary to a politician, lies on the verge of death. Meanwhile, in another world, the princess knight Reina has been captured by an enemy nation. The princess' soul is removed–and Naruse is summoned into the empty husk of her body! Now that he's taken over the form of this beautiful young woman, he's doomed to her fate: being sold to a yuri brothel where he has to service female customers. He's determined to l

title: Gal Nanajimi wa Koko ga Suki
author: BUTA

title: Nana to Kaoru: Pink Pure
author: Momose, Tamami
description: 4-koma side stories of Nana to Kaoru.

title: Glamorous
author: Nylon
description:
Ogawa Tomoo, a high school boy, can not figure out why his classmate, Oomori Yuka, likes him so much. Unlike him, she's friendly, upbeat, excels at sports and is one of the most popular students in the school. Tomoo doesn’t understand why someone so attractive would be interested in someone like himself. He decides to push Yuka away for her own good but her persistence eventually pays off and he can not help but be attracted to her. 

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Anekurabe
author: Shinonome, Tarou
description:
Shun knew what to expect when he became a high school student. As he entered the gates of his new school, four beautiful girls suddenly surround him. These four girls are the same four girls he grew up with since kindergarten. The four girls are Rio the athlete, Miku the cook, Nana the nerd, and Yuri the student president. These four girls will be battling it out between them in order to win the heard of their beloved Shun.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Middle-Aged Man Overpowers with Guns in the Another Universe.
author: Morio, Masahiro
description:
The middle-aged man and airsoft enthusiast Daisuke Koga is summoned to a different world on his 40th birthday. Given the ability to turn airsoft guns into real guns, Daisuke must save the other world while traveling back and forth between reality and the fantasy world. Alongside female swordsman Rena, Daisuke becomes the only gun user and dominates in the fantasy world after work!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Ladies versus Butlers!
author: Kouzuki, Tsukasa, Nekomaru, Nekoyashiki
description: Hino Akiharu lost his parents when he was an elementary student and was taken in by his uncle's family. One day, he sees on the news about the newly-established Hakureiryou Gakuin, a school which was re-built from an elite girls' school. He decides to take the exam for that school and succeeds in entering the House Management Department (the place to train maids & butlers). He wants to become a butler, although his appearance scares the ladies. Akiharu has a sinister look in his eyes, a scar

title: Doraemon
author: Matsumoto, Taiyou
description: A short oneshot about the effects of time travel on Nobita from Doraemon.

title: Kuni wo Owareta Ryuushi-san, Hirowareta Ringoku de Ukkari Musou Shiteshimau. Jakushou Kokka ga Tairiku Saikyou no Ryuu no Rakuen ni Naru made
author: Kenkyo na Circle, Satou, Hayato
description:
The series is about the old man Breed, who is fired from his job and exiled from his country. His dragons follow him, however, and so begins his journey to reclaim his glory.

(Source: ANN)

title: Kanojo no Sekai
author: Hakamada, Mera
description: Konno finds herself interested in an erotic tale created by her classmate Hikawa.

title: Ore to Ichino no Game Doukoukai Katsudou Nisshi
author: Hamura, Tetsu, Mori, Misaki
description: A romantic comedy involving Souji Shirosaki a student, who is in high school, whose personality can not leave out people in need, and Ichino Moritsuka, 16, a friend in the same class as Souji, who lives alone in an apartment near the mountains. Together, they discover they have strange psychic powers, founding a club game.

title: Seijou Kouchakan no Jijou
author: Suekane, Kumiko
description: This tale begins with Shino who was in love with a girl called Maruyama. Shino asked his best friend, Akira, to set him up with Maruyama, but instead Akira betrayed Shino. Depressed, Shino goes to spend the rest of his day binging on cakes at the Seijou Black Tea House which is run by two mental cases by names of Shuuji and Keisuke. Mix a magical tea leaf, homosexuals, and various other things for ensuing hilarity. (Source: Taruby's Paradox)

title: The Thing about Bees
author: Ashinano, Hitoshi
description: A girl, a bee, and a man... and a little bit of everyday magic.

title: Shounen Shoujo 18-kin
author: Kuzushiro
description:
Himekami Ringo is a typical high school student, but with a weird childhood friend. Hayachine Nagomi may look like just another girl, but she actually enjoys reading erotic manga stories.

(Source: MU)

title: My Poison Princess Is Still Cute
author: Sakutake, Chihiro
description:
When demon princess Raffy married Roren, an immortal knight who safeguards humanity, as part of a new peace treaty between humans and demons, she hadn’t quite expected... that he'd fall for her?! Not only that, he's weirdly stubborn enough to keep trying to get closer to her, despite repeatedly dying from the poison she naturally emits. Just how long will his adoration prevail...?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: She, Her Camera, and Her Seasons
author: Tsukiko
description: Akari is a third-year student who has spent her high school career sticking to the straight and narrow...but her attention is caught by Yuki Sendo, the short-haired, standoffish girl in her class who seems to buck the trend. Akari can't seem to stop seeking Yuki out, and her feelings rapidly develop into something more than girlish friendship. But Yuki seems to have eyes only for her childhood friend, Rintaro Kagawa...who himself seems to have feelings for Akari. It's a mess...and one that threa

title: Pochi-Gokko.
author: oimo
description:
One day, the protagonist Tomoyori decides to end his own life.
But that was not the end—as his eyes opened, he found himself in a strange room.

Turns out, he's now the pet of a mysterious high school girl. Yes, you heard that right. Interacting with a high school girl? Could this be a gift from the heavens? Or is it divine punishment?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Onna Maou-sama wa Yuusha-kun wo Taosenai.
author: Kasuga, Shun
description:
Abyss, the female demon king, is troubled by her inability to defeat the hero, the nemesis of the demon races. This hero is an inexperienced boy, still a long ways off. Defeating him should be easy!... and yet... The trouble is he doesn't know Abyss's true identity and gets attached to her as her adoring "disciple"...!?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Dark Mage
author: Kang, Jae-Sin, Kim, Jung Ryul
description: Once... Humans and Orcs peacefully co-existed, but at some point humans got greedy and started a war claiming the Orcs' territory. The diety-Lord who created all, got angry with the humans' greed and decided to punish them with 3 catastrophes. One of them was the "Dragons", divine creatures blessed with magic capable of doing almost anything. Now the Orcs, with a "Dragon" by their side, seem to have the upper hand. Will humans just sit back and see their land get destroyed? They are too devious

title: Ore x Yome - Cupid no Itazura
author: Kitazaki, Taku
description:
1-3. Ore x Yome
4-6. Gyakushu no Ore x Yome

title: Shinobuna! Chiyo-chan
author: Shitara, Kiyoto
description:
Chiyoyo Suzume is a shinobi, but she's also a high-school girl in love. Follow her as she tries to confess to the boy she likes.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Seven Sisters
author: Fujioka, Toki
description: To Minagawa Ichiri, both good things and bad things are bothersome. That's why his principle is to avoid doing anything that would cause such a thing. However, there is one thing that he can't avoid—because of his parents' jobs, he was constantly transferring from school to school. This time, he has transferred to Reimei Academy, one of the five famous private academies called the "Seven Sisters." On his tour of the school with vice president Kirishima Shitone, an attack occurs! The attacker see

title: Life Alive!: Kimi to Hajimeru Gakuen Sousenkyo
author: Asano, Hajime, Necometal
description:
Hokuto Kuzuhara is a delinquent known throughout Sekai Private Academy. His way of life being so hated by his family that they give him an ultimatum—find a girlfriend within a year or move out. That said, though, months pass and he still has had no luck and it seems like he never will. It is then during this predicament that he is approached by the student council vice president with a plan that would both save him from moving out... as well as help her with her revenge.

(Source: Deus Ex Scans)

title: Shiori's Diary
author: Tsuyatsuya
description:
Shiori is turning 35, married for 3 years and trying to adapt to the unvarying and boring routine as a wife. She thought that this tranquility will be their future as a married couple, but one day, she stumbles on a diary on her husband's study. As Shiori reads through the pages, she realizes it is her husband's diary where he put down in writing all his private moments with his lover! Is it time for Shiori to start her own diary?

(Source: MU)

title: Gunmania
author: Hirano, Kouta
description: Bandou Eiji is a hitman (though he hates to be called as such...) with more than a few screws loose. This 3 chapter mini-series from the creator of Hellsing follows the escapades of the demented Bandou as he picks off one target after another whilst simultaneously confusing the hell out of onlookers with his unhinged mental disposition!

title: Zingnize
author: Warainaku
description:
Follows the story of "Edo's Sanni-en (Sajin no)" Takasaka Jinouchi, Jozawa Junai, Shoji Jinouchi. Three years after the battle of Sekigahara (1603 AD), Okubo Changan invited Takasaka Junouchi, who is known as a former thief, to destroy Kotaro Fuuma and his clan of criminals in Edo, but what will he get in return?

(Source: MU)

title: Iketeru Futari
author: Sano, Takashi
description:
16-year old Keisuke Saji loves to fantasize about young beautiful women. He hopes to land the object of his affection, Koizumi Akira. However, Koizumi hates Saji (as well as all men) to the point of assault. While most guys take Koizumi's cold shoulder as a hint, Saji pursues head-on without having rejection faze him.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Included one-shots:
Volume 1: Channel Artemis♥
Volume 7: Joshikousei Imadoki-teki Houkago Jijou
Volume 9: Joshikousei Hasshin Kouza
Volume 10: Bangai-hen: Fuu

title: World's End Harem: Fantasia Academy
author: LINK, Andou, Okada
description:
In this comedic reimagining of World's End Harem: Fantasia, Lord Arc Nargala and the women who serve him must navigate a whole new heart-pounding world. Even the mysterious dark elf Lati makes an appearance—as Arc's new homeroom teacher! Do Arc and Aurelia stand a chance of being happy together in this place? What of Arc's power to wield Macht? And is it even legal for a homeroom teacher to be so scantily dressed?!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Virgin na Kankei R
author: Kobayashi, Takumi
description:
Preview Contains spoilers since it's a sequel for the original Virgin na Kankei.

After Kimijima managed to get married with his beautiful love interest Kana -san and they start "they happily ever" after life style, nothing could go wrong... right?

... Well, Kimijima himself doesn't seem to have that luck in work, as he gets a sudden transfer for another office and is forced to live away from his lovely wife... What's even "worse" is that Kimijima's old luck with women will lead him again into

title: Youki ni Naritai Shigure-san
author: Oohama, Kanata
description:
Yoshida (14 years old) is the inkya (not social, dark etc.) of the class. One day, he is seated next to Shigure-san, an inkya girl. After Shigure-san realizes that Yoshida is one of her kind, she starts to call out to him, all of a sudden...! The dark duo engages in a heated battle to become the youkya (happy/sunny person)!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Amai Seikatsu
author: Yuzuki, Hikaru
description: The complicated story of a young man who goes to work for a lingerie company.

title: Mathematical Girls
author: Hisaka, Mika, Yuuki, Hiroshi
description: Through the beauty of mathematical reasoning, three high school students try to connect with each other. When Milka, a gifted female student, meets a fellow first-year male student with glasses, the only words that come out of her mouth are numbers. Bewildered, the boy shortly understands that he is asked to solve a standard problem: to find the next term in a sequence of integers. Impressed by how he solves her riddle, the mysterious Milka befriends the mathematics enthusiast, and they frequent

title: Karate Shoukoushi Monogatari
author: Baba, Yasushi
description: The story picks up where the prequel, Karate Shoukoushi Kohinata Minoru, leaves off, with a bit of a time skip. However, the focus now shifts to two minor characters from the original series, Meo and Takeru, who are now first years in Reinan High School. The student council president there is Touko Izumi, the only daughter of Koushou Izumi, the head of Koudan-kai. Naturally, she is plotting something from the very start. Akiko Takakura and Rika Akamine are new teachers at that school as well. Me

title: The Pseudonym of "Ryuma"
author: Miyashita, Hiroki
description:
In a world where humanity has turned into prey against the so called "white skin" creatures, one legendary figure known simply as "Ryuuma" continues to give hope to this post-apocalyptic society. This individual has many faces and descriptions, but his/her legend has lived continuously in the hearts and minds of the people for half a century. No one knows where this legend started or who started it. Here starts a chronicle to unveil the mysteries of a legend.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Murikuri
author: CLAMP
description:
From Clamp no Lumiere:

Murikuri is the story of a popular pig, a pervert Santa Claus and his high school girlfriend, nice aliens and many more... It does not make sense and I would advise you to not try to understand it. Murikuri is to CLAMP what special Halloween is to the Simpsons, a collection of short gags.

title: Hajirau Kimi ga Mitainda
author: Umagome, Rakure
description:
Akito Shirasawa, a high school boy whose father is a film director, sees something in the library preparation room. It was the "masturbation scene" of his classmate, Kaho Honjou. Akito is puzzled, but ends up filming it with his smartphone. Kaho notices Akito, and in the men's restroom, makes a "proposal" to Akito! Exposed high school girl and movie boy. The "exposed love" of twisted adolescence, begins!

(Source: MU)

title: Dokumushi
author: Yazu, Michio, Aida, Keito
description: A group of very different people wake up together in the sealed environment of an abandoned school building. They include the college students Yumi and Reiji, a cabaret girl named Akane, an occult-obsessed salaryman named Yukitoshi, a punk factory worker named Toshio, an unemployed man named Taichi, and a 9-year-old girl named Michika. The building in which they find themselves has running water, no food, and a timer set for seven days. When they find a cleaver and a hot pot in an upstairs class

title: Netorare Manga no Kuzu Otoko ni Tensei shita Hazu ga Heroine ga Yottekuru Ken
author: Sumikawa, Haru, Myon
description:
I suddenly realized: I had been reincarnated as the scumbag whose role is to steal away the heroine of this ero-manga universe.  Well, that's not to my taste, so I figured let the heroine get along with the protagonist.  Or so I thought... Heroine, why are you paying so much attention to me!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Only I Know That Hinako Hirasaka Is Erotically Kawaii.
author: Konya, Yukio
description:
Eight years have passed since they promised the witch to keep loving each other. A little naughty love story where adolescent childhood friends secretly observe each other.

(Source: MU)

title: Shino Can't Say Her Name
author: Oshimi, Shuuzou
description: High school can be a stressful time for many young people. The change means a new commute, new friends, new courses...new teachers. For Shino Oshima the change could have meant an opportunity to blossom into adulthood. Unfortunately, things go wrong on her first day - she fails to even say her name during her homeroom introduction. From then on Shino is a part-mute part-stuttering mess. Ostracized and afraid she struggles to find her place in this new world... But thankfully for her, she finds h

title: Destiny Lovers
author: Tomohiro, Kai, Kazutaka
description: Long ago, Kosuke Fujishiro promised his love to his childhood friend, Sayaka-chan. But his pledge to save his first sexual experience for her takes a shocking turn when he's suddenly abducted and thrown into a secret prison—run by beautiful, terrifying women in fetish gear. His seductive kidnappers claim to have a higher purpose but are after one thing: Kosuke's virginity, and they're willing to employ every kink at their disposal. Who are these women, and why are they trying to break Kosuke's p

title: Love Is an Illusion!
author: Fargo
description:
Hye-sung spent his entire life believing he was an Alpha, the jackpot of the genetic lottery. But his world is flipped upside down when he finds out he isn't an Alpha, but a lowly Omega. This revelation is pushed to its limits when when he constantly crosses paths with Dojin, an Alpha who can't stand Omegas. Take a step into the omegaverse and find out what it is that makes their pulses race and their bodies go wild.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Bad Thinking Diary
author: Hodan, Rangrari
description:
High-spirited Kim Min-ji and striking beauty Kang Yu-na have been best friends since high school. Now in college, their friendship has deepened enough that Min-ji feels comfortable telling Yu-na she had a vivid and steamy dream about her. Min-ji is oblivious to the effect her confession has on Yu-na, but others notice that Yu-na is in love—and even seek to take advantage of it.

Min-ji, new to love and eager for experience, accepts a date with a man. But memories of her lustful dream and the way

title: Placebo
author: Oi Binu
description:
Woo-yeon has come to in a very compromising position in front of the people he loves. How is this possible? What's going on? And why is his brother, Woo-jin, whom he detests, here? This isn't right, it has to stop. But who's in control here? Is this all a dream? This is no ordinary family dinner...

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Make Me Bark
author: Sageum
description:
Everything seemed to be coming along for Bae Sungjoon. After graduation, Sungjoon moved to Seoul and through hard work, he saved enough money to finally afford a modest place on his own. But when a fire breaks out in his building, Sungjoon is once again left with nothing but a phone number of a former classmate—the privileged and wealthy Lee Hyo-in—whom he asks for help.

In order to get out of Hyo-in's hair as soon as possible, Sungjoon juggles multiple part-time jobs, which unsurprisingly wear

title: I Didn't Mean to Seduce the Male Lead!
author: Lazypiece, Salty
description:
Baroness Eleanor Mariche, renowned novelist and relationship expert, has been summoned by an ambitious duke to convince his son, Count Ryan Calabria, into marrying the princess. The problem is... not only does the count have no interest in the princess, he seems to have fallen for Eleanor instead! Now, she must deal with the wrath of his unhappy father, and also defend herself against a two-faced princess! Will she emerge victorious in this struggle for love and power?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Perfect Marriage Revenge
author: Yibambe, Jerryball
description:
When Han Iju married Jeong Sehyeok, it felt like a fairytale. After all, Iju is the heiress to a successful company and Sehyeok is the chauffeur's son. Sehyeok seemed like the perfect husband, always treating Iju with warmth and not caring about the difference in their stations. While Iju, reduced to living as a housewife with abusive in-laws, tolerated it all for her husband's sake. All that mattered was that they were together.

However, when Iju discovers that Sehyeok is actually in love with

title: Stranger Than Friends
author: Sageum, Yeoro
description:
Best friends is not a strong enough term to describe the bond Joo Yi-hyeok and Baek Inseo share. For as long as they can remember, they have been together. Nothing could ever shake their unbreakable friendship—until they share a kiss. Although Yi-hyeok quickly writes it off as just another one of Inseo's impulsive acts, he hates to admit just how much he loves it.

As Yi-hyeok and Inseo mindlessly continue to indulge the new, unfamiliar side of their relationship, Yi-hyeok wonders if it is truly

title: The Sweet Life of a Reincarnation Pro
author: Ebipo, Song, Suha
description: Arel may have been born as a prince of the Ernesia Kingdom, but this is actually his 101st life! He has been reborn into multiple types of universes that were full of magic, qi, and even spaceships. So this isn't his first fantasy world, and he's going to make use of his magic knowledge to take it easy. His past 100 lives have taught him that the best way to avoid dying young is to keep his head down and make lots of money. But let's see if this reincarnation pro can finally live the sweet life.

title: It's Not Your Baby!
author: Team Twinkle, Lee, Jihye
description:
As the most fearsome warrior of the Rohas Empire, Callia Taksecate never dared desire a family of her own. Women in her line of work are usually infertile, and Callia has dedicated her life to the empire. So, when she discovers she is pregnant, she can barely contain her joy. Her dreams are finally becoming a reality.

However, the child's father is Simon Tereloane, the most powerful magician and Callia's best friend, who absolutely despises children. His distinguished family would never allow f

title: The Lady I Served Became a Master
author: Tabby-ui Byeol, Sigma
description: When Sua wakes up inside the world of her favorite novel as the character of Blair, she is determined to help the female protagonist, Chloe, get through the darkest period of her life. For years, Chloe has had to endure discrimination and abuse for being an illegitimate child. Blair becomes her maid and confidante, and the two form a special friendship. But Chloe turns out to be quite a different character than the one described in the book. She wields black magic, sends Blair to fetch her myste

title: The Wicked Little Princess
author: Cha, Sohee, Hwasom, Chouchou
description: As the one and only fire witch in 300 years, Liona spends her life isolated from the world... until she falls for Rakus, prince of the Kingdom of Carrell. But after he betrays and kills her, she opens her eyes as the newborn baby princess of the Hasys Empire! With her OP-level strength and royal dragon-blood lineage, she's out for revenge against Rakus. To get there, she must first secretly harness her mana, find people she can trust, and defeat her 11 siblings to gain the power of the throne!

title: Precious Daughter of the Greatest Martial Arts Villain
author: Solddam, Ssalguksu
description: I've become a part of this Wuxia novel as Lihwa, the thoughtful and gentle daughter of Cheon Ma... who's also the ultimate villain! Known as the Demon King and ruthless leader of the Demonic Sect, he resorts to kidnapping and other nefarious deeds to make sure a boy named Ak Wuryeon never reaches his full potential. Wuryeon doesn't seem THAT bad, but I know he'll one day exact his revenge on my father and that includes me! Can I escape the clutches of my father's enemies and my doomed destiny be

title: The Fox-Eyed Villain of the Demon Academy
author: Cheon, Jinhui, Ahoe
description:
The very last moment before the novel was about to end... The strongest villain met a pitiful fate. But that wasn't the end.

"So, this is how I die."

I, who was once the author, woke up as the fox-eyed villian who was never once understood. A fallen family. A life thrown away for revenge. A future sealed in tragedy. I'm going to rewrite it all.This villain's end... will be reversed.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Am I Your Daughter?
author: Lee, Young-You, Flow
description: Adopted by the abusive Count Zackary, Hailynn is imprisoned for over a decade but a tragedy sets her back in time and she's now eight years old again! Eager to escape the horrors of her previous life, Hailynn runs away and crosses paths with a brave boy and the protective Duke Callisto. When a magical potion reveals she belongs to the powerful Callisto bloodline, the chaste Duke swears she can't be his! What is the secret behind Hailynn's birth? And will she ever find a family that'll love her?

title: I Woke Up as the Ugly Duckling
author: Jung, Haim, Kang, Seah
description: What good is being reborn as the duke's daughter when you're the shame of the family? While her siblings were talented and beautiful, poor Sylvia was called fat and ugly, with a rumored bad personality to boot. Acting out for her cold father's attention only got her exiled from home and made her take her own life. But when the new "Sylvia" wakes up five years before her death, she could care less about the snarky opinions of others—she'll live this life her own way. In a world crawling with demo

title: The Dragon King's Bride
author: Kanghee Jamae, Team Cappuccino
description: Ten years ago, a young girl saved the life of a dragon. Little did they know that they would be brought together again by the vicissitudes of fate, when Lucina's family estate is invaded by the fearsome Tayar nation led by King Hakan. After Lucina's selfish stepmother offers her up as a bride to Hakan in exchange for their lives, Lucina realizes that she is now fated to journey to the arid kingdom of Tayar and marry its seemingly brutish king. Will fate lead the unlikely pair to ruin or romance?

title: The Male Lead's Girl Friend
author: Ryu, Heon, Kakon
description: Waking up inside your favorite novel sounds like a dream come true. Unless you're born as the hated villainess, that is. Our new, full-fledged Louise Sweeny must try to reinvent her character to dodge her doomed fate of being killed off at the end of the story. It seemed easy enough at first, but there's one big problem. The story, which she knew like the back of her hand, has veered so far off course that she can't predict what plot twists are coming next. Can she avoid getting in the way of th

title: My Three Tyrant Brothers
author: Jomil, Parkha, Eundu
description: All members of the Ascania imperial family are cursed to die at the hands of a loved one, a curse only broken by the birth of a girl into the bloodline. So when a young slave girl with the telltale, color-changing Ascania eyes is discovered, she's declared Princess Chloe, the little sister of the three princes. She's excited to finally have a family, but her new brothers seem a bit strange... They've always had to be cold and unfeeling for their own protection, but will Chloe's arrival plant the

title: False Confession
author: Cooara, Haenok
description: "I think I've fallen for you." With a single drunken confession, Renesha's plans to live a comfortable and uneventful life were shattered. Somehow she confessed her love to the wrong man: the Grim Reaper of the Battlefield, Duke Cavert Willard! It's the worst thing to happen to her since she woke up in this fantasy universe and discovered her divine powers. In the midst of a war with a neighboring country, Renesha must balance her duties as a healer with her feelings for two alluring knights. Wh

title: Yours to Claim
author: Zzin-bam, Waje
description:
Nothing crazy ever happens to Jooin. He's just your average college student, keeping his head down and flying under the radar. Yahwi, on the other hand, is drop dead gorgeous, super popular...but also kinda mean. So why has the campus heartthrob taken an interest in a total nobody? There must be an ulterior motive...but it's hard to care when faced with those killer looks. Will Jooin become a slave to his desires? Or perhaps he'll become the master himself...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Leveling Up Alone
author: Sinfeel, Banggae
description:
Living in a world infested with monsters is hard enough, but doing it without powers? That's Hanyeol's life in a nutshell. Fearsome beasts roam the earth and kill everyone in their path. Elite members of society called the Awakened mobilize to protect humanity with their supernatural abilities. Amidst it all, Hanyeol is just a poor porter, tasked as sideline support. But when a benevolent being gifts him with special abilities, he's ready to harvest all the loot and take it to the next level!

(

title: I'm the Soldier's Ex-Girlfriend
author: Song, Seorim, Sete
description: Some women would kill to be the love interest of a book's charming protagonist, but Maise Hazelnut is different! As a girl from the 21st century, she struggles to keep up the appearance of the angelic "Maise" while defying the fate laid out for her by a harem romance novel. That's right, Maise's boyfriend is none other than the goofy and lovable protagonist, and every woman in the book has her eyes on him. Right after she dumps him to work toward her own happy ending, Maise gets set up on a blin

title: Secretly More Powerful than the Hero
author: Seunghan, Yelim
description: From a young age, I've always dreamed of being that "unassuming hero," appearing ordinary but possessing unmatched strength. But one day, fate took a turn when I was hit by an eight-ton truck, and suddenly, reincarnation was on the table! "What would you like to be in your next life?" asked the goddess of reincarnation. Eagerly, I replied, "I wish to become a wimp, but secretly OP!" She granted my wish, but with an unexpected twist: if anyone ever uncovers my true abilities, my heart will explod

title: Ultimate Outcast
author: No Do Hwan
description:
Most outcasts are ostracized because they look different, talk different, or live different. But not everyone. And not every previous outcast turns into a revenge machine. After seeing his friend suffer a horrific incident, the once outcast, Kang Haneul, decides to exact revenge with the help of an ability he never knew existed.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Beloved by the Male Lead's Nephew
author: Mokapanna, D.Rano
description:
One day, memories of my past life came to mind. In my second life, within a novel, I was the villainess who became obsessed with the male protagonist and met a self-destructive end. Living a peaceful life in the countryside, I was summoned by my father. The capital was in turmoil, and he wanted me to find the former prince...

As memories of my previous life resurfaced, the child I had picked up turned out to be the nephew of the male lead! But I had already sent a letter vowing to never bother

title: I Became a Childhood Friend of a Mid-Level Boss
author: Siyun, Yujeong
description:
Do Kyunwoo is the black sheep of his renowned swordsman family. He cannot even catch a rabbit on his own. On his first day of fifth grade, he meets a transfer student and recalls his past life. He had reincarnated into the world of a game he used to play called [Brave Hearts]. He was already frustrated that he had reincarnated as a loser, but on top of that, the transfer student is an intermediate/mid-tier boss who will destroy the world!

"Why are you being so nice to me?"

"Because I want to b

title: Adonis
author: Hyedori, Kyeol Jeong
description: Ianna and Arhad had much in common. They both only cared about themselves, and were madly obsessed with each other. The difference is one wanted the other's warmth, and the other wanted submission. Though Ianna's life ended in a heated battle against Arhad, the Kingdom's emperor, she is reincarnated into the same life for reasons unknown. Two people who faced misery in their previous life now have a chance to meet again. Will the same tragedy repeat itself, or can Ianna change the course of hist

title: He Does a Body Good
author: Lee, Won-Sik, Park, Hyeongjun
description:
To say that Hosang's luck with women throughout his life had been underwhelming would be an understatement. That all changes when he gets electrocuted by an electric mat that he bought from his old college friend Gahee. Armed with a newfound ability, Hosang embarks on a life that he had never even dreamed of...

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Holy Hella's Ultimate End
author: Sanji Jiksong, Midnight Studio
description: Kim Isaac, once the all-powerful Skeleton King, is now a baby in a onesie. Tricked by the gods and sealed away, he's reincarnated into a family of saints at the heart of the Holy Empire. He can't walk or talk, but he can plot. And with his loyal demon followers working from the shadows and a grudge deeper than the underworld itself, this baby isn't here to be cute—he's here for payback. The Holy Empire has no idea what's coming... and the gods are about to regret ever crossing the Skeleton King.

title: The Villainess's Daughter
author: Suncy, Kim, Jiho
description:
Born as the daughter of a villainess, Daphne lived her entire life hated by everyone she's ever crossed paths with. After her mother's pitiful death, Daphne knows that a similar fate awaits her⁠—but what did she ever do to deserve it? Why does she have to be branded as a wicked child when she's done no wrong? In order to survive, Daphne will have to take her life into her own hands... but will she be able to make a name for herself, or will she be known as the villainess's daughter forever?

(So

title: Window to Window
author: Lee, Aru
description:
Childhood friends Ginu and Yubin live in separate apartments in separate buildings right next to each other—so close, in fact, they can talk to each other and see into each other's apartments through their windows. But Yubin's long-held secret is revealed one day when Ginu sees him doing something naughty through the window...

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Double Click
author: Park, Subong, Kim, Janghun
description: What happens when you lose the one thing that you were the best in the world at? Jiho Seong was once a top-ranked player in the online action game, One Sword. When the game eventually shuts down due to a lack of players, he loses all interest in competitive gaming. That is, until he finds out that his school has an e-sports club and discovers a popular team-based game called Sword Rush, which seems to be an exact copy of One Sword. With new teammates now by his side, Jiho takes another shot at r

title: Adopted by a Murderous Duke Family
author: Rogang, Urang
description: After ten years of being exploited by Duke Gerwehr for her healing powers, Agnes meets her death in a dungeon. When she wakes up, she finds herself in her uncle's house before she was sold to Duke Gerwehr in the slave market. Desperate for her past life not to repeat itself, she lets Duke Rodwick adopt her and starts her new life with a new name, Tuariche Rodwick. Will she be able to keep her healing powers secret in this notorious family of assassins and find true happiness and love in her new

title: The Tyrant's Guardian Is an Evil Witch
author: Bluelagoon, Rata, Walpurgis
description: Clete's heart sinks when a little child shows up on her doorstep one day. The wide-eyed boy is none other than Alpen, the emperor's illegitimate son and her terrifying future killer. But as a powerful witch herself, Clete is not one to surrender to fate. She decides to raise him with warmth and kindness in the hopes that he will walk a different path in life this time. The only problem? She has no idea how to raise a human child! With the help of her loyal butler, she starts with the basics: rea

title: The Villain's Beloved Daughter
author: Yunon, Iring
description:
It's already unfair that I suffered greatly because I closely resembled the saintess, but why did the villain kill me without any mercy at all? No, actually, it said in the book that I was really bound to die. 'My life is already ruined. Of all things, why do I have to be the one to die a ridiculous death?' There's still hope! I haven't met any of the characters yet so I'll just run away! But why did the villain collapse in front of me...?

With a lot of effort, I barely saved the life of the vi

title: There Are No Bad Warriors in This World
author: Hanso, Yuryeong Dubu
description:
Hyeonseok Choi finally becomes the undisputed heavyweight MMA champion of the world, but gets hit by a truck, and dies. A fairy, Rahel, appears and convinces him to fight as a hero in the afterlife, but accidentally sends him to the side of the demons. Stuck in the demon world, he sweet talks his way into positions of power, but slowly discovers this battle between good and evil isn't as clearcut as it seems.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Reason She Lives as a Villainess
author: Yuwn, Beopsaeng
description: Some people would jump at the chance at a new life, but when Jeongyun wakes up after a terrible accident and finds that she has become Lecian Fucernien, a character of a cliche, romantic fantasy novel, it feels like she's woken up inside a nightmare. Disappointed as she is, she quickly accepts her fate and decides to make the best of her new life. The good news is that Lecian's character has a happy ending, but the bad news is that she's supposed to die once to get it. Between foiling her abusiv

title: The Newlywed Diary of a Witch and a Dragon
author: New Lung, Dimang, Baridal
description:
After watching the man who holds her affections walk down the aisle with another woman, Wendy Blanchett bids farewell to the love she had locked deep within her heart. One drunken mistake later, she wakes up naked in bed with Aiden Winters, the newest trainee at the Tower of Magic.

As his superior, Wendy is aghast at what she has done, offering to make it up to Aiden in any way possible. She is certain that he will only ask for money or a promotion—but against all expectations, Aiden demands th

title: Surviving as the Illegitimate Princess
author: Seo, Gyeol
description:
"Don't look down on me just because I'm a child! Even though I look like this, this is my 10th life!"

I'm an illegitimate princess whose life was cut short after being misunderstood for having the same blood as the enemy country and died early. After nine tragic repetitions, I discovered the identity of my biological father. He is Paeon, a war hero who defeated the demon king and the strongest holy knight in the continent. He had a forbidden relationship with the princess, had me, and then dese

title: The Duke's Cursed Charm
author: Lemon Gaeguri, Goyogom
description: Duke Carhel Luave is known as the devilish duke due to his uncontrollable magical ability to charm every single person who lays their eyes on him. But this is more of a curse than a blessing with several noble houses plotting to drive him out of power. Having no one he can genuinely like or trust, Carhel wonders if he will ever be able to feel the warmth of another human being. One day, after raiding the estate of one of his enemies, Carhel mistakenly has Lena, the house's maid, captured in the

title: The Challenger
author: TryTry, Keyboard
description: Noah's classmates can't even be bothered by him in real life, but inside the Interverse, he's the celebrated number one player. He may be applauded as a genius in-game, but the real world remains a cruel place for Noah... that is until he beats the school bully in an Interverse tournament. His talents are recognized by a mysterious professor who recruits him into an elite academy. As reality and the game world blur together, will Noah be able to make a stand for himself and challenge all expecta

title: The Nuna at Our Office
author: Palmeiro, Wasakbasak
description:
When Manager Son is sent to a new department, his boring office life takes a sweet turn. There, he meets Manager Ahn, an older colleague whose competence and charming aura leave him in awe. But as Manager Son grows closer to her, he realizes there's more to her strong, independent front than meets the eye. And soon enough, he begins to understand why office crushes can get complicated.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Surviving in a Romance Fantasy Novel
author: Korita, Sikppang
description:
I, Seo Taepyung, ended up transmigrating as the younger brother of the heroine in the fantasy romance novel Celestial Love. As romantic as this place is supposed to be, I was too busy just trying to adapt to my new life. Romance? Yeah, right. My goal was to keep a low profile and live quietly. But then...

"How could you make the crown princess fall for you of all people?!" At that point, I had no idea. I was only just beginning to scrape the surface of this bizarre turn of events...

(Source: K

title: I Don't Love You Anymore
author: Eun, Hayoon, Susu
description:
What happens after you fall out of love? Nevaeh Solene was engaged to the Duke, Baler Eustache. But for ten long winters, she endured in a relationship that was not meant to be. After calling off her engagement, Nevaeh moves to another country, hoping to lead a quiet life. But there she meets Emperor Arendt, who wants to give her the love she's never had. Will Nevaeh's eternal winter finally melt into the blossoms of spring?

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Harley Takes the House
author: Plutus, Min, Iyeong
description:
Harley thought that marriage would be her ticket out of the Ernst household and away from the family's three sons, aka her perpetual tormenters. But on the eve of her wedding, she's transported back in time 20 years to a youth she'd hoped to forget. As long as she's getting a second chance at childhood, Harley's determined to stand up to her bullies. But what began as retaliation quickly turns into reconciliation as both Harley and the Ernst brothers come to understand each other's pain.

(Sourc

title: I've Been Proposed to By a Villain
author: Sipsamwol-ui Saebyeok, Sadong
description: Whisked away into the novel The Forbidden Fruit of Isotta, and the body of Regina Blois, our female protagonist has the advantage of knowing how her story unfolds—which is that she is to be murdered by Duke Arsene Graroy! Her death moves the story forward and sets up her good friend and protagonist Isotta in a love triangle with the Emperor and the Duke when she tries to uncover the truth behind Regina's death. Not wanting to be murdered this time around, our new Regina keeps a low profile. She

title: The Frost Flower Knight
author: Jin, Juha, Towawa
description:
Yulia Von Rosenthal gave everything she had to serve her liege and love, Emperor Leonard, but she was rewarded with betrayal and death because of her "ugly" appearance, the result of an age-long family curse. Just when she thinks everything is over, Yulia finds herself alive, eight years before her death. Determined not to repeat her past mistakes, she ventures out on a journey to break her curse and become stronger. The question is, will that be enough for Yulia to escape Leonard's clutches?

(

title: Ghost King
author: Park, Jinseok, Son, Gohu
description: What if the world was divided into people with martial arts powers and people without? Taeyeon Kang was one of the lucky few born with such powers. He enrolls in Murim Police University, a special school for those with powers to stand on the side of justice... but he has a secret of his own. He's here to uncover the truth behind his father's disappearance as well as seek protection from the Evil Murim Faction which is after his family's secret book of martial arts techniques. At the same time, t

title: The Book of Lagier
author: Gongdeuntap, Siroo
description:
What happens when a good-for-nothing human prince signs a contract with an all-powerful Demon King? Well, the prince dies instantly, and the Demon King is forced to take his place. But wait, there's another catch! As the new Prince Lagier, the Demon King is obligated to fulfill the prince's last wishes or never return to his former body. Join the Demon King and his demon friends as he gets in shape, battles the Angels, and races against time to complete his missions before it's too late.

(Sourc

title: The Villainess Becomes the Leading Lady
author: Maru Gongbang, Yoo, Rinhae
description: Reborn into a fantasy novel as a wicked character fated to meet an early demise, Minjoo—now Dahlia Margaret—has a lot on her plate right from the start. But at least she's now free of her vicious high school bully, Sooyeon. Or is she? When Dahlia meets Flore, her estranged sister and the protagonist of the novel, she is shocked to find that the girl bears a suspicious resemblance to the classmate who tormented her. Now, driven by the desire to save her own life and also get revenge, Dahlia needs

title: Daisy: How to Become the Duke's Fiancée
author: Lisabel, Allyn, Yuzu
description: Sweet, timid Daisy meets a tragic end after being betrayed by the man she loves. When she is given a second chance at life, she vows not to repeat the same mistakes of the past! The only problem is that she must pay off her father's gambling debt to Kilian, an aristocrat with a terrifying reputation. One option will take her 60 years, and the other, just three... but it involves a contract marriage to Kilian, who must be three years married in order to inherit the title of duke. While Daisy has

title: The Status Window to the Soul
author: Yurisomsatang, Seori
description:
Princess Chervianne Aerveldote has lived a lonely life, and now she's being put to death for a crime she didn't commit. However, her execution turns out to be a fresh start when she wakes up as her 5-year-old self with an ability to read people's thoughts with status windows. Chervianne quickly learns how badly she misjudged everyone in the past, finding affection and betrayal in unexpected places. But will her newfound insight be enough to change her story and finally find love in her life?

(S

title: The Little Lady Behind the Villain
author: Super Hayang, Areca Yaja
